  AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES,
  validateAvatarsBucketUpload,
} from '../../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite =
  typeof g.describe === 'function'
    ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase =
  typeof g.it === 'function'
    ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const assertEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};

const collectSrcFiles = (dir: string): string[] => {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) {
      if (ent.name !== '__tests__') out.push(...collectSrcFiles(full));
    } else if (/\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(ent.name)) {
      out.push(full);
    }
  }
  return out;
};

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.8.2 — Ola 1 Blindaje P0 + Escrow 10 KC + Mazatlan 72h + Split 1/N + SAT 36% (500x)', () => {
  itCase('P1 (500x): Flash <3h en America/Mazatlan, Acceso Base === 0%, tope <= 40% y cuantizacion estricta 10 KC', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 300 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.constantFrom('Acceso Base', 'Free', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum'),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 75 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 5, max: 175 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1_780_000_000_000, max: 1_850_000_000_000 }),
        (baseKc, vipLevel, clubFlashPct, minsToStart, nowMs) => {
          const evParts = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs + minsToStart * 60_000));
          const res = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
            event: {
              precio_kc: baseKc,
              fecha_clase: evParts.isoDate,
              hora_inicio: evParts.hhmm,
              atributos: { descuento_flash_pct: clubFlashPct },
            },
            vipLevel,
            nowMs,
          });
          assertTrue(res.isFlashWindow, 'Session inside <3h Mazatlan window must activate Flash');
          assertTrue(res.discountPct <= 40, `Flash discount exceeded 40%: ${res.discountPct}`);
          if (vipLevel === 'Acceso Base' || vipLevel === 'Free') {
            assertEq(res.discountPct, 0, 'Acceso Base must ALWAYS receive 0% Flash discount');
            assertEq(res.discountedTotalKc, baseKc, 'Acceso Base pays full base price');
          }
          assertEq(res.discountedTotalKc % 10, 0, 'total_kc must be exact multiple of 10');
          assertEq(res.escrow40 % 10, 0, 'escrow_kc must be exact multiple of 10');
          assertEq(res.puerta60 % 10, 0, 'puerta_kc must be exact multiple of 10');
          assertEq(res.escrow40 + res.puerta60, res.discountedTotalKc, 'escrow + puerta must conserve total_kc');

          const outsideParts = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs + 190 * 60_000));
          const nonFlash = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
            event: { precio_kc: baseKc, fecha_clase: outsideParts.isoDate, hora_inicio: outsideParts.hhmm },
            vipLevel: 'Platinum',
            nowMs,
          });
          assertEq(nonFlash.isFlashWindow, false, 'Session >180m in Mazatlan must not trigger Flash');
          assertEq(nonFlash.discountPct, 0, 'Non-flash session must have 0% discount');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('P2 (500x): Ventana 72h / 4h exacta con hora_inicio real en America/Mazatlan (cero desfase 18h) y mes VIP', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 2026, max: 2028 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 12 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 28 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 23 }),
        fc.constantFrom(0, 15, 30, 45),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 120 }),
        fc.constantFrom('Acceso Base', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum'),
        (yr, mo, dy, hh, mm, deltaHours, vipLevel) => {
          const ymd = `${yr}-${String(mo).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(dy).padStart(2, '0')}`;
          const hms = `${String(hh).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mm).padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
          const expectedMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(yr, mo, dy, hh, mm, 0, 0);
          const resolvedMs = resolveMazatlanSessionInstantMs({ fecha_clase: ymd, hora_inicio: hms }, null);
          assertEq(resolvedMs, expectedMs, 'Mazatlan timestamp drifted from real hora_inicio');

          const nowExact4hBefore = expectedMs - 4 * 3600_000;
          const hrs4 = computeHoursUntilMazatlanSession({ fecha_clase: ymd, hora_inicio: hms }, null, nowExact4hBefore);
          assertTrue(Math.abs(hrs4 - 4) < 1e-6, '4h boundary must be exact in Mazatlan');

          const nowProbe = expectedMs - deltaHours * 3600_000;
          const hrsLeft = computeHoursUntilMazatlanSession({ fecha_clase: ymd }, { hora_inicio: hms }, nowProbe);
          assertTrue(Math.abs(hrsLeft - deltaHours) < 1e-6, 'Service hora_inicio fallback drifted');

          const polUnder4h = evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy({
            hoursUntilEvent: 3.9,
            minutesSinceCreated: 60,
            vipLevel,
            usedForgivenessCount: 0,
            montoEscrow: 80,
          });
          assertEq(polUnder4h.shouldRefund, false, '<4h must strictly retain 40% Escrow');
          assertEq(polUnder4h.isUnder4hWindow, true, '<4h must flag under4hWindow');

          const lateUtcEndOfMonth = Date.UTC(2026, 11, 1, 2, 0, 0); // 2026-11-30 19:00 Mazatlan
          assertEq(resolveMazatlanMonthKey(lateUtcEndOfMonth), '2026-11', 'Month key must use America/Mazatlan');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('P3 (500x): Split-Escrow 1/N cuantiza a 10 KC, conserva masa monetaria exacta y bloquea doble reembolso y B2B', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 80 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.integer({ min: 2, max: 4 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 500, max: 5000 }),
        fc.array(fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 2000 }), { minLength: 3, maxLength: 3 }),
        fc.array(fc.boolean(), { minLength: 3, maxLength: 3 }),
        fc.array(fc.boolean(), { minLength: 3, maxLength: 3 }),
        fc.boolean(),
        (escrowKc, splitCount, hostBal, guestBals, acceptFlags, b2bFlags, cancelWithRefund) => {
          const share = quantizeSplitEscrowShare10Kc(escrowKc, splitCount);
          assertEq(share % 10, 0, 'Split share must be multiple of 10 KC');
          assertTrue(share * (splitCount - 1) <= escrowKc, 'Guest shares sum must never exceed escrowKc');

          const sim = simulateSplitEscrow1NSettlement({
            hostInitialBalance: Math.max(hostBal, escrowKc),
            guestInitialBalances: guestBals,
            guestIsB2BFlags: b2bFlags,
            escrowTotalKc: escrowKc,
            splitCount,
            acceptFlags,
            cancelWithRefund,
          });
          assertEq(sim.totalSystemDelta, 0, 'Split-Escrow 1/N must conserve exact monetary mass (sum deltas === 0)');
          assertTrue(sim.hostNetRefundedKc + sim.guestsRefundedKc <= escrowKc, 'Refunds cannot exceed original escrow');
          if (cancelWithRefund) {
            assertEq(sim.hostNetRefundedKc, escrowKc - sim.guestsRefundedKc, 'Host only receives net remainder');
          }
          b2bFlags.forEach((isB2B, idx) => {
            if (isB2B && idx < splitCount - 1) {
              assertEq(sim.guestFinalBalances[idx], Math.max(0, Math.round(guestBals[idx])), 'B2B account must not settle split');
            }
          });
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('P4 (500x): Matriz fiscal SAT obliga 36.0% sin RFC valido, 0.0% PM 12 chars y 10.1% PF 13 chars', () => {
    const invalidRfcs = ['', '   ', 'XAXX010101000', 'XEXX010101000', 'INVALID123', 'ABC991332XYZ', 'KIN260230AA1'];
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom(...invalidRfcs),
        fc.constantFrom('persona_moral', 'persona_fisica_con_rfc', 'sin_rfc', '601 - Persona Moral', ''),
        fc.integer({ min: 10, max: 400 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        (badRfc, spoofedRegimen, priceKc) => {
          const satBad = resolveSatRetentionRates(badRfc, spoofedRegimen, true);
          assertEq(satBad.regimen, 'sin_rfc', 'Invalid/generic RFC must resolve to sin_rfc');
          assertEq(satBad.totalPct, 36, 'Invalid/generic RFC must enforce 36.0% SAT retention');
          assertEq(satBad.tasaIsr, 20, 'Invalid/generic RFC ISR must be 20%');
          assertEq(satBad.tasaIva, 16, 'Invalid/generic RFC IVA must be 16%');

          const pm = resolveSatRetentionRates('KIN260101AAA', 'sin_rfc', false);
          assertEq(pm.regimen, 'persona_moral', 'Valid 12-char PM RFC resolves to persona_moral');
          assertEq(pm.totalPct, 0, 'Valid PM RFC retention must be 0.0%');

          const pf = resolveSatRetentionRates('GODE561231GR8', 'persona_moral', false);
          assertEq(pf.regimen, 'persona_fisica_con_rfc', 'Valid 13-char PF RFC resolves to persona_fisica_con_rfc');
          assertEq(pf.totalPct, 10.1, 'Valid PF RFC retention must be 10.1%');

          const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
          const cut = calcularCorteSemanalB2B(
            [{ id: 'af-bad', nombre: 'Club Sin RFC', estado: 'activo', rfc: badRfc, regimen_fiscal: spoofedRegimen, csf_validada: true }],
            [{ id: 'r1', negocio_nombre: 'Club Sin RFC', estado: 'completada', precio_kc: priceKc, costo_total: priceKc, updated_at: nowIso, fecha_clase: nowIso.slice(0, 10) }]
          );
          const c = cut.cortes_por_afiliado[0];
          const expectedRet = Number((Number((c.subtotal_socio_80_mxn * 0.2).toFixed(2)) + Number((c.subtotal_socio_80_mxn * 0.16).toFixed(2))).toFixed(2));
          assertEq(c.total_retenciones_sat_mxn, expectedRet, 'Cut engine must apply exact 36% SAT retention');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('P5 (500x): Avatars XSS/8MB + Boveda Sandbox Anti-Downgrade/+20% + Idempotencia Stripe + Sello qr_token', () => {
    const uid = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom('svg', 'svgz', 'html', 'htm', 'xhtml', 'xml', 'js', 'mjs', 'cjs', 'php', 'exe', 'sh'),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4_000_000 }),
        fc.constantFrom('topup_100', 'topup_250', 'topup_500', 'topup_1000'),
        fc.uuid(),
        (badExt, doubleExt, extraBytes, topupId, piSuffix) => {
          const badName = doubleExt ? `${uid}/evil.${badExt}.jpg` : `${uid}/evil.${badExt}`;
          assertEq(
            validateAvatarsBucketUpload({ objectName: badName, authUid: uid, mimeType: 'image/jpeg', byteLength: 1024 }).ok,
            false,
            `Dangerous extension ${badName} must be rejected`
          );
          assertEq(
            validateAvatarsBucketUpload({ objectName: `${uid}/ok.jpg`, authUid: uid, mimeType: 'image/svg+xml', byteLength: 1024 }).ok,
            false,
            'image/svg+xml MIME must be rejected'
          );
          assertEq(
            validateAvatarsBucketUpload({ objectName: `${uid}/big.jpg`, authUid: uid, mimeType: 'image/jpeg', byteLength: AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES + extraBytes }).ok,
            false,
            'Payload > 8MB must be rejected'
          );
          assertEq(
            validateAvatarsBucketUpload({ objectName: `${uid}/ok.jpg`, authUid: uid, mimeType: 'image/jpeg', byteLength: AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES }).ok,
            true,
            'Valid 8MB JPEG in own folder must pass'
          );

          const downRes = simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase({ planId: 'silver', tipo: 'membresia', currentLevel: 'Gold', kcMembresia: 2500 });
          assertEq(downRes.ok, false, 'Gold -> Silver paid sandbox purchase must fail');
          assertEq(downRes.errorCode, 'MEMBERSHIP_DOWNGRADE_OR_SAME_TIER_FORBIDDEN', 'Downgrade error code mismatch');

          const blackDownRes = simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase({ planId: 'bronze', tipo: 'membresia', currentLevel: 'Black', kcMembresia: 3600 });
          assertEq(blackDownRes.ok, false, 'Black -> Bronze paid sandbox purchase must fail');
          assertEq(blackDownRes.errorCode, 'MEMBERSHIP_DOWNGRADE_OR_SAME_TIER_FORBIDDEN', 'Black downgrade error code mismatch');

          const upRes = simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase({ planId: 'platinum', tipo: 'membresia', currentLevel: 'Gold', kcMembresia: 2500 });
          assertTrue(upRes.ok && upRes.kcInyectados === 1100 && upRes.montoMxn === 1071, 'Gold -> Platinum delta must be 1100 KC / 1071 MXN');

          const topBase = simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase({ planId: topupId, tipo: 'topup', currentLevel: 'Acceso Base' });
          const topVip = simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase({ planId: topupId, tipo: 'topup', currentLevel: 'Bronze' });
          assertEq(topBase.montoMxn, Number((topBase.kcInyectados * 1.2).toFixed(2)), 'Base topup must include +20% fee');
          assertEq(topVip.montoMxn, topVip.kcInyectados, 'VIP topup must maintain 1:1 parity');
          assertEq(simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase({ planId: 'topup_50', tipo: 'topup', currentLevel: 'Acceso Base' }).ok, false, 'Legacy topup_50 must be rejected');

          const pi = `pi_${piSuffix.replace(/-/g, '')}`;
          const ledger = simulateStripeWebhookReceiptLedger([
            { eventId: `evt_a_${piSuffix}`, paymentIntentId: pi, userId: uid, billetera: 'topup', kcInyectados: 100, montoMxn: 120 },
            { eventId: `evt_a_${piSuffix}`, paymentIntentId: pi, userId: uid, billetera: 'topup', kcInyectados: 100, montoMxn: 120 },
            { eventId: `evt_b_${piSuffix}`, paymentIntentId: pi, userId: uid, billetera: 'topup', kcInyectados: 100, montoMxn: 120 },
          ]);
          assertEq(ledger.processedEventIds.length, 2, 'Duplicate event_id ignored');
          assertEq(ledger.receipts.length, 1, 'Unique stripe_payment_intent_id enforces single receipt');
          assertEq(ledger.totalCreditedKc, 100, 'Unique stripe_payment_intent_id credits KC only once');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );

    const expectedMazatlanEveningMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(2026, 11, 21, 19, 0, 0, 0);
    assertEq(
      resolveMazatlanSessionInstantMs({ fecha_clase: '2026-11-22T02:00:00Z' }),
      expectedMazatlanEveningMs,
      'ISO Z timestamp without hora_inicio must resolve exact Mazatlan instant'
    );
    assertEq(
      parseEventStartTimestampMazatlanMs({ fecha_clase: '2026-11-22T02:00:00Z' }),
      expectedMazatlanEveningMs,
      'Flash parser on ISO Z timestamp without hora_inicio must resolve exact Mazatlan instant'
    );

    const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
    const sqlTxt = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(root, 'supabase', 'migrations', '20261121180000_migration_v282_ola1_p0_escrow_storage_sat.sql'),
      'utf8'
    );
    assertTrue(sqlTxt.includes("column_name <> 'qr_token'"), 'SQL migration must exclude qr_token from reservas SELECT grant');
    assertTrue(sqlTxt.includes('obtener_semilla_qr_reserva_propia'), 'SQL migration must define owner QR seed RPC');
    const srcFiles = collectSrcFiles(path.join(root, 'src'));
    for (const file of srcFiles) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
      assertTrue(!/\.from\(\s*['"]reservas['"]\s*\)\s*\.select\([^)]*\*/.test(content), `Wildcard select(*) on reservas in ${file}`);
      assertTrue(!/\.from\(\s*['"]reservas['"]\s*\)\s*\.select\([^)]*qr_token/.test(content), `Direct qr_token select on reservas in ${file}`);
    }
  });
});

describe('KINETIC v2.8.3 Ola 1 — SWR <300ms, Shimmer 60fps, Google Vector Map & Native/UGC Shield', () => {
  it('Pillar 1 (500x PBT): Reconciliación optimista Mi Bóveda (<15000ms), deduplicación y purga cross-account SWR', async () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.uuid(),
        fc.stringMatching(/^[a-z0-9]{4,10}$/),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 14_900 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 15_001, max: 60_000 }),
        (uid, srvId, freshAgeMs, staleAgeMs) => {
          const baseNow = 1_800_000_000_000;
          const freshOpt: IBovedaPassRow = {
            id: `opt_${srvId}_1`,
            usuario_id: uid,
            servicio_id: srvId,
            fecha_hora: '2026-12-01T10:00:00Z',
            isOptimistic: true,
            optimisticCreatedAtMs: baseNow - freshAgeMs,
          };
          const staleOpt: IBovedaPassRow = {
            id: `opt_${srvId}_stale`,
            usuario_id: uid,
            servicio_id: `${srvId}_old`,
            fecha_hora: '2026-12-02T11:00:00Z',
            isOptimistic: true,
            optimisticCreatedAtMs: baseNow - staleAgeMs,
          };

          const preserved = reconcileBovedaSwrWithServerRows([freshOpt, staleOpt], [], baseNow, 15_000);
          expectTrue(preserved.some((p) => p.id === freshOpt.id), 'Pase optimista <15s debe sobrevivir si servidor aún no replica');
          expectTrue(!preserved.some((p) => p.id === staleOpt.id), 'Pase optimista >=15s huérfano debe expirar');

          const replicatedRow: IBovedaPassRow = {
            id: `real_${srvId}`,
            usuario_id: uid,
            servicio_id: srvId,
            fecha_hora: '2026-12-01T10:00:00Z',
          };
          const deduped = reconcileBovedaSwrWithServerRows([freshOpt], [replicatedRow], baseNow, 15_000);
          expectTrue(deduped.length === 1 && deduped[0].id === replicatedRow.id, 'Pase optimista ya replicado debe deduplicarse 1x1');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );

    setExploreSwrSync({ afiliados: [{ id: 'a1' }], servicios: [{ id: 's1' }], fetchedAt: Date.now() }, false);
    setEventosSwrSync({ servData: [{ id: 'e1' }], afData: [], resData: [], fetchedAt: Date.now() }, false);
    setAdminHubSwrSync('uid_a', { ugcPendingCount: 2 }, false);
    setB2BDashboardSwrSync('uid_a', { afData: [{ id: 'c1' }] });
    expectTrue(Boolean(getExploreSwrSync() && getEventosSwrSync() && getAdminHubSwrSync('uid_a') && getB2BDashboardSwrSync('uid_a')), 'SWR debe poblar RAM');

    runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks();
    purgeAllSwrMemoryHub();
    expectTrue(
      getExploreSwrSync() === null &&
        getEventosSwrSync() === null &&
        getAdminHubSwrSync('uid_a') === null &&
        getB2BDashboardSwrSync('uid_a') === undefined,
      'SignOut debe purgar 100% de cachés SWR en RAM'
    );
    expectTrue(PREFETCH_BRANCH_TIMEOUT_MS <= 4500, 'Prefetch debe limitar cada rama <= 4500ms');

    let rejectedSlow = false;
    try {
      await withPrefetchBranchTimeout(new Promise(() => {}), 300);
    } catch {

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/ola2V282HermesGraphAuthBio.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import ts from 'typescript';
import { evaluateAccountDeletionResponse } from '../../services/bovedaService';
import { resolveInitialOidcProfileWaiverState } from '../../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import {
  canPersistSessionInBiometricVault,
  parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap,
  serializeEncryptedBiometricVaultMap,
  type IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry,
} from '../../services/kineticBiometricVaultService';
import { resolveGoogleWebClientId } from '../../services/kineticGoogleOidcService';
import { doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, extractJwtAal } from '../../services/kineticMfaPureGuards';
import { CIPHER_PREFIX } from '../../services/kineticVaultCrypto';

interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  statSync(p: string): { isFile(): boolean; isDirectory(): boolean };
  readdirSync(p: string, opts: { withFileTypes: true }): { name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }[];
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
}
interface NodePathModule {
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
  dirname(p: string): string;
  relative(from: string, to: string): string;
  sep: string;
}
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite =
  typeof g.describe === 'function'
    ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase =
  typeof g.it === 'function'
    ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void)
    : (_name: string, fn: () => void) => fn();

const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const assertEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};

const toB64Url = (raw: string): string =>
  btoa(raw).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/g, '');

const makeFakeJwt = (aal: 'aal1' | 'aal2'): string => {
  const hdr = toB64Url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }));
  const pay = toB64Url(JSON.stringify({ sub: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', aal }));
  return `${hdr}.${pay}.sig1234567890abcdef`;
};

function scanSrcRuntimeCycles(srcRoot: string): { astCycles: string[][]; rtCycles: string[][] } {
  const allFiles: string[] = [];
  const walk = (d: string) => {
    for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const full = path.join(d, ent.name);
      if (ent.isDirectory()) {
        if (ent.name !== '__tests__') walk(full);
      } else if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(ent.name) && !ent.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
        allFiles.push(path.resolve(full));
      }
    }
  };
  walk(srcRoot);

  const resolveLocal = (fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null => {
    if (!spec || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('@/'))) return null;
    const base = spec.startsWith('@/')
      ? path.join(srcRoot, spec.slice(2))
      : path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), spec);
    const cands = [
      base, `${base}.ts`, `${base}.tsx`, `${base}.js`, `${base}.jsx`,
      path.join(base, 'index.ts'), path.join(base, 'index.tsx'), path.join(base, 'index.js'),
    ];
    for (const c of cands) {
      if (fs.existsSync(c) && fs.statSync(c).isFile()) return path.resolve(c);
    }
    return null;
  };

  const astAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const rtAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const f of allFiles) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
    const astDeps = new Set<string>();
    const sf = ts.createSourceFile(
      f, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true,
      f.endsWith('.tsx') || f.endsWith('.jsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS
    );
    const visitAst = (node: ts.Node) => {
      if (ts.isImportDeclaration(node) && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
        const cl = node.importClause;
        if (cl) {
          if (cl.isTypeOnly) return;
          const hasDefault = Boolean(cl.name);
          const nb = cl.namedBindings;
          if (!hasDefault && nb && ts.isNamedImports(nb) && !nb.elements.some((el) => !el.isTypeOnly)) return;
        }
        const r = resolveLocal(f, node.moduleSpecifier.text);
        if (r) astDeps.add(r);
      } else if (ts.isExportDeclaration(node) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
        if (node.isTypeOnly) return;
        if (node.exportClause && ts.isNamedExports(node.exportClause) && node.exportClause.elements.every((el) => el.isTypeOnly)) return;
        const r = resolveLocal(f, node.moduleSpecifier.text);
        if (r) astDeps.add(r);
      } else if (
        ts.isCallExpression(node) && ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) &&
        node.expression.text === 'require' && node.arguments.length === 1 && ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0])
      ) {
        const r = resolveLocal(f, node.arguments[0].text);
        if (r) astDeps.add(r);
      }
      ts.forEachChild(node, visitAst);
    };
    visitAst(sf);
    astAdj.set(f, [...astDeps]);

    const cjs = ts.transpileModule(content, {
      compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.React, esModuleInterop: true },
      fileName: f,
    }).outputText;
    const rtDeps = new Set<string>();
    const cjsSf = ts.createSourceFile(`${f}.js`, cjs, ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, true, ts.ScriptKind.JS);
    const visitRt = (node: ts.Node) => {
      if (
        ts.isCallExpression(node) && ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) &&
        node.expression.text === 'require' && node.arguments.length === 1 && ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0])
      ) {
        const r = resolveLocal(f, node.arguments[0].text);
        if (r) rtDeps.add(r);
      }
      ts.forEachChild(node, visitRt);
    };
    visitRt(cjsSf);
    rtAdj.set(f, [...rtDeps]);
  }

  const findSccs = (adj: Map<string, string[]>): string[][] => {
    let idx = 0;
    const indices = new Map<string, number>();
    const lowlink = new Map<string, number>();
    const stack: string[] = [];
    const onStack = new Set<string>();
    const sccs: string[][] = [];
    const sc = (v: string) => {
      indices.set(v, idx);
      lowlink.set(v, idx);
      idx += 1;
      stack.push(v);
      onStack.add(v);
      for (const w of adj.get(v) || []) {
        if (!indices.has(w)) {
          sc(w);
          lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v)!, lowlink.get(w)!));
        } else if (onStack.has(w)) {
          lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v)!, indices.get(w)!));
        }
      }
      if (lowlink.get(v) === indices.get(v)) {
        const comp: string[] = [];
        while (true) {
          const w = stack.pop()!;
          onStack.delete(w);
          comp.push(w);
          if (w === v) break;
        }
        if (comp.length > 1 || (adj.get(v) || []).includes(v)) {
          sccs.push(comp.map((p) => path.relative(srcRoot, p)));
        }
      }
    };
    for (const v of adj.keys()) {
      if (!indices.has(v)) sc(v);
    }
    return sccs;
  };
  return { astCycles: findSccs(astAdj), rtCycles: findSccs(rtAdj) };
}

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.8.2 — Ola 2 Hermes 0-Cycles, Biometric Refresh Vault, Account Deletion & OIDC Waiver', () => {
  itCase('G1: Grafo 100% aciclico en todo src/ (0 ciclos AST no-tipo ni CommonJS transpiled)', () => {
    const srcRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
    const { astCycles, rtCycles } = scanSrcRuntimeCycles(srcRoot);
    assertEq(astCycles.length, 0, `AST runtime cycles found: ${JSON.stringify(astCycles)}`);
    assertEq(rtCycles.length, 0, `Transpiled CJS cycles found: ${JSON.stringify(rtCycles)}`);
  });

  itCase('P1 (500x): Boveda biometrica cifra refresh_token con salt, purga secrets y aplica candado MFA AAL2', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.uuid(),
        fc.emailAddress(),
        fc.string({ minLength: 16, maxLength: 64 }).filter((s) => !s.includes('"') && !s.includes('\\') && s.trim().length >= 16),
        fc.string({ minLength: 12, maxLength: 32 }).filter((s) => !s.startsWith('diff_')),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.constantFrom<'aal1' | 'aal2'>('aal1', 'aal2'),
        (userId, rawEmail, refreshToken, salt, biometriaActiva, hasVerifiedTotp, aal) => {
          const email = rawEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
          const dirtyEntry = {
            userId,
            email,
            refreshToken,
            updatedAt: '2026-11-21T20:00:00.000Z',
            password: 'LEAKED_PASSWORD_FORBIDDEN',
            access_token: 'LEAKED_AT_FORBIDDEN',
          } as unknown as IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry;
          const mapWithPoison = {
            [email]: dirtyEntry,
            __proto__: dirtyEntry,
            constructor: dirtyEntry,
          } as Record<string, IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry>;

          const cipher = serializeEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(mapWithPoison, salt);
          assertTrue(cipher.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX), 'Vault cipher must carry encrypted prefix');
          assertTrue(!cipher.includes(refreshToken.trim()), 'Ciphertext must never expose raw refresh_token');
          assertTrue(!cipher.includes('LEAKED_PASSWORD_FORBIDDEN'), 'Serializer must strip forbidden password field');
          assertTrue(!cipher.includes('LEAKED_AT_FORBIDDEN'), 'Serializer must strip forbidden access_token field');

          const decoded = parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(cipher, salt);
          assertEq(decoded[email]?.userId, userId, 'Roundtrip userId mismatch');
          assertEq(decoded[email]?.refreshToken, refreshToken.trim(), 'Roundtrip refreshToken mismatch');
          assertEq(Object.keys(decoded).length, 1, 'Poisoned keys must never persist after decryption');

          const wrongDecoded = parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(cipher, `wrong_${salt}`);
          assertEq(Object.keys(wrongDecoded).length, 0, 'Wrong salt decryption must fail closed');

          const jwt = makeFakeJwt(aal);
          const allowed = canPersistSessionInBiometricVault({
            biometriaActiva,
            hasVerifiedTotpFactor: hasVerifiedTotp,
            session: {
              access_token: jwt,
              refresh_token: refreshToken,
              user: {
                id: userId,
                email,
                factors: hasVerifiedTotp ? [{ status: 'verified', factor_type: 'totp' }] : [],
              },
            },
          });
          const expectedAllowed = biometriaActiva && (!hasVerifiedTotp || aal === 'aal2');
          assertEq(allowed, expectedAllowed, 'Biometric persistence must enforce opt-in and MFA AAL2 lock');

          const syntheticBlocked = canPersistSessionInBiometricVault({
            biometriaActiva: true,
            hasVerifiedTotpFactor: false,
            session: {
              access_token: 'kinetic-local-bypass-token',
              refresh_token: refreshToken,
              user: { id: userId, email, factors: [] },
            },
          });
          assertEq(syntheticBlocked, false, 'Synthetic tokens must never persist in biometric vault');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('P2 (500x): evaluateAccountDeletionResponse siempre es fail-closed ante PGRST202, HTTP>=400 o payload invalido', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<number | undefined>(undefined, 200, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 503),
        fc.constantFrom<string | null>(null, 'PGRST202', 'MFA_AAL2_REQUIRED', 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'SERVER_ERROR'),
        fc.oneof(
          fc.constant(null),
          fc.constant({ ok: false }),
          fc.constant({ ok: 'true' }),
          fc.record({ ok: fc.boolean(), deletedUserId: fc.uuid() })
        ),
        (status, errCode, data) => {
          const error = errCode ? { code: errCode, message: errCode } : null;
          const res = evaluateAccountDeletionResponse({ status, error, data });
          const hasHttpErr = typeof status === 'number' && status >= 400;
          const bodyOk = Boolean(data && typeof data === 'object' && (data as { ok?: unknown }).ok === true);
          const shouldSucceed = !hasHttpErr && !error && bodyOk;
          assertEq(res.ok, shouldSucceed, 'Deletion response evaluation violated fail-closed invariant');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: 500 }
    );
  });

  itCase('P3 (500x): resolveInitialOidcProfileWaiverState exige opt-in para nuevos usuarios OIDC y preserva firmas en DB', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.option(
          fc.record({
            waiver_firmado: fc.oneof(fc.boolean(), fc.constant(null)),
            waiver_fecha: fc.option(fc.constant('2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z'), { nil: null }),
          }),
          { nil: null }
        ),
        fc.boolean(),
        (existingProfile, explicitWaiverAccepted) => {
          const out = resolveInitialOidcProfileWaiverState({
            existingProfile,

          });
          if (existingProfile?.waiver_firmado === true) {

  existsSync(p: string): boolean;

interface NodePath {

declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;

const collectSrcFiles = (dir: string): string[] => {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }) as Array<{ name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }>;
  for (const e of entries) {
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) out.push(...collectSrcFiles(full));
    else if (/\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(e.name)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
};

const resolveRelativeImport = (fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null => {
  if (!spec.startsWith('.')) return null;
  const base = path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), spec);
  const candidates = [base, `${base}.ts`, `${base}.tsx`, path.join(base, 'index.ts'), path.join(base, 'index.tsx')];
  for (const c of candidates) {
    if (fs.existsSync(c)) return c;
  }
  return null;
};

interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  statSync(p: string): { isFile(): boolean; isDirectory(): boolean; size: number };
  readdirSync(p: string, opts: { withFileTypes: true }): { name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }[];
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
}
interface NodePathModule {
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
  dirname(p: string): string;
  relative(from: string, to: string): string;
}
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite = typeof g.describe === 'function' ? (g.describe as (name: string, fn: () => void) => void) : (_n: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase = typeof g.it === 'function' ? (g.it as (name: string, fn: () => unknown) => void) : (_n: string, fn: () => unknown) => fn();
const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => { if (!cond) throw new Error(msg); };
const assertEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');

  'supabase/functions/admin-provision-b2b-operator/index.ts', 'supabase/functions/stripe-create-payment/index.ts',
];
const PLATFORM_EXTS = ['', '.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.web.ts', '.web.tsx', '.native.ts', '.native.tsx', '.ios.ts', '.ios.tsx', '.android.ts', '.android.tsx'];

function walkFiles(dir: string, exts: RegExp, skipTests = false): string[] {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) {
      if (ent.name === 'node_modules' || (skipTests && ent.name === '__tests__')) continue;
      out.push(...walkFiles(full, exts, skipTests));
    } else if (exts.test(ent.name) && !ent.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
      out.push(path.resolve(full));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function resolvePlatformMatches(fromFile: string, spec: string): string[] {
  if (!spec || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('@/'))) return [];
  const base = spec.startsWith('@/') ? path.join(SRC_ROOT, spec.slice(2)) : path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), spec);
  const matches: string[] = [];
  for (const ext of PLATFORM_EXTS) {
    const cand = ext ? `${base}${ext}` : base;
    if (fs.existsSync(cand) && fs.statSync(cand).isFile()) matches.push(path.resolve(cand));
  }
  for (const idxExt of ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.web.ts', '.web.tsx']) {
    const cand = path.join(base, `index${idxExt}`);
    if (fs.existsSync(cand) && fs.statSync(cand).isFile()) matches.push(path.resolve(cand));
  }
  return [...new Set(matches)];
}

function extractSpecs(filePath: string, content: string, includeTypeImports = false): string[] {
  const kind = filePath.endsWith('.tsx') || filePath.endsWith('.jsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(filePath, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kind);
  const specs: string[] = [];
  const visit = (node: ts.Node) => {
    if (ts.isImportDeclaration(node) && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
      const cl = node.importClause;
      if (!includeTypeImports && cl) {
        if (cl.isTypeOnly) return;
        const nb = cl.namedBindings;
        if (!cl.name && nb && ts.isNamedImports(nb) && !nb.elements.some((el) => !el.isTypeOnly)) return;
      }
      specs.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (ts.isExportDeclaration(node) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
      if (!includeTypeImports) {
        if (node.isTypeOnly) return;
        if (node.exportClause && ts.isNamedExports(node.exportClause) && node.exportClause.elements.every((el) => el.isTypeOnly)) return;
      }
      specs.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (
      ts.isCallExpression(node) &&
      node.arguments.length >= 1 &&
      ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0]) &&
      ((ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) && node.expression.text === 'require') || node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword)
    ) {
      specs.push(node.arguments[0].text);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return specs;
}

function auditCyclesAndReachability() {
  const srcFiles = walkFiles(SRC_ROOT, /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, true);
  const astAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const rtAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const fullAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const f of srcFiles) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
    const astDeps = new Set<string>();
    const fullDeps = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of extractSpecs(f, content, false)) { const m = resolvePlatformMatches(f, s); if (m[0]) astDeps.add(m[0]); }
    for (const s of extractSpecs(f, content, true)) { for (const m of resolvePlatformMatches(f, s)) fullDeps.add(m); }
    astAdj.set(f, [...astDeps]);
    fullAdj.set(f, [...fullDeps]);
    const cjs = ts.transpileModule(content, {
      compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.React, esModuleInterop: true },
      fileName: f,
    }).outputText;
    const rtDeps = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of extractSpecs(`${f}.js`, cjs, true)) { const m = resolvePlatformMatches(f, s); if (m[0]) rtDeps.add(m[0]); }
    rtAdj.set(f, [...rtDeps]);
  }
  const findSccs = (adj: Map<string, string[]>): string[][] => {
    let idx = 0;
    const indices = new Map<string, number>(), lowlink = new Map<string, number>(), stack: string[] = [], onStack = new Set<string>(), sccs: string[][] = [];
    const sc = (v: string) => {
      indices.set(v, idx); lowlink.set(v, idx); idx += 1; stack.push(v); onStack.add(v);
      for (const w of adj.get(v) || []) {
        if (!indices.has(w)) { sc(w); lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v)!, lowlink.get(w)!)); }
        else if (onStack.has(w)) lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v)!, indices.get(w)!));
      }
      if (lowlink.get(v) === indices.get(v)) {
        const comp: string[] = [];
        while (true) { const w = stack.pop()!; onStack.delete(w); comp.push(w); if (w === v) break; }
        if (comp.length > 1 || (adj.get(v) || []).includes(v)) sccs.push(comp.map((p) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, p)));
      }
    };
    for (const v of adj.keys()) { if (!indices.has(v)) sc(v); }
    return sccs;
  };
  const seeds = [
    ...walkFiles(path.join(SRC_ROOT, 'app'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false),
    ...walkFiles(path.join(SRC_ROOT, '__tests__'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false),
    ...walkFiles(path.join(ROOT, 'scripts'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/, false),
    ...walkFiles(path.join(ROOT, 'supabase', 'functions'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false),
  ];
  const testsRoot = path.join(SRC_ROOT, '__tests__');
  const visited = new Set<string>(), queue: string[] = [];
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const abs = path.resolve(seed);
    if (abs.startsWith(SRC_ROOT) && !abs.startsWith(testsRoot)) {
      if (!visited.has(abs)) { visited.add(abs); queue.push(abs); }
    } else if (fs.existsSync(abs)) {
      for (const spec of extractSpecs(abs, fs.readFileSync(abs, 'utf8'), true)) {
        for (const m of resolvePlatformMatches(abs, spec)) { if (!visited.has(m)) { visited.add(m); queue.push(m); } }
      }
    }
  }
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    for (const next of fullAdj.get(queue.shift()!) || []) { if (!visited.has(next)) { visited.add(next); queue.push(next); } }
  }
  return { astCycles: findSccs(astAdj), rtCycles: findSccs(rtAdj), orphans: srcFiles.filter((f) => !visited.has(f)).map((f) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, f)) };
}

function parseSqlQuotedSet(sql: string, fnName: string): Set<string> {
  const start = sql.indexOf(`CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.${fnName}`);
  assertTrue(start >= 0, `Missing SQL function ${fnName}`);
  const block = sql.slice(start, start + 700);
  const inIdx = block.indexOf('IN (');
  assertTrue(inIdx >= 0, `Missing IN clause in ${fnName}`);
  const endIdx = block.indexOf(')', inIdx);
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const m of block.slice(inIdx + 4, endIdx).matchAll(/'([^']+)'/g)) out.add(m[1].toLowerCase().trim());
  return out;
}

describeSuite('KINETIC OS v2.8.2 — Ola 3 B2B Roles, Untruncated Admin Scale, .agents QA & Orphan Prune', () => {

interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  statSync(p: string): { isFile(): boolean; size: number };
  readdirSync(p: string, opts: { withFileTypes: true }): { name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }[];
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
}
interface NodePathModule {
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
  dirname(p: string): string;
  relative(from: string, to: string): string;
}
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;

const g = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>;
const describeSuite = typeof g.describe === 'function' ? (g.describe as (n: string, fn: () => void) => void) : (_n: string, fn: () => void) => fn();
const itCase = typeof g.it === 'function' ? (g.it as (n: string, fn: () => unknown) => void) : (_n: string, fn: () => unknown) => fn();
const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => { if (!cond) throw new Error(msg); };
const assertEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const SRC_ROOT = path.join(ROOT, 'src');
const OLA4_TOUCHED_FILES = [

];
const PLATFORM_EXTS = ['', '.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.web.ts', '.web.tsx', '.native.ts', '.native.tsx', '.ios.ts', '.ios.tsx', '.android.ts', '.android.tsx'];

function walkFiles(dir: string, exts: RegExp, skipTests = false): string[] {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) {
      if (ent.name === 'node_modules' || (skipTests && ent.name === '__tests__')) continue;
      out.push(...walkFiles(full, exts, skipTests));
    } else if (exts.test(ent.name) && !ent.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
      out.push(path.resolve(full));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function resolvePlatformMatches(fromFile: string, spec: string): string[] {
  if (!spec || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('@/'))) return [];
  const base = spec.startsWith('@/') ? path.join(SRC_ROOT, spec.slice(2)) : path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), spec);
  const matches: string[] = [];
  for (const ext of PLATFORM_EXTS) {
    const cand = ext ? `${base}${ext}` : base;
    if (fs.existsSync(cand) && fs.statSync(cand).isFile()) matches.push(path.resolve(cand));
  }
  for (const idxExt of ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.web.ts', '.web.tsx']) {
    const cand = path.join(base, `index${idxExt}`);
    if (fs.existsSync(cand) && fs.statSync(cand).isFile()) matches.push(path.resolve(cand));
  }
  return [...new Set(matches)];
}

function extractSpecs(filePath: string, content: string, includeTypeImports = false): string[] {
  const kind = filePath.endsWith('.tsx') || filePath.endsWith('.jsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(filePath, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kind);
  const specs: string[] = [];
  const visit = (node: ts.Node) => {
    if (ts.isImportDeclaration(node) && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
      const cl = node.importClause;
      if (!includeTypeImports && cl) {
        if (cl.isTypeOnly) return;
        const nb = cl.namedBindings;
        if (!cl.name && nb && ts.isNamedImports(nb) && !nb.elements.some((el) => !el.isTypeOnly)) return;
      }
      specs.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (ts.isExportDeclaration(node) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
      if (!includeTypeImports) {
        if (node.isTypeOnly) return;
        if (node.exportClause && ts.isNamedExports(node.exportClause) && node.exportClause.elements.every((el) => el.isTypeOnly)) return;
      }
      specs.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (
      ts.isCallExpression(node) &&
      node.arguments.length >= 1 &&
      ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0]) &&
      ((ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) && node.expression.text === 'require') || node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword)
    ) {
      specs.push(node.arguments[0].text);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return specs;
}

function auditCyclesAndReachability() {
  const srcFiles = walkFiles(SRC_ROOT, /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, true);
  const astAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const rtAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const fullAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const f of srcFiles) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
    const astDeps = new Set<string>(), fullDeps = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of extractSpecs(f, content, false)) { const m = resolvePlatformMatches(f, s); if (m[0]) astDeps.add(m[0]); }
    for (const s of extractSpecs(f, content, true)) { for (const m of resolvePlatformMatches(f, s)) fullDeps.add(m); }
    astAdj.set(f, [...astDeps]);
    fullAdj.set(f, [...fullDeps]);
    const cjs = ts.transpileModule(content, { compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.React, esModuleInterop: true }, fileName: f }).outputText;
    const rtDeps = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of extractSpecs(`${f}.js`, cjs, true)) { const m = resolvePlatformMatches(f, s); if (m[0]) rtDeps.add(m[0]); }
    rtAdj.set(f, [...rtDeps]);
  }
  const findSccs = (adj: Map<string, string[]>): string[][] => {
    let idx = 0;
    const indices = new Map<string, number>(), lowlink = new Map<string, number>(), stack: string[] = [], onStack = new Set<string>(), sccs: string[][] = [];
    const sc = (v: string) => {
      indices.set(v, idx); lowlink.set(v, idx); idx += 1; stack.push(v); onStack.add(v);
      for (const w of adj.get(v) || []) {
        if (!indices.has(w)) { sc(w); lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v)!, lowlink.get(w)!)); }
        else if (onStack.has(w)) lowlink.set(v, Math.min(lowlink.get(v)!, indices.get(w)!));
      }
      if (lowlink.get(v) === indices.get(v)) {
        const comp: string[] = [];
        while (true) { const w = stack.pop()!; onStack.delete(w); comp.push(w); if (w === v) break; }
        if (comp.length > 1 || (adj.get(v) || []).includes(v)) sccs.push(comp.map((p) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, p)));
      }
    };
    for (const v of adj.keys()) if (!indices.has(v)) sc(v);
    return sccs;
  };
  const testsRoot = path.join(SRC_ROOT, '__tests__');
  const seeds = [
    ...walkFiles(path.join(SRC_ROOT, 'app'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false),
    ...walkFiles(testsRoot, /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false),
    ...walkFiles(path.join(ROOT, 'scripts'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/, false),
    ...walkFiles(path.join(ROOT, 'supabase', 'functions'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false),
  ];
  const visited = new Set<string>(), queue: string[] = [];
  for (const seed of seeds) {
    const abs = path.resolve(seed);
    if (abs.startsWith(SRC_ROOT) && !abs.startsWith(testsRoot)) {
      if (!visited.has(abs)) { visited.add(abs); queue.push(abs); }
    } else if (fs.existsSync(abs)) {
      for (const spec of extractSpecs(abs, fs.readFileSync(abs, 'utf8'), true)) {
        for (const m of resolvePlatformMatches(abs, spec)) if (!visited.has(m)) { visited.add(m); queue.push(m); }
      }
    }
  }
  while (queue.length > 0) for (const next of fullAdj.get(queue.shift()!) || []) if (!visited.has(next)) { visited.add(next); queue.push(next); }
  return { astCycles: findSccs(astAdj), rtCycles: findSccs(rtAdj), orphans: srcFiles.filter((f) => !visited.has(f)).map((f) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, f)) };
}

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/owaspAndGcpZkV277.adversarial.test.ts === //
import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  ConcurrentSimOp,
  createDeterministicWindowRateLimiter,
  createIdempotentStripeEventProcessor,
  createSingleUseQrNonceGuard,
  hmacSha256HexSync,
  simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst,
  verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync,
} from '../../services/kineticOwaspSecurityGuards';
import { completeNativeOAuthSessionFromUrl } from '../../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import {
  sanitizePushDeviceToken,
  shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce,
  syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost,
} from '../../services/kineticPushFcmZeroCostHelper';
import {
  isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl,
  resolveSafeKineticOAuthRedirectTo,
  validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl,
} from '../../services/kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';

interface NodeCryptoModule {
  createHmac(alg: string, key: string): { update(msg: string): { digest(enc: 'hex'): string } };
}
interface NodeFsModule {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
}
interface NodePathModule {
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
}

declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;

const nodeCrypto = require('node:crypto') as NodeCryptoModule;
const nodeFs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const nodePath = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;

const expectTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const expectEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(expected)}, actual=${String(actual)})`);
};

const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const ROOT = process.cwd();

describe('OWASP API Top 10 + OAuth/FCM + Zero-Knowledge GCP v2.7.7 (fast-check 500x)', () => {
  it('P1: Concurrent escrow bookings, chest claims, and 10 KC invariants prevent overbooking, negatives, and double rewards', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 25 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 200 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 200 }).map((n) => n * 10),
        fc.array(
          fc.oneof(
            fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('reserve' as const), precioKc: fc.constantFrom(50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300) }),
            fc.record({
              kind: fc.constant('claim_reward' as const),
              retoId: fc.constantFrom('cofre_lvl_1', 'cofre_lvl_2', 'reto_streak_7'),
              kcReward: fc.constantFrom(10, 20, 30, 50, 15, -10, 80),
            }),
            fc.constant({ kind: 'cancel_one' as const })
          ),
          { minLength: 1, maxLength: 30 }
        ),
        (cap, memKc, topKc, ops: ConcurrentSimOp[]) => {
          const res = simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst(cap, memKc, topKc, ops);
          expectTrue(res.inscritos >= 0 && res.inscritos <= res.cap, `Overbooking or negative spots: ${res.inscritos}/${res.cap}`);
          expectTrue(res.memKc >= 0 && res.topKc >= 0, 'Negative wallet balance');
          expectEq(res.totalKc, res.memKc + res.topKc, 'Wallet total mismatch');

          const dupBurst = simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst(5, 100, 0, [
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'cofre_unico_1', kcReward: 20 },
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'COFRE_UNICO_1', kcReward: 20 },
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'cofre_malo', kcReward: 15 },
            { kind: 'claim_reward', retoId: 'cofre_neg', kcReward: -10 },
          ]);
          expectEq(dupBurst.claimedCount, 1, 'Duplicate or invalid reward claim succeeded');
          expectEq(dupBurst.duplicateClaims, 1, 'Duplicate claim counter missed burst');
          expectEq(dupBurst.totalKc, 120, 'Reward credited more than once or invalid KC accepted');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P2: Stripe HMAC-SHA256 signature verification (<=300s) and event_id idempotency block tampering, replay, and duplicates', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.string({ minLength: 12, maxLength: 64 }),
        fc.string({ minLength: 2, maxLength: 120 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000, max: 1_900_000_000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: -290, max: 290 }),
        fc.constantFrom(100, 250, 500, 1000),
        (secret, msgSeed, nowSec, deltaSec, kcPack) => {
          const whSecret = ['whsec', secret].join('_');
          const rawBody = JSON.stringify({ id: `evt_${nowSec}`, type: 'payment_intent.succeeded', note: msgSeed });
          const ts = nowSec + deltaSec;
          const nodeSig = nodeCrypto.createHmac('sha256', whSecret).update(`${ts}.${rawBody}`).digest('hex');
          const pureSig = hmacSha256HexSync(whSecret, `${ts}.${rawBody}`);
          expectEq(pureSig, nodeSig, 'Pure HMAC-SHA256 diverged from Node crypto');

          const validRes = verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync({
            rawBody,
            signatureHeader: `t=${ts},v1=${pureSig}`,
            webhookSecret: whSecret,
            nowEpochSec: nowSec,
          });
          expectEq(validRes.ok, true, `Valid Stripe signature rejected: ${validRes.reason}`);

          const tampered = verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync({
            rawBody: `${rawBody} `,
            signatureHeader: `t=${ts},v1=${pureSig}`,
            webhookSecret: whSecret,
            nowEpochSec: nowSec,
          });
          expectEq(tampered.ok, false, 'Tampered webhook body accepted');

          const expired = verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync({
            rawBody,
            signatureHeader: `t=${nowSec - 301},v1=${hmacSha256HexSync(whSecret, `${nowSec - 301}.${rawBody}`)}`,
            webhookSecret: whSecret,
            nowEpochSec: nowSec,
          });
          expectEq(expired.ok, false, 'Expired >300s webhook timestamp accepted');

          const proc = createIdempotentStripeEventProcessor();
          const first = proc.process(`evt_${nowSec}`, kcPack);
          const second = proc.process(`evt_${nowSec}`, kcPack);
          expectEq(first.status, 'processed', 'First valid Stripe event rejected');
          expectEq(second.status, 'duplicate_ignored', 'Duplicate Stripe event not ignored');
          expectEq(second.totalKcCredited, kcPack, 'Stripe event credited twice');
          expectEq(proc.process(`evt_bad_${nowSec}`, 55).status, 'rejected', 'Non-10-multiple Stripe KC accepted');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P3: Deterministic rate limiter blocks exactly at maxHits+1, resets on window expiry, resists __proto__, and QR nonce is single-use', () => {
    const poisonKeys = ['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', 'toString', 'valueOf'];
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 12 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 10, max: 120 }),
        fc.constantFrom(...poisonKeys, 'user-uuid-1234', 'b2b-partner-99'),
        fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000, max: 1_800_000_000 }),
        (maxHits, winSec, actorKey, t0) => {
          const limiter = createDeterministicWindowRateLimiter(maxHits, winSec);
          for (let i = 0; i < maxHits; i += 1) {
            const okHit = limiter.consume('ai_engine', actorKey, t0 + 1);
            expectEq(okHit.allowed, true, `Blocked hit ${i + 1} within limit ${maxHits}`);
          }
          const blockedHit = limiter.consume('ai_engine', actorKey, t0 + 1);
          expectEq(blockedHit.allowed, false, 'Exceeded rate limit allowed through');
          expectTrue(blockedHit.retryAfterSeconds >= 1, 'Missing retryAfterSeconds');

          const resetHit = limiter.consume('ai_engine', actorKey, t0 + 1 + winSec);
          expectEq(resetHit.allowed, true, 'Rate limiter did not reset after window expiry');

          const qrGuard = createSingleUseQrNonceGuard();
          expectEq(qrGuard.consume(`res_${actorKey}`, 28000000, 'nonceA'), true, 'First valid QR check-in blocked');
          expectEq(qrGuard.consume(`res_${actorKey}`, 28000001, 'nonceB'), false, 'Replay on same reservation allowed');
          expectEq(qrGuard.consume(`res_other_${actorKey}`, 28000000, 'nonceA'), false, 'Cross-reservation nonce replay allowed');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('P4: OAuth whitelist blocks open-redirects, Push FCM tokens obey Write-Once, and repo enforces Zero-Knowledge GCP without .env.tpl or legacy secret URIs', async () => {
    const validRedirects = [
      'kinetic://login',
      'kinetic://login?code=abc123456&state=xyz',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx/login',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth',
      'https://www.kineticapp.com.mx',
      'http://localhost:8081',
    ];
    const evilRedirects = [
      'https://evil.com',
      'https://evil-kineticapp.com.mx',
      'https://kineticapp.com.mx.evil.org',
      'http://kineticapp.com.mx',
      'javascript:alert(1)',
      'data:text/html,<script>1</script>',
      'kinetic://evil.com@login',
      '//evil.com/steal',
    ];
    const uid = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';

    fc.assert(

function analyzeCapsula009Ast(relPath: string, content: string): { maxNesting: number; useStateCount: number; awaitInLoop: number; emptyCatch: number } {
  const kind = relPath.endsWith('.tsx') || relPath.endsWith('.jsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(relPath, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kind);
  let maxNesting = 0, useStateCount = 0, awaitInLoop = 0, emptyCatch = 0;
  const visit = (n: ts.Node, depth: number, inLoop: boolean) => {
    const isFn = ts.isFunctionDeclaration(n) || ts.isArrowFunction(n) || ts.isMethodDeclaration(n) || ts.isFunctionExpression(n);
    const isCtrl = ts.isIfStatement(n) || ts.isForStatement(n) || ts.isForOfStatement(n) || ts.isForInStatement(n) || ts.isWhileStatement(n) || ts.isDoStatement(n) || ts.isSwitchStatement(n) || ts.isTryStatement(n);
    const curDepth = (isFn ? 0 : depth) + (isCtrl ? 1 : 0);
    if (curDepth > maxNesting) maxNesting = curDepth;
    if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isIdentifier(n.expression) && n.expression.text === 'useState') useStateCount += 1;
    if (ts.isAwaitExpression(n) && inLoop) awaitInLoop += 1;
    if (ts.isCatchClause(n) && (!n.variableDeclaration || n.block.statements.length === 0)) emptyCatch += 1;
    if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n.expression) && n.expression.name.text === 'catch' && n.arguments[0] && ts.isArrowFunction(n.arguments[0]) && ts.isBlock(n.arguments[0].body) && n.arguments[0].body.statements.length === 0) emptyCatch += 1;
    const childInLoop = isFn ? false : inLoop || ts.isForStatement(n) || ts.isForOfStatement(n) || ts.isForInStatement(n) || ts.isWhileStatement(n) || ts.isDoStatement(n);
    ts.forEachChild(n, (c) => visit(c, curDepth, childInLoop));
  };
  visit(sf, 0, false);
  return { maxNesting, useStateCount, awaitInLoop, emptyCatch };
}

function walkFiles(dir: string, exts: RegExp, skipTests = false): string[] {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) {
      if (ent.name !== 'node_modules' && (!skipTests || ent.name !== '__tests__')) out.push(...walkFiles(full, exts, skipTests));
    } else if (exts.test(ent.name) && !ent.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) out.push(path.resolve(full));
  }
  return out;
}

function resolveMatches(fromFile: string, spec: string): string[] {
  if (!spec || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('@/'))) return [];
  const base = spec.startsWith('@/') ? path.join(SRC_ROOT, spec.slice(2)) : path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), spec);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ext of PLATFORM_EXTS) { const c = ext ? `${base}${ext}` : base; if (fs.existsSync(c) && fs.statSync(c).isFile()) out.push(path.resolve(c)); }
  for (const idx of ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.web.ts', '.web.tsx']) { const c = path.join(base, `index${idx}`); if (fs.existsSync(c) && fs.statSync(c).isFile()) out.push(path.resolve(c)); }
  return [...new Set(out)];
}

function extractSpecs(filePath: string, content: string, includeTypes: boolean): string[] {
  const kind = filePath.endsWith('.tsx') || filePath.endsWith('.jsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(filePath, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kind);
  const specs: string[] = [];
  const visit = (node: ts.Node) => {
    if (ts.isImportDeclaration(node) && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
      const cl = node.importClause;
      if (!includeTypes && cl && (cl.isTypeOnly || (!cl.name && cl.namedBindings && ts.isNamedImports(cl.namedBindings) && !cl.namedBindings.elements.some((e) => !e.isTypeOnly)))) return;
      specs.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (ts.isExportDeclaration(node) && node.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(node.moduleSpecifier)) {
      if (!includeTypes && (node.isTypeOnly || (node.exportClause && ts.isNamedExports(node.exportClause) && node.exportClause.elements.every((e) => e.isTypeOnly)))) return;
      specs.push(node.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (ts.isCallExpression(node) && node.arguments.length >= 1 && ts.isStringLiteral(node.arguments[0]) && ((ts.isIdentifier(node.expression) && node.expression.text === 'require') || node.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword)) {
      specs.push(node.arguments[0].text);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return specs;
}

function scanPartnerWebGraph() {
  const srcFiles = walkFiles(SRC_ROOT, /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, true);
  const astAdj = new Map<string, string[]>(), rtAdj = new Map<string, string[]>(), fullAdj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const f of srcFiles) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
    const astDeps = new Set<string>(), fullDeps = new Set<string>(), rtDeps = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of extractSpecs(f, content, false)) { const m = resolveMatches(f, s); if (m[0]) astDeps.add(m[0]); }
    for (const s of extractSpecs(f, content, true)) for (const m of resolveMatches(f, s)) fullDeps.add(m);
    const cjs = ts.transpileModule(content, { compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.React, esModuleInterop: true }, fileName: f }).outputText;
    for (const s of extractSpecs(`${f}.js`, cjs, true)) { const m = resolveMatches(f, s); if (m[0]) rtDeps.add(m[0]); }
    astAdj.set(f, [...astDeps]); fullAdj.set(f, [...fullDeps]); rtAdj.set(f, [...rtDeps]);
  }
  const findSccs = (adj: Map<string, string[]>): string[][] => {
    let idx = 0;
    const ind = new Map<string, number>(), low = new Map<string, number>(), st: string[] = [], on = new Set<string>(), sccs: string[][] = [];
    const sc = (v: string) => {
      ind.set(v, idx); low.set(v, idx); idx += 1; st.push(v); on.add(v);
      for (const w of adj.get(v) || []) {
        if (!ind.has(w)) { sc(w); low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v)!, low.get(w)!)); }
        else if (on.has(w)) low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v)!, ind.get(w)!));
      }
      if (low.get(v) === ind.get(v)) {
        const comp: string[] = [];
        while (true) { const w = st.pop()!; on.delete(w); comp.push(w); if (w === v) break; }
        if (comp.length > 1 || (adj.get(v) || []).includes(v)) sccs.push(comp.map((p) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, p)));
      }
    };
    for (const v of adj.keys()) if (!ind.has(v)) sc(v);
    return sccs;
  };
  const testsRoot = path.join(SRC_ROOT, '__tests__');
  const seeds = [...walkFiles(path.join(SRC_ROOT, 'app'), /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false), ...walkFiles(testsRoot, /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/, false)];
  const visited = new Set<string>(), q: string[] = [];
  for (const s of seeds) {
    const abs = path.resolve(s);
    if (abs.startsWith(SRC_ROOT) && !abs.startsWith(testsRoot)) { if (!visited.has(abs)) { visited.add(abs); q.push(abs); } }
    else if (fs.existsSync(abs)) for (const sp of extractSpecs(abs, fs.readFileSync(abs, 'utf8'), true)) for (const m of resolveMatches(abs, sp)) if (!visited.has(m)) { visited.add(m); q.push(m); }
  }
  while (q.length > 0) for (const nxt of fullAdj.get(q.shift()!) || []) if (!visited.has(nxt)) { visited.add(nxt); q.push(nxt); }
  return { astCycles: findSccs(astAdj), rtCycles: findSccs(rtAdj), orphans: srcFiles.filter((f) => !visited.has(f)).map((f) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, f)) };
}

describeSuite('KINETIC PARTNER HUB WEB (/socios) — Firewall Anti-Atleta, Anti-BOLA, SQL & Sanitización (550x)', () => {
  itCase('P1 (550x): Rechazo 100% de cuentas Atleta, nativo, tokens no-JWT/expirados y MFA AAL1 en /socios', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.uuid(),
        fc.constantFrom('atleta', 'user', 'vip', 'guest', '', 'client'),
        fc.constantFrom('android', 'ios', 'web'),
        fc.constantFrom<'valid' | 'empty' | 'kinetic' | 'expired' | 'aal1_totp'>('valid', 'empty', 'kinetic', 'expired', 'aal1_totp'),
        (uid, athleteRole, platformOs, tokenKind) => {
          const token =
            tokenKind === 'empty'
              ? ''
              : tokenKind === 'kinetic'
              ? 'kinetic-resilient-1'
              : tokenKind === 'expired'
              ? makeTestJwt(uid, -60)
              : makeTestJwt(uid, 3600, { aal: 'aal1' });
          const factors = tokenKind === 'aal1_totp' ? [{ id: 'f1', status: 'verified', factor_type: 'totp' }] : null;
          const athleteAccess = evaluatePartnerWebPortalAccess({
            platformOs,
            session: { access_token: token },
            user: { id: uid, email: `atleta_${uid}@gmail.com`, factors },
            profile: { rol: athleteRole, tipo_cuenta: athleteRole, es_afiliado: false },
          });
          if (athleteAccess.allowed) return false;
          if (platformOs !== 'web') return athleteAccess.status === 'redirect_native_root';
          if (tokenKind !== 'valid') return athleteAccess.status === 'invalid_jwt';
          return athleteAccess.status === 'blocked_athlete' && !athleteAccess.isAdmin && !athleteAccess.isB2B;
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
    for (const role of KINETIC_CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES) {
      const uid = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
      const b2bOk = evaluatePartnerWebPortalAccess({
        platformOs: 'web',
        session: { access_token: makeTestJwt(uid) },
        user: { id: uid, email: 'club@studio.mx', email_confirmed_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
        profile: { rol: role, tipo_cuenta: role },
      });
      assertTrue(b2bOk.allowed && b2bOk.status === 'authorized' && b2bOk.isB2B && !b2bOk.isAdmin, `B2B role rejected: ${role}`);
    }
    const adminUid = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
    const unconfirmedAdminBlocked = evaluatePartnerWebPortalAccess({
      platformOs: 'web',
      session: { access_token: makeTestJwt(adminUid) },
      user: { id: adminUid, email: KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_LIST[0], email_confirmed_at: null },
      profile: { rol: 'atleta', tipo_cuenta: 'atleta' },
    });
    assertTrue(!unconfirmedAdminBlocked.allowed, 'Unconfirmed admin email must be blocked');
    const adminOk = evaluatePartnerWebPortalAccess({
      platformOs: 'web',
      session: { access_token: makeTestJwt(adminUid) },
      user: { id: adminUid, email: KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_LIST[0], email_confirmed_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
      profile: { rol: 'admin', tipo_cuenta: 'admin' },
    });
    assertTrue(adminOk.allowed && adminOk.isAdmin, 'Confirmed Master Admin must be authorized');
  });

  itCase('P2 (550x): Bloqueo BOLA 100% entre afiliados distintos y autorización exclusiva dueño/admin', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.uuid(), fc.uuid(), fc.boolean(), (actorId, ownerId, isAdmin) => {
        const distinctBlocked = canActorManageAffiliateVenue({
          actorUserId: actorId,
          isAdmin: false,
          isB2B: true,
          targetOwnerId: actorId.toLowerCase() === ownerId.toLowerCase() ? 'ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff' : ownerId,
        });
        const ownAllowed = canActorManageAffiliateVenue({ actorUserId: ownerId, isAdmin, isB2B: true, targetOwnerId: ownerId });
        const athleteSameIdBlocked = canActorManageAffiliateVenue({ actorUserId: ownerId, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, targetOwnerId: ownerId });
        return (!distinctBlocked || actorId.toLowerCase() === 'ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff') && ownAllowed && !athleteSameIdBlocked;
      }),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  itCase('P3 (550x): Invariantes estrictos de CLABE 18 dígitos y precios múltiplos de 10 KC', () => {
    const digit18Arb = fc.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{18}$/);
    const nonClabeArb = fc.string({ minLength: 1, maxLength: 24 }).filter((s) => !/^\d{18}$/.test(s.trim()));
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(digit18Arb, nonClabeArb, fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 5000 }), fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 9 }), (clabe, badClabe, k, rem) => {
        const stepPrice = k * 10;
        const badPrice = k * 10 + rem;
        return (
          isValidPartnerClabe18(clabe) &&

        fc.constantFrom('=', '+', '-', '@', '|', '\t', '\r', '\n', '\u00A0', '\uFEFF'),
        fc.stringMatching(/^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,18}$/).filter((s) => !['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype'].includes(s.toLowerCase())),
        fc.constantFrom('http://evil.mx/a.jpg', 'javascript:alert(1)', '<script>alert(1)</script>', '<img src=x'),
        (prefix, payloadText, badUrl) => {
          const safeText = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(`${prefix}<script>x()</script><img src=x${payloadText}`, 120, true);
          if (safeText.includes('<script') || safeText.includes('<img') || /^[=+\-@|\s\u00A0\uFEFF]/.test(safeText)) return false;
          const badClabeRes = sanitizePartnerProfilePatch({ clabe_bancaria: `${prefix}012345678901234567` }, false);
          if (badClabeRes.ok) return false;
          const badUrlRes = sanitizePartnerProfilePatch({ avatar_url: badUrl }, false);
          if (badUrlRes.ok) return false;
          const nullRes = sanitizePartnerProfilePatch(null, false);
          if (nullRes.ok) return false;
          const satCheat = sanitizePartnerProfilePatch({ rfc: 'XAXX010101000', regimen_fiscal: 'persona_moral' }, false);
          if (satCheat.ok) return false;
          const satNoCsf = sanitizePartnerProfilePatch({ rfc: 'KIN260101ABC', regimen_fiscal: 'persona_moral' }, false, { currentCsfValidada: false });

      }

    for (const ig of ['.agents/', 'src/__tests__/', 'supabase/', 'scripts/']) assertTrue(easIgnore.includes(ig), `.easignore debe excluir ${ig}`);
    assertTrue(fs.existsSync(path.join(ROOT, '.agents/rules/02-capsulas-009-010-partner-web.md')), 'Falta regla Cápsulas 009/010 en .agents/rules/');
    const landingHtml = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'public/landing.html'), 'utf8');

    assertTrue(fs.statSync(path.join(ROOT, '.env.example')).size === 887, '.env.example debe medir 887B');

import fc from 'fast-check';
import {
  buildCleanEventDeepLink,
  buildCleanSquadDeepLink,
} from '../../components/eventos/eventDetailsPureHelpers';
import {
  KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID,
  KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID,
  beginNativeOidcFlow,
  buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl,
  buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink,
  buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl,
  endNativeOidcFlow,
  extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl,
  generateOidcNonceAndState,
  parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState,
  recordCapturedNativeOidcUrl,
  resolveNativeOidcAuthSessionCallbackUrl,
  sha256HexOidc,
} from '../../services/kineticGoogleOidcService';
import {
  isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl,
  validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl,
} from '../../services/kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';

interface NodeFsModule { existsSync(p: string): boolean; readdirSync(p: string, opts: { withFileTypes: true }): { name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }[]; readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string; }
interface NodePathModule { resolve(...parts: string[]): string; join(...parts: string[]): string; dirname(p: string): string; }
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;

const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFsModule;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePathModule;
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const NUM_RUNS = 500;

const assertEq = <T>(actual: T, expected: T, msg: string) => {
  if (actual !== expected) throw new Error(`${msg} | expected=${String(expected)} actual=${String(actual)}`);
};
const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string) => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};

const B64_CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_';
const encodeB64UrlUtf8 = (rawStr: string): string => {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(rawStr);
  let out = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i];
    const has1 = i + 1 < bytes.length;
    const has2 = i + 2 < bytes.length;
    const b1 = has1 ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const b2 = has2 ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
    const n = (b0 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b2;
    out += B64_CHARS[(n >>> 18) & 63] + B64_CHARS[(n >>> 12) & 63];
    if (has1) out += B64_CHARS[(n >>> 6) & 63];
    if (has2) out += B64_CHARS[n & 63];
  }
  return out;
};
const toB64Url = (obj: Record<string, unknown>): string => encodeB64UrlUtf8(JSON.stringify(obj));

const FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  new RegExp(['enr', 'ike', 'only'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['enr', 'ique', 'mor', 'ales'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['enr', 'ique', '\\s+', 'mor', 'ales'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['lu', 'is', '\\s+', 'enr', 'ique'].join(''), 'i'),
  new RegExp(['\\b', 'enr', 'ique', '\\b'].join(''), 'i'),
];

const scanDirFiles = (relDir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] => {
  const full = path.join(ROOT, relDir);
  if (!fs.existsSync(full)) return out;
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(full, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (['node_modules', '.git', '.expo', 'dist', 'build'].includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const childRel = path.join(relDir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) scanDirFiles(childRel, out);
    else if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|json|html)$/i.test(entry.name)) out.push(childRel);
  }
  return out;
};

describe('Paso 13 Integral v2.8.2 — Identidad Corporativa Pura + Paquete com.kineticapp.mx + Google OIDC Directo (500x)', () => {
  it('Propiedad 1: Cero nombres/usuarios personales en src/, app.config.js, eas.json, public/, scripts/ y Edge Functions + paquete com.kineticapp.mx', () => {
    const targets = [
      'app.config.js',
      'eas.json',
      'package.json',
      ...scanDirFiles('src'),
      ...scanDirFiles('public'),
      ...scanDirFiles('scripts'),
      ...scanDirFiles('supabase/functions'),
    ];
    for (const rel of targets) {
      const normalized = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
      for (const re of FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY_PATTERNS) {
        assertEq(re.test(normalized), false, `Identidad personal residual (${re}) detectada en ${rel}`);
      }
    }

    const appCfg = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app.config.js'), 'utf8');
    assertTrue(appCfg.includes("version: '2.8.6'"), 'app.config.js version debe ser 2.8.6');
    assertTrue(appCfg.includes("bundleIdentifier: 'com.kineticapp.mx'"), 'ios.bundleIdentifier debe ser com.kineticapp.mx');
    assertTrue(appCfg.includes("package: 'com.kineticapp.mx'"), 'android.package debe ser com.kineticapp.mx');
    assertTrue(!/pathPrefix:\s*['"]\/oauth['"]/.test(appCfg) && !/pathPrefix:\s*['"]\/socios['"]/.test(appCfg), 'android.intentFilters no debe secuestrar /oauth ni /socios');
    assertEq(/\bowner\s*:/.test(appCfg), false, 'app.config.js no debe exponer owner personal');
    assertEq(KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID, 'com.kineticapp.mx', 'KINETIC_APP_PACKAGE_ID debe ser com.kineticapp.mx');

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom('enriquecer tu perfil', 'contenido enriquecido', 'enriched metrics'),
        (safeWord) => {
          const clean = safeWord.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
          assertEq(FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY_PATTERNS.some((re) => re.test(clean)), false, `Falso positivo en ${safeWord}`);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('Propiedad 2: Google OIDC Directo apunta exclusivamente a accounts.google.com sobre kineticapp.com.mx con nonce SHA-256 y cero supabase.co', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<'web' | 'native'>('web', 'native'),
        fc.constantFrom<'b2c' | 'b2b'>('b2c', 'b2b'),
        fc.constantFrom('https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth', 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/login', 'https://kineticapp.com.mx'),
        fc.constantFrom('https://evil.com/cb', 'https://gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback', 'http://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth'),
        (platform, mode, validRedirect, badRedirect) => {
          const { rawNonce, nonceHash, state } = generateOidcNonceAndState(platform, mode);
          assertEq(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(nonceHash), true, 'nonceHash SHA-256 inválido');
          assertEq(nonceHash, sha256HexOidc(rawNonce), 'nonceHash no coincide con sha256(rawNonce)');
          const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(state, state);
          assertTrue(Boolean(parsedState && parsedState.platform === platform && parsedState.mode === mode), 'State OIDC inválido');

          const authUrl = buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl({ redirectUri: validRedirect, nonceHash, state });
          assertTrue(authUrl.startsWith('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?'), 'Host OIDC no es accounts.google.com');
          assertEq(new RegExp(`supabase\\.co|${['enrike', 'only'].join('')}`, 'i').test(authUrl), false, 'URL OIDC filtró supabase.co o usuario personal');
          const parsedUrl = new URL(authUrl);
          assertEq(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('response_type'), 'id_token', 'response_type debe ser id_token');
          assertEq(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('nonce'), nonceHash, 'nonce mismatch en URL');
          assertEq(parsedUrl.searchParams.get('state'), state, 'state mismatch en URL');

          if (platform === 'native') {
            const bridgeUrl = buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl({ mode, nonceHash, state });
            assertTrue(bridgeUrl.startsWith('https://kineticapp.com.mx/oauth?platform=native'), 'Puente nativo no usa kineticapp.com.mx/oauth');
          }

            buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl({ redirectUri: badRedirect, nonceHash, state });
          } catch {
            threwBadRedirect = true;
          }
          assertEq(threwBadRedirect, true, `Permitió redirectUri prohibido: ${badRedirect}`);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
