    const cleanWordArb = fc
      .string({ minLength: 2, maxLength: 20 })
      .filter((s) => /^[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚÑ][a-záéíóúñ]+(?:\s+[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚÑa-záéíóúñ]+)*$/.test(s) && !/^(?:s[ií]|yes)\b/i.test(s));

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(fc.constantFrom('Sí, ', 'Si, ', 'SÍ, ', 'YES, ', 'Yes, '), cleanWordArb, (prefix, action) => {
        const out = stripYesPrefix(`${prefix}${action}`);
        assertEq(out, action, 'Should strip Sí/Si/Yes prefix preserving action verb');
        assertTrue(!/^(?:S[IÍ]|YES)\s*,/i.test(out), 'Result must not retain affirmative prefix');
      }),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('3. Strict WhatsApp validator & B2B guards accept valid MX/E.164 numbers and reject CSV/synthetic junk (500x)', () => {
    assertTrue(countLines('src/utils/kineticPhoneValidatorLeaf.ts') < 110, 'Phone validator leaf must stay <110L');

    // Valid MX 10-digit generator avoiding equal/sequential/repeating blocks
    const valid10Arb = fc
      .tuple(
        fc.constantFrom('55', '624', '33', '81', '998', '442'),
        fc.integer({ min: 2000000, max: 9899999 })
      )
      .map(([lada, rest]) => `${lada}${rest}`.slice(0, 10))
      .filter(
        (d) =>
          d.length === 10 &&
          !/^(\d)\1+$/.test(d) &&
          !/^(\d{2})\1{4,}$/.test(d) &&
          !/^(\d{3})\1{2}/.test(d) &&
          !'01234567890123456789'.includes(d) &&
          !'98765432109876543210'.includes(d) &&
          d !== '6241234567'
      );

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(valid10Arb, fc.boolean(), (ten, withCountryCode) => {
        const formatted = withCountryCode ? `+52 ${ten.slice(0, 3)} ${ten.slice(3, 6)} ${ten.slice(6)}` : ten;
        const res = validateStrictWhatsappPhone(formatted);
        assertTrue(res.valid, `Expected valid phone for ${formatted}, got ${res.reason}`);
        assertEq(res.normalized10, ten, 'Normalized 10 digits must match base phone');
        assertTrue(isStrictValidWhatsappInput(formatted, false), 'Strict check must accept');
        assertTrue(isValidB2BWhatsapp(formatted), 'B2B validator must accept');
        const partnerInput = withCountryCode ? `52 ${ten.slice(0, 3)} ${ten.slice(3, 6)} ${ten.slice(6)}` : ten;
        const partnerRes = normalizePartnerWhatsapp10(partnerInput);
        assertTrue(partnerRes.ok && partnerRes.value === ten, 'Partner guard must normalize cleanly');
        assertTrue(!normalizePartnerWhatsapp10(`=${ten}`).ok, 'Partner guard blocks CSV formula prefix');
      }),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );

    const maliciousArb = fc.oneof(
      fc.constantFrom('0000000000', '9999999999', '1234567890', '0123456789', '9876543210', '1212121212', '3213213210', '123456789'),
      fc.constantFrom('=5512345678', '@5512345678', '|cmd|5512345678', '-5512345678', '+abc1234567890', 'hola1234567890')
    );

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(maliciousArb, (badInput) => {
        const res = validateStrictWhatsappPhone(badInput);
        assertTrue(!res.valid, `Malicious/synthetic input must fail: ${badInput}`);
        assertTrue(!isValidB2BWhatsapp(badInput), `B2B guard must reject: ${badInput}`);
        assertTrue(!normalizePartnerWhatsapp10(badInput).ok, `Partner guard must reject: ${badInput}`);
      }),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

  it('4. OIDC 1-step 0ms redirect, WRITE_SETTINGS blocked & PUBLIC_WEB_APP_OPEN=false remain sealed', () => {
    assertEq(PUBLIC_WEB_APP_OPEN, false, 'Prelaunch lock must stay closed in Ola 2');
    const oauthSrc = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'src/app/oauth.tsx'), 'utf8');
    assertTrue(oauthSrc.includes("if (reqPlatform === 'native')"), 'Must support instant native OIDC branch');
    assertTrue(oauthSrc.includes('window.location.replace(oidcUrl)'), 'Must redirect in 0ms without intermediate hold');
    assertTrue(oauthSrc.includes('ABRIR KINETIC') && oauthSrc.includes('OPEN KINETIC'), 'Must include single clean fallback CTA');
    assertTrue(!/Kinetic OS/i.test(oauthSrc), 'OAuth bridge must not reference Kinetic OS');

    const cfgSrc = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app.config.js'), 'utf8');
    assertTrue(cfgSrc.includes('android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS'), 'WRITE_SETTINGS must be blocked in app.config.js');
    assertTrue(cfgSrc.includes('android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT'), 'Bluetooth permissions stay blocked');
    assertTrue(cfgSrc.includes('android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES'), 'Nearby wifi permission stays blocked');
    assertTrue(!/\bQR TOTP\b|\bNTP TOTP\b|\bTOTP\b/i.test(cfgSrc), 'app.config.js must use clean 60s QR wording');
  });

  it('5. Pure Kinetic branding, clean 1-99 sports ranks, #125 RPG preserved & ScannerModal <360L', () => {
    assertTrue(countLines('src/components/ScannerModal.tsx') < 360, 'ScannerModal must remain <360L');
    const bannedCopy = [
      /Kinetic OS/i,
      /\(Supabase\)/i,
      /\bTOTP\b/i,
      /AN[AÁ]LISIS RPG/i,
      /Operador T[aá]ctico|Comandante [EÉ]lite|Leyenda Inmortal|Vanguardia del Corredor|Iron Specialist|Elite Commander|Immortal Legend|Corridor Vanguard|\bSoldado\b|\bTeniente\b|\bCoronel\b|\bGeneral\b/i,
    ];

    for (const grade of PRESTIGE_GRADES_META) {
      const joined = `${grade.divisionTitle} ${grade.divisionTitleEn}`;
      assertTrue(!/\b[IVX]{1,4}\b/.test(grade.divisionTitle) && !bannedCopy.some((r) => r.test(joined)), `Invalid prestige grade: ${joined}`);
    }
    for (let lvl = 1; lvl <= 99; lvl += 1) {
      for (const lang of ['es', 'en'] as const) {
        const title = getLevelTitleIn99Ladder(lvl, 0, lang);
        assertTrue(!bannedCopy.some((r) => r.test(title)), `Invalid rank L${lvl}(${lang}): ${title}`);
      }
    }
    for (const lang of ['es', 'en'] as const) {
      for (const item of [...PRESTIGE_RANKS_LADDER, ...getLocalizedPrestigeLadder(lang)]) {
        const txt = `${item.title} ${item.titleEn}`;
        assertTrue(!bannedCopy.some((r) => r.test(txt)), `Invalid ladder rank: ${txt}`);
      }
    }

    const legalDocs = [
      'src/app/privacidad.tsx',
      'src/app/terminos.tsx',
      'src/components/boveda/LegalTermsClausesBody.tsx',
      'src/components/partner-web/PartnerWebSidebar.tsx',
      'src/components/partner-web/PartnerWebAuthGate.tsx',
      'src/services/kineticPdfEngine.ts',
    ];
    for (const rel of legalDocs) {
      const txt = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8');
      assertTrue(!/Kinetic OS/i.test(txt), `Kinetic OS leaked in ${rel}`);
      assertTrue(!/\bTOTP\b/i.test(txt), `TOTP leaked in ${rel}`);
    }

    const discMapSrc = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'src/constants/kineticDisciplineMap.ts'), 'utf8');
    assertTrue(discMapSrc.includes('Reeducación Postural Global (RPG)'), '#125 RPG therapy discipline must remain intact');
  });

  it('6. Kinetic Oficial stays active with sinAgenda14d=false unless explicitly suspended, and Wave 2 files pass quality locks', () => {
    const activeRes = buildEnrichedAdminSociosList({
      afiliadosDb: [
        { id: 'official-1', nombre: 'Kinetic Oficial', estado: 'activo', verificado: true, es_cuenta_oficial: true },
        { id: 'club-2', nombre: 'Club Prueba', estado: 'activo', verificado: true },
      ],
      serviciosRaw: [],
      reservasHistoricas: [],
      deletedAffSet: new Set(),
      runtimeAffRaw: null,
    });
    const officialActive = activeRes.sociosReales.find((s) => s.nombre === 'Kinetic Oficial');
    const regularClub = activeRes.sociosReales.find((s) => s.nombre === 'Club Prueba');
    assertTrue(Boolean(officialActive && officialActive.esClubActivo && !officialActive.sinAgenda14d), 'Kinetic Oficial must stay active with sinAgenda14d=false');
    assertTrue(Boolean(regularClub && regularClub.sinAgenda14d), 'Regular affiliate without agenda in 14d flags sinAgenda14d=true');

    const suspendedRes = buildEnrichedAdminSociosList({
      afiliadosDb: [
        { id: 'official-1', nombre: 'Kinetic Oficial', estado: 'suspendido', verificado: false, es_cuenta_oficial: true },
        { id: 'spoof-1', nombre: 'kinetic', estado: 'pendiente', verificado: false, es_cuenta_oficial: false },
      ],
      serviciosRaw: [],
      reservasHistoricas: [],
      deletedAffSet: new Set(),
      runtimeAffRaw: null,
    });
    const officialSuspended = suspendedRes.sociosReales.find((s) => s.nombre === 'Kinetic Oficial');
    const spoofedPending = suspendedRes.sociosReales.find((s) => s.id === 'spoof-1');
    assertTrue(Boolean(officialSuspended && !officialSuspended.esClubActivo), 'Explicitly suspended Kinetic Oficial reflects inactive');
    assertTrue(Boolean(spoofedPending && !spoofedPending.esClubActivo && !spoofedPending.verificado), 'Unverified pending kinetic name spoof stays inactive');

    const wave2KeyModules = [
      'src/services/navigation/kineticOverlayStack.ts',
      'src/components/shared/KineticDualConfirmModal.tsx',
      'src/components/shared/KineticErgonomicFooter.tsx',
      'src/components/ScannerModal.tsx',
      'src/hooks/useScannerOpticalController.ts',
      'src/utils/kineticPhoneValidatorLeaf.ts',
      'src/components/admin/AdminHubDashboardCards.tsx',
      'src/components/admin/AdminAffiliatesDirectoryView.tsx',
      'src/components/admin/AdminCatalogAndMetricsView.tsx',
      'src/components/AdminModuleModal.tsx',
      'src/components/kineticlub/KinetiClubRpgConstants.ts',
    ];
    const tsIgnoreTag = ['@ts', 'ignore'].join('-');
    const tsIgnoreRe = new RegExp(tsIgnoreTag);
    for (const rel of wave2KeyModules) {
      const txt = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8');
      assertTrue(txt.split(/\r?\n/).length < 450, `File exceeds 450L: ${rel}`);
      assertTrue(!tsIgnoreRe.test(txt), `${tsIgnoreTag} found in ${rel}`);
      const sf = ts.createSourceFile(rel, txt, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
      let anyHits = 0;
      let ecHits = 0;
      const walk = (n: unknown) => {
        const node = n as { kind: number; block?: { statements: unknown[] } };
        if (node.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.AnyKeyword) anyHits += 1;
        if (node.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.CatchClause && node.block && node.block.statements.length === 0) ecHits += 1;
        ts.forEachChild(n, walk);
      };
      walk(sf);
      assertEq(anyHits, 0, `Zero any allowed in ${rel}`);
      assertEq(ecHits, 0, `Zero empty catch allowed in ${rel}`);
    }
  });
});

describe('KINETIC v2.8.6 OLA 3 — Pase Digital 3D, Favoritos 0ms, Calendario +7d, Biometria, Shimmer y No-Shows', () => {
  it('1. (500x PBT) PASE DIGITAL KINETIC unifica estacion 3D, Master Pass 0 KC, cero TOTP/Escrow y cancelacion dual', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 36 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 50, max: 1200 }),
        fc.constantFrom<'bike' | 'reformer' | 'court' | 'bag'>('bike', 'reformer', 'court', 'bag'),
        fc.boolean(),
        fc.boolean(),
        (spotNum, totalPrice, eqType, isEn, isMaster) => {
          const vm = buildKineticDigitalPassViewModel(
            {
              id: 'res-test-3d',
              negocio_nombre: 'Club Mar Los Cabos',
              servicio: 'Rodada Nocturna',
              categoria: 'Cycling',
              fecha_clase: '2026-12-18',
              hora_inicio: '18:30',
              duracion_minutos: 50,
              spot_number: spotNum,
              equipmentType: eqType,
              es_pase_maestro: isMaster,
              precio_kc: totalPrice,
            },
            { isEn }
          );
          assertEq(vm.headerTitle, isEn ? 'KINETIC DIGITAL PASS' : 'PASE DIGITAL KINETIC', 'Titulo pase digital');
          assertEq(vm.stationBadge, formatStudioStationBadge(eqType, spotNum, isEn), 'Estacion 3D localizada');
          assertEq(vm.escrowKc + vm.puertaKc, vm.totalKc, 'Desglose 40/60 debe sumar totalKc');
          if (isMaster) {
            assertEq(vm.totalKc, 0, 'Master Pass debe costar 0 KC');
            assertEq(vm.escrowKc, 0, 'Master Pass anticipo 0 KC');
            assertEq(vm.masterPassBadge, isEn ? 'MASTER PASS • 0 KC' : 'PASE MAESTRO • 0 KC', 'Badge Master Pass');
          }
          const qrTxt = vm.formatQrValidityText(37);
          const bodyTxt = formatDigitalPassAlertBody(vm);
          assertTrue(!/\bTOTP\b/i.test(qrTxt) && !/\bTOTP\b/i.test(bodyTxt), 'Cero TOTP visible');
          assertTrue(!/\bEscrow\b/i.test(bodyTxt), 'Cero Escrow visible B2C');
          assertTrue(Boolean(vm.stationBadge && bodyTxt.includes(vm.stationBadge)), 'Alert body incluye estacion 3D');

          const freePol = evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy({ hoursUntilEvent: 96, montoEscrow: vm.escrowKc, isZeroKcPass: isMaster, isEn });
          const vipPol = evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy({ hoursUntilEvent: 24, vipLevel: 'Black', usedForgivenessCount: 0, montoEscrow: 200, isEn });
          const latePol = evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy({ hoursUntilEvent: 2, montoEscrow: 200, isEn });

            buildCancelDualConfirmCopy(freePol, vm.escrowKc, isEn),
            buildCancelDualConfirmCopy(vipPol, 200, isEn),

          ]) {
            assertTrue(!/\bEscrow\b/i.test(`${cp.title} ${cp.message}`), 'Cancel dual copy sin Escrow');
            assertTrue(cp.confirmLabel === 'Cancelar Reserva' || cp.confirmLabel === 'Cancel Reservation', 'Confirm label invalido');
          }

          assertTrue(vipMsg.includes('Perdón VIP') || vipMsg.includes('VIP Forgiveness'), 'Modal VIP <72h debe advertir 1 Perdon VIP');

    // === src/__tests__/adversarial/v286Wave4Solid3DTrophies250SqlTruth.adversarial.test.ts === //

  simulateShield24hAtomicCharge,
} from '../../services/kineticGamificationSqlTruthLeaf';

interface NodeFs {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
  readdirSync(p: string, opts?: { withFileTypes: true }): Array<{ name: string; isDirectory(): boolean }>;
  statSync(p: string): { size: number; isFile(): boolean };
}
interface NodePath {
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
  dirname(p: string): string;
  relative(from: string, to: string): string;
}
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;
const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFs;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePath;

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const SRC_ROOT = path.join(ROOT, 'src');
const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => {
  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg);
};
const assertEq = <T,>(a: T, b: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (a !== b) throw new Error(`${msg} (expected=${String(b)}, actual=${String(a)})`);
};

const PLATFORM_EXTS = ['', '.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.web.ts', '.web.tsx', '.native.ts', '.native.tsx'];

function walkSrc(dir: string, exts: RegExp, skipTests = true): string[] {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) {
      if (ent.name !== 'node_modules' && (!skipTests || ent.name !== '__tests__')) out.push(...walkSrc(full, exts, skipTests));
    } else if (exts.test(ent.name) && !ent.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
      out.push(path.resolve(full));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function resolveImportTargets(fromFile: string, spec: string): string[] {
  if (!spec || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('@/'))) return [];
  const base = spec.startsWith('@/') ? path.join(SRC_ROOT, spec.slice(2)) : path.resolve(path.dirname(fromFile), spec);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const ext of PLATFORM_EXTS) {
    const c = ext ? `${base}${ext}` : base;
    if (fs.existsSync(c) && fs.statSync(c).isFile()) out.push(path.resolve(c));
  }
  for (const idx of ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx']) {
    const c = path.join(base, `index${idx}`);
    if (fs.existsSync(c) && fs.statSync(c).isFile()) out.push(path.resolve(c));
  }
  return [...new Set(out)];
}

function extractSpecs(filePath: string, content: string, includeTypes: boolean): string[] {
  const kind = filePath.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(filePath, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kind);
  const specs: string[] = [];
  const visit = (n: ts.Node) => {
    if (ts.isImportDeclaration(n) && ts.isStringLiteral(n.moduleSpecifier)) {
      const cl = n.importClause;
      if (!includeTypes && cl && (cl.isTypeOnly || (!cl.name && cl.namedBindings && ts.isNamedImports(cl.namedBindings) && !cl.namedBindings.elements.some((e) => !e.isTypeOnly)))) return;
      specs.push(n.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (ts.isExportDeclaration(n) && n.moduleSpecifier && ts.isStringLiteral(n.moduleSpecifier)) {
      if (!includeTypes && (n.isTypeOnly || (n.exportClause && ts.isNamedExports(n.exportClause) && n.exportClause.elements.every((e) => e.isTypeOnly)))) return;
      specs.push(n.moduleSpecifier.text);
    } else if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && n.arguments.length >= 1 && ts.isStringLiteral(n.arguments[0]) && ((ts.isIdentifier(n.expression) && n.expression.text === 'require') || n.expression.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ImportKeyword)) {
      specs.push(n.arguments[0].text);
    }
    ts.forEachChild(n, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return specs;
}

function findSccs(adj: Map<string, string[]>): string[][] {
  let idx = 0;
  const ind = new Map<string, number>(), low = new Map<string, number>(), st: string[] = [], on = new Set<string>(), sccs: string[][] = [];
  const sc = (v: string) => {
    ind.set(v, idx); low.set(v, idx); idx += 1; st.push(v); on.add(v);
    for (const w of adj.get(v) || []) {
      if (!ind.has(w)) { sc(w); low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v) || 0, low.get(w) || 0)); }
      else if (on.has(w)) low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v) || 0, ind.get(w) || 0));
    }
    if (low.get(v) === ind.get(v)) {
      const comp: string[] = [];
      while (st.length > 0) { const w = st.pop() as string; on.delete(w); comp.push(w); if (w === v) break; }
      if (comp.length > 1 || (adj.get(v) || []).includes(v)) sccs.push(comp.map((p) => path.relative(SRC_ROOT, p)));
    }
  };
  for (const v of adj.keys()) if (!ind.has(v)) sc(v);
  return sccs;
}

function inspectFileAst(relPath: string, content: string) {
  const kind = relPath.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(relPath, content, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kind);
  let maxNesting = 0, useStateCount = 0, anyHits = 0, emptyCatch = 0;
  const walk = (n: ts.Node, depth: number) => {
    const isFn = ts.isFunctionDeclaration(n) || ts.isArrowFunction(n) || ts.isMethodDeclaration(n) || ts.isFunctionExpression(n);
    const isCtrl = ts.isIfStatement(n) || ts.isForStatement(n) || ts.isForOfStatement(n) || ts.isForInStatement(n) || ts.isWhileStatement(n) || ts.isDoStatement(n) || ts.isSwitchStatement(n) || ts.isTryStatement(n);
    const curDepth = (isFn ? 0 : depth) + (isCtrl ? 1 : 0);
    if (curDepth > maxNesting) maxNesting = curDepth;
    if (n.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.AnyKeyword) anyHits += 1;
    if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isIdentifier(n.expression) && n.expression.text === 'useState') useStateCount += 1;
    if (ts.isCatchClause(n) && (!n.variableDeclaration || n.block.statements.length === 0)) emptyCatch += 1;
    if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n.expression) && n.expression.name.text === 'catch' && n.arguments[0] && ts.isArrowFunction(n.arguments[0]) && ts.isBlock(n.arguments[0].body) && n.arguments[0].body.statements.length === 0) emptyCatch += 1;
    ts.forEachChild(n, (c) => walk(c, curDepth));
  };
  walk(sf, 0);
  return { lines: content.split(/\r?\n/).length, maxNesting, useStateCount, anyHits, emptyCatch };
}

describe('KINETIC v2.8.6 Ola 4/6 — Motor 3D Z-Sort, 250 Trofeos, Scroll & Veracidad SQL (500x)', () => {
  it('(a) 500x: Oclusion dorsal Z-Sort [115..245] en Caja Misteriosa y Replay visual 0 KC/XP', () => {

        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }),

        (yawDeg, pitchDeg, hingeAngleDeg, chargeStep, isOpened) => {
          const res = buildArticulatedChestManifold({
            yawDeg, pitchDeg, hingeAngleDeg, chargeStep, rarityStep: Math.max(1, chargeStep),
            isOpened, trimMain: '#FFD700', trimBevel: '#FEF08A', trimDark: '#B45309', coreGlow: '#FFD700',
          });

          assertTrue(res.polys.length >= 24, 'Malla solida minima >= 24');
          assertEq(res.mouthVisibility01 ?? 0, 0, 'Oclusion dorsal: mouthVisibility01 === 0 en [115,245]');
          assertEq(res.cracks3D.length, 0, 'Grietas frontales ocultas de espaldas');
          assertEq(res.ejectedEmblemPos.visible, false, 'Emblema eyectado oculto de espaldas');
          assertEq(res.polys.filter((p) => p.tag === 'beam').length, 0, 'Cero haces amarillos a espaldas');
          for (const p of res.polys) {
            assertTrue(Number.isFinite(p.zSort) && p.points.length > 0 && !p.points.includes('NaN'), 'Sin NaN/Infinity en polys');
          }
          let maxClaspIdx = -1;
          let maxClaspZ = -Infinity;
          let minBackWallIdx = Infinity;
          let maxBackOrLidZ = -Infinity;
          res.polys.forEach((p, idx) => {
            if (p.tag === 'clasp') { maxClaspIdx = Math.max(maxClaspIdx, idx); maxClaspZ = Math.max(maxClaspZ, p.zSort); }
            if (p.tag === 'back_wall') { minBackWallIdx = Math.min(minBackWallIdx, idx); maxBackOrLidZ = Math.max(maxBackOrLidZ, p.zSort); }
            if (p.tag === 'lid_back') maxBackOrLidZ = Math.max(maxBackOrLidZ, p.zSort);
          });
          if (maxClaspIdx >= 0 && minBackWallIdx < Infinity) {
            assertTrue(maxClaspIdx < minBackWallIdx, `Clasp (${maxClaspIdx}) no puede dibujarse encima de back_wall (${minBackWallIdx})`);
            assertTrue(maxClaspZ < maxBackOrLidZ, 'zSort clasp menor que back_wall/lid_back');

interface NodeFs {
  existsSync(p: string): boolean;
  readFileSync(p: string, enc: 'utf8'): string;
  readdirSync(p: string, opts: { withFileTypes: true }): Array<{ name: string; isDirectory(): boolean; isFile(): boolean }>;
  statSync(p: string): { size: number };
}
interface NodePath {
  resolve(...parts: string[]): string;
  join(...parts: string[]): string;
  dirname(p: string): string;
  relative(from: string, to: string): string;
}
declare const require: (id: string) => unknown;
declare const __dirname: string;
declare const describe: (name: string, fn: () => void) => void;
declare const it: (name: string, fn: () => void | Promise<void>) => void;
const fs = require('node:fs') as NodeFs;
const path = require('node:path') as NodePath;

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const SRC_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'src');
const NUM_RUNS = 500;
const assertTrue = (cond: boolean, msg: string): void => { if (!cond) throw new Error(msg); };
const assertEq = <T>(a: T, e: T, msg: string): void => {
  if (a !== e) throw new Error(`${msg} | expected=${String(e)} actual=${String(a)}`);
};

function collectSrcFiles(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (ent.name === 'node_modules' || ent.name === '__tests__') continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, ent.name);
    if (ent.isDirectory()) collectSrcFiles(full, out);
    else if (ent.isFile() && /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(ent.name)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

function inspectAstFile(relPath: string): { lines: number; mn: number; us: number; ah: number; ec: number; ti: number; cl: number } {
  const full = path.join(ROOT, relPath);
  const code = fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8');
  const lines = code.split(/\r?\n/).length;
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(full, code, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, full.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS);
  let mn = 0; let us = 0; let ah = 0; let ec = 0;
  const walk = (n: ts.Node, depth: number): void => {
    const isCtl = ts.isIfStatement(n) || ts.isForStatement(n) || ts.isForInStatement(n) || ts.isForOfStatement(n)
      || ts.isWhileStatement(n) || ts.isDoStatement(n) || ts.isSwitchStatement(n) || ts.isTryStatement(n);
    const nd = isCtl ? depth + 1 : depth;
    if (nd > mn) mn = nd;
    if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && n.expression.getText(sf) === 'useState') us += 1;
    if (n.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.AnyKeyword) ah += 1;
    if (ts.isCatchClause(n) && (!n.variableDeclaration || n.block.statements.length === 0)) ec += 1;
    if (ts.isCallExpression(n) && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(n.expression) && n.expression.name.text === 'catch'
      && n.arguments[0] && ts.isArrowFunction(n.arguments[0]) && n.arguments[0].parameters.length === 0) ec += 1;
    ts.forEachChild(n, (c) => walk(c, nd));
  };
  walk(sf, 0);
  const ti = new RegExp(['@ts', '-ignore'].join('')).test(code) ? 1 : 0;
  const cl = /\bconsole\.log\(/.test(code) ? 1 : 0;
  return { lines, mn, us, ah, ec, ti, cl };
}

function findImportCycleGroups(files: string[]): string[][] {
  const known = new Set(files.map((f) => path.relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/')));
  const adj = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const abs of files) {
    const rel = path.relative(ROOT, abs).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const code = fs.readFileSync(abs, 'utf8');
    const sf = ts.createSourceFile(abs, code, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, abs.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS);
    const deps: string[] = [];
    for (const st of sf.statements) {
      if (!ts.isImportDeclaration(st) || st.importClause?.isTypeOnly) continue;
      const spec = (st.moduleSpecifier as ts.StringLiteral).text;
      if (!spec.startsWith('.')) continue;
      const base = path.relative(ROOT, path.resolve(path.dirname(abs), spec)).replace(/\\/g, '/');
      const hit = [`${base}.ts`, `${base}.tsx`, `${base}/index.ts`, `${base}/index.tsx`].find((c) => known.has(c));
      if (hit) deps.push(hit);
    }
    adj.set(rel, deps);
  }
  let idx = 0;
  const indices = new Map<string, number>();
  const low = new Map<string, number>();
  const onStack = new Set<string>();
  const stack: string[] = [];
  const sccs: string[][] = [];
  const visit = (v: string): void => {
    indices.set(v, idx); low.set(v, idx); idx += 1;
    stack.push(v); onStack.add(v);
    for (const w of adj.get(v) || []) {
      if (!indices.has(w)) { visit(w); low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v)!, low.get(w)!)); }
      else if (onStack.has(w)) low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v)!, indices.get(w)!));
    }
    if (low.get(v) !== indices.get(v)) return;
    const comp: string[] = [];
    let cur = '';
    do { cur = stack.pop()!; onStack.delete(cur); comp.push(cur); } while (cur !== v);
    if (comp.length > 1) sccs.push(comp);
  };
  for (const node of adj.keys()) { if (!indices.has(node)) visit(node); }
  return sccs;
}

describe('KINETIC v2.8.6 OLA 5 — Chat <1s Broadcast/Read Truth, Equipos, Encuadre Propio, Lightbox #050505 y Revalidacion Web Silenciosa', () => {
  it('1. (500x PBT) Verdad unica last_read_at sincroniza Campana 1:1 con MENSAJES, deduplica <1s, marca Leido ✓✓, traduce ES/EN y filtra 4 categorias', () => {
    const meId = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
    const peerA = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
    const peerBlocked = '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333';
    const teamId = '44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444';

    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.integer({ min: 1_700_000_000_000, max: 1_800_000_000_000 }),
        fc.array(fc.record({ offsetSec: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 5000 }), fromMe: fc.boolean() }), { minLength: 1, maxLength: 10 }),
        fc.array(fc.record({ offsetSec: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 5000 }), fromMe: fc.boolean() }), { minLength: 0, maxLength: 6 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 5500 }),
        (baseTs, dmSpecs, teamSpecs, readOffsetSec) => {
          const dmMsgs = dmSpecs.map((s, idx) => ({
            id: `dm_${idx}`,
            clientMsgId: `c_${idx}`,
            senderId: s.fromMe ? meId : peerA,
            text: `DM #${idx}`,
            createdAt: new Date(baseTs + s.offsetSec * 1000).toISOString(),
          }));
          const dupedInput = [...dmMsgs, { ...dmMsgs[0], id: 'uuid-db-row-0' }];
          const deduped = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages(dupedInput);
          assertEq(deduped.length, dmMsgs.length, 'Broadcast + postgres_changes debe deduplicar sin duplicados');

          const teamMsgs = teamSpecs.map((s, idx) => ({
            id: `tm_${idx}`,
            usuario_id: s.fromMe ? meId : peerA,
            mensaje: `Equipo #${idx}`,
            created_at: new Date(baseTs + s.offsetSec * 1000).toISOString(),
          }));
          const readIso = new Date(baseTs + readOffsetSec * 1000).toISOString();
          const truth = computeCanonicalChatUnreadTruth({
            myUserId: meId,
            myUserName: 'Alex Runner',
            lastReadAtMap: { [`dm:peer:${peerA}`]: readIso, [`sq:${teamId}`]: readIso },
            blockedIds: new Set([peerBlocked]),
            dmThreads: [
              { dmCode: 'DM-AA', requesterId: meId, targetId: peerA, status: 'accepted', messages: deduped },
              {
                dmCode: 'DM-BLOCKED', requesterId: peerBlocked, targetId: meId, status: 'pending',
                messages: [{ id: 'blk', senderId: peerBlocked, text: 'hola', createdAt: new Date(baseTs + 9_000_000).toISOString() }],
              },
            ],
            misEquipos: [{ id: teamId, nombre: 'Team Baja', codigo_invitacion: 'EQ-BAJA' }],
            squadRoomsMessagesMap: { [teamId]: teamMsgs },
          });

          const expectedDm = deduped.filter((m) => m.senderId !== meId && Date.parse(String(m.createdAt)) > Date.parse(readIso)).length;
          const expectedTm = teamMsgs.filter((m) => m.usuario_id !== meId && Date.parse(m.created_at) > Date.parse(readIso)).length;
          assertEq(truth.unreadByRoomKey[`dm:peer:${peerA}`] || 0, expectedDm, 'Unread DM debe coincidir con created_at > last_read_at');
          assertEq(truth.unreadByRoomKey[`sq:${teamId}`] || 0, expectedTm, 'Unread Equipo debe coincidir con created_at > last_read_at');
          assertEq(truth.bellChatUnreadCount, truth.messagesTotalUnreadCount, 'Campana y MENSAJES deben compartir verdad 1:1');
          assertEq(truth.incomingPendingDmCount, 0, 'Hilo de usuario bloqueado nunca debe sumar badge');

          const afterMaxRead = computeCanonicalChatUnreadTruth({
            myUserId: meId,
            lastReadAtMap: { [`dm:peer:${peerA}`]: new Date(baseTs + 9_999_000).toISOString(), [`sq:${teamId}`]: new Date(baseTs + 9_999_000).toISOString() },
            dmThreads: [{ dmCode: 'DM-AA', requesterId: meId, targetId: peerA, status: 'accepted', messages: deduped }],
            misEquipos: [{ id: teamId, nombre: 'Team Baja', codigo_invitacion: 'EQ-BAJA' }],
            squadRoomsMessagesMap: { [teamId]: teamMsgs },
          });
          assertEq(afterMaxRead.totalUnreadMessages, 0, 'Marcar leido en ambos cuartos debe dejar totalUnread en 0');

          assertTrue(isOwnMessageSeenByPeer({ isMine: true, msgCreatedAt: readIso, peerLastReadAt: readIso }), 'Seen ✓✓ true cuando peerLastRead >= msg');
          assertTrue(!isOwnMessageSeenByPeer({ isMine: false, msgCreatedAt: readIso, msgLeidoAt: readIso }), 'Nunca mostrar Seen en mensaje ajeno');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );

    const noticeEs = '⚡ Sofía aceptó la invitación y se integró al escuadrón!';
    assertTrue(translateChatSystemNoticeDynamic(noticeEs, 'en').includes('joined the team!'), 'Aviso dinamico ES->EN');
    assertTrue(translateChatSystemNoticeDynamic('⚡ Sofía left the team.', 'es').includes('salió del equipo'), 'Aviso dinamico EN->ES');

    const streamArgs = {

  it('2. (500x PBT + Scan src/) Erradica Kine✅tic, Escuadron/Squads visibles, allowsEditing: true y CROP nativo; sella Lightbox #050505', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom('Kine✅tic', 'Kine✓tic', 'Kine✔tic Oficial', 'Kine☑️tic Official', 'Kinetic ✅', 'Elena ✅ Ruiz'),
        fc.boolean(),

          assertTrue(!/kine[^\w\s]+tic/i.test(cleaned), `Nunca partir palabra Kinetic: ${cleaned}`);
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );

    const sanitizerAllowlist = new Set([
      'src/utils/kineticDisplayNamePureLeaf.ts', 'src/services/kineticlubHelpers.ts',
      'src/services/kineticChatReadTruthLeaf.ts', 'src/utils/kineticSmartTranslator.ts',
      'src/services/kineticConciergeIntentEngine.ts',
    ]);
    const hasUiEscuadronLiteral = (absPath: string, source: string): boolean => {
      const sf = ts.createSourceFile(absPath, source, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, absPath.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS);
      let found = false;
      const scan = (node: ts.Node): void => {
        if (found) return;
        if (ts.isStringLiteral(node) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(node) || ts.isJsxText(node)) {
          if (/(Escuadr[óo]n|Escuadrones|KinetiSquad)/i.test(node.text)) { found = true; return; }
        }
        ts.forEachChild(node, scan);
      };
      scan(sf);
      return found;
    };
    for (const abs of collectSrcFiles(SRC_DIR)) {
      const rel = path.relative(ROOT, abs).replace(/\\/g, '/');

      assertTrue(!/Recorte\s+1:1|1:1\s+Crop/.test(code), `Copy nativo de recorte prohibido en ${rel}`);

        assertTrue(!hasUiEscuadronLiteral(abs, code), `Termino legacy Escuadron/KinetiSquad en UI de ${rel}`);

    assertTrue(lbModal.includes("Platform.OS !== 'web'") && lbStyles.includes("backgroundColor: '#050505'") && lbStyles.includes('opacity: 1'), 'Lightbox #050505 opaco + useNativeDriver Web safe');
    assertEq(

      'https://gcppxrlzxlgkuapktxvl.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/a.jpg',

    );

    assertEq(isSafeKineticMediaUri('javascript:alert(1)', false), '', 'Bloquea javascript: URI en Framing');
    assertEq(isSafeKineticMediaUri('http://evil.example/a.jpg', false), '', 'Bloquea HTTP remoto inseguro en Framing');
  });

  it('3. (500x PBT) Geometria KineticImageFrame (1:1 / 9:16 / 16:9) acotada y Revalidacion Web Silenciosa sin parpadeos ni perdida de sesion', () => {
    fc.assert(
      fc.property(
        fc.constantFrom<KineticFrameAspect>('1:1', '9:16', '16:9'),
        fc.integer({ min: 280, max: 1440 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 480, max: 1200 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 200, max: 4000 }),
        fc.integer({ min: 200, max: 4000 }),
        fc.double({ min: 0.4, max: 4.8, noNaN: true }),
        fc.integer({ min: -1800, max: 1800 }),
        fc.integer({ min: -1800, max: 1800 }),
        (aspect, vw, vh, nw, nh, rawZoom, rawOx, rawOy) => {
          const stage = computeFrameStageDimensions(aspect, vw, vh);
          assertTrue(stage.width >= 120 && stage.height >= 120, 'Dimensiones minimas del visor de encuadre');
          const clamped = clampFrameTransform({
            naturalWidth: nw, naturalHeight: nh, stageWidth: stage.width, stageHeight: stage.height,
            zoom: rawZoom, offsetX: rawOx, offsetY: rawOy,
          });
          assertTrue(clamped.zoom >= MIN_FRAME_ZOOM && clamped.zoom <= MAX_FRAME_ZOOM, 'Zoom acotado [1x..3x]');
          assertTrue(Math.abs(clamped.offsetX) <= clamped.maxOffsetX + 0.001, 'offsetX acotado');
          assertTrue(Math.abs(clamped.offsetY) <= clamped.maxOffsetY + 0.001, 'offsetY acotado');

          const crop = computeNormalizedSourceCropRect({
            naturalWidth: nw, naturalHeight: nh, stageWidth: stage.width, stageHeight: stage.height,
            zoom: rawZoom, offsetX: rawOx, offsetY: rawOy,
          });
          assertTrue(crop.originX >= 0 && crop.originY >= 0, 'Origen de recorte >= 0');
          assertTrue(crop.originX + crop.width <= nw && crop.originY + crop.height <= nh, 'Recorte estrictamente dentro de imagen fuente');
          assertTrue(crop.normW > 0 && crop.normW <= 1 && crop.normH > 0 && crop.normH <= 1, 'Normalizacion en (0..1]');

          const shouldPreserve = shouldPreserveSessionOnTransientMfaCheckFailure({
            hasActiveValidUserSession: rawOx >= 0, sessionRequiresAal2: rawOy < 0,
            mfaCheckFailed: true, mfaRequiresChallenge: aspect === '16:9',
          });
          if (rawOx < 0 || rawOy < 0 || aspect === '16:9') assertTrue(!shouldPreserve, 'Nunca preservar si requiere AAL2 o falta sesion');
          else assertTrue(shouldPreserve, 'Preservar sesion valida ante fallo MFA transitorio en foco Web');

          assertTrue(!shouldShowLoadingOnWebFocusRevalidate({ hasHydratedData: true, isExplicitManualRefresh: false }), '0 skeletons en focus con SWR hidratado');
          assertEq(computeStableDataSignature({ a: vw, b: nh }), computeStableDataSignature({ a: vw, b: nh }), 'Firma estable determinista');
        }
      ),
      { numRuns: NUM_RUNS }
    );
  });

    assertTrue(!fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'src/services/kineticlubWallRealtimeHelper.ts'), 'utf8').includes('kinetic_chat_bus_v286'), 'Cero canal Broadcast global plaintext');

    assertTrue(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'src/services/stripeService.ts'), 'utf8').includes('allow_pre_stripe_sandbox'), 'allow_pre_stripe_sandbox activo');

const PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY = "@kinetic_pending_oauth_mode_v1";

const PUBLIC_ENTRY_ROUTES = new Set(["", "index", "oauth", "login", "login-type", "login_type", "login_b2b", "register", "register-type", "register_type", "register_b2b"]);
const PROTECTED_STAY_ROUTES = new Set(["(tabs)", "privacidad", "terminos", "reservation-detail", "reservation-details"]);

enforceDarkNativeWindowAndWebLocks();
applyGlobalSystemLocks();
try { SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; }); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }

const KineticTheme = {
  ...DarkTheme,
  colors: { ...DarkTheme.colors, background: "#050505", card: "#050505", text: COLORS.textPrimary, border: "#181A20", primary: COLORS.cyan, notification: COLORS.cyan },
};

const KineticLightTheme = {
  ...DefaultTheme,
  colors: { ...DefaultTheme.colors, background: "#ECF1F8", card: "#FFFFFF", text: "#0F172A", border: "#CBD5E1", primary: "#006B82", notification: "#006B82" },
};

export { resolveRoleDestination };

function RootNavigationGuard({ fontsLoaded }: { fontsLoaded: boolean }) {
  const { session, user, profile, isLoading: isAuthLoading } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors, resolvedTheme } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
  const router = useRouter();
  const segments = useSegments();
  const navigationState = useRootNavigationState();
  const isLandingHost = useMemo(() => isKineticWebLandingHost(), []);
  const [founderUnlocked, setFounderUnlocked] = useState(() => isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync());
  const seg0 = String(segments[0] || "");
  const webPathname = Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined" ? String(window.location?.pathname || "/") : "";
  const webSearch = Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined" ? String(window.location?.search || "") : "";
  const webHash = Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined" ? String(window.location?.hash || "") : "";
  const hasOAuthReturn = Platform.OS === "web" && hasActiveWebOAuthReturnParams(webSearch, webHash);
  const isWebPreLaunchBlocked = shouldBlockWebRoutePreLaunch({
    platformOs: Platform.OS,
    rootSegment: seg0,
    pathname: webPathname,
    search: webSearch,
    hash: webHash,
    hasFounderPass: founderUnlocked,
  });
  const isInstantWebLanding =
    Platform.OS === "web" &&
    (isWebPreLaunchBlocked ||
      ((!seg0 || seg0 === "index") && !hasOAuthReturn && (isLandingHost || !founderUnlocked || !user || isExplicitKineticSignOut())));

  const alreadyPlayedWebIntro = useMemo(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== "web" || typeof window === "undefined") return false;
    if (isLandingHost || isInstantWebLanding || !founderUnlocked || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return true;
    try {
      const webPath = String(window.location?.pathname || "");
      if (webPath === "/" || webPath.startsWith("/oauth") || webPath.startsWith("/socios")) return true;
      if (window.sessionStorage?.getItem("__kinetic_intro_played_v25") === "1") return true;
      if (readPersistedKineticSessionSync()?.user?.id) {
        window.sessionStorage?.setItem("__kinetic_intro_played_v25", "1");
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      return false;
    }
  }, [isLandingHost, isInstantWebLanding, founderUnlocked]);

  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(alreadyPlayedWebIntro ? 0 : 1)).current;
  const logoPulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0.96)).current;
  const [showOverlay, setShowOverlay] = useState(!alreadyPlayedWebIntro);
  const [introFinished, setIntroFinished] = useState(Platform.OS !== "web" || alreadyPlayedWebIntro);
  const hasHiddenSplashRef = useRef(false);
  const hasStartedFadeOutRef = useRef(false);

  const [oidcTransitionActive, setOidcTransitionActive] = useState(() => isOidcReturnTransitionActive());

  const syncWebPassState = useCallback(() => setFounderUnlocked(isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync()), []);
  const redirectWebPassTarget = useCallback((p: "/login" | "/socios" | "/") => {
    try { router.replace(p as Href); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  }, [router]);
  useWebPrivatePassLifecycle({ onPassChanged: syncWebPassState, onRedirect: redirectWebPassTarget, routeKey: `${seg0}:${webPathname}` });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isInstantWebLanding) {
      setIntroFinished(true);
      setShowOverlay(false);
      setIsSigningOutCurtain(false);
    }
  }, [isInstantWebLanding]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsSigningOutCurtain(isExplicitKineticSignOut() && !isInstantWebLanding);
    setOidcTransitionActive(isOidcReturnTransitionActive());
    const unsubSignOut = subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut((flag) => setIsSigningOutCurtain(flag && !isInstantWebLanding));
    const unsubOidc = subscribeOidcReturnTransition((flag) => setOidcTransitionActive(flag));
    const onWebPageShow = () => {
      if (Platform.OS !== "web" || typeof window === "undefined") return;
      if (String(window.location?.pathname || "").startsWith("/oauth")) return;
      if (!getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge().required) { setOidcReturnTransitionActive(false); setPendingMfaGateActive(false); }
    };
    if (Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined") window.addEventListener("pageshow", onWebPageShow);
    return () => {
      unsubSignOut(); unsubOidc();
      if (Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined") window.removeEventListener("pageshow", onWebPageShow);
    };
  }, [isInstantWebLanding]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const bootSafetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setForceSystemReady(true);
      setIntroFinished(true);
      if (!hasHiddenSplashRef.current) {
        hasHiddenSplashRef.current = true;
        SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      }
    }, 1200);
    return () => clearTimeout(bootSafetyTimer);
  }, []);

  const isNavMounted = Boolean(navigationState?.key);
  const isSystemReady = (fontsLoaded && !isAuthLoading && isNavMounted) || (forceSystemReady && isNavMounted);

  const webVideoUri = useMemo(() => getIntroWebVideoUri(), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showOverlay) return;
    const useNative = Platform.OS !== "web";
    const pulseLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(logoPulseAnim, { toValue: 1.04, duration: 750, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: useNative }),
        Animated.timing(logoPulseAnim, { toValue: 0.96, duration: 750, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: useNative }),
      ])
    );
    pulseLoop.start();
    const fallbackTimer = setTimeout(() => setIntroFinished(true), Platform.OS === "web" ? 2400 : 520);
    return () => { pulseLoop.stop(); clearTimeout(fallbackTimer); };
  }, [logoPulseAnim, showOverlay]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fontsLoaded && !hasHiddenSplashRef.current) {
      hasHiddenSplashRef.current = true;
      SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
    }
  }, [fontsLoaded]);

  const finishIntroNow = useCallback(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try { window.sessionStorage?.setItem("__kinetic_intro_played_v25", "1"); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }
    setIntroFinished(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSigningOutCurtain) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setIsSigningOutCurtain(false), 950);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [isSigningOutCurtain]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSigningOutCurtain) return;
    const curSeg = String(segments[0] || "");
    if (!PUBLIC_ENTRY_ROUTES.has(curSeg) && !(Platform.OS === "web" && curSeg === "socios")) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setIsSigningOutCurtain(false), 180);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [isSigningOutCurtain, segments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isNavMounted) return;
    if (isWebPreLaunchBlocked) {
      if (Platform.OS === "web" && typeof window !== "undefined" && window.location.pathname !== "/") {

      }
      try { router.replace("/"); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }

    }
    if (!isSystemReady || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return;

    const explicitSignOut = isExplicitKineticSignOut();
    const liveRequiresMfa = Boolean(getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge().required || (session && doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(session)));
    const rawSnap = !explicitSignOut && !liveRequiresMfa ? readPersistedKineticSessionSync() : null;
    const persistedSnap = rawSnap && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(rawSnap.session) ? rawSnap : null;
    const effectiveSession = explicitSignOut || liveRequiresMfa ? null : (session || persistedSnap?.session || null);
    const effectiveToken = (effectiveSession as { access_token?: string } | null)?.access_token;
    const hasRealJwt = isRealSupabaseJwt(effectiveToken);
    const effectiveUser = explicitSignOut || liveRequiresMfa ? null : (user || persistedSnap?.user || null);
    const effectiveProfile = explicitSignOut || liveRequiresMfa ? null : (profile || persistedSnap?.profile || null);

    const currentRoot = String(segments[0] || "");
    const currentTab = String(segments[1] || "");
    if (currentRoot === "oauth") return;
    if (Platform.OS === "web" && currentRoot === "socios") return;
    const inTabsGroup = currentRoot === "(tabs)";
    const isPublicEntryRoute = PUBLIC_ENTRY_ROUTES.has(currentRoot);
    const isProtectedStayRoute = PROTECTED_STAY_ROUTES.has(currentRoot);

    if (!effectiveUser || explicitSignOut) {
      const needsLoginRedirect = explicitSignOut && (inTabsGroup || currentRoot === "reservation-detail" || currentRoot === "reservation-details");
      if (needsLoginRedirect && claimExplicitSignOutLoginRedirect()) {

        return;
      }
      if (explicitSignOut && isSigningOutCurtain && !needsLoginRedirect) {
        const settledMs = PUBLIC_ENTRY_ROUTES.has(currentRoot) ? 80 : 600;
        const t = setTimeout(() => setIsSigningOutCurtain(false), settledMs);
        return () => clearTimeout(t);
      }
      if (!explicitSignOut && inTabsGroup) {
        try { router.replace("/"); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
      }
      return;
    }
    if (isSigningOutCurtain && inTabsGroup) setIsSigningOutCurtain(false);

import { Tabs, usePathname, useRouter, useSegments } from 'expo-router';

import { KineticBlurTargetContainer } from '../../components/shared/KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';

import { getSafeWebPushBrowserCapabilities } from '../../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

  getKineticHomeRouteForRole,
  resolveSyncRole,

import { useHasKinetiClubTabAlert } from '../../services/kineticlubTabAlertStore';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { persistRoleCache } from '../../utils/kineticRoleCache';
import { isKineticB2BRoleText, normalizeRoleToken } from '../../utils/kineticRoleLeafGuards';

type TabBarProps = Parameters<NonNullable<React.ComponentProps<typeof Tabs>['tabBar']>>[0];
type TabBarBridgeState = { state: TabBarProps['state']; navigation: TabBarProps['navigation'] };

export default function TabLayout() {
  const { user, profile, isLoading: isAuthLoading } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [isSigningOut, setIsSigningOut] = useState(() => isExplicitKineticSignOut());

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsSigningOut(isExplicitKineticSignOut());
    return subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut(setIsSigningOut);
  }, []);

  if (!user?.id || isSigningOut || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
    return <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: themeColors.background }} />;
  }

  return <AuthenticatedTabsShell user={user} profile={profile} isAuthLoading={isAuthLoading} />;
}

function AuthenticatedTabsShell({
  user,
  profile,
  isAuthLoading,
}: {
  user: KineticAuthUser;
  profile: KineticAuthProfile | null;

    asyncRoleEntry && asyncRoleEntry.uid === user.id ? asyncRoleEntry.role : null;

        if (isMounted) {

    if (!resolvedRole) return;

      _lastBootRoleRef.current = resolvedRole;
      if (prevRole && prevRole !== resolvedRole) {

    !isSocio;
  const isCliente = !isSocio && !isAdmin;
  const roleRootTarget: '/(tabs)/admin' | '/(tabs)/terminal' | '/(tabs)' = isAdmin
    ? '/(tabs)/admin'
    : isSocio
    ? '/(tabs)/terminal'

  const inTabsGroup = String(segments[0] || '') === '(tabs)';
  const replaceRoleRootRoute = useCallback(

  useTabsBackGuard({

  const needsSocioRedirect =
    !isCheckingDBRole &&

  useEffect(() => {

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id || isAdmin) return;
    const webPath =
      Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location
        ? window.location.pathname || ''
        : '';
    const onAdminOrExplore =
      !isCheckingDBRole &&
      (pathname === '/admin' ||
        pathname.endsWith('/admin') ||
        webPath === '/admin' ||
        webPath.endsWith('/admin') ||
        webPath === '/explorar' ||
        webPath.endsWith('/explorar'));
    const onBlockedTerminal =
      !isCheckingDBRole &&
      isCliente &&
      (pathname === '/terminal' || pathname.endsWith('/terminal') || webPath === '/terminal' || webPath.endsWith('/terminal'));
    if (onAdminOrExplore || onBlockedTerminal) {

  }, [user?.id, isAdmin, isB2B, isCheckingDBRole, isCliente, pathname, router]);

  const getInitialRoute = () => (isAdmin ? 'admin' : isSocio ? 'terminal' : 'index');
  const hasActiveStreak = useHasKinetiClubTabAlert(user?.id);
  const isColdRoleBoot = isCheckingDBRole && !lastKnownRoleRef.current;
  const showTransitionCurtain = Boolean(user?.id) && (isColdRoleBoot || needsSocioRedirect);
  const pillBottomOffset = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? Math.max(insets.bottom, 12) : Math.max(insets.bottom, 10) + 4;

  const visibleRouteNames = useMemo(() => {

const AndroidTabBarSyncBridge = React.memo(
  ({
    state,
    navigation,
    onSync,
  }: {
    state: TabBarProps['state'];
    navigation: TabBarProps['navigation'];
    onSync: (next: TabBarBridgeState) => void;
  }) => {
    const activeKey = state?.routes?.[state?.index]?.key || '';
    const routeKeys = Array.isArray(state?.routes)
      ? state.routes.map((r: { key?: string; name?: string }) => `${r.key}:${r.name}`).join('|')
      : '';
    useLayoutEffect(() => {
      onSync({ state, navigation });
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [state?.index, activeKey, routeKeys, navigation, onSync]);
    return null;
  }
);

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Platform,
  StatusBar,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { KineticButton } from '../components/KineticButton';
import { KineticWebLanding, isKineticWebLandingHost } from '../components/web/KineticWebLanding';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync } from '../services/kineticFounderWebPassLeaf';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut } from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const KINETIC_LOGO = require('../../assets/logo.png');

export default function WelcomeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors, resolvedTheme, t } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['logoBadgeBox']), [resolvedTheme]);
  const showCommercialLanding = useMemo(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location) return false;
    return (
      !isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync() ||
      isKineticWebLandingHost() ||
      !user ||
      isExplicitKineticSignOut()
    );
  }, [user]);

  if (showCommercialLanding) {
    return <KineticWebLanding />;
  }

  if (isLoading || user) {
    return <View style={[styles.mainContainer, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]} />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={[styles.mainContainer, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle={themeColors.statusBarStyle} backgroundColor={themeColors.background} />

      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
          <View style={styles.logoBadgeBox}>
            <Image
              source={KINETIC_LOGO}
              style={styles.logoImage}
              contentFit="contain"
              cachePolicy="memory-disk"
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.buttonContainer}>
          {/* ACCESO DIRECTO AL LOGIN UNIFICADO */}
          <KineticButton
            title={t('auth.elite_access')}
            iconName="arrow-right"
            iconPosition="right"
            variant="purple"
            style={styles.btnFull}
            onPress={() => router.push('/login')}
          />

          <Text style={[styles.helperText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{t('auth.new_on_court')}</Text>

          <KineticButton
            title={t('auth.create_account')}
            iconName="user-plus"
            iconPosition="left"
            variant="cyan"
            style={styles.btnFull}
            onPress={() => router.push('/register')}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { Redirect, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import React from 'react';

export default function LoginTypeLegacyAliasScreen() {
  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ mode?: string | string[] }>();
  const rawMode = Array.isArray(params.mode) ? params.mode[0] : params.mode;
  const mode = String(rawMode || '').trim();
  if (mode.toLowerCase() === 'b2b') {
    return <Redirect href="/login_b2b" />;
  }
  if (mode.length > 0) {
    return <Redirect href={{ pathname: '/login', params: { mode } }} />;
  }
  return <Redirect href="/login" />;
}

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, ScrollView, StatusBar, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { LoginMfaChallengeModal, SavedLoginAccountsStrip } from '../components/auth/LoginMfaChallengeModal';
import { TwoStepRecoveryModal, runSafeBiometricAuth } from '../components/auth/LoginQuickModals';
import { KineticButton } from '../components/KineticButton';
import { TacticalAlertModal } from '../components/KinetiClubModals';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { KineticFastAuthPanel } from '../components/auth/KineticFastAuthPanel';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { mapSupabaseAuthError, useKineticAuth } from '../hooks/useKineticAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { type SafeSavedAccountMeta, loadSanitizedLoginAccounts, removeSanitizedLoginAccount, saveSanitizedLoginAccount } from '../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import { clearLoginCredentialsState } from '../services/kineticLoginAccountsSanitizer';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut } from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys } from '../services/kineticVaultCrypto';
import { breakOutOfIframeToTop } from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';
import { baseLoginStyles } from '../styles/login.styles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const KINETIC_LOGIN_LOGO = require('../../assets/logo.png');

export function UnifiedLoginScreen({ initialMode = 'b2c' }: { initialMode?: 'b2c' | 'b2b' }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { resolvedTheme, themeColors, language, t, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const loginStyles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseLoginStyles, resolvedTheme, ['logoBadgeBox']), [resolvedTheme]);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [savedState, setSavedState] = useState<{
    bioEnabled: boolean; credsB2C: SafeSavedAccountMeta | null; credsB2B: SafeSavedAccountMeta | null; accountsMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>;
  }>({ bioEnabled: true, credsB2C: null, credsB2B: null, accountsMap: {} });
  const [uiState, setUiState] = useState({ passwordResetKey: 0, showPass: false, showRecoveryModal: false, keyboardHeight: 0 });
  const { credsB2C, credsB2B, accountsMap, bioEnabled: isBiometricSwitchEnabled } = savedState;
  const { passwordResetKey: passwordInputResetKey, showPass, showRecoveryModal, keyboardHeight } = uiState;

  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);
  const emailInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const passwordInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      breakOutOfIframeToTop();
      void Image.prefetch('/logo.png').catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
    }
  }, []);

  const readAutofilledWebInputs = useCallback(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof document === 'undefined') return { domEmail: '', domPassword: '' };
    const emailEl = (document.getElementById('kinetic-login-email') as HTMLInputElement | null) || (document.querySelector('input[autocomplete="email"], input[type="email"]') as HTMLInputElement | null);
    const passEl = (document.getElementById('kinetic-login-password') as HTMLInputElement | null) || (document.querySelector('input[autocomplete="current-password"], input[type="password"]') as HTMLInputElement | null);
    return { domEmail: String(emailEl?.value || '').trim(), domPassword: String(passEl?.value || '').trim() };
  }, []);

  const clearLoginInputsAtomically = useCallback(() => {
    const cleared = clearLoginCredentialsState();
    setEmail(cleared.email);
    setPassword(cleared.password);
    if (cleared.errorCleared) {
      setAlertConfig((prev) => (prev.visible && prev.type === 'error' ? { ...prev, visible: false, onConfirm: null } : prev));
    }
    setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, passwordResetKey: prev.passwordResetKey + 1 }));
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const emailEl = document.getElementById('kinetic-login-email') as HTMLInputElement | null;
      const passEl = document.getElementById('kinetic-login-password') as HTMLInputElement | null;
      if (emailEl) emailEl.value = '';
      if (passEl) passEl.value = '';
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const syncFromDom = () => {
      const { domEmail, domPassword } = readAutofilledWebInputs();
      if (domEmail) setEmail((prev) => (prev ? prev : domEmail.slice(0, 120)));
      if (domPassword) setPassword((prev) => (prev ? prev : domPassword.slice(0, 128)));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(syncFromDom, 350);
    document.addEventListener('change', syncFromDom, true);
    return () => { clearTimeout(timer); document.removeEventListener('change', syncFromDom, true); };
  }, [readAutofilledWebInputs]);

  const [alertConfig, setAlertConfig] = useState({
    visible: false, title: '', message: '', type: 'alert',
    onConfirm: null as (() => void) | null, confirmText: tx('ENTENDIDO', 'GOT IT'),
    cancelText: '', secondaryActionText: '', onSecondaryAction: null as (() => void) | null,
  });

  const loginTimersRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[]>([]);
  const scheduleLoginTimer = useCallback((fn: () => void, ms: number) => {
    const tid = setTimeout(fn, ms);
    loginTimersRef.current.push(tid);
    return tid;
  }, []);

  const showTacticalAlert = useCallback((title: string, message: string, type = 'alert') => {
    const isAuthDenied = /ACCESO DENEGADO|ACCESS DENIED/i.test(String(title || ''));
    setAlertConfig({
      visible: true, title, message, type, confirmText: tx('ENTENDIDO', 'GOT IT'), cancelText: '', onConfirm: null,
      secondaryActionText: isAuthDenied ? tx('¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?', 'Forgot password?') : '',
      onSecondaryAction: isAuthDenied ? () => {
        setAlertConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }));
        scheduleLoginTimer(() => setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, showRecoveryModal: true })), 60);
      } : null,
    });
  }, [tx, scheduleLoginTimer]);

  const {
    isEmailSigningIn, isTransitioningAfterLogin, isSsoLoading, pendingMfaChallenge, isVerifyingMfa, mfaErrorMsg, verifyPendingMfaLogin, cancelPendingMfaLogin,
    handleSignIn, handleBiometricSessionRestore, handleGoogleSignIn,
  } = useKineticAuth(triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert);
  const isAuthSubmitting = isEmailSigningIn || isTransitioningAfterLogin;
  const bioSelectBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const pendingPostMfaCredsRef = useRef<{ email: string; mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => () => {
    pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current = null;
    loginTimersRef.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
    loginTimersRef.current = [];
  }, []);

  const handleGoogleSSO = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (isSsoLoading) return false;
    return handleGoogleSignIn(initialMode);
  }, [isSsoLoading, handleGoogleSignIn, initialMode]);

  const handleForgetAccount = useCallback(async (accountEmail: string) => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    const normAcc = accountEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    const nextMap = await removeSanitizedLoginAccount(normAcc, accountsMap);
    setSavedState((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      accountsMap: nextMap,
      credsB2C: prev.credsB2C?.email?.trim().toLowerCase() === normAcc ? null : prev.credsB2C,
      credsB2B: prev.credsB2B?.email?.trim().toLowerCase() === normAcc ? null : prev.credsB2B,
    }));
    if (email.trim().toLowerCase() === normAcc) clearLoginInputsAtomically();
  }, [accountsMap, email, clearLoginInputsAtomically]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const showEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillShow' : 'keyboardDidShow';
    const hideEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillHide' : 'keyboardDidHide';
    const subShow = Keyboard.addListener(showEv, (e) => {
      const h = e.endCoordinates?.height || 260;
      setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, keyboardHeight: h }));
      scheduleLoginTimer(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: 124, animated: true }), 80);
    });
    const subHide = Keyboard.addListener(hideEv, () => setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, keyboardHeight: 0 })));
    return () => { subShow.remove(); subHide.remove(); };
  }, [scheduleLoginTimer]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    loadSanitizedLoginAccounts().then(({ bioEnabled, safeB2C, safeB2B, sanitizedMap }) => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      setSavedState({ bioEnabled, credsB2C: safeB2C, credsB2B: safeB2B, accountsMap: sanitizedMap });
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [initialMode]);

  const savedAccountList = useMemo(() => {
    const merged: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> = {};
    for (const acc of [...Object.values(accountsMap), credsB2C, credsB2B]) {
      if (!acc?.email) continue;
      const norm = acc.email.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!norm || norm === '__proto__' || norm === 'constructor' || norm === 'prototype') continue;
      const prev = merged[norm];
      merged[norm] = prev
        ? { email: norm, nombre: acc.nombre || prev.nombre, rol: prev.rol === 'b2b' || acc.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c' }
        : { ...acc, email: norm };
    }
    return Object.values(merged);
  }, [accountsMap, credsB2C, credsB2B]);

  const persistLoginSuccess = useCallback((targetEmail: string, _targetPass: string, targetMode: 'b2c' | 'b2b') => {
    saveSanitizedLoginAccount(targetEmail, targetMode, accountsMap)
      .then(({ isB2B, safeMeta, nextMap }) => {
        setSavedState((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          accountsMap: nextMap,
          credsB2B: isB2B ? safeMeta : prev.credsB2B,
          credsB2C: !isB2B ? safeMeta : prev.credsB2C,
        }));
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    void purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys();
  }, [accountsMap]);

  const onSubmitLogin = useCallback(async () => {
    Keyboard.dismiss();
    const { domEmail, domPassword } = readAutofilledWebInputs();
    const cleanEmail = (String(email || '').trim() || domEmail).trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
    const cleanPassword = (String(password || '').trim() || domPassword).trim().slice(0, 128);
    if (cleanEmail && cleanEmail !== email) setEmail(cleanEmail);
    if (cleanPassword && !password) setPassword(cleanPassword);
    if (!cleanEmail || !cleanPassword) {
      triggerHaptic('Error');
      showTacticalAlert(tx('CAMPOS REQUERIDOS', 'REQUIRED FIELDS'), tx('Ingresa tu correo electrónico y tu contraseña para iniciar sesión.', 'Enter your email address and password to sign in.'), 'error');
      return;
    }
    const signInRes = await handleSignIn(cleanEmail, cleanPassword, initialMode);
    if (signInRes === 'mfa_required') { pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current = { email: cleanEmail, mode: initialMode }; return; }
    if (signInRes === true && cleanEmail) persistLoginSuccess(cleanEmail, '', initialMode);
  }, [email, password, readAutofilledWebInputs, handleSignIn, initialMode, showTacticalAlert, tx, persistLoginSuccess]);

  const handleConfirmMfaCode = useCallback(async (code: string) => {
    const ok = await verifyPendingMfaLogin(code);
    if (ok && pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current) {
      const { email: savedEmail, mode: savedMode } = pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current;
      pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current = null;
      persistLoginSuccess(savedEmail, '', savedMode);
    }
    return ok;
  }, [verifyPendingMfaLogin, persistLoginSuccess]);

  const handleAbortMfaChallenge = useCallback(() => {
    pendingPostMfaCredsRef.current = null;
    void cancelPendingMfaLogin();
  }, [cancelPendingMfaLogin]);

  const handleSelectSavedAccount = useCallback(async (acc: SafeSavedAccountMeta) => {
    if (bioSelectBusyRef.current || isAuthSubmitting) return;
    bioSelectBusyRef.current = true;
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    const fallbackToManualPassword = () => { setEmail(acc.email); setPassword(''); passwordInputRef.current?.focus(); };
    try {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' || !isBiometricSwitchEnabled) { fallbackToManualPassword(); return; }
      const bioOk = await runSafeBiometricAuth(tx('Verifica tu biometría para entrar a Kinetic', 'Verify your biometrics to sign in to Kinetic'), tx('Usar PIN del dispositivo', 'Use device PIN'), tx('Usar contraseña', 'Use password'));
      if (!bioOk) { fallbackToManualPassword(); return; }
      const restored = await handleBiometricSessionRestore(acc.email, acc.rol || initialMode, { alreadyAuthenticatedHardware: true });
      if (!restored) fallbackToManualPassword();
    } finally { bioSelectBusyRef.current = false; }
  }, [isAuthSubmitting, isBiometricSwitchEnabled, tx, initialMode, handleBiometricSessionRestore]);

  const handleForgotPassword = useCallback(() => setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, showRecoveryModal: true })), []);
  const iconAccent = initialMode === 'b2b' ? (themeColors.isLight ? themeColors.purpleText : '#C77DFF') : themeColors.cyanText;
  const noSel: ViewStyle | null = Platform.OS === 'web'
    ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle)
    : null;
  const attenuatedPlaceholder = themeColors.isLight ? 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.46)' : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.44)';
  const lightInput3D = themeColors.isLight
    ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: initialMode === 'b2b' ? '#C084FC' : '#38BDF8', borderBottomColor: initialMode === 'b2b' ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4', shadowColor: initialMode === 'b2b' ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4', shadowOpacity: 0.18, elevation: 0 }
    : { backgroundColor: '#05070B' };
  const canShowLoginBackButton = useMemo(() => {
    if (isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return false;
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const refOrigin = document.referrer ? new URL(document.referrer).origin : '';
        return Boolean(refOrigin && refOrigin === window.location.origin && window.history.length > 1);
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return Boolean(router.canGoBack?.());
  }, [router]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[loginStyles.safeArea, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle={themeColors.statusBarStyle} backgroundColor={themeColors.background} />
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: themeColors.background }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : Platform.OS === 'android' ? 'height' : undefined}
        keyboardVerticalOffset={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 12 : 0}
      >
        <ScrollView
          ref={scrollRef}
          contentContainerStyle={[
            loginStyles.scrollContent,
            { backgroundColor: themeColors.background, paddingBottom: keyboardHeight > 0 ? keyboardHeight + 64 : 24 },
          ]}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >


          <View style={loginStyles.centerContentWrapper}>
            <View style={loginStyles.headerBox}>
              <View style={loginStyles.logoBadgeBox}>
                <Feather name="zap" size={30} color={iconAccent} style={{ position: 'absolute', opacity: 0.3 }} />
                <Image source={Platform.OS === 'web' ? { uri: '/logo.png' } : KINETIC_LOGIN_LOGO} style={loginStyles.logo} contentFit="cover" priority="high" transition={0} cachePolicy="memory-disk" />
              </View>
              <Text style={[loginStyles.title, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{t('auth.enter_radar')}</Text>
              <Text style={[loginStyles.subtitle, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{t('auth.login_subtitle')}</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={loginStyles.formBox}>
              <KineticFastAuthPanel
                mode={initialMode}
                isBusy={isSsoLoading}
                onGooglePress={handleGoogleSSO}
              />

              <View style={loginStyles.dividerRow}>
                <View style={loginStyles.dividerLine} />
                <Text style={[loginStyles.dividerText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{t('auth.or_email_pass')}</Text>
                <View style={loginStyles.dividerLine} />
              </View>

              <SavedLoginAccountsStrip
                accounts={savedAccountList}

                />
              </View>

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[loginStyles.switchLink, noSel]}
                delayPressIn={0}
                onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); router.push('/register'); }}

                <Text style={[loginStyles.switchLinkText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>

        </ScrollView>

      <TacticalAlertModal alertConfig={alertConfig} setAlertConfig={setAlertConfig} triggerHaptic={triggerHaptic} />
      <LoginMfaChallengeModal visible={Boolean(pendingMfaChallenge) && !alertConfig.visible && !showRecoveryModal} email={pendingMfaChallenge?.email} friendlyName={pendingMfaChallenge?.friendlyName} isVerifying={isVerifyingMfa} errorMsg={mfaErrorMsg} onVerifyCode={handleConfirmMfaCode} onCancel={handleAbortMfaChallenge} />

        onSubmitEmail={async (targetEmail) => {
          try {
            const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(targetEmail);
            setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, showRecoveryModal: false }));
            scheduleLoginTimer(() => {
              if (error) { triggerHaptic('Error'); showTacticalAlert(tx('FRICCIÓN DE RECUPERACIÓN', 'RECOVERY ERROR'), mapSupabaseAuthError(error.message, isEn), 'error'); }

            }, 240);
          } catch (err: unknown) {
            const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : '';
            setUiState((prev) => ({ ...prev, showRecoveryModal: false }));
            scheduleLoginTimer(() => { triggerHaptic('Error'); showTacticalAlert(tx('FRICCIÓN DE RECUPERACIÓN', 'RECOVERY ERROR'), mapSupabaseAuthError(msg, isEn), 'error'); }, 240);
          }
        }}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function LoginAtletaScreen() {

export default function KineticOAuthBridgeScreen() {

      let graceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      let handledNativeUrl = false;

    const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(rawHash);
    const reqPlatform = searchParams.get('platform');
    const reqNonce = String(searchParams.get('nonce') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const reqState = String(searchParams.get('state') || '').trim();
    const hashState = String(hashParams.get('state') || '').trim();
    const hashToken = String(hashParams.get('id_token') || '').trim();
    const parsedHashState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(hashState);

    const parsedCbState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(cbState);

        setReadyDeepLink(deepLink);
        setStatusMsg(tLocal('Credencial verificada. Regresando a Kinetic…', 'Verified. Returning to Kinetic…'));
        window.location.replace(deepLink);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        void err;
        const errLink = `${KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK}?error=invalid_token`;
        setReadyDeepLink(errLink);

      cancelled = true;

      if (mfaRedirectTimer) clearTimeout(mfaRedirectTimer);
    };

    <View style={styles.root}>
      <View style={styles.card}>
        <Text style={styles.brand}>KINETIC</Text>

import { Redirect, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import React from 'react';

export default function RegisterTypeLegacyAliasScreen() {
  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ mode?: string | string[] }>();
  const rawMode = Array.isArray(params.mode) ? params.mode[0] : params.mode;
  const mode = String(rawMode || '').trim();
  if (mode.toLowerCase() === 'b2b') {
    return <Redirect href="/register_b2b" />;
  }
  if (mode.length > 0) {
    return <Redirect href={{ pathname: '/register', params: { mode } }} />;
  }
  return <Redirect href="/register" />;
}
