import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, ScrollView, StatusBar, Text, TouchableOpacity, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { TacticalAlertModal } from '../components/KinetiClubModals';
import { LegalTermsModal } from '../components/LegalTermsModal';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { KineticFastAuthPanel } from '../components/auth/KineticFastAuthPanel';
import { LoginMfaChallengeModal } from '../components/auth/LoginMfaChallengeModal';
import { UnifiedRegisterFormBody } from '../components/auth/UnifiedRegisterFormBody';
import { openKineticImageFrame } from '../components/shared/KineticImageFrameModal';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { mapSupabaseAuthError, useKineticAuth } from '../hooks/useKineticAuth';
import { executeKineticRegistration, validateRealIdentityInputs } from '../services/kineticRegisterHelper';
import { baseRegisterStyles } from '../styles/register.styles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { preloadImageInMemory } from '../utils/kineticImageFramePureLeaf';

const RFC_REGEX = /^[A-ZÑ&]{3,4}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$/i;
const NO_SEL: ViewStyle | undefined = Platform.OS === 'web'
  ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle)
  : undefined;

interface RegisterFormState {
  regMode: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  tipoSocio: 'Club' | 'Especialista';
  nombre: string;
  rfc: string;
  email: string;
  telefono: string;
  password: string;
  confirmPassword: string;
  showPass: boolean;
  showConfirmPass: boolean;
  avatarUri: string | null;
  avatarBase64: string | null;
  acceptedTerms: boolean;
}

export function UnifiedRegisterScreen({ initialMode = 'b2c' }: { initialMode?: 'b2c' | 'b2b' }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useLocalSearchParams();
  const { refreshProfile, activateResilientSession } = useAuth();
  const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseRegisterStyles, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);

  const [form, setForm] = useState<RegisterFormState>(() => ({
    regMode: params?.mode === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : initialMode,
    tipoSocio: 'Club', nombre: '', rfc: '', email: '', telefono: '', password: '', confirmPassword: '',
    showPass: false, showConfirmPass: false, avatarUri: null, avatarBase64: null, acceptedTerms: false,
  }));
  const [uiState, setUiState] = useState({ showTermsModal: false, isLoading: false, isSuccess: false, keyboardExtraPad: 0 });
  const [alertConfig, setAlertConfig] = useState({ visible: false, title: '', message: '', type: 'alert', confirmText: 'ENTENDIDO', onConfirm: null as (() => void) | null });

  const isSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);
  const centerTopYRef = useRef(0);
  const pendingScrollYRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const scrollTimersRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[]>([]);

  const showTacticalAlert = useCallback((title: string, message: string, type = 'alert') => {
    setAlertConfig({ visible: true, title, message, type, confirmText: tx('ENTENDIDO', 'GOT IT'), onConfirm: null });
  }, [tx]);

  const {
    isSsoLoading, handleGoogleSignIn, pendingMfaChallenge, isVerifyingMfa,
    mfaErrorMsg, verifyPendingMfaLogin, cancelPendingMfaLogin,
  } = useKineticAuth(triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert);

  useEffect(() => {
    const showEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillShow' : 'keyboardDidShow';
    const hideEv = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'keyboardWillHide' : 'keyboardDidHide';
    const onShow = (e: { endCoordinates?: { height?: number } }) => {
      const kbHeight = Number(e?.endCoordinates?.height || 0);
      if (Platform.OS !== 'ios' && kbHeight > 0) setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, keyboardExtraPad: kbHeight }));
      if (pendingScrollYRef.current !== null) {
        const y = pendingScrollYRef.current;
        scrollTimersRef.current.push(setTimeout(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y, animated: true }), 60));
      }
    };
    const onHide = () => {
      setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, keyboardExtraPad: 0 }));
      pendingScrollYRef.current = null;
    };
    const s1 = Keyboard.addListener(showEv, onShow);
    const s2 = Keyboard.addListener(hideEv, onHide);
    return () => {
      s1.remove();
      s2.remove();
      scrollTimersRef.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
      scrollTimersRef.current = [];
    };
  }, []);

  const handleFieldFocusScroll = useCallback((localY: number) => {
    const targetY = Math.max(0, centerTopYRef.current + localY - 72);
    pendingScrollYRef.current = targetY;
    scrollTimersRef.current.push(setTimeout(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: targetY, animated: true }), 110));
  }, []);

  const handleGoogleSSO = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (uiState.isLoading || isSsoLoading || uiState.isSuccess) return false;
    return handleGoogleSignIn(form.regMode);
  }, [uiState.isLoading, isSsoLoading, uiState.isSuccess, handleGoogleSignIn, form.regMode]);

  const isAffiliateMode = form.regMode === 'b2b';

  const handlePickAvatar = async () => {
    try {
      triggerHaptic('Light');
      const res = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['images'], allowsEditing: false, quality: 0.84, base64: false });
      if (!res.canceled && res.assets?.[0]) {
        const framed = await openKineticImageFrame({
          uri: res.assets[0].uri, aspect: '1:1', lockAspect: true, titleEs: 'Foto de Perfil (1:1)', titleEn: 'Profile Photo (1:1)',
        });
        if (!framed) return;
        await preloadImageInMemory(framed);
        setForm((p) => ({ ...p, avatarUri: framed, avatarBase64: framed.startsWith('data:image/') ? framed : null }));
        triggerHaptic('Success');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      showTacticalAlert(tx('ERROR DE GALERÍA', 'GALLERY ERROR'), tx('No se pudo abrir selector de imágenes.', 'Unable to open image picker.'), 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitRegister = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isSubmittingRef.current || uiState.isLoading || uiState.isSuccess) return;
    Keyboard.dismiss();
    const validation = validateRealIdentityInputs(
      form.nombre, form.email, form.telefono, form.acceptedTerms, isEn, showTacticalAlert, triggerHaptic, isAffiliateMode
    );
    if (!validation.ok) return;
    const { cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone } = validation;
    const cleanPass = form.password.trim().slice(0, 128);
    const cleanConfirmPass = form.confirmPassword.trim().slice(0, 128);
    const cleanRfc = form.rfc.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-ZÑ&0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 13);
    const disciplinaSeleccionada = form.tipoSocio === 'Especialista' ? 'Fisioterapia' : 'Fuerza';
    if (isAffiliateMode && cleanRfc.length > 0 && !RFC_REGEX.test(cleanRfc)) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      showTacticalAlert(tx('RFC INVÁLIDO', 'INVALID TAX ID'), tx('Ingresa un RFC válido de 12 o 13 caracteres o déjalo vacío por ahora.', 'Enter a valid 12 or 13 character RFC or leave it blank for now.'), 'warning');
      return;
    }
    if (cleanPass.length < 6) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      showTacticalAlert(tx('CONTRASEÑA CORTA', 'SHORT PASSWORD'), tx('Debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.', 'Must be at least 6 characters long.'), 'warning');
      return;
    }
    if (cleanPass !== cleanConfirmPass) {
      triggerHaptic('Warning');
      showTacticalAlert(tx('LAS CONTRASEÑAS NO COINCIDEN', 'PASSWORDS DO NOT MATCH'), tx('Verifica que la contraseña y su confirmación sean exactamente iguales.', 'Make sure password and confirmation match.'), 'warning');
      return;
    }

    isSubmittingRef.current = true;
    setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, isLoading: true }));
    triggerHaptic('Medium');
    try {
      const targetRoute = await executeKineticRegistration({
        isAffiliate: isAffiliateMode, tipoSocio: form.tipoSocio, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPass, cleanRfc,
        cleanPhone, disciplinaSeleccionada, avatarUri: form.avatarUri, avatarBase64: form.avatarBase64,
        refreshProfile, activateResilientSession,
      });
      setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, isSuccess: true }));
      router.replace(targetRoute);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Intenta nuevamente.', 'Please try again.');
      if (errMsg === 'EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED') {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        showTacticalAlert(tx('CONFIRMA TU CORREO', 'CONFIRM YOUR EMAIL'), tx('Tu cuenta fue creada. Confirma el enlace enviado a tu correo electrónico para iniciar sesión.', 'Your account was created. Confirm the verification link sent to your email before signing in.'), 'success');
        router.replace('/login');
        return;
      }
      triggerHaptic('Error');
      showTacticalAlert(tx('FRICCIÓN EN REGISTRO', 'SIGN UP ERROR'), mapSupabaseAuthError(errMsg, isEn), 'error');
    } finally {
      isSubmittingRef.current = false;
      setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, isLoading: false }));
    }
  }, [uiState.isLoading, uiState.isSuccess, form, isAffiliateMode, refreshProfile, activateResilientSession, router, showTacticalAlert, tx, isEn]);

  const accentColor = isAffiliateMode ? '#9D4EDD' : '#00F0FF';
  const isManualBusy = uiState.isLoading || uiState.isSuccess;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safeArea, { backgroundColor: themeColors.background }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle={themeColors.statusBarStyle} backgroundColor={themeColors.background} />

              avatarUri={form.avatarUri} handlePickAvatar={handlePickAvatar}
              tipoSocio={form.tipoSocio} setTipoSocio={(v: 'Club' | 'Especialista') => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, tipoSocio: v }))}
              nombre={form.nombre} setNombre={(v: string) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, nombre: v }))}
              rfc={form.rfc} setRfc={(v: string) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, rfc: v }))}
              email={form.email} setEmail={(v: string) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, email: v }))}
              telefono={form.telefono} setTelefono={(v: string) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, telefono: v }))}
              password={form.password} setPassword={(v: string) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, password: v }))}
              confirmPassword={form.confirmPassword} setConfirmPassword={(v: string) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, confirmPassword: v }))}
              showPass={form.showPass} setShowPass={(v: boolean | ((c: boolean) => boolean)) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, showPass: typeof v === 'function' ? v(p.showPass) : v }))}
              showConfirmPass={form.showConfirmPass} setShowConfirmPass={(v: boolean | ((c: boolean) => boolean)) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, showConfirmPass: typeof v === 'function' ? v(p.showConfirmPass) : v }))}
              acceptedTerms={form.acceptedTerms} setAcceptedTerms={(v: boolean | ((c: boolean) => boolean)) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, acceptedTerms: typeof v === 'function' ? v(p.acceptedTerms) : v }))}
              setShowTermsModal={(v: boolean) => setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, showTermsModal: v }))}
              handleSubmitRegister={handleSubmitRegister} onGoToLogin={() => router.replace('/login')} onFieldFocusScroll={handleFieldFocusScroll}
            />
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>

      <LegalTermsModal isVisible={uiState.showTermsModal} onClose={() => setUiState((p) => ({ ...p, showTermsModal: false }))} onAccept={() => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, acceptedTerms: true }))} initialTab={isAffiliateMode ? 'b2b' : 'atleta'} />
      <TacticalAlertModal alertConfig={alertConfig} setAlertConfig={setAlertConfig} triggerHaptic={triggerHaptic} />
      <LoginMfaChallengeModal
        visible={Boolean(pendingMfaChallenge) && !alertConfig.visible}
        email={pendingMfaChallenge?.email} friendlyName={pendingMfaChallenge?.friendlyName}
        isVerifying={isVerifyingMfa} errorMsg={mfaErrorMsg}
        onVerifyCode={verifyPendingMfaLogin} onCancel={() => { void cancelPendingMfaLogin(); }}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function RegisterScreen() {
  return <UnifiedRegisterScreen initialMode="b2c" />;
}

import { Redirect } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Platform, View } from 'react-native';
import { loadPartnerWebPortalComponent } from '../components/partner-web/partnerWebEntry';
import { isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync } from '../services/kineticFounderWebPassLeaf';
import { breakOutOfIframeToTop } from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

const LazyKineticPartnerWebPortal =
  Platform.OS === 'web' && loadPartnerWebPortalComponent ? React.lazy(loadPartnerWebPortalComponent) : null;

export default function KineticPartnerWebRoute() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') breakOutOfIframeToTop();
  }, []);
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || !LazyKineticPartnerWebPortal || !isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync()) {
    return <Redirect href="/" />;
  }
  return (
    <React.Suspense
      fallback={
        <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#050505', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#00F0FF" />
        </View>
      }
    >
      <LazyKineticPartnerWebPortal />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}

import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticLoader } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

const GoogleOfficialIconSvg = memo(() => (
  <Svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 24 24">

    />
    <Path
      fill="#FBBC05"
      d="M5.285 14.28A7.22 7.22 0 0 1 4.91 12c0-.795.135-1.565.375-2.28V6.61H1.28A11.99 11.99 0 0 0 0 12c0 1.935.465 3.765 1.28 5.39l4.005-3.11z"
    />
    <Path
      fill="#EA4335"
      d="M12 4.775c1.76 0 3.34.605 4.585 1.795l3.435-3.435C17.95 1.19 15.235 0 12 0 7.31 0 3.255 2.69 1.28 6.61l4.005 3.11c.945-2.835 3.59-4.945 6.715-4.945z"
    />
  </Svg>
));
GoogleOfficialIconSvg.displayName = 'GoogleOfficialIconSvg';

export interface KineticFastAuthPanelProps {
  mode?: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  isBusy?: boolean;
  onGooglePress: (mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b') => Promise<boolean>;
}

export const KineticFastAuthPanel = memo(
  ({
    mode = 'b2c',
    isBusy = false,
    onGooglePress,
  }: KineticFastAuthPanelProps) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, themeColors, t } = useKineticPreferences();
    const faStyles = React.useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseFaStyles, resolvedTheme),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );

    return (
      <View style={faStyles.panelWrap}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[faStyles.googleBtn3D, NO_SEL]}
          activeOpacity={0.86}
          disabled={isBusy}
          onPress={() => onGooglePress(mode)}
        >
          <View style={faStyles.googleIconBadge}>
            <GoogleOfficialIconSvg />
          </View>
          <Text style={[faStyles.googleBtnText, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{t('auth.continue_google')}</Text>
          {isBusy ? (
            <KineticLoader size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
          ) : (
            <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color={themeColors.isLight ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8'} />
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

    // === src/components/auth/LoginMfaChallengeModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View, type StyleProp, type TextStyle, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { requireOptionalNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import type { SafeSavedAccountMeta } from '../../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import { isValidTotpSixDigitCode, sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode } from '../../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import { COLORS, globalStyles } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticLoader } from '../SharedUI';
import { KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS, KineticSwipeCloseHeader } from '../shared/KineticModalHeader3D';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : null;
const DARK_INK: Record<string, unknown> = { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

export interface LoginMfaChallengeModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  email?: string;
  friendlyName?: string;
  isVerifying: boolean;
  errorMsg?: string | null;
  onVerifyCode: (code: string) => Promise<boolean> | void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const LoginMfaChallengeModal = memo((props: LoginMfaChallengeModalProps) => {
  const { visible, email, friendlyName, isVerifying, errorMsg, onVerifyCode, onCancel } = props;
  const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const styles = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['verifyBtn']), [resolvedTheme]);
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const inputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const submitLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    setCode('');
    submitLockRef.current = false;
    const t = setTimeout(() => { try { inputRef.current?.focus(); } catch {} }, 180);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [visible]);

  const canSubmit = isValidTotpSixDigitCode(code) && !isVerifying;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!canSubmit || submitLockRef.current) return;
    submitLockRef.current = true;
    try { await onVerifyCode(code); } finally { submitLockRef.current = false; }
  };

  const handlePasteCode = async () => {
    try {
      let clip = '';
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.readText) {
        clip = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
      } else {
        const expClip = requireOptionalNativeModule<{ getStringAsync?: () => Promise<string> }>('ExpoClipboard');
        if (expClip?.getStringAsync) clip = await expClip.getStringAsync();
      }
      const clean = sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode(clip);
      if (clean) setCode(clean);
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <ReactNativeModal
      isVisible={Boolean(visible)}
      onBackdropPress={isVerifying ? undefined : onCancel}
      onBackButtonPress={isVerifying ? undefined : onCancel}
      avoidKeyboard={true}
      animationInTiming={200}
      animationOutTiming={180}
      backdropTransitionOutTiming={0}
      backdropTransitionInTiming={0}
      hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false}
      backdropColor={isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : COLORS.background}
      backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.5 : 0.92}
      useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
      useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
      style={{ margin: 0, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}
    >
      <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined} style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
        <View
          style={[
            globalStyles.bottomSheet,
            KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS,
            {
              backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : themeColors.surface,
              borderColor: isLightMode ? '#38BDF8' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)',
              paddingBottom: 28,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <KineticSwipeCloseHeader onClose={isVerifying ? () => {} : onCancel} />
          <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <View style={[styles.shieldCircle, isLightMode && { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' }]}>
              <Feather name="shield" size={22} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.title, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>
              {tx('VERIFICACIÓN 2FA (AAL2)', '2FA VERIFICATION (AAL2)')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {tx(
                `Ingresa el código dinámico de 6 dígitos de ${friendlyName || 'tu app autenticadora'}${email ? ` para ${email}` : ''}.`,
                `Enter the 6-digit code from ${friendlyName || 'your authenticator app'}${email ? ` for ${email}` : ''}.`
              )}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <TextInput
            ref={inputRef}
            style={[
              styles.codeInput,
              {
                color: themeColors.textPrimary,
                backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : 'rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.9)',
                borderColor: errorMsg ? COLORS.red : isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)',
              },
            ]}
            value={code}
            onChangeText={(v) => setCode(sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode(v))}
            placeholder="000000"
            placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
            keyboardType="number-pad"
            maxLength={12}
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
            autoFocus={false}
            returnKeyType="done"
            onSubmitEditing={handleSubmit}
          />
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={handlePasteCode} disabled={isVerifying} style={{ alignSelf: 'center', marginTop: 8, paddingVertical: 4, paddingHorizontal: 10 }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800', color: themeColors.cyanText }}>{tx('Pegar código del portapapeles', 'Paste code from clipboard')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {Boolean(errorMsg) && (
            <View style={styles.errorBox}>
              <Feather name="alert-circle" size={13} color={isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF6B6B'} />
              <Text style={[styles.errorTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#B91C1C' : '#FF6B6B' }]}>{errorMsg}</Text>
            </View>
          )}

          <TouchableOpacity
            {...DARK_INK}
            style={[styles.verifyBtn, !canSubmit && { opacity: 0.55 }, NO_SEL]}
            disabled={!canSubmit}
            onPress={handleSubmit}
          >
            {isVerifying ? (
              <KineticLoader size={18} color="#050505" />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.verifyBtnTxt}>{tx('VERIFICAR Y ENTRAR A BÓVEDA', 'VERIFY & ENTER VAULT')}</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.cancelBtn, NO_SEL]} disabled={isVerifying} onPress={onCancel}>
            <Text style={[styles.cancelBtnTxt, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {tx('Cancelar e iniciar con otra cuenta', 'Cancel & sign in with another account')}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </ReactNativeModal>
  );
});

const baseStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  shieldCircle: {
    width: 48, height: 48, borderRadius: 24, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12)', borderWidth: 1.4, borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)', marginBottom: 8, elevation: 0,

    marginTop: 14, height: 48, borderRadius: 14, backgroundColor: COLORS.cyan,

    alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', elevation: 8,
  },
  verifyBtnTxt: { color: '#050505', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.6 },
    cancelBtn: { marginTop: 12, paddingVertical: 8, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', elevation: 0 },
  cancelBtnTxt: { fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: '800' },
});

export const SavedLoginAccountsStrip = memo(({
  accounts, currentEmail, loginStyles, themeColors, onSelect, onForget,
}: {
  accounts: SafeSavedAccountMeta[];
  currentEmail: string;
  loginStyles: {
    savedAccountsWrap?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
    savedAccountsScroll?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
    savedAccountChip?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
    savedAccountChipActive?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
    savedAccountText?: StyleProp<TextStyle>;
    chipRemoveBtn?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
    savedAccountsEdgeFadeLeft?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
    savedAccountsEdgeFadeRight?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  };
  themeColors: { background?: string; isLight?: boolean; cyanText: string; textPrimary: string; textMuted: string };
  onSelect: (acc: SafeSavedAccountMeta) => void;
  onForget: (email: string) => void;
}) => {
  if (accounts.length === 0) return null;
  const normCur = currentEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
  const solidEdge = themeColors?.background || (themeColors?.isLight ? '#ECF1F8' : '#050505');
  const fadeTransparent = themeColors?.isLight ? 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0)' : 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0)';
  return (
    <View style={loginStyles.savedAccountsWrap}>
      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" contentContainerStyle={loginStyles.savedAccountsScroll}>
        {accounts.map((acc) => {
          const isSelected = normCur === acc.email.trim().toLowerCase();
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={acc.email.trim().toLowerCase()}
              style={[loginStyles.savedAccountChip, NO_SEL, isSelected && loginStyles.savedAccountChipActive]}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
              onPress={() => onSelect(acc)}
            >
              <Feather name={acc.rol === 'b2b' ? 'briefcase' : 'user'} size={12} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
              <Text style={[loginStyles.savedAccountText, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>{acc.email}</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity
                hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                onPress={(e) => { e.stopPropagation?.(); onForget(acc.email); }}
                style={loginStyles.chipRemoveBtn}
              >
                <Feather name="x" size={11} color={themeColors.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>
      <LinearGradient
        pointerEvents="none"
        colors={[solidEdge, fadeTransparent]}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0.5 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 0.5 }}
        style={loginStyles.savedAccountsEdgeFadeLeft}
      />
      <LinearGradient
        pointerEvents="none"
        colors={[fadeTransparent, solidEdge]}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0.5 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 0.5 }}
        style={loginStyles.savedAccountsEdgeFadeRight}
      />
    </View>
  );
});

    import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, Modal, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator, Alert, Platform, KeyboardAvoidingView } from 'react-native';
import { requireOptionalNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';

export async function getSafeLocalAuth() {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  try { return requireOptionalNativeModule<any>('ExpoLocalAuthentication') || null; } catch { return null; }
}

export async function runSafeBiometricAuth(
  promptMsg = 'Autenticación biométrica KINETIC',
  fallbackMsg = 'Usar PIN del dispositivo',
  cancelMsg = 'Usar contraseña'
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return false;
  try {
    const localAuth = await getSafeLocalAuth();
    if (!localAuth?.hasHardwareAsync || !localAuth?.isEnrolledAsync || !localAuth?.authenticateAsync) return false;
    const [hasHardware, isEnrolled] = await Promise.all([
      localAuth.hasHardwareAsync(),
      localAuth.isEnrolledAsync(),
    ]);
    if (!hasHardware || !isEnrolled) return false;
    const res = await localAuth.authenticateAsync({
      promptMessage: promptMsg,
      cancelLabel: cancelMsg,
      fallbackLabel: fallbackMsg,
      disableDeviceFallback: false,
    });
    return res?.success === true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

interface TwoStepRecoveryModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  isDark?: boolean;
  initialEmail?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmitEmail: (email: string) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const TwoStepRecoveryModal: React.FC<TwoStepRecoveryModalProps> = ({
  visible,
  isDark = true,
  initialEmail = '',
  onClose,
  onSubmitEmail,
}) => {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(String(initialEmail || '').trim());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [inlineError, setInlineError] = useState('');
  const submitLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) {
      setValue(String(initialEmail || '').trim());
      setInlineError('');
      submitLockRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [visible, initialEmail]);

  const bgModal = isDark ? '#12121A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const textColor = isDark ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0F172A';
  const subColor = isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#475569';
  const placeholderInk = isDark ? 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.44)' : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.46)';
  const inputBg = isDark ? '#1C1C28' : '#F8FAFC';
  const borderCol = isDark ? '#2D2D3D' : '#CBD5E1';

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (submitLockRef.current || loading) return;
    const clean = value.trim();
    if (!clean || !clean.includes('@')) {
      setInlineError(tx('Por favor ingresa un correo electrónico válido.', 'Please enter a valid email address.'));
      return;
    }
    submitLockRef.current = true;
    setInlineError('');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSubmitEmail(clean);
      onClose();
      setValue('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      setInlineError(e?.message || tx('No se pudo procesar la recuperación.', 'Could not process account recovery.'));
    } finally {
      submitLockRef.current = false;
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <View style={[styles.overlay, { backgroundColor: isDark ? 'rgba(4, 6, 12, 0.88)' : 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72)' }]}>
          <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor: bgModal, borderColor: borderCol }]}>
          <Text style={[styles.title, { color: textColor }]}>{tx('Recuperar Cuenta', 'Recover Account')}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.desc, { color: subColor }]}>
            {tx(
              'Ingresa tu correo registrado para recibir el enlace de restablecimiento:',
              'Enter your registered email to receive the password reset link:'
            )}
          </Text>

          <TextInput
            style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: inputBg, borderColor: inlineError ? '#EF4444' : borderCol, color: textColor, fontSize: 16 }]}
            placeholder={tx('correo@ejemplo.com', 'email@example.com')}
            placeholderTextColor={placeholderInk}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
            keyboardType="email-address"
            value={value}
            onChangeText={(txt) => {
              if (inlineError) setInlineError('');
              setValue(txt);
            }}
          />
          {Boolean(inlineError) && (
            <Text style={{ color: isDark ? '#FCA5A5' : '#B91C1C', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700', marginBottom: 10 }}>
              {inlineError}
            </Text>
          )}

          <View style={styles.actions}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnCancel} onPress={onClose} disabled={loading}>
              <Text style={[styles.btnCancelText, { color: subColor }]}>{tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnSubmit} onPress={handleSend} disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#0B0B10" size="small" />
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.btnSubmitText}>{tx('Enviar Enlace', 'Send Link')}</Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
};

interface GoogleInAppModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  isDark?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (email: string, fullName?: string) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export const GoogleInAppModal: React.FC<GoogleInAppModalProps> = ({
  visible,
  isDark = true,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
}) => {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [gmail, setGmail] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const submitLockRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) submitLockRef.current = false;
  }, [visible]);

  const bgModal = isDark ? '#12121A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const textColor = isDark ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0B0B10';
  const subColor = isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280';
  const inputBg = isDark ? '#1C1C28' : '#F3F4F6';
  const borderCol = isDark ? '#2D2D3D' : '#E5E7EB';

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (submitLockRef.current || loading) return;
    let cleanEmail = gmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cleanEmail) {
      Alert.alert(tx('Atención', 'Notice'), tx('Ingresa tu cuenta de Google.', 'Enter your Google account.'));
      return;
    }
    if (!cleanEmail.includes('@')) cleanEmail = `${cleanEmail}@gmail.com`;
    submitLockRef.current = true;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm(cleanEmail, name.trim() || undefined);
      onClose();
      setGmail('');
      setName('');
    } catch (e: any) {
      Alert.alert(tx('Error Google In-App', 'Google In-App Error'), e?.message || tx('No se pudo vincular la cuenta.', 'Could not link account.'));
    } finally {
      submitLockRef.current = false;
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView style={{ flex: 1 }} behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}>
        <View style={styles.overlay}>
          <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor: bgModal, borderColor: borderCol }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.title, { color: textColor }]}>{tx('Acceso Seguro Google', 'Secure Google Sign-In')}</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.desc, { color: subColor }]}>
              {tx(
                'Inicia sesión o vincula tu cuenta Google directamente sin salir de la app:',
                'Sign in or link your Google account directly without leaving the app:'
              )}
            </Text>

            <TextInput
              style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: inputBg, borderColor: borderCol, color: textColor, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx('Nombre completo (opcional)', 'Full name (optional)')}
              placeholderTextColor={subColor}
              value={name}
              onChangeText={setName}
            />
            <TextInput
              style={[styles.input, { backgroundColor: inputBg, borderColor: borderCol, color: textColor, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx('usuario@gmail.com', 'user@gmail.com')}
              placeholderTextColor={subColor}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              keyboardType="email-address"
              value={gmail}
              onChangeText={setGmail}
            />

            <View style={styles.actions}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnCancel} onPress={onClose} disabled={loading}>
                <Text style={[styles.btnCancelText, { color: subColor }]}>{tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel')}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.btnSubmit} onPress={handleConfirm} disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? <ActivityIndicator color="#0B0B10" size="small" /> : <Text style={styles.btnSubmitText}>{tx('Continuar', 'Continue')}</Text>}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: {
    flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.68)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 24,
  },

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { Platform, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

interface RegisterB2BFieldsSectionProps {
  styles: any;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  themeColors: any;
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
  iconAccent: string;
  inputBevelOverride: any;
  tipoSocio: 'Club' | 'Especialista';
  setTipoSocio: (v: 'Club' | 'Especialista') => void;
  nombre: string;
  setNombre: (v: string) => void;
  rfc: string;
  setRfc: (v: string) => void;
  onSubmitToNext: () => void;
}

export const RegisterB2BFieldsSection: React.FC<RegisterB2BFieldsSectionProps> = ({
  styles,
  isLightMode,
  themeColors,
  tx,
  iconAccent,
  inputBevelOverride,
  tipoSocio,
  setTipoSocio,
  nombre,
  setNombre,
  rfc,
  setRfc,
  onSubmitToNext,
}) => {
  const rfcInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);

  return (
    <>
      <View style={styles.typeSelectorRow}>
        {(['Club', 'Especialista'] as const).map((item) => {
          const active = tipoSocio === item;
          const displayLabel =
            item === 'Especialista'
              ? tx('ESPECIALISTA', 'SPECIALIST')
              : tx('CLUB', 'CLUB');
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={item}
              style={[
                styles.typeCard,
                NO_SEL,
                isLightMode && !active && {
                  backgroundColor: '#FAF5FF',
                  borderColor: '#C084FC',
                  borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
                  borderBottomColor: '#7C3AED',
                  shadowColor: '#7C3AED',
                  shadowOpacity: 0.22,
                  elevation: 0,
                },
                active && styles.typeCardActive,
              ]}
              onPress={() => {
                triggerHaptic('Selection');
                setTipoSocio(item);
              }}
            >
              <Feather
                name={item === 'Club' ? 'map-pin' : 'award'}
                size={14}
                color={active ? '#FFFFFF' : isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#C77DFF'}
              />
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.typeCardText,
                  active
                    ? { color: '#FFFFFF' }
                    : isLightMode
                    ? { color: '#6D28D9' }
                    : undefined,
                ]}
              >
                {displayLabel}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.formBox}>
        <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx(
              'NOMBRE OFICIAL DEL CLUB / ESPECIALISTA',
              'OFFICIAL CLUB / SPECIALIST NAME'
            )}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
            <Feather
              name="briefcase"
              size={16}
              color={iconAccent}
              style={styles.icon}
            />
            <TextInput
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx(
                'Ej. Nombre de tu Club, Estudio o Consultorio',
                'e.g. Name of your Club, Studio, or Practice'
              )}
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              autoCorrect={false}
              maxLength={80}
              value={nombre}
              onChangeText={(txt) => setNombre(txt.slice(0, 80))}
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={() => rfcInputRef.current?.focus()}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx(
              'RFC FISCAL (OPCIONAL · 12 O 13 CARACTERES)',
              'TAX ID / RFC (OPTIONAL · 12 OR 13 CHARS)'
            )}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
            <Feather
              name="file-text"
              size={16}
              color={iconAccent}
              style={styles.icon}
            />
            <TextInput
              ref={rfcInputRef}
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder="ESF260101AAA"
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              autoCapitalize="characters"
              autoCorrect={false}
              importantForAutofill="no"
              maxLength={13}
              value={rfc}
              onChangeText={(txt) =>
                setRfc(txt.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-ZÑ&0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 13))
              }
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={onSubmitToNext}
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </>
  );
};

    // === src/components/auth/UnifiedRegisterFormBody.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, Platform, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KineticButton } from '../KineticButton';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { RegisterB2BFieldsSection } from './RegisterB2BFieldsSection';

const NO_SEL: ViewStyle | undefined = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : undefined;

export interface UnifiedRegisterFormBodyProps {
  styles: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
  isAffiliateMode: boolean;
  accentColor: string;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  themeColors: { textMuted: string; textPrimary: string; cyanText: string; textSecondary?: string; green?: string };
  tx: (es: string, en: string) => string;
  isAnyBusy: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isSuccess: boolean;
  avatarUri: string | null;
  handlePickAvatar: () => void;
  tipoSocio: 'Club' | 'Especialista';
  setTipoSocio: (v: 'Club' | 'Especialista') => void;
  nombre: string;
  setNombre: (v: string) => void;
  rfc: string;
  setRfc: (v: string) => void;
  email: string;
  setEmail: (v: string) => void;
  telefono: string;
  setTelefono: (v: string) => void;
  password: string;
  setPassword: (v: string) => void;
  confirmPassword: string;
  setConfirmPassword: (v: string) => void;
  showPass: boolean;
  setShowPass: (v: boolean | ((c: boolean) => boolean)) => void;
  showConfirmPass: boolean;
  setShowConfirmPass: (v: boolean | ((c: boolean) => boolean)) => void;
  acceptedTerms: boolean;
  setAcceptedTerms: (v: boolean | ((c: boolean) => boolean)) => void;
  setShowTermsModal: (v: boolean) => void;
  handleSubmitRegister: () => void;
  onGoToLogin: () => void;
  onFieldFocusScroll?: (y: number) => void;
}

export const UnifiedRegisterFormBody = ({
  styles, isAffiliateMode, accentColor, isLightMode, themeColors, tx, isAnyBusy, isLoading, isSuccess,
  avatarUri, handlePickAvatar, tipoSocio, setTipoSocio, nombre, setNombre, rfc, setRfc, email, setEmail,
  telefono, setTelefono, password, setPassword, confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword, showPass, setShowPass,
  showConfirmPass, setShowConfirmPass, acceptedTerms, setAcceptedTerms, setShowTermsModal,
  handleSubmitRegister, onGoToLogin, onFieldFocusScroll,
}: UnifiedRegisterFormBodyProps) => {
  const emailInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const phoneInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const passInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const confirmPassInputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);
  const yMapRef = useRef({ formBoxTop: 0, pass: 0, confirmPass: 0, ctaBottom: 0 });
  const iconAccent = isLightMode
    ? isAffiliateMode
      ? '#6D28D9'
      : themeColors.cyanText
    : isAffiliateMode
    ? '#C77DFF'
    : themeColors.cyanText;

  const inputBevelOverride = isLightMode
    ? {
        backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
        borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
        borderColor: isAffiliateMode ? '#C084FC' : '#38BDF8',
        borderBottomColor: isAffiliateMode ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4',
        shadowColor: isAffiliateMode ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4',
        shadowOpacity: 0.18,
        elevation: 0,
      }
    : isAffiliateMode
    ? {
        borderTopColor: 'rgba(224, 170, 255, 0.48)',
        borderColor: 'rgba(157, 78, 221, 0.48)',
        borderBottomColor: '#4A1478',
        shadowColor: COLORS.purple,
        elevation: 0,
      }
    : null;

  return (
    <>
      {!isAffiliateMode ? (
        <View style={styles.avatarContainer}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.avatarWrapper, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={handlePickAvatar}
            disabled={isAnyBusy}
          >
            <View style={styles.avatarButton}>
              {avatarUri ? (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: avatarUri }}
                  style={styles.avatarFull}
                  contentFit="cover"
                  cachePolicy="memory-disk"
                  transition={0}
                />
              ) : (
                <View style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <Feather name="camera" size={22} color={iconAccent} />
                  <Text style={styles.avatarHint}>
                    {tx('Subir Avatar', 'Upload Avatar')}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.avatarSubHint}>
                    {tx('Encuadre 1:1', '1:1 Frame')}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>

            <View style={styles.editIconBadge}>
              <Feather name="edit-2" size={11} color="#050505" />
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <RegisterB2BFieldsSection
          styles={styles}
          isLightMode={isLightMode}
          themeColors={themeColors}
          tx={tx}
          iconAccent={iconAccent}
          inputBevelOverride={inputBevelOverride}
          tipoSocio={tipoSocio}
          setTipoSocio={setTipoSocio}
          nombre={nombre}
          setNombre={setNombre}
          rfc={rfc}
          setRfc={setRfc}
          onSubmitToNext={() => emailInputRef.current?.focus()}
        />
      )}

      <View
        style={styles.formBox}
        onLayout={(e) => {
          yMapRef.current.formBoxTop = e.nativeEvent.layout.y;
        }}
      >
        {!isAffiliateMode && (
          <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
            <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {tx('NOMBRE COMPLETO', 'FULL NAME')}
            </Text>
            <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
              <Feather
                name="user"
                size={16}
                color={iconAccent}
                style={styles.icon}
              />
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
                placeholder={tx('Escribe tu nombre completo aquí', 'Enter your full name here')}
                placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
                autoCorrect={false}
                maxLength={80}
                value={nombre}
                onChangeText={(txt) => setNombre(txt.slice(0, 80))}
                returnKeyType="next"
                blurOnSubmit={false}
                onSubmitEditing={() => emailInputRef.current?.focus()}
              />
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx('CORREO ELECTRÓNICO', 'EMAIL ADDRESS')}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
            <Feather name="mail" size={16} color={iconAccent} style={styles.icon} />
            <TextInput
              ref={emailInputRef}
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={
                isAffiliateMode
                  ? tx('club@tudominio.com', 'club@yourdomain.com')
                  : tx('atleta@kinetic.com', 'athlete@kinetic.com')
              }
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              keyboardType="email-address"
              autoCapitalize="none"
              autoCorrect={false}
              maxLength={120}
              value={email}
              onChangeText={(txt) => setEmail(txt.slice(0, 120))}
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={() => phoneInputRef.current?.focus()}
            />
          </View>

        </View>

        <View style={styles.inputGroup}>
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx('NÚMERO TELEFÓNICO (10 DÍGITOS)', 'PHONE NUMBER (10 DIGITS)')}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride, { elevation: 0 }]}>
            <Feather name="phone" size={16} color={iconAccent} style={styles.icon} />
            <TextInput
              ref={phoneInputRef}
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder="55 1234 5678"
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              keyboardType="phone-pad"
              autoCorrect={false}
              maxLength={10}
              value={telefono || ''}
              onChangeText={(txt) => setTelefono?.(txt.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10))}
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={() => passInputRef.current?.focus()}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View
          style={styles.inputGroup}
          onLayout={(e) => {
            yMapRef.current.pass = yMapRef.current.formBoxTop + e.nativeEvent.layout.y;
          }}
        >
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx('CONTRASEÑA / LLAVE', 'PASSWORD / KEY')}
          </Text>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrapper, inputBevelOverride]}>
            <Feather name="lock" size={16} color={iconAccent} style={styles.icon} />
            <TextInput
              ref={passInputRef}
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx('Mínimo 6 caracteres', 'Minimum 6 characters')}
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              secureTextEntry={!showPass}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              autoCorrect={false}
              importantForAutofill="no"
              maxLength={128}
              value={password}
              onChangeText={(txt) => setPassword(txt.slice(0, 128))}
              onFocus={() => onFieldFocusScroll?.(yMapRef.current.pass)}
              returnKeyType="next"
              blurOnSubmit={false}
              onSubmitEditing={() => confirmPassInputRef.current?.focus()}
            />
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowPass((p: boolean) => !p)}>
              <Feather
                name={showPass ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'}
                size={16}
                color={themeColors.textMuted}
              />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View
          style={styles.inputGroup}
          onLayout={(e) => {
            yMapRef.current.confirmPass = yMapRef.current.formBoxTop + e.nativeEvent.layout.y;
          }}
        >
          <Text style={[styles.inputLabel, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx('CONFIRMAR CONTRASEÑA / LLAVE', 'CONFIRM PASSWORD / KEY')}
          </Text>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.inputWrapper,
              inputBevelOverride,
              confirmPassword.length > 0 && password !== confirmPassword && {
                borderColor: COLORS.red,
                borderBottomColor: '#B91C1C',
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Feather
              name="check-circle"
              size={16}
              color={
                confirmPassword.length > 0 && password === confirmPassword
                  ? (themeColors.green || '#10B981')
                  : iconAccent
              }
              style={styles.icon}
            />
            <TextInput
              ref={confirmPassInputRef}
              style={[styles.input, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
              placeholder={tx(
                'Repite tu contraseña para confirmar',
                'Repeat your password to confirm'
              )}
              placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
              secureTextEntry={!showConfirmPass}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              autoCorrect={false}
              importantForAutofill="no"
              maxLength={128}
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChangeText={(txt) => setConfirmPassword(txt.slice(0, 128))}
              onFocus={() => {
                const ctaTarget =
                  yMapRef.current.ctaBottom > 0
                    ? Math.max(yMapRef.current.confirmPass, yMapRef.current.ctaBottom - 175)
                    : yMapRef.current.confirmPass;
                onFieldFocusScroll?.(ctaTarget);
              }}
              returnKeyType="done"
              onSubmitEditing={() => Keyboard.dismiss()}
            />
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowConfirmPass((p: boolean) => !p)}>
              <Feather
                name={showConfirmPass ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'}
                size={16}
                color={themeColors.textMuted}
              />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.termsRowBox}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.checkboxSquare,
              NO_SEL,
              { borderColor: iconAccent },
              acceptedTerms && { backgroundColor: accentColor },
            ]}
            onPress={() => {
              triggerHaptic('Selection');
              if (!acceptedTerms) setShowTermsModal(true);
              else setAcceptedTerms(false);
            }}
          >
            {acceptedTerms && (
              <Feather
                name="check"
                size={14}
                color={isAffiliateMode ? '#FFF' : '#050505'}
              />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={[styles.termsText, { color: themeColors.textSecondary || themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx('Acepto los ', 'I accept the ')}
            <Text
              style={[styles.termsLinkText, { color: iconAccent }]}
              onPress={() => setShowTermsModal(true)}
            >
              {isAffiliateMode
                ? tx(
                    'Términos Comerciales B2B y Protocolo Escrow 40/60',
                    'B2B Partner Terms & 40/60 Escrow Protocol'
                  )
                : tx(
                    'Términos, Condiciones y Carta Responsiva (Waiver)',
                    'Terms, Conditions & Athletic Waiver'
                  )}
            </Text>
            {tx(' de Kinetic.', ' of Kinetic.')}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View
          onLayout={(e) => {
            yMapRef.current.ctaBottom =
              yMapRef.current.formBoxTop + e.nativeEvent.layout.y + e.nativeEvent.layout.height;
          }}
        >
          <KineticButton
            title={
              isSuccess
                ? tx('¡CUENTA CREADA! ENTRANDO...', 'ACCOUNT CREATED! ENTERING...')
                : isLoading
                ? tx('SINCRONIZANDO BÓVEDA...', 'SYNCING VAULT...')
                : isAffiliateMode
                ? tx('ACTIVAR OPERACIÓN', 'ACTIVATE OPERATION')
                : tx('GENERAR IDENTIDAD', 'CREATE IDENTITY')
            }
            iconName={isAffiliateMode ? 'terminal' : 'user-plus'}
            disabled={isLoading || isSuccess}
            onPress={handleSubmitRegister}
          />
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.switchLink, NO_SEL]} onPress={onGoToLogin}>
          <Text style={[styles.switchLinkText, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
            {tx('¿Ya tienes cuenta en Kinetic?', 'Already have a Kinetic account?')}{' '}
            <Text style={{ color: iconAccent, fontWeight: '900' }}>
              {tx('Iniciar sesión', 'Sign in')}
            </Text>
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </>
  );
};

    // === src/components/KineticButton.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Animated,
  Platform,
  StyleProp,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextStyle,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { triggerHaptic } from './SharedUI';

interface KineticButtonProps {
  title: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  iconName?: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
  iconPosition?: 'left' | 'right';
  variant?: 'cyan' | 'purple';
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  textStyle?: StyleProp<TextStyle>;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function KineticButton({
  title,
  onPress,
  iconName,
  iconPosition = 'left',
  variant = 'cyan',
  style,
  textStyle,
  disabled = false,
}: KineticButtonProps) {
  const { isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  const translateYAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const useNative = Platform.OS !== 'web';

  const handlePressIn = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    triggerHaptic('Light');
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.spring(scaleAnim, {
        toValue: 0.982,
        tension: 310,
        friction: 20,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
      Animated.spring(translateYAnim, {
        toValue: 3,
        tension: 310,
        friction: 20,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
    ]).start();
  };

  const handlePressOut = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.spring(scaleAnim, {
        toValue: 1,
        tension: 290,
        friction: 18,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
      Animated.spring(translateYAnim, {
        toValue: 0,
        tension: 290,
        friction: 18,
        useNativeDriver: useNative,
      }),
    ]).start();
  };

  const isPurple = variant === 'purple';
  const noSel: any = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } : null;

  const lipColor = disabled
    ? isLightMode
      ? '#CBD5E1'
      : '#1E293B'
    : isLightMode
    ? isPurple
      ? '#6D28D9'
      : '#0284C7'
    : isPurple
    ? '#581C87'
    : '#009FB8';

  const faceBorderColor = disabled
    ? isLightMode
      ? '#CBD5E1'
      : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)'
    : isLightMode
    ? isPurple
      ? '#C084FC'
      : '#06B6D4'
    : isPurple
    ? 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.78)'
    : 'rgba(95, 255, 255, 0.78)';

  const iconColor = disabled
    ? isLightMode
      ? '#94A3B8'
      : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)'
    : isLightMode
    ? isPurple
      ? '#6D28D9'
      : '#006B82'
    : isPurple
    ? '#E0AAFF'
    : '#5FFFFF';

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      activeOpacity={1}
      onPress={onPress}
      onPressIn={handlePressIn}
      onPressOut={handlePressOut}
      disabled={disabled}
      style={[
        { backgroundColor: 'transparent', width: '100%' },
        noSel,
        Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ outlineStyle: 'none' } as any) : null,
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[
          styles.extrusionBase,
          {
            backgroundColor: lipColor,
            shadowColor: disabled ? 'transparent' : isPurple ? '#7C3AED' : '#00B8D4',
            shadowOpacity: disabled ? 0 : isLightMode ? 0.22 : 0.34,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <Animated.View
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            borderRadius: 15,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }, { translateY: translateYAnim }],
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.glassBubble,
              isPurple && styles.glassBubblePurple,
              isLightMode && (isPurple ? styles.glassBubblePurpleLight : styles.glassBubbleLight),
              disabled && (isLightMode ? styles.disabledBubbleLight : styles.disabledBubble),
              { borderColor: faceBorderColor },
            ]}
          >
            {iconName && iconPosition === 'left' && (
              <Feather name={iconName} size={18} color={iconColor} style={styles.iconLeft} />
            )}
            <Text
              style={[
                styles.title,
                isLightMode && { color: isPurple ? '#5B21B6' : '#0F172A' },
                disabled && (isLightMode ? styles.disabledTextLight : styles.disabledText),
                textStyle,
              ]}
            >
              {title}
            </Text>
            {iconName && iconPosition === 'right' && (
              <Feather name={iconName} size={18} color={iconColor} style={styles.iconRight} />

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Tabs, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { startTransition, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Circle, Path } from 'react-native-svg';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { KineticLiquidGlassSurface } from '../shared/KineticLiquidGlassSurface';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut, subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut } from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import {
  getAdminHubSwrSync,
  getB2BDashboardSwrSync,
  getEventosSwrSync,
  getExploreSwrSync,
} from '../../services/kineticSwrMemoryHub';
import { useIsFullScreenModalOverlayOpen } from '../../utils/kineticOverlayStack';
import { IS_COMPACT_SCREEN, KINETIC_DOCK_CLEARANCE, SPACING } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';

export { KINETIC_DOCK_CLEARANCE };

type KineticRouterTabBarProps = Parameters<NonNullable<React.ComponentProps<typeof Tabs>['tabBar']>>[0];

interface KineticTabRouteItem {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  params?: object;
}

interface KineticLiquidGlassTabBarProps {
  state: {
    index: number;
    routes: ReadonlyArray<KineticTabRouteItem>;
  };
  navigation: KineticRouterTabBarProps['navigation'];
  descriptors?: KineticRouterTabBarProps['descriptors'];
  insets?: { bottom?: number } | null;
  visibleRouteNames: readonly string[];
  labelsByRoute: Record<string, string>;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  cyanText: string;
  inactiveColor: string;
  bottomOffset: number;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  hasActiveStreak: boolean;
  blurTargetRef?: React.RefObject<unknown>;
  blurTargetReady?: boolean;
  blurTargetDimensions?: { width: number; height: number } | null;
}

const warmTabSwrSnapshot = (routeName: string): void => {
  if (routeName === 'index') void getExploreSwrSync();
  else if (routeName === 'eventos') void getEventosSwrSync();
  else if (routeName === 'admin') void getAdminHubSwrSync();
  else if (routeName === 'terminal') void getB2BDashboardSwrSync();
};

const CommunityThreePeopleIcon = ({ color, size = 20 }: { color: string; size?: number }) => (
  <Svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
    <Circle cx="12" cy="7.2" r="2.7" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.85} />
    <Path d="M7.6 18.5c0-2.45 2-4.2 4.4-4.2s4.4 1.75 4.4 4.2" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.85} strokeLinecap="round" />
    <Circle cx="5.4" cy="9.4" r="2.05" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.65} />
    <Path d="M2.2 18.2c0-1.85 1.35-3.2 3.1-3.2.7 0 1.35.22 1.88.6" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.65} strokeLinecap="round" />
    <Circle cx="18.6" cy="9.4" r="2.05" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.65} />
    <Path d="M21.8 18.2c0-1.85-1.35-3.2-3.1-3.2-.7 0-1.35.22-1.88.6" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.65} strokeLinecap="round" />
  </Svg>
);

const ROUTE_ICON_MAP: Record<string, keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap> = {
  admin: 'pie-chart',
  index: 'compass',
  eventos: 'calendar',
  kineticlub: 'users',
  terminal: 'monitor',
  boveda: 'user',
};

export const KineticLiquidGlassTabBar: React.FC<KineticLiquidGlassTabBarProps> = ({
  state,
  navigation,
  visibleRouteNames,
  labelsByRoute,
  isLightMode,
  cyanText,
  inactiveColor,
  bottomOffset,
  isAdmin,
  hasActiveStreak,
  blurTargetRef,
  blurTargetReady = false,
  blurTargetDimensions = null,
}) => {
  const isFullOverlayOpen = useIsFullScreenModalOverlayOpen();
  const [isSigningOut, setIsSigningOut] = useState(() => isExplicitKineticSignOut());
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsSigningOut(isExplicitKineticSignOut());
    return subscribeExplicitKineticSignOut(setIsSigningOut);
  }, []);
  const router = useRouter();
  const visibleSet = new Set(visibleRouteNames);
  const routesToRender = state.routes.filter((r) => visibleSet.has(r.name));
  const activeRouteKey = state.routes[state.index]?.key;
  const activeVisibleIdx = Math.max(
    0,
    routesToRender.findIndex((r) => r.key === activeRouteKey)
  );
  const [trackWidth, setTrackWidth] = useState(0);
  const lensIndexAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(activeVisibleIdx)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    const anim = Animated.spring(lensIndexAnim, {
      toValue: activeVisibleIdx,
      tension: 280,
      friction: 24,
      useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
    });
    anim.start();
    return () => {
      anim.stop();
    };
  }, [activeVisibleIdx, lensIndexAnim]);

  if (isSigningOut || isExplicitKineticSignOut() || isFullOverlayOpen || routesToRender.length === 0) return null;

  const activeTint = isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF';
  const activeLabelColor = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const slotCount = Math.max(1, routesToRender.length);
  const slotWidth = trackWidth > 0 ? trackWidth / slotCount : 0;
  const maxIdx = Math.max(1, slotCount - 1);
  const lensTranslateX =
    slotWidth > 0
      ? lensIndexAnim.interpolate({
          inputRange: [0, maxIdx],
          outputRange: [0, slotCount > 1 ? (slotCount - 1) * slotWidth : 0],
        })
      : 0;
  const sixTabs = isAdmin || slotCount >= 6;
  const manyTabs = sixTabs || slotCount >= 5;
  const scrimColors: readonly [string, string, string] = isLightMode
    ? ['rgba(236, 241, 248, 0)', 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0.88)', 'rgba(236, 241, 248, 0.98)']
    : ['rgba(5, 5, 5, 0)', 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.88)', 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.98)'];

  return (
    <View collapsable={false} pointerEvents="box-none" style={styles.outerDockHost}>
      <LinearGradient
        pointerEvents="none"
        colors={scrimColors}
        locations={[0, 0.48, 1]}
        style={[
          styles.bottomFadeScrim,
          { height: Math.max(14, bottomOffset) + 34, elevation: 0 },
        ]}
      />
      <View
        collapsable={false}
        pointerEvents="box-none"
        style={[
          styles.dockWrap,
          {
            bottom: bottomOffset,
            left: IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 10 : SPACING.md,
            right: IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 10 : SPACING.md,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <KineticLiquidGlassSurface
          isLight={isLightMode}
          active={false}
          accent="cyan"
          borderRadius={34}
          interactive={true}
          blurTargetRef={blurTargetRef}
          blurTargetReady={blurTargetReady}
          blurTargetDimensions={blurTargetDimensions}
          style={[styles.glassPill, { paddingHorizontal: sixTabs ? 6 : manyTabs ? 5 : 8 }]}
        >
          <View
            collapsable={false}
            style={styles.trackRow}
            onLayout={(e) => {
              const w = Math.round(e.nativeEvent.layout.width || 0);
              if (w > 0 && Math.abs(w - trackWidth) > 1) setTrackWidth(w);
            }}
          >
            {slotWidth > 12 && (
              <Animated.View
                pointerEvents="none"
                style={[
                  styles.liquidLens,
                  {
                    left: sixTabs ? 2 : 3,
                    width: Math.max(36, slotWidth - (sixTabs ? 4 : 6)),
                    backgroundColor: isLightMode
                      ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.14)'
                      : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.16)',
                    borderColor: isLightMode
                      ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.34)'
                      : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.36)',
                    borderTopColor: isLightMode
                      ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)'
                      : 'rgba(186, 255, 255, 0.56)',
                    transform: [{ translateX: lensTranslateX as unknown as number }],
                  },
                ]}
              />
            )}
            {routesToRender.map((route) => {
              const focused = route.key === activeRouteKey;
              const rawLabel = labelsByRoute[route.name] || route.name;
              const label = rawLabel;
              const iconName = ROUTE_ICON_MAP[route.name] || 'circle';
              const color = focused ? activeTint : inactiveColor;
              const showStreakDot = route.name === 'kineticlub' && !focused && hasActiveStreak;

              const onPress = () => {
                triggerHaptic('Selection');
                warmTabSwrSnapshot(route.name);
                const event = navigation.emit({
                  type: 'tabPress',
                  target: route.key,
                  canPreventDefault: true,
                });
                if (!focused && !event.defaultPrevented) {
                  startTransition(() => {
                    try {
                      navigation.navigate(route.name, route.params);
                    } catch (navErr) {
                      void navErr;
                      router.navigate(
                        (route.name === 'index' ? '/(tabs)' : `/(tabs)/${route.name}`) as never
                      );
                    }
                  });
                }
              };

              const onLongPress = () => {
                navigation.emit({
                  type: 'tabLongPress',
                  target: route.key,
                });
              };

              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={route.key}
                  preset="dockTab"
                  onPress={onPress}
                  onLongPress={onLongPress}
                  accessibilityRole="tab"
                  accessibilityState={focused ? { selected: true } : {}}
                  accessibilityLabel={label}
                  style={styles.tabPressItem}
                  contentContainerStyle={[styles.tabPressInner, sixTabs && { paddingHorizontal: IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 1 : 2 }]}
                >
                  <View style={styles.iconSlot}>
                    {route.name === 'kineticlub' ? (
                      <CommunityThreePeopleIcon color={color} size={20} />
                    ) : (
                      <Feather name={iconName} size={20} color={color} />
                    )}
                    {showStreakDot && (
                      <View style={[styles.streakDot, { backgroundColor: cyanText }]} />
                    )}
                  </View>
                  <Text
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    adjustsFontSizeToFit
                    minimumFontScale={0.72}
                    allowFontScaling={false}
                    ellipsizeMode="clip"
                    style={[
                      styles.tabLabel,
                      {
                        color: focused ? activeLabelColor : inactiveColor,
                        fontWeight: focused ? '900' : '700',
                        fontSize: sixTabs
                          ? route.name === 'kineticlub'
                            ? IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 7.8 : 8.5
                            : IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 8.3 : 8.8
                          : manyTabs
                            ? 9.5
                            : 10.5,
                        letterSpacing: sixTabs ? -0.25 : manyTabs ? 0 : 0.2,
                        paddingHorizontal: sixTabs ? (IS_COMPACT_SCREEN ? 1.5 : 2.5) : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {label}
                  </Text>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.activeBar,
                      { backgroundColor: focused ? activeTint : 'transparent' },
                    ]}
                  />
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </KineticLiquidGlassSurface>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
