import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { router as globalRouter } from 'expo-router';
import * as SplashScreen from 'expo-splash-screen';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { readInitialWebPreferencesSync } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit,
  isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  readPersistedKineticSessionSync,
} from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { safePlayHtmlVideoBestEffort } from '../../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

const KINETIC_LOGO = require('../../../assets/logo.png');

let INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE: any = null;
if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
    INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE = require('../../../assets/intro.mp4');
  } catch {
    INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE = null;
  }
}

export const resolveWebVideoUri = (rawSource: any): string | null => {
  if (!rawSource) return null;
  if (typeof rawSource === 'string') return rawSource;
  if (typeof rawSource?.default === 'string') return rawSource.default;
  if (typeof rawSource?.uri === 'string') return rawSource.uri;
  return null;
};

export const getIntroWebVideoUri = (): string | null =>
  Platform.OS === 'web' ? resolveWebVideoUri(INTRO_VIDEO_SOURCE) : null;

export class KineticNativeCrashShield extends React.Component<
  { children: React.ReactNode },
  { hasError: boolean; error: any; errorMsg: string }
> {
  private restartTimerRef: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  constructor(props: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorMsg: '' };
  }

  componentWillUnmount() {
    if (this.restartTimerRef) {
      clearTimeout(this.restartTimerRef);
      this.restartTimerRef = null;
    }
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: any) {
    return {
      hasError: true,
      error,
      errorMsg: String(error?.message || 'Reintentando montaje seguro...'),
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch() {
    try {
      SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch(() => {});
    } catch {}
  }

  handleRestart = async () => {
    const validSnap = !isExplicitKineticSignOut() ? readPersistedKineticSessionSync() : null;
    const hasValidProfile = Boolean(validSnap?.user?.id && validSnap?.profile?.id);
    if (!hasValidProfile) {
      try {
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit();
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
      } catch {}
    }
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorMsg: '' });
    if (!hasValidProfile) {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location) {
        window.location.replace('/login');
      } else {
        if (this.restartTimerRef) clearTimeout(this.restartTimerRef);
        this.restartTimerRef = setTimeout(() => {
          try {
            globalRouter.replace('/login');
          } catch {}
        }, 16);
      }
    }
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      const retryLabel = getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? 'RESTART INTERFACE' : 'REINICIAR INTERFAZ';
      const techMessage = String(this.state.error?.message || this.state.errorMsg || '').trim();
      const isLightBoot = Platform.OS === 'web' && readInitialWebPreferencesSync().resolvedTheme === 'light';
      return (
        <View style={[guardBaseStyles.fallbackLogoWrap, isLightBoot && { backgroundColor: '#ECF1F8' }]}>
          <View style={guardBaseStyles.logoBadgeBox}>
            <Image
              source={KINETIC_LOGO}
              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', borderRadius: 32 }}
              contentFit="contain"
            />
          </View>
          <Text style={[guardBaseStyles.errorShieldTitle, isLightBoot && { color: '#006B82' }]}>KINETIC</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={guardBaseStyles.errorRetryBtn} onPress={this.handleRestart}>
            <Text style={[guardBaseStyles.errorRetryTxt, isLightBoot && { color: '#0F172A' }]}>{retryLabel}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          {Boolean(techMessage) && (
            <Text
              style={{
                color: isLightBoot ? 'rgba(15,23,42,0.55)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.42)',
                fontSize: 10,
                marginTop: 10,
                paddingHorizontal: 28,
                textAlign: 'center',
              }}
              numberOfLines={3}
            >
              {techMessage}
            </Text>
          )}
        </View>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export const KineticIntroOverlay = React.memo(
  ({
    resolvedTheme,
    backgroundColor,
    fadeAnim,
    logoPulseAnim,
    webVideoUri,
    onFinishIntro,
  }: {
    resolvedTheme: 'dark' | 'light';
    backgroundColor: string;
    fadeAnim: Animated.Value;
    logoPulseAnim: Animated.Value;
    webVideoUri: string | null;
    onFinishIntro: () => void;
  }) => {
    const styles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(guardBaseStyles, resolvedTheme, ['logoBadgeBox']),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    return (
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, styles.loaderContainer, { backgroundColor, opacity: fadeAnim }]}
      >
        {Platform.OS === 'web' && webVideoUri ? (
          React.createElement('video' as any, {
            src: webVideoUri,
            autoPlay: true,
            muted: true,
            playsInline: true,
            ref: (el: { play?: () => unknown } | null) => {
              if (el) safePlayHtmlVideoBestEffort(el, onFinishIntro);
            },
            onEnded: onFinishIntro,
            onError: onFinishIntro,
            style: {
              width: '100%',
              height: '100%',
              objectFit: 'cover',
              backgroundColor: '#050505',
            },
          })
        ) : (
          <View style={[styles.fallbackLogoWrap, { backgroundColor }]}>
            <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: logoPulseAnim }] }}>
              <View style={styles.logoBadgeBox}>
                <Image
                  source={KINETIC_LOGO}
                  style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', borderRadius: 32 }}
                  contentFit="contain"
                  cachePolicy="memory-disk"
                />
              </View>
            </Animated.View>
          </View>
        )}
      </Animated.View>
    );
  }
);

const guardBaseStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  loaderContainer: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#050505', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', zIndex: 999 },
  fallbackLogoWrap: { flex: 1, width: '100%', backgroundColor: '#050505', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },

import { PartnerWebSidebar } from './PartnerWebSidebar';
import { KineticDualConfirmModal } from '../shared/KineticDualConfirmModal';
import {
  computeStableDataSignature,
  shouldShowLoadingOnWebFocusRevalidate,
} from '../../utils/kineticWebSilentRevalidateLeaf';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, buildPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

export function KineticPartnerWebPortal() {
  const { user, session, profile, isLoading: isAuthLoading, signOut } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors, isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const pal = useMemo(() => buildPartnerWebPalette(themeColors, isLightMode), [themeColors, isLightMode]);
  const isDesktop = width >= 1024;

  const access = useMemo(
    () =>
      evaluatePartnerWebPortalAccess({
        platformOs: Platform.OS,
        session,
        user,
        profile,
      }),
    [session, user, profile]
  );

  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<PartnerWebSectionKey>('overview');
  const [portalUi, setPortalUi] = useState({ mobileMenu: false, signOutConfirm: false });
  const [supervisedAffiliate, setSupervisedAffiliate] = useState<IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null>(null);
  const [workspace, setWorkspace] = useState<IPartnerPortalWorkspaceData | null>(null);
  const [workspaceLoading, setWorkspaceLoading] = useState(false);
  const [adminAffiliates, setAdminAffiliates] = useState<IPartnerWebAffiliateRow[]>([]);
  const [adminReport, setAdminReport] = useState<IReporteMaestroSemanalCEO | null>(null);
  const [adminDirLoading, setAdminDirLoading] = useState(false);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const accessAllowedRef = useRef(access.allowed);
  const workspaceRef = useRef<IPartnerPortalWorkspaceData | null>(null);
  const workspaceSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const adminDirSigRef = useRef<string>('');
  const workspaceReqIdRef = useRef(0);
  const adminDirReqIdRef = useRef(0);
  accessAllowedRef.current = access.allowed;
  workspaceRef.current = workspace;

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      workspaceReqIdRef.current += 1;
      adminDirReqIdRef.current += 1;
    };
  }, []);

  const refreshWorkspace = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!access.allowed || !user?.id) return;
    const reqId = ++workspaceReqIdRef.current;
    if (shouldShowLoadingOnWebFocusRevalidate({ hasHydratedData: Boolean(workspaceRef.current) })) {
      setWorkspaceLoading(true);
    }
    try {
      const data = await loadPartnerPortalWorkspace({
        userId: user.id,
        userEmail: user.email,
        profileName: profile?.nombre || null,
        userRole: String(profile?.rol || profile?.tipo_cuenta || ''),
        isAdmin: access.isAdmin,
        isEn: language === 'en',
        supervisedAffiliate,
      });
      if (mountedRef.current && reqId === workspaceReqIdRef.current && accessAllowedRef.current) {
        const nextSig = computeStableDataSignature(data);
        if (nextSig !== workspaceSigRef.current) {
          workspaceSigRef.current = nextSig;
          setWorkspace(data);
        }
      }
    } catch (wsErr: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current && reqId === workspaceReqIdRef.current && accessAllowedRef.current && wsErr instanceof Error && !workspaceRef.current) {
        setWorkspace(null);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current && reqId === workspaceReqIdRef.current) setWorkspaceLoading(false);
    }
  }, [access.allowed, access.isAdmin, user?.id, user?.email, profile?.nombre, profile?.rol, profile?.tipo_cuenta, language, supervisedAffiliate]);

  const refreshAdminDirectory = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!access.allowed || !access.isAdmin) return;
    const reqId = ++adminDirReqIdRef.current;
    if (shouldShowLoadingOnWebFocusRevalidate({ hasHydratedData: Boolean(adminDirSigRef.current) })) {
      setAdminDirLoading(true);
    }
    try {
      const dir = await loadAdminGlobalDirectoryData();
      if (mountedRef.current && reqId === adminDirReqIdRef.current && accessAllowedRef.current) {
        const dirSig = computeStableDataSignature(dir);
        if (dirSig !== adminDirSigRef.current) {
          adminDirSigRef.current = dirSig;
          setAdminAffiliates(dir.affiliates);
          setAdminReport(dir.reporteCorteSemanal);
        }
      }
    } catch (dirErr: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current && reqId === adminDirReqIdRef.current && dirErr instanceof Error) {
        setAdminAffiliates((prev) => prev);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current && reqId === adminDirReqIdRef.current) setAdminDirLoading(false);
    }
  }, [access.allowed, access.isAdmin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSupervisedAffiliate(null);
  }, [user?.id, access.isAdmin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!access.allowed) {
      workspaceReqIdRef.current += 1;
      adminDirReqIdRef.current += 1;
      setSupervisedAffiliate(null);
      setWorkspace(null);
      setAdminAffiliates([]);
      setAdminReport(null);
      setActiveSection('overview');
      return;
    }
    void refreshWorkspace();
    if (access.isAdmin) {
      void refreshAdminDirectory();
    }
  }, [access.allowed, access.isAdmin, refreshWorkspace, refreshAdminDirectory]);

  const handleSignOutStayOnSocios = useCallback(() => {
    workspaceReqIdRef.current += 1;
    adminDirReqIdRef.current += 1;
    setSupervisedAffiliate(null);
    setPortalUi({ mobileMenu: false, signOutConfirm: false });
    void signOut();
  }, [signOut]);

  if (isAuthLoading && !user) {
    return (
      <View
        testID="partner-web-booting"
        style={{ flex: 1, width: '100%', backgroundColor: pal.canvasBg, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 12 }}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={pal.cyanText} />
        <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700' }}>KINETIC PARTNER</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!access.allowed) {
    const gateStatus =
      access.status === 'blocked_athlete' || access.status === 'invalid_jwt'
        ? access.status
        : 'unauthenticated';
    return (
      <View testID="partner-web-root" style={{ flex: 1, width: '100%', backgroundColor: pal.canvasBg }}>
        <PartnerWebAuthGate
          status={gateStatus}
          userEmail={user?.email}
          onSignOut={handleSignOutStayOnSocios}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const activeBusiness = supervisedAffiliate
    ? workspace?.business?.id === supervisedAffiliate.id
      ? workspace.business
      : supervisedAffiliate
    : workspace?.business || null;
  const effectiveSection: PartnerWebSectionKey =
    activeSection === 'admin_directory' && !access.isAdmin ? 'overview' : activeSection;

  return (
    <View testID="partner-web-root" style={{ flex: 1, width: '100%', flexDirection: isDesktop ? 'row' : 'column', backgroundColor: pal.canvasBg }}>
      <PartnerWebSidebar
        pal={pal}
        isDesktop={isDesktop}
        mobileOpen={portalUi.mobileMenu}
        onCloseMobile={() => setPortalUi((p) => ({ ...p, mobileMenu: false }))}
        activeSection={effectiveSection}
        onSelectSection={setActiveSection}
        isAdmin={access.isAdmin}
        activeBusiness={activeBusiness}
        userEmail={user?.email}
        onSignOut={() => setPortalUi((p) => ({ ...p, signOutConfirm: true }))}
      />

      <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        {!isDesktop && (
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              paddingHorizontal: 16,
              paddingVertical: 12,
              backgroundColor: pal.sidebarBg,
              borderBottomWidth: 1,
              borderBottomColor: pal.borderSubtle,
            }}
          >
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setPortalUi((p) => ({ ...p, mobileMenu: true }))} style={{ padding: 6 }}>
              <Feather name="menu" size={22} color={pal.textPrimary} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text numberOfLines={1} style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '900', flex: 1, textAlign: 'center' }}>
              {activeBusiness?.nombre || 'KINETIC PARTNER'}
            </Text>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => void refreshWorkspace()} style={{ padding: 6 }}>
              <Feather name="refresh-cw" size={18} color={pal.cyanText} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        {access.isAdmin && supervisedAffiliate && (
          <View
            testID="partner-web-supervision-banner"
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              gap: 10,
              paddingHorizontal: 22,
              paddingVertical: 10,
              backgroundColor: pal.translucentAmberBg,
              borderBottomWidth: 1,
              borderBottomColor: pal.amberText,
              elevation: 0,
            }}
          >
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <Feather name="eye" size={16} color={pal.amberText} />
              <Text style={{ color: pal.amberText, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '900' }}>
                {tx(
                  `Supervisando como Admin: ${supervisedAffiliate.nombre}`,
                  `Supervising as Admin: ${supervisedAffiliate.nombre}`
                )}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => {
                setWorkspace(null);
                setWorkspaceLoading(true);
                setSupervisedAffiliate(null);
                setActiveSection('admin_directory');
              }}
              style={[
                partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D,
                PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE,
                { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.cyanText, paddingVertical: 6 },
              ]}
            >
              <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>
                {tx('Volver a Vista Global', 'Return to Global View')}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1 }} contentContainerStyle={{ padding: isDesktop ? 28 : 16, gap: 20 }}>
          {!activeBusiness && !access.isAdmin && !workspaceLoading && user?.id ? (
            <PartnerWebOnboardingCard
              pal={pal}
              userId={user.id}
              userEmail={String(user.email || '')}
              onCreated={refreshWorkspace}
            />
          ) : effectiveSection === 'admin_directory' && access.isAdmin ? (
            <PartnerWebAdminDirectoryView
              pal={pal}
              affiliates={adminAffiliates}
              reporteCorteSemanal={adminReport}
              loading={adminDirLoading}
              supervisedAffiliateId={supervisedAffiliate?.id || null}
              onSelectSupervisedAffiliate={(af) => {
                setWorkspace(null);
                setWorkspaceLoading(true);
                setSupervisedAffiliate(af);
                setActiveSection('overview');
              }}
              onRefreshDirectory={refreshAdminDirectory}
            />
          ) : effectiveSection === 'finance_spei' ? (
            <PartnerWebFinanceView
              pal={pal}
              business={activeBusiness}
              historyReservations={workspace?.historyReservations || []}
              activeReservations={workspace?.activeReservations || []}
              masterPassSummary={workspace?.masterPassSummary || { total_emitidos: 0, activos: 0, liquidados: 0, cancelados: 0, hoy: 0, semana: 0, mes: 0 }}
            />
          ) : effectiveSection === 'events_3d' || effectiveSection === 'profile_media' ? (
            <PartnerWebCatalogAndProfileView
              mode={effectiveSection}
              pal={pal}
              actorUserId={user?.id || ''}
              isAdmin={access.isAdmin}
              isB2B={access.isB2B}
              workspaceLoading={workspaceLoading}
              business={activeBusiness}
              services={workspace?.services || []}
              activeReservations={workspace?.activeReservations || []}
              completedReservations={workspace?.completedReservations || []}
              onRefreshWorkspace={refreshWorkspace}

                if (supervisedAffiliate && updated.id === supervisedAffiliate.id) {
                  setSupervisedAffiliate(updated);
                }
                if (access.isAdmin) void refreshAdminDirectory();
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <PartnerWebDashboardAndOpsView
              mode={effectiveSection === 'agenda_qr' ? 'agenda_qr' : 'overview'}

                }

              historyReservations={workspace?.historyReservations || []}

              onRefreshWorkspace={refreshWorkspace}
            />

      </View>

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Platform, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { LoginMfaChallengeModal } from '../auth/LoginMfaChallengeModal';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import {
  cancelPartnerWebMfaChallenge,
  signInPartnerWebEmail,
  signInPartnerWebGoogle,
  verifyPartnerWebMfaTotp,
  type IPartnerWebPendingMfa,
} from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebAuthService';
import type { PartnerWebAccessStatus } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebTypes';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, buildPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

interface PartnerWebAuthGateProps {
  status: Exclude<PartnerWebAccessStatus, 'authorized' | 'redirect_native_root'>;
  userEmail?: string | null;
  onSignOut: () => void;
}

export function PartnerWebAuthGate({ status, userEmail, onSignOut }: PartnerWebAuthGateProps) {
  const { activateResilientSession } = useAuth();
  const { themeColors, isLightMode, resolvedTheme, setThemeMode, language, setLanguage, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const pal = useMemo(() => buildPartnerWebPalette(themeColors, isLightMode), [themeColors, isLightMode]);

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPass, setShowPass] = useState(false);
  const [busyAuth, setBusyAuth] = useState<'email' | 'google' | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mfaState, setMfaState] = useState<{ pending: IPartnerWebPendingMfa | null; verifying: boolean; error: string | null }>({
    pending: null,
    verifying: false,
    error: null,
  });
  const googleCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const mfaBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const busyEmail = busyAuth === 'email';
  const busyGoogle = busyAuth === 'google';
  const pendingMfa = mfaState.pending;

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      googleCleanupRef.current?.();
      googleCleanupRef.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  const handleEmailLogin = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current || busyAuth) return;
    busyRef.current = true;
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setBusyAuth('email');
    try {
      const outcome = await signInPartnerWebEmail(email, password, activateResilientSession);
      if (mountedRef.current && outcome.status === 'mfa_required') setMfaState({ pending: outcome.challenge, verifying: false, error: null });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current) setErrorMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('No fue posible iniciar sesión.', 'Unable to sign in.'));
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setBusyAuth(null);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogleLogin = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current || busyAuth) return;
    busyRef.current = true;
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setBusyAuth('google');
    try {
      const outcome = await signInPartnerWebGoogle(activateResilientSession, (fn) => { googleCleanupRef.current = fn; });
      if (mountedRef.current && outcome.status === 'mfa_required') setMfaState({ pending: outcome.challenge, verifying: false, error: null });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current) setErrorMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Error conectando Google.', 'Google sign-in failed.'));
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      googleCleanupRef.current = null;
      if (mountedRef.current) setBusyAuth(null);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmMfa = async (code: string) => {
    if (!mfaState.pending || mfaBusyRef.current || mfaState.verifying) return false;
    mfaBusyRef.current = true;
    setMfaState((p) => ({ ...p, error: null, verifying: true }));
    try {
      const ok = await verifyPartnerWebMfaTotp(mfaState.pending, code, activateResilientSession);
      if (mountedRef.current && ok) setMfaState({ pending: null, verifying: false, error: null });
      return ok;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current) setMfaState((p) => ({ ...p, verifying: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Código 2FA inválido.', 'Invalid 2FA code.') }));
      return false;
    } finally {
      mfaBusyRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  const handleCancelMfa = () => {
    setMfaState({ pending: null, verifying: false, error: null });
    void cancelPartnerWebMfaChallenge();
  };

  const utilityBar = (
    <View style={s.topBar}>
      <View style={s.brandRow}>
        <View style={[s.brandBadge, { backgroundColor: pal.purple }]}>
          <Feather name="shield" size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
        </View>
        <Text style={[s.brandTitle, { color: pal.textPrimary }]}>KINETIC PARTNER OS</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={s.actionRow}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={() => setLanguage(language === 'es' ? 'en' : 'es')}

        >

        <TouchableOpacity

        >
          <Feather name={resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'sun' : 'moon'} size={15} color={pal.cyanText} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  if (status === 'blocked_athlete') {
    return (
      <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: pal.canvasBg }} contentContainerStyle={s.centerScroll}>
        <View style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 680 }}>
          {utilityBar}
          <View
            testID="partner-web-athlete-blocked"
            style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, s.blockedCard, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.purple, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D }]}
          >
            <View style={[s.lockCircle, { backgroundColor: pal.translucentPurpleBg, borderColor: pal.purple }]}>

            </View>
            <Text style={[s.blockedTitle, { color: pal.textPrimary }]}>
              {tx('Acceso Exclusivo para Clubes, Especialistas y Administración Kinetic', 'Exclusive Portal for Clubs, Specialists & Kinetic Administration')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[s.blockedDesc, { color: pal.textSecondary }]}>
              {tx(
                'Usa tu cuenta de Atleta en la App Móvil Kinetic. Este portal Web está reservado exclusivamente para operación B2B de sedes, especialistas verificados y consola administrativa.',
                'Use your Athlete account in the Kinetic Mobile App. This Web portal is reserved strictly for B2B venues, verified specialists, and administrative operations.'
              )}
            </Text>
            {Boolean(userEmail) && (
              <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { backgroundColor: pal.translucentCyanBg, borderColor: pal.cyanText, marginBottom: 20 }]}>
                <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700' }}>{userEmail}</Text>
              </View>
            )}
            <TouchableOpacity
              testID="partner-web-athlete-signout"
              onPress={onSignOut}
              style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnPrimaryPurple, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { minWidth: 240 }]}
            >
              <Feather name="log-out" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
              <Text style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Cerrar Sesión', 'Sign Out')}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: pal.canvasBg }} contentContainerStyle={s.centerScroll} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
      <View testID="partner-web-auth-gate" style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 1060 }}>
        {utilityBar}
        <View style={s.splitWrap}>
          <View
            style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, s.heroCol, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.borderTop3D, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D }]}
          >
            <View>
              <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { alignSelf: 'flex-start', backgroundColor: pal.translucentCyanBg, borderColor: pal.cyanText, marginBottom: 16 }]}>
                <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800', letterSpacing: 0.6 }}>
                  {tx('SOLO SOCIOS B2B & MASTER ADMIN', 'B2B PARTNERS & MASTER ADMIN ONLY')}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <Text style={[s.heroTitle, { color: pal.textPrimary }]}>
                {tx('KINETIC PARTNER — Portal de Afiliados y Administración', 'KINETIC PARTNER — Affiliate & Administration Portal')}
              </Text>
              <Text style={[s.heroSub, { color: pal.textSecondary }]}>
                {tx(
                  'Controla tu recepción QR dinámica en tiempo real, ocupación de Sala 3D, cortes semanales 80% SPEI, retenciones SAT automatizadas y analítica operativa en pantalla completa.',
                  'Manage front-desk 60s dynamic QR check-ins, 3D Studio occupancy, weekly 80% SPEI settlements, automated SAT tax breakdowns, and widescreen operational analytics.'
                )}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
              {[
                { icon: 'check-circle' as const, label: tx('Custodia Escrow 40/60 y check-in QR dinámico 60s', '40/60 Escrow Custody & 60s dynamic QR check-in') },
                { icon: 'file-text' as const, label: tx('Estados de Cuenta PDF A4 & Layout Bancario SPEI .CSV', 'A4 PDF Statements & Massive SPEI Bank .CSV Layout') },
                { icon: 'shield' as const, label: tx('Aislamiento estricto B2B Zero-Trust sobre RLS PostgreSQL', 'Strict Zero-Trust B2B isolation enforced via PostgreSQL RLS') },
              ].map((feat) => (
                <View key={feat.label} style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                  <Feather name={feat.icon} size={16} color={pal.cyanText} />
                  <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 14, flex: 1 }}>{feat.label}</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          </View>

          <View
            style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, s.formCol, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.purple, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D }]}
          >
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Acceso Ejecutivo', 'Executive Sign In')}</Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>

            </Text>

            {Boolean(errorMsg || status === 'invalid_jwt') && (
              <View style={[s.errBox, { backgroundColor: pal.isLight ? 'rgba(220,38,38,0.08)' : 'rgba(255,59,48,0.14)', borderColor: pal.redText }]}>
                <Text style={{ color: pal.redText, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600' }}>
                  {errorMsg || tx('Sesión inválida o expirada. Inicia sesión nuevamente.', 'Invalid or expired session. Please sign in again.')}
                </Text>

            )}

            <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700' }}>{tx('Correo Corporativo / Socio', 'Partner / Corporate Email')}</Text>
              <TextInput
                value={email}
                onChangeText={setEmail}
                placeholder="socio@tustudio.mx"
                placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
                autoCapitalize="none"
                keyboardType="email-address"
                autoComplete="email"
                style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary }]}
              />
            </View>

            <View style={{ gap: 6 }}>
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700' }}>{tx('Contraseña', 'Password')}</Text>
              <View style={{ position: 'relative', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                <TextInput
                  value={password}
                  onChangeText={setPassword}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
                  secureTextEntry={!showPass}
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  onSubmitEditing={handleEmailLogin}
                  style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary, paddingRight: 44 }]}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowPass((v) => !v)} style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 12, padding: 6 }}>
                  <Feather name={showPass ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'} size={18} color={pal.textMuted} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              testID="partner-web-login-submit"
              disabled={busyEmail || busyGoogle}
              onPress={handleEmailLogin}
              style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnPrimaryCyan, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { marginTop: 4 }]}
            >
              {busyEmail ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#050505" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Feather name="log-in" size={16} color="#050505" />
                  <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Entrar al Partner Hub', 'Enter Partner Hub')}</Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginVertical: 2 }}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, backgroundColor: pal.borderSubtle }} />
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700' }}>{tx('O', 'OR')}</Text>
              <View style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, backgroundColor: pal.borderSubtle }} />
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              testID="partner-web-google-btn"
              disabled={busyEmail || busyGoogle}
              onPress={handleGoogleLogin}
              style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { backgroundColor: pal.cardElevatedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle }]}
            >
              {busyGoogle ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={pal.cyanText} />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Feather name="chrome" size={16} color={pal.cyanText} />
                  <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700' }}>{tx('Continuar con Google', 'Continue with Google')}</Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>

            {Platform.OS === 'web' && (
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 12, textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 4 }}>
                {tx('Protegido por 2FA AAL2, JWT Supabase y Row Level Security.', 'Protected by 2FA AAL2, Supabase JWT & Row Level Security.')}
              </Text>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      <LoginMfaChallengeModal
        visible={Boolean(pendingMfa)}
        email={pendingMfa?.email}
        friendlyName={pendingMfa?.friendlyName}
        isVerifying={mfaState.verifying}
        errorMsg={mfaState.error}
        onVerifyCode={handleConfirmMfa}
        onCancel={handleCancelMfa}
      />
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { activateOwnPartnerVenueOnboarding } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebDataService';
import { sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebGuards';
import type {
  IPartnerWebAffiliateRow,
  IPartnerWebReservationRow,
  IPartnerWebServiceRow,
} from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebTypes';
import { PartnerWebEventsCrudView } from './PartnerWebEventsCrudView';
import { PartnerWebProfileEditorView } from './PartnerWebProfileEditorView';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, type IPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

export function PartnerWebOnboardingCard({
  pal,
  userId,
  userEmail,
  onCreated,
}: {
  pal: IPartnerWebPalette;
  userId: string;
  userEmail: string;
  onCreated: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [ubicacion, setUbicacion] = useState('');
  const [disciplina, setDisciplina] = useState('Fuerza');
  const [categoria, setCategoria] = useState<'Club' | 'Especialista'>('Club');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [errMsg, setErrMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  const cleanNombre = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(nombre, 120, true);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current || busy) return;
    if (cleanNombre.length < 2) {
      setErrMsg(tx('Ingresa un nombre comercial válido (mínimo 2 caracteres).', 'Enter a valid venue name (minimum 2 characters).'));
      return;
    }
    busyRef.current = true;
    setErrMsg(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await activateOwnPartnerVenueOnboarding({
        userId,
        email: userEmail,
        nombre: cleanNombre,
        ubicacion: sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(ubicacion, 240, true),
        disciplina: sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(disciplina, 60, true) || 'Fuerza',
        categoria,
      });
      await onCreated();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current) {
        setErrMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Error registrando sede.', 'Error activating venue.'));
      }
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View
      testID="partner-web-onboarding-card"
      style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, s.onboardCard, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.purple, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D }]}
    >
      <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Activa tu Sede o Perfil de Especialista B2B', 'Activate Your B2B Venue or Specialist Profile')}</Text>
      <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 14 }}>
        {tx('Tu cuenta aún no tiene una sede vinculada. Registra tus datos comerciales para habilitar tu Terminal Web.', 'Your account has no linked venue yet. Register your commercial profile to unlock your Web Terminal.')}
      </Text>
      {Boolean(errMsg) && <Text style={{ color: pal.redText, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700' }}>{errMsg}</Text>}

      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 10 }}>
        {(['Club', 'Especialista'] as const).map((cat) => {
          const sel = categoria === cat;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={cat}
              onPress={() => setCategoria(cat)}
              style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { flex: 1, backgroundColor: sel ? pal.translucentPurpleBg : pal.recessedBg, borderColor: sel ? pal.purple : pal.borderSubtle }]}
            >
              <Text style={{ color: sel ? pal.textPrimary : pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>
                {cat === 'Club' ? tx('Club / Estudio', 'Club / Studio') : tx('Especialista', 'Specialist')}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <TextInput
        value={nombre}
        onChangeText={setNombre}
        placeholder={tx('Nombre comercial de la sede', 'Commercial venue name')}
        placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
        style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary }]}
      />
      <TextInput
        value={disciplina}
        onChangeText={setDisciplina}
        placeholder={tx('Disciplina principal (ej. Pilates, Fuerza)', 'Main discipline (e.g. Pilates, Strength)')}
        placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
        style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary }]}
      />
      <TextInput
        value={ubicacion}
        onChangeText={setUbicacion}
        placeholder={tx('Ubicación / Zona comercial', 'Location / Address')}
        placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
        style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary }]}
      />

      <TouchableOpacity disabled={busy || cleanNombre.length < 2} onPress={handleSubmit} style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnPrimaryCyan, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { opacity: cleanNombre.length < 2 ? 0.55 : 1 }]}>
        {busy ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#050505" /> : <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Registrar y Abrir Panel B2B', 'Register & Open B2B Hub')}</Text>}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  );
}

interface PartnerWebCatalogAndProfileViewProps {
  mode: 'events_3d' | 'profile_media';
  pal: IPartnerWebPalette;
  actorUserId: string;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  isB2B: boolean;
  workspaceLoading?: boolean;
  business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  services: IPartnerWebServiceRow[];
  activeReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  completedReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  onRefreshWorkspace: () => Promise<void>;
  onBusinessUpdated?: (updated: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow) => void;
}

export function PartnerWebCatalogAndProfileView({
  mode,
  pal,
  actorUserId,
  isAdmin,
  isB2B,
  workspaceLoading,
  business,
  services,
  activeReservations,
  completedReservations,
  onRefreshWorkspace,
  onBusinessUpdated,
}: PartnerWebCatalogAndProfileViewProps) {
  if (mode === 'events_3d') {
    return (
      <PartnerWebEventsCrudView
        pal={pal}
        actorUserId={actorUserId}
        isAdmin={isAdmin}
        isB2B={isB2B}
        business={business}
        services={services}
        activeReservations={activeReservations}
        completedReservations={completedReservations}
        onRefreshWorkspace={onRefreshWorkspace}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <PartnerWebProfileEditorView
      pal={pal}
      actorUserId={actorUserId}
      isAdmin={isAdmin}
      workspaceLoading={workspaceLoading}
      business={business}
      onRefreshWorkspace={onRefreshWorkspace}
      onBusinessUpdated={onBusinessUpdated}
    />
  );
}

const s = StyleSheet.create({
  onboardCard: { maxWidth: 680, gap: 14 },
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { validateAndSettlePartnerQrCheckin } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebDataService';
import type {
  IPartnerWebAffiliateRow,
  IPartnerWebKpis,
  IPartnerWebReservationRow,
} from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebTypes';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, type IPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

interface PartnerWebDashboardAndOpsViewProps {
  mode: 'overview' | 'agenda_qr';
  pal: IPartnerWebPalette;
  business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  workspaceLoading?: boolean;
  kpis: IPartnerWebKpis;
  activeReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  historyReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  isAdmin: boolean;
  onRefreshWorkspace: () => Promise<void>;
}

const formatCurrencyMxn = (val: number): string =>
  `$${(Number(val) || 0).toLocaleString('es-MX', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} MXN`;

export function PartnerWebDashboardAndOpsView({
  mode,
  pal,
  business,
  workspaceLoading = false,
  kpis,
  activeReservations,
  historyReservations,
  isAdmin,
  onRefreshWorkspace,
}: PartnerWebDashboardAndOpsViewProps) {
  const { language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [qrInput, setQrInput] = useState('');
  const [qrBusy, setQrBusy] = useState(false);
  const [qrFeedback, setQrFeedback] = useState<{ ok: boolean; msg: string } | null>(null);
  const [rosterTab, setRosterTab] = useState<'active' | 'history' | 'no_shows' | 'all'>('active');
  const [searchRoster, setSearchRoster] = useState('');
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const qrBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const scopeKeyRef = useRef(`${business?.id || ''}|${business?.nombre || ''}`);
  scopeKeyRef.current = `${business?.id || ''}|${business?.nombre || ''}`;
  const isVenueReadyForQr = !workspaceLoading && (isAdmin || Boolean(business?.nombre));

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setQrInput('');
    setQrFeedback(null);
  }, [business?.id, business?.nombre]);

  const handleSettleQr = async () => {
    const raw = qrInput.trim();
    if (!raw || qrBusyRef.current || qrBusy || !isVenueReadyForQr) return;
    qrBusyRef.current = true;
    const startScope = scopeKeyRef.current;
    setQrBusy(true);
    setQrFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await validateAndSettlePartnerQrCheckin({
        rawInput: raw,
        scopeBusinessName: business?.nombre || null,
        isMasterAdmin: isAdmin,
        isEn: language === 'en',
      });
      if (!mountedRef.current || scopeKeyRef.current !== startScope) return;
      setQrInput('');
      setQrFeedback({
        ok: true,
        msg: tx(
          `Check-in liquidado: ${res.athleteName} (${res.reserva.servicio || res.reserva.nombre_servicio || 'Pase Kinetic'}).`,
          `Check-in settled: ${res.athleteName} (${res.reserva.servicio || res.reserva.nombre_servicio || 'Kinetic Pass'}).`
        ),
      });
      await onRefreshWorkspace();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current && scopeKeyRef.current === startScope) {
        setQrFeedback({
          ok: false,
          msg: err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Error validando pase QR.', 'Failed validating QR pass.'),
        });
      }
    } finally {
      qrBusyRef.current = false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setQrBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const noShowReservations = useMemo(
    () =>
      (historyReservations || []).filter((r) => {
        const st = String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        return st === 'no_show' || st === 'penalizada' || st === 'penalizado';
      }),
    [historyReservations]
  );

  const filteredRoster = useMemo(() => {
    const base =
      rosterTab === 'active'
        ? activeReservations
        : rosterTab === 'no_shows'
        ? noShowReservations
        : rosterTab === 'history'
        ? historyReservations
        : [...activeReservations, ...historyReservations];
    const q = searchRoster.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return base.slice(0, 60);
    return base
      .filter((r) =>
        [r.id, r.perfiles?.nombre, r.servicio, r.nombre_servicio, r.titulo_clase, r.negocio_nombre, r.estado]
          .map((v) => String(v || '').toLowerCase())
          .join(' ')
          .includes(q)
      )
      .slice(0, 60);
  }, [activeReservations, historyReservations, noShowReservations, rosterTab, searchRoster]);

  const isInitialMetricsLoading = workspaceLoading && kpis.checkInsCompletados === 0 && activeReservations.length === 0 && historyReservations.length === 0;
  const kpiCards = [
    { label: tx('Ingresos Hoy', "Today's Revenue"), value: isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : formatCurrencyMxn(kpis.ingresosHoyMxn), sub: tx('Check-ins + 40% No-Show honorado', 'Check-ins + honored 40% No-Show'), accent: pal.cyanText, icon: 'dollar-sign' as const },
    { label: tx('Proyección Corte Semanal 80% SPEI', 'Weekly 80% SPEI Projection'), value: isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : formatCurrencyMxn(kpis.proyeccionSpei80Mxn), sub: tx('Antes de retenciones fiscales SAT', 'Before SAT tax withholdings'), accent: pal.greenText, icon: 'trending-up' as const },
    { label: tx('Check-ins QR Completados', 'Completed QR Check-ins'), value: isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : String(kpis.checkInsCompletados), sub: tx('Liquidación ACID 60% en puerta', 'ACID 60% front-desk settlement'), accent: pal.purpleText, icon: 'check-circle' as const },
    { label: tx('Reservas Custodia Escrow 40/60', 'Active 40/60 Escrow Custody'), value: isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : `${kpis.reservasActivasEscrow} (${kpis.escrowCustodiaKc} KC)`, sub: tx('Saldo protegido previo a recepción', 'Protected balance prior to check-in'), accent: pal.amberText, icon: 'shield' as const },
    { label: tx('Ocupación Activa', 'Active Occupancy'), value: isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : `${kpis.ocupacionPct}%`, sub: tx('Aforo comprometido sobre catálogo', 'Committed capacity across classes'), accent: pal.cyanText, icon: 'users' as const },
    { label: tx('Pases Maestros 0 KC', '0 KC Master Passes'), value: isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : `${kpis.pasesMaestrosHoy} / ${kpis.pasesMaestrosSemana} / ${kpis.pasesMaestrosMes}`, sub: tx('Hoy / Semana / Mes (Exento SPEI)', 'Day / Week / Month (SPEI exempt)'), accent: pal.purpleText, icon: 'award' as const },
  ];

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 20 }}>
      {mode === 'overview' && (
        <View style={s.gridWrap}>
          {kpiCards.map((card) => (
            <View
              key={card.label}
              style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, s.kpiCard, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.borderTop3D, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D }]}
            >
              <View style={s.rowBetween}>
                <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800', flex: 1 }}>{card.label}</Text>
                <Feather name={card.icon} size={16} color={card.accent} />
              </View>
              <Text style={{ color: card.accent, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: '900' }}>{card.value}</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 12 }}>{card.sub}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      <View
        style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.cyanText, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D, gap: 12 }]}
      >
        <View style={s.headerWrap}>
          <View>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: '800' }}>
              {tx('Validador Web QR Dinámico 60s (Recepción ACID)', 'Web 60s Dynamic QR Validator (ACID Check-in)')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>
              {tx('Escanea o pega la llave dinámica KINETIC_PASS|... o folio para liberar el 60% restante en puerta.', 'Scan or paste the KINETIC_PASS|... dynamic key or pass folio to settle the remaining 60% at front desk.')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { backgroundColor: pal.translucentCyanBg, borderColor: pal.cyanText }]}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('VENTANA ANTI-REPLAY 60S', '60S ANTI-REPLAY WINDOW')}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={s.qrRow}>
          <TextInput
            value={qrInput}
            onChangeText={setQrInput}
            placeholder={tx('KINETIC_PASS|folio|totpStep|nonce o #KNT-...', 'KINETIC_PASS|folio|totpStep|nonce or #KNT-...')}
            placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            onSubmitEditing={handleSettleQr}
            style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { flex: 1, minWidth: 260, fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary }]}
          />
          <TouchableOpacity
            testID="partner-qr-settle-btn"
            disabled={qrBusy || !qrInput.trim() || !isVenueReadyForQr}
            onPress={handleSettleQr}
            style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnPrimaryCyan, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { minWidth: 190, opacity: isVenueReadyForQr ? 1 : 0.6 }]}
          >
            {qrBusy ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#050505" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Feather name="check-square" size={16} color="#050505" />
                <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Validar y Liquidar QR', 'Validate & Settle QR')}</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {qrFeedback && (
          <View
            style={[s.feedbackBox, { borderColor: qrFeedback.ok ? pal.greenText : pal.redText, backgroundColor: qrFeedback.ok ? pal.translucentCyanBg : pal.translucentPurpleBg }]}
          >
            <Text style={{ color: qrFeedback.ok ? pal.greenText : pal.redText, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700' }}>{qrFeedback.msg}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      <View
        style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.borderTop3D, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D, gap: 14 }]}
      >
        <View style={s.headerWrap}>
          <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Roster de Reservas y Check-ins', 'Reservations & Check-ins Roster')}</Text>
          <View style={s.pillRow}>
            {(
              [
                { k: 'active', label: `${tx('Activas Escrow', 'Active Escrow')} (${isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : activeReservations.length})` },
                { k: 'history', label: `${tx('Histórico', 'History')} (${isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : historyReservations.length})` },
                { k: 'no_shows', label: `No-Shows (${isInitialMetricsLoading ? '...' : noShowReservations.length})` },
                { k: 'all', label: tx('Todas', 'All') },
              ] as const
            ).map((tab) => {
              const sel = rosterTab === tab.k;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={tab.k}
                  onPress={() => setRosterTab(tab.k)}
                  style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { backgroundColor: sel ? pal.translucentCyanBg : pal.recessedBg, borderColor: sel ? pal.cyanText : pal.borderSubtle, paddingVertical: 7 }]}
                >
                  <Text style={{ color: sel ? pal.cyanText : pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tab.label}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <TextInput
          value={searchRoster}
          onChangeText={setSearchRoster}
          placeholder={tx('Filtrar por atleta, clase, folio o estado...', 'Filter by athlete, class, folio or status...')}
          placeholderTextColor={pal.textMuted}
          style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.input16, { fontSize: 16, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary }]}
        />

        {filteredRoster.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={{ paddingVertical: 24, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 14 }}>{tx('Sin reservas registradas con este filtro.', 'No reservations found for this filter.')}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            {filteredRoster.map((item) => {
              const st = String(item.estado || 'activa').toLowerCase();
              const isDone = st === 'completada';
              const totalKc = Math.max(Number(item.costo_total) || 0, Number(item.precio_kc) || 0, (Number(item.monto_escrow) || 0) + (Number(item.monto_puerta) || 0));
              const folio = `#KNT-${String(item.id || '').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
              return (
                <View key={item.id} style={[s.rosterRow, { backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle }]}>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220, gap: 2 }}>
                    <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '800' }}>
                      {item.perfiles?.nombre || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete')} • {folio}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 13 }}>
                      {item.servicio || item.nombre_servicio || item.titulo_clase || tx('Sesión Kinetic', 'Kinetic Session')}
                      {item.spot_number ? ` • Spot #${item.spot_number}` : ''}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 12 }}>
                      {String(item.fecha_clase || item.fecha_hora || item.created_at || '').slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                    <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '900' }}>{totalKc === 0 ? '0 KC VIP' : `${totalKc} KC`}</Text>
                    <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { backgroundColor: isDone ? pal.translucentCyanBg : pal.translucentAmberBg, borderColor: isDone ? pal.greenText : pal.amberText }]}>
                      <Text style={{ color: isDone ? pal.greenText : pal.amberText, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{st}</Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import type { IMasterPassAuditSummary } from '../../services/bovedaB2BDataHelper';

import {
  buildPartnerPeriodOptions,
  computePartnerSpeiStatement,
  exportPartnerSpeiPdfStatement,
} from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebDataService';
import type {
  IPartnerWebAffiliateRow,
  IPartnerWebReservationRow,
} from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebTypes';
import type { IPartnerPeriodOption } from '../../services/terminalSpeiAndStudioService';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, type IPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

interface PartnerWebFinanceViewProps {
  pal: IPartnerWebPalette;
  business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  historyReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  activeReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  masterPassSummary: IMasterPassAuditSummary;
}

const fmtMxn = (val: unknown): string =>
  `$${(Number(val) || 0).toLocaleString('es-MX', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} MXN`;

export function PartnerWebFinanceView({
  pal,
  business,
  historyReservations,
  activeReservations,
  masterPassSummary,
}: PartnerWebFinanceViewProps) {
  const { language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const periodOptions = useMemo(() => buildPartnerPeriodOptions(Date.now(), isEn), [isEn]);
  const [selectedKey, setSelectedKey] = useState<IPartnerPeriodOption['key']>('week_0');
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const activeOpt = useMemo(
    () => periodOptions.find((p) => p.key === selectedKey) || periodOptions[0],
    [periodOptions, selectedKey]
  );

  const { corteSocio } = useMemo(
    () =>
      computePartnerSpeiStatement(
        business || { nombre: 'Sede Kinetic' },
        historyReservations,
        activeReservations,
        activeOpt?.override
      ),
    [business, historyReservations, activeReservations, activeOpt]
  );

  const handleExportPdf = async () => {
    if (exporting) return;
    setExporting(true);
    setStatusMsg(null);
    try {
      await exportPartnerSpeiPdfStatement({
        business,
        historyReservations,
        activeReservations,
        periodOption: activeOpt,
        masterPassSummary,
      });
      setStatusMsg(
        tx('Estado de Cuenta Semanal PDF A4 generado correctamente.', 'Weekly A4 PDF Statement generated successfully.')
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setStatusMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('No fue posible generar el PDF.', 'Could not generate PDF.'));
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const regimenBadge = useMemo(() => {
    const reg = String(corteSocio?.regimen_fiscal || 'sin_rfc');
    if (reg === 'persona_moral') return tx('Persona Moral (0% Retención SAT)', 'Corporation (0% SAT Withholding)');
    if (reg === 'persona_fisica_con_rfc') return tx('Persona Física c/RFC (10.1%: 2.1% ISR + 8% IVA)', 'Individual w/ RFC (10.1%: 2.1% ISR + 8% IVA)');
    return tx('Sin RFC Validado (36.0%: 20% ISR + 16% IVA)', 'Unregistered RFC (36.0%: 20% ISR + 16% IVA)');
  }, [corteSocio?.regimen_fiscal, tx]);

  const rows = [
    { label: tx('Volumen Bruto Liquidado QR (100%)', 'Gross Settled QR Volume (100%)'), value: fmtMxn(corteSocio?.volumen_bruto_mxn), color: pal.textPrimary },
    { label: tx('Peaje Tecnológico Kinetic (20%)', 'Kinetic Technology Fee (20%)'), value: `-${fmtMxn(corteSocio?.comision_kinetic_total_mxn)}`, color: pal.purpleText },
    { label: tx('Subtotal Bruto Socio (80%)', 'Partner Gross Subtotal (80%)'), value: fmtMxn(corteSocio?.subtotal_socio_80_mxn), color: pal.cyanText },
    { label: tx(`Retención ISR (${corteSocio?.tasa_retencion_isr_pct ?? 0}%)`, `ISR Withholding (${corteSocio?.tasa_retencion_isr_pct ?? 0}%)`), value: `-${fmtMxn(corteSocio?.retencion_isr_mxn)}`, color: pal.amberText },
    { label: tx(`Retención IVA (${corteSocio?.tasa_retencion_iva_pct ?? 0}%)`, `IVA Withholding (${corteSocio?.tasa_retencion_iva_pct ?? 0}%)`), value: `-${fmtMxn(corteSocio?.retencion_iva_mxn)}`, color: pal.amberText },
    {
      label: tx('Pases Maestros 0 KC (Día / Semana / Mes)', '0 KC Master Passes (Day / Week / Month)'),
      value: `${masterPassSummary.hoy} / ${masterPassSummary.semana} / ${masterPassSummary.mes} (${tx('Exento SPEI $0.00', 'SPEI Exempt $0.00')})`,
      color: pal.textSecondary,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 20 }}>
      <View
        style={[
          partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D,
          {
            backgroundColor: pal.cardBg,
            borderColor: pal.borderSubtle,
            borderTopColor: pal.cyanText,
            borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D,
            gap: 14,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
          <View>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: '900' }}>
              {tx('Finanzas SPEI 80/20 & Retenciones SAT', '80/20 SPEI Finance & SAT Tax Breakdown')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>
              {activeOpt?.rangeLabel} • {regimenBadge}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity
            testID="partner-finance-pdf-btn"
            disabled={exporting}
            onPress={handleExportPdf}
            style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnPrimaryCyan, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE]}
          >
            {exporting ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#050505" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Feather name="download" size={16} color="#050505" />
                <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '900' }}>
                  {tx('Descargar Estado de Cuenta PDF A4', 'Download A4 PDF Statement')}
                </Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
          {periodOptions.map((opt) => {
            const sel = opt.key === selectedKey;
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={opt.key}
                onPress={() => setSelectedKey(opt.key)}
                style={[
                  partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D,
                  PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: sel ? pal.translucentPurpleBg : pal.recessedBg,
                    borderColor: sel ? pal.purple : pal.borderSubtle,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Text style={{ color: sel ? pal.textPrimary : pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>
                  {opt.label}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </View>

        {statusMsg && (
          <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { backgroundColor: pal.translucentCyanBg, borderColor: pal.cyanText, alignSelf: 'flex-start' }]}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700' }}>{statusMsg}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 16 }}>
        <View
          style={[
            partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D,
            {
              flex: 2,
              minWidth: 320,
              backgroundColor: pal.cardBg,
              borderColor: pal.borderSubtle,
              borderTopColor: pal.borderTop3D,
              borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D,
              gap: 10,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '800', marginBottom: 4 }}>
            {tx('Desglose Contable del Periodo', 'Period Accounting Breakdown')}
          </Text>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <View
              key={r.label}
              style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 12,
                paddingVertical: 10,
                borderBottomWidth: 1,
                borderBottomColor: pal.borderSubtle,
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 13, flex: 1 }}>{r.label}</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: r.color, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '800' }}>{r.value}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 10 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '900' }}>
              {tx('NETO A DISPERSAR SPEI', 'NET SPEI PAYOUT')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.greenText, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: '900' }}>
              {fmtMxn(corteSocio?.neto_dispersar_spei_mxn)}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View
          style={[
            partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D,
            {
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 260,
              backgroundColor: pal.cardBg,
              borderColor: pal.borderSubtle,
              borderTopColor: pal.purple,
              borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D,
              gap: 12,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '800' }}>
            {tx('Datos Bancarios & Fiscales SAT', 'Banking & SAT Tax Profile')}
          </Text>
          <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700' }}>CLABE SPEI (18)</Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800' }}>
              {corteSocio?.clabe_bancaria
                ? maskClabeAccount(corteSocio.clabe_bancaria)
                : tx('Pendiente de registro', 'Pending registration')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700' }}>RFC</Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800' }}>
              {corteSocio?.rfc || tx('Sin RFC (Tasa máxima 36%)', 'No RFC (36% statutory rate)')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700' }}>
              {tx('Saldo en Custodia Escrow', 'In Active Escrow Custody')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: pal.amberText, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800' }}>
              {`${corteSocio?.en_custodia_escrow_kc ?? 0} KC`}
            </Text>

      </View>

  );
