    // === src/components/partner-web/PartnerWebProfileEditorView.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { maskClabeAccount } from '../../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import { updateOwnAffiliateProfileCloud } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebDataService';
import { resolvePartnerRegimenFiscal } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebGuards';
import {
  framePartnerWebPickedImage,
  pickWebImageFileAsBytes,
  removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectsBatchSafe,
  removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectSafe,
  uploadPartnerImageToAvatarsBucket,
} from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebMediaAndCatalogService';
import type { IPartnerWebAffiliateRow, PartnerMediaSlotKind } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebTypes';
import { preloadImageInMemory } from '../../utils/kineticImageFramePureLeaf';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, type IPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

const OFFICIAL_AMENITIES = [
  'Regaderas y Lockers', 'Estacionamiento', 'WiFi Alta Velocidad', 'Climatizado A/C', 'Estación de Agua',
  'Servicio de Toallas', 'Sauna & Vapor', 'Camas Reformer & Core', 'Shake & Coffee Bar',
  'Recovery Lounge', 'Pet Friendly', 'Fisioterapia en Sede', 'Acceso Óptico QR',
];
const ADMIN_STATES = ['activo', 'pendiente', 'prospecto', 'inactivo'] as const;

interface IProfileDraft {
  nombre: string;
  disciplina: string;
  ubicacion: string;
  latitud: string;
  longitud: string;
  horarios: string;
  whatsapp: string;
  instagram: string;
  descripcion: string;
  avatar_url: string;
  portada_url: string;
  galeria: string[];
  amenidades: string[];
  clabe_bancaria: string;
  rfc: string;
  estado: string;
  verificado: boolean;
  csf_validada: boolean;
  estrellas_exclusividad: number;
  strikes_operativos: number;
}

function hydrateProfileDraft(biz: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null): IProfileDraft {
  return {
    nombre: String(biz?.nombre || ''),
    disciplina: String(biz?.disciplina || ''),
    ubicacion: String(biz?.ubicacion || ''),
    latitud: typeof biz?.latitud === 'number' && Number.isFinite(biz.latitud) ? String(biz.latitud) : '',
    longitud: typeof biz?.longitud === 'number' && Number.isFinite(biz.longitud) ? String(biz.longitud) : '',
    horarios: String(biz?.horarios || ''),
    whatsapp: String(biz?.whatsapp || ''),
    instagram: String(biz?.instagram || ''),
    descripcion: String(biz?.descripcion || ''),
    avatar_url: String(biz?.avatar_url || ''),
    portada_url: String(biz?.portada_url || ''),
    galeria: Array.isArray(biz?.galeria) ? biz.galeria.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 4) : [],
    amenidades: Array.isArray(biz?.amenidades) ? biz.amenidades.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 24) : [],
    clabe_bancaria: String(biz?.clabe_bancaria || ''),
    rfc: String(biz?.rfc || ''),
    estado: String(biz?.estado || 'pendiente').toLowerCase(),
    verificado: Boolean(biz?.verificado),
    csf_validada: Boolean(biz?.csf_validada),
    estrellas_exclusividad: Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(biz?.estrellas_exclusividad) || 4))),
    strikes_operativos: Math.min(3, Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(biz?.strikes_operativos) || 0))),
  };
}

interface PartnerWebProfileEditorViewProps {
  pal: IPartnerWebPalette;
  actorUserId: string;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  workspaceLoading?: boolean;
  business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  onRefreshWorkspace: () => Promise<void>;
  onBusinessUpdated?: (updated: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow) => void;
}

export function PartnerWebProfileEditorView({
  pal, actorUserId, isAdmin, workspaceLoading, business, onRefreshWorkspace, onBusinessUpdated,
}: PartnerWebProfileEditorViewProps) {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<IProfileDraft>(() => hydrateProfileDraft(business));
  const [uploadingSlot, setUploadingSlot] = useState<PartnerMediaSlotKind | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const dirtyRef = useRef(false);
  const replacedMediaRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const hydratedBizIdRef = useRef<string | null>(business?.id || null);
  const activeBizIdRef = useRef<string | null>(business?.id || null);
  activeBizIdRef.current = business?.id || null;

  const updateDraft = (updater: (prev: IProfileDraft) => IProfileDraft) => {
    dirtyRef.current = true;
    setDraft(updater);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const nextId = business?.id || null;
    if (hydratedBizIdRef.current !== nextId) {
      hydratedBizIdRef.current = nextId;
      dirtyRef.current = false;
      setDraft(hydrateProfileDraft(business));
      setFeedback(null);
      replacedMediaRef.current.clear();
    } else if (nextId && !dirtyRef.current && !busyRef.current) {
      setDraft(hydrateProfileDraft(business));
    }
  }, [business]);

  const effectiveRegimen = useMemo(
    () => resolvePartnerRegimenFiscal(draft.rfc.trim().toUpperCase(), draft.csf_validada, isAdmin),
    [draft.rfc, draft.csf_validada, isAdmin]
  );

  if (!business?.id) {
    return (
      <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.purple, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D, padding: 28 }]}>
        <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 17, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Selecciona o registra una sede comercial', 'Select or register a commercial venue')}</Text>
        <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 13, marginTop: 6 }}>{tx('En Modo Admin Global selecciona una sede desde el Directorio Maestro para editar su ficha B2B y multimedia.', 'In Global Admin Mode select a venue from the Master Directory to edit its B2B profile & media.')}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const handleUploadSlot = async (slot: 'avatar' | 'cover' | 'gallery') => {
    if (busyRef.current || uploadingSlot || saving || workspaceLoading) return;
    if (slot === 'gallery' && draft.galeria.length >= 4) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'err', text: tx('Máximo 4 fotos en galería.', 'Maximum 4 gallery photos allowed.') });
      return;
    }
    busyRef.current = true;
    const startBizId = activeBizIdRef.current;
    setFeedback(null); setUploadingSlot(slot);
    try {
      const picked = await pickWebImageFileAsBytes();
      if (!picked) return;
      const framed = await framePartnerWebPickedImage(picked, slot);
      if (!framed) return;
      const publicUrl = await uploadPartnerImageToAvatarsBucket({ ...framed, slot, isAdmin });
      await preloadImageInMemory(publicUrl);
      if (!mountedRef.current || activeBizIdRef.current !== startBizId) {
        void removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectSafe(publicUrl, actorUserId, isAdmin);
        return;
      }
      dirtyRef.current = true;
      setDraft((prev) => {
        if (slot === 'avatar') {
          if (prev.avatar_url) replacedMediaRef.current.add(prev.avatar_url);
          return { ...prev, avatar_url: publicUrl };
        }
        if (slot === 'cover') {
          if (prev.portada_url) replacedMediaRef.current.add(prev.portada_url);
          return { ...prev, portada_url: publicUrl };
        }
        return { ...prev, galeria: [...prev.galeria, publicUrl].slice(0, 4) };
      });
      setFeedback({ type: 'ok', text: tx('Imagen cargada a Storage (avatars). Presiona Guardar Perfil para confirmar.', 'Image uploaded to Storage (avatars). Click Save Profile to apply.') });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current) setFeedback({ type: 'err', text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('Error subiendo imagen.', 'Image upload failed.') });
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setUploadingSlot(null);
    }
  };

  const toggleAmenity = (item: string) => {
    updateDraft((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.amenidades.includes(item);
      return { ...prev, amenidades: exists ? prev.amenidades.filter((a) => a !== item) : [...prev.amenidades, item].slice(0, 24) };
    });
  };

  const handleSaveProfile = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current || saving || uploadingSlot || workspaceLoading) return;
    busyRef.current = true; setSaving(true); setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const latTrim = draft.latitud.trim();
      const lngTrim = draft.longitud.trim();
      const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {
        nombre: draft.nombre, disciplina: draft.disciplina, ubicacion: draft.ubicacion,
        latitud: latTrim ? latTrim : null, longitud: lngTrim ? lngTrim : null,
        horarios: draft.horarios, whatsapp: draft.whatsapp, instagram: draft.instagram, descripcion: draft.descripcion,
        avatar_url: draft.avatar_url || null, portada_url: draft.portada_url || null,
        galeria: draft.galeria, amenidades: draft.amenidades,
        clabe_bancaria: draft.clabe_bancaria.trim(), rfc: draft.rfc.trim().toUpperCase(),
        ...(isAdmin ? {
          estado: draft.estado, verificado: draft.verificado, csf_validada: draft.csf_validada,
          estrellas_exclusividad: draft.estrellas_exclusividad, strikes_operativos: draft.strikes_operativos,
        } : {}),
      };
      const updated = await updateOwnAffiliateProfileCloud(business.id, patch, isAdmin, {
        currentCsfValidada: Boolean(business.csf_validada),
        currentRfc: business.rfc,
      });
      const keepUrls = new Set([updated.avatar_url || '', updated.portada_url || '', ...(updated.galeria || [])].filter(Boolean));
      const staleUrls = [...replacedMediaRef.current].filter((oldUrl) => !keepUrls.has(oldUrl));
      if (staleUrls.length > 0) void removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectsBatchSafe(staleUrls, actorUserId, isAdmin);
      replacedMediaRef.current.clear();
      if (mountedRef.current && activeBizIdRef.current === business.id) {
        dirtyRef.current = false;
        setDraft(hydrateProfileDraft(updated));
        setFeedback({ type: 'ok', text: tx('Perfil B2B, multimedia y datos SAT actualizados en Cloud.', 'B2B profile, media & SAT data saved to Cloud.') });
      }
      onBusinessUpdated?.(updated);
      await onRefreshWorkspace();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (mountedRef.current) setFeedback({ type: 'err', text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : tx('No se pudo guardar el perfil.', 'Profile save failed.') });
    } finally { busyRef.current = false; if (mountedRef.current) setSaving(false); }
  };

  const inpBg = { backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, color: pal.textPrimary };
  const clabeDigitsLen = draft.clabe_bancaria.replace(/\D/g, '').length;

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 16 }}>
      <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.card3D, s.headerCard, { backgroundColor: pal.cardBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, borderTopColor: pal.purple, borderBottomColor: pal.borderBottom3D }]}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 240 }}>
          <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 19, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Editor Perfil B2B, Storage & SAT', 'B2B Profile, Storage & SAT Editor')}</Text>
          <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>{tx(`Sede activa: ${business.nombre} • RPC b2b_actualizar_perfil_afiliado_propio`, `Active venue: ${business.nombre} • Secured via SQL RPC`)}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { backgroundColor: pal.translucentCyanBg, borderColor: pal.cyanText }]}>
          <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>{`${draft.galeria.length}/4 FOTOS HTTPS`}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {Boolean(feedback) && (
        <View style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.translucentPill, { borderRadius: 12, padding: 12, backgroundColor: feedback?.type === 'ok' ? pal.translucentCyanBg : pal.translucentAmberBg, borderColor: feedback?.type === 'ok' ? pal.cyanText : pal.redText }]}>

              {Boolean(draft.avatar_url) && <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { replacedMediaRef.current.add(draft.avatar_url); updateDraft((p) => ({ ...p, avatar_url: '' })); }} style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D, { borderColor: pal.borderSubtle, backgroundColor: pal.cardBg }]}><Text style={{ color: pal.redText, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>{tx('Quitar', 'Remove')}</Text></TouchableOpacity>}

            <View style={s.wrapRow}>

'VERIFICADO ✓' : 'NO VERIFICADO'}</Text></TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => updateDraft((p) => ({ ...p, csf_validada: !p.csf_validada }))} style={[s.chipBtn, { borderColor: draft.csf_validada ? pal.purple : pal.borderSubtle, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg }]}><Text style={{ color: draft.csf_validada ? pal.purpleText : pal.textMuted, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>{draft.csf_validada ? 'CSF VALIDADA ✓' : 'CSF PENDIENTE'}</Text></TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => updateDraft((p) => ({ ...p, estrellas_exclusividad: (p.estrellas_exclusividad % 5) + 1 }))} style={[s.chipBtn, { borderColor: pal.amberText, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg }]}><Text style={{ color: pal.amberText, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>{`★ ${draft.estrellas_exclusividad}/5`}</Text></TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => updateDraft((p) => ({ ...p, strikes_operativos: (p.strikes_operativos + 1) % 4 }))} style={[s.chipBtn, { borderColor: pal.redText, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg }]}><Text style={{ color: pal.redText, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>{`Strikes: ${draft.strikes_operativos}/3`}</Text></TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
        <TouchableOpacity disabled={saving || Boolean(uploadingSlot) || Boolean(workspaceLoading)} onPress={handleSaveProfile} style={[partnerWebSharedStyles.btnPrimaryCyan, PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, { alignSelf: 'flex-end', opacity: workspaceLoading ? 0.55 : 1 }]}>
          {saving ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#050505" /> : <Text style={{ color: '#050505', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '900' }}>{tx('Guardar Perfil B2B', 'Save B2B Profile')}</Text>}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const s = StyleSheet.create({
  headerCard: { flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 },

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React from 'react';
import { Modal, ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import type { IPartnerWebAffiliateRow, PartnerWebSectionKey } from '../../services/partner-web/partnerWebTypes';
import { PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE, type IPartnerWebPalette, partnerWebSharedStyles } from './partnerWebThemeStyles';

interface NavItemDef {
  key: PartnerWebSectionKey;
  icon: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
  labelEs: string;
  labelEn: string;
  adminOnly?: boolean;
}

const NAV_ITEMS: NavItemDef[] = [
  { key: 'overview', icon: 'bar-chart-2', labelEs: 'Resumen & Analítica', labelEn: 'Overview & Analytics' },
  { key: 'agenda_qr', icon: 'check-square', labelEs: 'Agenda & Recepción QR', labelEn: 'Schedule & QR Desk' },
  { key: 'events_3d', icon: 'layers', labelEs: 'Mis Eventos & Sala 3D', labelEn: 'Events & 3D Studio' },
  { key: 'profile_media', icon: 'image', labelEs: 'Perfil & Multimedia', labelEn: 'Profile & Media' },
  { key: 'finance_spei', icon: 'credit-card', labelEs: 'Finanzas SPEI & SAT', labelEn: 'SPEI Finance & SAT' },
  { key: 'admin_directory', icon: 'globe', labelEs: 'Directorio Global Admin', labelEn: 'Global Admin Directory', adminOnly: true },
];

interface PartnerWebSidebarProps {
  pal: IPartnerWebPalette;
  isDesktop: boolean;
  mobileOpen: boolean;
  onCloseMobile: () => void;
  activeSection: PartnerWebSectionKey;
  onSelectSection: (section: PartnerWebSectionKey) => void;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  activeBusiness: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  userEmail?: string | null;
  onSignOut: () => void;
}

export function PartnerWebSidebar({
  pal,
  isDesktop,
  mobileOpen,
  onCloseMobile,
  activeSection,
  onSelectSection,
  isAdmin,
  activeBusiness,
  userEmail,
  onSignOut,
}: PartnerWebSidebarProps) {
  const { resolvedTheme, setThemeMode, language, setLanguage, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const visibleItems = NAV_ITEMS.filter((item) => !item.adminOnly || isAdmin);

  const railBody = (
    <View
      style={{
        flex: 1,
        backgroundColor: pal.sidebarBg,
        borderRightWidth: 1,
        borderRightColor: pal.borderSubtle,
        padding: 18,
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
      }}
    >
      <View style={{ gap: 18 }}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <View
              style={{
                width: 34,
                height: 34,
                borderRadius: 10,
                backgroundColor: pal.purple,
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <Feather name="activity" size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            </View>
            <View>
              <Text style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.4 }}>
                KINETIC
              </Text>
              <Text style={{ color: pal.cyanText, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '800' }}>
                {isAdmin ? tx('CONSOLA MASTER', 'MASTER CONSOLE') : tx('PARTNER HUB', 'PARTNER HUB')}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          {!isDesktop && (
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={onCloseMobile} style={{ padding: 6 }}>
              <Feather name="x" size={20} color={pal.textSecondary} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
        </View>

        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg,
            borderColor: pal.borderSubtle,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderRadius: 14,
            padding: 12,
            gap: 4,
          }}
        >
          <Text style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700' }}>
            {tx('SEDE EN OPERACIÓN', 'ACTIVE VENUE')}
          </Text>
          <Text numberOfLines={1} style={{ color: pal.textPrimary, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '800' }}>
            {activeBusiness?.nombre || tx('Pendiente de Alta', 'Onboarding Pending')}
          </Text>
          <Text numberOfLines={1} style={{ color: pal.textMuted, fontSize: 12 }}>
            {activeBusiness?.disciplina || activeBusiness?.categoria || userEmail || 'Kinetic B2B'}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 440 }} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}>
          {visibleItems.map((item) => {
            const selected = activeSection === item.key;
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={item.key}
                testID={`partner-nav-${item.key}`}
                onPress={() => {
                  onSelectSection(item.key);
                  if (!isDesktop) onCloseMobile();
                }}
                style={[
                  PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE,
                  {
                    flexDirection: 'row',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 10,
                    paddingVertical: 11,

                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: selected ? (item.adminOnly ? pal.purple : pal.cyanText) : 'transparent',
                    backgroundColor: selected
                      ? item.adminOnly
                        ? pal.translucentPurpleBg
                        : pal.translucentCyanBg
                      : 'transparent',
                    elevation: 0,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Feather
                  name={item.icon}
                  size={17}
                  color={selected ? (item.adminOnly ? pal.purpleText : pal.cyanText) : pal.textMuted}
                />
                <Text
                  style={{
                    color: selected ? pal.textPrimary : pal.textSecondary,
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: selected ? '800' : '600',
                    flex: 1,
                  }}
                >
                  {language === 'en' ? item.labelEn : item.labelEs}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>

      <View style={{ gap: 10, paddingTop: 14, borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: pal.borderSubtle }}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => setLanguage(language === 'es' ? 'en' : 'es')}
            style={[
              partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D,
              PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE,
              { flex: 1, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle },
            ]}
          >
            <Feather name="globe" size={14} color={pal.textSecondary} />
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700' }}>
              {language === 'es' ? 'ES' : 'EN'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => setThemeMode(resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}
            style={[
              partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D,
              PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE,
              { flex: 1, backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle },
            ]}
          >
            <Feather name={resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'sun' : 'moon'} size={14} color={pal.cyanText} />
            <Text style={{ color: pal.textSecondary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700' }}>
              {resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? tx('Claro', 'Light') : tx('Oscuro', 'Dark')}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity
          testID="partner-sidebar-signout"
          onPress={onSignOut}
          style={[
            partnerWebSharedStyles.btnGhost3D,
            PARTNER_NO_SELECT_STYLE,
            { backgroundColor: pal.recessedBg, borderColor: pal.borderSubtle },
          ]}
        >
          <Feather name="log-out" size={15} color={pal.redText} />
          <Text style={{ color: pal.redText, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>
            {tx('Cerrar Sesión', 'Sign Out')}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  if (isDesktop) {
    return <View style={{ width: 276 }}>{railBody}</View>;
  }

  return (
    <Modal visible={mobileOpen} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onCloseMobile}>
      <View style={{ flex: 1, flexDirection: 'row', backgroundColor: 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.72)' }}>
        <View style={{ width: 290, maxWidth: '84%', height: '100%' }}>{railBody}</View>
        <TouchableOpacity style={{ flex: 1 }} activeOpacity={1} onPress={onCloseMobile} />
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

    // === src/components/shared/KineticB2BSelectorsCard.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SORTED_CATEGORIES, isWellnessCategory } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import { KINETIC_OPERATING_DAYS_OPTIONS, KINETIC_OPERATING_HOURS_30M } from '../../constants/kineticEventCatalogs';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { openExternalLinkSafe } from '../../utils/externalLinks';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords } from '../../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';
import {
  AffiliateDisciplinePickerModal,
  AffiliateOperatingHoursModal,
  CUSTOM_WEEKDAYS,
  resolveCanonicalDaysEs,
  resolveShortDaysDisplay,
} from '../admin/AdminAffiliateSubModals';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any) : null;
const B2B_LOCK_KEYS = [
  'mapsBtn3D', 'mapsBtnLight', 'inputWrap3D', 'inputWrapLight',
  'selectorBtn3D', 'selectorBtnLight', 'selectorBtnPurpleLight',
  'medallionCyanDark', 'medallionCyanLight', 'medallionPurpleDark', 'medallionPurpleLight',
];

export const parseOperatingHoursDraft = (rawHorarios?: string | null) => {
  const full = String(rawHorarios || '').trim();
  const igMatch = full.match(/(\s*\|\|\s*ig:@?[^\s|]+|\s*__ig:@?[^\s|]+)/i);
  const igSuffix = igMatch ? igMatch[0] : '';
  const clean = full
    .replace(/(\s*\|\|\s*ig:@?[^\s|]+|\s*__ig:@?[^\s|]+)/gi, '')
    .replace(/\b2[4-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '20:$1')
    .trim();

  const timeMatch = clean.match(/(\d{2}:\d{2})\s*(?:a|to|-|–)\s*(\d{2}:\d{2})/i);
  const openHour = timeMatch && KINETIC_OPERATING_HOURS_30M.includes(timeMatch[1]) ? timeMatch[1] : '06:00';
  const closeHour = timeMatch && KINETIC_OPERATING_HOURS_30M.includes(timeMatch[2]) && timeMatch[2] > openHour ? timeMatch[2] : '21:00';

  const daysPart = clean.split('•')[0]?.trim() || '';
  const lower = daysPart.toLowerCase();
  let daysKey = 'mon_sat';
  let customDaysEs: string[] = ['Lunes', 'Miércoles', 'Viernes'];

  const preset = KINETIC_OPERATING_DAYS_OPTIONS.find(
    (o) => o.key !== 'custom' && (o.es.toLowerCase() === lower || o.en.toLowerCase() === lower)
  );
  if (preset) {
    daysKey = preset.key;
  } else if (lower.includes('lunes a viernes') || lower.includes('monday to friday') || lower.includes('mon–fri') || lower.includes('lun a vie')) {
    daysKey = 'mon_fri';
  } else if (lower.includes('todos') || lower.includes('every day') || lower.includes('daily') || lower.includes('lunes a domingo')) {
    daysKey = 'mon_sun';
  } else if (lower.includes('sábado y domingo') || lower.includes('fin de semana') || lower.includes('sat & sun')) {
    daysKey = 'weekends';
  } else if (daysPart.includes(',')) {
    const matched = CUSTOM_WEEKDAYS.filter((d) => lower.includes(d.es.toLowerCase()) || lower.includes(d.en.toLowerCase())).map((d) => d.es);
    if (matched.length > 0) {
      daysKey = 'custom';
      customDaysEs = matched;
    }
  }

  return { daysKey, customDaysEs, openHour, closeHour, igSuffix };
};

export const openGoogleMapsVenueSearch = (venueName?: string) => {
  triggerHaptic('Light');
  const q = String(venueName || '').trim();
  const url = q
    ? `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`
    : 'https://www.google.com/maps';
  openExternalLinkSafe(url).catch(() => {});
};

const extractReadableCityText = (val?: string | null): string => {
  const clean = String(val || '')
    .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, '')
    .replace(/^[\s•|–—-]+|[\s•|–—-]+$/g, '')
    .trim();
  if (
    !clean ||
    clean === 'Ubicación Verificada' ||
    clean === 'Verified Location' ||
    clean.includes('google.com/maps') ||
    clean.includes('maps.app.goo.gl') ||
    clean.includes('goo.gl/maps')
  ) {
    return '';
  }
  return clean;
};

export const KineticGoogleMapsLinkField = memo(
  ({
    venueName,
    value,
    onChangeValue,
    onDetectedCoords,
    labelEs = 'DIRECCIÓN / ENLACE DE UBICACIÓN',
    labelEn = 'ADDRESS / LOCATION LINK',
  }: {
    venueName?: string;
    value: string;
    onChangeValue: (val: string) => void;
    onDetectedCoords?: (coords: { lat: number | null; lng: number | null }) => void;
    labelEs?: string;
    labelEn?: string;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseB2B, resolvedTheme, B2B_LOCK_KEYS), [resolvedTheme]);
    const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{ lat: number | null; lng: number | null }>({ lat: null, lng: null });
    const lastReadableCityRef = useRef<string>(extractReadableCityText(value));

    const currentReadable = extractReadableCityText(value);
    if (currentReadable) {
      lastReadableCityRef.current = currentReadable;
    }

    const displayVal = value === 'Ubicación Verificada' || value === 'Verified Location' ? '' : value;

    const handleChange = (raw: string) => {
      const parsed = extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords(raw);
      if (parsed.url) {
        const inlineCity = extractReadableCityText(raw);
        const isShortLink = /maps\.app\.goo\.gl|goo\.gl\/maps/i.test(parsed.url);
        const preservedCity = inlineCity || (isShortLink ? lastReadableCityRef.current : parsed.detectedZone || lastReadableCityRef.current);
        const nextVal = preservedCity ? `${preservedCity} • ${parsed.url}` : parsed.cleanValue;
        onChangeValue(nextVal);
        setCoords({ lat: parsed.lat, lng: parsed.lng });
        onDetectedCoords?.({ lat: parsed.lat, lng: parsed.lng });
      } else {
        const typedReadable = extractReadableCityText(raw);
        if (typedReadable) lastReadableCityRef.current = typedReadable;
        onChangeValue(raw);
        if (!raw.trim()) {
          lastReadableCityRef.current = '';
          setCoords({ lat: null, lng: null });
          onDetectedCoords?.({ lat: null, lng: null });
        }
      }
    };

    return (
      <View style={s.fieldGroup}>
        <Text style={[s.label, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{tx(labelEs, labelEn)}</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          style={[s.mapsBtn3D, isLightMode && baseB2B.mapsBtnLight, NO_SEL]}
          onPress={() => openGoogleMapsVenueSearch(venueName)}
        >
          <Text selectable={false} style={[s.mapsBtnTxt, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>
            {tx(
              '📍 Toca aquí para buscar en Google Maps y copiar el enlace',
              '📍 Tap here to search on Google Maps and copy the link'
            )}
          </Text>
          <Feather name="external-link" size={13} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <View style={[s.inputWrap3D, isLightMode && baseB2B.inputWrapLight]}>
          <Feather name="map-pin" size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
          <TextInput
            style={[s.textInput, { fontSize: 16, color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}
            placeholder={tx('Pega aquí el link de Google Maps...', 'Paste the Google Maps link here...')}
            placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
            value={displayVal}
            onChangeText={handleChange}
          />
        </View>
        {coords.lat !== null && coords.lng !== null && (
          <Text style={{ color: themeColors.green, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800', marginTop: 4 }}>
            {tx(
              `✓ Coordenadas GPS detectadas (${coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${coords.lng.toFixed(4)})`,
              `✓ GPS coordinates detected (${coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${coords.lng.toFixed(4)})`
            )}
          </Text>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

export const KineticDisciplineSelectorField = memo(
  ({
    selectedDiscipline,
    onSelectDiscipline,
    labelEs,
    labelEn,
  }: {
    selectedDiscipline: string;
    onSelectDiscipline: (disc: string) => void;
    labelEs?: string;
    labelEn?: string;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, themeColors, tx, tDisc } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseB2B, resolvedTheme, B2B_LOCK_KEYS), [resolvedTheme]);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const activeDisc = selectedDiscipline || 'Fuerza';
    const isWell = isWellnessCategory(activeDisc);
    const lowDisc = activeDisc.toLowerCase();
    const medallionIcon: any = isWell
      ? lowDisc.includes('fisio') || lowDisc.includes('masaje') || lowDisc.includes('rehab')
        ? 'heart'
        : 'sun'
      : lowDisc.includes('cross') || lowDisc.includes('hiit') || lowDisc.includes('box')
        ? 'zap'
        : 'activity';

    return (
      <View style={s.fieldGroup}>
        <Text style={[s.label, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
          {tx(
            labelEs || `DISCIPLINA PRINCIPAL (${SORTED_CATEGORIES.length})`,
            labelEn || `PRIMARY DISCIPLINE (${SORTED_CATEGORIES.length})`
          )}
        </Text>
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          style={[s.selectorBtn3D, isLightMode && baseB2B.selectorBtnLight, NO_SEL]}
          onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setOpen(true); }}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              s.medallionBase,
              isWell
                ? isLightMode ? s.medallionPurpleLight : s.medallionPurpleDark
                : isLightMode ? s.medallionCyanLight : s.medallionCyanDark,
            ]}
          >
            <Feather
              name={medallionIcon}
              size={13}
              color={isWell ? (isLightMode ? '#7C3AED' : '#E0AAFF') : isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : COLORS.cyan}
            />
          </View>
          <Text selectable={false} style={[s.selectorTxt, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {tDisc(activeDisc)}
          </Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color={isWell ? themeColors.purpleText : themeColors.cyanText} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <AffiliateDisciplinePickerModal
          visible={open}
          selectedDiscipline={activeDisc}
          onSelectDiscipline={onSelectDiscipline}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }
);

export const KineticOperatingHoursDualField = memo(
  ({
    horariosValue,
    onChangeHorarios,
    labelEs = 'HORARIOS DE ATENCIÓN',
    labelEn = 'OPERATING HOURS',
  }: {
    horariosValue?: string;
    onChangeHorarios: (nextCanonicalHorarios: string) => void;
    labelEs?: string;
    labelEn?: string;
  }) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, isLightMode, language, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const s = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseB2B, resolvedTheme, B2B_LOCK_KEYS), [resolvedTheme]);
    const isEn = language === 'en';
    const initial = useMemo(() => parseOperatingHoursDraft(horariosValue), [horariosValue]);

    const [daysKey, setDaysKey] = useState(initial.daysKey);
    const [customDaysEs, setCustomDaysEs] = useState<string[]>(initial.customDaysEs);
    const [openHour, setOpenHour] = useState(initial.openHour);
    const [closeHour, setCloseHour] = useState(initial.closeHour);
    const [modalMode, setModalMode] = useState<'days' | 'hours' | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      const parsed = parseOperatingHoursDraft(horariosValue);
      setDaysKey(parsed.daysKey);
      setCustomDaysEs(parsed.customDaysEs);
      setOpenHour(parsed.openHour);
      setCloseHour(parsed.closeHour);
    }, [horariosValue]);

    const emitSchedule = (dKey: string, cDays: string[], oH: string, cH: string) => {
      const canonical = `${resolveCanonicalDaysEs(dKey, cDays)} • ${oH} a ${cH}${initial.igSuffix}`;
      onChangeHorarios(canonical);
    };

    return (
      <View style={s.fieldGroup}>
        <Text style={[s.label, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{tx(labelEs, labelEn)}</Text>
        <View style={s.dualRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[s.selectorBtn3D, { flex: 1.12 }, isLightMode && baseB2B.selectorBtnLight, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setModalMode('days'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="calendar" size={13} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            <Text selectable={false} style={[s.selectorTxt, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {resolveShortDaysDisplay(daysKey, customDaysEs, isEn)}
            </Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={[s.selectorBtn3D, { flex: 0.96 }, isLightMode && baseB2B.selectorBtnPurpleLight, NO_SEL]}
            onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); setModalMode('hours'); }}
          >
            <Feather name="clock" size={13} color={themeColors.purpleText} />
            <Text selectable={false} style={[s.selectorTxt, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {`${openHour} ${isEn ? 'to' : 'a'} ${closeHour}`}
            </Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color={themeColors.purpleText} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
        <AffiliateOperatingHoursModal
          mode={modalMode}
          selectedDaysKey={daysKey}
          customDaysEs={customDaysEs}
          openHour={openHour}
          closeHour={closeHour}
          onApplyDays={(nextKey, nextCustom) => {
            setDaysKey(nextKey);
            setCustomDaysEs(nextCustom);
            emitSchedule(nextKey, nextCustom, openHour, closeHour);
          }}
          onApplyHours={(nextOpen, nextClose) => {
            setOpenHour(nextOpen);
            setCloseHour(nextClose);
            emitSchedule(daysKey, customDaysEs, nextOpen, nextClose);
          }}
          onClose={() => setModalMode(null)}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }
);

const baseB2B = StyleSheet.create({
  fieldGroup: { marginBottom: 10 },
  label: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 1.1, marginBottom: 6, textTransform: 'uppercase' },
  mapsBtn3D: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.1)', borderRadius: 12, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 10, marginBottom: 8, borderWidth: 1.2, borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45)', borderTopWidth: 1.8, borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomWidth: 4.4, borderBottomColor: '#006B78', shadowColor: COLORS.cyan, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 3 }, shadowOpacity: 0.25, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 0 },
  mapsBtnLight: { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#06B6D4', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#00B8D4', shadowColor: '#00B8D4', shadowOpacity: 0.2, elevation: 0 },

import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AppState, type AppStateStatus, Modal, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { isBiometricPreferenceEnabledAsync, runBiometricHardwarePromptAsync, subscribeBiometricPreferenceChanges, wasInteractiveLoginVerifiedThisBoot } from '../../services/kineticBiometricVaultService';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut, isOidcReturnTransitionActive } from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { evaluateBiometricAppGateState, isTransientNativeOverlayActive } from '../../utils/kineticBiometricGateMachineLeaf';
import { KineticLoader, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

export const KineticBiometricAppGate = memo(() => {
  const { user, profile, signOut } = useAuth();
  const { tx, themeColors } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isLight = Boolean(themeColors.isLight);
  const [bioEnabled, setBioEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [isLocked, setIsLocked] = useState(false);
  const [isPrompting, setIsPrompting] = useState(false);
  const bgEnteredAtRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const coldBootPendingRef = useRef(true);
  const promptingRef = useRef(false);
  const bioEnabledRef = useRef(false);
  const hasSessionRef = useRef(false);
  const appStateRef = useRef<AppStateStatus>(AppState.currentState);
  const hasActiveSession = Boolean(user?.id) && !isExplicitKineticSignOut();
  hasSessionRef.current = hasActiveSession;

  const triggerUnlockPrompt = useCallback(async () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || promptingRef.current || !hasSessionRef.current) return;
    promptingRef.current = true;
    setIsPrompting(true);
    try {
      const ok = await runBiometricHardwarePromptAsync(tx('Desbloquear KINETIC', 'Unlock KINETIC'), tx('Usar PIN del dispositivo', 'Use device passcode'), tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel'));
      if (ok) {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        bgEnteredAtRef.current = null;
        coldBootPendingRef.current = false;
        setIsLocked(false);
      }
    } finally { promptingRef.current = false; setIsPrompting(false); }
  }, [tx]);

  const evaluateLockState = useCallback((enabledFlag: boolean) => {
    const decision = evaluateBiometricAppGateState({
      platformOs: Platform.OS,
      hasActiveSession: hasSessionRef.current,
      isBiometricLockEnabled: enabledFlag,
      isColdBootPending: coldBootPendingRef.current,
      backgroundEnteredAtMs: bgEnteredAtRef.current,
      nowMs: Date.now(),
      isTransientOverlayActive: isTransientNativeOverlayActive(),
      isOidcTransitionActive: isOidcReturnTransitionActive(),
      wasInteractiveLoginVerified: wasInteractiveLoginVerifiedThisBoot(),
    });
    if (decision.clearColdBootPending) coldBootPendingRef.current = false;
    if (decision.shouldLock) { setIsLocked(true); void triggerUnlockPrompt(); }
    else if (!hasSessionRef.current || !enabledFlag) setIsLocked(false);
  }, [triggerUnlockPrompt]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
    if (!hasActiveSession) {
      setIsLocked(false); bgEnteredAtRef.current = null; coldBootPendingRef.current = true;
      return;
    }
    let alive = true;
    const syncPref = () => {
      void isBiometricPreferenceEnabledAsync(profile?.biometria_activa ?? null).then((enabled) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        bioEnabledRef.current = enabled; setBioEnabled(enabled); evaluateLockState(enabled);
      });
    };
    syncPref();
    const unsubPref = subscribeBiometricPreferenceChanges(syncPref);
    return () => { alive = false; unsubPref(); };
  }, [hasActiveSession, profile?.biometria_activa, evaluateLockState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
    const sub = AppState.addEventListener('change', (nextState) => {
      const prevState = appStateRef.current;
      appStateRef.current = nextState;
      if (nextState === 'background' || nextState === 'inactive') {
        if (bgEnteredAtRef.current === null && !isTransientNativeOverlayActive() && !isOidcReturnTransitionActive()) bgEnteredAtRef.current = Date.now();
        return;
      }
      if (nextState === 'active' && prevState !== 'active') { evaluateLockState(bioEnabledRef.current); bgEnteredAtRef.current = null; }
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, [evaluateLockState]);

  if (Platform.OS === 'web' || !isLocked || !bioEnabled || !hasActiveSession) return null;

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent={false} animationType="none" statusBarTranslucent onRequestClose={() => { void 0; }}>
      <View style={[st.backdrop, { backgroundColor: isLight ? '#ECF1F8' : '#05070C' }]}>
        <View style={[st.card, isLight && st.cardLight]}>
          <View style={[st.emblem, isLight && st.emblemLight]}><Ionicons name="finger-print" size={34} color={isLight ? '#0284C7' : COLORS.cyan} /></View>
          <Text style={[st.title, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{tx('BÓVEDA PROTEGIDA KINETIC', 'KINETIC PROTECTED VAULT')}</Text>
          <Text style={[st.sub, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>{tx('Confirma tu Face ID o Huella Biométrica para acceder a tus pases QR y saldos.', 'Verify Face ID or Fingerprint to unlock your QR passes and balances.')}</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={st.unlockBtn} activeOpacity={0.86} disabled={isPrompting} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); void triggerUnlockPrompt(); }}>
            {isPrompting ? <KineticLoader size={18} color="#050505" /> : (<><Feather name="unlock" size={16} color="#050505" /><Text style={st.unlockTxt}>{tx('DESBLOQUEAR CON BIOMETRÍA', 'UNLOCK WITH BIOMETRICS')}</Text></>)}
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity style={[st.logoutBtn, isLight && st.logoutBtnLight]} activeOpacity={0.84} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Warning'); setIsLocked(false); void signOut(); }}>
            <Feather name="log-out" size={14} color={isLight ? '#B91C1C' : '#FCA5A5'} />
            <Text style={[st.logoutTxt, { color: isLight ? '#B91C1C' : '#FCA5A5' }]}>{tx('Cerrar Sesión', 'Sign Out')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
});

const st = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: { flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24 },
  card: { width: '100%', maxWidth: 360, borderRadius: 24, padding: 24, alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, backgroundColor: '#0A0F1A', borderWidth: 1.4, borderColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4)', borderTopWidth: 2, borderTopColor: 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.5)', borderBottomWidth: 5, borderBottomColor: '#004E5C' },
  cardLight: { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#38BDF8', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7' },
  emblem: { width: 68, height: 68, borderRadius: 34, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.1)', borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: COLORS.cyan, elevation: 0 },
  emblemLight: { backgroundColor: '#ECFEFF', borderColor: '#0284C7' },
  title: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '900', textAlign: 'center', letterSpacing: 0.6 },
  sub: { fontSize: 12.5, lineHeight: 18, textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 4 },
  unlockBtn: { width: '100%', minHeight: 48, borderRadius: 14, backgroundColor: COLORS.cyan, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8, paddingHorizontal: 14, borderWidth: 1.2, borderColor: '#B8FFFF', borderBottomWidth: 4.4, borderBottomColor: '#008B99' },
  unlockTxt: { color: '#050505', fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: 0.5 },
  logoutBtn: { width: '100%', minHeight: 42, borderRadius: 12, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 7, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: 'rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.35)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.14)', elevation: 0 },
  logoutBtnLight: { borderColor: '#CBD5E1', backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC' },
  logoutTxt: { fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: '800' },
});

import React, { memo, useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { GestureResponderEvent, LayoutChangeEvent, Platform, StyleProp, StyleSheet, View, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { computeDeepZParallaxLayers } from '../../services/kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';

export interface IKineticDeepParallaxCard3DProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  accentColor?: string;
  secondaryColor?: string;
  maxOffsetPx?: number;
  isLightMode?: boolean;
}

export const KineticDeepParallaxCard3D = memo(({
  children,
  style,
  accentColor = '#00F0FF',
  secondaryColor = '#9D4EDD',
  maxOffsetPx = 6,
  isLightMode = false,
}: IKineticDeepParallaxCard3DProps) => {
  const [tilt, setTilt] = useState<{ x: number; y: number }>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const sizeRef = useRef<{ w: number; h: number }>({ w: 320, h: 160 });

  const handleLayout = useCallback((e: LayoutChangeEvent) => {
    const { width, height } = e.nativeEvent.layout;
    if (width > 10 && height > 10) {
      sizeRef.current = { w: width, h: height };
    }
  }, []);

  const updateTiltFromLocalPoint = useCallback((locX: number, locY: number) => {
    const { w, h } = sizeRef.current;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(locX) || !Number.isFinite(locY)) return;
    const nx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (locX / w) * 2 - 1));
    const ny = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (locY / h) * 2 - 1));
    setTilt({ x: nx, y: ny });
  }, []);

  const handleTouchStartOrMove = useCallback((e: GestureResponderEvent) => {
    const ne = e.nativeEvent;
    if (typeof ne?.locationX === 'number' && typeof ne?.locationY === 'number') {
      updateTiltFromLocalPoint(ne.locationX, ne.locationY);
    }
  }, [updateTiltFromLocalPoint]);

  const resetTilt = useCallback(() => {
    setTilt({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  }, []);

  const layers = useMemo(
    () => computeDeepZParallaxLayers({ tiltX: tilt.x, tiltY: tilt.y, maxOffsetPx }),
    [tilt.x, tilt.y, maxOffsetPx]
  );

  const webMouseHandlers = Platform.OS === 'web'
    ? ({
        onMouseMove: (ev: { clientX: number; clientY: number; currentTarget?: { getBoundingClientRect?: () => { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number } } }) => {
          const rect = ev?.currentTarget?.getBoundingClientRect?.();
          if (rect && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
            updateTiltFromLocalPoint(ev.clientX - rect.left, ev.clientY - rect.top);
          }
        },
        onMouseLeave: resetTilt,
      } as Record<string, unknown>)
    : {};

  return (
    <View
      onLayout={handleLayout}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStartOrMove}
      onTouchMove={handleTouchStartOrMove}
      onTouchEnd={resetTilt}
      onTouchCancel={resetTilt}
      {...webMouseHandlers}
      style={[
        dpStyles.cardShell,
        isLightMode ? dpStyles.shellLight : dpStyles.shellDark,
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {/* Capa Z profunda (halo ambiental contenido dentro del borde sin rebalsar) */}
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          dpStyles.deepHaloOrb,
          {
            backgroundColor: accentColor,
            opacity: isLightMode ? 0.11 : 0.16,
            transform: [{ translateX: layers.bgShiftX }, { translateY: layers.bgShiftY }],
          },
        ]}
      />
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          dpStyles.deepHaloOrbSecondary,
          {
            backgroundColor: secondaryColor,
            opacity: isLightMode ? 0.09 : 0.14,
            transform: [{ translateX: layers.midShiftX }, { translateY: layers.midShiftY }],
          },
        ]}
      />

      {/* Bisel especular reactivo en Z superficial */}
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          dpStyles.specularEdgeHighlight,
          {
            left: `${Math.max(6, Math.min(62, layers.specularShiftPct - 18))}%`,
            backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)' : 'rgba(184, 255, 255, 0.55)',
          },
        ]}
      />

      <View
        style={{
          transform: [
            { translateX: Number((layers.fgShiftX * 0.25).toFixed(2)) },
            { translateY: Number((layers.fgShiftY * 0.25).toFixed(2)) },
          ],
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
});

const dpStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  cardShell: {
    position: 'relative',
    overflow: 'hidden',
    elevation: 0,
  },
  shellDark: {
    borderRadius: 22,
  },
  shellLight: {
    borderRadius: 22,
  },
  deepHaloOrb: {
    position: 'absolute',
    width: 150,
    height: 150,
    borderRadius: 75,
    top: -54,
    right: -28,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  deepHaloOrbSecondary: {
    position: 'absolute',
    width: 120,
    height: 120,
    borderRadius: 60,
    bottom: -48,
    left: -24,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  specularEdgeHighlight: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    width: '36%',
    height: 2,
    borderRadius: 2,
    elevation: 0,
  },
});

import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Easing, Platform, Share, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { claimDailyShareProgressBonusCloud, claimSteelContract4x4Cloud, mergeClaimKeys } from '../../hooks/kineticlub/kineticClubRewardsCloudHelper';
import { type KineticAuthProfile, type KineticAuthUser } from '../../services/kineticAuthContextHelpers';
import { type IGamificationReservaRow, evaluateSteelContract4x4Truth } from '../../services/kineticGamificationSqlTruthLeaf';
import { computeSplitEscrow1NMath } from '../../services/kineticSplitPreBookingStore';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { openExternalLinkSafe } from '../../utils/externalLinks';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { GpuProgressBar, triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { SplitEscrowInviteModal } from '../eventos/SplitEscrowInviteModal';
import { baseDisruptiveWidgetStyles as baseDw } from './KineticDisruptiveWidgets.styles';

let _shareActionLocked = false;

const tryWebNativeShare = async (title: string, text: string, url?: string): Promise<'shared' | 'aborted' | 'fallback'> => {
  const nav = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator : null;
  if (!nav || typeof nav.share !== 'function') return 'fallback';
  try {
    await nav.share({ title, text, ...(url ? { url } : {}) });
    return 'shared';
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const errName = err && typeof err === 'object' ? String((err as { name?: unknown }).name || '') : '';
    return errName === 'AbortError' || errName === 'InvalidStateError' ? 'aborted' : 'fallback';
  }
};

const runPlatformShareFlow = async (title: string, message: string, url?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const nav = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator : null;
    const cleanText = url ? message.replace(url, '').trim() : message;
    const nativeOutcome = await tryWebNativeShare(title, cleanText, url);
    if (nativeOutcome !== 'fallback') return nativeOutcome === 'shared';
    try { if (nav?.clipboard?.writeText) await nav.clipboard.writeText(message); } catch (e: unknown) { void e; }
    await openExternalLinkSafe(`https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`);
    return true;
  }
  try {
    const res = await Share.share({ title, message, ...(Platform.OS === 'ios' && url ? { url } : {}) });
    return res?.action === Share.sharedAction;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return false;
  }
};

const executeConfirmedShareAction = async (title: string, message: string, url?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (_shareActionLocked) return false;
  _shareActionLocked = true;
  try {
    return await runPlatformShareFlow(title, message, url);
  } finally {
    _shareActionLocked = false;
  }
};

export interface IWeeklySteelContractCardProps {
  userId?: string;
  completedSessionsCount?: number;
  userReservas?: IGamificationReservaRow[];
}

export const WeeklySteelContractCard = memo(({ userId, userReservas }: IWeeklySteelContractCardProps) => {
  const { user, profile, activateResilientSession, refreshProfile } = useAuth();
  const { resolvedTheme, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const dw = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseDw, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
  const effectiveUserId = String(userId || user?.id || 'guest').trim();
  const storageKey = `@kinetic_steel_contract_v25_${effectiveUserId}`;
  const claimedKeys = useMemo(() => (Array.isArray(profile?.recompensas_reclamadas) ? profile.recompensas_reclamadas.map(String) : []), [profile?.recompensas_reclamadas]);
  const steelEval = useMemo(() => evaluateSteelContract4x4Truth(userReservas || [], claimedKeys), [userReservas, claimedKeys]);
  const [contractState, setContractState] = useState<{ active: boolean; isLoaded: boolean; isClaiming: boolean }>({ active: false, isLoaded: false, isClaiming: false });
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const claimingRef = useRef(false);

    useEffect(() => {
      mountedRef.current = true;
      return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
      let mounted = true;
      AsyncStorage.getItem(storageKey)
        .then((raw) => {
          if (!mounted) return;
          let active = steelEval.claimedThisWeek;
          if (!active && raw) {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { weekKey?: string; active?: boolean } | null;
              if (parsed && parsed.weekKey === steelEval.weekKey && parsed.active) active = true;
            } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
          }
          setContractState({ active, isLoaded: true, isClaiming: false });
        })
        .catch(() => { if (mounted) setContractState((p) => ({ ...p, isLoaded: true })); });
      return () => { mounted = false; };
    }, [storageKey, steelEval.weekKey, steelEval.claimedThisWeek]);

    const weeklyCompleted = Math.min(4, steelEval.completedWeekSessions);
    const isCompleted = steelEval.claimedThisWeek;
    const canClaimNow = steelEval.eligibleToClaim;
    const isActive = contractState.active || isCompleted || canClaimNow;

    const handleContractPress = useCallback(async () => {
      if (isCompleted || contractState.isClaiming || claimingRef.current) {
        triggerArcadeHaptic(isCompleted ? 'levelUp' : 'shield');
        return;
      }
      if (canClaimNow && effectiveUserId && effectiveUserId !== 'guest') {
        claimingRef.current = true;
        setContractState((p) => ({ ...p, isClaiming: true }));
        let claimedOk = false;
        try {
          const res = await claimSteelContract4x4Cloud(effectiveUserId, steelEval.weekKey);
          if (res.ok) {
            claimedOk = true;
            triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
            if (mountedRef.current && user && profile) {
              activateResilientSession(user as unknown as KineticAuthUser, {
                ...profile,
                xp_total: res.xpTotal ?? ((Number(profile.xp_total) || 0) + res.xpGranted),
                recompensas_reclamadas: mergeClaimKeys(profile.recompensas_reclamadas, res.claimedKeys || [steelEval.weekKey]),
              } as unknown as KineticAuthProfile);
            }
            await refreshProfile?.();
          } else {
            triggerHaptic('Warning');
          }
        } finally {
          claimingRef.current = false;
          if (mountedRef.current) setContractState((p) => ({ ...p, active: claimedOk ? true : p.active, isClaiming: false }));
        }
        return;
      }
      if (!contractState.active) {
        setContractState((p) => ({ ...p, active: true }));
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        AsyncStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({ active: true, weekKey: steelEval.weekKey })).catch((e: unknown) => { void e; });
      } else {
        triggerArcadeHaptic('shield');
      }
    }, [isCompleted, contractState.isClaiming, contractState.active, canClaimNow, effectiveUserId, steelEval.weekKey, user, profile, activateResilientSession, refreshProfile, storageKey]);

    return (
      <View style={[dw.steelCard, isActive && dw.steelCardActive, isCompleted && dw.steelCardCompleted]}>
        <Text style={dw.steelTitle}>{tx('🛡️ CONTRATO DE ACERO SEMANAL (4 SESIONES QR = +150 XP BONUS)', '🛡️ WEEKLY STEEL CONTRACT (4 QR SESSIONS = +150 XP BONUS)')}</Text>
        <Text style={dw.steelDesc}>
          {tx('Compromiso de Acero: completa 4 check-ins QR verificados en la semana vigente para reclamar +150 XP reales.', 'Steel Commitment: complete 4 verified QR check-ins this week to claim +150 real XP.')}
        </Text>
        <View style={dw.steelProgressMetaRow}>
          <Text style={dw.steelProgressLabel}>{weeklyCompleted} / 4 {tx('sesiones completadas', 'sessions completed')}</Text>
          <Text style={[dw.steelMultiplierBadge, (isCompleted || canClaimNow) && { color: themeColors.green }]}>
            {isCompleted ? '🏆 +150 XP ACREDITADOS' : canClaimNow ? '🎁 LISTO +150 XP' : isActive ? tx('⚡ CONTRATO ACTIVO', '⚡ CONTRACT ACTIVE') : tx('LUN–DOM', 'MON–SUN')}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <GpuProgressBar progress={steelEval.progressPct} color={isCompleted || canClaimNow ? COLORS.green : COLORS.cyan} height={8} />
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity
          testID="steel-contract-action-btn"
          style={[dw.steelActivateBtn, isActive && dw.steelActivateBtnSigned, (isCompleted || canClaimNow) && dw.steelActivateBtnCompleted]}
          disabled={!contractState.isLoaded || contractState.isClaiming} activeOpacity={0.86} onPress={handleContractPress}
        >
          <Ionicons name={isCompleted ? 'trophy' : canClaimNow ? 'gift' : isActive ? 'shield-checkmark' : 'flash'} size={15} color={isActive && !canClaimNow ? (isCompleted ? themeColors.green : themeColors.cyanText) : '#050505'} />
          <Text style={[dw.steelActivateBtnTxt, isActive && !canClaimNow && { color: isCompleted ? themeColors.green : themeColors.cyanText }]}>
            {isCompleted
              ? tx('CONTRATO DE ACERO CUMPLIDO (+150 XP) ✓', 'STEEL CONTRACT COMPLETED (+150 XP) ✓')
              : canClaimNow
                ? tx('RECLAMAR CONTRATO 4/4 (+150 XP) ›', 'CLAIM 4/4 CONTRACT (+150 XP) ›')
                : isActive
                  ? tx(`EN PROGRESO (${weeklyCompleted}/4) • 150 XP EN JUEGO ✓`, `IN PROGRESS (${weeklyCompleted}/4) • 150 XP AT STAKE ✓`)
                  : tx('ACTIVAR COMPROMISO DE ACERO (+150 XP)', 'ACTIVATE STEEL CONTRACT (+150 XP)')}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

export interface IAutoPopReservationItem {
  id?: string; servicio?: string | null; titulo?: string; negocio_nombre?: string | null; club_nombre?: string;
  fecha_clase?: string; fecha?: string; fecha_hora?: string; hora?: string; hora_inicio?: string;
  servicios?: { titulo?: string; fecha?: string; hora_inicio?: string; clubs?: { nombre?: string } | null; afiliados?: { negocio_nombre?: string; nombre?: string } | null } | null;
  afiliados?: { negocio_nombre?: string; nombre?: string } | null;
}

const getHoyLocalYmdWidget = (): string => {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

const isPassWithin45MinToday = (res: IAutoPopReservationItem | null | undefined): boolean => {
  if (!res) return false;
  const rawFecha = String(res?.fecha_clase || res?.servicios?.fecha || res?.fecha || res?.fecha_hora || '').trim();
  const ymdMatch = rawFecha.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);
  const fechaClase = ymdMatch ? ymdMatch[1] : '';
  if (!fechaClase || fechaClase !== getHoyLocalYmdWidget()) return false;
  const rawHora = String(
    res?.hora || res?.hora_inicio || res?.servicios?.hora_inicio || (rawFecha.includes('T') ? rawFecha.split('T')[1] : '') || ''
  ).trim();
  const hmMatch = rawHora.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!hmMatch) return false;
  const hh = Number(hmMatch[1]);
  const mm = Number(hmMatch[2]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return false;
  const now = new Date();
  const diff = hh * 60 + mm - (now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes());
  return diff >= 0 && diff <= 45;
};

export interface IAutoPopReceptionQrBannerProps {
  primaryReservation: IAutoPopReservationItem | null | undefined;
  reservations?: IAutoPopReservationItem[];
  activeCount: number;
  onInstantOpenQr: (reserva: IAutoPopReservationItem) => void;
}

export const AutoPopReceptionQrBanner = memo(
  ({ primaryReservation, reservations, activeCount, onInstantOpenQr }: IAutoPopReceptionQrBannerProps) => {
    const { resolvedTheme, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const dw = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseDw, resolvedTheme), [resolvedTheme]);
    const pulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const readyReservation = useMemo(() => {
      const candidates = Array.isArray(reservations) && reservations.length > 0
        ? reservations
        : primaryReservation ? [primaryReservation] : [];
      return candidates.find(isPassWithin45MinToday) || null;
    }, [reservations, primaryReservation]);
    const hasReservation = Boolean(readyReservation);

    useEffect(() => {
      pulseAnim.setValue(0);
      if (!hasReservation) return;
      const loop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
            toValue: 1,
            duration: 900,
            easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
            useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
          }),
          Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
            toValue: 0,
            duration: 900,
            easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
            useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
          }),
        ])
      );
      loop.start();
      return () => loop.stop();
    }, [pulseAnim, hasReservation]);

    if (!readyReservation) return null;

    const scale = pulseAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [1, 1.016] });
    const dotOpacity = pulseAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.45, 1] });
    const serviceTitle = readyReservation?.servicio || tx('Sesión Kinetic', 'Kinetic Session');
    const clubTitle = readyReservation?.negocio_nombre || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official');
    const horaLabel = String(readyReservation?.hora || readyReservation?.hora_inicio || readyReservation?.servicios?.hora_inicio || '08:00').substring(0, 5);

    return (
      <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale }], marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[
            dw.autoPopBanner,
            resolvedTheme === 'light' && {
              backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#E2E8F0', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
              borderBottomColor: '#CBD5E1', shadowColor: '#0F172A', shadowOpacity: 0.06,
            },
          ]}
          activeOpacity={0.86}
          onPress={() => { triggerArcadeHaptic('checkIn'); onInstantOpenQr(readyReservation); }}
        >
          <View style={dw.autoPopLeft}>
            <View style={dw.autoPopMicroRow}>
              <Animated.View style={[dw.autoPopLiveDot, { opacity: dotOpacity }]} />
              <Text style={[dw.autoPopMicroLabel, resolvedTheme === 'light' && { color: '#047857' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                {tx('⚡ PASE LISTO PARA RECEPCIÓN (AUTO-POP QR • 60S)', '⚡ PASS READY FOR RECEPTION (AUTO-POP QR • 60S)')}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={[dw.autoPopTitle, resolvedTheme === 'light' && { color: '#0F172A' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {serviceTitle} • {horaLabel} hrs
            </Text>
              <Text style={[dw.autoPopSub, resolvedTheme === 'light' && { color: '#475569' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                📍 {clubTitle}
                {activeCount > 1
                  ? tx(` (+${activeCount - 1} pase adicional)`, ` (+${activeCount - 1} extra pass)`)
                  : tx(' • Abre tu pase dinámico en 1 toque', ' • Open your dynamic pass in 1 tap')}
              </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={dw.autoPopRightCta}>
            <Ionicons name="qr-code" size={16} color="#050505" />
            <Text numberOfLines={1} style={dw.autoPopRightCtaTxt}>{tx('ABRIR QR ›', 'OPEN QR ›')}</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </Animated.View>
    );
  }
);

export const shareAthleteProgressSummary = async (
  params: IShareRpgDossierButtonProps & { language: 'es' | 'en'; tx: (es: string, en: string) => string }
): Promise<IShareAthleteResult> => {
  const { athleteUserId, athleteName, referralCode, prestigeGradeRoman, prestigeLevel, prestigeRankTitle, rachaDias, ovr, fuerza, cardio, agilidad, zen, language, tx } = params;
  triggerHaptic('Success');
  triggerArcadeHaptic('reward');
  const safeName = athleteName || tx('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  const cleanCode = String(referralCode || 'KNT-ELITE').trim().toUpperCase();

  const streakDays = Math.max(0, Number(rachaDias) || 0);
  const prestigeNum = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(prestigeGradeRoman) || 0));
  const prestigeLineEn = prestigeNum > 0
    ? `★ Prestige ${prestigeNum} • Level ${prestigeLevel}/99 (${prestigeRankTitle})`
    : `★ Level ${prestigeLevel}/99 (${prestigeRankTitle})`;
  const prestigeLineEs = prestigeNum > 0
    ? `★ Prestigio ${prestigeNum} • Nivel ${prestigeLevel}/99 (${prestigeRankTitle})`
    : `★ Nivel ${prestigeLevel}/99 (${prestigeRankTitle})`;
  const message = language === 'en'
    ? `⚡ SPORTS PROFILE — ${safeName.toUpperCase()} (KINETIC)\n\n${prestigeLineEn}\n🔥 Active Streak: ${streakDays} ${streakDays === 1 ? 'Day' : 'Days'} | Score: ${ovr}/99\n\n📊 PERFORMANCE PILLARS:\n• 💪 Strength: ${fuerza}/99\n• ⚡ Cardio: ${cardio}/99\n• 🎯 Agility: ${agilidad}/99\n• 🧘 Zen: ${zen}/99\n\n🎁 Use my referral code *${cleanCode}* on Kinetic and we both earn *+100 KC (Rollover)* + *50 XP*:\n${refUrl}`
    : `⚡ PERFIL DEPORTIVO — ${safeName.toUpperCase()} (KINETIC)\n\n${prestigeLineEs}\n🔥 Racha Activa: ${streakDays} ${streakDays === 1 ? 'Día' : 'Días'} | Índice Global: ${ovr}/99\n\n📊 PILARES DE RENDIMIENTO:\n• 💪 Fuerza: ${fuerza}/99\n• ⚡ Cardio: ${cardio}/99\n• 🎯 Agilidad: ${agilidad}/99\n• 🧘 Zen: ${zen}/99\n\n🎁 Usa mi código de referido *${cleanCode}* al unirte a Kinetic y ambos ganamos *+100 KC (Rollover)* + *50 XP*:\n${refUrl}`;
  const shared = await executeConfirmedShareAction(tx(`Perfil Deportivo Kinetic — ${safeName}`, `Kinetic Sports Profile — ${safeName}`), message, refUrl);
  if (!shared || !athleteUserId) return { shared, xpGranted: 0 };
  const claimRes = await claimDailyShareProgressBonusCloud(athleteUserId);
  return { shared: true, xpGranted: claimRes.xpGranted, xpTotal: claimRes.xpTotal, claimedKeys: claimRes.claimedKeys };
};

export const ShareRpgDossierButton = memo(

);

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Platform, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import ReactNativeModal from 'react-native-modal';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { useRegisterOverlayLayer } from '../../services/navigation/kineticOverlayStack';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KineticLoader, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

export type KineticDualConfirmTone = 'cyan' | 'purple' | 'danger' | 'amber';

export interface KineticDualConfirmModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  tone?: KineticDualConfirmTone;
  loading?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const stripYesPrefix = (rawLabel: string): string => {
  const clean = String(rawLabel || '').trim();
  const stripped = clean.replace(/^(?:S[IÍ]|YES)\s*,\s*/i, '').trim();
  return stripped || clean;
};

const getTonePalette = (tone: KineticDualConfirmTone, isLight: boolean) => {
  if (tone === 'danger') {
    return {
      icon: 'alert-octagon' as const, accent: isLight ? '#DC2626' : '#FF4D4F', border: isLight ? '#FCA5A5' : '#FF3B30',
      topLip: isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : '#FFA3A3', bottomLip: isLight ? '#DC2626' : '#7F0000', btnBg: isLight ? '#DC2626' : '#EF4444', btnText: '#FFFFFF',
    };
  }
  if (tone === 'amber') {
    return {
      icon: 'alert-triangle' as const, accent: isLight ? '#B45309' : COLORS.yellow, border: isLight ? '#FCD34D' : COLORS.yellow,
      topLip: '#FEF08A', bottomLip: '#92400E', btnBg: isLight ? '#D97706' : '#F59E0B', btnText: '#050505',
    };
  }
  if (tone === 'purple') {
    return {
      icon: 'zap' as const, accent: isLight ? '#6D28D9' : '#D8B4FE', border: isLight ? '#C4B5FD' : COLORS.purple,
      topLip: '#E9D5FF', bottomLip: '#5B21B6', btnBg: isLight ? '#7C3AED' : '#9D4EDD', btnText: '#FFFFFF',
    };
  }
  return {
    icon: 'shield' as const, accent: isLight ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan, border: isLight ? '#38BDF8' : COLORS.cyan,
    topLip: '#B8FFFF', bottomLip: '#006B78', btnBg: isLight ? '#0284C7' : COLORS.cyan, btnText: isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : '#050505',
  };
};

const DARK_INK = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } as Record<string, unknown>) : {};

export const KineticDualConfirmModal = memo(
  ({ visible, title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, tone = 'cyan', loading = false, onConfirm, onCancel }: KineticDualConfirmModalProps) => {
    const { isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    useRegisterOverlayLayer('dual-confirm-modal', Boolean(visible), onCancel);
    const palette = getTonePalette(tone, isLightMode);
    const resolvedCancel = cancelLabel || tx('Cancelar', 'Cancel');
    const resolvedConfirm = stripYesPrefix(confirmLabel || tx('Confirmar', 'Confirm'));

    return (
      <ReactNativeModal
        isVisible={Boolean(visible)} onBackdropPress={onCancel} onBackButtonPress={onCancel}
        animationIn="fadeIn" animationOut="fadeOut" animationInTiming={160} animationOutTiming={140}
        backdropColor={isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#050505'} backdropOpacity={isLightMode ? 0.56 : 0.88}
        backdropTransitionInTiming={0} backdropTransitionOutTiming={0} hideModalContentWhileAnimating={false}
        useNativeDriver={Platform.OS !== 'web'} useNativeDriverForBackdrop={Platform.OS !== 'web'}
        style={{ margin: 0, padding: 20, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}
      >
        <View style={[st.card, { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : '#090D16', borderColor: palette.border, borderTopColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : palette.topLip, borderBottomColor: palette.bottomLip }]}>
          <View style={st.headerRow}>
            <View style={[st.iconBadge, { borderColor: palette.border, backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F8FAFC' : '#111827' }]}>
              <Feather name={palette.icon} size={17} color={palette.accent} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[st.title, { color: palette.accent }]} numberOfLines={2}>{title}</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
              accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel={tx('Cerrar confirmación', 'Close confirmation')}
              hitSlop={{ top: 12, bottom: 12, left: 12, right: 12 }}
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onCancel(); }}
              style={[st.closeXBtn, { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F1F5F9' : '#151B26', borderColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)' }]}
            >
              <Feather name="x" size={15} color={isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#E2E8F0'} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
          <Text style={[st.message, { color: isLightMode ? '#334155' : '#CBD5E1' }]}>{message}</Text>
          <View style={st.actionsRow}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); onCancel(); }}
              style={[st.cancelBtn, { backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#F1F5F9' : '#121824', borderColor: isLightMode ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', borderBottomColor: isLightMode ? '#94A3B8' : '#020617' }]}
            >
              <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[st.cancelTxt, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#E2E8F0' }]}>{resolvedCancel}</Text>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={() => { if (loading) return; triggerHaptic(tone === 'danger' ? 'Warning' : 'Success'); onConfirm(); }}
              style={[st.confirmBtn, { backgroundColor: palette.btnBg, borderColor: palette.border, borderBottomColor: palette.bottomLip, opacity: loading ? 0.65 : 1 }]}
              {...(palette.btnText === '#050505' ? DARK_INK : {})}
            >
              {loading ? <KineticLoader size={16} color={palette.btnText} /> : <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[st.confirmTxt, { color: palette.btnText }]}>{resolvedConfirm}</Text>}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ReactNativeModal>
    );
  }
);
