import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { KineticLoader, triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

export type KineticFooterTone = 'cyan' | 'purple' | 'green' | 'danger' | 'neutral';

export interface KineticFooterRightAction {
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  icon?: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
  tone?: KineticFooterTone;
  disabled?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
  testID?: string;
}

export interface KineticErgonomicFooterProps {
  onBack: () => void;
  backLabel?: string;
  backAccessibilityLabel?: string;
  backTestID?: string;
  rightAction?: KineticFooterRightAction | null;
  style?: ViewStyle;
}

const DARK_INK_ATTR = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } } as Record<string, unknown>) : {};

const getRightToneStyle = (tone: KineticFooterTone, isLightMode: boolean): { container: ViewStyle; text: string; loader: string } => {
  if (tone === 'purple') {
    return {
      container: {
        backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#7C3AED' : '#9D4EDD',
        borderColor: isLightMode ? '#8B5CF6' : '#C77DFF',
        borderTopColor: '#E9D5FF',
        borderBottomColor: '#5B21B6',
      },
      text: '#FFFFFF',
      loader: '#FFFFFF',
    };
  }
  if (tone === 'green') {
    return {
      container: {
        backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#10B981' : COLORS.green,
        borderColor: '#34D399',
        borderTopColor: '#A7F3D0',
        borderBottomColor: '#047857',
      },
      text: '#050505',
      loader: '#050505',
    };
  }
  if (tone === 'danger') {
    return {
      container: {
        backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#DC2626' : '#EF4444',
        borderColor: '#F87171',
        borderTopColor: '#FECACA',
        borderBottomColor: '#991B1B',
      },
      text: '#FFFFFF',
      loader: '#FFFFFF',
    };
  }
  if (tone === 'neutral') {
    return {
      container: {
        backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#E2E8F0' : '#1E293B',
        borderColor: isLightMode ? '#94A3B8' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)',
        borderTopColor: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.38)',
        borderBottomColor: isLightMode ? '#64748B' : '#020617',
      },
      text: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF',
      loader: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF',
    };
  }
  return {
    container: {
      backgroundColor: isLightMode ? '#0891B2' : COLORS.cyan,
      borderColor: '#67E8F9',
      borderTopColor: '#CFFAFE',
      borderBottomColor: '#0E7490',
    },
    text: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : '#050505',
    loader: isLightMode ? '#FFFFFF' : '#050505',
  };
};

export const KineticErgonomicFooter = memo(
  ({
    onBack,
    backLabel,
    backAccessibilityLabel,
    backTestID = 'kinetic-ergonomic-back-btn',
    rightAction,
    style,
  }: KineticErgonomicFooterProps) => {
    const { isLightMode, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const safeBottom = Math.max(insets.bottom, Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 12 : 10);
    const resolvedBackLabel = backLabel || tx('← ATRÁS', '← BACK');
    const rightTone = rightAction ? getRightToneStyle(rightAction.tone || 'cyan', isLightMode) : null;

    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.footerWrap,
          { paddingBottom: safeBottom },
          isLightMode ? styles.footerLight : styles.footerDark,
          style,
        ]}
      >
        <KineticPhysicsPressable
          preset="tactileChip"
          testID={backTestID}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel={backAccessibilityLabel || resolvedBackLabel}
          onPress={() => {
            triggerHaptic('Selection');
            onBack();
          }}
          style={[
            styles.backBtn,
            isLightMode ? styles.backBtnLight : styles.backBtnDark,
            !rightAction && styles.backBtnSolo,
          ]}
        >
          <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[styles.backBtnText, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#E2E8F0' }]}>
            {resolvedBackLabel}
          </Text>
        </KineticPhysicsPressable>

        {rightAction && rightTone && (
          <KineticPhysicsPressable
            preset="primaryAction"
            testID={rightAction.testID}
            disabled={rightAction.disabled || rightAction.loading}
            onPress={() => {
              if (rightAction.disabled || rightAction.loading) return;
              triggerHaptic('Selection');
              rightAction.onPress();
            }}
            style={[
              styles.rightBtn,
              rightTone.container,
              (rightAction.disabled || rightAction.loading) && { opacity: 0.6 },
            ]}
            {...(rightTone.text === '#050505' ? DARK_INK_ATTR : {})}
          >
            {rightAction.loading ? (
              <KineticLoader size={15} color={rightTone.loader} />
            ) : (
              <>
                {rightAction.icon && <Feather name={rightAction.icon} size={13} color={rightTone.text} />}
                <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[styles.rightBtnText, { color: rightTone.text }]}>
                  {rightAction.label}
                </Text>
              </>
            )}
          </KineticPhysicsPressable>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  footerWrap: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    gap: 10,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingTop: 10,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  footerDark: {
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(6, 9, 15, 0.94)',
    borderTopColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',
  },
  footerLight: {

  },
  backBtn: {
    minHeight: 42,
    paddingHorizontal: 15,
    paddingVertical: 9,
    borderRadius: 13,
    borderWidth: 1.2,
    borderTopWidth: 1.8,
    borderBottomWidth: 3.8,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    flexShrink: 0,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  backBtnSolo: {
    alignSelf: 'flex-start',
  },
  backBtnDark: {
    backgroundColor: '#0E1420',
    borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)',
    borderTopColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.34)',
    borderBottomColor: '#020408',
  },
  backBtnLight: {
    backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9',
    borderColor: '#CBD5E1',
    borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF',
    borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8',
  },
  backBtnText: {
    fontSize: 11.5,
    fontWeight: '900',
    letterSpacing: 0.45,
  },
  rightBtn: {
    flex: 1,
    minWidth: 0,
    minHeight: 42,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 9,
    borderRadius: 13,
    borderWidth: 1.2,
    borderTopWidth: 1.8,
    borderBottomWidth: 4,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: 6,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  rightBtnText: {

  },
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Animated, Modal, PanResponder, Platform, ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, useWindowDimensions, View,
  type GestureResponderEvent, type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { useRegisterOverlayLayer } from '../../services/navigation/kineticOverlayStack';
import { lightboxStyles as ls } from '../../styles/kineticlubHybridWall.styles';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../../utils/kineticHapticsEngine';
import { isSafeKineticMediaUri } from '../../utils/kineticImageFramePureLeaf';
import { renderInWebPortal } from '../../utils/kineticWebPortal';

const NO_SEL: ViewStyle | undefined = Platform.OS === 'web'
  ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle)
  : undefined;
const USE_NATIVE_ANIM = Platform.OS !== 'web';

export interface KineticFullscreenLightboxModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  images: string[];
  initialIndex?: number;
  caption?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  inlineOverlay?: boolean;
}

export function normalizeLightboxMediaUrl(raw?: string | null): string {
  const s = isSafeKineticMediaUri(raw, true);
  if (!s) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s) && s.includes('/storage/v1/render/image/public/')) {
    return s.replace('/storage/v1/render/image/public/', '/storage/v1/object/public/').split('?')[0];
  }
  return s;
}

const touchDistance = (touches: ReadonlyArray<{ pageX: number; pageY: number }>): number => {
  if (!touches || touches.length < 2) return 0;
  return Math.hypot(Number(touches[0].pageX || 0) - Number(touches[1].pageX || 0), Number(touches[0].pageY || 0) - Number(touches[1].pageY || 0));
};

export const KineticFullscreenLightboxModal: React.FC<KineticFullscreenLightboxModalProps> = memo(
  ({ visible, images, initialIndex = 0, caption, onClose, inlineOverlay = false }) => {
    const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    const { width: winW, height: winH } = useWindowDimensions();
    const slideW = Math.max(320, Math.round(winW));
    const slideH = Math.max(420, Math.round(winH));
    const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();

    const cleanImages = useMemo(
      () => (Array.isArray(images) ? images.map((u) => normalizeLightboxMediaUrl(u)).filter(Boolean) : []),
      [images]
    );
    const [viewState, setViewState] = useState({ index: 0, zoomScale: 1 });

    useRegisterOverlayLayer('kinetic-fullscreen-lightbox', Boolean(visible && cleanImages.length > 0), onClose);

    const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView>(null);
    const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const panXAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const panYAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const dismissYAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const scaleRef = useRef(1);
    const panRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    const pinchRef = useRef({ dist: 0, scale: 1 });
    const dragPanRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    const lastTapRef = useRef(0);

    const resetTransform = useCallback(
      (animated = false) => {
        scaleRef.current = 1;
        panRef.current = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        setViewState((p) => (p.zoomScale === 1 ? p : { ...p, zoomScale: 1 }));
        if (animated) {
          Animated.parallel([
            Animated.spring(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
            Animated.spring(panXAnim, { toValue: 0, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
            Animated.spring(panYAnim, { toValue: 0, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
            Animated.spring(dismissYAnim, { toValue: 0, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 68 }),
          ]).start();
        } else {
          scaleAnim.setValue(1);
          panXAnim.setValue(0);
          panYAnim.setValue(0);
          dismissYAnim.setValue(0);
        }
      },
      [scaleAnim, panXAnim, panYAnim, dismissYAnim]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!visible || cleanImages.length === 0) return;
      const safeIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(cleanImages.length - 1, initialIndex));
      setViewState({ index: safeIdx, zoomScale: 1 });
      resetTransform(false);
      const t = setTimeout(() => scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ x: safeIdx * slideW, animated: false }), 30);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }, [visible, initialIndex, cleanImages.length, slideW, resetTransform]);

    const toggleDoubleTapZoom = useCallback(
      (tapX?: number, tapY?: number) => {
        triggerHaptic('Selection');
        if (scaleRef.current > 1.08) { resetTransform(true); return; }
        const z = 2.2;
        const maxX = ((z - 1) * slideW) / 2;
        const maxY = ((z - 1) * slideH) / 2.4;
        const nx = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, Number.isFinite(tapX) ? (slideW / 2 - Number(tapX)) * (z - 1) : 0));
        const ny = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, Number.isFinite(tapY) ? (slideH / 2 - Number(tapY)) * (z - 1) : 0));
        scaleRef.current = z;
        panRef.current = { x: nx, y: ny };
        setViewState((p) => ({ ...p, zoomScale: z }));
        Animated.parallel([
          Animated.spring(scaleAnim, { toValue: z, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 65 }),
          Animated.spring(panXAnim, { toValue: nx, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 65 }),
          Animated.spring(panYAnim, { toValue: ny, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_ANIM, friction: 8, tension: 65 }),
        ]).start();
      },
      [slideW, slideH, resetTransform, scaleAnim, panXAnim, panYAnim]
    );

    const panResponder = useMemo(
      () =>
        PanResponder.create({
          onStartShouldSetPanResponder: (evt) => (evt.nativeEvent.touches?.length || 0) >= 2,
          onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (evt, gs) => {
            if ((evt.nativeEvent.touches?.length || 0) >= 2) return true;
            if (scaleRef.current > 1.05) return Math.abs(gs.dx) > 4 || Math.abs(gs.dy) > 4;
            return gs.dy > 12 && Math.abs(gs.dy) > Math.abs(gs.dx) * 1.25;
          },
          onPanResponderGrant: (evt) => {
            const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
            if (touches.length >= 2) {
              pinchRef.current = { dist: touchDistance(touches), scale: scaleRef.current };
            } else {
              dragPanRef.current = { ...panRef.current };
            }
          },
          onPanResponderMove: (evt, gs) => {
            const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
            if (touches.length >= 2 && pinchRef.current.dist > 8) {
              const next = Math.max(1, Math.min(3.5, pinchRef.current.scale * (touchDistance(touches) / pinchRef.current.dist)));
              scaleRef.current = next;
              scaleAnim.setValue(next);
              return;
            }
            if (scaleRef.current > 1.05) {
              const maxX = ((scaleRef.current - 1) * slideW) / 2;
              const maxY = ((scaleRef.current - 1) * slideH) / 2.4;
              const nx = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, dragPanRef.current.x + gs.dx));
              const ny = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, dragPanRef.current.y + gs.dy));
              panRef.current = { x: nx, y: ny };
              panXAnim.setValue(nx);
              panYAnim.setValue(ny);
            } else if (gs.dy > 0) {
              dismissYAnim.setValue(gs.dy);
            }
          },
          onPanResponderRelease: (_evt, gs) => {
            pinchRef.current.dist = 0;
            setViewState((p) => ({ ...p, zoomScale: scaleRef.current }));
            if (scaleRef.current <= 1.05) {
              if (gs.dy > 95 || gs.vy > 0.85) { triggerHaptic('Light'); onClose(); return; }
              resetTransform(true);
            }
          },
        }),
      [slideW, slideH, scaleAnim, panXAnim, panYAnim, dismissYAnim, resetTransform, onClose]
    );

    const handleSlideTap = useCallback(
      (evt: GestureResponderEvent) => {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastTapRef.current < 280) {
          lastTapRef.current = 0;
          const tapX = evt?.nativeEvent?.pageX;
          const tapY = evt?.nativeEvent?.pageY;
          toggleDoubleTapZoom(typeof tapX === 'number' ? tapX : undefined, typeof tapY === 'number' ? tapY : undefined);
        } else {
          lastTapRef.current = now;
        }
      },
      [toggleDoubleTapZoom]
    );

    const goToSlide = useCallback(
      (idx: number) => {
        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(cleanImages.length - 1, idx));
        resetTransform(false);
        setViewState((p) => ({ ...p, index: clamped }));
        scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ x: clamped * slideW, animated: true });
      },
      [cleanImages.length, slideW, resetTransform]
    );

    if (!visible || cleanImages.length === 0) return null;

    const onMediaProps: Record<string, unknown> = Platform.OS === 'web' ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } : {};
    const viewerBody = (
      <View
        {...onMediaProps}
        style={[
          ls.root,
          { backgroundColor: '#050505', opacity: 1, elevation: 0, width: slideW, height: slideH },
          Platform.OS === 'web'
            ? ({ position: 'fixed', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100vw', height: '100dvh', zIndex: 2147480000, backgroundColor: '#050505', opacity: 1 } as unknown as ViewStyle)
            : null,
        ]}
      >
        <View style={[ls.topBar, { top: Math.max(insets.top + 8, 22) }]}>
          {cleanImages.length > 1 ? (
            <View style={[ls.counterPill, { backgroundColor: '#111622' }]}><Text selectable={false} style={ls.counterTxt}>{`${viewState.index + 1} / ${cleanImages.length}`}</Text></View>
          ) : (<View />)}
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); onClose(); }} hitSlop={{ top: 16, bottom: 16, left: 16, right: 16 }} accessibilityLabel={tx('Cerrar visor', 'Close viewer')} style={[ls.closeBtn, { backgroundColor: '#111622' }, NO_SEL]}>
            <Feather name="x" size={21} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <Animated.View style={[ls.stageWrap, { width: slideW, height: slideH, transform: [{ translateY: dismissYAnim }] }]} {...panResponder.panHandlers}>
          <ScrollView
            ref={scrollRef} horizontal pagingEnabled style={{ width: slideW, height: slideH }}
            scrollEnabled={viewState.zoomScale <= 1.05 && cleanImages.length > 1}
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} scrollEventThrottle={16}
            onMomentumScrollEnd={(e) => {
              const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(cleanImages.length - 1, Math.round(e.nativeEvent.contentOffset.x / Math.max(1, slideW))));
              if (next !== viewState.index) { resetTransform(false); setViewState((p) => ({ ...p, index: next })); }
            }}
          >
            {cleanImages.map((uri, i) => {
              const isActive = i === viewState.index;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity key={`${uri.slice(-24)}_${i}`} activeOpacity={1} onPress={handleSlideTap} style={{ width: slideW, height: slideH, flexShrink: 0, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <Animated.View
                    style={{
                      width: slideW, height: Math.round(slideH * 0.84), justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center',
                      transform: isActive ? [{ translateX: panXAnim }, { translateY: panYAnim }, { scale: scaleAnim }] : [{ scale: 1 }],
                    }}
                  >
                    {Platform.OS === 'web'
                      ? React.createElement('img', {
                          src: uri, alt: caption || 'Kinetic Media', draggable: false,
                          style: { maxWidth: '100%', maxHeight: '84dvh', width: 'auto', height: 'auto', objectFit: 'contain', display: 'block', userSelect: 'none', opacity: 1 },
                        })
                      : <Image source={{ uri }} style={{ width: slideW, height: Math.round(slideH * 0.84) }} contentFit="contain" cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} />}
                  </Animated.View>

              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>
        </Animated.View>

        {cleanImages.length > 1 && Platform.OS === 'web' && (
          <>
            {viewState.index > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ls.webNavBtn, { left: 14 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => goToSlide(viewState.index - 1)}>
                <Feather name="chevron-left" size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
            {viewState.index < cleanImages.length - 1 && (
              <TouchableOpacity style={[ls.webNavBtn, { right: 14 }, NO_SEL]} onPress={() => goToSlide(viewState.index + 1)}>
                <Feather name="chevron-right" size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        <View style={[ls.bottomBar, { bottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 16, 24) }]} pointerEvents="none">
          {Boolean(caption && caption.trim()) && <Text style={ls.captionTxt} numberOfLines={2}>{caption}</Text>}
          {cleanImages.length > 1 && (
            <View style={ls.dotsRow}>{cleanImages.map((_, i) => <View key={`lb_dot_${i}`} style={[ls.dot, i === viewState.index && ls.dotActive]} />)}</View>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    );

    if (Platform.OS === 'web') return renderInWebPortal(viewerBody);
    if (inlineOverlay) return <View style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, zIndex: 9999, backgroundColor: '#050505', elevation: 0 }}>{viewerBody}</View>;
    return <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose} statusBarTranslucent>{viewerBody}</Modal>;
  }
);

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image as ExpoImage } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Modal,
  PanResponder,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  useWindowDimensions,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { useRegisterOverlayLayer } from '../../services/navigation/kineticOverlayStack';
import {
  KineticFrameAspect,
  type KineticImageFrameRequest,
  MAX_FRAMED_JPEG_BYTES,
  MAX_FRAME_ZOOM,
  MIN_FRAME_ZOOM,
  clampFrameTransform,
  computeCoverScaledImageSize,
  computeFrameStageDimensions,
  computeNormalizedSourceCropRect,
  openKineticImageFrame,
  preloadImageInMemory,
  registerKineticImageFrameHost,
  resolveKineticImageFrameRequest,
  resolveOutputDimensionsForAspect,
} from '../../utils/kineticImageFramePureLeaf';
import { compressWebImageUri } from '../../utils/webImageCompressLeaf';
import { renderInWebPortal } from '../../utils/kineticWebPortal';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

export { openKineticImageFrame, type KineticImageFrameRequest };

async function renderFramedJpegWeb(
  uri: string,
  nat: { w: number; h: number },
  stage: { width: number; height: number },
  tr: { zoom: number; offsetX: number; offsetY: number },
  aspect: KineticFrameAspect
): Promise<string | null> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    return compressWebImageUri(uri, 1080, 0.84);
  }
  const rect = computeNormalizedSourceCropRect({
    naturalWidth: nat.w, naturalHeight: nat.h, stageWidth: stage.width, stageHeight: stage.height,
    zoom: tr.zoom, offsetX: tr.offsetX, offsetY: tr.offsetY,
  });
  const outDim = resolveOutputDimensionsForAspect(aspect);
  return new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
    const img = new window.Image();
    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    const tid = setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 6000);
    img.onload = () => {
      clearTimeout(tid);
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = outDim.width;
        canvas.height = outDim.height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) { resolve(null); return; }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#050505';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, outDim.width, outDim.height);
        ctx.drawImage(img, rect.originX, rect.originY, rect.width, rect.height, 0, 0, outDim.width, outDim.height);
        let dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86);
        if (dataUrl.length * 0.75 > MAX_FRAMED_JPEG_BYTES) dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.72);
        if (!dataUrl.startsWith('data:image/jpeg') || dataUrl.length * 0.75 > MAX_FRAMED_JPEG_BYTES) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        resolve(dataUrl);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        void err;
        resolve(null);
      }
    };
    img.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(tid); resolve(null); };
    img.src = uri;
  });
}

const ASPECT_OPTS: KineticFrameAspect[] = ['1:1', '9:16', '16:9'];

export const KineticGlobalImageFrameHost: React.FC = () => {
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { width: winW, height: winH } = useWindowDimensions();
  const [req, setReq] = useState<KineticImageFrameRequest | null>(null);
  const [aspect, setAspect] = useState<KineticFrameAspect>('1:1');
  const [nat, setNat] = useState({ w: 1000, h: 1000 });
  const [tr, setTr] = useState({ zoom: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 });
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const dragStartRef = useRef({ ox: 0, oy: 0, pinchDist: 0, startZoom: 1 });
  const trRef = useRef(tr);
  trRef.current = tr;

  useEffect(() => registerKineticImageFrameHost((nextReq) => {
    if (!nextReq) { setReq(null); return; }
    setAspect(nextReq.aspect || '1:1');
    setNat({ w: 1000, h: 1000 });
    setTr({ zoom: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 });
    setIsSaving(false);
    setReq(nextReq);
  }), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!req?.uri || Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const probe = new window.Image();
    probe.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    probe.onload = () => {
      const nw = probe.naturalWidth || 1000;
      const nh = probe.naturalHeight || 1000;
      setNat({ w: nw, h: nh });
      setTr({ zoom: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 });
    };
    probe.src = req.uri;
  }, [req?.uri]);

  const stage = useMemo(() => computeFrameStageDimensions(aspect, winW, winH), [aspect, winW, winH]);
  const cover = useMemo(() => computeCoverScaledImageSize(nat.w, nat.h, stage.width, stage.height, tr.zoom), [nat, stage, tr.zoom]);

  const applyTransform = useCallback((nextZoom: number, nextOx: number, nextOy: number) => {
    const clamped = clampFrameTransform({
      naturalWidth: nat.w, naturalHeight: nat.h, stageWidth: stage.width, stageHeight: stage.height,
      zoom: nextZoom, offsetX: nextOx, offsetY: nextOy,
    });
    setTr({ zoom: clamped.zoom, offsetX: clamped.offsetX, offsetY: clamped.offsetY });
  }, [nat, stage]);

  const handleClose = useCallback((result: string | null) => {
    resolveKineticImageFrameRequest(result);
  }, []);

  useRegisterOverlayLayer('kinetic-image-frame-modal', Boolean(req), () => handleClose(null));

  const panResponder = useMemo(() => PanResponder.create({
    onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
    onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
    onPanResponderGrant: (evt) => {
      const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
      let pinchDist = 0;
      if (touches.length >= 2) {
        const dx = touches[0].pageX - touches[1].pageX;
        const dy = touches[0].pageY - touches[1].pageY;
        pinchDist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      }
      dragStartRef.current = { ox: trRef.current.offsetX, oy: trRef.current.offsetY, pinchDist, startZoom: trRef.current.zoom };
    },
    onPanResponderMove: (evt, gs) => {
      const touches = evt.nativeEvent.touches || [];
      let nextZoom = trRef.current.zoom;
      if (touches.length >= 2 && dragStartRef.current.pinchDist > 10) {
        const dx = touches[0].pageX - touches[1].pageX;
        const dy = touches[0].pageY - touches[1].pageY;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        nextZoom = dragStartRef.current.startZoom * (dist / dragStartRef.current.pinchDist);
      }
      applyTransform(nextZoom, dragStartRef.current.ox + gs.dx, dragStartRef.current.oy + gs.dy);
    },
  }), [applyTransform]);

  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!req?.uri || isSaving) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    triggerHaptic('Success');
    try {
      const outUri = Platform.OS === 'web'
        ? await renderFramedJpegWeb(req.uri, nat, stage, trRef.current, aspect)
        : await compressWebImageUri(req.uri, 1080, 0.86);
      if (!outUri) {
        handleClose(null);
        return;
      }
      await preloadImageInMemory(outUri);
      const imgApi = ExpoImage as unknown as { prefetch?: (urls: string[]) => Promise<boolean> };
      if (typeof imgApi.prefetch === 'function' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(outUri)) {
        await imgApi.prefetch([outUri]).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      }
      handleClose(outUri);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      handleClose(null);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }, [req?.uri, isSaving, nat, stage, aspect, handleClose]);

  if (!req) return null;

  const frameContent = (
    <View style={[s.root, { paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top + 10, 28), paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom + 14, 22) }]}>
        <View style={s.headerRow}>
          <Text style={s.kicker}>{tx('ENCUADRE KINETIC', 'KINETIC FRAME')}</Text>
          <Text style={s.title} numberOfLines={1}>
            {tx(req.titleEs || 'Ajusta tu encuadre', req.titleEn || 'Adjust your frame')} ({aspect})
          </Text>
          <Text style={s.hint}>{tx('Arrastra para mover • Ajusta el zoom sin deformar', 'Drag to pan • Zoom smoothly without distortion')}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={s.stageArea}>
          <View {...panResponder.panHandlers} style={[s.stageBox, { width: stage.width, height: stage.height }]}>
            <ExpoImage
              source={{ uri: req.uri }}
              style={{
                width: cover.scaledWidth,
                height: cover.scaledHeight,
                transform: [{ translateX: tr.offsetX }, { translateY: tr.offsetY }],
              }}
              contentFit="cover"
              transition={0}
              onLoad={(e) => {
                const sw = e?.source?.width;
                const sh = e?.source?.height;
                if (sw && sh && sw > 0 && sh > 0) setNat({ w: sw, h: sh });
              }}
            />
            <View pointerEvents="none" style={s.gridOverlay}>
              <View style={[s.gridLineV, { left: '33.3%' }]} />
              <View style={[s.gridLineV, { left: '66.6%' }]} />
              <View style={[s.gridLineH, { top: '33.3%' }]} />
              <View style={[s.gridLineH, { top: '66.6%' }]} />
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        {!req.lockAspect && (
          <View style={s.pillsRow}>
            {ASPECT_OPTS.map((opt) => {
              const active = aspect === opt;
              return (
                <Pressable key={opt} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); setAspect(opt); setTr({ zoom: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 }); }} style={[s.aspectPill, active && s.aspectPillActive]}>
                  <Text style={[s.aspectTxt, active && s.aspectTxtActive]}>{opt}</Text>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        )}

        <View style={s.zoomRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.zoomBtn} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); applyTransform(tr.zoom - 0.25, tr.offsetX, tr.offsetY); }}>
            <Feather name="minus" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          {[1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3].map((step) => (
            <TouchableOpacity key={step} style={[s.stepPill, Math.abs(tr.zoom - step) < 0.16 && s.stepPillActive]} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Selection'); applyTransform(step, tr.offsetX, tr.offsetY); }}>
              <Text style={[s.stepTxt, Math.abs(tr.zoom - step) < 0.16 && s.stepTxtActive]}>{step.toFixed(step % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1)}x</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.zoomBtn} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); applyTransform(Math.min(MAX_FRAME_ZOOM, Math.max(MIN_FRAME_ZOOM, tr.zoom + 0.25)), tr.offsetX, tr.offsetY); }}>
            <Feather name="plus" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <View style={s.footerRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.backBtn} disabled={isSaving} onPress={() => { triggerHaptic('Light'); handleClose(null); }}>
            <Text style={s.backTxt}>{tx('← ATRÁS', '← BACK')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.saveBtn} disabled={isSaving} onPress={handleSave}>
            {isSaving ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#050505" /> : <Text style={s.saveTxt}>{tx('GUARDAR', 'SAVE')}</Text>}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
    </View>
  );

  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    return renderInWebPortal(
      <View style={{ position: 'fixed' as unknown as 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, width: '100%' as unknown as number, height: '100%' as unknown as number, zIndex: 2147480000 }}>
        {frameContent}
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Modal visible={Boolean(req)} transparent animationType="fade" presentationStyle="overFullScreen" onRequestClose={() => handleClose(null)} statusBarTranslucent>
      {frameContent}
    </Modal>
  );
};

const s = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#050505', paddingHorizontal: 18, justifyContent: 'space-between' },

    // === src/components/shared/KineticInstallPromptModal.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';

const PWA_PROMPT_DISMISSED_KEY = '@kinetic_pwa_prompt_dismissed';
const SNOOZE_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const SHOW_DELAY_MS = 4500;

type InstallMode = 'android' | 'ios' | null;

// Captura temprana de beforeinstallprompt (Chrome puede dispararlo antes del montaje)
let deferredInstallEvent: any = null;
const installListeners = new Set<() => void>();
if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e: any) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    deferredInstallEvent = e;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb());
  });
  window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
    deferredInstallEvent = null;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb());
  });
}

const isStandaloneDisplay = (): boolean => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true;
  const mql = typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' ? window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') : null;
  return Boolean(mql?.matches) || (window.navigator as any)?.standalone === true;
};

const detectMobilePlatform = (): 'android' | 'ios' | null => {
  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return null;
  const ua = String(navigator.userAgent || '');
  if (/android/i.test(ua)) return 'android';
  const isIPadOS = navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && Number((navigator as any).maxTouchPoints) > 1;
  if (/iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(ua) || isIPadOS) return 'ios';
  return null;
};

export const KineticInstallPromptModal = React.memo(() => {
  const { tx, isLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<InstallMode>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || isStandaloneDisplay()) return;
    const platform = detectMobilePlatform();
    if (!platform) return;
    let active = true;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const evaluate = () => {
      if (!active || isStandaloneDisplay()) {
        setMode(null);
        return;
      }
      if (platform === 'ios') setMode('ios');
      else setMode(deferredInstallEvent ? 'android' : null);
    };

    AsyncStorage.getItem(PWA_PROMPT_DISMISSED_KEY)
      .then((raw) => {
        const dismissedAt = Number(raw) || 0;
        if (!active || Date.now() - dismissedAt < SNOOZE_MS) return;
        timer = setTimeout(evaluate, SHOW_DELAY_MS);
        installListeners.add(evaluate);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    return () => {
      active = false;
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      installListeners.delete(evaluate);
    };
  }, []);

  const dismiss = useCallback(() => {
    triggerHaptic('Selection');
    setMode(null);
    AsyncStorage.setItem(PWA_PROMPT_DISMISSED_KEY, String(Date.now())).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const installAndroid = useCallback(async () => {
    const evt = deferredInstallEvent;
    if (!evt) return;
    triggerHaptic('Medium');
    try {
      await evt.prompt();
      const choice = await evt.userChoice;
      deferredInstallEvent = null;
      if (choice?.outcome === 'accepted') {
        triggerHaptic('Success');
        setMode(null);
      } else {
        dismiss();
      }
    } catch {
      setMode(null);
    }
  }, [dismiss]);

  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || !mode) return null;

  const cyan = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : '#00F0FF';
  const textPrimary = isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF';
  const textMuted = isLightMode ? '#475569' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.68)';

  return (
    <View pointerEvents="box-none" style={styles.overlay}>
      <View
        style={[
          styles.card,
          isLightMode
            ? { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#0284C7' }
            : { backgroundColor: '#0B0B0F', borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)', borderTopColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)', borderBottomColor: '#006B78' },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <View style={[styles.iconBadge, { borderColor: cyan }]}>
            <Feather name="smartphone" size={16} color={cyan} />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Text style={[styles.title, { color: textPrimary }]}>
              {tx('KINETIC EN PANTALLA COMPLETA', 'KINETIC IN FULL SCREEN')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { color: textMuted }]}>
              {tx('Instálala y úsala como app nativa, sin barra del navegador.', 'Install it and use it like a native app, no browser bar.')}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={dismiss} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }} accessibilityLabel={tx('Cerrar', 'Close')}>
            <Feather name="x" size={18} color={textMuted} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {mode === 'android' ? (
          <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.85} style={styles.installBtn} onPress={installAndroid}>
            <Feather name="download" size={15} color="#050505" />
            <Text style={styles.installBtnTxt}>{tx('INSTALAR APP EN TU TELÉFONO', 'INSTALL APP ON YOUR PHONE')}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.stepsBox}>
            <View style={styles.stepRow}>
              <Text style={[styles.stepNum, { color: cyan, borderColor: cyan }]}>1</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.stepTxt, { color: textPrimary }]}>
                {tx('Toca Compartir ', 'Tap Share ')}
                <Feather name="share" size={13} color={cyan} />
                {tx(' (cuadro con flecha)', ' (square with arrow)')}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.stepRow}>
              <Text style={[styles.stepNum, { color: cyan, borderColor: cyan }]}>2</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.stepTxt, { color: textPrimary }]}>
                {tx('Selecciona “Agregar a pantalla de inicio”', 'Select “Add to Home Screen”')}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity onPress={dismiss} style={styles.laterBtn}>
          <Text style={[styles.laterTxt, { color: textMuted }]}>{tx('Ahora no', 'Not now')}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
});

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: { position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingBottom: 18, zIndex: 1200 },

    // === src/components/shared/KineticLiquidGlassSurface.tsx === //
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, StyleProp, StyleSheet, View, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';

let NativeGlassView: React.ComponentType<any> | null = null;
let checkLiquidGlassAvailable: (() => boolean) | null = null;
let NativeBlurView: React.ComponentType<any> | null = null;
let NativeBlurTargetView: React.ComponentType<any> | null = null;

try {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
  const mod = require('expo-glass-effect');
  NativeGlassView = mod?.GlassView || null;
  checkLiquidGlassAvailable =
    typeof mod?.isLiquidGlassAvailable === 'function'
      ? mod.isLiquidGlassAvailable
      : null;
} catch {}

try {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
  const blurMod = require('expo-blur');
  NativeBlurView = blurMod?.BlurView || null;
  NativeBlurTargetView = blurMod?.BlurTargetView || null;
} catch {}

export const KineticBlurTargetContainer: React.ComponentType<any> = NativeBlurTargetView || View;

export type LiquidGlassAccent = 'cyan' | 'purple' | 'neutral';

export interface ICanMountAndroidDimezisBlurParams {
  isAndroid: boolean;
  hasNativeBlur: boolean;
  blurTargetReady?: boolean;
  layoutReady?: boolean;
  hasTargetNode: boolean;
  rafCommitted?: boolean;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  targetWidth?: number;
  targetHeight?: number;
}

export const canMountAndroidDimezisBlur = (
  params: ICanMountAndroidDimezisBlurParams
): boolean => {
  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return false;
  const ready = Boolean(params.blurTargetReady ?? params.layoutReady);
  if (!params.isAndroid || !params.hasNativeBlur || !ready || !params.hasTargetNode) {
    return false;
  }
  if (!params.rafCommitted) return false;
  const w = Number(params.width ?? params.targetWidth ?? 0);
  const h = Number(params.height ?? params.targetHeight ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(w) || !Number.isFinite(h) || w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
};

export const canRenderIosLiquidGlass = (): boolean => {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'ios' || !NativeGlassView || !checkLiquidGlassAvailable) {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    return Boolean(checkLiquidGlassAvailable());
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

export const KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA = 'rgba(8, 12, 22, 0.78)';

export interface ILiquidGlassSurfaceSpec {
  backgroundColor: string;
  androidFrostedBg: string;
  tintColor: string;
  alpha: number;
  elevation: 0;
}

export const resolveLiquidGlassSurfaceSpec = (
  isLight: boolean,
  active = false,
  accent: LiquidGlassAccent = 'cyan'
): ILiquidGlassSurfaceSpec => {
  if (isLight) {
    const bg = active
      ? accent === 'purple'
        ? 'rgba(243, 232, 255, 0.86)'
        : 'rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.86)'
      : 'rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.78)';
    const frosted = active
      ? accent === 'purple'
        ? 'rgba(243, 232, 255, 0.68)'
        : 'rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.68)'
      : 'rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.64)';
    const tint = active
      ? accent === 'purple'
        ? 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.16)'
        : 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.16)'
      : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74)';
    return { backgroundColor: bg, androidFrostedBg: frosted, tintColor: tint, alpha: active ? 0.86 : 0.78, elevation: 0 };
  }
  const darkBg = active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(22, 12, 38, 0.78)'
      : accent === 'cyan'
      ? 'rgba(8, 18, 30, 0.78)'
      : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA
    : 'rgba(8, 12, 22, 0.80)';
  const darkFrosted = active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(22, 12, 38, 0.78)'
      : accent === 'cyan'
      ? 'rgba(8, 18, 30, 0.78)'
      : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA
    : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA;
  const darkTint = active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(22, 12, 38, 0.78)'
      : accent === 'cyan'
      ? 'rgba(8, 18, 30, 0.78)'
      : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA
    : KINETIC_DARK_FROSTED_VEIL_RGBA;
  return { backgroundColor: darkBg, androidFrostedBg: darkFrosted, tintColor: darkTint, alpha: active ? 0.78 : 0.8, elevation: 0 };
};

/**
 * Construye estilos de superficie Liquid Glass multiplataforma.
 * Candado Android: todo fondo rgba(...) DEBE mantener elevation: 0.
 */
export const buildLiquidGlassPillStyle = (
  isLight: boolean,
  active = false,
  accent: LiquidGlassAccent = 'cyan'
): ViewStyle => {
  const accentHex =
    accent === 'purple'
      ? isLight
        ? '#7C3AED'
        : '#9D4EDD'
      : accent === 'neutral'
      ? isLight
        ? '#0F172A'
        : '#94A3B8'
      : isLight
      ? '#0284C7'
      : '#00F0FF';

  const bg = resolveLiquidGlassSurfaceSpec(isLight, active, accent).backgroundColor;

  const borderColor = active
    ? accentHex
    : isLight
    ? 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.44)'
    : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20)';

  const borderTopColor = isLight
    ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)'
    : active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(233, 213, 255, 0.78)'
      : 'rgba(186, 255, 255, 0.74)'
    : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34)';

  const borderBottomColor = isLight
    ? active
      ? accentHex
      : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.48)'
    : active
    ? accent === 'purple'
      ? 'rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.85)'
      : 'rgba(0, 145, 168, 0.85)'
    : 'rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.85)';

  return {
    backgroundColor: bg,
    borderColor,
    borderTopColor,
    borderBottomColor,
    shadowColor: active ? accentHex : '#000000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 6 },
    shadowOpacity: isLight ? 0.14 : 0.28,
    shadowRadius: 12,
    elevation: 0,
    ...(Platform.OS === 'web'
      ? ({
          backdropFilter: 'blur(32px) saturate(200%)',
          WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(32px) saturate(200%)',
        } as any)
      : null),
  };
};

export interface KineticLiquidGlassSurfaceProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  isLight: boolean;
  active?: boolean;
  accent?: LiquidGlassAccent;
  borderRadius?: number;
  interactive?: boolean;
  blurTargetRef?: React.RefObject<any>;
  blurTargetReady?: boolean;
  blurTargetDimensions?: { width: number; height: number } | null;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export const KineticLiquidGlassSurface = memo(
  ({
    children,
    isLight,
    active = false,
    accent = 'cyan',
    borderRadius = 24,
    interactive = false,
    blurTargetRef,
    blurTargetReady = false,
    blurTargetDimensions = null,
    style,
  }: KineticLiquidGlassSurfaceProps) => {
    const [rafCommitted, setRafCommitted] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (
        Platform.OS !== 'android' ||
        !blurTargetReady ||
        !blurTargetRef?.current ||
        !(Number(blurTargetDimensions?.width) > 0) ||
        !(Number(blurTargetDimensions?.height) > 0)
      ) {
        setRafCommitted(false);
        return;
      }
      const rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setRafCommitted(true);
      });
      return () => {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      };
    }, [
      blurTargetReady,
      blurTargetRef,
      blurTargetDimensions?.width,
      blurTargetDimensions?.height,
    ]);

    const glassStyle = buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLight, active, accent);
    const surfaceSpec = resolveLiquidGlassSurfaceSpec(isLight, active, accent);
    const tintColor = surfaceSpec.tintColor;

    const gradientColors: readonly [string, string, string] = isLight
      ? ['rgba(255,255,255,0.44)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', 'rgba(148,163,184,0.14)']
      : ['rgba(255,255,255,0.16)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)'];

    const useNativeIosGlass = canRenderIosLiquidGlass() && NativeGlassView;
    const useAndroidDimezisBlur = canMountAndroidDimezisBlur({
      isAndroid: Platform.OS === 'android',
      hasNativeBlur: Boolean(NativeBlurView),
      blurTargetReady: Boolean(blurTargetReady),
      hasTargetNode: Boolean(blurTargetRef?.current),
      rafCommitted,
      width: blurTargetDimensions?.width ?? 0,
      height: blurTargetDimensions?.height ?? 0,
    });
    const Container: React.ComponentType<any> = useNativeIosGlass
      ? (NativeGlassView as React.ComponentType<any>)
      : View;

    const nativeProps = useNativeIosGlass
      ? {
          glassEffectStyle: 'regular',
          tintColor,
          isInteractive: interactive,
          colorScheme: isLight ? 'light' : 'dark',
        }
      : {};

    const androidFrostedBg = useAndroidDimezisBlur ? surfaceSpec.androidFrostedBg : undefined;

    return (
      <Container
        {...nativeProps}
        collapsable={false}
        style={[
          styles.baseFrame,
          { borderRadius },
          !useNativeIosGlass ? glassStyle : { elevation: 0 },
          style,
          useAndroidDimezisBlur ? { backgroundColor: 'transparent', elevation: 0 } : null,
        ]}
      >
        {useAndroidDimezisBlur && NativeBlurView ? (
          <>
            <NativeBlurView
              blurTarget={blurTargetRef}
              experimentalBlurMethod="dimezisBlurView"
              blurMethod="dimezisBlurView"
              blurReductionFactor={isLight ? 6 : 8}
              intensity={isLight ? 92 : 100}
              tint={isLight ? 'light' : 'dark'}
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { borderRadius, elevation: 0 }]}
            />
            <View
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[
                StyleSheet.absoluteFill,
                { borderRadius, backgroundColor: androidFrostedBg, elevation: 0 },
              ]}
            />
          </>
        ) : null}
        <LinearGradient
          pointerEvents="none"
          colors={gradientColors}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { borderRadius, elevation: 0 }]}
        />
        <View
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={[
            styles.specularRim,
            {
              backgroundColor: isLight
                ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)'
                : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)',
            },
          ]}
        />
        {children}
      </Container>
    );
  }
);
KineticLiquidGlassSurface.displayName = 'KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  baseFrame: {
    overflow: 'hidden',
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderTopWidth: 1.5,
    borderBottomWidth: 2,
    elevation: 0,
  },
  specularRim: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 1,
    left: 16,
    right: 16,
    height: 1.2,
    borderRadius: 999,
  },
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { buildLiquidGlassPillStyle } from './KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

export interface IKineticFilterChip {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface IKineticSortOption {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

type GlobalFilterSelectListener = (filterKey: string) => void;
let _globalFilterSelectListener: GlobalFilterSelectListener | null = null;
const _openMenuDismissListeners = new Set<() => void>();
export const dismissOpenFilterSortMenus = () => {
  _openMenuDismissListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try { fn(); } catch {}
  });
};
export const registerGlobalFilterBarSelectListener = (fn: GlobalFilterSelectListener | null) => {
  _globalFilterSelectListener = fn;
  return () => {
    if (_globalFilterSelectListener === fn) _globalFilterSelectListener = null;
  };
};

export interface KineticListFilterSortBarProps {
  searchQuery: string;
  onChangeSearch: (q: string) => void;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  filterChips?: IKineticFilterChip[];
  activeFilter?: string;
  onSelectFilter?: (key: string) => void;
  sortOptions?: IKineticSortOption[];
  activeSort?: string;
  onSelectSort?: (key: string) => void;
  hideSearch?: boolean;
  hideFilter?: boolean;
  hideSort?: boolean;
  rightSlot?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const KineticListFilterSortBar = memo(
  ({
    searchQuery,
    onChangeSearch,
    searchPlaceholder,
    filterChips = [],
    activeFilter = 'all',
    onSelectFilter,
    sortOptions = [],
    activeSort,
    onSelectSort,
    hideSearch = false,
    hideFilter = false,
    hideSort = false,
    rightSlot,
  }: KineticListFilterSortBarProps) => {
    const { isLightMode, resolvedTheme, themeColors, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    const styles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseStyles, resolvedTheme),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );
    const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState<'filter' | 'sort' | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      const dismiss = () => setOpenMenu(null);
      _openMenuDismissListeners.add(dismiss);
      return () => { _openMenuDismissListeners.delete(dismiss); };
    }, []);

    const effectiveFilters = useMemo<IKineticFilterChip[]>(
      () =>
        filterChips.length > 0
          ? filterChips
          : [{ key: 'all', label: tx('Todos', 'All') }],
      [filterChips, tx]
    );

    const effectiveSorts = useMemo<IKineticSortOption[]>(
      () =>
        sortOptions.length > 0
          ? sortOptions
          : [{ key: 'default', label: tx('Predeterminado', 'Default') }],
      [sortOptions, tx]
    );

    const currentFilterOption = useMemo(
      () =>
        effectiveFilters.find((f) => f.key === activeFilter) ||
        effectiveFilters[0],
      [effectiveFilters, activeFilter]
    );

    const currentSortOption = useMemo(
      () =>
        effectiveSorts.find((s) => s.key === activeSort) || effectiveSorts[0],
      [effectiveSorts, activeSort]
    );

    const cyanInk = isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan;
    const purpleInk = isLightMode ? '#6D28D9' : '#D8B4FE';
    const searchGlassStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, searchQuery.length > 0, 'cyan'),
      [isLightMode, searchQuery.length]
    );
    const filterGlassStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, openMenu === 'filter', 'cyan'),
      [isLightMode, openMenu]
    );
    const sortGlassStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, openMenu === 'sort', 'purple'),
      [isLightMode, openMenu]
    );
    const filterValueStr =
      typeof currentFilterOption.count === 'number'
        ? `${currentFilterOption.label} (${currentFilterOption.count})`
        : currentFilterOption.label;

    return (
      <View style={styles.wrapper}>
        {(!hideSearch || Boolean(rightSlot)) && (
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            {!hideSearch && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.searchContainer,
                  { flex: 1 },
                  isLightMode ? styles.searchContainerLight : styles.searchContainerDark,
                  searchGlassStyle,
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="search" size={15} color={cyanInk} />
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.searchInput, { color: themeColors.textPrimary, fontSize: 16 }]}
                  placeholder={searchPlaceholder || tx('Buscar...', 'Search...')}
                  placeholderTextColor={themeColors.textMuted}
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChangeText={onChangeSearch}
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  multiline={false}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                  returnKeyType="search"
                />
                {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Light');
                      onChangeSearch('');
                    }}
                    hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
                    style={[
                      styles.clearBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: isLightMode
                          ? '#E2E8F0'
                          : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)',
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.clearBtnText, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>
                      ✕
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                )}
              </View>
            )}
            {rightSlot}
          </View>
        )}

        {(!hideFilter || !hideSort) && (
          <View style={styles.splitRow50}>
            {!hideFilter && (
              <KineticPhysicsPressable
                preset="tactileChip"
                onPress={() => {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setOpenMenu((prev) => (prev === 'filter' ? null : 'filter'));
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.halfBtn3D,
                  isLightMode ? styles.filterBtnLight : styles.filterBtnDark,
                  filterGlassStyle,
                  openMenu === 'filter' &&
                    (isLightMode
                      ? styles.filterBtnOpenLight
                      : styles.filterBtnOpenDark),
                  Platform.OS === 'web'
                    ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any)
                    : null,
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="filter" size={11} color={cyanInk} />
                <Text
                  style={[styles.halfBtnText, { color: cyanInk }]}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {tx('Filtrar', 'Filter')}: {filterValueStr}{' '}
                  {openMenu === 'filter' ? '▲' : '▼'}
                </Text>
              </KineticPhysicsPressable>
            )}

            {!hideSort && (
              <KineticPhysicsPressable
                preset="tactileChip"
                onPress={() => {
                  triggerHaptic('Selection');
                  setOpenMenu((prev) => (prev === 'sort' ? null : 'sort'));
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.halfBtn3D,
                  isLightMode ? styles.sortBtnLight : styles.sortBtnDark,
                  sortGlassStyle,
                  openMenu === 'sort' &&
                    (isLightMode ? styles.sortBtnOpenLight : styles.sortBtnOpenDark),
                  Platform.OS === 'web'
                    ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as any)
                    : null,
                ]}
              >
                <Feather name="sliders" size={11} color={purpleInk} />
                <Text
                  style={[styles.halfBtnText, { color: purpleInk }]}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {tx('Ordenar', 'Sort')}: {currentSortOption.label}{' '}
                  {openMenu === 'sort' ? '▲' : '▼'}
                </Text>
              </KineticPhysicsPressable>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {openMenu === 'filter' && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.dropdownSheet,
              isLightMode
                ? styles.dropdownFilterLight
                : styles.dropdownFilterDark,
              filterGlassStyle,
            ]}
          >
            <ScrollView
              nestedScrollEnabled
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={{ maxHeight: 215 }}
            >
              {effectiveFilters.map((chip) => {
                const isSelected = chip.key === currentFilterOption.key;
                const rowLabel =
                  typeof chip.count === 'number'
                    ? `${chip.label} (${chip.count})`
                    : chip.label;
                return (
                  <KineticPhysicsPressable
                    key={chip.key}
                    preset="tactileChip"
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Selection');
                      _globalFilterSelectListener?.(chip.key);
                      onSelectFilter?.(chip.key);
                      setOpenMenu(null);
                    }}
                    style={[
                      styles.optionRow,
                      isSelected &&
                        (isLightMode
                          ? styles.optionSelectedCyanLight
                          : styles.optionSelectedCyanDark),
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.optionText,
                        {
                          color: isSelected
                            ? cyanInk
                            : themeColors.textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: isSelected ? '900' : '700',
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {rowLabel}
                    </Text>
                    <Feather
                      name={isSelected ? 'check-circle' : 'circle'}
                      size={14}
                      color={isSelected ? cyanInk : themeColors.textMuted}
                    />
                  </KineticPhysicsPressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}

        {openMenu === 'sort' && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.dropdownSheet,
              isLightMode ? styles.dropdownSortLight : styles.dropdownSortDark,
              sortGlassStyle,
            ]}
          >
            <ScrollView
              nestedScrollEnabled
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={{ maxHeight: 215 }}
            >
              {effectiveSorts.map((opt) => {
                const isSelected = opt.key === currentSortOption.key;
                return (
                  <KineticPhysicsPressable
                    key={opt.key}
                    preset="tactileChip"
                    onPress={() => {
                      triggerHaptic('Selection');
                      onSelectSort?.(opt.key);
                      setOpenMenu(null);
                    }}
                    style={[
                      styles.optionRow,
                      isSelected &&
                        (isLightMode
                          ? styles.optionSelectedPurpleLight
                          : styles.optionSelectedPurpleDark),
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.optionText,
                        {
                          color: isSelected
                            ? purpleInk
                            : themeColors.textPrimary,
                          fontWeight: isSelected ? '900' : '700',
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {opt.label}
                    </Text>
                    <Feather
                      name={isSelected ? 'check-circle' : 'circle'}
                      size={14}
                      color={isSelected ? purpleInk : themeColors.textMuted}
                    />
                  </KineticPhysicsPressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  }
);

const baseStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: { marginBottom: 12, gap: 8 },
  searchContainer: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', minHeight: 44, borderRadius: 16, paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 4, gap: 8,

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Animated,
  Platform,
  RefreshControl,
  TouchableOpacity,
  type StyleProp,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';

export const AttentionShakeView = React.memo(
  ({ active = true, children, style }: { active?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode; style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle> }) => {
    const shakeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!active) {
        shakeAnim.setValue(0);
        return;
      }
      const loop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.delay(1800),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: -1, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
          Animated.timing(shakeAnim, { toValue: 0, duration: 90, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        ])
      );
      loop.start();
      return () => loop.stop();
    }, [active, shakeAnim]);

    const rotate = shakeAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [-1, 1], outputRange: ['-3.5deg', '3.5deg'] });
    return <Animated.View style={[style, active && { transform: [{ rotate }] }]}>{children}</Animated.View>;
  }
);

export type Touchable3DProps = React.ComponentProps<typeof KineticPhysicsPressable>;

export const Touchable3D = React.memo(({ preset = 'tactileChip', ...rest }: Touchable3DProps) => (
  <KineticPhysicsPressable preset={preset} {...rest} />
));

export const AnimatedScaleTouchable = React.memo(
  ({
    style,
    onPress,
    onLongPress,
    disabled,
    activeOpacity,
    hitSlop,
    accessibilityRole,
    accessibilityLabel,
    accessibilityState,
    testID,
    children,
  }: React.ComponentProps<typeof TouchableOpacity>) => (
    <Touchable3D
      preset="tactileChip"
      style={style}
      onPress={onPress}
      onLongPress={onLongPress}
      disabled={Boolean(disabled)}
      activeOpacity={activeOpacity}
      hitSlop={hitSlop ?? undefined}
      accessibilityRole={accessibilityRole}
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
      accessibilityState={accessibilityState}
      testID={testID}
    >
      {children}
    </Touchable3D>
  )
);

export const getKinetic3DReliefStyle = (isActive: boolean, _isLight = false) => {
  if (isActive) {
    return { borderBottomWidth: 1, borderTopWidth: 2, transform: [{ translateY: 2 }], elevation: 0 };
  }
  return { borderBottomWidth: 3.5, borderTopWidth: 1.8, transform: [{ translateY: 0 }] };

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import React, { createContext, memo, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Animated,
  PanResponder,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  type GestureResponderEvent,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { useRegisterOverlayLayer } from '../../services/navigation/kineticOverlayStack';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { evaluateSubModalSwipeDismiss } from '../../utils/kineticVolumetric3dPureLeaf';
import { buildLiquidGlassPillStyle } from './KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

const fireHeaderHaptic = (mode: 'Light' | 'Selection'): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  if (mode === 'Selection') {
    Haptics.selectionAsync().catch(() => {});
  } else {
    Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light).catch(() => {});
  }
};

export const KINETIC_TOP_SHEET_METRICS: ViewStyle = {
  marginTop: 58,
  height: '92%',
  maxHeight: '92%',
};

export interface KineticSwipeCloseHeaderProps {
  onClose?: (() => void) | null;
  visible?: boolean;
  labelEs?: string;
  labelEn?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  style?: ViewStyle;
}

const OverlayLayerRegisteredContext = createContext(false);

export const KineticSwipeCloseHeader = memo(
  ({
    onClose,
    visible = true,
    labelEs = 'DESLIZA PARA CERRAR',
    labelEn = 'SWIPE TO CLOSE',
    accentColor,
    style,
  }: KineticSwipeCloseHeaderProps) => {
    const { isLightMode, language, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
    void language;
    const parentRegistered = useContext(OverlayLayerRegisteredContext);
    useRegisterOverlayLayer('swipe-close-header', visible && Boolean(onClose) && !parentRegistered, onClose);
    const touchStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; closed: boolean }>({
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      closed: false,
    });

    const fireClose = () => {
      if (!onClose || touchStartRef.current.closed) return;
      touchStartRef.current.closed = true;
      fireHeaderHaptic('Light');
      onClose();
      setTimeout(() => {
        touchStartRef.current.closed = false;
      }, 280);
    };

    const panResponder = useMemo(
      () =>
        PanResponder.create({
          onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_evt, gs) =>
            Math.abs(gs.dy) > 10 && Math.abs(gs.dy) > Math.abs(gs.dx),
          onPanResponderRelease: (_evt, gs) => {
            if (gs.dy > 42 || (gs.dy > 24 && gs.vy > 0.45)) {
              fireClose();
            }
          },
        }),
      // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
      [onClose]
    );

type HeaderTouchEvt = GestureResponderEvent & {
  nativeEvent: GestureResponderEvent['nativeEvent'] & {
    touches?: Array<{ pageX?: number; pageY?: number; clientX?: number; clientY?: number }>;
    changedTouches?: Array<{ pageX?: number; pageY?: number; clientX?: number; clientY?: number }>;
    clientX?: number;
    clientY?: number;
  };
};

    const handleTouchStart = (e: HeaderTouchEvt) => {
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      touchStartRef.current = {
        x: Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0),
        y: Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0),
        closed: false,
      };
    };

    const handleTouchMove = (e: HeaderTouchEvt) => {
      if (!touchStartRef.current.y || touchStartRef.current.closed) return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const curY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      const curX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      const deltaY = curY - touchStartRef.current.y;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(curX - touchStartRef.current.x);
      if (deltaY > 42 && deltaY > deltaX * 1.1) {
        touchStartRef.current.y = 0;
        fireClose();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = (e: HeaderTouchEvt) => {
      if (!touchStartRef.current.y || touchStartRef.current.closed) return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.changedTouches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const endY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      const endX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      const deltaY = endY - touchStartRef.current.y;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(endX - touchStartRef.current.x);
      touchStartRef.current.y = 0;
      if (deltaY > 42 && deltaY > deltaX * 1.1) {
        fireClose();
      }
    };

    const inkColor = accentColor || (isLightMode ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan);
    const glassPillStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(isLightMode, false, 'cyan'),
      [isLightMode]
    );

    return (
      <View
        style={[styles.headerZone, style]}
        onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
        onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
        onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
        {...panResponder.panHandlers}
      >
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.84}
          onPress={() => {
            if (!onClose) return;
            fireHeaderHaptic('Selection');
            onClose();
          }}
          style={[
            styles.pill3D,
            isLightMode ? styles.pillLight : styles.pillDark,
            glassPillStyle,
            { elevation: 0 },
            Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as unknown as ViewStyle) : null,
          ]}
        >
          <View style={[styles.dragBar, { backgroundColor: inkColor }]} />
          <View style={styles.labelRow}>
            <View style={styles.headerIconSlot}>
              <Feather name="chevron-down" size={12} color={inkColor} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.pillText, { color: isLightMode ? '#0F172A' : '#E2E8F0' }]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {tx(labelEs, labelEn)}
            </Text>
            <View style={styles.headerIconSlot}>
              <Feather name="x" size={11} color={isLightMode ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8'} />
            </View>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

export const KineticSwipeableSubSheet = memo(
  ({
    visible,
    onClose,
    backdropStyle,
    sheetStyle,
    children,
    webAttrs,
  }: {
    visible: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    backdropStyle?: ViewStyle | Array<ViewStyle | false | undefined>;
    sheetStyle?: ViewStyle | Array<ViewStyle | false | undefined>;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    webAttrs?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }) => {
    const dragY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
    onCloseRef.current = onClose;

    useRegisterOverlayLayer('swipeable-sub-sheet', visible, onClose);

    useEffect(() => {
      if (visible) dragY.setValue(0);
    }, [visible, dragY]);

    const subPan = useMemo(
      () =>
        PanResponder.create({
          onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_evt, gs) =>
            gs.dy > 8 && Math.abs(gs.dy) > Math.abs(gs.dx) * 1.15,
          onPanResponderMove: (_evt, gs) => {
            if (gs.dy > 0) dragY.setValue(gs.dy);
          },
          onPanResponderRelease: (_evt, gs) => {
            const evalRes = evaluateSubModalSwipeDismiss(gs.dy, gs.vy);
            if (evalRes.shouldDismiss) {
              fireHeaderHaptic('Light');
              Animated.timing(dragY, {
                toValue: 420,
                duration: 150,
                useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
              }).start(() => onCloseRef.current());
            } else {
              Animated.spring(dragY, {
                toValue: 0,
                friction: 7,
                tension: 95,
                useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
              }).start();
            }
          },
          onPanResponderTerminate: () => {
            Animated.spring(dragY, {
              toValue: 0,
              friction: 7,
              tension: 95,
              useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
            }).start();
          },
        }),
      [dragY]
    );

    if (!visible) return null;

    return (
      <OverlayLayerRegisteredContext.Provider value={true}>
        <View style={backdropStyle} {...webAttrs}>
          <Pressable style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} onPress={onClose} />
          <Animated.View
            style={[sheetStyle, { transform: [{ translateY: dragY }] }]}
            {...subPan.panHandlers}
          >
            {children}
          </Animated.View>
        </View>
      </OverlayLayerRegisteredContext.Provider>
    );
  }
);

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  headerZone: {
    width: '100%',

  },

  },
