    // === src/components/shared/KineticSkeletonShimmerLeaf.tsx === //
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Easing, Platform, StyleProp, StyleSheet, View, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';

export const SHIMMER_DURATION_MS = 1100;
export const SHIMMER_DARK_BASE = '#0A0F18';
export const SHIMMER_LIGHT_BASE = '#DDE6F2';
export const SHIMMER_DARK_STOPS = [
  'rgba(0,240,255,0.06)',
  'rgba(0,240,255,0.25)',
  'rgba(255,255,255,0.32)',
  'rgba(0,240,255,0.06)',
] as const;
export const SHIMMER_LIGHT_STOPS = [
  'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)',
  'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
  'rgba(2,132,199,0.22)',
  'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)',
] as const;
export const KINETIC_WEB_SHIMMER_KEYFRAME_NAME = 'kineticDiagonalShimmer60';
const WEB_STYLE_TAG_ID = 'kinetic-shimmer-60fps-style';

let _sharedShimmerRefCount = 0;
let _sharedShimmerProgress: Animated.Value | null = null;
let _sharedShimmerLoop: Animated.CompositeAnimation | null = null;

export const getSharedNativeShimmerProgress = (): Animated.Value => {
  if (!_sharedShimmerProgress) {
    _sharedShimmerProgress = new Animated.Value(0);
  }
  return _sharedShimmerProgress;
};

export const acquireSharedShimmerAnimation = (): (() => void) => {
  const val = getSharedNativeShimmerProgress();
  _sharedShimmerRefCount += 1;
  if (_sharedShimmerRefCount === 1 && Platform.OS !== 'web') {
    val.setValue(0);
    _sharedShimmerLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(val, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: SHIMMER_DURATION_MS,
        easing: Easing.linear,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      })
    );
    _sharedShimmerLoop.start();
  }
  return () => {
    _sharedShimmerRefCount = Math.max(0, _sharedShimmerRefCount - 1);
    if (_sharedShimmerRefCount === 0 && _sharedShimmerLoop) {
      _sharedShimmerLoop.stop();
      _sharedShimmerLoop = null;
      _sharedShimmerProgress?.setValue(0);
    }
  };
};

export const ensureWebShimmerStylesheetInjected = (): void => {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  if (document.getElementById(WEB_STYLE_TAG_ID)) return;
  const styleEl = document.createElement('style');
  styleEl.id = WEB_STYLE_TAG_ID;
  styleEl.textContent = `@keyframes ${KINETIC_WEB_SHIMMER_KEYFRAME_NAME}{0%{transform:translate3d(-120%,0,0) skewX(-18deg);}100%{transform:translate3d(220%,0,0) skewX(-18deg);}}`;
  document.head?.appendChild(styleEl);
};

export interface KineticSkeletonShimmerLeafProps {
  width?: number | `${number}%` | 'auto';
  height?: number | `${number}%` | 'auto';
  borderRadius?: number;
  resolvedTheme?: 'dark' | 'light';
  isLightMode?: boolean;
  baseColor?: string;
  laserColor?: string;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export function resolveShimmerVisualTokens(
  isLight: boolean,
  overrides?: { baseColor?: string; laserColor?: string }
) {
  const baseColor = overrides?.baseColor || (isLight ? SHIMMER_LIGHT_BASE : SHIMMER_DARK_BASE);
  const stops = overrides?.laserColor
    ? ([
        isLight ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.06)',
        overrides.laserColor,
        isLight ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.88)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.32)',
        isLight ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.06)',
      ] as const)
    : isLight
      ? [...SHIMMER_LIGHT_STOPS]
      : [...SHIMMER_DARK_STOPS];
  return {
    baseColor,
    stops,
    borderColor: isLight ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.14)',
  };
}

export const KineticSkeletonShimmerLeaf: React.FC<KineticSkeletonShimmerLeafProps> = ({
  width = '100%',
  height = 18,
  borderRadius = 10,
  resolvedTheme,
  isLightMode,
  baseColor,
  laserColor,
  style,
}) => {
  const isLight = Boolean(isLightMode ?? resolvedTheme === 'light');
  const tokens = resolveShimmerVisualTokens(isLight, { baseColor, laserColor });
  const [boxWidth, setBoxWidth] = useState<number>(typeof width === 'number' && width > 0 ? width : 320);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      ensureWebShimmerStylesheetInjected();
      return undefined;
    }
    return acquireSharedShimmerAnimation();
  }, []);

  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    const webGrad = `linear-gradient(90deg, ${tokens.stops[0]} 0%, ${tokens.stops[1]} 36%, ${tokens.stops[2]} 52%, ${tokens.stops[3]} 100%)`;
    const webRunnerStyle = {
      position: 'absolute',
      top: '-18%',
      bottom: '-18%',
      left: 0,
      width: '58%',
      backgroundImage: webGrad,
      animationName: KINETIC_WEB_SHIMMER_KEYFRAME_NAME,
      animationDuration: `${SHIMMER_DURATION_MS}ms`,
      animationTimingFunction: 'linear',
      animationIterationCount: 'infinite',
      willChange: 'transform',
      pointerEvents: 'none',
    } as unknown as ViewStyle;

    return (
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          styles.container,
          { width, height, borderRadius, backgroundColor: tokens.baseColor, borderColor: tokens.borderColor },
          style,
        ]}
      >
        <View pointerEvents="none" style={webRunnerStyle} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const bandW = Math.max(90, Math.round(boxWidth * 0.65));
  const translateX = getSharedNativeShimmerProgress().interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1],
    outputRange: [-bandW - 40, boxWidth + 40],
  });

  return (
    <View
      pointerEvents="none"
      onLayout={(e) => {
        const w = Math.round(e.nativeEvent.layout.width);
        if (w > 16 && Math.abs(w - boxWidth) > 8) setBoxWidth(w);
      }}
      style={[
        styles.container,
        { width, height, borderRadius, backgroundColor: tokens.baseColor, borderColor: tokens.borderColor },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          styles.nativeRunner,
          {
            width: bandW,
            transform: [{ translateX }, { rotateZ: '18deg' }],
          },
        ]}
      >
        <LinearGradient
          colors={[tokens.stops[0], tokens.stops[1], tokens.stops[2], tokens.stops[3]]}
          locations={[0, 0.35, 0.55, 1]}

    // === src/components/shared/KineticThemeLanguageControl.tsx === //
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import type { KineticLanguage, KineticThemeMode } from '../../constants/kineticTranslations';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import { KineticPhysicsPressable } from '../../utils/kineticPhysicsEngine';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../SharedUI';
import { buildLiquidGlassPillStyle } from './KineticLiquidGlassSurface';

export interface KineticThemeLanguageControlProps {
  compact?: boolean;
  onPreferenceChanged?: (toastMessage: string) => void;
}

export const KineticThemeLanguageControl = memo(
  ({ compact = false, onPreferenceChanged }: KineticThemeLanguageControlProps) => {
    const {
      themeMode,
      setThemeMode,
      resolvedTheme,
      language,
      setLanguage,
      themeColors,
      t,
      tx,
    } = useKineticPreferences();
    const tlStyles = useMemo(
      () => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(baseTlStyles, resolvedTheme, ['pillBtnActiveCyan']),
      [resolvedTheme]
    );

    const handleSelectTheme = (nextMode: KineticThemeMode) => {
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      setThemeMode(nextMode);
      if (onPreferenceChanged) {
        const label =
          nextMode === 'light'
            ? tx('✓ Modo Claro activado', '✓ Light Mode enabled')
            : tx('✓ Modo Oscuro activado', '✓ Dark Mode enabled');
        onPreferenceChanged(label);
      }
    };

    const handleSelectLanguage = (nextLang: KineticLanguage) => {
      triggerHaptic('Selection');
      setLanguage(nextLang);
      if (onPreferenceChanged) {
        onPreferenceChanged(
          nextLang === 'en' ? '✓ Language switched to English' : '✓ Idioma cambiado a Español'
        );
      }
    };

    const themeOptions: { mode: KineticThemeMode; emoji: string; fullLabel: string; shortLabel: string }[] = [
      {
        mode: 'dark',
        emoji: '🌙',
        fullLabel: t('settings.theme_dark'),
        shortLabel: t('settings.theme_dark_short'),
      },
      {
        mode: 'light',
        emoji: '☀️',
        fullLabel: t('settings.theme_light'),
        shortLabel: t('settings.theme_light_short'),
      },
    ];

    const languageOptions: { lang: KineticLanguage; emoji: string; label: string }[] = [
      { lang: 'es', emoji: '🇲🇽', label: language === 'en' ? 'Spanish (ES)' : 'Español (ES)' },
      { lang: 'en', emoji: '🇺🇸', label: 'English (EN)' },
    ];

    const cardSurfaceStyle = {
      backgroundColor: themeColors.surface,
      borderColor: themeColors.cardBorder,
      borderTopColor: themeColors.cardBorderTop,
      borderBottomColor: themeColors.cardBorderBottom,
    };

    const glassTrackStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(themeColors.isLight, false, 'cyan'),
      [themeColors.isLight]
    );

    const inactivePillStyle = useMemo(
      () => buildLiquidGlassPillStyle(themeColors.isLight, false, 'neutral'),
      [themeColors.isLight]
    );

    const activeCyanPillStyle = themeColors.isLight
      ? {
          backgroundColor: '#0284C7',
          borderColor: '#38BDF8',
          borderTopColor: '#E0F2FE',
          borderBottomColor: '#0369A1',
          shadowColor: '#0284C7',
          shadowOpacity: 0.25,
          elevation: 0,
        }
      : {
          ...tlStyles.pillBtnActiveCyan,
          elevation: 0,
        };
    const activeCyanTextColor = themeColors.isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : '#050505';
    const activeCyanDataSet: any = themeColors.isLight
      ? { dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } }
      : { dataSet: { kineticInk: 'dark' } };

    if (compact) {
      return (
        <View style={[tlStyles.compactCard3D, cardSurfaceStyle]}>
          <View style={tlStyles.compactHeaderRow}>
            <View style={tlStyles.compactIconCircle}>
              <Feather name="sun" size={14} color={themeColors.cyanText} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={[tlStyles.compactTitle, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>
                {t('vault.lang_appearance_title')}
              </Text>
              <Text style={[tlStyles.compactSub, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
                {tx(
                  'Modo Oscuro o Claro • Español / Inglés',
                  'Dark or Light theme • Spanish / English'
                )}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle]}>
            {themeOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = resolvedTheme === opt.mode;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.mode}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.pillBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectTheme(opt.mode)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.pillBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    adjustsFontSizeToFit
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.shortLabel}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle, { marginTop: 8 }]}>
            {languageOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = language === opt.lang;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.lang}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.pillBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectLanguage(opt.lang)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.pillBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      );
    }

    return (
      <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <Text style={[tlStyles.sectionHeader, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
          {t('settings.lang_appearance_header')}
        </Text>
        <View style={[tlStyles.fullCard3D, cardSurfaceStyle]}>
          <View style={tlStyles.subHeaderRow}>
            <Text style={[tlStyles.subLabel, { color: themeColors.cyanText }]}>
              {t('settings.appearance_label')}
            </Text>
            <Text style={[tlStyles.resolvedMicroBadge, { color: themeColors.textMuted }]}>
              {resolvedTheme === 'light' ? tx('☀️ Claro', '☀️ Light') : tx('🌙 Oscuro', '🌙 Dark')}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle, { marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 14 }]}>
            {themeOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = resolvedTheme === opt.mode;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.mode}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.halfBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectTheme(opt.mode)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.fullBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    adjustsFontSizeToFit
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.fullLabel}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          <Text style={[tlStyles.subLabel, { color: themeColors.cyanText, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
            {tx('IDIOMA', 'LANGUAGE')}
          </Text>
          <View style={[tlStyles.segmentedGlassTrack, glassTrackStyle]}>
            {languageOptions.map((opt) => {
              const isSelected = language === opt.lang;
              return (
                <KineticPhysicsPressable
                  key={opt.lang}
                  preset="tactileChip"
                  style={[
                    tlStyles.halfBtn3D,
                    isSelected ? activeCyanPillStyle : inactivePillStyle,
                  ]}
                  onPress={() => handleSelectLanguage(opt.lang)}
                  {...(isSelected ? activeCyanDataSet : {})}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      tlStyles.fullBtnText,
                      { color: isSelected ? activeCyanTextColor : themeColors.textPrimary },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {opt.emoji} {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                </KineticPhysicsPressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }
);

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { resolveCategoryImage } from '../../constants/exploreData';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import { adaptStyleSheetForTheme } from '../../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';

const KINETIC_LOGO = require('../../../assets/logo.png');
const HUB_MEDIA_LOCK = [
  'walletHero', 'walletHeroDim', 'walletLogoBox', 'walletDiscTag', 'walletTitle', 'walletClub',
];

export const KineticUnifiedControlHub = ({
  onOpenBilling,
  onOpenFiscal,
  onOpenLegal,
  onOpenConcierge,
  onOpenSupport,
  isB2B = false,
}: {
  onOpenBilling?: () => void;
  onOpenFiscal?: () => void;
  onOpenLegal?: () => void;
  onOpenConcierge?: () => void;
  onOpenSupport?: () => void;
  isB2B?: boolean;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}) => {
  const { themeColors, resolvedTheme, t, tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const st = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(hubSt, resolvedTheme, HUB_MEDIA_LOCK), [resolvedTheme]);
  const handleFiscal = onOpenBilling || onOpenFiscal || (() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:open-boveda-billing'));
    }
  });

  const items = [
    { icon: 'file-text' as const, color: themeColors.cyanText, title: isB2B ? t('vault.tax_billing_b2b') : t('vault.tax_billing_b2c'), onPress: handleFiscal },
    { icon: 'shield' as const, color: themeColors.purpleText, title: t('vault.legal_waiver'), onPress: onOpenLegal },
    { icon: 'cpu' as const, color: themeColors.cyanText, title: tx('Concierge IA 24/7', '24/7 AI Concierge'), onPress: onOpenConcierge },
    { icon: 'headphones' as const, color: themeColors.green, title: t('vault.talk_human'), onPress: onOpenSupport },
  ];

  return (
    <View style={[st.hubBox, themeColors.isLight && { backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#94A3B8' }]}>
      {items.map((it, idx) => (
        <TouchableOpacity key={idx} style={[st.hubRow, themeColors.isLight && { borderBottomColor: '#E2E8F0' }, idx === items.length - 1 && { borderBottomWidth: 0 }]} activeOpacity={0.82} onPress={it.onPress}>
          <View style={[st.hubIconCircle, { borderColor: it.color }, themeColors.isLight && { backgroundColor: '#F8FAFC' }]}>
            <Feather name={it.icon} size={14} color={it.color} />
          </View>
          <Text style={[st.hubRowTitle, { color: themeColors.textPrimary }]}>{it.title}</Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color={themeColors.textMuted} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
};

export interface KineticBoardingPassWalletItem {
  id?: string | number | null;
  categoria?: string | null;
  disciplina?: string | null;
  servicio?: string | null;
  titulo?: string | null;
  nombre_servicio?: string | null;
  negocio_nombre?: string | null;
  sede?: string | null;
  avatar_club?: string | null;
  avatar_url?: string | null;
}

export const KineticBoardingPassWalletCard = ({
  pass, selectedPass, qrSecondsLeft = 60, secondsLeft, escrowKc, puertaKc, children,
}: {
  pass?: KineticBoardingPassWalletItem | null; selectedPass?: KineticBoardingPassWalletItem | null; qrSecondsLeft?: number; secondsLeft?: number; escrowKc?: number; puertaKc?: number; children?: React.ReactNode; [key: string]: unknown;
}) => {
  const { tx, td, tDisc, themeColors, resolvedTheme } = useKineticPreferences();
  const st = useMemo(() => adaptStyleSheetForTheme(hubSt, resolvedTheme, HUB_MEDIA_LOCK), [resolvedTheme]);
  const item: KineticBoardingPassWalletItem = pass || selectedPass || {};
  const rawSec = Number(secondsLeft ?? qrSecondsLeft);
  const secs = Number.isFinite(rawSec) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(60, rawSec)) : 60;
  const pct = Math.max(2, Math.min(100, (secs / 60) * 100));
  const barColor = secs <= 10 ? '#FF3B30' : secs <= 20 ? '#FFB800' : themeColors.isLight ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF';
  const disc = String(item?.categoria || item?.disciplina || item?.servicio || 'Fuerza');
  const rawTitle = String(item?.servicio || item?.titulo || item?.nombre_servicio || '');
  const title = rawTitle ? td(rawTitle) : tx('Pase Activo Kinetic', 'Active Kinetic Pass');
  const club = String(item?.negocio_nombre || item?.sede || tx('Kinetic Oficial', 'Kinetic Official'));
  const coverUri = resolveCategoryImage(disc, title);
  const logoUri = item?.avatar_club || item?.avatar_url;
  const hasLogo = Boolean(logoUri && String(logoUri).length > 5);
  const coverSource = useMemo(() => ({ uri: coverUri }), [coverUri]);
  const logoSource = useMemo(() => (hasLogo ? { uri: String(logoUri) } : null), [hasLogo, logoUri]);

  return (
    <View style={st.walletCard}>
      <View style={st.walletHero} {...({ dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } as Record<string, unknown>)}>
        <Image source={coverSource} recyclingKey={coverUri} cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} style={st.walletHeroImg} contentFit="cover" />
        <View style={st.walletHeroDim} />
        <View style={st.walletHeroRow}>
          <View style={st.walletLogoBox}>
            {logoSource ? (
              <Image source={logoSource} recyclingKey={String(logoUri)} cachePolicy="memory-disk" transition={0} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }} contentFit="cover" />
            ) : (
              <Image source={KINETIC_LOGO} transition={0} style={{ width: 30, height: 30 }} contentFit="contain" />
            )}
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={st.walletDiscTag}>{tDisc(disc).toUpperCase()}</Text>
            <Text style={st.walletTitle} numberOfLines={1}>{title}</Text>
            <Text style={st.walletClub} numberOfLines={1}>{club}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
      {children}
      <View style={[st.timerTrack, themeColors.isLight && { backgroundColor: '#E2E8F0', borderColor: '#7DD3FC' }]}>
        <View style={[st.timerFill, { width: `${pct}%`, backgroundColor: barColor }]} />
      </View>
      <Text style={[st.timerCaption, themeColors.isLight && { color: '#475569' }]}>
        {tx(`Vigencia QR 60s: ${secs}s`, `60s QR validity: ${secs}s`)}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
};

const hubSt = StyleSheet.create({

import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Animated, Platform, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Defs, Line, LinearGradient, Rect, Stop } from 'react-native-svg';
import { COLORS } from '../../styles/globalStyles';
import {
  computeIsometricStationProjection,
  resolveVolumetricPerspectiveTransform,
} from '../../utils/kineticVolumetric3dPureLeaf';

export interface IVolumetricStageCell {
  key: string;
  row: number;
  col: number;
  disabled: boolean;
  spotNum: number | null;
  status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'selected' | 'checked_in' | 'reserved' | 'aisle_cfg';
  labelTop?: string;
  labelBottom?: string;
  isInteractive?: boolean;
}

export interface KineticVolumetricStudioStageLeafProps {
  mode: 'athlete_picker' | 'config_editor' | 'b2b_supervision';
  rows: number;
  cols: number;
  stageLabel: string;
  cells: IVolumetricStageCell[];
  isLight: boolean;
  iconName: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
  onPressCell: (cell: IVolumetricStageCell) => void;
  disabledAction?: boolean;
  aisleLabel?: string;
}

const USE_NATIVE_DRV = Platform.OS !== 'web';
const NO_SEL = Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' } as Record<string, string>) : undefined;

const Station3DCell = memo(({
  cell, rows, cols, isLight, iconName, disabledAction, aisleLabel, onPress,
}: {
  cell: IVolumetricStageCell;
  rows: number;
  cols: number;
  isLight: boolean;
  iconName: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
  disabledAction?: boolean;
  aisleLabel?: string;
  onPress: () => void;
}) => {
  const springAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(cell.status === 'selected' ? 1 : 0)).current;
  const pressAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.spring(springAnim, {
      toValue: cell.status === 'selected' ? 1 : 0,
      friction: 6,
      tension: 120,
      useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_DRV,
    }).start();
  }, [cell.status, springAnim]);

  if (cell.disabled && cell.status !== 'aisle_cfg') {
    return <View style={st.aisleSpacer} />;
  }

  const proj = computeIsometricStationProjection({ row: cell.row, col: cell.col, rows, cols });
  const isSel = cell.status === 'selected';
  const isOcc = cell.status === 'occupied';
  const isChecked = cell.status === 'checked_in';
  const isRes = cell.status === 'reserved';
  const isAisleCfg = cell.status === 'aisle_cfg';

  const bg = isAisleCfg
    ? (isLight ? '#F1F5F9' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)')
    : isChecked
      ? (isLight ? '#ECFDF5' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.18)')
      : isSel
        ? (isLight ? '#ECFDF5' : 'rgba(0,255,102,0.16)')
        : isRes
          ? (isLight ? '#F5F3FF' : 'rgba(168,85,247,0.18)')
          : isOcc
            ? (isLight ? '#FEF2F2' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.16)')
            : (isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0B1220');

  const topColor = isAisleCfg
    ? (isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)')
    : (isLight ? '#FFFFFF' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)');

  const lipBottom = isAisleCfg
    ? (isLight ? '#94A3B8' : '#1E293B')
    : isChecked || isSel
      ? '#047857'
      : isRes
        ? '#5B21B6'
        : isOcc
          ? '#991B1B'
          : (isLight ? '#0369A1' : '#007C91');

  const sideBorder = isAisleCfg
    ? (isLight ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)')
    : isChecked || isSel
      ? (isLight ? '#10B981' : COLORS.green)
      : isRes
        ? '#7C3AED'
        : isOcc
          ? (isLight ? '#DC2626' : '#EF4444')
          : (isLight ? '#0284C7' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.48)');

  const ink = isAisleCfg
    ? (isLight ? '#475569' : '#94A3B8')
    : isChecked || isSel
      ? (isLight ? '#047857' : COLORS.green)
      : isRes
        ? (isLight ? '#6D28D9' : '#C77DFF')
        : isOcc
          ? (isLight ? '#991B1B' : '#FCA5A5')
          : (isLight ? '#006B82' : COLORS.cyan);

  const scaleAnim = springAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [proj.depthScale, proj.depthScale * 1.06] });
  const liftAnim = springAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [proj.liftY, proj.liftY - 4] });
  const isRgba = bg.startsWith('rgba(');

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        st.cellWrap,
        { zIndex: isSel ? proj.zIndex + 20 : proj.zIndex, transform: [{ translateY: liftAnim }, { scale: Animated.multiply(scaleAnim, pressAnim) }] },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[
          st.ellipticShadow,
          {
            width: `${Math.round(proj.shadowWidthRatio * 100)}%`,
            opacity: proj.shadowOpacity,
            backgroundColor: isLight ? 'rgba(15,23,42,0.18)' : '#020408',
          },
        ]}
      />
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.86}
        disabled={Boolean(disabledAction) || cell.isInteractive === false}
        onPressIn={() => Animated.spring(pressAnim, { toValue: 0.94, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_DRV }).start()}
        onPressOut={() => Animated.spring(pressAnim, { toValue: 1, friction: 5, useNativeDriver: USE_NATIVE_DRV }).start()}
        onPress={onPress}
        style={[
          st.station3DCard,
          {
            backgroundColor: bg,
            borderColor: sideBorder,
            borderTopColor: topColor,
            borderBottomWidth: proj.frontLipPx,
            borderBottomColor: lipBottom,
            elevation: isRgba ? 0 : isLight ? 2 : 3,
          },
          NO_SEL,
        ]}
      >
        {isAisleCfg ? (
          <>
            <Feather name="plus" size={11} color={ink} />
            <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[st.microTag, { color: ink }]}>{aisleLabel || '+ PASILLO'}</Text>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Feather name={isOcc ? 'lock' : isSel || isChecked ? 'check-circle' : iconName} size={12} color={ink} />
            <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[st.spotTitle, { color: isOcc ? ink : isLight ? '#0F172A' : '#FFFFFF' }]}>
              {cell.labelTop || `#${cell.spotNum ?? 1}`}
            </Text>
            <Text selectable={false} numberOfLines={1} style={[st.microTag, { color: ink }]}>
              {cell.labelBottom || ''}
            </Text>
          </>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </Animated.View>
  );
});

export const KineticVolumetricStudioStageLeaf = memo((props: KineticVolumetricStudioStageLeafProps) => {
  const { rows, cols, stageLabel, cells, isLight, iconName, onPressCell, disabledAction, aisleLabel } = props;
  const safeRows = Math.max(1, rows);
  const groupedRows = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: safeRows }, (_, rIdx) => cells.filter((c) => c.row === rIdx)),
    [cells, safeRows]
  );
  const persp = useMemo(() => resolveVolumetricPerspectiveTransform(Platform.OS, 28), []);
  const gridStroke = isLight ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.22)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.20)';

  return (
    <View style={[st.stageShell, { backgroundColor: isLight ? '#E2E8F0' : '#050811', borderColor: isLight ? '#CBD5E1' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.22)' }]}>
      <View
        {...(Platform.OS === 'web' ? ({ dataSet: { kineticOnMedia: 'true' } } as Record<string, unknown>) : {})}
        style={[
          st.podium3D,
          {
            backgroundColor: isLight ? '#0F172A' : '#080E1A',
            borderColor: isLight ? '#0284C7' : 'rgba(0,240,255,0.52)',
            borderTopColor: '#B8FFFF',
            borderBottomColor: isLight ? '#0369A1' : '#007C91',
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View style={st.podiumHalo} />
        <View style={st.podiumInnerRow}>
          <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={13} color={COLORS.cyan} />
          <Text selectable={false} style={st.podiumTxt} numberOfLines={1}>{stageLabel}</Text>
          <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={13} color={COLORS.cyan} />
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={st.perspectiveFrame}>
        <Svg style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} viewBox="0 0 320 180" preserveAspectRatio="none" pointerEvents="none">
          <Defs>
            <LinearGradient id="floorDepth" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <Stop offset="0%" stopColor={isLight ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF'} stopOpacity="0.16" />
              <Stop offset="100%" stopColor={isLight ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF'} stopOpacity="0.02" />
            </LinearGradient>
          </Defs>
          <Rect x="16" y="4" width="288" height="172" rx="12" fill="url(#floorDepth)" />
          {[32, 80, 128, 176, 224, 272].map((xBottom, idx) => (
            <Line key={`v_${idx}`} x1={60 + idx * 40} y1="6" x2={xBottom} y2="176" stroke={gridStroke} strokeWidth="1" />
          ))}
          {[36, 74, 114, 154].map((yPos, idx) => (
            <Line key={`h_${idx}`} x1="18" y1={yPos} x2="302" y2={yPos} stroke={gridStroke} strokeWidth="1" />
          ))}
        </Svg>

        <View style={[st.cinemaFloor, persp.usePerspective3D ? { transform: persp.styleTransform } : null]}>
          {groupedRows.map((rowCells, rIdx) => (
            <View key={`vr_${rIdx}`} style={st.gridRow}>
              {rowCells.map((cell) => (
                <Station3DCell
                  key={cell.key}
                  cell={cell}
                  rows={safeRows}
                  cols={Math.max(1, cols)}
                  isLight={isLight}
                  iconName={iconName}
                  disabledAction={disabledAction}
                  aisleLabel={aisleLabel}
                  onPress={() => onPressCell(cell)}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
});

const st = StyleSheet.create({
  stageShell: { borderRadius: 18, borderWidth: 1.2, padding: 10, overflow: 'hidden', elevation: 0 },
  podium3D: {
    borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1.2, borderTopWidth: 2, borderBottomWidth: 5,

});

const STEALTH_RIVAL_HASHES = new Set([1507459749, 1800830082, 79832761, 2447318640, 2016519120]);
function hasStealthRivalToken(q: string): boolean {
  return q.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).some((tok) => {
    if (!tok) return false;
    let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < tok.length; i += 1) { h = Math.imul(h ^ tok.charCodeAt(i), 16777619) >>> 0; }
    return STEALTH_RIVAL_HASHES.has(h);
  });
}

export function resolveKineticConciergeReply(rawInput: string, lang: KineticLang): { text: string; ctaRole?: 'atleta' | 'club' | 'especialista' } {
  const q = String(rawInput || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const en = lang === 'en';
  const wantsClub = /\b(club|gym|gimnasio|estudio|studio|sede|cancha|venue|partner|socio|b2b)\b/.test(q);
  const wantsSpec = /\b(especialista|consultorio|fisio|fisioterapia|recovery|specialist|clinic)\b/.test(q);
  const roleHint: 'atleta' | 'club' | 'especialista' = wantsSpec ? 'especialista' : wantsClub ? 'club' : 'atleta';

  if (hasStealthRivalToken(q) || /\b(precio|precios|costo|costos|cuanto|cuesta|mensualidad|tarifa|comision|porcentaje|split|divide|pago|pagos|moneda|coin|competencia|rival|alternativa|membresia|plan|vs|versus|price|pricing|cost|fee|monthly|commission|percent|how much|membership)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      ctaRole: roleHint,
      text: en
        ? 'Exclusive conditions, membership details and opening perks are shared privately once your invitation is activated. Join the priority list and we will send your private access directly.'
        : 'Las condiciones exclusivas y beneficios de apertura se comparten de forma privada al activar tu invitación. Solicita tu lugar en la lista prioritaria para recibir los detalles al momento de tu ola.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(donde|ciudad|ciudades|ubicacion|zona|cobertura|cabo|san lucas|san jose|where|city|cities|location|coverage)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      ctaRole: 'atleta',
      text: en
        ? 'Initial coverage launches across Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo, while the ecosystem is engineered to scale rapidly into new cities by curated invitation.'
        : 'La cobertura inicial inicia entre Cabo San Lucas y San José del Cabo, con una arquitectura diseñada para expandirse progresivamente a nuevas ciudades.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(3d|espacio|lugar|estacion|cama|reformer|bici|bicicleta|camilla|fila|filas|mapa|spot|station|bed|bike|court|line|queue)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Before leaving home, open the 3D spatial view of each venue to select your exact bike, Pilates reformer, training rack, padel court or recovery bed. Walk straight in with zero queues.'
        : 'Antes de salir, entras al mapa espacial en 3D de la sede y eliges tu bicicleta, cama de Pilates, estación, cancha o camilla exacta. Llegas directo a entrenar sin filas.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(nivel|pilar|pilares|fuerza|zen|resistencia|agilidad|racha|rachas|cofre|cofres|premio|premios|trofeo|level|pillar|strength|endurance|agility|streak|chest|reward|trophy)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Every real session boosts Strength, Zen, Endurance and Agility. Keeping active streaks unlocks interactive reward chests and trophies tied directly to your real consistency.'
        : 'Cada entrenamiento real impulsa tus cuatro pilares —Fuerza, Zen, Resistencia y Agilidad—. Al sostener rachas activas desbloqueas cofres con premios y trofeos ligados a tu constancia.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(comunidad|historia|historias|equipo|equipos|amigo|social|community|story|stories|squad|team)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Connect with real athletes nearby, organize training teams for courts or studio classes, and share live moments through 24-hour venue stories.'
        : 'Conecta con atletas reales, arma equipos para canchas o sesiones grupales y comparte tus logros en vivo mediante historias efímeras de 24h desde cada sede.',
    };
  }
  if (wantsClub || wantsSpec) {
    return {
      ctaRole: roleHint,
      text: en
        ? 'Kinetic empowers clubs, studios, courts and specialists with smart off-peak and peak occupancy, verified bookings and zero friction at reception. Leave your details to evaluate your founding venue spot.'
        : 'Kinetic conecta clubes, estudios, canchas y especialistas con ocupación inteligente en todo horario y agenda verificada. Registra tu sede en el formulario para evaluar tu ingreso fundador.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(app|ios|android|iphone|web|dispositivo|celular|device|mobile|download)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Kinetic runs seamlessly across iOS, Android and modern mobile web browsers, keeping your passes, 3D reservations and athletic progress in real-time sync.'
        : 'Kinetic opera en iOS, Android y web móvil manteniendo tus reservas 3D, accesos y progreso atlético sincronizados al instante.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(privacidad|dato|datos|seguridad|privacy|data|security)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      text: en
        ? 'Your pre-registration information is used solely to coordinate your priority invitation under KineticApp S.A.S. strict data-protection controls.'
        : 'Tus datos de pre-registro se resguardan bajo control estricto de KineticApp S.A.S. únicamente para coordinar tu invitación y avisos de apertura.',
    };
  }
  if (/\b(invitacion|acceso|registro|espera|lista|invite|invitation|access|waitlist|join)\b/.test(q)) {
    return {
      ctaRole: 'atleta',
      text: en
        ? 'Access rolls out in controlled waves. Leave your name, email and 10-digit WhatsApp in the invitation card so we can notify you as soon as your wave opens.'
        : 'La apertura avanza por oleadas controladas. Deja tu nombre, correo y WhatsApp de 10 dígitos en la tarjeta de invitación para avisarte en cuanto se abra tu acceso.',
    };
  }
  return {
    ctaRole: 'atleta',
    text: en
      ? 'Kinetic unites over 230 fitness, court and recovery disciplines on a single digital pass — with 3D spot selection before leaving home, four living progression pillars, reward chests and community.'
      : 'Kinetic reúne más de 230 disciplinas de fitness, deporte, canchas y recuperación bajo un solo pase digital: reserva exacta en 3D, cuatro pilares de evolución, cofres con premios y comunidad real.',
  };
}

  style,
  hasCachedData,
  isLightMode: isLightModeProp,
  borderRadius,
}: {
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  hasCachedData?: boolean;
  isLightMode?: boolean;
  borderRadius?: number;
}) => {
  const { isLightMode: ctxLightMode } = useKineticPreferences();
  const isLightMode = typeof isLightModeProp === 'boolean'
    ? isLightModeProp
    : Boolean(ctxLightMode || getLastSyncedKineticTheme() === 'light');
  if (hasCachedData) return null;
  const flatStyle = style ? (StyleSheet.flatten(style) as ViewStyle) : undefined;
  const resolvedRadius = borderRadius ?? (typeof flatStyle?.borderRadius === 'number' ? flatStyle.borderRadius : RADIUS.md);

  return (
    <KineticSkeletonShimmerLeaf
      isLightMode={isLightMode}
      borderRadius={resolvedRadius}
      baseColor={isLightMode ? LIGHT_M3_TOKENS.skeletonBase : undefined}
      laserColor={isLightMode ? LIGHT_M3_TOKENS.skeletonLaser : undefined}
      style={[
        baseStyles.skeletonBaseBox,
        isLightMode && baseStyles.skeletonBaseBoxLight,
        style,
      ]}
    />
  );
});

export const KineticLoader = React.memo(
  ({ size = 28, color = COLORS.cyan }: { size?: number; color?: string }) => {
    const isLightMode = getLastSyncedKineticTheme() === 'light';
    const effectiveColor = isLightMode && String(color).toUpperCase() === '#00F0FF' ? '#0284C7' : color;
    const rotateAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    useEffect(() => {
      if (size <= 18) return;
      const rotateLoop = Animated.loop(
        Animated.timing(rotateAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 1050, easing: Easing.linear, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      );
      rotateLoop.start();
      return () => {
        rotateLoop.stop();
      };
    }, [rotateAnim, size]);

    if (size <= 18) return <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={effectiveColor} />;
    const hexClean = String(effectiveColor || '#00F0FF').replace('#', '%23');
    const boltSvgDataUri = `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="${hexClean}"><path d="M13 2L3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9l1-8z"/></svg>`;
    const spin = rotateAnim.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: ['0deg', '360deg'] });

    return (
      <View style={{ justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', width: size + 16, height: size + 16 }}>
        <Animated.View
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', width: size + 12, height: size + 12, borderRadius: (size + 12) / 2,
            backgroundColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.12)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.14)',
            borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: isLightMode ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.35)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)',
            borderTopColor: isLightMode ? '#0284C7' : '#00F0FF',
            transform: [{ rotate: spin }],
          }}
        />
        <Image source={{ uri: boltSvgDataUri }} style={{ width: size, height: size }} contentFit="contain" cachePolicy="memory-disk" priority="low" />
      </View>
    );
  },
);

const _cachedSmartImageUris = new Set<string>();

interface ISmartImageProps {
  source?: string | number | { uri?: string | null } | null;
  uri?: string | null;
  fallbackUri?: string | null;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  contentFit?: ImageContentFit;
  contentPosition?: ImageContentPosition;
  fallbackCategory?: string;
  transition?: number;
  priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'normal' | 'high';
}

export const SmartImage = React.memo(
  ({
    source,
    uri,
    fallbackUri,
    style,
    contentFit = 'cover',
    contentPosition = 'center',
    fallbackCategory = 'Fuerza',
    transition = 180,
    priority = 'low',
  }: ISmartImageProps) => {
    const numericSource = typeof source === 'number' ? source : null;
    const sourceObjUri = typeof source === 'object' && source !== null && 'uri' in source ? source.uri : undefined;
    const rawUri =
      typeof source === 'string'
        ? source.trim()
        : sourceObjUri
        ? String(sourceObjUri).trim()
        : uri
        ? String(uri).trim()
        : '';
    const safeFallbackUri = fallbackUri ? String(fallbackUri).trim() : '';

    const [errorStage, setErrorStage] = useState(0);
    const hasError = errorStage > 0;
    const [isDecoded, setIsDecoded] = useState<boolean>(
      () => numericSource !== null || Boolean(rawUri && _cachedSmartImageUris.has(rawUri))
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      setErrorStage(0);
      setIsDecoded(numericSource !== null || Boolean(rawUri && _cachedSmartImageUris.has(rawUri)));
    }, [rawUri, fallbackCategory, numericSource]);

    const optimizedRawUri = useMemo(() => {
      if (!rawUri || rawUri.length < 5) return rawUri;
      return getOptimizedImageUrl(rawUri, {
        quality: 80,
        format: 'webp',
        resize: contentFit === 'contain' ? 'contain' : 'cover',
      });
    }, [rawUri, contentFit]);

    const resolvedSource = useMemo(() => {
      if (errorStage >= 2) return { uri: GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI };
      if (hasError) {
        const tier1 = safeFallbackUri.length > 4 ? safeFallbackUri : resolveCategoryImage(fallbackCategory);
        return { uri: tier1 || GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI };
      }
      if (numericSource !== null) return numericSource;
      if (optimizedRawUri.length > 4) return { uri: optimizedRawUri };
      return { uri: resolveCategoryImage(fallbackCategory) || GUARANTEED_FALLBACK_FITNESS_URI };
    }, [hasError, errorStage, optimizedRawUri, fallbackCategory, safeFallbackUri, numericSource]);

    const effectiveTransition = rawUri && _cachedSmartImageUris.has(rawUri) ? 0 : transition;
    const resolvedPriority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' =
      priority === 'high' ? 'high' : priority === 'medium' || priority === 'normal' ? 'normal' : 'low';

    return (
      <View style={[{ overflow: 'hidden' }, style]} pointerEvents="none" collapsable={false}>
        {!isDecoded && (
          <SkeletonShimmer style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 }} />
        )}
        <Image
          source={resolvedSource}
          recyclingKey={rawUri || String(numericSource ?? fallbackCategory)}
          style={baseStyles.fullImageFill}
          contentFit={contentFit}
          contentPosition={contentPosition}
          transition={effectiveTransition}
          cachePolicy="memory-disk"
          priority={resolvedPriority}
          onLoad={() => {
            if (rawUri) _cachedSmartImageUris.add(rawUri);
            setIsDecoded(true);
          }}
          onLoadEnd={() => setIsDecoded(true)}
          onError={() => {
            if (errorStage >= 1) setIsDecoded(true);
            setErrorStage((prev) => Math.min(2, prev + 1));
          }}
        />
      </View>
    );
  },
  (prev, next) => {
    const prevObjUri = typeof prev.source === 'object' && prev.source !== null && 'uri' in prev.source ? prev.source.uri : undefined;
    const nextObjUri = typeof next.source === 'object' && next.source !== null && 'uri' in next.source ? next.source.uri : undefined;
    const prevRaw = typeof prev.source === 'string' ? prev.source : prevObjUri || prev.uri || '';
    const nextRaw = typeof next.source === 'string' ? next.source : nextObjUri || next.uri || '';
    const prevNum = typeof prev.source === 'number' ? prev.source : null;
    const nextNum = typeof next.source === 'number' ? next.source : null;
    return (
      prevRaw === nextRaw &&
      prevNum === nextNum &&
      prev.priority === next.priority &&
      prev.fallbackUri === next.fallbackUri &&
      prev.fallbackCategory === next.fallbackCategory &&
      prev.contentFit === next.contentFit &&
      prev.contentPosition === next.contentPosition &&
      prev.style === next.style
    );
  },
);

export const KineticSmartImage = SmartImage;

export const GpuProgressBar = ({
  progress = 0,
  color = COLORS.cyan,
  height = 7,
  backgroundColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
  isLightMode: isLightModeProp,
}: {
  progress: number;
  color?: string;
  height?: number;
  duration?: number;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  isLightMode?: boolean;
}) => {
  const isLightMode = typeof isLightModeProp === 'boolean' ? isLightModeProp : getLastSyncedKineticTheme() === 'light';
  const clamped = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(progress) || 0));
  const isDefaultTrack = backgroundColor === 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' || backgroundColor === 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)';
  const resolvedTrack = isLightMode && isDefaultTrack ? '#E2E8F0' : backgroundColor;
  const normFill = String(color || '').toUpperCase();
  const resolvedFill = isLightMode
    ? normFill === '#00F0FF' || normFill === '#00E5FF'
      ? '#0284C7'
      : normFill === '#00FF66'
      ? '#059669'
      : normFill === '#FFCC00' || normFill === '#FFD700'
      ? '#D97706'
      : normFill === '#E0AAFF'
      ? '#7C3AED'
      : color
    : color;

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height,
        backgroundColor: resolvedTrack,
        borderRadius: height / 2,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        borderWidth: isLightMode && isDefaultTrack ? 0.8 : 0,
        borderColor: '#CBD5E1',
      }}
    >
      <View style={{ width: `${clamped}%`, height: '100%', backgroundColor: resolvedFill, borderRadius: height / 2 }} />
    </View>
  );
};

export const PulseBadge = React.memo(({ color = COLORS.cyan, size = 8 }: { color?: string; size?: number }) => {
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  useEffect(() => {
    const loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1.35, duration: 650, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 650, useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' }),
      ]),
    );
    loop.start();
    return () => loop.stop();
  }, [scaleAnim]);

  return <Animated.View style={{ width: size, height: size, borderRadius: size / 2, backgroundColor: color, transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }] }} />;
});

import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { type Href, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Image, Linking, Modal, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, View } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync,
  revokeFounderWebDevicePassSync,
  subscribeFounderWebDevicePass,
  tapFounderCopyrightCounter,
  writeFounderWebDevicePassSync,
} from '../../services/kineticFounderWebPassLeaf';
import {
  KINETIC_CAROUSEL_ITEMS,
  KINETIC_CONCIERGE_CHIPS,
  KINETIC_HERO_SCENES,
  KINETIC_QUICK_ICONS,
  KINETIC_SCROLL_CARDS,
  KINETIC_STEALTH_FAQS,
  resolveKineticConciergeReply,
  type KineticLang,
} from '../shared/kineticWebLandingStealthData';
import { askKineticConciergeCloud } from '../../services/kineticConciergeCloudService';
import { KineticWebPassModalFields } from './KineticWebPassModalFields';
import { styles } from './KineticWebLanding.styles';

export { KINETIC_REVEAL_DROPS } from '../shared/kineticWebLandingStealthData';

export function isKineticWebLandingHost(): boolean {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location) return false;
  const hostname = String(window.location.hostname || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const search = String(window.location.search || '');
  if (search.includes('landing=1')) return true;
  return hostname === 'kineticapp.com.mx' || hostname === 'www.kineticapp.com.mx';
}

interface SheetDetail { titleBright: string; titleTitanium: string; accent: string; bullets: string[]; }
type RoleChoice = 'atleta' | 'club' | 'especialista';
interface ChatBubble { id: string; from: 'ai' | 'user'; text: string; ctaRole?: RoleChoice; }
const KINETIC_MARK_SOURCE = require('../../../assets/logo.png');
const WebIframeTag = 'iframe' as unknown as React.ComponentType<React.IframeHTMLAttributes<HTMLIFrameElement>>;
const ICON_MAP: Record<string, keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap> = {
  radar: 'radio', space3d: 'box', evolution: 'zap', community: 'users', venues: 'map-pin',
};

export function KineticWebLanding() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [ui, setUi] = useState<{
    lang: KineticLang;
    sceneIdx: number;
    paused: boolean;
    openAcc: string | null;
    sheet: SheetDetail | null;
    founderUnlocked: boolean;
  }>(() => ({
    lang: 'es',
    sceneIdx: 0,
    paused: false,
    openAcc: null,
    sheet: null,
    founderUnlocked: isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync(),
  }));
  const [waitlist, setWaitlist] = useState<{
    role: RoleChoice;
    name: string;
    bizDetail: string;
    email: string;
    whatsapp: string;
    busy: boolean;
    errorMsg: string;
    success: boolean;
  }>({ role: 'atleta', name: '', bizDetail: '', email: '', whatsapp: '', busy: false, errorMsg: '', success: false });
  const [concierge, setConcierge] = useState<{ open: boolean; input: string; log: ChatBubble[] }>({ open: false, input: '', log: [] });
  const [founderGate, setFounderGate] = useState<{ open: boolean; email: string; password: string; busy: boolean; errorMsg: string }>({
    open: false,
    email: '',
    password: '',
    busy: false,
    errorMsg: '',
  });

  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollView | null>(null);
  const touchXRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const founderBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const cooldownUntilRef = useRef(0);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const conciergeSeqRef = useRef(0);
  const founderTapRef = useRef<{ count: number; lastMs: number }>({ count: 0, lastMs: 0 });
  useEffect(() => { conciergeSeqRef.current += 1; }, [ui.lang]);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    const unsubFounder = subscribeFounderWebDevicePass(() => {
      if (mountedRef.current) setUi((prev) => ({ ...prev, founderUnlocked: isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync() }));
    });
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      unsubFounder();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || ui.paused) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (mountedRef.current) setUi((prev) => ({ ...prev, sceneIdx: (prev.sceneIdx + 1) % KINETIC_HERO_SCENES.length }));
    }, 5200);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [ui.paused]);

  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    const querySuffix = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location ? String(window.location.search || '') : '';
    return (
      <View style={styles.root}>
        <WebIframeTag
          src={`/landing.html${querySuffix}`}
          title="KINETIC — Fitness, Deporte & Wellness"
          style={{ border: 'none', width: '100%', height: '100%', backgroundColor: '#050505', display: 'block' }}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const { lang, sceneIdx, paused, openAcc, sheet, founderUnlocked } = ui;
  const isEn = lang === 'en';
  const scene = KINETIC_HERO_SCENES[sceneIdx] || KINETIC_HERO_SCENES[0];
  const roleLabel = waitlist.role === 'club' ? 'Club / Estudio B2B' : waitlist.role === 'especialista' ? 'Especialista / Consultorio B2B' : 'Atleta Acceso Prioritario';
  const bizPlaceholder = waitlist.role === 'club' ? (isEn ? 'Club or studio name' : 'Nombre del club o estudio') : (isEn ? 'Clinic name or specialty' : 'Nombre del consultorio o especialidad');

  const handleConciergeAsk = (rawPrompt: string) => {
    const cleanQ = rawPrompt.trim();
    if (!cleanQ) return;
    const baseReply = resolveKineticConciergeReply(cleanQ, lang);
    const seq = ++conciergeSeqRef.current;
    setConcierge((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      input: '',
      log: [...prev.log, { id: `u_${seq}`, from: 'user', text: cleanQ }],
    }));
    void askKineticConciergeCloud({
      query: cleanQ,
      isLanding: true,
      preferredLang: lang,
      localFallback: () => baseReply.text,
    }).then((out) => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || seq !== conciergeSeqRef.current) return;
      setConcierge((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        log: [...prev.log, { id: `a_${seq}`, from: 'ai', text: out.text, ctaRole: baseReply.ctaRole }],
      }));
    });
  };

  const openConcierge = () => {
    setConcierge((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      open: true,
      log: prev.log.length > 0 ? prev.log : [{
        id: 'welcome',
        from: 'ai',
        text: isEn
          ? 'Welcome to Kinetic Concierge 24/7. Ask me about disciplines, 3D spot selection, levels & reward chests, or founding venues.'
          : 'Bienvenido al Concierge 24/7 de Kinetic. Pregúntame sobre disciplinas, selección 3D, niveles y cofres o cómo sumar tu sede.',
      }],
    }));
  };

  const handleCopyrightTap = () => {
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    const res = tapFounderCopyrightCounter(founderTapRef.current.count, founderTapRef.current.lastMs, nowMs);
    founderTapRef.current = { count: res.count, lastMs: res.triggered ? 0 : nowMs };
    if (res.triggered) setFounderGate({ open: true, email: '', password: '', busy: false, errorMsg: '' });
  };

  const handleFounderUnlockSubmit = async () => {
    if (founderBusyRef.current) return;
    const cleanEmail = founderGate.email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const rawPass = founderGate.password;
    if (!cleanEmail || rawPass.length < 6) {
      setFounderGate((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Enter Master Admin credentials.' : 'Ingresa credenciales Master Admin.' }));
      return;
    }
    founderBusyRef.current = true;
    setFounderGate((p) => ({ ...p, busy: true, errorMsg: '' }));
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: cleanEmail, password: rawPass });
      if (error || !data?.user?.id) throw new Error('AUTH_REJECTED');
      const { data: isMaster, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc('is_kinetic_master_admin');
      await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }).catch(() => {});
      if (rpcErr || isMaster !== true) throw new Error('ADMIN_REQUIRED');
      const savedOk = writeFounderWebDevicePassSync(data.user.id, cleanEmail);
      if (!savedOk) throw new Error('STORAGE_BLOCKED');
      if (mountedRef.current) setFounderGate({ open: false, email: '', password: '', busy: false, errorMsg: '' });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error && err.message === 'STORAGE_BLOCKED'
        ? (isEn ? 'Browser storage is blocked; unable to save device pass.' : 'El almacenamiento del navegador está bloqueado.')
        : (isEn ? 'Access denied: Master Admin required.' : 'Acceso denegado: requiere Master Admin.');
      if (mountedRef.current) setFounderGate((p) => ({ ...p, busy: false, errorMsg: msg }));
    } finally {
      founderBusyRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current) return;
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    if (nowMs < cooldownUntilRef.current) {
      setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Please wait a few seconds before submitting again.' : 'Espera unos segundos antes de volver a enviar.' }));
      return;
    }
    const cleanName = waitlist.name.trim();
    const cleanBiz = waitlist.bizDetail.trim();
    const cleanEmail = waitlist.email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const digits = waitlist.whatsapp.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (cleanName.length < 2) { setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Enter your full name.' : 'Ingresa tu nombre completo.' })); return; }
    if (waitlist.role !== 'atleta' && cleanBiz.length < 2) { setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Enter your club or specialty.' : 'Ingresa el nombre de tu club o especialidad.' })); return; }
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(cleanEmail)) { setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Enter a valid email address.' : 'Ingresa un correo electrónico válido.' })); return; }
    if (digits.length < 10 || digits.length > 15) { setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Enter a valid 10-digit WhatsApp number.' : 'Ingresa un WhatsApp válido de 10 dígitos.' })); return; }
    busyRef.current = true;
    cooldownUntilRef.current = nowMs + 10_000;
    setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, busy: true, errorMsg: '' }));
    const discVal = waitlist.role !== 'atleta' ? `Acceso Anticipado Web • Sede/Esp: ${cleanBiz}` : 'Acceso Anticipado Web';
    try {
      const r1 = await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
        { nombre: cleanName, email: cleanEmail, whatsapp: digits, perfil_interes: roleLabel, zona: 'Acceso Prioritario Web', disciplina_favorita: discVal, origen: 'kineticapp.com.mx' },
      ]);
      if (r1.error) {
        const r2 = await supabase.from('fundadores_waitlist').insert([
          { nombre: cleanName, email: cleanEmail, telefono: digits, tipo_perfil: roleLabel, ciudad_zona: 'Acceso Prioritario Web', disciplina_interes: discVal, origen: 'kineticapp.com.mx' },
        ]);
        if (r2.error && !String(r2.error.code || '').includes('23505')) throw r2.error;
      }
      if (mountedRef.current) setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, success: true }));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      cooldownUntilRef.current = 0;
      if (mountedRef.current) setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, errorMsg: isEn ? 'Could not register right now. Try again.' : 'No pudimos registrar ahora. Intenta de nuevo.' }));
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setWaitlist((p) => ({ ...p, busy: false }));
    }
  };

      <Modal visible={Boolean(sheet)} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setUi((p) => ({ ...p, sheet: null }))}>

    // === src/components/web/KineticWebPassModalFields.tsx === //
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, TextInput, View } from 'react-native';
import { redeemPrivateWebInviteCloud } from '../../services/kineticWebPrivatePassLeaf';

export function KineticWebPassModalFields(props: {
  isEn: boolean;
  inputStyle: object;
  btnStyle: object;
  btnTextStyle: object;
  onSuccess: (targetPath: '/login' | '/socios') => void;
}) {
  const { isEn, inputStyle, btnStyle, btnTextStyle, onSuccess } = props;
  const [inviteCode, setInviteCode] = useState('');
  const [inviteState, setInviteState] = useState<{ busy: boolean; err: string }>({ busy: false, err: '' });
  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { isMountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  const handleRedeem = async () => {
    if (busyRef.current || inviteState.busy) return;
    busyRef.current = true;
    setInviteState({ busy: true, err: '' });
    try {
      const res = await redeemPrivateWebInviteCloud(inviteCode);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (res.ok && res.targetPath) {
        setInviteCode('');
        setInviteState({ busy: false, err: '' });
        onSuccess(res.targetPath);
        return;
      }
      const errTxt =
        res.reason === 'RATE_LIMITED'
          ? (isEn ? 'Too many attempts. Wait 10 min.' : 'Demasiados intentos. Espera 10 min.')
          : (isEn ? 'Invalid, expired or revoked invite code.' : 'Clave inválida, expirada o revocada.');
      setInviteState({ busy: false, err: errTxt });
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (isMountedRef.current) setInviteState((p) => (p.busy ? { ...p, busy: false } : p));
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ marginTop: 12, paddingBottom: 12, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' }}>
      <Text style={{ color: '#00F0FF', fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: '800', letterSpacing: 1.2, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {isEn ? 'INVITATION CODE' : 'CLAVE DE INVITACIÓN PRIVADA'}
      </Text>
      <TextInput
        style={[inputStyle, { fontSize: 16 }]}
        placeholder="KNT-XXXX-XXXX"
        placeholderTextColor="#64748B"
        autoCapitalize="characters"
        value={inviteCode}
        onChangeText={setInviteCode}
      />
      {Boolean(inviteState.err) && (
        <Text style={{ color: '#FF3B30', fontSize: 12.5, marginBottom: 8 }}>{inviteState.err}</Text>
      )}
      <Pressable
        style={[btnStyle, { backgroundColor: '#7B61FF' }, inviteState.busy && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
        disabled={inviteState.busy}
        onPress={handleRedeem}
      >
        <Text style={[btnTextStyle, { color: '#FFFFFF' }]}>
          {inviteState.busy ? '...' : isEn ? 'Redeem Invitation Key' : 'Canjear Clave Privada'}
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

const DISC_EN_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  fuerza: 'Strength',
  padel: 'Padel',
  pilates: 'Pilates',
  boxeo: 'Boxing',
  yoga: 'Yoga',
  crossfit: 'CrossFit',
  ciclismo: 'Cycling',
  natacion: 'Swimming',
  fisioterapia: 'Physiotherapy',
  movilidad: 'Mobility',
  surf: 'Surf',
  'cold plunge': 'Cold Plunge',
};

export function translateDisciplineTokenEn(raw: string): string {
  const clean = String(raw || '').trim();
  const norm = clean
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  return DISC_EN_MAP[norm] || clean;
}

const STARTER_EN: Record<string, { titulo: string; desc: string; req: string }> = {
  reto_1: { titulo: 'Active Kinetic Identity', desc: 'Activate your athlete account and explore the verified venue network.', req: 'Active Profile' },
  reto_2: { titulo: 'First App Streak Day', desc: 'Verify your first active day in Kinetic and start your streak.', req: '1-Day Streak' },
  reto_3: { titulo: 'First Active QR Check-in', desc: 'Complete your first session validated with a dynamic QR Pass at reception.', req: '1 QR Session' },
  reto_4: { titulo: 'Radar Explorer', desc: 'Visit your first affiliated club or specialist in the network.', req: '1 Venue Visited' },
  reto_5: { titulo: 'Team Spirit', desc: 'Join or create your first training team in KinetiClub.', req: '1 Active Team' },
  reto_6: { titulo: '2-Day Consistency', desc: 'Maintain an active streak for 2 consecutive days.', req: '2-Day Streak' },
  reto_7: { titulo: 'Double QR Check-in', desc: 'Complete 2 workouts validated with a dynamic QR Pass.', req: '2 QR Sessions' },
  reto_8: { titulo: 'Discipline Duo', desc: 'Complete sessions across 2 distinct sports or wellness disciplines.', req: '2 Disciplines' },
  reto_9: { titulo: '2-Venue Route', desc: 'Train at 2 different clubs or studios across the network.', req: '2 Distinct Venues' },
  reto_10: { titulo: 'Starter Triad (3 Days)', desc: 'Maintain an active 3-day streak on Kinetic.', req: '3-Day Streak' },
};

export interface IChallengeLocalizable {
  id?: string;
  divisionLabel?: string;
  titulo?: string;
  desc?: string;
  requisitoCorto?: string;
  tituloEn?: string;
  descEn?: string;
  requisitoCortoEn?: string;
}

export function localizeKineticChallengeEn<T extends IChallengeLocalizable>(challenge: T): T {
  const id = String(challenge?.id || '');
  const divLabelEn = String(challenge?.divisionLabel || '')
    .replace(/\bF[ÁA]CIL\b/gi, 'EASY')
    .replace(/\bINTERMEDIO\b/gi, 'INTERMEDIATE')
    .replace(/\bAVANZADO\b/gi, 'ADVANCED')
    .replace(/\bLEYENDA\b/gi, 'LEGEND')
    .replace(/\bSESIONES\b/g, 'SESSIONS')
    .replace(/\bRACHA\b/g, 'STREAK')
    .replace(/\bCLUBES\b/g, 'VENUES')
    .replace(/\bDISCIPLINAS\b/g, 'DISCIPLINES')
    .replace(/•\s*(.+)$/, (_, tail) => `• ${translateDisciplineTokenEn(tail).toUpperCase()}`);

  const starter = STARTER_EN[id];
  if (starter) {
    return { ...challenge, divisionLabel: divLabelEn, titulo: starter.titulo, desc: starter.desc, requisitoCorto: starter.req };
  }
  if (challenge.tituloEn && challenge.descEn && challenge.requisitoCortoEn) {
    return {
      ...challenge,
      divisionLabel: divLabelEn,
      titulo: challenge.tituloEn,
      desc: challenge.descEn,
      requisitoCorto: challenge.requisitoCortoEn,
    };
  }
  const titulo = String(challenge.titulo || '')
    .replace(/^Potencia QR • #(\d+)$/i, 'QR Power • #$1')
    .replace(/^Maestr[íi]a Multidisciplina • #(\d+)$/i, 'Multi-Discipline Mastery • #$1')
    .replace(/^Racha Imparable (\d+)D • #(\d+)$/i, 'Unstoppable Streak $1D • #$2')
    .replace(/^Ruta de (\d+) Sedes • #(\d+)$/i, '$1-Venue Route • #$2')
    .replace(/^Explorador (\d+) Disciplinas • #(\d+)$/i, '$1-Discipline Explorer • #$2')
    .replace(/^Especialista (.+) • #(\d+)$/i, (_, d, n) => `${translateDisciplineTokenEn(d)} Specialist • #${n}`);
  const desc = String(challenge.desc || '')
    .replace(/^Completa (\d+) sesiones validadas con pase QR de acceso en la red\.$/i, 'Complete $1 sessions validated with a dynamic QR pass across the network.')
    .replace(/^Mant[ée]n una racha activa de (\d+) d[íi]as consecutivos en Kinetic\.$/i, 'Maintain an active streak of $1 consecutive days on Kinetic.')
    .replace(/^Reserva y entrena en (\d+) sedes afiliadas distintas\.$/i, 'Book and complete check-ins at $1 distinct partner venues.')
    .replace(/^Entrena en (\d+) disciplinas distintas verificadas en la red\.$/i, 'Complete verified workouts across $1 distinct disciplines.')
    .replace(/^Completa (\d+) sesiones certificadas de (.+) en clubes de la red\.$/i, (_, m, d) => `Complete ${m} certified ${translateDisciplineTokenEn(d)} sessions across network clubs.`);
  const req = String(challenge.requisitoCorto || '')
    .replace(/^(\d+) Sesiones QR$/i, '$1 QR Sessions')
    .replace(/^Racha (\d+) D[íi]as$/i, '$1-Day Streak')
    .replace(/^(\d+) Sedes Distintas$/i, '$1 Distinct Venues')
    .replace(/^(\d+) Disciplinas$/i, '$1 Disciplines')
    .replace(/^(\d+) en (.+)$/i, (_, m, d) => `${m} in ${translateDisciplineTokenEn(d)}`);
  return { ...challenge, divisionLabel: divLabelEn, titulo, desc, requisitoCorto: req };
}

export const translateVaultDivisionLabel = (raw: string, language: string): string => {
  if (language !== 'en' || !raw) return raw;
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N F[ÁA]CIL/gi, 'EASY DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N INTERMEDI[OA]/gi, 'INTERMEDIATE DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N AVANZAD[OA]/gi, 'ADVANCED DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N PRO/gi, 'PRO DIVISION')
    .replace(/DIVISI[ÓO]N LEYENDA/gi, 'LEGEND DIVISION')
    .replace(/\bF[ÁA]CIL\b/gi, 'EASY')
    .replace(/\bINTERMEDIO\b/gi, 'INTERMEDIATE')
    .replace(/\bAVANZADO\b/gi, 'ADVANCED')
    .replace(/\bLEYENDA\b/gi, 'LEGEND')
    .replace(/\bSESIONES\b/g, 'SESSIONS')
    .replace(/\bRACHA\b/g, 'STREAK')
    .replace(/\bCLUBES\b/g, 'VENUES')
    .replace(/\bDISCIPLINAS\b/g, 'DISCIPLINES');
};

import { ITrofeo } from '../types';
import { translateDisciplineTokenEn } from './challenges250LocalizationLeaf';

  { level: 2, title: 'Atleta de Impacto', requiredXp: 750 },

  { level: 4, title: 'Élite del Corredor', requiredXp: 2000 },
  { level: 5, title: 'Leyenda Mensual', requiredXp: 2500 },
];

const DISCIPLINE_POOL_10 = [
  'Fuerza',
  'Pádel',
  'Pilates',
  'Boxeo',
  'Yoga',
  'CrossFit',
  'Ciclismo',
  'Natación',
  'Fisioterapia',
  'Movilidad',
] as const;

const TIER_CONFIGS = [
  { key: 'facil', label: 'FÁCIL', labelEn: 'EASY', xpBase: 20 },
  { key: 'intermedio', label: 'INTERMEDIO', labelEn: 'INTERMEDIATE', xpBase: 55 },
  { key: 'avanzado', label: 'AVANZADO', labelEn: 'ADVANCED', xpBase: 115 },
  { key: 'pro', label: 'PRO', labelEn: 'PRO', xpBase: 220 },
  { key: 'leyenda', label: 'LEYENDA', labelEn: 'LEGEND', xpBase: 400 },
] as const;

type TierCfg = (typeof TIER_CONFIGS)[number];

const buildChallengeForSlot = (tierCfg: TierCfg, globalNum: number, id: string, codigo: string): ITrofeo => {
  const k = Math.floor((globalNum - 11) / 5);
  const slot = (globalNum - 11) % 5;
  if (slot === 0) {
    const metaSesiones = 3 + k * 6;
    return {
      id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo} • SESIONES`,
      titulo: `Potencia QR • ${codigo}`, desc: `Completa ${metaSesiones} sesiones validadas con pase QR de acceso en la red.`,
      requisitoCorto: `${metaSesiones} Sesiones QR`, meta: metaSesiones, tipo: 'sesiones', familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'zap', recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + (k % 3) * 5, recompensaKc: 0,
    };
  }
  if (slot === 1) {
    const metaRacha = 4 + k * 5;
    return {
      id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo} • RACHA`,
      titulo: `Racha Imparable ${metaRacha}D • ${codigo}`, desc: `Mantén una racha activa de ${metaRacha} días consecutivos en Kinetic.`,
      requisitoCorto: `Racha ${metaRacha} Días`, meta: metaRacha, tipo: 'racha', familia: 'sesiones',
      icon: 'flame', recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 10 + (k % 2) * 5, recompensaKc: 0,
    };
  }
  if (slot === 2) {
    const metaClubes = Math.min(25, 2 + Math.floor(k / 2));
    return {
      id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo} • CLUBES`,
      titulo: `Ruta de ${metaClubes} Sedes • ${codigo}`, desc: `Reserva y entrena en ${metaClubes} sedes afiliadas distintas.`,
      requisitoCorto: `${metaClubes} Sedes Distintas`, meta: metaClubes, tipo: 'clubes_visitados', familia: 'clubes',
      icon: 'map-pin', recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 15, recompensaKc: 0,
    };
  }
  if (slot === 3) {
    const dName = DISCIPLINE_POOL_10[k % DISCIPLINE_POOL_10.length];
    const metaDisc = 2 + Math.floor(k / 10) * 8 + Math.floor((k % 10) / 2);
    const dEn = translateDisciplineTokenEn(dName);
    return {
      id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo} • ${dName.toUpperCase()}`,
      titulo: `Especialista ${dName} • ${codigo}`, desc: `Completa ${metaDisc} sesiones certificadas de ${dName} en clubes de la red.`,
      requisitoCorto: `${metaDisc} en ${dName}`, tituloEn: `${dEn} Specialist • ${codigo}`,
      descEn: `Complete ${metaDisc} certified ${dEn} sessions across network clubs.`, requisitoCortoEn: `${metaDisc} in ${dEn}`,
      meta: metaDisc, tipo: 'disciplina_especifica', familia: 'experto', disciplinaClave: dName,
      icon: 'award', recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 20, recompensaKc: 0,
    };
  }
  if (k < 36) {
    const metaDiscCount = Math.min(10, 3 + Math.floor(k / 5));
    return {
      id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo} • DISCIPLINAS`,
      titulo: `Explorador ${metaDiscCount} Disciplinas • ${codigo}`, desc: `Entrena en ${metaDiscCount} disciplinas distintas verificadas en la red.`,
      requisitoCorto: `${metaDiscCount} Disciplinas`, meta: metaDiscCount, tipo: 'disciplinas', familia: 'experto',
      icon: 'compass', recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 25, recompensaKc: 0,
    };
  }
  const metaMaster = 290 + (k - 36) * 10;
  return {
    id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo} • SESIONES`,
    titulo: `Maestría Multidisciplina • ${codigo}`, desc: `Completa ${metaMaster} sesiones validadas con pase QR de acceso en la red.`,
    requisitoCorto: `${metaMaster} Sesiones QR`, meta: metaMaster, tipo: 'sesiones', familia: 'sesiones',
    icon: 'award', recompensaXp: tierCfg.xpBase + 25, recompensaKc: 0,
  };
};

const build250Challenges = (): ITrofeo[] => {
  const starterChallenges = [
    { titulo: 'Identidad Activa en Kinetic', desc: 'Activa tu cuenta y explora el directorio de marcas en la red.', req: 'Perfil Activo', meta: 1, tipo: 'habito_app', familia: 'sesiones', icon: 'user-check', xp: 20 },
    { titulo: 'Primer Día de Racha en App', desc: 'Abre tu panel de constancia y registra tu primer día activo.', req: 'Racha 1 Día', meta: 1, tipo: 'racha', familia: 'sesiones', icon: 'zap', xp: 25 },
    { titulo: 'Primer Check-in QR Activo', desc: 'Completa tu primera sesión validada con pase QR de acceso en recepción.', req: '1 Sesión QR', meta: 1, tipo: 'sesiones', familia: 'sesiones', icon: 'check-circle', xp: 30 },
    { titulo: 'Explorador de Radar', desc: 'Visita tu primer club o especialista afiliado en la red.', req: '1 Sede Visitada', meta: 1, tipo: 'clubes_visitados', familia: 'clubes', icon: 'map-pin', xp: 35 },
    { titulo: 'Espíritu de Equipo', desc: 'Únete o funda tu primer equipo en KinetiClub.', req: '1 Equipo Activo', meta: 1, tipo: 'equipo', familia: 'clubes', icon: 'users', xp: 15 },
    { titulo: 'Constancia de 2 Días', desc: 'Mantén una racha activa de 2 días consecutivos en Kinetic.', req: 'Racha 2 Días', meta: 2, tipo: 'racha', familia: 'sesiones', icon: 'trending-up', xp: 20 },
    { titulo: 'Doble Check-in QR', desc: 'Completa 2 entrenamientos validados con Pase QR.', req: '2 Sesiones QR', meta: 2, tipo: 'sesiones', familia: 'sesiones', icon: 'activity', xp: 35 },
    { titulo: 'Dúo de Disciplinas', desc: 'Experimenta 2 disciplinas deportivas distintas en el ecosistema.', req: '2 Disciplinas', meta: 2, tipo: 'disciplinas', familia: 'experto', icon: 'compass', xp: 30 },
    { titulo: 'Ruta de 2 Sedes', desc: 'Entrena en 2 clubes o estudios diferentes de la red.', req: '2 Sedes Distintas', meta: 2, tipo: 'clubes_visitados', familia: 'clubes', icon: 'navigation', xp: 35 },
    { titulo: 'Tríada de Inicio (3 Días)', desc: 'Mantén una racha activa de 3 días consecutivos en Kinetic.', req: 'Racha 3 Días', meta: 3, tipo: 'racha', familia: 'sesiones', icon: 'award', xp: 15 },
  ] as const;

  const list: ITrofeo[] = [];
  let globalNum = 0;

  for (const tierCfg of TIER_CONFIGS) {
    for (let i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
      globalNum += 1;
      const id = `reto_${globalNum}`;
      const codigo = `#${String(globalNum).padStart(3, '0')}`;
      if (tierCfg.key === 'facil' && i <= 10) {
        const st = starterChallenges[i - 1];
        list.push({
          id, orden: globalNum, codigo, division: tierCfg.key, divisionLabel: `${tierCfg.label} ${codigo}`,
          titulo: st.titulo, desc: st.desc, requisitoCorto: st.req, meta: st.meta, tipo: st.tipo, familia: st.familia,
          icon: st.icon, recompensaXp: st.xp, recompensaKc: 0,
        });
        continue;
      }
      list.push(buildChallengeForSlot(tierCfg, globalNum, id, codigo));
    }
  }

  return list;
};

export const KINETIC_250_CHALLENGES: ITrofeo[] = build250Challenges();

const stripAccentsLower = (val: string): string =>
  val
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim();

const NORMALIZED_AMENITY_LOOKUP: Map<string, string> = (() => {
  const m = new Map<string, string>();
  Object.entries(AMENITY_EXACT_EN_MAP).forEach(([es, en]) => {
    m.set(stripAccentsLower(es), en);
  });
  Object.entries(AMENITY_ID_EN_MAP).forEach(([id, entry]) => {
    m.set(stripAccentsLower(id), entry.titleEn);
    m.set(stripAccentsLower(id.replace(/_/g, ' ')), entry.titleEn);
  });
  return m;
})();

export const translateAmenityLabelEn = (raw?: string | null): string | null => {
  const clean = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  if (AMENITY_EXACT_EN_MAP[clean]) return AMENITY_EXACT_EN_MAP[clean];
  const hit = NORMALIZED_AMENITY_LOOKUP.get(stripAccentsLower(clean));
  if (hit) return hit;

  if (clean.includes(' / ')) {
    const parts = clean.split(' / ').map((p) => p.trim());
    const mapped = parts.map((p) => translateAmenityLabelEn(p));
    if (mapped.some(Boolean)) {
      return mapped.map((mVal, idx) => mVal || parts[idx]).join(' / ');
    }
  }
  if (/\s+y\s+/i.test(clean)) {
    const parts = clean.split(/\s+y\s+/i).map((p) => p.trim());
    const mapped = parts.map((p) => translateAmenityLabelEn(p));
    if (mapped.every(Boolean)) {
      return mapped.join(' & ');
    }
  }
  if (/[_-]/.test(clean)) {
    return clean
      .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .replace(/(^|\s)\S/g, (ch) => ch.toUpperCase());
  }
  return null;
};
