    // === src/context/AuthContext.tsx === //
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { router as globalRouter } from 'expo-router';
import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Linking, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { CATEGORY_IMAGES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  bindWebAuthFocusGuards, executeAuthSignOutTeardown, syncOrCreateAuthProfileRow,
  toKineticAuthSession, toKineticAuthUser, verifyAndHydrateAuthSession, withAuthTimeout,
  type KineticAuthProfile, type KineticAuthSession, type KineticAuthUser,
} from '../services/kineticAuthContextHelpers';
import { clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge, setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge } from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import { doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, getMfaSecuritySnapshot, isPendingMfaGateActive, setPendingMfaGateActive } from '../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  claimExplicitSignOutLoginRedirect, clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit, isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  isRealSupabaseJwt, markExplicitKineticSignOut, persistKineticSessionSnapshot, purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly,
  readPersistedKineticSessionSync, resetExplicitKineticSignOut, runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks, synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import {
  markInteractiveLoginVerified,
  resetInteractiveLoginVerified,
} from '../services/kineticBiometricVaultService';
import { emitPostLoginPrefetch } from '../services/kineticSwrMemoryHub';
import { areProfilesEquivalent, areSessionsEquivalent, areUsersEquivalent, handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens } from '../services/kineticSessionReconciler';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from '../services/kineticVaultCrypto';
import { isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync } from '../services/kineticFounderWebPassLeaf';
import { shouldPreserveSessionOnTransientMfaCheckFailure } from '../utils/kineticWebSilentRevalidateLeaf';
import { shouldRequireMfaOnGoogleOAuthReturn } from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

export type { KineticAuthProfile, KineticAuthSession, KineticAuthUser };
interface AuthContextType {
  user: KineticAuthUser | null;
  session: KineticAuthSession | null;
  profile: KineticAuthProfile | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  loading: boolean;
  isSigningOut: boolean;
  refreshProfile: () => Promise<void>;
  activateResilientSession: (u: KineticAuthUser, p: KineticAuthProfile | null, s?: KineticAuthSession | null) => void;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
}
const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({
  user: null, session: null, profile: null, isLoading: true, loading: true, isSigningOut: false,
  refreshProfile: async () => {}, activateResilientSession: () => {}, signOut: async () => {},
});

const COLD_START_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS = 2200;
const BG_AUTH_RACE_MS = 3500;

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  const [initialHydrated] = useState(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return null;
    const snap = readPersistedKineticSessionSync();
    return snap && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(snap.session) ? snap : null;
  });
  const [user, setUser] = useState<KineticAuthUser | null>(() => (initialHydrated?.user as KineticAuthUser | undefined) ?? null);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<KineticAuthSession | null>(() => (initialHydrated?.session as KineticAuthSession | undefined) ?? null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<KineticAuthProfile | null>(() => (initialHydrated?.profile as KineticAuthProfile | undefined) ?? null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !(Boolean(initialHydrated?.user) || (Platform.OS === 'web' && isExplicitKineticSignOut())));
  const [isSigningOut, setIsSigningOut] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const hasHydratedInitialRef = useRef<boolean>(Boolean(initialHydrated?.user));
  const fetchingUserIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const fetchReqIdRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const signOutSeqRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const userRef = useRef<KineticAuthUser | null>(user);
  const profileRef = useRef<KineticAuthProfile | null>(profile);
  const sessionRef = useRef<KineticAuthSession | null>(session);

  const finishInitialHydration = useCallback(() => {
    hasHydratedInitialRef.current = true;
    setIsLoading((prev) => (prev ? false : prev));
  }, []);

  const commitUserIfChanged = useCallback((nextUser: KineticAuthUser | null) => {
    userRef.current = nextUser;
    setUser((prev) => (areUsersEquivalent(prev, nextUser) ? prev : nextUser));
  }, []);

  const commitSessionIfChanged = useCallback((nextSession: KineticAuthSession | null) => {
    sessionRef.current = nextSession;
    setSession((prev) => (areSessionsEquivalent(prev, nextSession) ? prev : nextSession));
  }, []);

  const commitProfileIfChanged = useCallback((nextProfile: KineticAuthProfile | null) => {
    profileRef.current = nextProfile;
    setProfile((prev) => (areProfilesEquivalent(prev, nextProfile) ? prev : nextProfile));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    userRef.current = user;
    profileRef.current = profile;
    sessionRef.current = session;
    if (user?.id && !isExplicitKineticSignOut() && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(session)) {
      const safeProf = !profile || !profile.id || String(profile.id) === String(user.id) ? profile : null;
      const safeSess = !session || !session.user?.id || String(session.user.id) === String(user.id) ? session : null;
      persistKineticSessionSnapshot(user, safeProf, safeSess);
      if (safeProf && !isPendingMfaGateActive()) {
        emitPostLoginPrefetch({
          user: user as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
          profile: safeProf as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
          session: safeSess as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
        });
      }
    }
  }, [user, profile, session]);

  const activateResilientSession = useCallback(
    (nextUser: KineticAuthUser, nextProfile: KineticAuthProfile | null, nextSession?: KineticAuthSession | null) => {
      if (!nextUser?.id || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(nextSession)) return;
      const sameOwnerSess =
        sessionRef.current &&
        String(sessionRef.current.user?.id || '') === String(nextUser.id) &&
        !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(sessionRef.current)
          ? sessionRef.current
          : null;
      const effectiveSession: KineticAuthSession | null =
        nextSession ||
        sameOwnerSess ||
        (isKineticDevRuntime()
          ? { access_token: `kinetic-resilient-${nextUser.id}`, token_type: 'bearer', user: nextUser }
          : null);
      if (!isKineticDevRuntime() && !isRealSupabaseJwt(effectiveSession?.access_token)) return;
      const prevActivatedUid = userRef.current?.id;
      const isSwitchedUser = Boolean(prevActivatedUid && String(prevActivatedUid) !== String(nextUser.id));
      if (!prevActivatedUid || isSwitchedUser) markInteractiveLoginVerified();
      resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
      clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
      if (isSwitchedUser) {
        runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks();
        commitProfileIfChanged(null);
      }
      const sameOwnerProf =
        !isSwitchedUser && profileRef.current && String(profileRef.current.id || '') === String(nextUser.id)
          ? profileRef.current
          : null;
      const mergedProfile = synthesizeProfileFromUser(nextUser, nextProfile || sameOwnerProf);
      persistKineticSessionSnapshot(nextUser, mergedProfile, effectiveSession);
      emitPostLoginPrefetch({
        user: nextUser as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
        profile: mergedProfile as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
        session: effectiveSession as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
      });
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setIsSigningOut(false);
        commitSessionIfChanged(effectiveSession);
        commitUserIfChanged(nextUser);
        commitProfileIfChanged(mergedProfile);
        finishInitialHydration();
      }
    },
    [commitProfileIfChanged, commitSessionIfChanged, commitUserIfChanged, finishInitialHydration]
  );

  const fetchUserProfile = useCallback(
    async (currentUser: KineticAuthUser) => {
      const targetUid = String(currentUser?.id || '');
      if (!targetUid || fetchingUserIdRef.current === targetUid) return;
      fetchingUserIdRef.current = targetUid;
      const reqId = ++fetchReqIdRef.current;
      const isStale = () =>
        !isMountedRef.current ||
        isExplicitKineticSignOut() ||
        reqId !== fetchReqIdRef.current ||
        !userRef.current?.id ||
        String(userRef.current.id) !== targetUid;
      const ownerSess = () =>
        sessionRef.current &&
        String(sessionRef.current.user?.id || '') === targetUid &&
        !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(sessionRef.current)
          ? sessionRef.current
          : null;
      const ownerProf = () =>
        profileRef.current && String(profileRef.current.id || '') === targetUid ? profileRef.current : null;

      try {
        const persisted = readPersistedKineticSessionSync();
        const samePersistedProf =
          persisted && String(persisted.user?.id || '') === targetUid && String(persisted.profile?.id || targetUid) === targetUid
            ? persisted.profile
            : null;
        const result = await syncOrCreateAuthProfileRow({
          currentUser,
          ownerProf: ownerProf(),
          fallbackPersistedProf: samePersistedProf,
          raceMs: BG_AUTH_RACE_MS,
          isStale,
        });
        if (!result || isStale()) return;
        if (!result.shouldPersistOnlyIfMissing || !ownerProf()) {
          commitProfileIfChanged(result.profile);
        }
        persistKineticSessionSnapshot(currentUser, ownerProf() || result.profile, ownerSess());
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        void err;
        if (!isStale() && currentUser?.id && !ownerProf()) {
          commitProfileIfChanged(synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, null));
        }
      } finally {
        if (fetchingUserIdRef.current === targetUid) fetchingUserIdRef.current = null;
      }
    },
    [commitProfileIfChanged]
  );

  const refreshProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return;
    const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
    try {
      const targetUser = userRef.current;
      if (targetUser?.id) {
        await fetchUserProfile(targetUser);
        return;
      }
      const {
        data: { session: activeSession },
      } = await withAuthTimeout(supabase.auth.getSession(), BG_AUTH_RACE_MS);
      const kSess = toKineticAuthSession(activeSession);
      if (
        !isMountedRef.current ||
        signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart ||
        isExplicitKineticSignOut() ||
        isPendingMfaGateActive() ||
        doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(kSess)
      ) {
        return;
      }
      if (kSess?.user?.id) {
        commitUserIfChanged(kSess.user);
        await fetchUserProfile(kSess.user);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  }, [commitUserIfChanged, fetchUserProfile]);

  const signOut = useCallback(async () => {
    const prevBioFlag = profileRef.current?.biometria_activa;
    const prevIdentity = userRef.current?.email || userRef.current?.id || null;
    resetInteractiveLoginVerified();
    markExplicitKineticSignOut();
    runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks();
    const seq = (signOutSeqRef.current += 1);
    fetchReqIdRef.current += 1;
    fetchingUserIdRef.current = null;
    setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
    userRef.current = null;
    profileRef.current = null;
    sessionRef.current = null;
    if (isMountedRef.current) {
      setIsSigningOut(true);
      setUser(null);
      setSession(null);
      setProfile(null);
    }
    const onSociosWeb =
      Platform.OS === 'web' &&
      typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      String(window.location?.pathname || '').startsWith('/socios');
    const webPostSignOutRoute = Platform.OS === 'web' && !isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync() ? '/' : '/login';
    if ((!onSociosWeb || webPostSignOutRoute === '/') && claimExplicitSignOutLoginRedirect()) {
      try { globalRouter.replace(webPostSignOutRoute); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }
    await executeAuthSignOutTeardown({
      prevBioFlag,
      prevIdentity,
      isStale: () => signOutSeqRef.current !== seq || !isExplicitKineticSignOut(),
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    const safetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (isMountedRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
    }, COLD_START_SAFETY_TIMEOUT_MS);

    const routeToMfaScreen = () => {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const p = String(window.location?.pathname || '');
        if (p.startsWith('/socios') || p.startsWith('/oauth')) return;
      }
      globalRouter.replace({ pathname: '/login', params: { mfa: '1' } });
    };

    const verifyAndHydrateRealSession = async () => {
      if (isPendingMfaGateActive() || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) {
        clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
        if (isMountedRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
      try {
        await verifyAndHydrateAuthSession({
          raceMs: BG_AUTH_RACE_MS,
          isAborted: () => !isMountedRef.current || isPendingMfaGateActive() || signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart || isExplicitKineticSignOut(),
          commitSession: commitSessionIfChanged,
          commitUser: commitUserIfChanged,
          commitProfile: commitProfileIfChanged,
          fetchUserProfile,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } finally {
        clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
        if (isMountedRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
      }
    };

    verifyAndHydrateRealSession();
    const unbindWebGuards = bindWebAuthFocusGuards({
      raceMs: BG_AUTH_RACE_MS,
      getUserId: () => userRef.current?.id,
      getAccessToken: () => sessionRef.current?.access_token,
      getProfile: () => profileRef.current,
      isStale: () => !isMountedRef.current || isExplicitKineticSignOut(),
      updateSessionRef: (s) => { sessionRef.current = s; },
      commitSession: commitSessionIfChanged,
      commitUser: commitUserIfChanged,
      commitProfile: commitProfileIfChanged,
      verifyAndHydrate: verifyAndHydrateRealSession,
    });

    const prefetchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const urls = Object.values(CATEGORY_IMAGES || {}).slice(0, 10);
        if (urls.length > 0) Image.prefetch(urls).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }, 300);

    let urlSub: { remove: () => void } | null = null;
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
      Linking.getInitialURL().then((url) => handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens(supabase, url)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      urlSub = Linking.addEventListener('url', (ev) => { void handleOAuthDeepLinkTokens(supabase, ev.url); });
    }

    const { data: authListener } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(async (event, rawNewSession) => {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      const newSession = toKineticAuthSession(rawNewSession);
      const seqStart = signOutSeqRef.current;
      const nextUser = newSession?.user ?? null;
      if (
        event === 'SIGNED_OUT' ||
        !nextUser ||
        !isRealSupabaseJwt(newSession?.access_token) ||
        (isExplicitKineticSignOut() && event !== 'SIGNED_IN')
      ) {
        if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || event === 'SIGNED_OUT') {
          resetInteractiveLoginVerified();
          runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks();
          setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
          commitSessionIfChanged(null);
          commitUserIfChanged(null);
          commitProfileIfChanged(null);
        }
        finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot();
      if (!isMountedRef.current || signOutSeqRef.current !== seqStart || (isExplicitKineticSignOut() && event !== 'SIGNED_IN')) {
        finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      const isExplicitEmptyWebTotp =
        Platform.OS === 'web' && Array.isArray(nextUser.factors) &&
        !shouldRequireMfaOnGoogleOAuthReturn({ session: newSession, userFactors: nextUser.factors, mfaSnap });
      const canPreserveOnTransientMfa =
        (event !== 'SIGNED_IN' || isExplicitEmptyWebTotp) && !isPendingMfaGateActive() &&
        shouldPreserveSessionOnTransientMfaCheckFailure({
          hasActiveValidUserSession: Boolean(isExplicitEmptyWebTotp || (userRef.current?.id && String(userRef.current.id) === String(nextUser.id))),
          sessionRequiresAal2: doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(newSession),
          mfaCheckFailed: Boolean(mfaSnap.checkFailed),
          mfaRequiresChallenge: isExplicitEmptyWebTotp ? false : mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge,
        });
      if (canPreserveOnTransientMfa && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(newSession) && (!mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge || isExplicitEmptyWebTotp)) {
        if (event === 'SIGNED_IN') { resetExplicitKineticSignOut(); setIsSigningOut(false); }
        commitSessionIfChanged(newSession);
        commitUserIfChanged(nextUser);
        if (!profileRef.current || event === 'SIGNED_IN') await fetchUserProfile(nextUser);
        if (isMountedRef.current && !hasHydratedInitialRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      if ((mfaSnap.checkFailed && !isKineticDevRuntime()) || isPendingMfaGateActive() || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(newSession) || mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge) {
        resetInteractiveLoginVerified();
        runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks();
        commitSessionIfChanged(null);
        commitUserIfChanged(null);
        commitProfileIfChanged(null);
        if (mfaSnap.checkFailed && !isKineticDevRuntime()) {
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
          await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
        } else if (mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(newSession)) {
          await purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
          if (!isPendingMfaGateActive() && mfaSnap.verifiedFactors?.[0]?.id) {
            setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
            setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge({ required: true, email: String(nextUser.email || ''), factorId: String(mfaSnap.verifiedFactors[0].id), reason: 'aal2_required' });
            routeToMfaScreen();
          }
        }
        finishInitialHydration();
        return;
      }
      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN') {
        resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
        setIsSigningOut(false);
      }
      const prevUserId = userRef.current?.id;
      const isAccountSwitch = Boolean(prevUserId && String(prevUserId) !== String(nextUser.id));
      if (isAccountSwitch) {
        runRegisteredSessionCleanupHooks();
        commitProfileIfChanged(null);
      }
      commitSessionIfChanged(newSession);
      commitUserIfChanged(nextUser);
      if (event !== 'TOKEN_REFRESHED' || !profileRef.current || isAccountSwitch) {
        await fetchUserProfile(nextUser);
      }
      if (isMountedRef.current && !hasHydratedInitialRef.current) finishInitialHydration();
    });

    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      clearTimeout(safetyTimer);
      clearTimeout(prefetchTimer);
      urlSub?.remove();
      unbindWebGuards();
      authListener?.subscription?.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [commitProfileIfChanged, commitSessionIfChanged, commitUserIfChanged, fetchUserProfile, finishInitialHydration]);

  const contextValue = useMemo<AuthContextType>(
    () => ({ user, session, profile, isLoading, loading: isLoading, isSigningOut, refreshProfile, activateResilientSession, signOut }),
    [user, session, profile, isLoading, isSigningOut, refreshProfile, activateResilientSession, signOut]
  );

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={contextValue}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
};

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Appearance, Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS,
  type KineticLanguage,
  type KineticResolvedTheme,
  type KineticThemeMode,
} from '../constants/kineticTranslations';
import {
  DARK_M3_TOKENS,
  LIGHT_M3_TOKENS,
  syncOmniSurfaceEngine,
  type KineticM3SurfaceTokens,
} from '../utils/kineticContrastAnd3DEngine';
import {
  formatActiveEventsCount,
  formatDistanceLabel,
  formatKineticDate,
  formatKineticDateTime,
  setActiveKineticLanguage,
  translateChallenge,
  translateDiscipline,
  translateDynamicContent,
  translateRarity,
} from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';

export const KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_user_theme_pref';
export const KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_language_v25';

const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window === 'undefined' ? useEffect : useLayoutEffect;

// Persistencia silenciosa en segundo plano: nunca bloquea el hilo de UI durante el cambio de tema/idioma.
const persistPreferenceSilently = (key: string, value: string) => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.localStorage?.setItem(key, value);
      } catch {}
    }
    AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value).catch(() => {});
  }, 0);
};

export const syncNativeAndWebThemeSurface = syncOmniSurfaceEngine;

export interface KineticPreferencesContextValue {
  themeMode: KineticThemeMode;
  setThemeMode: (mode: KineticThemeMode) => void;
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme;
  isLightMode: boolean;
  isPreferencesHydrated: boolean;
  language: KineticLanguage;
  setLanguage: (lang: KineticLanguage) => void;
  themeColors: KineticThemeColors;
  m3Tokens: KineticM3SurfaceTokens;
  t: (key: string, fallback?: string) => string;
  tx: (esText: string, enText: string) => string;
  td: (text?: string | null) => string;
  tDisc: (cat?: string | null) => string;
  tChallenge: <T extends Record<string, any>>(ch: T) => T;
  tRarity: (rarity?: string | null) => string;
  fmtDate: (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => string;
  fmtDateTime: (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => string;
  fmtDist: (km: number | string | null | undefined, fromYou?: boolean) => string;
  fmtEventsCount: (count: number) => string;
}

const KineticPreferencesContext = createContext<KineticPreferencesContextValue>({
  themeMode: 'dark',
  setThemeMode: () => {},
  resolvedTheme: 'dark',
  isLightMode: false,
  isPreferencesHydrated: true,
  language: 'es',
  setLanguage: () => {},
  themeColors: DARK_THEME_COLORS,
  m3Tokens: DARK_M3_TOKENS,
  t: (key, fallback) => fallback || KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS.es[key] || key,
  tx: (esText) => esText,
  td: (text) => String(text ?? ''),
  tDisc: (cat) => String(cat ?? ''),
  tChallenge: (ch) => ch,
  tRarity: (r) => String(r ?? ''),
  fmtDate: (iso, opts) => formatKineticDate(iso, 'es', opts),
  fmtDateTime: (iso, opts) => formatKineticDateTime(iso, 'es', opts),
  fmtDist: (km, fromYou) => formatDistanceLabel(km, 'es', fromYou),
  fmtEventsCount: (count) => formatActiveEventsCount(count, 'es'),
});

export const readInitialWebPreferencesSync = (): {
  themeMode: KineticThemeMode;
  language: KineticLanguage;
  deviceScheme: KineticResolvedTheme;
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme;
} => {
  const resolveDeviceScheme = (): KineticResolvedTheme => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.matchMedia === 'function') {
      return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'light' : 'dark';
    }
    return Appearance?.getColorScheme?.() === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  };
  let themeMode: KineticThemeMode = 'dark';
  let language: KineticLanguage = 'es';
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const savedTheme = window.localStorage?.getItem(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (savedTheme === 'light' || savedTheme === 'dark' || savedTheme === 'system') {
        themeMode = savedTheme;
      }
      const savedLang = window.localStorage?.getItem(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (savedLang === 'es' || savedLang === 'en') {
        language = savedLang;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  const deviceScheme = resolveDeviceScheme();
  const resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme =
    themeMode === 'system' ? deviceScheme : themeMode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  return { themeMode, language, deviceScheme, resolvedTheme };
};

export const KineticPreferencesProvider = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  const [initialWebPrefs] = useState(readInitialWebPreferencesSync);
  const [themeMode, setThemeModeState] = useState<KineticThemeMode>(() => initialWebPrefs.themeMode);
  const [deviceScheme, setDeviceScheme] = useState<KineticResolvedTheme>(() => initialWebPrefs.deviceScheme);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<KineticLanguage>(() => {
    setActiveKineticLanguage(initialWebPrefs.language);
    return initialWebPrefs.language;
  });
  const [isPreferencesHydrated, setIsPreferencesHydrated] = useState<boolean>(() => Platform.OS === 'web');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
      const sub = Appearance?.addChangeListener?.(({ colorScheme }) => {
        setDeviceScheme(colorScheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
      });
      return () => sub?.remove?.();
    }
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)');
    const onChange = () => setDeviceScheme(mq.matches ? 'light' : 'dark');
    mq.addEventListener?.('change', onChange);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener?.('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY).catch(() => null),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY).catch(() => null),
    ])
      .then(([savedTheme, savedLang]) => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (savedTheme === 'light' || savedTheme === 'dark' || savedTheme === 'system') {
          setThemeModeState((prev) => (prev === savedTheme ? prev : savedTheme));
        } else {
          setThemeModeState('dark');
          persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY, 'dark');
        }
        if (savedLang === 'es' || savedLang === 'en') {
          setActiveKineticLanguage(savedLang);
          setLanguageState((prev) => (prev === savedLang ? prev : savedLang));
        } else {
          setActiveKineticLanguage('es');
          setLanguageState('es');
          persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, 'es');
        }
        setIsPreferencesHydrated(true);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setIsPreferencesHydrated(true);
      });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme =
    themeMode === 'system' ? deviceScheme : themeMode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';

  // Sincronía de superficie DOM/nativa DESPUÉS del commit y ANTES del pintado (sin frame intermedio con
  // atributos de tema adelantados al árbol React). Jamás remonta el árbol: solo propagación reactiva.
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    setActiveKineticLanguage(language);
    syncOmniSurfaceEngine(resolvedTheme, language);
  }, [resolvedTheme, language]);

  const setThemeMode = useCallback((mode: KineticThemeMode) => {
    const nextMode: KineticThemeMode =
      mode === 'system' ? 'system' : mode === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    setThemeModeState((prev) => (prev === nextMode ? prev : nextMode));
    persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_THEME_STORAGE_KEY, nextMode);
  }, []);

  const setLanguage = useCallback((lang: KineticLanguage) => {
    const nextLang: KineticLanguage = lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
    setActiveKineticLanguage(nextLang);
    setLanguageState((prev) => (prev === nextLang ? prev : nextLang));
    persistPreferenceSilently(KINETIC_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY, nextLang);
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback(
    (key: string, fallback?: string): string =>
      KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS[language]?.[key] ?? KINETIC_TRANSLATIONS.es[key] ?? fallback ?? key,
    [language]
  );

  const tx = useCallback((esText: string, enText: string): string => (language === 'en' ? enText : esText), [language]);
  const td = useCallback((text?: string | null): string => translateDynamicContent(text, language), [language]);
  const tDisc = useCallback((cat?: string | null): string => translateDiscipline(cat, language), [language]);
  const tChallenge = useCallback(<T extends Record<string, any>>(ch: T): T => translateChallenge(ch, language), [language]);
  const tRarity = useCallback((rarity?: string | null): string => translateRarity(rarity, language), [language]);
  const fmtDate = useCallback(
    (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) =>
      formatKineticDate(isoOrDate, language, options),
    [language]
  );
  const fmtDateTime = useCallback(
    (isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) =>
      formatKineticDateTime(isoOrDate, language, options),
    [language]
  );
  const fmtDist = useCallback(
    (km: number | string | null | undefined, fromYou?: boolean) => formatDistanceLabel(km, language, fromYou),
    [language]
  );
  const fmtEventsCount = useCallback((count: number) => formatActiveEventsCount(count, language), [language]);

  const isLightMode = resolvedTheme === 'light';
  const themeColors = isLightMode ? LIGHT_THEME_COLORS : DARK_THEME_COLORS;
  const m3Tokens = isLightMode ? LIGHT_M3_TOKENS : DARK_M3_TOKENS;

  const value = useMemo<KineticPreferencesContextValue>(
    () => ({
      themeMode,
      setThemeMode,
      resolvedTheme,
      isLightMode,
      isPreferencesHydrated,
      language,
      setLanguage,
      themeColors,
      m3Tokens,
      t,
      tx,
      td,
      tDisc,
      tChallenge,
      tRarity,
      fmtDate,
      fmtDateTime,
      fmtDist,
      fmtEventsCount,
    }),
    [
      themeMode,
      setThemeMode,
      resolvedTheme,
      isLightMode,
      isPreferencesHydrated,
      language,
      setLanguage,
      themeColors,
      m3Tokens,
      t,
      tx,
      td,
      tDisc,
      tChallenge,
      tRarity,
      fmtDate,
      fmtDateTime,
      fmtDist,
      fmtEventsCount,
    ]
  );

  return <KineticPreferencesContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</KineticPreferencesContext.Provider>;
};

export const useKineticPreferences = () => useContext(KineticPreferencesContext);

export const useKineticTheme = () => {
  const prefs = useKineticPreferences();
  return {
    theme: prefs.resolvedTheme,
    themeMode: prefs.themeMode,
    setThemeMode: prefs.setThemeMode,
    isLight: prefs.isLightMode,
    isLightMode: prefs.isLightMode,
    colors: prefs.themeColors,
    themeColors: prefs.themeColors,
    m3: prefs.m3Tokens,
    m3Tokens: prefs.m3Tokens,
  };
};

export const useKineticI18n = () => {
  const prefs = useKineticPreferences();
  return {
    language: prefs.language,
    setLanguage: prefs.setLanguage,
    t: prefs.t,
    tx: prefs.tx,
    td: prefs.td,
    tDisc: prefs.tDisc,
    tChallenge: prefs.tChallenge,
    tRarity: prefs.tRarity,
    fmtDate: prefs.fmtDate,
    fmtDateTime: prefs.fmtDateTime,
    fmtDist: prefs.fmtDist,
    fmtEventsCount: prefs.fmtEventsCount,
  };
};

export const ThemeContext = KineticPreferencesContext;
export const I18nContext = KineticPreferencesContext;

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';
import { useCallback, type MutableRefObject } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, Linking, Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY,
  ensureFirstTimeProfile,
  isKineticDevRuntime,
  mapSupabaseAuthError,
  saveSanitizedLoginAccount,
} from '../../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import { toKineticAuthSession, toKineticAuthUser, type KineticAuthProfile, type KineticAuthSession, type KineticAuthUser } from '../../services/kineticAuthContextHelpers';
import { runWebGoogleGisSignIn } from '../../services/kineticGoogleGisWebRunner';
import {
  KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK,
  beginNativeOidcFlow,
  buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl,
  clearPendingOidcChallenge,
  endNativeOidcFlow,
  generateOidcNonceAndState,
  persistPendingOidcChallenge,
  recordCapturedNativeOidcUrl,
  resolveNativeOidcAuthSessionCallbackUrl,
  verifyAndExchangeNativeGoogleOidcUrl,
} from '../../services/kineticGoogleOidcService';
import { persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync } from '../../services/kineticBiometricVaultService';
import { doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, type IMfaSessionLike } from '../../services/kineticMfaPureGuards';
import {
  buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail,
  setOidcReturnTransitionActive,
  synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from '../../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { resolveRoleDestination } from '../../services/kineticTabRoleGuard';
import { isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl, scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation } from '../../services/kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';

const tr = (es: string, en: string) => (getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? en : es);
const PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;

const raceWithAuthTimeout = <T,>(promise: PromiseLike<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> =>
  new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('KINETIC_AUTH_TIMEOUT')), ms);
    Promise.resolve(promise).then((v) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(v); }, (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(e); });
  });

export interface GoogleAuthActionsParams {
  mountedRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  ssoSubmittingRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  oauthPendingRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  pendingMfaActiveRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  oauthPopupCleanupRef: MutableRefObject<(() => void) | null>;
  setIsSsoLoading: (v: boolean) => void;
  setIsTransitioningAfterLogin: (v: boolean) => void;
  setGate: (active: boolean) => void;
  evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed: (
    signedUser: KineticAuthUser,
    sessionObj: KineticAuthSession | null,
    emailLabel: string,
    mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b'
  ) => Promise<'clear' | 'mfa_required'>;
  activateResilientSession: (
    u: KineticAuthUser,
    p: KineticAuthProfile | null,
    s?: KineticAuthSession | null
  ) => void;
  router: { replace: (dest: never) => void };
  triggerHaptic?: (type: string) => void;
  showTacticalAlert?: (title: string, msg: string, type?: string) => void;
}

export function useKineticGoogleAuthActions(p: GoogleAuthActionsParams) {
  const {
    mountedRef, ssoSubmittingRef, oauthPendingRef, pendingMfaActiveRef, oauthPopupCleanupRef,
    setIsSsoLoading, setIsTransitioningAfterLogin, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed,
    activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert,
  } = p;

  const handleGoogleSignIn = useCallback(
    async (mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (ssoSubmittingRef.current) return false;
      Keyboard.dismiss();
      ssoSubmittingRef.current = true;
      oauthPendingRef.current = true;
      setIsSsoLoading(true);
      triggerHaptic?.('Light');
      let nativeFlowId: number | undefined;
      let nativeChallengeState: string | null = null;
      let nativeUrlSub: { remove: () => void } | null = null;
      let isWebRedirecting = false;
      try {
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY, mode).catch(() => {});
        const finishOAuthLogin = async (signedUser: KineticAuthUser, activeSess: KineticAuthSession | null) => {
          if (mountedRef.current) setGate(true);
          const mfaStatus = await evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed(signedUser, activeSess, String(signedUser.email || ''), mode);
          if (mfaStatus === 'mfa_required') { setOidcReturnTransitionActive(false); return true; }
          if (mountedRef.current) setGate(false);
          AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => {});
          const profileData = await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(signedUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(
            () => synthesizeProfileFromUser(signedUser)
          );
          await persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync({
            session: activeSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike | null,
            hasVerifiedTotpFactor: false,
            biometriaActiva: (profileData as { biometria_activa?: boolean | null } | null)?.biometria_activa,
          });
          if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
          setOidcReturnTransitionActive(true);
          activateResilientSession(signedUser, profileData as KineticAuthProfile, activeSess);
          if (signedUser.email) {
            const profName = String((profileData as { nombre?: string } | null)?.nombre || '').trim();
            void saveSanitizedLoginAccount(signedUser.email, mode, {}, profName).catch(() => {});
          }
          triggerHaptic?.('Success');
          try {
            router.replace(resolveRoleDestination(signedUser, profileData, activeSess?.access_token) as never);
          } catch (err) { void err; }
          setTimeout(() => setOidcReturnTransitionActive(false), 380);
          return true;
        };

        if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
          const webRes = await runWebGoogleGisSignIn(mode, {
            onBeforeTokenExchange: () => { if (mountedRef.current) setGate(true); },
            registerCleanup: (fn) => { oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = fn; },
          });
          oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = null;
          if (webRes.status === 'redirecting') {
            isWebRedirecting = true;
            return true;
          }
          scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
          const kUser = webRes.status === 'success' ? toKineticAuthUser(webRes.user) : null;
          if (!kUser || webRes.status !== 'success') return false;
          return await finishOAuthLogin(kUser, toKineticAuthSession(webRes.session));
        }

        const challenge = generateOidcNonceAndState('native', mode);
        nativeChallengeState = challenge.state;
        await persistPendingOidcChallenge({ ...challenge, mode, createdAtMs: Date.now() });
        nativeFlowId = beginNativeOidcFlow();
        nativeUrlSub = Linking.addEventListener('url', ({ url }) => {
          if (url && url.includes('id_token=')) recordCapturedNativeOidcUrl(url);
        });
        const bridgeUrl = buildNativeOidcBridgeStartUrl({ mode, nonceHash: challenge.nonceHash, state: challenge.state });
        const authSession = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(
          bridgeUrl,
          KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK,
          { showInRecents: false, createTask: false }
        );
        oauthPendingRef.current = false;
        const callbackUrl = await resolveNativeOidcAuthSessionCallbackUrl({
          authSession,
          graceMs: 1500,
          expectedState: challenge.state,
          getInitialUrl: () => Linking.getInitialURL().catch(() => null),
        });
        if (
          callbackUrl &&
          callbackUrl.startsWith(KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK) &&
          isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(callbackUrl) &&
          !/[?&]cancelled=1(?:&|#|$)/.test(callbackUrl)
        ) {
          setOidcReturnTransitionActive(true);
          if (mountedRef.current) setGate(true);
          const authRes = await verifyAndExchangeNativeGoogleOidcUrl(callbackUrl);
          const signedUser = toKineticAuthUser(authRes.data?.user);
          if (signedUser) return await finishOAuthLogin(signedUser, toKineticAuthSession(authRes.data?.session));
          setOidcReturnTransitionActive(false);
          if (mountedRef.current) setGate(false);
        }
        return false;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        setOidcReturnTransitionActive(false);
        if (!pendingMfaActiveRef.current && mountedRef.current) setGate(false);
        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          showTacticalAlert?.(tr('CONEXIÓN CON GOOGLE', 'GOOGLE SIGN-IN'), mapSupabaseAuthError(errMsg), 'error');
        }
        return false;
      } finally {
        try { nativeUrlSub?.remove(); } catch (err) { void err; }
        if (nativeFlowId !== undefined) endNativeOidcFlow(nativeFlowId);
        if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
          if (mountedRef.current && !isWebRedirecting) await clearPendingOidcChallenge();
        } else if (nativeChallengeState) {
          await clearPendingOidcChallenge(nativeChallengeState);
        }
        oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = null;
        if (!pendingMfaActiveRef.current && mountedRef.current && !isWebRedirecting) {
          setGate(false);
          AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
        }
        oauthPendingRef.current = false;
        ssoSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current && !isWebRedirecting) setIsSsoLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [
      mountedRef, ssoSubmittingRef, oauthPendingRef, pendingMfaActiveRef, oauthPopupCleanupRef,
      setIsSsoLoading, setIsTransitioningAfterLogin, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed,
      activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert,
    ]
  );

  const handleGoogleInAppLogin = useCallback(
    async (emailGoogle: string, fullName?: string, _mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!isKineticDevRuntime()) return false;
      const cleanEmail = emailGoogle.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@')) return false;
      const fallbackSession = await buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail(cleanEmail).catch(() => null);
      if (!fallbackSession?.user || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(fallbackSession?.session)) return false;
      if (fallbackSession.profile && fullName) fallbackSession.profile.nombre = fullName;
      const authUser = toKineticAuthUser(fallbackSession.user);
      if (!authUser) return false;
      if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
      activateResilientSession(authUser, fallbackSession.profile, null);
      triggerHaptic?.('Success');
      router.replace(resolveRoleDestination(authUser, fallbackSession.profile) as never);
      return true;
    },
    [activateResilientSession, mountedRef, router, setIsTransitioningAfterLogin, triggerHaptic]
  );

  return { handleGoogleSignIn, handleGoogleInAppLogin };
}

// Kinetic OS v2.5 — Hook Unificado de Checkout y Procesamiento Atómico Stripe
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useKineticPreferences } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { CheckoutItemPayload, stripeService } from '../services/stripeService';
import { confirmStripeWebPayment, resolveStripeCheckoutExecutionMode, validateStripeClientSecretFormat } from '../services/kineticStripeWebBridge';
import { getNativeStripeSdk } from '../services/nativeStripeBridge';
import { assertValidKcMultipleOfTen } from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import { type IBovedaPassRow, prependBovedaOptimisticPass } from '../services/kineticOptimisticStore';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from '../services/kineticVaultCrypto';

export type CheckoutStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'initializing'
  | 'processing'
  | 'succeeded'
  | 'canceled'
  | 'failed';

export interface CheckoutError {
  code:
    | 'CANCELED'
    | 'CARD_DECLINED'
    | 'NETWORK_ERROR'
    | 'INVALID_SESSION'
    | 'SERVER_ERROR';
  message: string;
}

export interface UseCheckoutOptions {
  onSuccess?: (item: CheckoutItemPayload, paymentId: string) => void;
  onError?: (error: CheckoutError) => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

export function useCheckout(options: UseCheckoutOptions = {}) {
  const { user, refreshProfile } = useAuth();
  const { tx } = useKineticPreferences();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<CheckoutStatus>('idle');
  const [error, setError] = useState<CheckoutError | null>(null);
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<CheckoutItemPayload | null>(null);
  const isExecutingRef = useRef(false);

  const resetCheckout = useCallback(() => {
    isExecutingRef.current = false;
    setStatus('idle');
    setError(null);
    setActiveItem(null);
  }, []);

  const startCheckout = useCallback(
    async (item: CheckoutItemPayload): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (isExecutingRef.current) return false;
      isExecutingRef.current = true;
      setError(null);
      setActiveItem(item);
      setStatus('initializing');
      triggerHaptic('Medium');

      try {
        if (item.userId && user?.id && String(item.userId) !== String(user.id)) {
          throw new Error('IDENTIDAD_INVALIDA');
        }
        const userId = user?.id;
        if (!userId) {
          const err: CheckoutError = {
            code: 'INVALID_SESSION',
            message: tx(
              'Sesión no válida. Inicia sesión para continuar.',
              'Invalid session. Please log in to continue.'
            ),
          };
          setError(err);
          setStatus('failed');
          options.onError?.(err);
          return false;
        }

        if (Number(item?.kcOtorgados) > 0) {
          assertValidKcMultipleOfTen(Number(item.kcOtorgados), 'Checkout');
        }
        setStatus('processing');
        let confirmedPaymentId = `knt_pay_${Date.now()}`;

        const allowPreStripeSandbox = await stripeService.fetchAllowPreStripeSandbox();
        const publishableKey = stripeService.getPublishableKey();
        const execMode = resolveStripeCheckoutExecutionMode({
          allowPreStripeSandbox,
          publishableKey,
          platformOs: Platform.OS,
        });

        const runPreStripeSandbox = async () => {
          if (!isKineticDevRuntime()) {
            const rawSlug = String(item.planId || item.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '_');
            const sandboxSlug =
              item.tipo === 'topup' && !/^topup_\d+$/.test(rawSlug) && Number(item.kcOtorgados) > 0
                ? `topup_${Math.round(Number(item.kcOtorgados))}`
                : rawSlug;
            const { data: sandboxData, error: sandboxErr } = await supabase.rpc(
              'procesar_compra_boveda_sandbox',
              { p_plan_id: sandboxSlug, p_tipo: item.tipo }
            );
            if (sandboxErr) {
              const errMsg = String(sandboxErr.message || '');
              if (errMsg.includes('SANDBOX_DESHABILITADO')) {
                throw new Error(tx('Pasarela Stripe Live requerida en producción.', 'Stripe Live gateway required in production.'));
              }
              throw new Error(errMsg || tx('No se pudo procesar el pago Pre-Stripe.', 'Could not process Pre-Stripe payment.'));
            }
            const sRec = (sandboxData || null) as { plan_id?: string } | null;
            return `sandbox_${String(sRec?.plan_id || Date.now())}`;
          }
          const simIntent = await stripeService.createPaymentIntent(item);
          const pid = simIntent?.id || confirmedPaymentId;
          await stripeService.registrarTransaccionEnBoveda({ ...item, userId }, pid);
          return pid;
        };

        if (execMode === 'blocked_missing_key') {
          throw new Error(tx('Pasarela Stripe Live requerida en producción.', 'Stripe Live gateway required in production.'));
        }

        if (execMode === 'pre_stripe_sandbox') {
          confirmedPaymentId = await runPreStripeSandbox();
        } else {
          const paymentIntentData = await stripeService.createPaymentIntent(item);
          if (paymentIntentData?.mode === 'pre_stripe_sandbox' || paymentIntentData?.allow_pre_stripe_sandbox) {
            confirmedPaymentId = await runPreStripeSandbox();
          } else if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
            const stripeSdk = getNativeStripeSdk();
            if (!stripeSdk?.initPaymentSheet || !stripeSdk?.presentPaymentSheet) {
              throw new Error(tx('El módulo nativo de pagos seguros Stripe no está disponible.', 'Native Stripe secure payments module is unavailable.'));
            }
            const clientSecret = String(paymentIntentData?.clientSecret || paymentIntentData?.client_secret || '');
            if (!validateStripeClientSecretFormat(clientSecret)) {
              throw new Error(tx('No se pudo inicializar la autorización bancaria con Stripe.', 'Could not initialize bank authorization with Stripe.'));
            }
            const initRes = await stripeSdk.initPaymentSheet({
              paymentIntentClientSecret: clientSecret,
              merchantDisplayName: 'KineticApp S.A.S.',
              applePay: { merchantCountryCode: 'MX' },
              googlePay: { merchantCountryCode: 'MX', testEnv: false },
              style: 'alwaysDark',
            });
            if (initRes.error) throw new Error(initRes.error.message);
            const presentRes = await stripeSdk.presentPaymentSheet();
            if (presentRes.error) {
              if (presentRes.error.code === 'Canceled' || presentRes.error.message?.toLowerCase().includes('cancel')) {
                const cancelErr: CheckoutError = { code: 'CANCELED', message: tx('Operación cancelada por el usuario.', 'Operation canceled by user.') };
                setError(cancelErr);
                setStatus('canceled');
                options.onCancel?.();
                return false;
              }
              const cardErr: CheckoutError = { code: 'CARD_DECLINED', message: presentRes.error.message || tx('Tarjeta rechazada por el banco emisor.', 'Card declined by issuing bank.') };
              setError(cardErr);
              setStatus('failed');
              triggerHaptic('Error');
              options.onError?.(cardErr);
              return false;
            }
            confirmedPaymentId = paymentIntentData?.id || confirmedPaymentId;
          } else {
            const clientSecret = String(paymentIntentData?.clientSecret || paymentIntentData?.client_secret || '');
            if (paymentIntentData?.status !== 'succeeded') {
              const webPay = await confirmStripeWebPayment({
                publishableKey,
                clientSecret,
                returnUrl: 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda',
              });
              if (!webPay.ok) {
                if (webPay.canceled) {
                  const cancelErr: CheckoutError = { code: 'CANCELED', message: tx('Operación cancelada por el usuario.', 'Operation canceled by user.') };
                  setError(cancelErr);
                  setStatus('canceled');
                  options.onCancel?.();
                  return false;
                }
                throw new Error(webPay.errorMessage || tx('La autorización de pago Web con Stripe no fue confirmada.', 'Stripe Web payment authorization was not confirmed.'));
              }
            }
            confirmedPaymentId = paymentIntentData?.id || confirmedPaymentId;
          }
        }

        await refreshProfile?.();
        const itemWithPass = item as CheckoutItemPayload & { pendingPass?: IBovedaPassRow | null };
        if (itemWithPass.pendingPass && userId) {
          prependBovedaOptimisticPass(userId, {
            ...itemWithPass.pendingPass,
            id: itemWithPass.pendingPass.id || `opt_chk_${confirmedPaymentId}`,
            optimisticCreatedAtMs: Date.now(),
          });
        }
        triggerArcadeHaptic('levelUp');
        setStatus('succeeded');
        options.onSuccess?.(item, confirmedPaymentId);
        return true;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : '';
        const errorObj: CheckoutError = {
          code: 'SERVER_ERROR',
          message: msg || tx('No se pudo completar el cobro. Intenta nuevamente.', 'Payment could not be completed. Please try again.'),
        };
        setError(errorObj);
        setStatus('failed');
        triggerHaptic('Error');
        options.onError?.(errorObj);
        return false;
      } finally {
        isExecutingRef.current = false;
      }
    },
    [user?.id, refreshProfile, options, tx]
  );

  return {
    status,
    isProcessing: status === 'initializing' || status === 'processing',
    isSuccess: status === 'succeeded',
    error,
    activeItem,
    startCheckout,
    resetCheckout,
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AppState, Keyboard, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY,
  ensureFirstTimeProfile,
  isKineticDevRuntime,
  mapSupabaseAuthError,
} from '../services/kineticAuthHelpers';
import {
  toKineticAuthSession,
  toKineticAuthUser,
  withAuthTimeout,
  type KineticAuthProfile,
  type KineticAuthSession,
  type KineticAuthUser,
} from '../services/kineticAuthContextHelpers';
import {
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  subscribeGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
} from '../services/kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import {
  canPersistSessionInBiometricVault,
  persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync,
  purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync,
  readBiometricRefreshEntryAsync,
  runBiometricHardwarePromptAsync,
} from '../services/kineticBiometricVaultService';
import type { IMfaSessionLike } from '../services/kineticMfaPureGuards';
import { isNativeOidcFlowInFlight } from '../services/kineticGoogleOidcService';
import {
  doesSessionRequireMfaAal2,
  getMfaSecuritySnapshot,
  setPendingMfaGateActive,
  verifyAndActivateTotpFactor,
} from '../services/kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail,
  clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit,
  synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { isEgressOrTransientAuthError } from '../services/kineticSessionReconciler';
import { resolveRoleDestination } from '../services/kineticTabRoleGuard';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { useKineticGoogleAuthActions } from './auth/useKineticGoogleAuthActions';

try { WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession(); } catch {}

const tr = (es: string, en: string) => (getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? en : es);
const SIGN_IN_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 9000;
const PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;
const MFA_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;
const raceWithAuthTimeout = withAuthTimeout;

export { PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY, mapSupabaseAuthError };

const resolveAuthTarget = (user: KineticAuthUser, profile: KineticAuthProfile | null, _mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b') =>
  resolveRoleDestination(user, profile);

export interface IPendingMfaChallenge {
  factorId: string;
  friendlyName: string;
  email: string;
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
  user: KineticAuthUser | null;
}

export function useKineticAuth(
  triggerHaptic?: (type: string) => void,
  showTacticalAlert?: (title: string, msg: string, type?: string) => void
) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { activateResilientSession } = useAuth();
  const emailSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const bioSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const lastSignInAttemptRef = useRef(0);
  const ssoSubmittingRef = useRef(false);
  const mfaBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const localGateRef = useRef(false);
  const pendingMfaActiveRef = useRef(false);
  const oauthPendingRef = useRef(false);
  const oauthPopupCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const unlockDebounceTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const [isEmailSigningIn, setIsEmailSigningIn] = useState(false);
  const [isTransitioningAfterLogin, setIsTransitioningAfterLogin] = useState(false);
  const [isSsoLoading, setIsSsoLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pendingMfaChallenge, setPendingMfaChallenge] = useState<IPendingMfaChallenge | null>(null);
  const [isVerifyingMfa, setIsVerifyingMfa] = useState(false);
  const [mfaErrorMsg, setMfaErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const setGate = useCallback((active: boolean) => {
    localGateRef.current = active;
    setPendingMfaGateActive(active);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    const syncGlobalMfa = async (st: ReturnType<typeof getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge>) => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || !st?.required || !st.factorId) return;
      const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser().catch(() => ({ data: { user: null } }));
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      const storedMode = ((await AsyncStorage.getItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => null)) === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c') as 'b2c' | 'b2b';
      pendingMfaActiveRef.current = true;
      setGate(true);
      setPendingMfaChallenge({
        factorId: st.factorId,
        friendlyName: 'Kinetic Authenticator',
        email: st.email || String(data?.user?.email || ''),
        mode: storedMode,
        user: toKineticAuthUser(data?.user),
      });
    };
    const gCur = getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
    if (gCur.required && gCur.factorId) void syncGlobalMfa(gCur);
    const unsubGlobalMfa = subscribeGlobalPendingMfaChallenge((st) => { void syncGlobalMfa(st); });

    const unlockOAuth = (immediate = false) => {
      if (!oauthPendingRef.current || oauthPopupCleanupRef.current !== null || isNativeOidcFlowInFlight()) return;
      if (unlockDebounceTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(unlockDebounceTimerRef.current);
      const finalizeUnlock = () => {
        unlockDebounceTimerRef.current = null;
        if (!oauthPendingRef.current || oauthPopupCleanupRef.current !== null || isNativeOidcFlowInFlight()) return;
        oauthPendingRef.current = false;
        ssoSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setIsSsoLoading(false);
          setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
        }
      };
      if (immediate) finalizeUnlock();
      else unlockDebounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(finalizeUnlock, 450);
    };
    const appSub = AppState.addEventListener('change', (s) => { if (s === 'active') unlockOAuth(false); });
    const onWebPageShow = () => {
      if (mountedRef.current && !oauthPopupCleanupRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
      if (mountedRef.current && !oauthPopupCleanupRef.current && !isNativeOidcFlowInFlight()) { ssoSubmittingRef.current = false; setIsSsoLoading(false); }
      unlockOAuth(true);
    };
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') window.addEventListener('pageshow', onWebPageShow);
    if (Platform.OS === 'android') WebBrowser.warmUpAsync?.().catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      if (unlockDebounceTimerRef.current) { clearTimeout(unlockDebounceTimerRef.current); unlockDebounceTimerRef.current = null; }
      oauthPopupCleanupRef.current?.(); oauthPopupCleanupRef.current = null;
      if (Platform.OS === 'android') WebBrowser.coolDownAsync?.().catch(() => {});
      unsubGlobalMfa(); appSub.remove();
      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') window.removeEventListener('pageshow', onWebPageShow);
      const hadPending = pendingMfaActiveRef.current;
      if (localGateRef.current || hadPending) {
        localGateRef.current = false;
        pendingMfaActiveRef.current = false;
        setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
      }
      if (hadPending && !getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge()?.required) {
        clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
        void supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
        void clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
      }
    };
  }, [setGate]);

  const evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed = useCallback(
    async (
      signedUser: KineticAuthUser,
      sessionObj: KineticAuthSession | null,
      emailLabel: string,
      mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b'
    ): Promise<'clear' | 'mfa_required'> => {
      const mfaSnap = await raceWithAuthTimeout(getMfaSecuritySnapshot(), MFA_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(() => null);
      const tokenRequiresMfa = doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(sessionObj);
      if ((!mfaSnap || mfaSnap.checkFailed) && (tokenRequiresMfa || !isKineticDevRuntime())) {
        setGate(false);
        clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
        throw new Error('MFA_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE');
      }
      const needsMfa = Boolean(mfaSnap?.requiresMfaChallenge || tokenRequiresMfa);
      if (!needsMfa) return 'clear';
      const userFactors = Array.isArray(signedUser?.factors) ? signedUser.factors : [];
      const verifiedFactor =
        mfaSnap?.verifiedFactors?.[0] ||
        userFactors.find((f) => f?.status === 'verified' && (!f?.factor_type || f.factor_type === 'totp'));
      if (!verifiedFactor?.id) {
        setGate(false);
        clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
        throw new Error('MFA_FACTOR_RESOLUTION_FAILED');
      }
      pendingMfaActiveRef.current = true;
      setGate(true);
      setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge({ required: true, email: emailLabel, factorId: String(verifiedFactor.id), reason: 'aal2_required' });
      if (mountedRef.current) {
        setMfaErrorMsg(null);
        setPendingMfaChallenge({
          factorId: String(verifiedFactor.id),
          friendlyName: String(verifiedFactor.friendly_name || 'Kinetic Authenticator'),
          email: emailLabel,
          mode,
          user: signedUser,
        });
      }
      triggerHaptic?.('Selection');
      return 'mfa_required';
    },
    [setGate, triggerHaptic]
  );

  const handleSignIn = useCallback(
    async (emailRaw: string, passwordRaw: string, mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): Promise<boolean | 'mfa_required'> => {
      if (emailSubmittingRef.current) return false;
      const cleanEmail = String(emailRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
      const cleanPassword = String(passwordRaw || '').trim().slice(0, 128);
      if (!cleanEmail || !cleanPassword) {
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        showTacticalAlert?.(tr('CAMPOS REQUERIDOS', 'REQUIRED FIELDS'), tr('Ingresa tu correo electrónico y tu contraseña para continuar.', 'Enter your email address and password to continue.'), 'error');
        return false;
      }
      const nowMs = Date.now();
      if (nowMs - lastSignInAttemptRef.current < 1500) return false;
      lastSignInAttemptRef.current = nowMs;
      Keyboard.dismiss();
      emailSubmittingRef.current = true;
      setIsEmailSigningIn(true);
      setGate(true);
      triggerHaptic?.('Light');
      try {
        const { data, error } = await raceWithAuthTimeout(
          supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: cleanEmail, password: cleanPassword }),
          SIGN_IN_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS
        );
        if (error) throw error;
        const signedUser = toKineticAuthUser(data?.user);
        if (!signedUser) throw new Error('KINETIC_AUTH_TIMEOUT');
        const confirmObj = data?.user as { email_confirmed_at?: string | null; confirmed_at?: string | null; phone_confirmed_at?: string | null } | null;
        const isConfirmed = Boolean(confirmObj?.email_confirmed_at || confirmObj?.confirmed_at || confirmObj?.phone_confirmed_at);
        if (!isKineticDevRuntime() && !isConfirmed && !cleanEmail.endsWith('@phone.kineticapp.mx')) {
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
          throw new Error('Email not confirmed');
        }
        const mfaStatus = await evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed(signedUser, toKineticAuthSession(data?.session), cleanEmail, mode);
        if (mfaStatus === 'mfa_required') {
          if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
          return 'mfa_required';
        }
        setGate(false);
        let profileData: KineticAuthProfile | null = null;
        try {
          profileData = (await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(signedUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS)) as KineticAuthProfile;
        } catch {
          profileData = synthesizeProfileFromUser(signedUser, null, mode);
        }
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
        const activeSess = toKineticAuthSession(data?.session);
        await persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync({
          session: activeSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike | null,
          hasVerifiedTotpFactor: false,
          biometriaActiva: profileData?.biometria_activa,
        });
        activateResilientSession(signedUser, profileData, activeSess);
        triggerHaptic?.('Success');
        router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(signedUser, profileData, mode) as never);
        return true;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        setGate(false);
        if (isKineticDevRuntime() && isEgressOrTransientAuthError(err)) {
          const fallbackSession = await buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail(cleanEmail, mode);
          if (fallbackSession && !doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(fallbackSession.session)) {
            const authUser = toKineticAuthUser(fallbackSession.user);
            if (authUser) {
              if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
              activateResilientSession(authUser, fallbackSession.profile, toKineticAuthSession(fallbackSession.session));
              triggerHaptic?.('Success');
              router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(authUser, fallbackSession.profile, mode) as never);
              return true;
            }
          }
        }
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        showTacticalAlert?.(tr('ACCESO DENEGADO', 'ACCESS DENIED'), mapSupabaseAuthError(errMsg), 'error');
        return false;
      } finally {
        emailSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsEmailSigningIn(false);
      }
    },
    [router, activateResilientSession, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed]
  );

  const verifyPendingMfaLogin = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!pendingMfaChallenge || mfaBusyRef.current) return false;
      mfaBusyRef.current = true;
      setIsVerifyingMfa(true);
      setMfaErrorMsg(null);
      try {
        const upgradedRaw = await verifyAndActivateTotpFactor(pendingMfaChallenge.factorId, rawCode);
        const upgradedSession = toKineticAuthSession(upgradedRaw);
        if (!upgradedSession || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(upgradedSession)) throw new Error('MFA_AAL2_REQUIRED');
        const activeUser = upgradedSession.user || pendingMfaChallenge.user;
        if (!activeUser) throw new Error('MFA_AAL2_REQUIRED');
        pendingMfaActiveRef.current = false;
        setGate(false);
        clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
        let profileData: KineticAuthProfile | null = null;
        try {
          profileData = (await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(activeUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS)) as KineticAuthProfile;
        } catch {
          const cachedFallback = await buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail(pendingMfaChallenge.email, pendingMfaChallenge.mode);
          profileData = synthesizeProfileFromUser(activeUser, cachedFallback?.profile || null, pendingMfaChallenge.mode);
        }
        const targetMode = pendingMfaChallenge.mode;
        AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => {});
        if (mountedRef.current) { setPendingMfaChallenge(null); setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true); }
        await persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync({
          session: upgradedSession as unknown as IMfaSessionLike | null,
          hasVerifiedTotpFactor: true,
          biometriaActiva: profileData?.biometria_activa,
        });
        activateResilientSession(activeUser, profileData, upgradedSession);
        triggerHaptic?.('Success');
        router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(activeUser, profileData, targetMode) as never);
        return true;
      } catch {
        triggerHaptic?.('Error');
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
          setMfaErrorMsg(tr('Código 2FA inválido o expirado. Verifica los 6 dígitos en tu app autenticadora.', 'Invalid or expired 2FA code. Check the 6 digits in your authenticator app.'));
        }
        return false;
      } finally {
        mfaBusyRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsVerifyingMfa(false);
      }
    },
    [pendingMfaChallenge, activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, setGate]
  );

  const cancelPendingMfaLogin = useCallback(async () => {
    if (mfaBusyRef.current) return;
    pendingMfaActiveRef.current = false;
    setGate(false);
    clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
    AsyncStorage.removeItem(PENDING_OAUTH_MODE_KEY).catch(() => {});
    if (mountedRef.current) { setPendingMfaChallenge(null); setMfaErrorMsg(null); }
    triggerHaptic?.('Light');
    await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
    await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch(() => {});
  }, [triggerHaptic, setGate]);

  const { handleGoogleSignIn, handleGoogleInAppLogin } = useKineticGoogleAuthActions({
    mountedRef, ssoSubmittingRef, oauthPendingRef, pendingMfaActiveRef, oauthPopupCleanupRef,
    setIsSsoLoading, setIsTransitioningAfterLogin, setGate, evaluateMfaGateOrFailClosed,
    activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, showTacticalAlert,
  });

  const handleBiometricSessionRestore = useCallback(
    async (emailRaw: string, mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c', options?: { alreadyAuthenticatedHardware?: boolean }): Promise<boolean> => {
      const cleanEmail = String(emailRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@') || bioSubmittingRef.current) return false;
      bioSubmittingRef.current = true;
      let gateOwned = false;
      try {
        if (Platform.OS !== 'web' && !options?.alreadyAuthenticatedHardware) {
          const hwOk = await runBiometricHardwarePromptAsync();
          if (!hwOk) return false;
        }
        const bioEntry = await readBiometricRefreshEntryAsync(cleanEmail);
        if (!bioEntry?.refreshToken) return false;
        gateOwned = true;
        setGate(true);
        const { data: refRes, error: refErr } = await raceWithAuthTimeout(
          supabase.auth.refreshSession({ refresh_token: bioEntry.refreshToken }),
          SIGN_IN_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS
        );
        const restoredSess = toKineticAuthSession(refRes?.session);
        const restoredUser = toKineticAuthUser(refRes?.user);
        if (refErr || !restoredSess || !restoredUser) {
          if (!isEgressOrTransientAuthError(refErr)) {
            await purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync(cleanEmail).catch(() => {});
          }
          return false;
        }
        const mfaSnap = await raceWithAuthTimeout(getMfaSecuritySnapshot(), MFA_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(() => null);
        const mfaFailed = (!mfaSnap || mfaSnap.checkFailed) && !isKineticDevRuntime();
        const canTrustSession = canPersistSessionInBiometricVault({
          session: restoredSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike,
          hasVerifiedTotpFactor: Boolean(mfaSnap?.hasVerifiedTotp),
          biometriaActiva: true,
        });
        if (mfaFailed || !canTrustSession || mfaSnap?.requiresMfaChallenge) {
          await purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync(cleanEmail).catch(() => {});
          await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }).catch(() => {});
          return false;
        }
        await persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync({
          session: restoredSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike,
          hasVerifiedTotpFactor: Boolean(mfaSnap?.hasVerifiedTotp),
          biometriaActiva: true,
        });
        setGate(false);
        gateOwned = false;
        const profileData = await raceWithAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(restoredUser), PROFILE_RACE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(
          () => synthesizeProfileFromUser(restoredUser, null, mode)
        );
        if (!mountedRef.current) return false;
        setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(true);
        activateResilientSession(restoredUser, profileData as KineticAuthProfile, restoredSess);
        triggerHaptic?.('Success');
        router.replace(resolveAuthTarget(restoredUser, profileData as KineticAuthProfile, mode) as never);
        return true;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (!isEgressOrTransientAuthError(err)) {
          await purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync(cleanEmail).catch(() => {});
        }
        if (mountedRef.current) setIsTransitioningAfterLogin(false);
        return false;
      } finally {
        bioSubmittingRef.current = false;
        if (gateOwned && !pendingMfaActiveRef.current) setGate(false);
      }
    },
    [activateResilientSession, router, triggerHaptic, setGate]
  );

  return {
    isLoading: isEmailSigningIn || isSsoLoading || isTransitioningAfterLogin,
    isEmailSigningIn, isTransitioningAfterLogin, isSsoLoading, pendingMfaChallenge, isVerifyingMfa, mfaErrorMsg,
    verifyPendingMfaLogin, cancelPendingMfaLogin, handleSignIn, handleBiometricSessionRestore,
    handleGoogleSignIn, handleGoogleInAppLogin, mapSupabaseAuthError,
  };
}

export default useKineticAuth;

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { BackHandler, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut } from '../services/kineticSessionPersistence';
import { isPathMatchingRoleRoot } from '../services/kineticTabRoleGuard';
import { getOverlayDepth, popTopOverlay } from '../services/navigation/kineticOverlayStack';
import { emitKineticRootRefresh, hasOpenKineticModal } from '../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';

export type KineticTabsRootTarget = '/(tabs)/admin' | '/(tabs)/terminal' | '/(tabs)';

export interface IUseTabsBackGuardParams {
  pathname: string;
  inTabsGroup: boolean;
  hasUser: boolean;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  isSocio: boolean;
  roleRootTarget: KineticTabsRootTarget;
  replaceRoute: (target: KineticTabsRootTarget) => void;
}

export function useTabsBackGuard({
  pathname,
  inTabsGroup,
  hasUser,
  isAdmin,
  isSocio,
  roleRootTarget,
  replaceRoute,
}: IUseTabsBackGuardParams): void {
  const navGuardRef = useRef({
    pathname,
    inTabsGroup,
    hasUser,
    isAdmin,
    isSocio,
    roleRootTarget,
  });
  navGuardRef.current = { pathname, inTabsGroup, hasUser, isAdmin, isSocio, roleRootTarget };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !inTabsGroup || !hasUser) return;
    try {
      if (!window.history.state?.kineticGuard) {
        window.history.pushState({ kineticGuard: true }, '', window.location.href);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      void err;
    }

        if (hasOpenKineticModal()) return;

          emitKineticRootRefresh();
        }

    }

    const sub = BackHandler.addEventListener('hardwareBackPress', () => {
      const snap = navGuardRef.current;
      if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || !snap.hasUser || !snap.inTabsGroup) return false;
      if (getOverlayDepth() > 0 && popTopOverlay()) return true;

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  extractAndScrubKpassFromBrowserUrl,
  readValidPrivateWebGrantSync,
  redeemPrivateWebInviteCloud,
  revalidatePrivateWebGrantCloud,
  type PrivateWebTargetPath,
} from '../services/kineticWebPrivatePassLeaf';
import { assignTopWindowLocation } from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

export function useWebPrivatePassLifecycle(params: {
  onPassChanged: () => void;
  onRedirect: (path: PrivateWebTargetPath | '/') => void;
  routeKey: string;
}): void {
  const { onPassChanged, onRedirect, routeKey } = params;
  const lastCheckAtRef = useRef(0);
  const redeemingRef = useRef(false);
  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const cbRef = useRef({ onPassChanged, onRedirect });
  cbRef.current = { onPassChanged, onRedirect };

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => { mountedRef.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const code = extractAndScrubKpassFromBrowserUrl();
    if (!code || redeemingRef.current) return;
    redeemingRef.current = true;
    void redeemPrivateWebInviteCloud(code)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!mountedRef.current) return;
        cbRef.current.onPassChanged();
        if (res.ok && res.targetPath) {
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.top && window.top !== window.self) {
            assignTopWindowLocation(res.targetPath);
          } else {
            cbRef.current.onRedirect(res.targetPath);
          }
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        redeemingRef.current = false;
      });
  }, [routeKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const checkGrant = () => {
      if (redeemingRef.current || String(window.location?.search || '').includes('kpass=')) return;
      const grant = readValidPrivateWebGrantSync();
      if (!grant) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastCheckAtRef.current < 10_000) return;
      lastCheckAtRef.current = now;
      void revalidatePrivateWebGrantCloud().then((res) => {
        if (!mountedRef.current) return;
        if (res.checked && !res.active) {
          cbRef.current.onPassChanged();
          cbRef.current.onRedirect('/');
        }
      });
    };
    checkGrant();
    const onFocus = () => checkGrant();
    const onVis = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkGrant();
    };
    window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
    };
  }, [routeKey]);
}

const SAFE_FALLBACK_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = 'sb-anon-unconfigured-placeholder';

export function resolveSafeSupabaseClientConfig(rawUrl, rawAnonKey) {
  assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(rawAnonKey);
  const candidateUrl = typeof rawUrl === 'string' ? rawUrl.trim() : '';
  const candidateKey = typeof rawAnonKey === 'string' ? rawAnonKey.trim() : '';

  let validHttpsUrl = false;
  if (candidateUrl && !candidateUrl.includes('<REDACTED_')) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(candidateUrl);
      validHttpsUrl = parsed.protocol === 'https:' && Boolean(parsed.hostname);
    } catch {
      validHttpsUrl = false;
    }
  }

  const validKey = Boolean(candidateKey && !candidateKey.includes('<REDACTED_'));
  const isConfigured = validHttpsUrl && validKey;

  return {
    url: validHttpsUrl ? candidateUrl : SAFE_FALLBACK_SUPABASE_URL,
    anonKey: validKey ? candidateKey : SAFE_FALLBACK_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    isConfigured,
