// Inyección segura mediante variables de entorno nativas de Expo (Cero exposición de llaves en consola)

);

const supabaseAnonKey = resolvedSupabaseConfig.anonKey;

const mirrorAuthTokenToPersistedSession = (key, value) => {
  if (!key || typeof value !== 'string' || !/^sb-.*-auth-token$/.test(String(key))) return;
  try {
    if (getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge()?.required) return;

    if (sessionObj?.user?.id) {

      const factors = Array.isArray(sessionObj?.user?.factors) ? sessionObj.user.factors : [];
      const hasVerifiedTotp = factors.some((f) => f?.status === 'verified' && (!f?.factor_type || f.factor_type === 'totp'));
      if (hasVerifiedTotp && String(claims?.aal || 'aal1').toLowerCase() !== 'aal2') return;

  } catch {
    // Silencioso

};

// Adaptador optimizado y seguro tanto para SSR, entornos Web puros y App Móvil (Zero-Logout on Update)
const customStorage = {
  getItem: async (key) => {
    try {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
        try {
          return typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' &&
            typeof localStorage.getItem === 'function'

            : null;

          return null;

      return await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch {

    }
  },
  setItem: async (key, value) => {

        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

            typeof localStorage.setItem === 'function'

            localStorage.setItem(key, value);
          }

        return;
      }
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch {
      // Silencioso: jamás exponer payloads de sesión/JWT en logs de consola
    }
  },
  removeItem: async (key) => {
    try {
      // Blindaje Zero-Logout: no borrar tokens salvo signOut explícito o cancelación de reto MFA pendiente
      if (!isExplicitKineticSignOut() && !getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge()?.required && /^sb-.*-auth-token$/.test(String(key || ''))) {
        return;
      }
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
        try {
          if (
            typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' &&
            typeof localStorage.removeItem === 'function'
          ) {
            localStorage.removeItem(key);
          }
        } catch {}
        return;
      }
      await AsyncStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch {
      // Silencioso
    }
  },
};

// Circuit Breaker Anti-Egress y Resiliencia ante HTTP 402 (Payment Required / Quota Exceeded)
let _isQuotaExceeded = false;
let _lastQuotaErrorTs = 0;
const QUOTA_COOLDOWN_MS = 60000;

export const isSupabaseQuotaExceeded = () => {
  if (_isQuotaExceeded && Date.now() - _lastQuotaErrorTs > QUOTA_COOLDOWN_MS) {
    _isQuotaExceeded = false;
  }
  return _isQuotaExceeded;
};

export const setSupabaseQuotaExceeded = (state = true) => {
  _isQuotaExceeded = Boolean(state);
  if (state) _lastQuotaErrorTs = Date.now();
};

export const isSupabaseQuotaOr402Error = (errOrRes) => {
  if (!errOrRes) return false;
  const status = Number(errOrRes?.status || errOrRes?.statusCode || 0);
  if (status === 402) return true;
  const code = String(errOrRes?.code || '').toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'PGRST_QUOTA_402' || code === '402') return true;
  const msg = String(errOrRes?.message || errOrRes?.details || errOrRes || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    msg.includes('payment required') ||
    msg.includes('quota exceeded') ||
    msg.includes('egress quota') ||
    msg.includes('exceeded the quota')
  );
};

// Fetch con timeout defensivo (10s) y Circuit Breaker ante HTTP 402 / throttling de Egress
const kineticResilientFetch = async (input, init) => {
  const reqMethod = typeof input === 'object' && input !== null && 'method' in input ? input.method : undefined;
  const method = String(init?.method || reqMethod || 'GET').toUpperCase();
  const isReadMethod = method === 'GET' || method === 'HEAD';

  if (isReadMethod && isSupabaseQuotaExceeded()) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        message: 'Payment Required: quota exceeded (circuit breaker active)',
        code: 'PGRST_QUOTA_402',
        details: null,
        hint: null,
      }),
      { status: 402, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    );
  }

  const canAbort = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' && !init?.signal;
  const controller = canAbort ? new AbortController() : null;
  const timeoutId = controller ? setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000) : null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(input, {
      ...(init || {}),
      ...(controller ? { signal: controller.signal } : {}),
    });
    if (res.status === 402 || isSupabaseQuotaOr402Error({ status: res.status, message: res.statusText })) {
      setSupabaseQuotaExceeded(true);
    }
    return res;
  } finally {
    if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }
};

// Inicialización del cliente optimizada para alta concurrencia descentralizada
export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    storage: customStorage,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    persistSession: true,
    flowType: 'pkce',
    detectSessionInUrl: Platform.OS === 'web',
  },
  global: {
    fetch: kineticResilientFetch,
  },
});

// Sincronización de Token con el ciclo de vida nativo (Foreground / Background)
if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
  try {
    AppState.addEventListener('change', (state) => {
      try {
        if (state === 'active') {
          supabase.auth.startAutoRefresh();
        } else {
          supabase.auth.stopAutoRefresh();
        }
      } catch {}
    });
  } catch {}
}

const formatAmenityTitleCase = (raw?: string | null): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .replace(/(^|\s)\S/g, (ch) => ch.toUpperCase());

const normKey = (s?: string | null): string =>
  String(s || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

export function normalizeClubAmenityIds(rawList?: any): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(rawList) || rawList.length === 0) {
    return KINETIC_AMENITIES.slice(0, 6).map((a) => a.id);
  }
  const resolved: string[] = [];
  rawList.forEach((raw) => {
    const clean = String(raw || '').trim();
    if (!clean || clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('__ig:')) return;
    const nk = normKey(clean);
    const preset = KINETIC_AMENITIES.find(
      (a) =>
        a.id === clean ||
        normKey(a.id) === nk ||
        normKey(a.title) === nk ||
        normKey((a as any).titleEn) === nk ||
        (nk.includes('regadera') && a.id === 'regaderas') ||
        (nk.includes('locker') && a.id === 'regaderas') ||
        (nk.includes('estacionamiento') && a.id === 'estacionamiento') ||
        (nk.includes('wifi') && a.id === 'wifi') ||
        ((nk.includes('aire') || nk.includes('climatiza')) && a.id === 'aire_acondicionado') ||
        ((nk.includes('agua') || nk.includes('hidrat')) && a.id === 'hidratacion') ||
        (nk.includes('toalla') && a.id === 'toallas') ||
        ((nk.includes('ice') || nk.includes('recovery') || nk.includes('plunge')) && a.id === 'cold_plunge_recovery') ||
        ((nk.includes('shake') || nk.includes('protein') || nk.includes('smoothie')) && a.id === 'shake_bar') ||
        (nk.includes('valet') && a.id === 'valet_parking') ||
        (nk.includes('pet') && a.id === 'pet_friendly') ||
        ((nk.includes('infrared') || nk.includes('hot')) && a.id === 'hot_studio')
    );
    const finalId = preset ? preset.id : clean;
    if (!resolved.includes(finalId)) resolved.push(finalId);
  });
  return resolved.length > 0 ? resolved : KINETIC_AMENITIES.slice(0, 6).map((a) => a.id);
}

export function localizeSingleAmenity(rawAm: any, language: string): any {
  if (!rawAm) return rawAm;
  const isEn = language === 'en';
  const nkId = normKey(rawAm.id);
  const nkTitle = normKey(rawAm.title);
  const preset = KINETIC_AMENITIES.find((a) => a.id === rawAm.id || normKey(a.title) === nkTitle);
  if (preset) {
    return {
      ...preset,
      ...rawAm,
      icon: rawAm.icon && rawAm.icon !== 'check-circle' ? rawAm.icon : preset.icon,
      title: isEn ? ((preset as any).titleEn || rawAm.titleEn || preset.title) : preset.title,
      desc: isEn ? ((preset as any).descEn || rawAm.descEn || preset.desc) : preset.desc,
    };
  }
  const dictHit =
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkId] ||
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkId.replace(/_/g, ' ')] ||
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkTitle] ||
    CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nkTitle.replace(/_/g, ' ')];
  if (dictHit) {
    const resolvedTier = dictHit.tier || rawAm.tier || 'estandar';
    return {
      ...rawAm,
      icon: dictHit.icon || rawAm.icon || 'check-circle',
      tier: resolvedTier,
      color: resolvedTier === 'vip' ? '#9D4EDD' : rawAm.color || '#00F0FF',
      title: isEn
        ? dictHit.titleEn
        : dictHit.titleEs || formatAmenityTitleCase(rawAm.title || rawAm.id),
      desc: isEn
        ? dictHit.descEn
        : dictHit.descEs || rawAm.desc || 'Instalación verificada disponible en esta sede.',
    };
  }
  const cleanFallbackTitle = formatAmenityTitleCase(rawAm.title || rawAm.id);
  if (!isEn) {
    const hasUnderscoreOrRaw = /[_-]/.test(String(rawAm.title || '')) || String(rawAm.title || '') === String(rawAm.title || '').toLowerCase();
    return {
      ...rawAm,
      title: hasUnderscoreOrRaw ? cleanFallbackTitle : rawAm.title,
      desc: rawAm.desc || 'Instalación verificada disponible en esta sede.',
    };
  }
  const fallback = translateAmenity({ ...rawAm, title: cleanFallbackTitle }, 'en');
  return {
    ...fallback,
    title: formatAmenityTitleCase(rawAm.titleEn || fallback.title || translateDynamicContent(cleanFallbackTitle, 'en')),
    desc: rawAm.descEn || fallback.desc || 'Verified facility available at this Kinetic venue.',
  };
}

export function resolveLocalizedClubAmenities(selectedIds: string[], language: string): any[] {
  const normalized = normalizeClubAmenityIds(selectedIds);
  const items = normalized.map((idOrLabel) => {
    const preset = KINETIC_AMENITIES.find((a) => a.id === idOrLabel);
    if (preset) return preset;
    const nk = normKey(idOrLabel);
    const dictHit = CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nk] || CUSTOM_AMENITY_EN_DICT[nk.replace(/_/g, ' ')];
    const tier = dictHit?.tier || 'estandar';
    return {
      id: idOrLabel,
      title: dictHit?.titleEs || formatAmenityTitleCase(idOrLabel),
      titleEn: dictHit?.titleEn || formatAmenityTitleCase(translateDynamicContent(formatAmenityTitleCase(idOrLabel), 'en')),
      desc: dictHit?.descEs || 'Instalación verificada disponible en esta sede.',
      descEn: dictHit?.descEn || 'Verified facility available at this Kinetic venue.',
      icon: dictHit?.icon || 'check-circle',
      tier,
      color: tier === 'vip' ? '#9D4EDD' : '#00F0FF',
    };
  });
  return items.map((am) => localizeSingleAmenity(am, language));
}

export function localizeClubSchedule(rawHorarios?: string | null, language: string = 'es'): string {
  const base = String(rawHorarios || '').trim().replace(/\b2[4-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '20:$1');
  if (!base) {
    return language === 'en' ? 'Monday to Friday • 06:00 to 22:00' : 'Lunes a Viernes • 06:00 a 22:00';
  }
  const out = translateOperatingHours(base, language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es');
  if (language !== 'en') return out;
  return out
    .replace(/\bCerrado\b/gi, 'Closed')
    .replace(/\bAbierto 24\s*h(?:oras|rs)?\b/gi, 'Open 24h')
    .replace(/\bPrevia Cita\b/gi, 'By Appointment')
    .replace(/\bCita Previa\b/gi, 'By Appointment')
    .replace(/\bLun\b/gi, 'Mon')
    .replace(/\bMar\b/gi, 'Tue')
    .replace(/\bMi[ée]\b/gi, 'Wed')
    .replace(/\bJue\b/gi, 'Thu')
    .replace(/\bVie\b/gi, 'Fri')
    .replace(/\bS[áa]b\b/gi, 'Sat')
    .replace(/\bDom\b/gi, 'Sun');
}

export async function fetchRealClubReviewsFromSupabase(
  clubId?: string | null,
  clubName?: string | null
): Promise<IRealClubReview[]> {
  const cleanName = String(clubName || '').trim();
  const cleanId = String(clubId || '').trim();
  const out: IRealClubReview[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  try {
    if (cleanName) {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('reservas')
        .select('id, servicio_nombre, nombre_servicio, calificacion_estrellas, comentario_resena, created_at')
        .ilike('negocio_nombre', cleanName)
        .not('calificacion_estrellas', 'is', null)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(20);
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        data.forEach((r: any) => {
          const stars = Number(r?.calificacion_estrellas || 0);
          if (stars >= 1 && stars <= 5) {
            const rid = `res_${r.id}`;
            if (!seen.has(rid)) {
              seen.add(rid);
              out.push({
                id: rid,
                author: 'Atleta Verificado QR',
                stars,
                comment: String(r?.comentario_resena || '').trim(),
                serviceName: String(r?.nombre_servicio || r?.servicio_nombre || '').trim(),
                dateIso: r?.created_at ? String(r.created_at) : undefined,
              });
            }
          }
        });
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  if (UUID_RE.test(cleanId)) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('afiliados').select('comentarios').eq('id', cleanId).maybeSingle();
      if (Array.isArray(data?.comentarios)) {
        data.comentarios.forEach((c: any, idx: number) => {
          const stars = Number(c?.estrellas ?? c?.stars ?? c?.calificacion ?? 0);
          const txt = String(c?.comentario ?? c?.comment ?? c?.texto ?? '').trim();
          if (stars >= 1 && stars <= 5 && (txt.length > 0 || c?.id)) {
            const cid = `com_${c?.id || idx}`;
            if (!seen.has(cid)) {
              seen.add(cid);
              out.push({
                id: cid,
                author: String(c?.autor || c?.author || 'Atleta Verificado').trim(),
                stars,
                comment: txt,
                dateIso: c?.created_at || c?.fecha || undefined,
              });
            }
          }
        });
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return out;
}

import {
  KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES,
  cleanLocationDisplay,
  resolveCategoryImage,
  resolveDisciplineGalleryFallbacks,
  upsertRuntimeAffiliateState,
} from '../constants/exploreData';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  persistClubAuditRatingToStorage,
  saveClubExtCache,
} from '../utils/clubLocalOverridesHelper';
import { setSyncClubMediaMemory } from '../utils/exploreEnrichmentHelpers';
import {
  emitKineticRadarUpdated,
  extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords,
} from '../utils/kineticEliteHelpers';
import {
  isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl,
  readMediaUriAsUint8Array,
  validateSafeStorageImagePayload,
} from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

export {
  fetchRealClubReviewsFromSupabase,
  localizeClubSchedule,
  localizeSingleAmenity,
  normalizeClubAmenityIds,
  resolveLocalizedClubAmenities,
} from './clubAmenitiesAndReviewsHelper';
export type { IRealClubReview } from './clubAmenitiesAndReviewsHelper';

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

const normKey = (s?: string | null): string =>
  String(s || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

const keepOnlyVerifiedHttps = (u?: unknown): string | null => {
  const s = String(u || '').trim();
  return isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(s) ? s : null;
};

export async function uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(uri?: string | null, clubKey = 'club', slot = 'img'): Promise<string | null> {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  if (isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(clean)) return clean;
  if (/^http:\/\//i.test(clean)) return null;
  try {
    const safeKey = normKey(clubKey).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').slice(0, 28) || 'club';
    const bytes = await readMediaUriAsUint8Array(clean);
    const check = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes, uriOrName: clean });
    if (!check.ok || !bytes) return null;
    const path = `clubs/${safeKey}_${slot}_${Date.now()}.${check.ext || 'jpg'}`;
    const { error } = await supabase.storage
      .from('avatars')
      .upload(path, bytes, { contentType: check.contentType || 'image/jpeg', cacheControl: '604800', upsert: true });
    if (error) return null;
    const { data } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
    const pub = String(data?.publicUrl || '').trim();
    return isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(pub) ? pub : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate: any, targetName: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const rawId = String(affiliate?.id || '').trim();
  if (UUID_RE.test(rawId)) return rawId;
  const namesToTry = Array.from(
    new Set([String(affiliate?.nombre || '').trim(), String(targetName || '').trim()].filter(Boolean))
  );
  for (const nm of namesToTry) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('afiliados').select('id').ilike('nombre', nm).limit(1);
      if (Array.isArray(data) && data[0]?.id && UUID_RE.test(String(data[0].id))) {
        return String(data[0].id);
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}

export async function persistClubSheetAsAdmin(affiliate: any, updatedFields: Record<string, any>): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
  const clubKey = String(affiliate?.id || updatedFields.nombre || affiliate?.nombre || 'club');
  const [resolvedAvatar, resolvedPortada] = await Promise.all([
    uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(updatedFields.avatar_url, clubKey, 'avatar'),
    uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(updatedFields.portada_url, clubKey, 'cover'),
  ]);
  const rawGal = Array.isArray(updatedFields.galeria) ? updatedFields.galeria.slice(0, 4) : [];
  const positionalGaleria = await Promise.all(
    [0, 1, 2, 3].map(async (idx) => {
      const g = String(rawGal[idx] || '').trim();
      if (!g || g.length <= 5) return '';
      return (await uploadClubImageToStorageSafe(g, clubKey, `gal${idx}`)) || '';
    })
  );
  const resolvedGaleria = positionalGaleria.some(Boolean) ? positionalGaleria : [];

  const finalFields: Record<string, any> = {
    ...updatedFields,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.avatar_url),
    portada_url: resolvedPortada ?? keepOnlyVerifiedHttps(updatedFields.portada_url),
    galeria: resolvedGaleria,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const parsedGeo = extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords(String(finalFields.ubicacion || ''));
  const lat = parsedGeo.lat ?? affiliate?.latitud ?? affiliate?.latitude ?? null;
  const lng = parsedGeo.lng ?? affiliate?.longitud ?? affiliate?.longitude ?? null;
  if (typeof lat === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lat)) finalFields.latitud = lat;
  if (typeof lng === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lng)) finalFields.longitud = lng;

  const scores = Array.isArray(finalFields.audit_scores) ? finalFields.audit_scores : null;
  const ratingFallback = Number(finalFields.rating) > 0 ? Number(finalFields.rating) : null;
  const isSpec = Boolean(affiliate?.es_especialista);

  const tier1Payload: Record<string, any> = {
    nombre: finalFields.nombre,
    disciplina: finalFields.disciplina,
    categoria: affiliate?.categoria || (isSpec ? 'Especialista' : 'Club'),
    ubicacion: finalFields.ubicacion,
    descripcion: finalFields.descripcion,
    horarios: finalFields.horarios,
    instagram: finalFields.instagram,
    whatsapp: finalFields.whatsapp,
    amenidades: finalFields.amenidades,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
    galeria: finalFields.galeria,
  };
  if (typeof lat === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lat)) tier1Payload.latitud = lat;
  if (typeof lng === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(lng)) tier1Payload.longitud = lng;
  if (scores && scores.length >= 4) {
    tier1Payload.rating_limpieza = scores[2] ?? scores[0] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_seguridad = scores[3] ?? scores[1] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_equipo = scores[1] ?? scores[2] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_atencion = scores[4] ?? scores[3] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
    tier1Payload.rating_comunidad = scores[0] ?? ratingFallback ?? 5;
  } else if (ratingFallback) {
    tier1Payload.rating_limpieza = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_seguridad = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_equipo = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_atencion = ratingFallback;
    tier1Payload.rating_comunidad = ratingFallback;
  }
  if (finalFields.audit_checklists) tier1Payload.audit_checklists = finalFields.audit_checklists;

  const tier2Payload: Record<string, any> = {
    nombre: finalFields.nombre,
    disciplina: finalFields.disciplina,
    ubicacion: finalFields.ubicacion,
    descripcion: finalFields.descripcion,
    horarios: finalFields.horarios,
    instagram: finalFields.instagram,
    whatsapp: finalFields.whatsapp,
    amenidades: finalFields.amenidades,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
  };

  const tier3Payload: Record<string, any> = {
    nombre: finalFields.nombre,
    disciplina: finalFields.disciplina,
    ubicacion: finalFields.ubicacion,
    descripcion: finalFields.descripcion,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
    whatsapp: finalFields.whatsapp,
    instagram: finalFields.instagram,
  };

  const existingUuid = await resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate, finalFields.nombre);
  if (existingUuid) {
    finalFields.id = existingUuid;
    const r1 = await supabase.from('afiliados').update(tier1Payload).eq('id', existingUuid);
    if (r1.error) {
      const r2 = await supabase.from('afiliados').update(tier2Payload).eq('id', existingUuid);
      if (r2.error) await supabase.from('afiliados').update(tier3Payload).eq('id', existingUuid);
    }
  } else {
    const insPayload = { ...tier1Payload, estado: affiliate?.esActivo ? 'activo' : 'inactivo' };
    let createdId: string | null = null;
    const i1 = await supabase.from('afiliados').insert([insPayload]).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (!i1.error && i1.data?.id) {
      createdId = String(i1.data.id);
    } else {
      const i2 = await supabase
        .from('afiliados')
        .insert([{ ...tier2Payload, estado: affiliate?.esActivo ? 'activo' : 'inactivo' }])
        .select('id')
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!i2.error && i2.data?.id) createdId = String(i2.data.id);
      else {
        const i3 = await supabase.from('afiliados').insert([tier3Payload]).select('id').maybeSingle();
        if (!i3.error && i3.data?.id) createdId = String(i3.data.id);
      }
    }
    if (createdId) finalFields.id = createdId;
  }

  const finalIdKey = String(finalFields.id || clubKey);
  setSyncClubMediaMemory([finalIdKey, clubKey, affiliate?.id, affiliate?.nombre, finalFields.nombre], {
    portada_url: finalFields.portada_url,
    avatar_url: finalFields.avatar_url,
    galeria: finalFields.galeria,
  });
  await saveClubExtCache(finalIdKey, finalFields, finalFields.nombre);
  if (clubKey !== finalIdKey) await saveClubExtCache(clubKey, finalFields, affiliate?.nombre);
  upsertRuntimeAffiliateState({ ...affiliate, ...finalFields });

  const oldNameNorm = normKey(affiliate?.nombre);
  const newNameNorm = normKey(finalFields.nombre);
  (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).forEach((st: any) => {
    const stNorm = normKey(st?.nombre);
    if ((oldNameNorm && stNorm === oldNameNorm) || (newNameNorm && stNorm === newNameNorm)) {
      Object.assign(st, finalFields);
    }
  });

  const { exploreService } = await import('./exploreService');
  exploreService.clearRadarCache();
  emitKineticRadarUpdated();
  return finalFields;
}

export async function persistClubAuditAndChecklists(
  affiliate: any,
  clubId: string,
  clubName: string,
  cleanRating: number,
  cleanScores: number[] | null,
  checklists: Record<string, boolean> | null,
  isAdminUser: boolean
): Promise<void> {
  await persistClubAuditRatingToStorage(affiliate, clubId, clubName, cleanRating, cleanScores);
  if (checklists) {
    await saveClubExtCache(clubId, { audit_checklists: checklists }, clubName);
  }
  upsertRuntimeAffiliateState({
    ...affiliate,
    rating: cleanRating,
    calificacion: cleanRating,
    audit_scores: cleanScores,
    audit_checklists: checklists || affiliate?.audit_checklists || null,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  if (isAdminUser) {
    const existingUuid = await resolveExistingAffiliateUuid(affiliate, clubName);
    const fiveRubrosPayload: Record<string, any> =
      cleanScores && cleanScores.length >= 4
        ? {
            rating_limpieza: cleanScores[2] ?? cleanScores[0] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_seguridad: cleanScores[3] ?? cleanScores[1] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_equipo: cleanScores[1] ?? cleanScores[2] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_atencion: cleanScores[4] ?? cleanScores[3] ?? cleanRating,
            rating_comunidad: cleanScores[0] ?? cleanRating,
          }
        : {
            rating_limpieza: cleanRating,
            rating_seguridad: cleanRating,
            rating_equipo: cleanRating,
            rating_atencion: cleanRating,
            rating_comunidad: cleanRating,
          };
    const fullAuditPayload: Record<string, any> = {
      ...fiveRubrosPayload,
      ...(checklists ? { audit_checklists: checklists } : {}),
    };

    if (existingUuid) {
      affiliate.id = existingUuid;
      const { error } = await supabase.from('afiliados').update(fullAuditPayload).eq('id', existingUuid);
      if (error) {
        await supabase.from('afiliados').update(fiveRubrosPayload).eq('id', existingUuid);
      }
    } else if (clubName) {
      const ins = await supabase
        .from('afiliados')
        .insert([
          {
            nombre: clubName,
            disciplina: affiliate?.disciplina || 'Fuerza',
            ubicacion: affiliate?.ubicacion || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.',
            ...fiveRubrosPayload,
            estado: affiliate?.esActivo ? 'activo' : 'inactivo',
          },
        ])
        .select('id')
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!ins.error && ins.data?.id) affiliate.id = String(ins.data.id);
    }
    const { exploreService } = await import('./exploreService');
    exploreService.clearRadarCache();
    emitKineticRadarUpdated();
  }
}

const ADMIN_EMAILS = ['administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com'];

export function resolveClubOwnerPermissions(hasValidJwt: boolean, user: any, profile: any, activeClub: any) {
  if (!hasValidJwt) return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: false };
  const email = String(user?.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const rol = String(profile?.rol || profile?.tipo_cuenta || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const isAdmin = ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(email) || rol === 'admin' || rol === 'fundador';
  if (isAdmin) return { isAdmin: true, isOwnerOfThisClub: true };
  if (!user?.id || !activeClub) return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: false };
  if (activeClub.propietario_id && String(activeClub.propietario_id) === String(user.id)) return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: true };
  const myName = String(profile?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cName = String(activeClub.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return { isAdmin: false, isOwnerOfThisClub: Boolean(myName && cName && myName === cName) };
}

export function resolveClubCarouselMedia(disciplina: string, nombreSede: string, activeClub: any, editData: any) {
  const clubFallbackUri = resolveCategoryImage(disciplina, activeClub?.categoria || nombreSede);
  const discFallbacks = resolveDisciplineGalleryFallbacks(disciplina, activeClub?.categoria || nombreSede);
  const rawCover = editData?.portada_url || activeClub?.portada_url;
  const coverImageUri = rawCover && String(rawCover).trim().length > 5 ? rawCover : clubFallbackUri;
  const rawGal = Array.isArray(editData?.galeria) ? editData.galeria : Array.isArray(activeClub?.galeria) ? activeClub.galeria : [];
  const galSlots = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((idx) => {
    const u = String(rawGal[idx] || '').trim();
    return u.length > 5 && !u.startsWith('data:image/nonexistent') ? u : discFallbacks[idx] || clubFallbackUri;
  });
  const l = String(nombreSede).trim().toLowerCase();
  const isOfficialKineticBrand = l === 'kinetic oficial' || l === 'kinetic sports club';
  const rawAv = editData?.avatar_url || activeClub?.avatar_url;
  const logoSquareUri = rawAv && String(rawAv).trim().length > 5 ? rawAv : isOfficialKineticBrand ? null : coverImageUri;
  return { clubFallbackUri, allCarouselImages: [coverImageUri, ...galSlots], logoSquareUri };
}

export function buildClubSharePayload(p: { nombreSede: string; disciplina: string; ubicacion?: string; rating: number; language: string; discLoc: string }) {
  const isEn = p.language === 'en';
  const cleanLoc = cleanLocationDisplay(p.ubicacion, isEn ? 'Verified Location' : 'Ubicación Verificada');
  const url = `https://kineticapp.com.mx/?sede=${encodeURIComponent(String(p.nombreSede).toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-'))}`;
  const title = isEn ? `${p.nombreSede} on Kinetic` : `${p.nombreSede} en Kinetic`;
  const webText = isEn
    ? `⚡ Train at ${p.nombreSede} (${p.discLoc} • ★ ${p.rating.toFixed(1)}) via Kinetic.\n📍 ${cleanLoc}`
    : `⚡ Entrena en ${p.nombreSede} (${p.discLoc} • ★ ${p.rating.toFixed(1)}) vía Kinetic.\n📍 ${cleanLoc}`;
  return { title, url, webText, message: `${webText}\n📲 ${url}` };
}

import { normalizeOrbitalYawDeg } from './kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';
import {
  type IProjectedPolygon,
  type IRawPolyFace,
  type IVec3,
  addClosedBox,
  projectPerspectivePoint,
  rotX,
  rotY,
  shadeAndSortFaces,
} from './kinetic3DProjectionLeaf';

export type TrophyArchetypeKey = 'fuerza_kettlebell' | 'padel_raqueta' | 'zen_reformer_loto' | 'combate_hexagono' | 'acuatico_ola_crono' | 'racha_flama_solar' | 'equipo_escudo_dual' | 'clubes_brujula_pin' | 'fisio_pulso_prisma' | 'prestigio_corona_caliz';

export interface ITrophySculptureRecipe {
  orden: number; codigo: string; archetype: TrophyArchetypeKey; pedestalSides: number; pedestalHeight: number;
  waistScale: number; shoulderScale: number; twistDeg: number; orbitTiltDeg: number; wingMode: number; finialMode: number; heightOffset: number;
}

export interface IIndividualizedTrophyManifoldParams {
  orden?: number; id?: string; tipo?: string; disciplinaClave?: string; familia?: string; yawDeg: number; pitchDeg: number;
  tierMain: string; tierBevel: string; tierDark: string; tierWing: string; unlocked: boolean; size?: number; staticPreview?: boolean;
}

export interface IIndividualizedTrophyManifoldResult {
  polys: IProjectedPolygon[]; frontScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number }; backScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  pedestalRingRx: number; pedestalRingRy: number; archetype: TrophyArchetypeKey; codigo: string;
}

const STATIC_PREVIEW_CACHE = new Map<string, IIndividualizedTrophyManifoldResult>();
const MAX_PREVIEW_CACHE = 600;

export function resolveTrophyOrderNumber(ordenOrId?: number | string): number {
  if (typeof ordenOrId === 'number' && Number.isFinite(ordenOrId)) {
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(250, Math.round(ordenOrId)));
  }
  const m = String(ordenOrId || '').match(/(\d{1,3})/);
  const parsed = m ? Number(m[1]) : 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(250, Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 1));
}

export function formatTrophyCode(orden: number): string {
  return `#${String(resolveTrophyOrderNumber(orden)).padStart(3, '0')}`;
}

function resolveTrophyArchetype(meta?: {
  tipo?: string;
  disciplinaClave?: string;
  familia?: string;
  orden?: number;
}): TrophyArchetypeKey {
  const disc = String(meta?.disciplinaClave || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const tipo = String(meta?.tipo || '').toLowerCase();
  const fam = String(meta?.familia || '').toLowerCase();

  if (disc.includes('padel') || disc.includes('tenis')) return 'padel_raqueta';
  if (disc.includes('pilates') || disc.includes('yoga') || disc.includes('movilidad')) return 'zen_reformer_loto';
  if (disc.includes('box') || disc.includes('combate')) return 'combate_hexagono';
  if (disc.includes('natacion') || disc.includes('surf') || disc.includes('ciclismo')) return 'acuatico_ola_crono';
  if (disc.includes('fisio') || tipo === 'habito_app') return 'fisio_pulso_prisma';
  if (disc.includes('fuerza') || disc.includes('crossfit')) return 'fuerza_kettlebell';
  if (tipo === 'racha') return 'racha_flama_solar';
  if (tipo === 'equipo') return 'equipo_escudo_dual';
  if (tipo === 'clubes_visitados' || fam === 'clubes') return 'clubes_brujula_pin';
  if (tipo === 'disciplinas' || tipo === 'sesiones') return 'prestigio_corona_caliz';
  const fallbackPool: TrophyArchetypeKey[] = ['prestigio_corona_caliz', 'fuerza_kettlebell', 'racha_flama_solar'];
  return fallbackPool[resolveTrophyOrderNumber(meta?.orden) % fallbackPool.length];
}

export function resolveTrophySculptureRecipe(
  orden1To250: number,
  meta?: { id?: string; tipo?: string; disciplinaClave?: string; familia?: string; division?: string }
): ITrophySculptureRecipe {
  const orden = resolveTrophyOrderNumber(orden1To250 || meta?.id);
  const archetype = resolveTrophyArchetype({ ...meta, orden });
  return {
    orden,
    codigo: formatTrophyCode(orden),
    archetype,
    pedestalSides: 5 + (orden % 6),
    pedestalHeight: Number((2.4 + ((orden * 7) % 19) * 0.25).toFixed(2)),
    waistScale: Number((0.76 + ((orden * 11) % 29) * 0.014).toFixed(3)),
    shoulderScale: Number((0.88 + ((orden * 13) % 31) * 0.014).toFixed(3)),
    twistDeg: ((orden * 19) % 44) - 22,
    orbitTiltDeg: ((orden * 23) % 64) - 32,
    wingMode: orden % 5,
    finialMode: orden % 6,
    heightOffset: Number(((((orden * 37) % 250) / 250 - 0.5) * 4.2).toFixed(3)),
  };
}

function emitLatheQuadOrCap(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  ringA: IVec3[],
  ringB: IVec3[],
  r0: number,
  r1: number,
  segs: number,
  baseHex: string,
  specWeight: number,
  ambientMin: number
): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) {
    const ni = (i + 1) % segs;
    if (r0 === 0 && r1 > 0) {
      faces.push({ pts: [ringA[i], ringB[ni], ringB[i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
      continue;
    }
    if (r1 === 0 && r0 > 0) {
      faces.push({ pts: [ringA[i], ringA[ni], ringB[i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
      continue;
    }
    if (r0 > 0 || r1 > 0) {
      faces.push({ pts: [ringA[i], ringA[ni], ringB[ni], ringB[i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
    }
  }
}

function pushLatheSection(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  profile: { y: number; r: number; twistRatio?: number }[],
  segs: number,
  baseHex: string,
  specWeight: number,
  ambientMin: number,
  twistRad: number,
  xf: (v: IVec3) => IVec3
): void {
  const rings: IVec3[][] = profile.map((pt) => {
    const tAng = twistRad * (pt.twistRatio ?? 0);
    return Array.from({ length: segs }, (_, i) => {
      const phi = tAng + (i / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
      return xf({ x: pt.r * Math.cos(phi), y: pt.y, z: pt.r * Math.sin(phi) });
    });
  });
  for (let k = 0; k < profile.length - 1; k++) {
    emitLatheQuadOrCap(faces, rings[k], rings[k + 1], profile[k].r, profile[k + 1].r, segs, baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin);
  }
}

function pushWingFins(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  recipe: ITrophySculptureRecipe,
  wingHex: string,
  spec: number,
  xf: (v: IVec3) => IVec3
): void {
  const wScale = 0.9 + (recipe.wingMode % 3) * 0.14;
  const dy = recipe.heightOffset * 0.4;
  if (recipe.wingMode === 0) return;
  const count = recipe.wingMode === 4 ? 3 : 2;
  for (let idx = 0; idx < count; idx++) {
    const rotAng = count === 3 ? (idx / 3) * Math.PI * 2 : idx === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
    const finXf = (v: IVec3) => xf(rotY(v, rotAng));
    const yTop = -20 + dy - (recipe.wingMode % 2) * 3;
    const xTip = (28 + recipe.wingMode * 2.1) * wScale;
    addClosedBox(faces, 14, xTip, yTop, yTop + 12, -2.4, 2.4, wingHex, spec, finXf);
    if (recipe.wingMode >= 2) {
      addClosedBox(faces, xTip - 5, xTip + 3.5, yTop - 7, yTop + 2, -2.0, 2.0, wingHex, spec, finXf);
    }
  }
}

function pushFinialAndOrbital(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  recipe: ITrophySculptureRecipe,
  bevelHex: string,
  mainHex: string,
  segs: number,
  spec: number,
  xf: (v: IVec3) => IVec3
): void {
  const topY = -28 + recipe.heightOffset;
  const orbTilt = (recipe.orbitTiltDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const orbXf = (v: IVec3) => xf(rotX({ x: v.x, y: v.y, z: v.z }, orbTilt));

  if (recipe.finialMode % 2 === 1) {
    const rOut = 23 + (recipe.orden % 5);
    const rIn = rOut - 2.4;
    const steps = Math.max(8, segs);
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const a0 = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
      const a1 = ((i + 1) / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
      const yRing = -10 + recipe.heightOffset * 0.5;
      faces.push({
        pts: [
          orbXf({ x: rOut * Math.cos(a0), y: yRing - 1.5, z: rOut * Math.sin(a0) }),
          orbXf({ x: rOut * Math.cos(a1), y: yRing - 1.5, z: rOut * Math.sin(a1) }),
          orbXf({ x: rIn * Math.cos(a1), y: yRing + 1.5, z: rIn * Math.sin(a1) }),
          orbXf({ x: rIn * Math.cos(a0), y: yRing + 1.5, z: rIn * Math.sin(a0) }),
        ],
        baseHex: bevelHex,
        specWeight: spec,
        doubleSided: true,
      });
    }
  }

  const tipRadius = 4.2 + (recipe.finialMode % 4) * 1.1;
  pushLatheSection(
    faces,
    [
      { y: topY + 6, r: 0 },
      { y: topY + 3, r: tipRadius },
      { y: topY - 4 - (recipe.finialMode % 3) * 1.8, r: 0 },
    ],
    Math.max(5, Math.min(8, segs)),
    bevelHex,
    spec,
    0.26,
    0,
    xf
  );
  if (recipe.finialMode >= 3) {
    addClosedBox(faces, -8.5, 8.5, topY + 4, topY + 7.2, -2.5, 2.5, mainHex, spec, xf);
  }
}

function buildArchetypeBodyFaces(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  recipe: ITrophySculptureRecipe,
  p: { main: string; bevel: string; dark: string; wing: string; spec: number; segs: number },
  xf: (v: IVec3) => IVec3
): void {
  const ws = recipe.waistScale;
  const ss = recipe.shoulderScale;
  const dy = recipe.heightOffset * 0.65;
  const tw = (recipe.twistDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a = recipe.archetype;

  if (a === 'fuerza_kettlebell') {
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 21, r: 0 }, { y: 21, r: 15 * ss }, { y: 12, r: 18.5 * ss }, { y: 2 + dy, r: 16 * ws }, { y: -8 + dy, r: 9.5 * ws }, { y: -8 + dy, r: 0 },
    ], p.segs, p.main, p.spec, 0.22, tw * 0.4, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -11, 11, -22 + dy, -17 + dy, -3.5, 3.5, p.bevel, p.spec, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -11, -6.5, -18 + dy, -7 + dy, -3.5, 3.5, p.wing, p.spec, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, 6.5, 11, -18 + dy, -7 + dy, -3.5, 3.5, p.wing, p.spec, xf);
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'padel_raqueta') {
    addClosedBox(faces, -3.4, 3.4, 8, 22, -3.2, 3.2, p.wing, p.spec, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -10.5 * ws, 10.5 * ws, 1, 9, -3.4, 3.4, p.dark, p.spec, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -16 * ss, 16 * ss, -23 + dy, 2, -4.0, 4.0, p.main, p.spec, xf);
    pushLatheSection(faces, [{ y: -15 + dy, r: 0 }, { y: -19 + dy, r: 6.2 }, { y: -23 + dy, r: 0 }], 6, p.bevel, p.spec, 0.25, 0, (v) => xf({ x: v.x + 12, y: v.y, z: v.z + 4 }));
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'zen_reformer_loto') {
    addClosedBox(faces, -24 * ss, 24 * ss, 14, 21, -11, 11, p.wing, p.spec, xf);
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 14, r: 0 }, { y: 14, r: 13 * ws }, { y: 4 + dy, r: 21 * ss, twistRatio: 0.6 }, { y: -8 + dy, r: 11 * ws, twistRatio: 1 }, { y: -18 + dy, r: 5 }, { y: -18 + dy, r: 0 },
    ], p.segs, p.main, p.spec, 0.24, tw, xf);
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'combate_hexagono') {
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 20, r: 0 }, { y: 20, r: 19 * ss }, { y: 11, r: 19 * ss }, { y: 6, r: 9 * ws }, { y: -4 + dy, r: 17 * ss }, { y: -19 + dy, r: 14 * ss }, { y: -24 + dy, r: 0 },
    ], 6, p.main, p.spec, 0.22, tw * 0.5, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -13, 13, -15 + dy, -7 + dy, 9, 16, p.bevel, p.spec, xf);
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'acuatico_ola_crono') {
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 21, r: 0 }, { y: 21, r: 11 * ws }, { y: 10, r: 7.5 * ws }, { y: 2, r: 18 * ss, twistRatio: 0.5 }, { y: -15 + dy, r: 15 * ss, twistRatio: 1 }, { y: -22 + dy, r: 0 },
    ], p.segs, p.main, p.spec, 0.22, tw * 1.4, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -4.5, 4.5, -27 + dy, -20 + dy, -3.5, 3.5, p.bevel, p.spec, xf);
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'racha_flama_solar') {
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 21, r: 0 }, { y: 21, r: 10 * ws }, { y: 9, r: 16 * ss, twistRatio: 0.4 }, { y: -3 + dy, r: 13 * ws, twistRatio: 0.8 }, { y: -16 + dy, r: 7.5, twistRatio: 1.2 }, { y: -28 + dy, r: 0, twistRatio: 1.5 },

    return;
  }
  if (a === 'equipo_escudo_dual') {
    addClosedBox(faces, -5, 5, 11, 21, -5, 5, p.dark, p.spec, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -17 * ss, 17 * ss, -18 + dy, 6, -4.2, 4.2, p.main, p.spec, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -11 * ws, 11 * ws, 6, 14, -4.0, 4.0, p.wing, p.spec, xf);
    return;

  if (a === 'clubes_brujula_pin') {
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 21, r: 0 }, { y: 12, r: 4.5 }, { y: -3 + dy, r: 16.5 * ss }, { y: -18 + dy, r: 14 * ss }, { y: -24 + dy, r: 0 },
    ], p.segs, p.main, p.spec, 0.22, tw, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -21, 21, -12 + dy, -8 + dy, -2.5, 2.5, p.bevel, p.spec, xf);
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'fisio_pulso_prisma') {
    pushLatheSection(faces, [
      { y: 21, r: 0 }, { y: 21, r: 12 * ws }, { y: 4, r: 15 * ss, twistRatio: 0.5 }, { y: -17 + dy, r: 11 * ws, twistRatio: 1 }, { y: -25 + dy, r: 0 },
    ], 5 + (recipe.orden % 3), p.main, p.spec, 0.24, tw, xf);
    addClosedBox(faces, -17, 17, -6 + dy, -1 + dy, -3.5, 3.5, p.bevel, p.spec, xf);
    return;
  }
  pushLatheSection(faces, [
    { y: 21, r: 0 }, { y: 21, r: 8.5 * ws }, { y: 12, r: 6.2 * ws }, { y: 3, r: 14.5 * ss }, { y: -12 + dy, r: 21.5 * ss }, { y: -22 + dy, r: 23.2 * ss }, { y: -22 + dy, r: 17.5 * ss }, { y: -6 + dy, r: 9 }, { y: -4 + dy, r: 0 },
  ], p.segs, p.main, p.spec, 0.22, tw * 0.4, xf);
}

export function buildIndividualizedTrophyManifold(
  params: IIndividualizedTrophyManifoldParams
): IIndividualizedTrophyManifoldResult {
  const orden = resolveTrophyOrderNumber(params.orden ?? params.id);
  const recipe = resolveTrophySculptureRecipe(orden, {
    id: params.id,
    tipo: params.tipo,
    disciplinaClave: params.disciplinaClave,
    familia: params.familia,
  });
  const normYaw = normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(params.yawDeg);
  const safePitch = Math.max(-28, Math.min(18, Number.isFinite(params.pitchDeg) ? params.pitchDeg : -13));
  const cacheKey = params.staticPreview
    ? `${recipe.orden}_${recipe.archetype}_${params.tierMain}_${params.unlocked ? 1 : 0}_${normYaw.toFixed(1)}_${safePitch.toFixed(1)}`
    : '';
  if (cacheKey) {
    const cached = STATIC_PREVIEW_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) return cached;
  }

  const yawRad = (normYaw * Math.PI) / 180;
  const pitchRad = (safePitch * Math.PI) / 180;
  const camF = 248;
  const cx = 60;
  const cy = 62;
  const xf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => rotX(rotY(v, yawRad), pitchRad);
  const segs = params.staticPreview ? 8 : 14;
  const spec = params.unlocked ? 0.62 : 0.22;
  const rawFaces: IRawPolyFace[] = [];

  const pedTop = 44 - recipe.pedestalHeight * 7.2;
  pushLatheSection(rawFaces, [{ y: 44, r: 0 }, { y: 44, r: 24.5 }, { y: pedTop + 5, r: 22.8 }, { y: pedTop, r: 16.2 }, { y: 21, r: 14.5 * recipe.waistScale }, { y: 21, r: 0 }], recipe.pedestalSides, params.tierDark, spec * 0.85, 0.2, 0, xf);
  buildArchetypeBodyFaces(rawFaces, recipe, { main: params.tierMain, bevel: params.tierBevel, dark: params.tierDark, wing: params.tierWing, spec, segs }, xf);
  pushWingFins(rawFaces, recipe, params.tierWing, spec, xf);
  pushFinialAndOrbital(rawFaces, recipe, params.tierBevel, params.tierMain, segs, spec, xf);

  const polys = shadeAndSortFaces(rawFaces, camF, cx, cy, params.tierBevel, params.tierDark, 1.08, 1.2);
  const f3 = xf({ x: 0, y: -8, z: 22.8 }), b3 = xf({ x: 0, y: -8, z: -22.8 });
  const fP = projectPerspectivePoint(f3, camF, cx, cy), bP = projectPerspectivePoint(b3, camF, cx, cy);
  const pitchCos = Math.max(0.28, Math.abs(Math.sin(pitchRad)) + 0.32);

  const out: IIndividualizedTrophyManifoldResult = {
    polys, frontScreen: { x: fP.x, y: fP.y, z: f3.z }, backScreen: { x: bP.x, y: bP.y, z: b3.z },
    pedestalRingRx: 33.5, pedestalRingRy: Number((10.5 * pitchCos).toFixed(1)), archetype: recipe.archetype, codigo: recipe.codigo,
  };
  if (cacheKey) {
    if (STATIC_PREVIEW_CACHE.size >= MAX_PREVIEW_CACHE) STATIC_PREVIEW_CACHE.clear();
    STATIC_PREVIEW_CACHE.set(cacheKey, out);
  }
  return out;
}

export function computeTrophyGeometricSignature(orden1To250: number, meta?: { id?: string; tipo?: string; disciplinaClave?: string; familia?: string }): string {
  const res = buildIndividualizedTrophyManifold({ orden: orden1To250, id: meta?.id, tipo: meta?.tipo, disciplinaClave: meta?.disciplinaClave, familia: meta?.familia, yawDeg: 18, pitchDeg: -13, tierMain: '#00F0FF', tierBevel: '#CFFAFE', tierDark: '#0E4E5E', tierWing: '#00838F', unlocked: true, size: 120, staticPreview: true });
  return `${res.archetype}|${res.polys.length}|${res.polys.map((p) => p.points).join(';')}`;
}

export interface IPaginatedVaultSlice<T> { items: T[]; currentPage: number; totalPages: number; totalItems: number; rangeStart: number; rangeEnd: number; }

export function paginateTrophyVault40<T>(items: readonly T[], page1Based: number, pageSize = 40): IPaginatedVaultSlice<T> {
  const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
  const safeSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(40, Math.floor(Number(pageSize) || 40)));
  const totalItems = list.length;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / safeSize));
  const rawPage = Number.isFinite(page1Based) ? Math.floor(page1Based) : 1;
  const currentPage = Math.max(1, Math.min(totalPages, rawPage));
  const startIdx = (currentPage - 1) * safeSize;
  const sliced = list.slice(startIdx, startIdx + safeSize);
  return { items: sliced, currentPage, totalPages, totalItems, rangeStart: totalItems === 0 ? 0 : startIdx + 1, rangeEnd: totalItems === 0 ? 0 : startIdx + sliced.length };
}

import { normalizeOrbitalYawDeg } from './kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';
import {
  type IProjectedPolygon,
  type IRawPolyFace,

  rotX,

export interface IChaliceManifoldParams {

export interface IChaliceManifoldResult {

  backScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  pedestalRingRx: number;
  pedestalRingRy: number;
}

const PEDESTAL_LATHE: [number, number][] = [
  [44, 0], [44, 24.8], [39.5, 24.8], [36, 18.8], [32, 18.8], [29, 14], [25, 14], [25, 0],
];

const CHALICE_LATHE: { y: number; r: number; inner?: boolean }[] = [
  { y: 25.2, r: 0 }, { y: 25.2, r: 8.4 }, { y: 20, r: 5.4 }, { y: 15, r: 7.9 }, { y: 10.5, r: 4.9 },
  { y: 6.5, r: 7.3 }, { y: 1.5, r: 15 }, { y: -7.5, r: 21.4 }, { y: -17, r: 23.6 }, { y: -22.2, r: 24.8 },
  { y: -24.4, r: 24.8 }, { y: -24.4, r: 21.6, inner: true }, { y: -21.8, r: 19.6, inner: true },
  { y: -12, r: 16.8, inner: true }, { y: -3, r: 10.0, inner: true }, { y: -0.4, r: 0, inner: true },
];

export function buildVolumetricChaliceManifold(params: IChaliceManifoldParams): IChaliceManifoldResult {
  const yawRad = (normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(params.yawDeg) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const safePitch = Math.max(-28, Math.min(18, Number.isFinite(params.pitchDeg) ? params.pitchDeg : -13));
  const pitchRad = (safePitch * Math.PI) / 180;
  const camF = 248;
  const cx = 60;
  const cy = 62;
  const xf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => rotX(rotY(v, yawRad), pitchRad);

  const rawFaces: IRawPolyFace[] = [];
  const pushLathe = (prof: { y: number; r: number; inner?: boolean }[], segs: number, phaseOffset: number, isPedestal: boolean) => {
    const rings: IVec3[][] = prof.map((pt) =>
      Array.from({ length: segs }, (_, i) => {
        const phi = phaseOffset + (i / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
        return xf({ x: pt.r * Math.cos(phi), y: pt.y, z: pt.r * Math.sin(phi) });
      })
    );
    for (let k = 0; k < prof.length - 1; k++) {
      const r0 = prof[k].r, r1 = prof[k + 1].r;
      const isInner = Boolean(prof[k].inner || prof[k + 1].inner);
      const baseHex = isPedestal ? params.tierDark : params.tierMain;
      const specWeight = isInner ? 0.14 : params.unlocked ? 0.62 : 0.22;
      const ambientMin = isInner ? 0.08 : 0.22;
      for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) {
        const ni = (i + 1) % segs;
        if (r0 === 0 && r1 > 0) rawFaces.push({ pts: [rings[k][i], rings[k + 1][ni], rings[k + 1][i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
        else if (r1 === 0 && r0 > 0) rawFaces.push({ pts: [rings[k][i], rings[k][ni], rings[k + 1][i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
        else if (r0 > 0 || r1 > 0) rawFaces.push({ pts: [rings[k][i], rings[k][ni], rings[k + 1][ni], rings[k + 1][i]], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin });
      }
    }
  };

  pushLathe(PEDESTAL_LATHE.map(([y, r]) => ({ y, r })), 8, Math.PI / 8, true);
  pushLathe(CHALICE_LATHE, 22, 0, false);

  const spine = [
    { x: 18.5, y: -17 }, { x: 30.5, y: -18 }, { x: 36.5, y: -10.5 }, { x: 32.5, y: -1.5 }, { x: 23.5, y: 3.5 }, { x: 13.5, y: 3 },
  ];
  [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
    const tubeRings: IVec3[][] = spine.map((pt, idx) => {
      const next = spine[Math.min(spine.length - 1, idx + 1)];
      const prev = spine[Math.max(0, idx - 1)];
      const tx = (next.x - prev.x) * side, ty = next.y - prev.y;
      const tLen = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;
      const nx = -ty / tLen, ny = tx / tLen;
      const rad = idx === 2 ? 2.6 : 2.1;
      return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, j) => {
        const ang = (j / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
        return xf({ x: pt.x * side + nx * Math.cos(ang) * rad, y: pt.y + ny * Math.cos(ang) * rad, z: Math.sin(ang) * rad });
      });
    });
    for (let k = 0; k < tubeRings.length - 1; k++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
        const nj = (j + 1) % 6;
        const pts = side > 0
          ? [tubeRings[k][j], tubeRings[k][nj], tubeRings[k + 1][nj], tubeRings[k + 1][j]]
          : [tubeRings[k][nj], tubeRings[k][j], tubeRings[k + 1][j], tubeRings[k + 1][nj]];
        rawFaces.push({ pts, baseHex: params.tierWing, specWeight: params.unlocked ? 0.58 : 0.2 });
      }
    }
  });

  const polys = shadeAndSortFaces(rawFaces, camF, cx, cy, params.tierBevel, params.tierDark, 1.08, 1.2);
  const f3 = xf({ x: 0, y: -9, z: 22.8 });
  const b3 = xf({ x: 0, y: -9, z: -22.8 });
  const fP = projectPerspectivePoint(f3, camF, cx, cy);
  const bP = projectPerspectivePoint(b3, camF, cx, cy);
  const pitchCos = Math.max(0.28, Math.abs(Math.sin(pitchRad)) + 0.32);
  return {
    polys,
    frontScreen: { x: fP.x, y: fP.y, z: f3.z },
    backScreen: { x: bP.x, y: bP.y, z: b3.z },
    pedestalRingRx: 33.5,
    pedestalRingRy: Number((10.5 * pitchCos).toFixed(1)),
  };
}

import { CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG, normalizeOrbitalYawDeg } from './kinetic3DRigidBodyPhysics';

  type IProjectedPolygon,
  type IRawPolyFace,
  type IVec3,
  addClosedBox,
  clamp01,

  rotY,
  shadeAndSortFaces,
} from './kinetic3DProjectionLeaf';

export type { IVec3, IProjectedPolygon, IRawPolyFace };
export { rotX, rotY, projectPerspectivePoint, shadeAndSortFaces };

export interface IProjectedSegment {
  x1: number;
  y1: number;
  x2: number;
  y2: number;
  zSort: number;
  width: number;
}

export interface IChestManifoldParams {
  yawDeg: number;
  pitchDeg: number;
  hingeAngleDeg: number;
  chargeStep: number;
  rarityStep: number;
  isOpened: boolean;
  trimMain: string;
  trimBevel: string;
  trimDark: string;
  coreGlow: string;
  keyLightBoost?: number;
  rimLightBoost?: number;
}

export interface IChestManifoldResult {
  polys: IProjectedPolygon[];
  cracks3D: IProjectedSegment[];
  coreCenterScreen: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  ejectedEmblemPos: { x: number; y: number; rotDeg: number; scale: number; visible: boolean };
  hingeAngleDeg: number;
  closedLateralTympanumFaces: number;
  mouthVisibility01?: number;
}

export {
  buildVolumetricChaliceManifold,
  type IChaliceManifoldParams,
  type IChaliceManifoldResult,
} from './kinetic3DChaliceMeshBuilder';

export type RevealBeatPhase = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

export interface I5BeatRevealState {
  beat: RevealBeatPhase;
  pedestalGlow01: number;
  rimBoost: number;
  keyLightBoost: number;
  targetHingeDeg: number;
  ejectProgress01: number;
  turntableHoldActive: boolean;
}

export function compute5BeatRevealStage(progress01: number, isOpened: boolean): I5BeatRevealState {
  const p = clamp01(progress01);
  if (!isOpened) {
    return {
      beat: 1,
      pedestalGlow01: clamp01(0.35 + p * 0.65),
      rimBoost: 1,
      keyLightBoost: 1,
      targetHingeDeg: 0,
      ejectProgress01: 0,
      turntableHoldActive: true,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.18) {
    return {
      beat: 1,
      pedestalGlow01: clamp01(p / 0.18),
      rimBoost: 0.9,
      keyLightBoost: 0.9,
      targetHingeDeg: 0,
      ejectProgress01: 0,
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.36) {
    const local = (p - 0.18) / 0.18;
    return {
      beat: 2,
      pedestalGlow01: 1,
      rimBoost: 1 + local * 0.75,
      keyLightBoost: 0.95,
      targetHingeDeg: local * 8,
      ejectProgress01: 0,
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.58) {
    const local = (p - 0.36) / 0.22;
    return {
      beat: 3,
      pedestalGlow01: 1,
      rimBoost: 1.55 - local * 0.2,
      keyLightBoost: 1.1 + local * 0.55,
      targetHingeDeg: 8 + local * 38,
      ejectProgress01: local * 0.15,
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  if (p < 0.82) {
    const local = (p - 0.58) / 0.24;
    return {
      beat: 4,
      pedestalGlow01: 1,
      rimBoost: 1.35,
      keyLightBoost: 1.45,
      targetHingeDeg: 46 + local * (CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG - 46),
      ejectProgress01: clamp01(0.15 + local * 0.85),
      turntableHoldActive: false,
    };
  }
  return {
    beat: 5,
    pedestalGlow01: 0.9,
    rimBoost: 1.15,
    keyLightBoost: 1.15,
    targetHingeDeg: CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG,
    ejectProgress01: 1,
    turntableHoldActive: true,
  };
}

export function buildArticulatedChestManifold(params: IChestManifoldParams): IChestManifoldResult {
  const safeYaw = normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(params.yawDeg);
  const safePitch = Math.max(-34, Math.min(12, Number.isFinite(params.pitchDeg) ? params.pitchDeg : -18));
  const yawRad = (safeYaw * Math.PI) / 180;
  const pitchRad = (safePitch * Math.PI) / 180;
  const safeHinge = Math.max(0, Math.min(CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG, Number.isFinite(params.hingeAngleDeg) ? params.hingeAngleDeg : 0));
  const lidRad = (safeHinge * Math.PI) / 180;
  const camF = 316;
  const cx = 128;
  const cy = 114;

  const worldXf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => rotX(rotY(v, yawRad), pitchRad);
  const lidHingeXf = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => {
    const shifted = { x: v.x, y: v.y + 8, z: v.z + 35 };

  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, 51, 14, 35, -35, 35, hullDark, 0.35);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, 51, -8, 15, 27, 35, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, 51, -8, 15, -35, -27, hullMid, 0.44, undefined, undefined, 'back_wall');
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -51, -43, -8, 15, -27, 27, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, 43, 51, -8, 15, -27, 27, hullMid, 0.44);
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -43, 43, 12.2, 14.5, -27, 27, cavityFloorHex, params.isOpened ? 0.85 : 0.2, undefined, params.isOpened ? 0.58 : 0.14);

  // Cinchos perimetrales extruidos + asas laterales + bisagras traseras 3D
  [-29, 29].forEach((bx) => {
    addClosedBox(rawFaces, bx - 6, bx + 6, -8.4, 36.2, 33.2, 37.6, params.trimMain, 0.78);
    addClosedBox(rawFaces, bx - 6, bx + 6, -8.4, 36.2, -37.6, -33.2, params.trimMain, 0.78);

  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -54.4, -50.6, -2, 24, -18, 18, params.trimDark, 0.52);

  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -13, 13, -8, 18, 35, 42, '#0A101E', 0.52, undefined, undefined, 'clasp');

  rawFaces.push({ pts: boltLower, baseHex: boltHex, specWeight: 1, emissive: true, tag: 'clasp' });

  // Reverso grabado 3D real (z=-35..-41.2): normal mirando a -z para visibilidad nitida a 180 grados
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -22, 22, -3, 21, -38.8, -35, '#09101C', 0.48, undefined, undefined, 'back_wall');
  addClosedBox(rawFaces, -15, 15, 1, 17, -40.4, -38.8, params.trimDark, 0.7, undefined, undefined, 'back_wall');
  rawFaces.push({
    pts: [{ x: 0, y: 2.5, z: -41.2 }, { x: -8, y: 9, z: -41.2 }, { x: 0, y: 15.5, z: -41.2 }, { x: 8, y: 9, z: -41.2 }],
    baseHex: params.trimMain, specWeight: 0.92, emissive: params.isOpened || params.chargeStep >= 2, tag: 'back_wall',
  });

  const archSteps = 14;

  let closedLateralTympanumFaces = 0;

      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: o0.y, z: o0.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: xL, y: o1.y, z: o1.z })], baseHex: params.trimDark, specWeight: 0.48, tag: 'tympanum' },
      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: 45.8, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: 45.8, y: in0.y, z: in0.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: 45.8, y: in1.y, z: in1.z })], baseHex: innerDark, specWeight: 0.22, ambientMin: 0.16, tag: 'tympanum' },
      { pts: [lidHingeXf({ x: -45.8, y: -8, z: 0 }), lidHingeXf({ x: -45.8, y: in1.y, z: in1.z }), lidHingeXf({ x: -45.8, y: in0.y, z: in0.z })], baseHex: innerDark, specWeight: 0.22, ambientMin: 0.16, tag: 'tympanum' }
    );

  [-29, 29].forEach((bx) => {

      { pts: [{ x: 0, y: 10, z: -12 }, { x: 0, y: 10, z: 12 }, { x: 0, y: topY, z: 16 }, { x: 0, y: topY, z: -16 }], baseHex: beamHex, specWeight: 0, emissive: true, doubleSided: true, strokeHex: 'none', tag: 'beam', fillOpacity: Number((0.34 * mouthVisibility01).toFixed(2)) },

    );

  const worldFaces = rawFaces.map((f) => ({ ...f, pts: f.pts.map(worldXf) }));
  const polys = shadeAndSortFaces(
    worldFaces,
    camF,
    cx,
    cy,
    params.trimBevel,
    '#04070F',
    params.keyLightBoost ?? 1,
    params.rimLightBoost ?? 1
  );

  // Grietas de sobrecarga proyectadas en 3D real solo cuando el frente apunta hacia camara
  const cracks3D: IProjectedSegment[] = [];
  if (!params.isOpened && params.chargeStep >= 1 && frontNormalCamZ > 0.12) {
    const segs3D: [IVec3, IVec3][] = [
      [{ x: -34, y: -4, z: 35.6 }, { x: -16, y: 4, z: 35.6 }],
      [{ x: -16, y: 4, z: 35.6 }, { x: -8, y: -1, z: 35.6 }],
      ...(params.chargeStep >= 2
        ? [
            [{ x: 14, y: 2, z: 35.6 }, { x: 32, y: 10, z: 35.6 }] as [IVec3, IVec3],

        : []),
      ...(params.chargeStep >= 3

        : []),
    ];
    for (const [a0, b0] of segs3D) {
      const a = worldXf(a0), b = worldXf(b0);
      if (a.z < -8 && b.z < -8) continue;
      const pA = projectPerspectivePoint(a, camF, cx, cy);
      const pB = projectPerspectivePoint(b, camF, cx, cy);
      cracks3D.push({ x1: pA.x, y1: pA.y, x2: pB.x, y2: pB.y, zSort: (a.z + b.z) * 0.5, width: params.rarityStep >= 3 ? 2.5 : 1.9 });
    }
  }

  const core3D = worldXf({ x: 0, y: 4, z: 0 });
  const coreScreen = projectPerspectivePoint(core3D, camF, cx, cy);
  const ejectOrigin = worldXf({ x: 0, y: 10 - openRatio * 54, z: 0 });
  const ejectP = projectPerspectivePoint(ejectOrigin, camF, cx, cy);

  return {
    polys,
    cracks3D,
    coreCenterScreen: { x: coreScreen.x, y: coreScreen.y, z: core3D.z },
    ejectedEmblemPos: {
      x: ejectP.x,
      y: ejectP.y,
      rotDeg: Number(((1 - openRatio) * -140 + (safeYaw % 40) * 0.2).toFixed(1)),
      scale: Number((0.45 + openRatio * 0.55).toFixed(3)),
      visible: Boolean(params.isOpened && openRatio > 0.25 && mouthVisibility01 > 0.18),
    },
    hingeAngleDeg: safeHinge,
    closedLateralTympanumFaces,
    mouthVisibility01,
  };
}

export interface IVec3 {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
}

export type PolyTag = 'tympanum' | 'hull' | 'emblem' | 'clasp' | 'beam' | 'lid_back' | 'back_wall';

export interface IProjectedPolygon {
  points: string;
  fill: string;
  stroke: string;
  zSort: number;
  tag?: PolyTag;
  fillOpacity?: number;
}

export interface IRawPolyFace {
  pts: IVec3[];
  baseHex: string;
  specWeight: number;
  emissive?: boolean;
  ambientMin?: number;
  strokeHex?: string;
  tag?: PolyTag;
  fillOpacity?: number;
  doubleSided?: boolean;
}

export const clamp01 = (v: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0));

const parseHex = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
  const clean = String(hex || '#00F0FF').replace('#', '');
  const full = clean.length === 3 ? clean.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('') : clean.padEnd(6, '0');
  return [
    parseInt(full.slice(0, 2), 16) || 0,
    parseInt(full.slice(2, 4), 16) || 0,
    parseInt(full.slice(4, 6), 16) || 0,
  ];
};

const mixHex = (a: string, b: string, tRaw: number): string => {
  const t = clamp01(tRaw);
  const [r1, g1, b1] = parseHex(a);
  const [r2, g2, b2] = parseHex(b);
  return `#${Math.round(r1 + (r2 - r1) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${Math.round(g1 + (g2 - g1) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${Math.round(b1 + (b2 - b1) * t).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export const rotX = (v: IVec3, rad: number): IVec3 => {
  const c = Math.cos(rad);
  const s = Math.sin(rad);
  return { x: v.x, y: v.y * c - v.z * s, z: v.y * s + v.z * c };
};

export const rotY = (v: IVec3, rad: number): IVec3 => {
  const c = Math.cos(rad);
  const s = Math.sin(rad);
  return { x: v.x * c + v.z * s, y: v.y, z: -v.x * s + v.z * c };
};

const sub3 = (a: IVec3, b: IVec3): IVec3 => ({ x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y, z: a.z - b.z });
const dot3 = (a: IVec3, b: IVec3): number => a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
const cross3 = (a: IVec3, b: IVec3): IVec3 => ({
  x: a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
  y: a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
  z: a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x,
});
const norm3 = (v: IVec3): IVec3 => {
  const l = Math.hypot(v.x, v.y, v.z);
  return l > 1e-6 ? { x: v.x / l, y: v.y / l, z: v.z / l } : { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 };
};

export function addClosedBox(
  faces: IRawPolyFace[],
  x0: number,
  x1: number,
  y0: number,
  y1: number,
  z0: number,
  z1: number,
  baseHex: string,
  specWeight: number,
  xf?: (v: IVec3) => IVec3,
  ambientMin?: number,
  tag?: PolyTag
): void {
  const fn = xf || ((v: IVec3) => v);
  const v000 = fn({ x: x0, y: y0, z: z0 }), v100 = fn({ x: x1, y: y0, z: z0 });
  const v110 = fn({ x: x1, y: y1, z: z0 }), v010 = fn({ x: x0, y: y1, z: z0 });
  const v001 = fn({ x: x0, y: y0, z: z1 }), v101 = fn({ x: x1, y: y0, z: z1 });
  const v111 = fn({ x: x1, y: y1, z: z1 }), v011 = fn({ x: x0, y: y1, z: z1 });
  faces.push({ pts: [v001, v101, v111, v011], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin, ...(tag ? { tag } : {}) });
  faces.push({ pts: [v100, v000, v010, v110], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin, ...(tag ? { tag } : {}) });
  faces.push({ pts: [v101, v100, v110, v111], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin, ...(tag ? { tag } : {}) });
  faces.push({ pts: [v000, v001, v011, v010], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin, ...(tag ? { tag } : {}) });
  faces.push({ pts: [v000, v100, v101, v001], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin, ...(tag ? { tag } : {}) });
  faces.push({ pts: [v011, v111, v110, v010], baseHex, specWeight, ambientMin, ...(tag ? { tag } : {}) });
}

export function projectPerspectivePoint(
  v: IVec3,
  camF: number,
  cx: number,
  cy: number
): { x: number; y: number; s: number } {
  const denom = Math.max(45, camF - v.z);
  const s = camF / denom;
  return { x: cx + v.x * s, y: cy + v.y * s, s };
}

export function shadeAndSortFaces(
  rawFaces: IRawPolyFace[],
  camF: number,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  bevelHex: string,
  darkFloorHex: string,
  keyBoost = 1,
  rimBoost = 1
): IProjectedPolygon[] {
  const keyDir = norm3({ x: -0.44, y: -0.72, z: 0.68 });
  const fillDir = norm3({ x: 0.65, y: 0.15, z: 0.55 });
  const halfVec = norm3({ x: keyDir.x, y: keyDir.y, z: keyDir.z + 1 });
  const out: IProjectedPolygon[] = [];

  for (const face of rawFaces) {
    if (!face.pts || face.pts.length < 3) continue;
    const rawCross = cross3(sub3(face.pts[1], face.pts[0]), sub3(face.pts[2], face.pts[0]));
    const crossLen = Math.hypot(rawCross.x, rawCross.y, rawCross.z);
    if (crossLen < 1e-4) continue;
    let normal = { x: rawCross.x / crossLen, y: rawCross.y / crossLen, z: rawCross.z / crossLen };

    const centroid = face.pts.reduce(
      (acc, pt) => ({ x: acc.x + pt.x, y: acc.y + pt.y, z: acc.z + pt.z }),
      { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }
    );
    const nPts = face.pts.length;
    centroid.x /= nPts;
    centroid.y /= nPts;
    centroid.z /= nPts;

    const toCamera = norm3({ x: -centroid.x, y: -centroid.y, z: camF - centroid.z });
    const facingDot = dot3(normal, toCamera);
    if (face.doubleSided) {
      if (Math.abs(facingDot) <= 0.03) continue;
      if (facingDot < 0) normal = { x: -normal.x, y: -normal.y, z: -normal.z };
    } else if (facingDot <= -0.02) {
      continue;
    }

    const ptsProj = face.pts.map((pt) => projectPerspectivePoint(pt, camF, cx, cy));
    if (ptsProj.some((p) => !Number.isFinite(p.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.y))) continue;
    const points = ptsProj.map((p) => `${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');

    const keyDiff = Math.max(0, dot3(normal, keyDir)) * keyBoost;
    const fillDiff = Math.max(0, dot3(normal, fillDir)) * 0.24;
    const spec = Math.pow(Math.max(0, dot3(normal, halfVec)), 22) * face.specWeight * keyBoost;
    const rim = Math.pow(1 - Math.max(0, dot3(normal, toCamera)), 2.4) * 0.34 * rimBoost;
    const lum = clamp01((face.ambientMin ?? 0.2) + keyDiff * 0.52 + fillDiff + spec * 0.45 + rim);

    let fill = face.baseHex;
    if (!face.emissive) {
      fill =
        lum < 0.5
          ? mixHex(darkFloorHex, face.baseHex, lum / 0.5)
          : mixHex(face.baseHex, bevelHex, (lum - 0.5) * 0.92);
    }
    const zSort = face.doubleSided || face.tag === 'beam' ? centroid.z : centroid.z + normal.z * 1.15;
    out.push({
      points,
      fill,
      stroke: face.strokeHex || fill,
      zSort,
      ...(face.tag ? { tag: face.tag } : {}),
      ...(face.fillOpacity !== undefined ? { fillOpacity: face.fillOpacity } : {}),
    });
  }

  out.sort((a, b) => a.zSort - b.zSort);
  return out;
}

export interface IOrbitalSample {
  dx: number;
  dy: number;
  t: number;
}

export interface IOrbitalTurntableState {
  yawDeg: number;
  pitchDeg: number;
  omegaYaw: number;
  omegaPitch: number;
}

export interface IOrbitalStepOptions {
  turntableHold?: boolean;
  turntableSpeedDegPerSec?: number;
  restPitchDeg?: number;
  minPitchDeg?: number;
  maxPitchDeg?: number;
  dampYawPerSec?: number;
  dampPitchPerSec?: number;
  pitchReturnStiffness?: number;
}

export interface IHingeSpringState {
  angleDeg: number;
  omegaDeg: number;
}

export interface IHopSquashInput {
  hopHeightPx: number;
  velY: number;
  squashY: number;
  squashVel: number;
}

export interface IHopSquashResult extends IHopSquashInput {
  scaleX: number;
  scaleY: number;
  scaleZ: number;
  shadowScale: number;
  shadowOpacity: number;
  didImpactFloor: boolean;
}

export interface IDeepZParallaxInput {
  tiltX: number;
  tiltY: number;
  maxOffsetPx?: number;
}

export interface IDeepZParallaxResult {
  bgShiftX: number;
  bgShiftY: number;
  midShiftX: number;
  midShiftY: number;
  fgShiftX: number;
  fgShiftY: number;
  specularShiftPct: number;
}

export const TURNTABLE_HOLD_DEG_PER_SEC = 14;
export const CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG = 108;

const finiteOr = (val: unknown, fallback: number): number => {
  const n = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
};

const clampNum = (val: number, min: number, max: number): number =>
  Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Number.isFinite(val) ? val : min));

export function normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(rawYawDeg: number): number {
  const clean = finiteOr(rawYawDeg, 0);
  const mod = ((clean % 360) + 360) % 360;
  return mod === 360 ? 0 : mod;
}

export function clampPhysicsDtMs(rawDtMs: number): number {
  const clean = finiteOr(rawDtMs, 16);
  return clampNum(clean, 4, 64);
}

export function computeSlidingWindowOrbitalVelocity(
  samples: ReadonlyArray<IOrbitalSample>,
  nowMs: number,
  windowMs = 70
): { omegaYaw: number; omegaPitch: number } {
  const safeNow = finiteOr(nowMs, 0);
  const safeWin = Math.max(16, Math.min(250, finiteOr(windowMs, 70)));
  const recent = (Array.isArray(samples) ? samples : []).filter(
    (s) => s && Number.isFinite(s.t) && Number.isFinite(s.dx) && Number.isFinite(s.dy) && s.t >= safeNow - safeWin && s.t <= safeNow + 8
  );
  if (recent.length < 2) return { omegaYaw: 0, omegaPitch: 0 };
  const first = recent[0];
  const last = recent[recent.length - 1];
  const dtSec = Math.max(0.012, (last.t - first.t) / 1000);
  const omegaYaw = clampNum(((last.dx - first.dx) * 0.92) / dtSec, -2400, 2400);
  const omegaPitch = clampNum(((last.dy - first.dy) * 0.28) / dtSec, -720, 720);
  return { omegaYaw, omegaPitch };
}

export function stepOrbitalTurntablePhysics(
  state: IOrbitalTurntableState,
  dtMs: number,
  opts?: IOrbitalStepOptions
): IOrbitalTurntableState {
  const dt = clampPhysicsDtMs(dtMs) / 1000;
  const minPitch = finiteOr(opts?.minPitchDeg, -34);
  const maxPitch = finiteOr(opts?.maxPitchDeg, 12);
  const restPitch = clampNum(finiteOr(opts?.restPitchDeg, -18), minPitch, maxPitch);
  const dampYaw = Math.max(0.1, finiteOr(opts?.dampYawPerSec, 3.1));
  const dampPitch = Math.max(0.2, finiteOr(opts?.dampPitchPerSec, 6.2));
  const returnK = Math.max(0, finiteOr(opts?.pitchReturnStiffness, 12));
  const turntableHold = opts?.turntableHold !== false;
  const targetHoldSpeed = finiteOr(opts?.turntableSpeedDegPerSec, TURNTABLE_HOLD_DEG_PER_SEC);

  let omegaYaw = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.omegaYaw, 0), -2600, 2600);
  let omegaPitch = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.omegaPitch, 0), -900, 900);
  let yawDeg = finiteOr(state?.yawDeg, 332);
  let pitchDeg = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.pitchDeg, restPitch), minPitch, maxPitch);

  omegaYaw *= Math.exp(-dampYaw * dt);
  if (turntableHold && Math.abs(omegaYaw) < 18) {
    const blend = Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
    const desiredSign = omegaYaw < -2 ? -1 : 1;
    const targetVel = desiredSign * Math.abs(targetHoldSpeed);
    omegaYaw = omegaYaw + (targetVel - omegaYaw) * blend;
  } else if (!turntableHold && Math.abs(omegaYaw) < 1.5) {
    omegaYaw = 0;
  }

  const pitchAccel = (restPitch - pitchDeg) * returnK;
  omegaPitch = (omegaPitch + pitchAccel * dt) * Math.exp(-dampPitch * dt);
  if (Math.abs(omegaPitch) < 0.25 && Math.abs(restPitch - pitchDeg) < 0.08) {
    omegaPitch = 0;
    pitchDeg = restPitch;
  } else {
    pitchDeg = clampNum(pitchDeg + omegaPitch * dt, minPitch, maxPitch);
    if (pitchDeg === minPitch || pitchDeg === maxPitch) omegaPitch *= -0.35;
  }

  yawDeg = normalizeOrbitalYawDeg(yawDeg + omegaYaw * dt);
  return { yawDeg, pitchDeg, omegaYaw, omegaPitch };
}

export function stepArticulatedHingeSpring(
  state: IHingeSpringState,
  targetDeg: number,
  dtMs: number
): IHingeSpringState {
  const dt = clampPhysicsDtMs(dtMs) / 1000;
  const safeTarget = clampNum(finiteOr(targetDeg, 0), 0, CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG);
  let angleDeg = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.angleDeg, 0), 0, CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG);
  let omegaDeg = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.omegaDeg, 0), -1800, 1800);

  const subSteps = 2;
  const subDt = dt / subSteps;
  const stiffness = 190;
  const damping = 14.5;

  for (let i = 0; i < subSteps; i++) {
    const force = (safeTarget - angleDeg) * stiffness - omegaDeg * damping;
    omegaDeg = clampNum(omegaDeg + force * subDt, -1800, 1800);
    angleDeg += omegaDeg * subDt;
    if (angleDeg < 0) {
      angleDeg = 0;
      if (omegaDeg < 0) omegaDeg = 0;
    } else if (angleDeg > CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG) {
      angleDeg = CHEST_OPEN_HINGE_TARGET_DEG;
      if (omegaDeg > 0) omegaDeg = 0;
    }
  }

  if (Math.abs(safeTarget - angleDeg) < 0.05 && Math.abs(omegaDeg) < 0.4) {
    angleDeg = safeTarget;
    omegaDeg = 0;
  }
  return { angleDeg, omegaDeg };
}

export function computeVolumePreservingScale(squashYInput: number): {
  scaleX: number;
  scaleY: number;
  scaleZ: number;
} {
  const scaleY = clampNum(finiteOr(squashYInput, 1), 0.82, 1.18);
  const invSqrt = 1 / Math.sqrt(scaleY);
  return { scaleX: invSqrt, scaleY, scaleZ: invSqrt };
}

export function stepBallisticHopAndSquash(
  state: IHopSquashInput,
  dtMs: number
): IHopSquashResult {
  const dt = clampPhysicsDtMs(dtMs) / 1000;
  const gravityPxPerSec2 = 980;
  let hopHeightPx = Math.max(0, clampNum(finiteOr(state?.hopHeightPx, 0), 0, 96));
  let velY = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.velY, 0), -900, 900);
  let squashY = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.squashY, 1), 0.82, 1.18);
  let squashVel = clampNum(finiteOr(state?.squashVel, 0), -20, 20);
  let didImpactFloor = false;

  if (hopHeightPx > 0 || velY > 0) {
    velY -= gravityPxPerSec2 * dt;
    hopHeightPx += velY * dt;
    if (hopHeightPx <= 0) {
      hopHeightPx = 0;
      didImpactFloor = Math.abs(velY) > 45;
      if (didImpactFloor) {
        squashVel -= clampNum(Math.abs(velY) * 0.012, 0.5, 4.2);
      }
      velY = 0;
    } else if (hopHeightPx > 96) {
      hopHeightPx = 96;
      if (velY > 0) velY = 0;
    }
  }

  const squashAccel = (1 - squashY) * 240 - squashVel * 15;
  squashVel = clampNum(squashVel + squashAccel * dt, -20, 20);
  squashY = clampNum(squashY + squashVel * dt, 0.82, 1.18);
  if (Math.abs(1 - squashY) < 0.002 && Math.abs(squashVel) < 0.02) {
    squashY = 1;
    squashVel = 0;
  }

  const { scaleX, scaleY, scaleZ } = computeVolumePreservingScale(squashY);
  const shadowScale = clampNum(1 / (1 + hopHeightPx * 0.016), 0.38, 1);
  const shadowOpacity = clampNum(0.62 / (1 + hopHeightPx * 0.028), 0.14, 0.62);

  return {
    hopHeightPx,
    velY,
    squashY,
    squashVel,
    scaleX,
    scaleY,
    scaleZ,
    shadowScale,
    shadowOpacity,
    didImpactFloor,
  };
}

export function computeDeepZParallaxLayers(input: IDeepZParallaxInput): IDeepZParallaxResult {
  const maxPx = clampNum(finiteOr(input?.maxOffsetPx, 7), 1, 16);
  const nx = clampNum(finiteOr(input?.tiltX, 0), -1, 1);
  const ny = clampNum(finiteOr(input?.tiltY, 0), -1, 1);
  const clampOff = (v: number) => clampNum(Number(clampNum(v, -maxPx, maxPx).toFixed(2)), -maxPx, maxPx) || 0;
  return {
    bgShiftX: clampOff(-nx * maxPx * 0.45),
    bgShiftY: clampOff(-ny * maxPx * 0.45),
    midShiftX: clampOff(nx * maxPx * 0.72),
    midShiftY: clampOff(ny * maxPx * 0.72),
    fgShiftX: clampOff(nx * maxPx),
    fgShiftY: clampOff(ny * maxPx),
    specularShiftPct: Number(clampNum(50 + nx * 38, 12, 88).toFixed(2)),
  };
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { PermissionsAndroid, Platform } from 'react-native';

export const ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_android_notif_prompted_v1';

let _promptInFlightOrDone = false;
let _activePromptPromise: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

/**
 * Solicita de forma contextual e idempotente el permiso POST_NOTIFICATIONS en Android 13+ (API 33+).
 * Comparte una promesa singleton para evitar cuadros simultáneos al dispararse desde layout y modal.
 */
export const requestContextualAndroidNotificationsOnce = (): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return Promise.resolve(false);
  const apiLevel = Number(Platform.Version);
  if (!Number.isFinite(apiLevel) || apiLevel < 33) return Promise.resolve(false);
  if (_activePromptPromise) return _activePromptPromise;

  const perm =
    ((PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS as Record<string, string | undefined>)?.POST_NOTIFICATIONS as
      | (typeof PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS)[keyof typeof PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS]
      | undefined) ||
    ('android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS' as (typeof PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS)[keyof typeof PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS]);

  const task = (async () => {
    try {
      const alreadyGranted = await PermissionsAndroid.check(perm);
      if (alreadyGranted) {
        _promptInFlightOrDone = true;
        AsyncStorage.setItem(ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY, '1').catch(() => {});
        return true;
      }
      if (_promptInFlightOrDone) return false;
      const promptedFlag = await AsyncStorage.getItem(ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (promptedFlag === '1') {
        _promptInFlightOrDone = true;
        return false;
      }
      _promptInFlightOrDone = true;
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(ANDROID_NOTIF_PROMPTED_STORAGE_KEY, '1').catch(() => {});
      const status = await PermissionsAndroid.request(perm);
      return status === PermissionsAndroid.RESULTS.GRANTED;
    } catch {
      return false;
    } finally {
      _activePromptPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  _activePromptPromise = task;
  return task;
};
