import { sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName } from '../utils/kineticDisplayNamePureLeaf';

export const KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
export const KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS = new Set<string>([
  'administrador@kinetic.com.mx', 'administrador@kinetic.com', 'kinetic@kinetic.com', 'admin@kinetic.com',
]);

type AthleteRecord = Record<string, unknown>;
const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const GENERIC_NAMES = new Set<string>([
  '', 'atleta', 'athlete', 'atletakinetic', 'kineticathlete', 'miembrokinetic', 'kineticmember',
  'usuario', 'user', 'anon', 'me', 'kineticoficial', 'kineticofficial', 'terminalglobalkinetic',
]);
const RESERVED_ADMIN_SLUGS = new Set<string>(['kinetic', 'kineticoficial', 'kineticofficial', 'terminalglobalkinetic']);
const RESERVED_ROLES = new Set<string>(['admin', 'fundador', 'ceo']);

const normText = (v?: unknown): string =>
  String(v ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');

const normIdentitySlug = (v?: unknown): string => normText(v).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');

export function isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(row: AthleteRecord | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return true;
  if (row.desactivado === true || normText(row.estado_cuenta) === 'desactivado') return true;
  const nameLow = normText(row.nombre);
  if (nameLow === 'usuario desactivado' || nameLow === 'deactivated user' || nameLow.includes('usuario desactivado')) return true;
  const emailLow = String(row.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return emailLow.startsWith('anonimo_') || emailLow.startsWith('anonymous_') || emailLow.startsWith('deleted_');
}

export function isMasterAdminProfileRecord(row: AthleteRecord | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return false;
  const idLow = String(row.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailLow = String(row.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (idLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID) return true;
  return !idLow && KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLow);
}

const hasRichAvatar = (r: AthleteRecord): boolean => {
  const av = String(r?.avatar_url ?? r?.avatar ?? '').trim();
  return /^https?:\/\//i.test(av) || av.startsWith('data:image/');
};

const getXpValue = (r: AthleteRecord): number => {
  const n = Number(r?.xpTotal ?? r?.xp_total ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, n) : 0;
};

const getStreakValue = (r: AthleteRecord): number => {
  const n = Number(r?.racha ?? r?.racha_dias ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, n) : 0;
};

function compareAthleteRichness(a: AthleteRecord, b: AthleteRecord, cleanCurrentUid: string): number {
  const aMaster = String(a?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID;
  const bMaster = String(b?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID;
  if (aMaster !== bMaster) return aMaster ? -1 : 1;
  const aMasterEmail = KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(String(a?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
  const bMasterEmail = KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(String(b?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
  if (aMasterEmail !== bMasterEmail) return aMasterEmail ? -1 : 1;
  const aMe = Boolean(cleanCurrentUid && String(a?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanCurrentUid);
  const bMe = Boolean(cleanCurrentUid && String(b?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanCurrentUid);
  if (aMe !== bMe) return aMe ? -1 : 1;
  const aUuid = UUID_RE.test(String(a?.id ?? '').trim());
  const bUuid = UUID_RE.test(String(b?.id ?? '').trim());
  if (aUuid !== bUuid) return aUuid ? -1 : 1;
  const xpDiff = getXpValue(b) - getXpValue(a);
  if (xpDiff !== 0) return xpDiff;
  const aAv = hasRichAvatar(a);
  const bAv = hasRichAvatar(b);
  if (aAv !== bAv) return aAv ? -1 : 1;
  const stDiff = getStreakValue(b) - getStreakValue(a);
  if (stDiff !== 0) return stDiff;
  const aEm = Boolean(String(a?.email ?? '').trim());
  const bEm = Boolean(String(b?.email ?? '').trim());
  if (aEm !== bEm) return aEm ? -1 : 1;
  return String(a?.id ?? '').localeCompare(String(b?.id ?? ''));
}

function deduplicateSinglePass<T extends AthleteRecord>(valid: T[], cleanCurrentUid: string): T[] {
  const n = valid.length;
  if (n === 0) return [];
  const parent = new Int32Array(n);
  const compUuid: string[] = new Array(n);
  const compEmail: string[] = new Array(n);
  const compAdmin: boolean[] = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    parent[i] = i;
    const r = valid[i];
    const idLow = String(r.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    compUuid[i] = UUID_RE.test(idLow) ? idLow : '';
    compEmail[i] = String(r.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    compAdmin[i] = isMasterAdminProfileRecord(r);
  }
  const find = (x: number): number => {
    let cur = x;
    while (parent[cur] !== cur) { parent[cur] = parent[parent[cur]]; cur = parent[cur]; }
    return cur;
  };
  const unite = (a: number, b: number, allowDistinctIdentity: boolean): void => {
    const ra = find(a);
    const rb = find(b);
    if (ra === rb) return;
    if ((compAdmin[ra] || compAdmin[rb]) && (compAdmin[ra] !== compAdmin[rb] || (compUuid[ra] && compUuid[rb] && compUuid[ra] !== compUuid[rb]))) return;
    if (!allowDistinctIdentity && ((compUuid[ra] && compUuid[rb] && compUuid[ra] !== compUuid[rb]) || (compEmail[ra] && compEmail[rb] && compEmail[ra] !== compEmail[rb]))) return;
    parent[rb] = ra;
    if (!compUuid[ra] && compUuid[rb]) compUuid[ra] = compUuid[rb];
    if (!compEmail[ra] && compEmail[rb]) compEmail[ra] = compEmail[rb];
    if (compAdmin[rb]) compAdmin[ra] = true;
  };

  const hardBuckets = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const bindHard = (key: string, idx: number): void => {
    if (!key) return;
    const list = hardBuckets.get(key);
    if (!list) hardBuckets.set(key, [idx]);
    else { for (const prev of list) unite(prev, idx, true); list.push(idx); }
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const r = valid[i];
    const idLow = String(r.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailLow = String(r.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (idLow) bindHard(`id:${idLow}`, i);
    if (emailLow) bindHard(`em:${emailLow}`, i);
    if (compAdmin[i]) bindHard('admin:kinetic_oficial', i);
  }

  const softBuckets = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const bindSoft = (key: string, idx: number): void => {
    if (!key) return;
    const list = softBuckets.get(key);
    if (!list) softBuckets.set(key, [idx]);
    else { for (const prev of list) unite(prev, idx, false); list.push(idx); }
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (compAdmin[i]) continue;
    const r = valid[i];
    const emailLow = String(r.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const nameSlug = normIdentitySlug(r.nombre);
    if (GENERIC_NAMES.has(nameSlug) || nameSlug.length < 4) continue;
    const avatarUrl = hasRichAvatar(r) ? String(r.avatar_url ?? r.avatar ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
    if (avatarUrl) bindSoft(`av_nm:${avatarUrl}|${nameSlug.slice(0, 10)}`, i);
    const tokens = normText(r.nombre).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (tokens.length >= 2) bindSoft(`fullname:${tokens.join('_')}`, i);
    const emailLocal = emailLow.includes('@') ? normIdentitySlug(emailLow.split('@')[0]) : '';
    if (emailLocal && emailLocal.length >= 4 && emailLocal === nameSlug) bindSoft(`handle:${emailLocal}`, i);
  }

  const groups = new Map<number, T[]>();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const root = find(i);
    const bucket = groups.get(root);
    if (bucket) bucket.push(valid[i]);
    else groups.set(root, [valid[i]]);
  }

  const consolidated: T[] = [];
  groups.forEach((bucket) => {
    if (bucket.length === 1) { consolidated.push(bucket[0]); return; }
    const sorted = [...bucket].sort((a, b) => compareAthleteRichness(a, b, cleanCurrentUid));
    const winner: AthleteRecord = { ...sorted[0] };
    for (let k = 1; k < sorted.length; k++) {
      const alt = sorted[k];
      if (GENERIC_NAMES.has(normIdentitySlug(winner.nombre)) && !GENERIC_NAMES.has(normIdentitySlug(alt.nombre))) winner.nombre = alt.nombre;
      if (!hasRichAvatar(winner) && hasRichAvatar(alt)) {
        if (alt.avatar_url) winner.avatar_url = alt.avatar_url;
        else if (alt.avatar) winner.avatar = alt.avatar;
      }
      if (!String(winner.email ?? '').trim() && String(alt.email ?? '').trim()) winner.email = alt.email;
      const maxStreak = Math.max(getStreakValue(winner), getStreakValue(alt));
      if ('racha_dias' in winner && maxStreak > (Number(winner.racha_dias) || 0)) winner.racha_dias = maxStreak;
      if ('racha' in winner && maxStreak > (Number(winner.racha) || 0)) winner.racha = maxStreak;
      const maxXp = Math.max(getXpValue(winner), getXpValue(alt));
      if ('xp_total' in winner && maxXp > (Number(winner.xp_total) || 0)) winner.xp_total = maxXp;
      if ('xpTotal' in winner && maxXp > (Number(winner.xpTotal) || 0)) winner.xpTotal = maxXp;
    }
    if (isMasterAdminProfileRecord(winner)) winner.nombre = 'Kinetic Oficial';
    consolidated.push(winner as T);
  });
  return consolidated;
}

function resolveOrSynthesizeAthleteId(
  cleanId: string,
  isAdmin: boolean,
  cleanEmail: string,
  normName: string,
  seenRawIds: Set<string>,
  rawEmailById: Map<string, string>,
  synthEmailIds: Map<string, string>,
  counters: { anonSeq: number; emailSeq: number }
): string {
  if (cleanId) return cleanId;
  if (isAdmin) return KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID;
  if (cleanEmail) {
    const emailTag = `em:${cleanEmail}`;
    let chosen = synthEmailIds.get(cleanEmail);
    if (chosen) return chosen;
    const base = `ath_em_${cleanEmail}`;
    if (!seenRawIds.has(base) || rawEmailById.get(base) === emailTag) {
      chosen = base;
    } else {
      chosen = `ath_em_${counters.emailSeq}_${cleanEmail}`;
      while (seenRawIds.has(chosen) && rawEmailById.get(chosen) !== emailTag) {
        counters.emailSeq += 1;
        chosen = `ath_em_${counters.emailSeq}_${cleanEmail}`;
      }
      counters.emailSeq += 1;
    }
    seenRawIds.add(chosen);
    rawEmailById.set(chosen, emailTag);
    synthEmailIds.set(cleanEmail, chosen);
    return chosen;
  }
  let candidate = `ath_anon_${counters.anonSeq}_${normName || 'u'}`;
  while (seenRawIds.has(candidate)) {
    counters.anonSeq += 1;
    candidate = `ath_anon_${counters.anonSeq}_${normName || 'u'}`;
  }
  counters.anonSeq += 1;
  seenRawIds.add(candidate);
  return candidate;
}

export function deduplicateCanonicalAthletes<T extends AthleteRecord>(rows: T[], currentUserId?: string | null): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return [];
  const cleanCurrentUid = String(currentUserId ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const seenRawIds = new Set<string>();
  const rawEmailById = new Map<string, string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const cid = String(rows[i]?.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cid) continue;
    seenRawIds.add(cid);
    const cem = String(rows[i]?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const neutralizedCem = cid !== KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID && KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(cem) ? '' : cem;
    const effectiveCem = neutralizedCem ? `em:${neutralizedCem}` : '__empty__';
    if (!rawEmailById.has(cid)) rawEmailById.set(cid, effectiveCem);
    else if (rawEmailById.get(cid) !== effectiveCem) rawEmailById.set(cid, '__conflict__');
  }

  const counters = { anonSeq: 0, emailSeq: 0 };
  const synthEmailIds = new Map<string, string>();
  const valid: T[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const raw = rows[i];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(raw)) continue;
    const isAdmin = isMasterAdminProfileRecord(raw);
    const cleanId = String(raw.id ?? '').trim();
    const cleanIdLow = cleanId.toLowerCase();
    const rawEmail = String(raw.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const isForeignMasterEmail = Boolean(cleanId) && cleanIdLow !== KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID && KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(rawEmail);
    const isNonMasterEmailOnMaster = cleanIdLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID && Boolean(rawEmail) && !KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(rawEmail);
    const cleanEmail = isForeignMasterEmail || isNonMasterEmailOnMaster ? '' : rawEmail;
    const normName = normIdentitySlug(sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName(raw.nombre, { fallback: '' }));
    if (!cleanId && !cleanEmail && !normName && !isAdmin) continue;

    const normalized: AthleteRecord = { ...raw };
    if (isForeignMasterEmail || isNonMasterEmailOnMaster) normalized.email = '';
    if (isAdmin) {
      normalized.nombre = 'Kinetic Oficial';
    } else {
      const sanitized = sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName(raw.nombre, { fallback: 'Atleta Kinetic' });
      normalized.nombre = RESERVED_ADMIN_SLUGS.has(normName) ? 'Atleta Kinetic' : sanitized;
      if (RESERVED_ROLES.has(normText(raw.rol)) && 'rol' in normalized) normalized.rol = 'atleta';
      if (RESERVED_ROLES.has(normText(raw.tipo_cuenta)) && 'tipo_cuenta' in normalized) normalized.tipo_cuenta = 'atleta';
    }
    normalized.id = resolveOrSynthesizeAthleteId(cleanId, isAdmin, cleanEmail, normName, seenRawIds, rawEmailById, synthEmailIds, counters);
    valid.push(normalized as T);
  }

  let cur = deduplicateSinglePass(valid, cleanCurrentUid);
  let curJson = JSON.stringify(cur);
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
    const next = deduplicateSinglePass(cur, cleanCurrentUid);
    const nextJson = JSON.stringify(next);
    if (next.length === cur.length && nextJson === curJson) break;
    cur = next; curJson = nextJson;
  }
  return cur;
}

export function isExcludedSelfOrBlockedAthlete(
  athlete: AthleteRecord | null | undefined, myUserId?: string | null, myEmail?: string | null, myName?: string | null, blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string>
): boolean {
  if (!athlete || isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(athlete)) return true;
  const aId = String(athlete.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanMyId = String(myUserId ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (cleanMyId && aId && aId === cleanMyId) return true;
  if (aId && blockedIdsSet?.has(aId)) return true;
  const aEmail = String(athlete.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanMyEmail = String(myEmail ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (cleanMyEmail && aEmail && aEmail === cleanMyEmail) return true;
  const aNameSlug = normIdentitySlug(athlete.nombre);
  const myNameSlug = normIdentitySlug(myName);
  return Boolean(myNameSlug && !GENERIC_NAMES.has(myNameSlug) && aNameSlug === myNameSlug);
}

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import type { Session, User } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { router as globalRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { isBiometricPreferenceEnabledAsync, purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync } from './kineticBiometricVaultService';
import { clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge, setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge } from './kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import {
  doesSessionRequireMfaAal2,
  getMfaSecuritySnapshot,
  isPendingMfaGateActive,
  setPendingMfaGateActive,
  type IMfaSessionLike,
} from './kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit,
  isExplicitKineticSignOut,
  isKineticMasterAdminEmail,
  isRealSupabaseJwt,
  persistKineticSessionSnapshot,
  purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly,
  synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from './kineticSessionPersistence';
import { reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession } from './kineticSessionReconciler';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from './kineticVaultCrypto';
import { shouldPreserveSessionOnTransientMfaCheckFailure } from '../utils/kineticWebSilentRevalidateLeaf';

export interface KineticAuthUser {
  id: string;
  email?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  role?: string | null;
  email_confirmed_at?: string | null;
  confirmed_at?: string | null;
  phone_confirmed_at?: string | null;
  app_metadata?: { rol?: string; provider?: string; providers?: string[]; [k: string]: unknown };
  user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  factors?: Array<{ id?: string; status?: string | null; factor_type?: string | null; friendly_name?: string | null }> | null;
  [k: string]: unknown;
}

export interface KineticAuthSession {
  access_token?: string | null;

  token_type?: string | null;
  expires_at?: number | null;

}

export interface KineticAuthProfile {

export const toKineticAuthUser = (
  u:
    | User
    | KineticAuthUser
    | { id: string; email?: string | null; phone?: string | null; created_at?: string; user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }
    | null
    | undefined
): KineticAuthUser | null => (u?.id ? (u as unknown as KineticAuthUser) : null);

export const toKineticAuthSession = (
  s: Session | KineticAuthSession | { access_token?: string | null; refresh_token?: string | null; user?: unknown } | null | undefined
): KineticAuthSession | null => (s ? (s as unknown as KineticAuthSession) : null);

export const withAuthTimeout = <T,>(promise: PromiseLike<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> =>
  new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('KINETIC_BG_AUTH_TIMEOUT')), ms);
    Promise.resolve(promise).then((v) => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(v); }, (e) => { clearTimeout(t); reject(e); });
  });

export async function syncOrCreateAuthProfileRow(params: {
  currentUser: KineticAuthUser;
  ownerProf: KineticAuthProfile | null;
  fallbackPersistedProf: KineticAuthProfile | null;
  raceMs: number;
  isStale: () => boolean;
}): Promise<{ profile: KineticAuthProfile; shouldPersistOnlyIfMissing?: boolean } | null> {
  const { currentUser, ownerProf, fallbackPersistedProf, raceMs, isStale } = params;
  const { data, error } = await withAuthTimeout(
    supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle(),
    raceMs
  );
  if (isStale()) return null;

  const meta = currentUser.user_metadata || {};
  const isGoogleProvider =
    currentUser.app_metadata?.provider === 'google' ||
    (Array.isArray(currentUser.app_metadata?.providers) && currentUser.app_metadata.providers.includes('google'));
  const googleRealName = String(meta.nombre || meta.full_name || meta.name || '').trim();
  const googleAvatar = typeof meta.avatar_url === 'string' ? meta.avatar_url : typeof meta.picture === 'string' ? meta.picture : null;
  const dbRow = (data as KineticAuthProfile | null) || null;
  const hasGhostName = !dbRow?.nombre || /^atleta\s*\d*$/i.test(String(dbRow.nombre).trim());

  if (!error && dbRow && !(isGoogleProvider && hasGhostName && googleRealName)) {
    const isMasterAdmin = Boolean(currentUser.email_confirmed_at) && isKineticMasterAdminEmail(currentUser.email);
    let finalProfile: KineticAuthProfile =
      isMasterAdmin && dbRow.rol !== 'admin' ? { ...dbRow, rol: 'admin', nivel: dbRow.nivel || 'Black' } : dbRow;
    if (!dbRow.avatar_url && googleAvatar) {
      supabase.from('perfiles').update({ avatar_url: googleAvatar }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(() => {}, () => {});
      finalProfile = { ...finalProfile, avatar_url: googleAvatar };
    }
    return { profile: finalProfile };
  }

  if (isGoogleProvider && currentUser.email) {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const finalName = googleRealName || currentUser.email.split('@')[0] || 'Kinetic Athlete';
    if (dbRow) {
      const nextAvatar = dbRow.avatar_url || googleAvatar;
      await supabase.from('perfiles').update({ nombre: finalName, avatar_url: nextAvatar }).eq('id', currentUser.id);
      if (isStale()) return null;
      return { profile: { ...dbRow, nombre: finalName, avatar_url: nextAvatar } };
    }
    const googlePayload: KineticAuthProfile = {
      id: currentUser.id,
      nombre: finalName,
      email: currentUser.email.toLowerCase(),
      avatar_url: googleAvatar,
      rol: 'atleta',
      nivel: 'Acceso Base',
      kc_membresia: 0,
      kc_topup: 0,
      fecha_activacion_membresia: nowIso,
      perdones_mensuales_usados: 0,
      mes_perdones_control: nowIso.slice(0, 7),
      waiver_firmado: false,
      waiver_fecha: null,
    };
    const { data: upserted } = await supabase
      .from('perfiles')
      .upsert(googlePayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
      .select('*')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (isStale()) return null;
    return { profile: (upserted as KineticAuthProfile | null) || googlePayload };
  }

  if (error) {
    const fallbackProf = ownerProf || fallbackPersistedProf || synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, null);
    return { profile: fallbackProf, shouldPersistOnlyIfMissing: true };
  }

  const baseProfilePayload = ownerProf
    ? synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, ownerProf)
    : { ...synthesizeProfileFromUser(currentUser, null), kc_membresia: 0, kc_topup: 0 };

  if (!dbRow) {
    const { data: createdRow, error: createErr } = await withAuthTimeout(
      supabase.from('perfiles').upsert(baseProfilePayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true }).select('*').maybeSingle(),
      raceMs
    );
    if (isStale()) return null;
    if (!createErr && createdRow) {
      return { profile: createdRow as KineticAuthProfile };
    }
    const { data: minimalRow } = await withAuthTimeout(
      supabase
        .from('perfiles')
        .upsert(
          {
            id: currentUser.id,
            email: baseProfilePayload.email || null,
            nombre: baseProfilePayload.nombre,
            avatar_url: baseProfilePayload.avatar_url,
            telefono: baseProfilePayload.telefono,
            rol: baseProfilePayload.rol || 'atleta',
            nivel: baseProfilePayload.nivel || 'Acceso Base',
            kc_membresia: 0,
            kc_topup: 0,
            waiver_firmado: Boolean(baseProfilePayload.waiver_firmado),
          },
          { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true }
        )
        .select('*')
        .maybeSingle(),
      raceMs
    );
    if (isStale()) return null;
    return { profile: (minimalRow as KineticAuthProfile | null) || ownerProf || baseProfilePayload };
  }

  return ownerProf ? null : { profile: baseProfilePayload, shouldPersistOnlyIfMissing: true };
}

export async function verifyAndHydrateAuthSession(params: {
  raceMs: number;
  isAborted: () => boolean;
  commitSession: (s: KineticAuthSession | null) => void;
  commitUser: (u: KineticAuthUser | null) => void;
  commitProfile: (p: KineticAuthProfile | null) => void;
  fetchUserProfile: (u: KineticAuthUser) => Promise<void>;
}): Promise<void> {
  const { raceMs, isAborted, commitSession, commitUser, commitProfile, fetchUserProfile } = params;
  const res = await reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession(supabase, raceMs);
  if (isAborted()) return;
  const rUser = res.user as KineticAuthUser | null;
  const rSess = res.session as KineticAuthSession | null;
  if (res.status === 'valid' && rUser?.id) {
    const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot();
    if (isAborted()) return;
    const needsMfa = doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(rSess) || mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge;
    if (mfaSnap.checkFailed && !isKineticDevRuntime()) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      commitSession(null);
      commitUser(null);
      commitProfile(null);
      return;
    }
    if (needsMfa) {

      } else {
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
        await clearPersistedKineticSessionExplicit().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });

    }
    commitSession(rSess);
    commitUser(rUser);

export function bindWebAuthFocusGuards(params: {
  raceMs: number;
  getUserId: () => string | undefined;
  getAccessToken: () => string | null | undefined;
  getProfile: () => KineticAuthProfile | null;
  isStale: () => boolean;
  updateSessionRef: (s: KineticAuthSession | null) => void;
  commitSession: (s: KineticAuthSession | null) => void;
  commitUser: (u: KineticAuthUser | null) => void;
  commitProfile: (p: KineticAuthProfile | null) => void;
  verifyAndHydrate: () => Promise<void>;
}): () => void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
  let lastFocusVerifyTs = 0;
  const handleFocus = () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastFocusVerifyTs < 2500) return;
    lastFocusVerifyTs = now;
    if (isExplicitKineticSignOut() || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return;
    const uid = params.getUserId();
    if (uid && isRealSupabaseJwt(params.getAccessToken())) {
      void reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession(supabase, params.raceMs)
        .then(async (res) => {
          if (params.isStale()) return;
          const rUser = res.user as KineticAuthUser | null;
          const rSess = res.session as KineticAuthSession | null;
          if (isPendingMfaGateActive() || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return;
          if (res.status === 'valid' && rSess && rUser?.id && String(rUser.id) !== String(uid)) {
            void params.verifyAndHydrate();
            return;
          }
          if (res.status === 'valid' && rSess && String(rUser?.id || '') === String(uid)) {
            if (doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(rSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike)) {
              params.commitSession(null);
              params.commitUser(null);
              params.commitProfile(null);
              await purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
              return;
            }
            const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; return null; });
            if (params.isStale() || isPendingMfaGateActive() || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return;
            if (!mfaSnap) return;
            if (mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge) {
              params.commitSession(null);
              params.commitUser(null);
              params.commitProfile(null);
              await purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly().catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
              return;
            }
            const curProf = params.getProfile();
            const safeProf = curProf && uid && String(curProf.id || '') === uid ? curProf : null;
            if (
              mfaSnap.checkFailed &&
              shouldPreserveSessionOnTransientMfaCheckFailure({
                hasActiveValidUserSession: Boolean(uid && isRealSupabaseJwt(rSess.access_token)),
                sessionRequiresAal2: doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(rSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike),
                mfaCheckFailed: mfaSnap.checkFailed,
                mfaRequiresChallenge: mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge,
              })
            ) {
              params.updateSessionRef(rSess);
              params.commitSession(rSess);
              if (rUser) persistKineticSessionSnapshot(rUser, safeProf, rSess);
              return;
            }
            params.updateSessionRef(rSess);
            params.commitSession(rSess);
            if (rUser) persistKineticSessionSnapshot(rUser, safeProf, rSess);
          } else if (res.status === 'cleared') {
            params.commitSession(null);
            params.commitUser(null);
            params.commitProfile(null);
          }
        })
        .catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      return;
    }
    void params.verifyAndHydrate();
  };
  const handleVisibility = () => {
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'visible') handleFocus();
  };
  window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
  };
}

export const normalizeKineticPhone = (phoneRaw: string, defaultDialCode = '+52') => {
  const trimmed = String(phoneRaw || '').trim();
  const hasPlus = trimmed.startsWith('+');
  const allDigits = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (allDigits.length < 10 || allDigits.length > 15) {
    return { isValid: false, e164: '', digits10: allDigits.slice(-10), variants: [] as string[] };
  }
  const digits10 = allDigits.slice(-10);
  const dialDigits = defaultDialCode.replace(/\D/g, '') || '52';
  const e164 = hasPlus
    ? `+${allDigits}`
    : allDigits.length === 10
    ? `+${dialDigits}${digits10}`
    : `+${allDigits}`;
  const variants = Array.from(new Set([e164, digits10, e164.replace('+', ''), `52${digits10}`]));
  return { isValid: digits10.length === 10, e164, digits10, variants };
};

export const mapSupabaseAuthError = (rawMessage?: string, isEnInput?: boolean): string => {
  let cleanRaw = String(rawMessage || '').trim();
  if (cleanRaw.startsWith('{') && cleanRaw.endsWith('}')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanRaw) as Record<string, unknown>;
      cleanRaw = String(parsed.msg || parsed.error_description || parsed.message || parsed.error_code || cleanRaw);
    } catch {}
  }
  const msg = cleanRaw.toLowerCase();
  const isEn = typeof isEnInput === 'boolean' ? isEnInput : getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en';

  if (
    msg.includes('unsupported provider') ||
    msg.includes('provider is not enabled') ||
    msg.includes('oauth') && msg.includes('disabled')
  ) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Google Sign-In is currently being enabled on the server. Please use your email and password in the meantime.'
      : 'El acceso directo con Google está en activación en el servidor. Usa tu correo y contraseña mientras concluye.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('kinetic_auth_timeout') || msg.includes('kinetic_bg_auth_timeout') || msg.includes('timed out') || msg.includes('timeout')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Server verification took too long. Please check your connection and try again.'
      : 'La verificación con el servidor tardó demasiado. Verifica tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('invalid login credentials') || msg.includes('user not found') || msg.includes('invalid_credentials')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Incorrect email or password. Please verify your login credentials.'
      : 'Correo o contraseña incorrectos. Verifica tus credenciales de acceso.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('user already registered') || msg.includes('already exists') || msg.includes('already been registered')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'This email address already has a registered Kinetic account.'
      : 'Este correo electrónico ya tiene una cuenta registrada en Kinetic.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('email_confirmation_required') || msg.includes('email not confirmed')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Confirm your email via the link sent to your inbox before entering Kinetic.'
      : 'Confirma tu correo electrónico mediante el enlace enviado a tu bandeja antes de ingresar a Kinetic.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('password should be at least')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Password must contain at least 6 characters.'
      : 'La contraseña debe contener al menos 6 caracteres.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('invalid format') || msg.includes('unable to validate email')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Invalid email address format.'
      : 'El formato del correo electrónico no es válido.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('over_email_send_rate_limit') || msg.includes('rate limit') || msg.includes('too many requests') || msg.includes('for security purposes') || msg.includes('429')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Too many consecutive attempts. Please wait a minute and try signing in again.'
      : 'Demasiados intentos seguidos. Espera un momento e intenta iniciar sesión de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('oidc_challenge_expired') || msg.includes('oidc_callback_invalid') || msg.includes('oidc_token_invalid') || msg.includes('oidc_session_empty')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Google verification expired or failed validation. Please try signing in again.'
      : 'La verificación con Google expiró o no pudo validarse. Inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('google_gis_') || msg.includes('secure_crypto_unavailable')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Could not start Google Sign-In in this browser. Check your connection or allow popups.'
      : 'No se pudo iniciar Google Sign-In en este navegador. Verifica tu conexión o habilita ventanas emergentes.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('mfa_verification_unavailable') || msg.includes('mfa_factor_resolution_failed')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Two-factor (2FA) verification could not be confirmed. Try again.'
      : 'No fue posible verificar la autenticación de dos pasos (2FA). Inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (msg.includes('network request failed') || msg.includes('failed to fetch') || msg.includes('load failed')) {
    return isEn
      ? 'Unstable internet connection. Check your signal and try again.'
      : 'Sin conexión estable a internet. Verifica tu señal e inténtalo de nuevo.';
  }
  if (cleanRaw.startsWith('{')) {
    return isEn ? 'Could not complete authentication request.' : 'No se pudo completar la solicitud de autenticación.';
  }
  return cleanRaw || (isEn ? 'Could not connect to the authentication vault.' : 'No se pudo establecer conexión con la bóveda de autenticación.');
};

const OAUTH_JWT_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+$/;

const hasOAuthUrlError = (callbackUrl: string): boolean => {
  const q = callbackUrl.includes('?') ? callbackUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const h = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : '';
  for (const part of [q, h]) {
    if (!part) continue;
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams(part);
      if (p.get('error') || p.get('error_description')) return true;
    } catch {}
  }
  return false;
};

export const extractOAuthTokensFromUrl = (callbackUrl: string) => {
  if (typeof callbackUrl !== 'string' || !callbackUrl.trim() || hasOAuthUrlError(callbackUrl)) return null;
  const hashPart = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] : '';
  const queryPart = callbackUrl.includes('?') ? callbackUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const params = new URLSearchParams(hashPart || queryPart);
  const accessToken = String(params.get('access_token') || '').trim();
  const refreshToken = String(params.get('refresh_token') || '').trim();
  return OAUTH_JWT_RE.test(accessToken) && refreshToken.length >= 10
    ? { accessToken, refreshToken }
    : null;
};

const FORBIDDEN_OAUTH_CODES = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export const extractOAuthCodeFromUrl = (callbackUrl: string): string | null => {
  if (typeof callbackUrl !== 'string' || !callbackUrl.trim() || hasOAuthUrlError(callbackUrl)) return null;
  const queryPart = callbackUrl.includes('?') ? callbackUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const hashPart = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : '';
  for (const rawPart of [queryPart, hashPart]) {
    if (!rawPart) continue;
    try {
      const code = String(new URLSearchParams(rawPart).get('code') || '').trim();
      if (
        code.length >= 6 &&
        code.length <= 512 &&
        !/\s/.test(code) &&
        !FORBIDDEN_OAUTH_CODES.has(code.toLowerCase())
      ) {
        return code;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
};

export async function completeNativeOAuthSessionFromUrl(callbackUrl: string) {
  if (!isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(callbackUrl)) return null;
  if (callbackUrl.includes('id_token=')) {
    const challenge = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
    if (!challenge) return null;
    const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(callbackUrl, {
      expectedState: challenge.state,
      expectedNonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
      expectedClientId: resolveGoogleWebClientId(),
    });
    if (!extracted) return null;
    return exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(extracted.idToken, challenge.rawNonce);
  }
  const oauthCode = extractOAuthCodeFromUrl(callbackUrl);
  if (oauthCode) {
    return supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(oauthCode);
  }
  const tokens = extractOAuthTokensFromUrl(callbackUrl);
  if (tokens) {
    const rawPart = callbackUrl.includes('#') ? callbackUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : callbackUrl.split('?')[1] || '';
    const linkType = String(new URLSearchParams(rawPart).get('type') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!new Set(['signup', 'recovery', 'invite', 'magiclink', 'email_change']).has(linkType)) return null;
    return supabase.auth.setSession({
      access_token: tokens.accessToken,
      refresh_token: tokens.refreshToken,
    });
  }
  return null;
}

export function resolveInitialOidcProfileWaiverState(params: {
  existingProfile?: { waiver_firmado?: boolean | null; waiver_fecha?: string | null } | null;
  explicitWaiverAccepted?: boolean;
  nowIso?: string;
}): { waiver_firmado: boolean; waiver_fecha: string | null } {
  const effectiveNow = params.nowIso || new Date().toISOString();
  if (params.existingProfile?.waiver_firmado === true) {
    const existingFecha = typeof params.existingProfile.waiver_fecha === 'string' && params.existingProfile.waiver_fecha.trim()
      ? params.existingProfile.waiver_fecha
      : effectiveNow;
    return { waiver_firmado: true, waiver_fecha: existingFecha };
  }
  if (params.explicitWaiverAccepted === true) {
    return { waiver_firmado: true, waiver_fecha: effectiveNow };
  }
  return { waiver_firmado: false, waiver_fecha: null };
}

export async function ensureFirstTimeProfile(
  signedUser: { id: string; email?: string | null; phone?: string | null; user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> },
  options?: {
    linkedName?: string | null;
    linkedAvatar?: string | null;
    linkedRole?: string | null;
    linkedNivel?: string | null;
    phoneE164?: string | null;
    explicitWaiverAccepted?: boolean;
  }
) {
  const { data: existing } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', signedUser.id).maybeSingle();
  if (existing) {
    if (options?.phoneE164 && !existing.telefono) {
      await supabase.from('perfiles').update({ telefono: options.phoneE164 }).eq('id', signedUser.id);
      return { ...existing, telefono: options.phoneE164 };
    }
    return existing;
  }

  const meta = signedUser.user_metadata || {};
  const emailStr = String(signedUser.email || '').trim();
  const isPhoneSynthetic = emailStr.endsWith('@phone.kineticapp.mx');
  const resolvedPhone =
    options?.phoneE164 ||
    (typeof signedUser.phone === 'string' && signedUser.phone.trim()) ||
    (typeof meta.telefono === 'string' && meta.telefono.trim()) ||
    null;

  const isMasterAdmin = MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(emailStr.toLowerCase());
  const resolvedName = isMasterAdmin
    ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
    : String(
        options?.linkedName ||
          meta.full_name ||
          meta.name ||
          meta.nombre ||
          meta.nombre_negocio ||
          (!isPhoneSynthetic && emailStr ? emailStr.split('@')[0] : '') ||
          (resolvedPhone ? `Atleta ${resolvedPhone.slice(-4)}` : 'Atleta Kinetic')
      ).trim().slice(0, 80);

  const resolvedAvatar =
    options?.linkedAvatar ||
    (typeof meta.avatar_url === 'string' && meta.avatar_url.trim()) ||
    (typeof meta.picture === 'string' && meta.picture.trim()) ||
    null;

  const resolvedRole = isMasterAdmin ? 'admin' : 'atleta';
  const resolvedNivel = isMasterAdmin ? 'Black' : 'Acceso Base';
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const initialWaiver = resolveInitialOidcProfileWaiverState({
    existingProfile: null,
    explicitWaiverAccepted: options?.explicitWaiverAccepted,
    nowIso,
  });

  const fullPayload = {
    id: signedUser.id,
    nombre: resolvedName,
    email: !isPhoneSynthetic && emailStr ? emailStr : null,
    telefono: resolvedPhone,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar,
    rol: resolvedRole,
    tipo_cuenta: resolvedRole,
    nivel: resolvedNivel,
    kc_membresia: 0,
    kc_topup: 0,
    racha_dias: 0,
    xp_total: 0,
    radar_publico: true,
    waiver_firmado: initialWaiver.waiver_firmado,
    waiver_fecha: initialWaiver.waiver_fecha,
    fecha_activacion_membresia: nowIso,
    perdones_mensuales_usados: 0,
    mes_perdones_control: nowIso.slice(0, 7),
  };

  const minPayload = {
    id: signedUser.id,
    email: !isPhoneSynthetic && emailStr ? emailStr : null,
    nombre: resolvedName,
    avatar_url: resolvedAvatar,
    telefono: resolvedPhone,
    rol: resolvedRole,
    nivel: resolvedNivel,
    kc_membresia: 0,
    kc_topup: 0,
    waiver_firmado: initialWaiver.waiver_firmado,
  };

  try {
    const { data: createdFull, error: fullErr } = await supabase
      .from('perfiles')
      .upsert(fullPayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
      .select('*')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!fullErr && createdFull) return createdFull;

    const { data: createdMin } = await supabase
      .from('perfiles')
      .upsert(minPayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
      .select('*')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (createdMin) return createdMin;

    const { data: fetchedAfter } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', signedUser.id).maybeSingle();
    return fetchedAfter || minPayload;
  } catch {
    return minPayload;
  }
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

const POISONED_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);
let _biometricVaultLock: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
let _interactiveLoginVerified = false;
const _bioPrefListeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function markInteractiveLoginVerified(): void {
  _interactiveLoginVerified = true;
}
export function resetInteractiveLoginVerified(): void {
  _interactiveLoginVerified = false;
}

  return _interactiveLoginVerified;
}
export function subscribeBiometricPreferenceChanges(cb: () => void): () => void {
  _bioPrefListeners.add(cb);
  return () => { _bioPrefListeners.delete(cb); };
}
export function emitBiometricPreferenceChanged(): void {
  _bioPrefListeners.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } });
}

const withBiometricVaultLock = <T,>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
  const next = _biometricVaultLock.then(fn, fn);
  _biometricVaultLock = next.then(() => undefined, () => undefined);
  return next;
};

interface LocalAuthNativeModuleLike {
  hasHardwareAsync?: () => Promise<boolean>;
  isEnrolledAsync?: () => Promise<boolean>;
  authenticateAsync?: (opts: {
    promptMessage: string;

    fallbackLabel?: string;
    disableDeviceFallback?: boolean;
  }) => Promise<{ success?: boolean }>;

export interface IPlatformBiometricAvailabilityState {
  isSupported: boolean;
  reasonCode: 'WEB_UNSUPPORTED' | 'HARDWARE_UNAVAILABLE' | 'AVAILABLE';
  labelEs: string;
  labelEn: string;
}

export async function resolvePlatformBiometricAvailabilityState(): Promise<IPlatformBiometricAvailabilityState> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    return {
      isSupported: false,
      reasonCode: 'WEB_UNSUPPORTED',
      labelEs: 'Solo disponible en app móvil iOS / Android',
      labelEn: 'Available on iOS / Android mobile app only',
    };
  }
  try {
    const localAuth = requireOptionalNativeModule<LocalAuthNativeModuleLike>('ExpoLocalAuthentication');
    if (localAuth?.hasHardwareAsync && localAuth?.isEnrolledAsync) {
      const [hasHw, enrolled] = await Promise.all([localAuth.hasHardwareAsync(), localAuth.isEnrolledAsync()]);
      if (hasHw && enrolled) {
        return {
          isSupported: true,
          reasonCode: 'AVAILABLE',
          labelEs: 'Biometría verificada en este dispositivo',
          labelEn: 'Biometrics verified on this device',
        };
      }
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  return {
    isSupported: false,
    reasonCode: 'HARDWARE_UNAVAILABLE',
    labelEs: 'Configura Face ID o huella en ajustes del dispositivo',
    labelEn: 'Enable Face ID or fingerprint in device settings',
  };
}

export async function runBiometricHardwarePromptAsync(
  promptMsg = 'Autenticación biométrica KINETIC',
  fallbackMsg = 'Usar PIN del dispositivo',
  cancelMsg = 'Usar contraseña'
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return false;
  try {
    const localAuth = requireOptionalNativeModule<LocalAuthNativeModuleLike>('ExpoLocalAuthentication');
    if (!localAuth?.hasHardwareAsync || !localAuth?.isEnrolledAsync || !localAuth?.authenticateAsync) {
      return false;
    }
    const [hasHw, enrolled] = await Promise.all([localAuth.hasHardwareAsync(), localAuth.isEnrolledAsync()]);
    if (!hasHw || !enrolled) return false;
    markTransientNativeOverlayActive('biometric_prompt', true);
    try {
      const res = await localAuth.authenticateAsync({
        promptMessage: promptMsg,
        cancelLabel: cancelMsg,
        fallbackLabel: fallbackMsg,
        disableDeviceFallback: false,
      });
      return res?.success === true;
    } finally {
      markTransientNativeOverlayActive('biometric_prompt', false);
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export interface IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export function sanitizeBiometricVaultEntry(raw: unknown): IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return null;
  const rec = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const userId = typeof rec.userId === 'string' ? rec.userId.trim() : '';
  const email = typeof rec.email === 'string' ? rec.email.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const refreshToken = typeof rec.refreshToken === 'string' ? rec.refreshToken.trim() : '';
  const updatedAt =
    typeof rec.updatedAt === 'string' && rec.updatedAt.trim()
      ? rec.updatedAt.trim()
      : new Date().toISOString();
  if (!userId || !email || !email.includes('@') || refreshToken.length < 8) return null;
  return { userId, email, refreshToken, updatedAt };
}

export function canPersistSessionInBiometricVault(params: {
  session: IMfaSessionLike | null | undefined;
  hasVerifiedTotpFactor: boolean;
  biometriaActiva: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (!params.biometriaActiva) return false;
  const uid = String(params.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
  const refresh = String(params.session?.refresh_token || '').trim();
  const access = String(params.session?.access_token || '').trim();
  if (!uid || refresh.length < 8 || !access || access.startsWith('kinetic-')) return false;
  if (doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(params.session)) return false;
  if (params.hasVerifiedTotpFactor && extractJwtAal(access) !== 'aal2') return false;
  return true;
}

export function serializeEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(
  entries: Record<string, IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry>,
  salt: string
): string {
  const cleanMap: Record<string, IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry> = {};
  if (entries && typeof entries === 'object' && !Array.isArray(entries)) {
    for (const [keyHint, rawVal] of Object.entries(entries)) {
      const normKey = String(keyHint || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!normKey || POISONED_KEYS.has(normKey)) continue;
      const sanitized = sanitizeBiometricVaultEntry(rawVal);
      if (!sanitized) continue;
      cleanMap[sanitized.email] = {
        userId: sanitized.userId,
        email: sanitized.email,
        refreshToken: sanitized.refreshToken,
        updatedAt: sanitized.updatedAt,
      };
    }
  }
  return encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify(cleanMap), salt);
}

export function parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(
  cipherText: string | null | undefined,
  salt: string
): Record<string, IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry> {
  if (typeof cipherText !== 'string' || !cipherText.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) return {};
  const decoded = decryptKineticString(cipherText, salt);
  if (!decoded) return {};
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return {};
    const out: Record<string, IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (POISONED_KEYS.has(k)) continue;
      const entry = sanitizeBiometricVaultEntry(v);
      if (!entry) continue;
      out[entry.email] = entry;
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export async function isBiometricPreferenceEnabledAsync(profileFlag?: boolean | null): Promise<boolean> {
  const rawPref = await AsyncStorage.getItem(BIOMETRIC_PREF_KEY).catch(() => null);
  if (rawPref === 'false' || profileFlag === false) return false;
  if (rawPref === 'true' || profileFlag === true) return true;
  return false;
}

export async function persistBiometricRefreshTokenIfAllowedAsync(params: {
  session: IMfaSessionLike | null | undefined;
  hasVerifiedTotpFactor: boolean;
  biometriaActiva?: boolean | null;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const uid = String(params.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
  const email = String(params.session?.user?.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const refreshToken = String(params.session?.refresh_token || '').trim();
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    if (email || uid) await purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync(email || uid).catch(() => {});
    return false;
  }
  return withBiometricVaultLock(async () => {
    const bioEnabled = await isBiometricPreferenceEnabledAsync(params.biometriaActiva);
    if (!canPersistSessionInBiometricVault({ ...params, biometriaActiva: bioEnabled })) return false;
    if (!uid || !email || !email.includes('@') || refreshToken.length < 8) return false;
    try {
      const [salt, existingCipher] = await Promise.all([
        ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync(),
        secureVaultReadAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY),
      ]);
      const stillEnabled = await isBiometricPreferenceEnabledAsync(params.biometriaActiva);
      if (!stillEnabled) return false;
      const currentMap = parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(existingCipher, salt);
      currentMap[email] = { userId: uid, email, refreshToken, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      const nextCipher = serializeEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(currentMap, salt);
      await secureVaultWriteAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY, nextCipher);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
}

export async function readBiometricRefreshEntryAsync(
  emailOrUserId: string
): Promise<IBiometricRefreshVaultEntry | null> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  const target = String(emailOrUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!target) return null;
  return withBiometricVaultLock(async () => {
    try {
      const [salt, existingCipher] = await Promise.all([
        ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync(),
        secureVaultReadAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY),
      ]);
      const currentMap = parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(existingCipher, salt);
      if (currentMap[target]) return currentMap[target];
      return Object.values(currentMap).find((e) => e.userId.toLowerCase() === target) || null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });
}

export async function purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync(emailOrUserId?: string | null): Promise<void> {
  return withBiometricVaultLock(async () => {
    const cleanTarget = String(emailOrUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cleanTarget) {
      await secureVaultDeleteAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const [salt, existingCipher] = await Promise.all([
        ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync(),
        secureVaultReadAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY),
      ]);
      const currentMap = parseEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(existingCipher, salt);
      let mutated = false;
      for (const [k, entry] of Object.entries(currentMap)) {
        if (k === cleanTarget || entry.email === cleanTarget || entry.userId.toLowerCase() === cleanTarget) {
          delete currentMap[k];
          mutated = true;
        }
      }
      if (!mutated) return;
      if (Object.keys(currentMap).length === 0) {
        await secureVaultDeleteAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY);
      } else {
        await secureVaultWriteAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY, serializeEncryptedBiometricVaultMap(currentMap, salt));
      }
    } catch {
      await secureVaultDeleteAsync(BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY);
    }
  });
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Linking, Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  type IKineticCalendarEventInput,
  type IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry,
  buildGoogleCalendarWebFallbackUrl,
  buildKineticReservaIcsPayload,
  removeCalendarMapImmutable,
  resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow,
  upsertCalendarMapImmutable,
} from '../utils/kineticIcsCalendarLeaf';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { markTransientNativeOverlayActive } from '../utils/kineticBiometricGateMachineLeaf';
import { formatStudioStationBadge } from './studioLayoutGridHelper';
import { CIPHER_PREFIX, decryptKineticString, ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync } from './kineticVaultCrypto';

export const KINETIC_CALENDAR_EVENT_MAP_KEY = '@kinetic_calendar_event_map_v1';
const USER_PREFS_PREFIX = '@kinetic_user_prefs_v1_';

export type IKineticCalendarSyncMode =
  | 'native_created'
  | 'native_updated'
  | 'web_ics'
  | 'google_web_fallback'
  | 'skipped';

export interface IKineticCalendarSyncResult {
  ok: boolean;
  mode: IKineticCalendarSyncMode;
  eventId?: string;
}

const _inFlightSyncByReserva = new Map<string, Promise<IKineticCalendarSyncResult>>();
const _recentReservaByServiceDate = new Map<string, string>();
let _calendarMapQueue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
const _reservaOpsQueue = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();

export function rememberCreatedReservaId(serviceId?: string | number | null, fechaIso?: string | null, reservaId?: string | null): void {
  const sId = String(serviceId || '').trim(), rId = String(reservaId || '').trim();
  if (!sId || !rId || sId === rId) return;
  _recentReservaByServiceDate.set(`${sId}::${String(fechaIso || '').trim()}`, rId);
  _recentReservaByServiceDate.set(sId, rId);
}

export function resolveRecentCreatedReservaId(serviceId?: string | number | null, fechaIso?: string | null): string | null {
  const sId = String(serviceId || '').trim();
  return sId ? _recentReservaByServiceDate.get(`${sId}::${String(fechaIso || '').trim()}`) || _recentReservaByServiceDate.get(sId) || null : null;
}

function withCalendarMapLock<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const next = _calendarMapQueue.then(fn, fn);
  _calendarMapQueue = next.catch(() => {});
  return next;
}

function withReservaCalendarQueue<T>(cleanId: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const prev = _reservaOpsQueue.get(cleanId) || Promise.resolve();
  const next = prev.then(fn, fn);
  const settled = next.finally(() => {
    if (_reservaOpsQueue.get(cleanId) === settled) {
      _reservaOpsQueue.delete(cleanId);
    }
  });
  _reservaOpsQueue.set(cleanId, settled);
  return next;
}

const _calendarChangeListeners = new Set<(reservaId: string) => void>();
export function subscribeCalendarSyncChanges(listener: (reservaId: string) => void): () => void {
  _calendarChangeListeners.add(listener);
  return () => { _calendarChangeListeners.delete(listener); };
}
function emitCalendarSyncChange(reservaId: string): void {
  _calendarChangeListeners.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(reservaId); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } });
}

async function mutateSyncedCalendarMapLocked(
  mutator: (latest: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>) => Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>,
  notifyReservaId?: string
): Promise<void> {
  await withCalendarMapLock(async () => {
    const latest = await readSyncedCalendarMap();
    await writeSyncedCalendarMap(mutator(latest));
  });
  if (notifyReservaId) emitCalendarSyncChange(notifyReservaId);
}

interface ExpoCalendarModuleLike {
  EntityTypes?: { EVENT?: string };
  CalendarAccessLevel?: { OWNER?: string };
  getCalendarPermissionsAsync?: () => Promise<{ status?: string }>;
  requestCalendarPermissionsAsync?: () => Promise<{ status?: string }>;
  getDefaultCalendarAsync?: () => Promise<{ id?: string; allowsModifications?: boolean } | null>;
  getCalendarsAsync?: (entityType?: string) => Promise<{
    id: string;
    allowsModifications?: boolean;
    accessLevel?: string;
    isPrimary?: boolean;
    source?: { name?: string; isLocalAccount?: boolean };
  }[]>;
  createCalendarAsync?: (details: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<string>;
  createEventAsync?: (calendarId: string, details: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<string>;
  updateEventAsync?: (eventId: string, details: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<string>;
  getEventAsync?: (eventId: string) => Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null>;
  deleteEventAsync?: (eventId: string) => Promise<void>;
}

const getExpoCalendar = (): ExpoCalendarModuleLike | null => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
    return (require('expo-calendar') as ExpoCalendarModuleLike) || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

async function readSyncedCalendarMap(): Promise<Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_CALENDAR_EVENT_MAP_KEY);
    if (!raw) return Object.create(null) as Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>;
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return Object.create(null) as Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>;
    }
    let out = Object.create(null) as Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (v && typeof v === 'object' && typeof (v as IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry).eventId === 'string') {
        out = upsertCalendarMapImmutable(out, k, v as IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry);
      }
    }
    return out;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return Object.create(null) as Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>;
  }
}

async function writeSyncedCalendarMap(map: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const plain: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(map)) plain[k] = v;
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(KINETIC_CALENDAR_EVENT_MAP_KEY, JSON.stringify(plain));
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
}

export async function shouldAutoSyncCalendarReminders(userId?: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
  const cleanUid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUid) return true;
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(`${USER_PREFS_PREFIX}${cleanUid}`);
    if (!raw) return true;
    let jsonStr = raw;
    if (raw.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) {
      const salt = await ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync();
      jsonStr = decryptKineticString(raw, salt) || '';
    }
    if (!jsonStr) return true;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr) as { recordatorios_entrenamiento?: unknown };
    return parsed?.recordatorios_entrenamiento !== false;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return true;
  }
}

function triggerWebIcsDownload(filename: string, icsText: string): boolean {
  const g = globalThis as {
    Blob?: new (parts: string[], opts: { type: string }) => unknown;
    File?: new (parts: unknown[], name: string, opts: { type: string }) => unknown;
    URL?: { createObjectURL?: (b: unknown) => string; revokeObjectURL?: (u: string) => void };
    navigator?: {
      userAgent?: string;
      canShare?: (d: { files?: unknown[] }) => boolean;
      share?: (d: { files?: unknown[]; title?: string }) => Promise<void>;
    };
    document?: {
      createElement?: (tag: string) => { href: string; download: string; rel?: string; style: { display: string }; click: () => void; remove?: () => void };
      body?: { appendChild?: (node: unknown) => void };
    };
  };
  const ua = String(g.navigator?.userAgent || '');
  const isIosWebKit = /(iphone|ipad|ipod)/i.test(ua);
  if (isIosWebKit && typeof g.File === 'function' && typeof g.Blob === 'function' && typeof g.navigator?.canShare === 'function' && typeof g.navigator?.share === 'function') {
    try {
      const file = new g.File([new g.Blob([icsText], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' })], filename, { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
      if (g.navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
        void g.navigator.share({ files: [file], title: filename }).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
        return true;
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  }
  if (isIosWebKit) return false;
  if (typeof g.Blob !== 'function' || !g.URL?.createObjectURL || !g.document?.createElement || !g.document.body?.appendChild) return false;
  try {
    const blob = new g.Blob([icsText], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = g.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = g.document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url; link.download = filename; link.rel = 'noopener'; link.style.display = 'none';
    g.document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    setTimeout(() => { try { link.remove?.(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } }, 300);
    setTimeout(() => { try { g.URL?.revokeObjectURL?.(url); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } }, 30_000);
    return true;
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; return false; }
}

export async function openGoogleCalendarDirectWeb(input: IKineticCalendarEventInput): Promise<void> {
  const url = buildGoogleCalendarWebFallbackUrl(input);
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.open === 'function') {
    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    return;
  }
  await Linking.openURL(url).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
}

const WRITABLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS = new Set(['owner', 'editor', 'contributor', 'root']);

async function resolvePrimaryWritableCalendarId(cal: ExpoCalendarModuleLike): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    if (Platform.OS === 'ios' && cal.getDefaultCalendarAsync) {
      const defCal = await cal.getDefaultCalendarAsync().catch(() => null);
      if (defCal?.id && defCal.allowsModifications !== false) return defCal.id;
    }
    if (cal.getCalendarsAsync) {
      const list = await cal.getCalendarsAsync(cal.EntityTypes?.EVENT || 'event');
      const writable = (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).filter((c) => {
        if (!c?.id || c.allowsModifications !== true) return false;
        const acc = String(c.accessLevel || '').toLowerCase();
        return !acc || WRITABLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS.has(acc);
      });
      const primary = writable.find((c) => c.isPrimary) || writable[0];
      if (primary?.id) return primary.id;
    }
    if (cal.createCalendarAsync) {
      const createdId = await cal.createCalendarAsync({
        title: 'Kinetic Agenda',
        name: 'kinetic_agenda',
        color: '#00F0FF',
        entityType: cal.EntityTypes?.EVENT || 'event',
        accessLevel: cal.CalendarAccessLevel?.OWNER || 'owner',
        ownerAccount: 'kinetic',
        source: Platform.OS === 'android' ? { isLocalAccount: true, name: 'Kinetic', type: 'LOCAL' } : undefined,
      }).catch(() => null);
      if (createdId) return createdId;
    }
    return null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export async function syncReservationToNativeCalendar(params: {
  input: IKineticCalendarEventInput;
  silent?: boolean;
}): Promise<IKineticCalendarSyncResult> {
  const cleanId = String(params.input?.reservaId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanId) return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };

  const flightKey = `${cleanId}::${params.silent ? 'silent' : 'manual'}`;
  const existingFlight = _inFlightSyncByReserva.get(flightKey);
  if (existingFlight) return existingFlight;

  const lang = params.input.language || (getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es');
  const normalizedInput: IKineticCalendarEventInput = { ...params.input, reservaId: cleanId, language: lang };

  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    if (params.silent) return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
    const ics = buildKineticReservaIcsPayload(normalizedInput);
    const downloaded = triggerWebIcsDownload(`kinetic-reserva-${cleanId.slice(0, 8)}.ics`, ics);
    if (!downloaded) {
      await Linking.openURL(buildGoogleCalendarWebFallbackUrl(normalizedInput)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
    }
    await mutateSyncedCalendarMapLocked((latest) =>
      upsertCalendarMapImmutable(latest, cleanId, {
        eventId: `ics:${cleanId}`,
        calendarId: downloaded ? 'web-ics' : 'google-web',
        syncedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
    );
    return { ok: true, mode: downloaded ? 'web_ics' : 'google_web_fallback', eventId: `ics:${cleanId}` };
  }

  const task = withReservaCalendarQueue<IKineticCalendarSyncResult>(cleanId, async () => {
    const cal = getExpoCalendar();
    if (!cal?.getCalendarPermissionsAsync || !cal.createEventAsync) {
      return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
    }

    let perm = await cal.getCalendarPermissionsAsync().catch(() => ({ status: 'denied' }));
    if (perm?.status !== 'granted') {
      if (params.silent) return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
      markTransientNativeOverlayActive('calendar_perm', true);
      try {
        perm = cal.requestCalendarPermissionsAsync
          ? await cal.requestCalendarPermissionsAsync().catch(() => ({ status: 'denied' }))
          : { status: 'denied' };
      } finally {
        markTransientNativeOverlayActive('calendar_perm', false);
      }
    }
    if (perm?.status !== 'granted') {
      return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
    }

    const win = resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow(normalizedInput.fechaIso, normalizedInput.horaInicio, normalizedInput.durationMinutes);
    const parsedSpot = normalizedInput.spotNumber != null && String(normalizedInput.spotNumber).trim() !== '' ? Math.round(Number(normalizedInput.spotNumber)) : NaN;
    const stationNote = Number.isFinite(parsedSpot) && parsedSpot > 0
      ? ` • ${formatStudioStationBadge(normalizedInput.equipmentType, parsedSpot, lang === 'en')}`
      : '';
    const details: Record<string, unknown> = {
      title: `Kinetic: ${normalizedInput.title}${normalizedInput.venueName ? ` (${normalizedInput.venueName})` : ''}`,
      startDate: new Date(win.startMs),
      endDate: new Date(win.endMs),
      timeZone: 'America/Mazatlan',
      location: normalizedInput.location || normalizedInput.venueName || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S., México',
      notes: `${normalizedInput.venueName}${stationNote} • Pase #${cleanId.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()} • Bóveda QR: https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda`,
      alarms: [{ relativeOffset: -240 }, { relativeOffset: -60 }],
    };

    const existing = await withCalendarMapLock(async () => (await readSyncedCalendarMap())[cleanId]);
    if (existing?.eventId && !existing.eventId.startsWith('ics:') && cal.updateEventAsync && cal.getEventAsync) {
      try {
        const remoteEv = await cal.getEventAsync(existing.eventId).catch(() => null);
        if (remoteEv) {
          await cal.updateEventAsync(existing.eventId, details);
          await mutateSyncedCalendarMapLocked(
            (latest) =>
              upsertCalendarMapImmutable(latest, cleanId, {
                eventId: existing.eventId,
                calendarId: existing.calendarId,
                syncedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              }),
            cleanId
          );
          return { ok: true, mode: 'native_updated', eventId: existing.eventId };
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }

    const calendarId = await resolvePrimaryWritableCalendarId(cal);
    if (!calendarId) {
      return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
    }

    try {
      const newEventId = await cal.createEventAsync(calendarId, details);
      await mutateSyncedCalendarMapLocked(
        (latest) =>
          upsertCalendarMapImmutable(latest, cleanId, {
            eventId: newEventId,
            calendarId,
            syncedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          }),
        cleanId
      );
      return { ok: true, mode: 'native_created', eventId: newEventId };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
    }
  });

  _inFlightSyncByReserva.set(flightKey, task);
  try {
    return await task;
  } finally {
    if (_inFlightSyncByReserva.get(flightKey) === task) {
      _inFlightSyncByReserva.delete(flightKey);
    }
  }
}

export async function reconcileReservationCalendarSyncState(
  reservaId?: string | null
): Promise<{ isSynced: boolean; wasDeletedExternally: boolean }> {
  const cleanId = String(reservaId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanId) return { isSynced: false, wasDeletedExternally: false };
  return withReservaCalendarQueue(cleanId, async () => {
    const entry = await withCalendarMapLock(async () => (await readSyncedCalendarMap())[cleanId]);
    if (!entry?.eventId) return { isSynced: false, wasDeletedExternally: false };
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || entry.eventId.startsWith('ics:')) {
      return { isSynced: true, wasDeletedExternally: false };
    }
    const cal = getExpoCalendar();
    if (!cal?.getCalendarPermissionsAsync || !cal.getEventAsync) {
      return { isSynced: true, wasDeletedExternally: false };
    }
    try {
      const perm = await cal.getCalendarPermissionsAsync();
      if (perm?.status !== 'granted') return { isSynced: true, wasDeletedExternally: false };
      const remoteEv = await cal.getEventAsync(entry.eventId).catch(() => null);
      if (!remoteEv) {
        await mutateSyncedCalendarMapLocked((latest) => removeCalendarMapImmutable(latest, cleanId));
        return { isSynced: false, wasDeletedExternally: true };
      }
      return { isSynced: true, wasDeletedExternally: false };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      return { isSynced: true, wasDeletedExternally: false };
    }
  });
}

export async function removeCanceledReservationFromCalendar(reservaId?: string | null): Promise<void> {
  const cleanId = String(reservaId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanId) return;
  await withReservaCalendarQueue(cleanId, async () => {
    const entry = await withCalendarMapLock(async () => (await readSyncedCalendarMap())[cleanId]);
    if (entry?.eventId && !entry.eventId.startsWith('ics:') && Platform.OS !== 'web') {
      const cal = getExpoCalendar();
      if (cal?.deleteEventAsync && cal.getCalendarPermissionsAsync) {
        try {
          const perm = await cal.getCalendarPermissionsAsync();
          if (perm?.status === 'granted') await cal.deleteEventAsync(entry.eventId);
        } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
      }
    }
    if (entry) await mutateSyncedCalendarMapLocked((latest) => removeCalendarMapImmutable(latest, cleanId), cleanId);
  });
}

export async function syncConfirmedModalBookingCalendar(params: {
  returnedOutcome?: unknown; serviceId?: string | number | null; title: string; venueName: string;
  location?: string | null; fechaIso: string; horaInicio: string; spotNumber?: number | null;
  escrowKc: number; puertaKc: number; language?: 'es' | 'en' | string; lookupFallbackReservaId?: () => Promise<string | null>;
}): Promise<IKineticCalendarSyncResult> {
  const out = params.returnedOutcome;
  let realId = typeof out === 'string'
    ? out.trim()
    : typeof out === 'object' && out !== null
      ? String((out as { reservaId?: unknown; id?: unknown }).reservaId ?? (out as { id?: unknown }).id ?? '').trim()
      : '';
  if (!realId) realId = resolveRecentCreatedReservaId(params.serviceId, params.fechaIso) || '';
  if (!realId && params.lookupFallbackReservaId) realId = String((await params.lookupFallbackReservaId().catch(() => null)) || '').trim();
  if (!realId) return { ok: false, mode: 'skipped' };
  return syncReservationToNativeCalendar({
    silent: false,
    input: {
      reservaId: realId, title: params.title, venueName: params.venueName, location: params.location ?? null,
      fechaIso: params.fechaIso, horaInicio: params.horaInicio, spotNumber: params.spotNumber ?? null,
      escrowKc: params.escrowKc, puertaKc: params.puertaKc, status: 'CONFIRMED', language: params.language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es',
    },
  });
}
