import { getMaxForgivenessForLevel } from '../constants/memberships';
import { getMazatlanNowParts, mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs } from './kineticVenueCanonicalGeoAndHours';

export type CancellationWindowType =
  | 'zero_kc_or_admin'
  | 'grace_5m_or_72h'
  | 'vip_forgiveness_72h_4h'
  | 'late_no_forgiveness_72h_4h'
  | 'under_4h_strict_retention';

export interface ICancellationWindowInput {
  hoursUntilEvent: number;
  minutesSinceCreated?: number;
  vipLevel?: string | null;
  usedForgivenessCount?: number;
  isAdminUser?: boolean;
  isZeroKcPass?: boolean;
  montoEscrow?: number;
  isEn?: boolean;
}

export interface ICancellationWindowPolicy {
  shouldRefund: boolean;
  usedVipForgiveness: boolean;
  remainingForgiveness: number;
  maxForgiveness: number;
  windowType: CancellationWindowType;
  isUnder4hWindow: boolean;
  actionButtonLabel: string;
  windowMessage: string;
  resultMessage: string;
}

export interface IMazatlanSessionTimingSource {
  fecha_clase?: string | Date | null;
  fecha_programada?: string | Date | null;
  fecha?: string | Date | null;
  fecha_hora?: string | Date | null;
  created_at?: string | Date | null;
  hora_inicio?: string | null;
  hora?: string | null;
}

const extractNonZeroIsoTime = (val?: unknown): string | null => {
  const s = String(val || '').trim();
  const m = s.match(/[T\s](\d{2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?/);
  if (!m) return null;
  if (`${m[1]}:${m[2]}` === '00:00') return null;
  if (/[zZ]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2}$/.test(s)) {
    const parsed = new Date(s);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return `${getMazatlanNowParts(parsed).hhmm}:00`;
  }
  return `${m[1]}:${m[2]}:${m[3] || '00'}`;
};

export const resolveMazatlanMonthKey = (nowMs: number = Date.now()): string => {
  const ref = Number.isFinite(nowMs) ? new Date(nowMs) : new Date();
  return getMazatlanNowParts(ref).isoDate.slice(0, 7);
};

export const resolveMazatlanSessionInstantMs = (
  reserva: IMazatlanSessionTimingSource | null | undefined,
  servFallback?: IMazatlanSessionTimingSource | null
): number => {
  const rawDate =
    reserva?.fecha_clase ||
    reserva?.fecha_programada ||
    reserva?.fecha ||
    servFallback?.fecha ||
    reserva?.fecha_hora ||
    reserva?.created_at;
  if (!rawDate) return NaN;

  const explicitHora = String(
    reserva?.hora_inicio || reserva?.hora || servFallback?.hora_inicio || servFallback?.hora || ''
  ).trim();

  let ymd = '';
  if (rawDate instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(rawDate.getTime())) return NaN;
    if (!explicitHora && (rawDate.getUTCHours() !== 0 || rawDate.getUTCMinutes() !== 0)) {
      return rawDate.getTime();
    }
    ymd = getMazatlanNowParts(rawDate).isoDate;
  } else {
    const s = String(rawDate).trim();
    const ymdMatch = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:$|[T\s](.+))?/);
    if (ymdMatch) {
      const timePart = (ymdMatch[4] || '').trim();
      const hasExplicitTz = /[zZ]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2}$/.test(timePart);
      const isMidnight = /^00:00(?::00(?:\.0+)?)?(?:[zZ]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?$/i.test(timePart);
      if (!explicitHora && hasExplicitTz && !isMidnight) {
        const parsed = new Date(s);
        if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return parsed.getTime();
      }
      if (!timePart || !hasExplicitTz || isMidnight) {
        ymd = `${ymdMatch[1]}-${ymdMatch[2]}-${ymdMatch[3]}`;
      } else {
        const parsed = new Date(s);
        ymd = Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? `${ymdMatch[1]}-${ymdMatch[2]}-${ymdMatch[3]}` : getMazatlanNowParts(parsed).isoDate;
      }
    } else {
      const parsed = new Date(s);
      if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return NaN;
      if (!explicitHora && (parsed.getUTCHours() !== 0 || parsed.getUTCMinutes() !== 0)) {
        return parsed.getTime();
      }
      ymd = getMazatlanNowParts(parsed).isoDate;
    }
  }

  const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
  if (!y || !m || !d) return NaN;
  const rawHora = String(
    explicitHora ||
      extractNonZeroIsoTime(reserva?.fecha_programada) ||
      extractNonZeroIsoTime(reserva?.fecha_hora) ||
      extractNonZeroIsoTime(typeof rawDate === 'string' ? rawDate : '') ||
      '08:00:00'
  ).trim();
  const hmMatch = rawHora.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?/i);
  let hh = hmMatch ? parseInt(hmMatch[1], 10) : 8;
  const mm = hmMatch ? Math.max(0, Math.min(59, parseInt(hmMatch[2], 10) || 0)) : 0;
  const ss = hmMatch ? Math.max(0, Math.min(59, parseInt(hmMatch[3] || '0', 10) || 0)) : 0;
  const ampm = (hmMatch?.[4] || '').toLowerCase();
  if (ampm.startsWith('p') && hh < 12) hh += 12;
  if (ampm.startsWith('a') && hh === 12) hh = 0;
  hh = Math.max(0, Math.min(23, hh));
  return mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(y, m, d, hh, mm, ss, 0);
};

export const computeHoursUntilMazatlanSession = (
  reserva: IMazatlanSessionTimingSource | null | undefined,
  servFallback: IMazatlanSessionTimingSource | null | undefined,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): number => {
  const evMs = resolveMazatlanSessionInstantMs(reserva, servFallback);
  return Number.isFinite(evMs) && Number.isFinite(nowMs) ? (evMs - nowMs) / 3600000 : 999;
};

export const buildQrCancelCtaLabel = ({
  escrowKc,
  isFullRefund,
  isAdminPass = false,
  isEn = false,
  fallbackLabel,
}: {
  escrowKc: number;
  isFullRefund: boolean;
  isAdminPass?: boolean;
  isEn?: boolean;
  fallbackLabel?: string;
}): string => {
  const safeEscrow = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(escrowKc) || 0));
  if (isAdminPass || safeEscrow <= 0) {
    return isEn ? 'RELEASE / REMOVE PASS (0 KC)' : 'LIBERAR / ELIMINAR PASE (0 KC)';
  }
  if (isFullRefund) {
    return isEn
      ? `CANCEL & REFUND MY ${safeEscrow} KC (100% ESCROW)`
      : `CANCELAR Y REEMBOLSAR MIS ${safeEscrow} KC (100% APARTADO)`;
  }
  return (
    fallbackLabel ||
    (isEn ? 'CANCEL & RELEASE SPOT (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR Y LIBERAR CUPO (40% RETENIDO)')
  );
};

export const evaluateCancellationWindowPolicy = (
  input: ICancellationWindowInput
): ICancellationWindowPolicy => {
  const {
    hoursUntilEvent,
    minutesSinceCreated = 999,
    vipLevel,
    usedForgivenessCount = 0,
    isAdminUser = false,
    isZeroKcPass = false,
    montoEscrow = 0,
    isEn = false,
  } = input;

  const safeHours = Number.isFinite(hoursUntilEvent) ? hoursUntilEvent : 999;
  const safeMinSince = Number.isFinite(minutesSinceCreated) ? minutesSinceCreated : 999;
  const safeUsed = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(usedForgivenessCount) || 0));
  const safeEscrow = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(montoEscrow) || 0));
  const maxForgiveness = getMaxForgivenessForLevel(vipLevel);
  const remainingBefore = Math.max(0, maxForgiveness - safeUsed);
  const isWithin5mGrace = safeMinSince >= 0 && safeMinSince <= 5;

  if (isZeroKcPass || isAdminUser) {
    return {
      shouldRefund: true,
      usedVipForgiveness: false,
      remainingForgiveness: remainingBefore,
      maxForgiveness,
      windowType: 'zero_kc_or_admin',
      isUnder4hWindow: false,
      actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'RELEASE / REMOVE PASS (0 KC)' : 'LIBERAR / ELIMINAR PASE (0 KC)',
      windowMessage: isEn
        ? '0 KC courtesy pass can be released immediately at no charge.'
        : 'Este pase 0 KC puede liberarse sin costo ni penalización.',
      resultMessage: isEn
        ? 'The 0 KC reservation was released cleanly.'
        : 'La reserva 0 KC fue liberada correctamente.',
    };
  }

  if (isWithin5mGrace || safeHours >= 72) {
    return {
      shouldRefund: true,
      usedVipForgiveness: false,
      remainingForgiveness: remainingBefore,
      maxForgiveness,
      windowType: 'grace_5m_or_72h',
      isUnder4hWindow: false,
      actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL & REFUND 40%' : 'CANCELAR Y REEMBOLSAR 40%',
      windowMessage: isWithin5mGrace
        ? isEn
          ? 'Within 5-min grace period: 100% of your Protected Deposit (40%) is refunded.'
          : 'Dentro de tolerancia (<=5 min): reembolso del 100% de tu Anticipo Protegido (40%).'
        : isEn
          ? 'Early cancellation (>=72h): 100% of your Protected Deposit (40%) is refunded.'
          : 'Cancelación anticipada (>=72h): reembolso del 100% de tu Anticipo Protegido (40%).',
      resultMessage: isEn
        ? `${safeEscrow} KC refunded to your Vault (100% Protected Deposit returned).`
        : `${safeEscrow} KC reembolsados íntegros a tu Bóveda (100% del Anticipo Protegido 40%).`,
    };
  }

  if (safeHours >= 4 && safeHours < 72) {
    if (remainingBefore > 0) {
      const remainingAfter = remainingBefore - 1;
      return {
        shouldRefund: true,
        usedVipForgiveness: true,
        remainingForgiveness: remainingAfter,
        maxForgiveness,
        windowType: 'vip_forgiveness_72h_4h',
        isUnder4hWindow: false,
        actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL WITH VIP FORGIVENESS (100%)' : 'CANCELAR CON PERDÓN VIP (100%)',
        windowMessage: isEn
          ? `Window 72h–4h: Your VIP Forgiveness applies (${remainingBefore}/${maxForgiveness} left) for a 100% refund.`
          : `Ventana 72h–4h: Se aplicará 1 Perdón VIP (${remainingBefore}/${maxForgiveness} disponibles) con reembolso del 100%.`,
        resultMessage: isEn
          ? `VIP Forgiveness applied! ${safeEscrow} KC refunded 100% (${remainingAfter} left this month).`
          : `¡Perdón VIP aplicado! ${safeEscrow} KC devueltos al 100% (${remainingAfter} perdones restantes este mes).`,
      };
    }

    return {
      shouldRefund: false,
      usedVipForgiveness: false,
      remainingForgiveness: 0,
      maxForgiveness,
      windowType: 'late_no_forgiveness_72h_4h',
      isUnder4hWindow: false,
      actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL SESSION (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR SESIÓN (RETENCIÓN 40%)',
      windowMessage: isEn
        ? 'Window 72h–4h with 0 monthly VIP Forgiveness left: the 40% Protected Deposit is retained (60% front-desk settlement waived).'
        : 'Ventana 72h–4h con 0 Perdones VIP disponibles este mes: se retiene el Anticipo Protegido (40%) sin cargo del 60% en recepción.',
      resultMessage: isEn
        ? `Session cancelled. With 0 monthly VIP Forgiveness left in the 72h–4h window, the ${safeEscrow} KC (40% Protected Deposit) is retained.`
        : `Sesión cancelada. Sin Perdones VIP disponibles en la ventana 72h–4h, los ${safeEscrow} KC (Anticipo Protegido 40%) quedan retenidos.`,
    };
  }

  return {
    shouldRefund: false,
    usedVipForgiveness: false,
    remainingForgiveness: remainingBefore,
    maxForgiveness,
    windowType: 'under_4h_strict_retention',
    isUnder4hWindow: true,
    actionButtonLabel: isEn ? 'CANCEL SESSION (40% RETAINED)' : 'CANCELAR SESIÓN (RETENCIÓN 40%)',
    windowMessage: isEn
      ? `Less than 4h before class (<4h): The 40% Protected Deposit (${safeEscrow} KC) is retained for the studio/coach (60% front-desk fee is never charged).`
      : `A menos de 4h de iniciar (<4h): Tu Anticipo Protegido 40% (${safeEscrow} KC) queda retenido a favor de la sede y coach (el 60% de recepción nunca se cobra).`,
    resultMessage: isEn
      ? `Session cancelled inside <4h window. The ${safeEscrow} KC (40% Protected Deposit) was retained to protect the studio; the remaining 60% was not charged.`
      : `Sesión cancelada con menos de 4h (<4h). El Anticipo Protegido 40% (${safeEscrow} KC) fue retenido en garantía de la sede; el 60% de recepción nunca se cobra.`,
  };
};

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const PROTO_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', 'tostring', 'valueof']);

export interface IChatReadMessageLike {
  id?: string | null;
  clientMsgId?: string | null;
  client_msg_id?: string | null;
  senderId?: string | null;
  usuario_id?: string | null;
  senderName?: string | null;
  usuario_nombre?: string | null;
  text?: string | null;
  mensaje?: string | null;
  contenido?: string | null;
  createdAt?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
  leidoAt?: string | null;
  leido_at?: string | null;
}

export interface IChatReadDmThreadLike {
  dmCode?: string | null;
  threadId?: string | null;
  requesterId?: string | null;
  requesterName?: string | null;
  targetId?: string | null;
  targetName?: string | null;
  status?: string | null;
  updatedAt?: string | null;
  messages?: IChatReadMessageLike[] | null;
}

export interface IChatReadTeamLike {
  id?: string | null;
  nombre?: string | null;
  codigo_invitacion?: string | null;
  disciplina?: string | null;
  creador_id?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
  updated_at?: string | null;
}

export interface ICanonicalChatUnreadTruth {
  unreadByRoomKey: Record<string, number>;
  totalUnreadMessages: number;
  incomingPendingDmCount: number;
  pendingTeamInvitesCount: number;
  bellChatUnreadCount: number;
  messagesTotalUnreadCount: number;
  bellBadgeCount: number;
  messagesBadgeCount: number;
}

const normSlug = (raw?: unknown): string =>
  String(raw ?? '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '').trim();

const hasSafeOwn = (obj: unknown, key: string): boolean =>
  Boolean(obj && typeof obj === 'object' && !PROTO_KEYS.has(key) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, key));

export const parseChatTimestampMs = (raw: unknown): number => {
  if (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0) return raw;
  const parsed = Date.parse(String(raw ?? '').trim());
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0;
};

export const resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey = (peerId?: string | null, dmCode?: string | null): string => {
  const cleanPeer = String(peerId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (UUID_RE.test(cleanPeer)) return `dm:peer:${cleanPeer}`;
  const cleanCode = String(dmCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return cleanCode ? `dm:${cleanCode}` : 'dm:unknown';
};

export const resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey = (equipoId?: string | null): string => {
  const cleanId = String(equipoId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return cleanId ? `sq:${cleanId}` : 'sq:unknown';
};

const isMessageFromSelf = (msg: IChatReadMessageLike, myUidLow: string, myNameSlug: string): boolean => {
  const sId = String(msg.senderId || msg.usuario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (sId === 'me') return true;
  if (myUidLow && sId && sId === myUidLow) return true;
  const sSlug = normSlug(msg.senderName || msg.usuario_nombre);
  return Boolean(!sId && myNameSlug && sSlug && sSlug === myNameSlug);
};

export function deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages<T extends IChatReadMessageLike>(messages: readonly T[]): T[] {
  const byKey = new Map<string, T>();
  for (const item of messages || []) {
    if (!item) continue;
    const text = String(item.text ?? item.mensaje ?? item.contenido ?? '').trim();
    if (!text) continue;
    const idStr = String(item.id || '').trim();
    const clientId = String(item.clientMsgId || item.client_msg_id || '').trim();
    const senderSlug = String(item.senderId || item.usuario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase() || normSlug(item.senderName || item.usuario_nombre);
    const tsMs = parseChatTimestampMs(item.createdAt || item.created_at);
    let matchedKey = '';
    for (const [k, existing] of byKey.entries()) {
      const exId = String(existing.id || '').trim();
      const exClient = String(existing.clientMsgId || existing.client_msg_id || '').trim();
      if ((idStr && exId === idStr) || (clientId && exClient && clientId === exClient)) {
        matchedKey = k;
        break;
      }
      const exText = String(existing.text ?? existing.mensaje ?? existing.contenido ?? '').trim();
      const exSender = String(existing.senderId || existing.usuario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase() || normSlug(existing.senderName || existing.usuario_nombre);
      const exTs = parseChatTimestampMs(existing.createdAt || existing.created_at);
      if (exText === text && exSender === senderSlug && Math.abs(tsMs - exTs) <= 15_000) {
        matchedKey = k;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!matchedKey) {
      byKey.set(idStr || clientId || `msg_${byKey.size}_${tsMs}`, item);
      continue;
    }
    const prev = byKey.get(matchedKey)!;
    const mergedReadAt = item.leidoAt || item.leido_at || prev.leidoAt || prev.leido_at || null;
    const preferIncoming = Boolean(idStr && !idStr.startsWith('dm_') && !idStr.startsWith('msg_') && String(prev.id || '').match(/^(dm_|msg_)/));
    const merged: T = { ...(preferIncoming ? item : prev), ...(mergedReadAt ? { leidoAt: mergedReadAt, leido_at: mergedReadAt } : {}) };
    byKey.set(matchedKey, merged);
  }
  return Array.from(byKey.values()).sort(
    (a, b) => parseChatTimestampMs(a.createdAt || a.created_at) - parseChatTimestampMs(b.createdAt || b.created_at)
  );
}

export function computeRoomUnreadCountByLastReadAt(params: {
  messages: readonly IChatReadMessageLike[];
  lastReadAt?: string | number | null;
  myUserId?: string | null;
  myUserName?: string | null;
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
}): number {
  const lastReadMs = parseChatTimestampMs(params.lastReadAt);
  const myUidLow = String(params.myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myNameSlug = normSlug(params.myUserName);
  const blocked = params.blockedIds;
  let unread = 0;

  for (const msg of params.messages || []) {
    if (!msg) continue;
    const text = String(msg.text ?? msg.mensaje ?? msg.contenido ?? '').trim();
    const sId = String(msg.senderId || msg.usuario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!text || sId === 'system' || isMessageFromSelf(msg, myUidLow, myNameSlug)) continue;
    if (blocked && sId && blocked.has(sId)) continue;
    if (msg.leidoAt || msg.leido_at) continue;
    const msgMs = parseChatTimestampMs(msg.createdAt || msg.created_at);
    if (msgMs > lastReadMs) unread += 1;
  }
  return unread;
}

export function lookupLastReadAtValue(
  lastReadAtMap: Record<string, string | number> | null | undefined,
  keys: readonly string[]
): number {
  if (!lastReadAtMap || typeof lastReadAtMap !== 'object') return 0;
  let best = 0;
  for (const rawKey of keys) {
    const k = String(rawKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!k || !hasSafeOwn(lastReadAtMap, k)) continue;
    const ms = parseChatTimestampMs(lastReadAtMap[k]);
    if (ms > best) best = ms;
  }
  return best;
}

export function computeCanonicalChatUnreadTruth(params: {
  dmThreads?: readonly IChatReadDmThreadLike[] | null;
  misEquipos?: readonly IChatReadTeamLike[] | null;
  squadRoomsMessagesMap?: Record<string, readonly IChatReadMessageLike[]> | null;
  lastReadAtMap?: Record<string, string | number> | null;
  deletedDmCodes?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  blockedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  restrictedIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  pendingTeamInvites?: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] | null;
  unseenWallCommentsCount?: number;
  pendingSplitInvitesCount?: number;
  myUserId?: string | null;
  myUserName?: string | null;
}): ICanonicalChatUnreadTruth {
  const myUidLow = String(params.myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myNameSlug = normSlug(params.myUserName);
  const unreadByRoomKey: Record<string, number> = Object.create(null);
  let incomingPendingDmCount = 0;

  for (const dm of params.dmThreads || []) {
    const dmCode = String(dm?.dmCode || dm?.threadId || '').trim();
    const dmLow = dmCode.toLowerCase();
    if (!dmLow || params.deletedDmCodes?.has(dmLow)) continue;
    const reqLow = String(dm.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const tgtLow = String(dm.targetId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const iAmReq = (myUidLow && reqLow === myUidLow) || (!reqLow && normSlug(dm.requesterName) === myNameSlug);
    const iAmTgt = (myUidLow && tgtLow === myUidLow) || (!tgtLow && normSlug(dm.targetName) === myNameSlug);
    if (!iAmReq && !iAmTgt) continue;
    const peerLow = iAmReq ? tgtLow : reqLow;
    if (peerLow && (peerLow === myUidLow || params.blockedIds?.has(peerLow) || params.restrictedIds?.has(peerLow))) continue;
    if (dm.status === 'pending' && !iAmReq) {
      incomingPendingDmCount += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const roomKey = resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey(peerLow, dmCode);
    const lastReadMs = lookupLastReadAtValue(params.lastReadAtMap, [roomKey, `dm:${dmLow}`, dmLow]);
    const deduped = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages(dm.messages || []);
    const unread = computeRoomUnreadCountByLastReadAt({
      messages: deduped,
      lastReadAt: lastReadMs,
      myUserId: myUidLow,
      myUserName: params.myUserName,
      blockedIds: params.blockedIds,
    });
    unreadByRoomKey[roomKey] = Math.max(unreadByRoomKey[roomKey] || 0, unread);
  }

  for (const sq of params.misEquipos || []) {
    const sqId = String(sq?.id || '').trim();
    const codeUp = String(sq?.codigo_invitacion || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const discUp = String(sq?.disciplina || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!sqId || codeUp.startsWith('DM-') || codeUp === 'STORIES-V25' || discUp === 'DM_1A1' || discUp === 'STORIES_24H') continue;
    const roomKey = resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey(sqId);
    const rawMsgs = params.squadRoomsMessagesMap && hasSafeOwn(params.squadRoomsMessagesMap, sqId) ? params.squadRoomsMessagesMap[sqId] : [];
    const lastReadMs = lookupLastReadAtValue(params.lastReadAtMap, [roomKey, sqId.toLowerCase()]);
    const deduped = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages(rawMsgs || []);
    unreadByRoomKey[roomKey] = computeRoomUnreadCountByLastReadAt({
      messages: deduped,
      lastReadAt: lastReadMs,
      myUserId: myUidLow,
      myUserName: params.myUserName,
      blockedIds: params.blockedIds,
    });
  }

  const totalUnreadMessages = Object.values(unreadByRoomKey).reduce((acc, n) => acc + n, 0);
  const pendingTeamInvitesCount = Array.isArray(params.pendingTeamInvites)
    ? params.pendingTeamInvites.filter((inv) => {
        const actor = String(inv?.creador_id || inv?.invitado_por_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        return !actor || !params.blockedIds?.has(actor);
      }).length
    : 0;
  const nonChatCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(params.unseenWallCommentsCount) || 0))
    + Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(params.pendingSplitInvitesCount) || 0));

  return {
    unreadByRoomKey,
    totalUnreadMessages,
    incomingPendingDmCount,
    pendingTeamInvitesCount,
    bellChatUnreadCount: totalUnreadMessages,
    messagesTotalUnreadCount: totalUnreadMessages,
    bellBadgeCount: totalUnreadMessages + incomingPendingDmCount + pendingTeamInvitesCount + nonChatCount,
    messagesBadgeCount: totalUnreadMessages + incomingPendingDmCount + pendingTeamInvitesCount,
  };
}

export function isOwnMessageSeenByPeer(params: {
  isMine: boolean;
  msgCreatedAt?: string | null;
  msgLeidoAt?: string | null;
  peerLastReadAt?: string | number | null;
}): boolean {
  if (!params.isMine) return false;
  if (params.msgLeidoAt) return true;
  const msgMs = parseChatTimestampMs(params.msgCreatedAt);
  const peerReadMs = parseChatTimestampMs(params.peerLastReadAt);
  return msgMs > 0 && peerReadMs >= msgMs;
}

export function translateChatSystemNoticeDynamic(rawText?: string | null, lang: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'): string {
  const clean = String(rawText || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  const isEn = lang === 'en';
  const esCanonical = clean
    .replace(/\bEscuadrones\b/gi, 'Equipos')
    .replace(/\bEscuadr[óo]n\b/gi, 'Equipo')
    .replace(/\bSquads\b/gi, 'Teams')
    .replace(/\bSquad\b/gi, 'Team');

  let m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ Canal t[áa]ctico activo para (.+?)\.\s*Coordina aqu[íi] tus entrenamientos grupales\.$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ Tactical channel active for ${m[1]}. Coordinate your group workouts here.` : esCanonical;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ Tactical channel active for (.+?)\.\s*Coordinate your group workouts here\.$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? esCanonical : `⚡ Canal táctico activo para ${m[1]}. Coordina aquí tus entrenamientos grupales.`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^📩 Invitaci[óo]n enviada a (.+?) \(Pendiente de aceptaci[óo]n\)\.$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `📩 Invitation sent to ${m[1]} (Pending acceptance).` : esCanonical;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^📩 Invitation sent to (.+?) \(Pending acceptance\)\.$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? esCanonical : `📩 Invitación enviada a ${m[1]} (Pendiente de aceptación).`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ ¡?(.+?) se uni[óo] al (?:equipo|team) mediante c[óo]digo de invitaci[óo]n!?$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ ${m[1]} joined the team via invite code!` : `⚡ ¡${m[1]} se unió al equipo mediante código de invitación!`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ (.+?) joined the (?:team|equipo) via invite code!$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ ${m[1]} joined the team via invite code!` : `⚡ ¡${m[1]} se unió al equipo mediante código de invitación!`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ ¡?(.+?) acept[óo] la invitaci[óo]n y se integr[óo] al (?:equipo|team)!?$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ ${m[1]} accepted the invite and joined the team!` : `⚡ ¡${m[1]} aceptó la invitación y se integró al equipo!`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ (.+?) accepted the invite and joined the (?:team|equipo)!$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ ${m[1]} accepted the invite and joined the team!` : `⚡ ¡${m[1]} aceptó la invitación y se integró al equipo!`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ (.+?) sali[óo] del (?:equipo|team)\.$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ ${m[1]} left the team.` : `⚡ ${m[1]} salió del equipo.`;

  m = esCanonical.match(/^⚡ (.+?) left the (?:team|equipo)\.$/i);
  if (m) return isEn ? `⚡ ${m[1]} left the team.` : `⚡ ${m[1]} salió del equipo.`;

  return isEn
    ? esCanonical.replace(/\bEquipos\b/g, 'Teams').replace(/\bEquipo\b/g, 'Team')
    : esCanonical.replace(/\bTeams\b/g, 'Equipos').replace(/\bTeam\b/g, 'Equipo');
}

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { sanitizeExternalLinkUrl } from '../utils/externalLinks';
import {
  decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array,
  encodeUint8ArrayToBase64,
  StorageImageMime,
  validateSafeStorageImagePayload,
} from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';
import { sha256HexSync } from './terminalSpeiAndStudioService';

export type FinOpsAiTask = 'b2b_digitizer' | 'b2c_coach_match' | 'catalog_seeder';
export type RpgAttributeKey = 'Fuerza' | 'Zen' | 'Resistencia' | 'Agilidad';
export type ExternalMapsProvider = 'google_maps' | 'waze';

export interface IDigitizedB2BServiceItem {
  nombre_servicio: string; disciplina: string; fecha: string; hora_inicio: string;
  duracion_minutos: number; cupo_maximo: number; precio_kc: number; frecuencia: string; ubicacion: string; descripcion: string;
}
export interface IDigitizeB2BScheduleInput {
  scheduleText?: string; clubName?: string; imageBase64?: string; imageMimeType?: string;
}
export interface IDigitizeB2BScheduleData {
  negocio_detectado: string; notas: string; servicios: IDigitizedB2BServiceItem[];
}
export interface ICoachMatchInput {
  disciplina?: string; atributo_rpg?: RpgAttributeKey; objetivo?: string; nivel?: string; duracion_min?: number;
}
export interface ICoachMatchRoutineItem {
  slug: string; nombre_es: string; nombre_en: string; series_repeticiones: string; indicacion_es?: string; indicacion_en?: string;
}
export interface ICoachMatchData {

  recuperacion_es: string; recuperacion_en: string; rutina_sugerida: ICoachMatchRoutineItem[];
}
export interface ICatalogSeederInput { count?: number; disciplina?: string; }
export interface IWriteOnceGeoCheckInput {
  ubicacion?: string | null; existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null; prevUbicacion?: string | null;
}
export interface IResolvedGeoResult {
  latitude: number; longitude: number; place_id: string; formatted_address: string; cached: boolean;
}
export interface IExternalMapsUrlInput {
  latitude?: number | null; longitude?: number | null; label?: string | null; placeId?: string | null; provider?: ExternalMapsProvider;
}
export interface IBase64ImageValidationResult {
  ok: boolean; mimeType?: StorageImageMime; byteLength: number; cleanBase64?: string; reason?: string;
}
export interface IAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch {
  place_id?: string | null; formatted_address?: string | null; geo_verified_at?: string | null; latitud?: number; longitud?: number;
}
export interface IServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch {
  place_id?: string | null; formatted_address?: string | null; geo_verified_at?: string | null;
}
export interface ICloudAiResponse<TData> {
  ok: boolean; cached: boolean; cache_key?: string | null; data?: TData; quota?: Record<string, unknown>; error?: string;
}

export const MAX_B2B_DIGITIZER_IMAGE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const UUID_STRICT_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const GENERIC_GEO_LABELS = new Set([
  'ubicacion verificada', 'ubicación verificada', 'por definir', 'online', 'sin direccion', 'sin dirección', 'mexico', 'méxico',
]);

const normalizeAddressText = (raw?: string | null): string =>
  String(raw || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

function normalizeCanonicalValue(val: unknown): unknown {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  if (typeof val === 'number') return Number.isFinite(val) ? (Object.is(val, -0) ? 0 : val) : 0;
  if (typeof val === 'boolean') return val;
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return val.map((item) => normalizeCanonicalValue(item));
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [key, entryVal] of Object.entries(val as Record<string, unknown>).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
      if (entryVal !== undefined) out[key] = normalizeCanonicalValue(entryVal);
    }
    return out;
  }
  return String(val);
}

export function buildCanonicalFinOpsHashInput(task: FinOpsAiTask, payload: unknown, version = 'v1'): string {
  const cleanVersion = String(version || 'v1').trim() || 'v1';
  return JSON.stringify({ task, version: cleanVersion, payload: normalizeCanonicalValue(payload ?? {}) });
}

export function computeCanonicalFinOpsCacheKey(task: FinOpsAiTask, payload: unknown, version = 'v1'): string {
  const cleanVersion = String(version || 'v1').trim() || 'v1';
  return `${task}:${cleanVersion}:${sha256HexSync(buildCanonicalFinOpsHashInput(task, payload, cleanVersion))}`;
}

export function quantizeServicePriceToTenKc(rawKc: unknown): number {
  const num = Number(rawKc);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(Math.min(num, 10_000_000) / 10) * 10);
}

export function clampB2BServiceCapacity(raw: unknown): number {
  const num = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.min(50, Math.max(1, Math.round(num))) : 10;
}

export function clampB2BServiceDurationMinutes(raw: unknown): number {
  const num = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.min(240, Math.max(15, Math.round(num))) : 60;
}

export function validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(base64Input: unknown, mimeType?: unknown): IBase64ImageValidationResult {
  const raw = typeof base64Input === 'string' ? base64Input.trim() : '';
  if (!raw) return { ok: false, byteLength: 0, reason: 'empty_payload' };
  const isDataUri = /^data:/i.test(raw);
  const declaredMime = typeof mimeType === 'string' ? mimeType.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const b64Body = isDataUri ? raw.slice(raw.indexOf(',') + 1) : raw;
  if (b64Body.length > 5_592_416 && b64Body.replace(/[\r\n\t ]+/g, '').length > 5_592_412) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: MAX_B2B_DIGITIZER_IMAGE_BYTES + 1, reason: 'file_too_large' };
  }
  const bytes = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(raw);
  if (!bytes) return { ok: false, byteLength: 0, reason: 'invalid_base64' };
  const safeCheck = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({
    bytes,
    uriOrName: isDataUri ? raw : undefined,
    declaredMime: declaredMime || undefined,
    maxBytes: MAX_B2B_DIGITIZER_IMAGE_BYTES,
  });
  if (!safeCheck.ok || !safeCheck.contentType) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: safeCheck.byteLength, reason: safeCheck.reason || 'invalid_image' };
  }
  return { ok: true, mimeType: safeCheck.contentType, byteLength: safeCheck.byteLength, cleanBase64: encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(bytes) };
}

export function shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver(input: IWriteOnceGeoCheckInput): boolean {
  const normUbicacion = normalizeAddressText(input.ubicacion);
  if (normUbicacion.length < 5 || GENERIC_GEO_LABELS.has(normUbicacion)) return false;
  const hasPlaceId = Boolean(String(input.existingPlaceId || '').trim());
  const hasVerifiedAt = Boolean(String(input.existingGeoVerifiedAt || '').trim());
  if (hasPlaceId && hasVerifiedAt) {
    const normPrev = normalizeAddressText(input.prevUbicacion);
    if (!normPrev || normPrev === normUbicacion) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function parseStrictCoord(val: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof val === 'boolean' || val === null || val === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '') return null;
  const n = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

export function isValidGeoCoordPair(lat: unknown, lng: unknown): boolean {
  const nLat = parseStrictCoord(lat);
  const nLng = parseStrictCoord(lng);
  return nLat !== null && nLng !== null && nLat >= -90 && nLat <= 90 && nLng >= -180 && nLng <= 180 && !(nLat === 0 && nLng === 0);
}

export function isMissingColumnPostgrestError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const msg = String((err as { message?: string } | null)?.message || err || '');
  return /Could not find the '[^']+' column|column "[^"]+" of relation/i.test(msg);
}

export function buildExternalMapsNavigationUrl(input: IExternalMapsUrlInput): string | null {
  const lat = parseStrictCoord(input.latitude);
  const lng = parseStrictCoord(input.longitude);
  const hasCoords = isValidGeoCoordPair(lat, lng);
  const cleanLabel = String(input.label || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 180);
  const cleanPlaceId = String(input.placeId || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 120);
  if (!hasCoords && !cleanLabel) return null;

  let rawUrl = '';
  if (input.provider === 'waze') {
    rawUrl = hasCoords
      ? `https://waze.com/ul?ll=${(lat as number).toFixed(6)},${(lng as number).toFixed(6)}&navigate=yes`
      : `https://waze.com/ul?q=${encodeURIComponent(cleanLabel)}&navigate=yes`;
  } else {
    const queryTarget = hasCoords ? `${(lat as number).toFixed(6)},${(lng as number).toFixed(6)}` : cleanLabel;
    rawUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(queryTarget)}`;
    if (cleanPlaceId) rawUrl += `&query_place_id=${encodeURIComponent(cleanPlaceId)}`;
  }
  const sanitized = sanitizeExternalLinkUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!sanitized) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(sanitized);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return null;
    if (parsed.hostname !== 'www.google.com' && parsed.hostname !== 'waze.com') return null;
    return sanitized;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function invokeEdgeJson<TData>(fnName: string, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<TData>> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(fnName, { body });
    if (error || !data || typeof data !== 'object') {
      return { ok: false, cached: false, error: error?.message || 'EDGE_INVOKE_UNAVAILABLE' };
    }
    const payload = data as Partial<ICloudAiResponse<TData>>;
    return {
      ok: Boolean(payload.ok),
      cached: Boolean(payload.cached),
      cache_key: payload.cache_key ?? null,
      data: payload.data,
      quota: payload.quota,
      error: payload.error,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return { ok: false, cached: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'EDGE_NETWORK_ERROR' };
  }
}

export async function digitizeB2BScheduleCloud(input: IDigitizeB2BScheduleInput): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<IDigitizeB2BScheduleData>> {
  const scheduleText = String(input.scheduleText || '').trim();
  let safeImg: IBase64ImageValidationResult | null = null;
  if (input.imageBase64) {
    safeImg = validateB2BDigitizerBase64Image(input.imageBase64, input.imageMimeType);
    if (!safeImg.ok || !safeImg.cleanBase64 || !safeImg.mimeType) {
      return { ok: false, cached: false, error: safeImg.reason || 'INVALID_OR_UNSAFE_IMAGE' };
    }
  }
  if (!scheduleText && !safeImg) return { ok: false, cached: false, error: 'EMPTY_DIGITIZER_INPUT' };
  const resp = await invokeEdgeJson<IDigitizeB2BScheduleData>('kinetic-ai-engine', {
    task: 'b2b_digitizer',
    scheduleText,
    clubName: String(input.clubName || '').trim(),
    ...(safeImg ? { imageBase64: safeImg.cleanBase64, imageMimeType: safeImg.mimeType } : {}),
  });
  if (!resp.ok || !resp.data) return resp;
  return {
    ...resp,
    data: {
      ...resp.data,
      servicios: (Array.isArray(resp.data.servicios) ? resp.data.servicios : []).map((s) => ({
        ...s,
        precio_kc: quantizeServicePriceToTenKc(s.precio_kc),
        cupo_maximo: clampB2BServiceCapacity(s.cupo_maximo),
        duracion_minutos: clampB2BServiceDurationMinutes(s.duracion_minutos),
      })),
    },
  };
}

export async function requestKineticCoachMatchCloud(input: ICoachMatchInput): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<ICoachMatchData>> {
  return invokeEdgeJson<ICoachMatchData>('kinetic-ai-engine', {
    task: 'b2c_coach_match',
    disciplina: String(input.disciplina || '').trim(),
    atributo_rpg: input.atributo_rpg,
    objetivo: String(input.objetivo || '').trim(),
    nivel: String(input.nivel || '').trim(),
    duracion_min: Number(input.duracion_min) || 45,
  });
}

export async function seedKineticExerciseCatalogCloud(input: ICatalogSeederInput): Promise<ICloudAiResponse<{ inserted_or_updated: number }>> {
  return invokeEdgeJson<{ inserted_or_updated: number }>('kinetic-ai-engine', {
    task: 'catalog_seeder',
    count: Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(input.count) || 5))),
    disciplina: String(input.disciplina || '').trim(),
  });
}

export async function resolveWriteOnceGeoCloud(ubicacion: string): Promise<IResolvedGeoResult | null> {
  if (!shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion })) return null;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('kinetic-geo-resolver', { body: { address: ubicacion.trim() } });
    if (error || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return null;
    const raw = data as Partial<IResolvedGeoResult & { ok?: boolean }>;
    const lat = parseStrictCoord(raw.latitude);
    const lng = parseStrictCoord(raw.longitude);
    if (!raw.ok || typeof raw.place_id !== 'string' || !raw.place_id.trim() || !isValidGeoCoordPair(lat, lng)) return null;
    return {
      latitude: lat as number,
      longitude: lng as number,
      place_id: raw.place_id.trim(),
      formatted_address: typeof raw.formatted_address === 'string' && raw.formatted_address.trim() ? raw.formatted_address.trim() : ubicacion.trim(),
      cached: Boolean(raw.cached),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function resolveTableWriteOnceGeoPatch(opts: {
  table: 'afiliados' | 'servicios'; lookupCol: 'id' | 'propietario_id' | ''; lookupVal: string;
  ubicacion: string; existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null;
  prevUbicacion?: string | null; includeCoords: boolean;
}): Promise<IAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch> {
  const normUbicacion = normalizeAddressText(opts.ubicacion);
  if (!normUbicacion) return {};
  let { existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt, prevUbicacion } = opts;
  if ((!existingPlaceId || !existingGeoVerifiedAt || !prevUbicacion) && opts.lookupCol && opts.lookupVal) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from(opts.table).select('ubicacion, place_id, geo_verified_at').eq(opts.lookupCol, opts.lookupVal).limit(1).maybeSingle();
      if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
        const row = data as Record<string, unknown>;
        if (!existingPlaceId && typeof row.place_id === 'string') existingPlaceId = row.place_id;
        if (!existingGeoVerifiedAt && typeof row.geo_verified_at === 'string') existingGeoVerifiedAt = row.geo_verified_at;
        if (!prevUbicacion && typeof row.ubicacion === 'string') prevUbicacion = row.ubicacion;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  const hadVerifiedGeo = Boolean(String(existingPlaceId || '').trim() || String(existingGeoVerifiedAt || '').trim());
  const normPrev = normalizeAddressText(prevUbicacion);
  const addressChanged = Boolean(normPrev && normPrev !== normUbicacion);
  if (!shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: opts.ubicacion, existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt, prevUbicacion })) {
    const becameInvalidOrGeneric = !shouldInvokeWriteOnceGeoResolver({ ubicacion: opts.ubicacion });
    return becameInvalidOrGeneric && hadVerifiedGeo && addressChanged ? { place_id: null, formatted_address: null, geo_verified_at: null } : {};
  }
  const geo = await resolveWriteOnceGeoCloud(opts.ubicacion);
  if (!geo) return hadVerifiedGeo && (!normPrev || addressChanged) ? { place_id: null, formatted_address: null, geo_verified_at: null } : {};
  const basePatch: IServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch = { place_id: geo.place_id, formatted_address: geo.formatted_address, geo_verified_at: new Date().toISOString() };
  return opts.includeCoords ? { ...basePatch, latitud: geo.latitude, longitud: geo.longitude } : basePatch;
}

export async function resolveAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch(params: {
  affiliateId?: string | null; ownerUserId?: string | null; ubicacion: string;
  existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null; prevUbicacion?: string | null;
}): Promise<IAffiliateWriteOnceGeoPatch> {
  const affId = String(params.affiliateId || '').trim();
  const ownerId = String(params.ownerUserId || '').trim();
  const lookupCol = UUID_STRICT_RE.test(affId) ? 'id' : UUID_STRICT_RE.test(ownerId) ? 'propietario_id' : '';
  const lookupVal = lookupCol === 'id' ? affId : lookupCol === 'propietario_id' ? ownerId : '';
  return resolveTableWriteOnceGeoPatch({
    table: 'afiliados', lookupCol, lookupVal, ubicacion: params.ubicacion,
    existingPlaceId: params.existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt: params.existingGeoVerifiedAt,
    prevUbicacion: params.prevUbicacion, includeCoords: true,
  });
}

export async function resolveServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch(params: {
  serviceId?: string | null; ubicacion: string; existingPlaceId?: string | null; existingGeoVerifiedAt?: string | null; prevUbicacion?: string | null;
}): Promise<IServiceWriteOnceGeoPatch> {
  const sid = String(params.serviceId || '').trim();
  const lookupCol = UUID_STRICT_RE.test(sid) ? 'id' : '';
  return resolveTableWriteOnceGeoPatch({
    table: 'servicios', lookupCol, lookupVal: lookupCol ? sid : '', ubicacion: params.ubicacion,
    existingPlaceId: params.existingPlaceId, existingGeoVerifiedAt: params.existingGeoVerifiedAt,
    prevUbicacion: params.prevUbicacion, includeCoords: false,
  });
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

import {
  deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages,
  parseChatTimestampMs,
  resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey,
  resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey,
} from './kineticChatReadTruthLeaf';
import {
  IDirectMessageItem, IDirectMessageThread, areDmTimestampsClose, buildDeterministicDmCode, canInitiateOrHydrateDm,
  extractPeerUuidFromDmCode, filterAntiZombieDmThreads, isGenericPlaceholderName,
  isMasterAdminChatIdentity, isStrictDmParticipant, isUuid, matchesUserIdentity,
  mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap, normalizeChatIdentity, resolveOfficialChatDisplayName, resolvePeerUuidForThread,
} from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import {
  CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS, DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY, DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY, DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX,
  getChatLastReadMapSync, getDmCacheSnapshotState, getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot, getPeerLastReadMapSync,
  getScopedDmStorageKey, getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot, hydrateMissingDmPeerProfiles, injectInstantDmBroadcastMessage,
  injectInstantSquadBroadcastMessage, invalidateDirectMessagesCache, loadDeletedDmMap, loadLocalDmThreads,
  loadPersistedChatReadsMap, markChatRoomLastReadLocal, markDmDeletedLocally, markDmSeenCountInStorage,
  markPeerLastReadLocal, mergeChatLastReadMap, resolveStrictDmUserId, setDmCacheIdentityKey, setDmThreadsCache,
  setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot,
} from './kineticDmMemoryStore';
import { emitSquadsDataChanged } from './kineticlubSquadsDeterministicEngine';
import { td } from './kineticlubHelpers';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet, hydrateUgcModerationState, isUserBlockedUgc } from './kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import {
  broadcastInstantChatMessage,
  broadcastInstantChatRead,
  subscribeInstantChatEvents,
} from './kineticlubWallRealtimeHelper';

export {
  buildDeterministicDmCode, canInitiateOrHydrateDm, DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY, DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY,
  DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX, extractPeerUuidFromDmCode, filterAntiZombieDmThreads, getChatLastReadMapSync,
  getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot, getPeerLastReadMapSync, getScopedDmStorageKey, getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot,
  injectInstantDmBroadcastMessage, injectInstantSquadBroadcastMessage, invalidateDirectMessagesCache,
  isGenericPlaceholderName, isMasterAdminChatIdentity, isStrictDmParticipant, isUuid, loadLocalDmThreads,
  markDmDeletedLocally, markDmSeenCountInStorage, markPeerLastReadLocal, matchesUserIdentity, normalizeChatIdentity,
  resolveOfficialChatDisplayName, resolvePeerUuidForThread, resolveStrictDmUserId, setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot,
  subscribeInstantChatEvents,
};
export type { IDirectMessageItem, IDirectMessageThread };

const STORY_BASE64_PREFIX_FILTER = '__KINETIC_STORY_V25__%';
let _dmSyncInflight: Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> | null = null;
let _readsSyncInflight: Promise<Record<string, string>> | null = null;
let _lastReadsSyncTs = 0;

export async function syncChatReadsFromCloud(uid?: string | null): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const cleanUid = String(uid || '').trim();
  if (!isUuid(cleanUid)) return getChatLastReadMapSync(cleanUid);
  if (_readsSyncInflight && Date.now() - _lastReadsSyncTs < 2000) return _readsSyncInflight;
  _lastReadsSyncTs = Date.now();
  _readsSyncInflight = (async () => {
    await loadPersistedChatReadsMap(cleanUid);
    const cloudMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    try {
      const [readsRes, memberReadsRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('kinetic_chat_reads').select('room_key, last_read_at').eq('usuario_id', cleanUid).limit(120),
        supabase.from('equipo_miembros').select('equipo_id, last_read_at').eq('usuario_id', cleanUid).not('last_read_at', 'is', null).limit(60),
      ]);
      for (const row of (readsRes.data || []) as Array<{ room_key?: string; last_read_at?: string }>) {
        if (row?.room_key && row?.last_read_at) cloudMap[String(row.room_key).toLowerCase()] = String(row.last_read_at);
      }
      for (const row of (memberReadsRes.data || []) as Array<{ equipo_id?: string; last_read_at?: string }>) {
        if (row?.equipo_id && row?.last_read_at) {
          cloudMap[resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey(row.equipo_id)] = String(row.last_read_at);
        }
      }
      mergeChatLastReadMap(cleanUid, cloudMap);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    } finally {
      _readsSyncInflight = null;
    }
    return getChatLastReadMapSync(cleanUid);
  })();
  return _readsSyncInflight;
}

export async function markChatRoomReadEverywhere(params: {
  uid?: string | null;
  roomKey: string;
  roomKind: 'dm' | 'team';
  equipoId?: string | null;
  peerId?: string | null;
  dmCode?: string | null;
}): Promise<string> {
  const cleanUid = String(params.uid || '').trim();
  const cleanRoomKey = String(params.roomKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  if (!cleanUid || !cleanRoomKey) return nowIso;
  markChatRoomLastReadLocal(cleanUid, cleanRoomKey, nowIso);
  if (params.dmCode) markChatRoomLastReadLocal(cleanUid, `dm:${String(params.dmCode).trim().toLowerCase()}`, nowIso);
  if (params.equipoId) markChatRoomLastReadLocal(cleanUid, resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey(params.equipoId), nowIso);
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  if (isUuid(cleanUid)) {
    const pEquipo = params.equipoId && isUuid(params.equipoId) ? params.equipoId : null;
    const pPeer = params.peerId && isUuid(params.peerId) ? params.peerId : null;
    await Promise.allSettled([
      broadcastInstantChatRead({
        readerId: cleanUid,
        roomKey: cleanRoomKey,
        roomKind: params.roomKind,
        equipoId: pEquipo,
        peerId: pPeer,
        readAtIso: nowIso,
      }),
      supabase.rpc('marcar_chat_leido_v286', {
        p_room_key: cleanRoomKey,
        p_room_kind: params.roomKind,
        p_equipo_id: pEquipo,
        p_peer_id: pPeer,
      }),
    ]);
  }
  return nowIso;
}

function foldDirectMsgsIntoMap(
  rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  byCode: Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>,
  effectiveUid: string,
  myDisplay: string
): void {
  const uidLow = effectiveUid.toLowerCase();
  [...rows].reverse().forEach((dm) => {
    const sId = String(dm.sender_id || '').trim();
    const rId = String(dm.recipient_id || '').trim();
    const txt = String(dm.mensaje || '').trim();
    if (!txt || !canInitiateOrHydrateDm(sId, rId, effectiveUid)) return;
    const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
    const sName = sId.toLowerCase() === uidLow ? myDisplay : resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: sId, fallback: fb });
    const rName = rId.toLowerCase() === uidLow ? myDisplay : resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: rId, fallback: fb });
    const createdTs = String(dm.created_at || new Date().toISOString());
    const leidoAtIso = dm.leido_at ? String(dm.leido_at) : (dm.leido === true ? createdTs : null);
    const code = buildDeterministicDmCode(sId, sName, rId, rName);
    const thread = mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, {
      threadId: code, dmCode: code, requesterId: sId, requesterName: sName, requesterAvatar: null,
      targetId: rId, targetName: rName, targetAvatar: null, status: 'pending', updatedAt: createdTs, messages: [],
    });
    if (sId.toLowerCase() === String(thread.targetId || '').toLowerCase()) thread.status = 'accepted';
    if (sId.toLowerCase() === uidLow && leidoAtIso) {
      markPeerLastReadLocal(effectiveUid, resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey(rId, thread.dmCode), leidoAtIso);
      if (parseChatTimestampMs(leidoAtIso) > parseChatTimestampMs(thread.peerLastReadAt)) thread.peerLastReadAt = leidoAtIso;
    }
    thread.updatedAt = createdTs;
    const senderDisplay = sId.toLowerCase() === String(thread.requesterId || '').toLowerCase() ? thread.requesterName : thread.targetName;
    const dup = thread.messages.some((ex) => ex.id === String(dm.id) || (ex.senderId === sId && String(ex.text).trim() === txt && areDmTimestampsClose(ex.createdAt, createdTs)));
    if (!dup) {
      thread.messages = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages([
        ...thread.messages,
        { id: String(dm.id), senderId: sId, senderName: senderDisplay, text: txt, createdAt: createdTs, leidoAt: leidoAtIso },
      ]);
    }
  });
}

function foldDmTeamMsgsIntoMap(
  dmMsgs: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  dmTeamIdToCanonical: Map<string, string>,
  byCode: Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>
): void {
  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  [...dmMsgs].reverse().forEach((m) => {
    const code = dmTeamIdToCanonical.get(String(m.equipo_id));
    const thread = code ? byCode.get(code) : null;
    const mTxt = String(m.mensaje || '').trim();
    if (!thread || !mTxt) return;
    const mCreated = String(m.created_at || new Date().toISOString());
    const mSender = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: String(m.usuario_id || ''), name: String(m.usuario_nombre || ''), fallback: fb });
    if (matchesUserIdentity(String(m.usuario_id || ''), mSender, thread.targetId, thread.targetName)) thread.status = 'accepted';
    thread.updatedAt = mCreated;
    thread.messages = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages([
      ...thread.messages,
      { id: String(m.id), senderId: String(m.usuario_id || ''), senderName: mSender, text: mTxt, createdAt: mCreated },
    ]);
  });
}

export async function syncDirectMessagesFromCloud(
  myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null
): Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> {
  const effectiveUid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
  if (!effectiveUid) return [];

  const identityKey = `${effectiveUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName)}`;
  const cacheState = getDmCacheSnapshotState();
  if (cacheState.val && cacheState.key === identityKey && Date.now() - cacheState.ts < CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return cacheState.val;
  }
  if (_dmSyncInflight && cacheState.key === identityKey) return _dmSyncInflight;
  setDmCacheIdentityKey(identityKey);

  _dmSyncInflight = (async () => {
    try {
      await hydrateUgcModerationState(effectiveUid, false).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      const [deletedMap, localThreads] = await Promise.all([
        loadDeletedDmMap(effectiveUid),
        loadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, myUserName),
        syncChatReadsFromCloud(effectiveUid),
      ]);
      const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
      localThreads.forEach((t) => { mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t); });

      try {
        const safeNameToken = !isGenericPlaceholderName(myUserName) ? normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName).slice(0, 14).toUpperCase() : '';
        const teamOrClauses = [`creador_id.eq.${effectiveUid}`, `nombre.ilike.%${effectiveUid}%`, `codigo_invitacion.ilike.%${effectiveUid}%`];
        if (safeNameToken.length >= 3) teamOrClauses.push(`codigo_invitacion.ilike.DM-%${safeNameToken}%`);

        const [dmTeamsRes, directMsgsRes] = await Promise.all([
          supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id, nombre, disciplina, codigo_invitacion, creador_id, creador_nombre, created_at')
            .ilike('codigo_invitacion', 'DM-%').or(teamOrClauses.join(',')).limit(40),
          isUuid(effectiveUid)
            ? supabase.from('mensajes_directos').select('id, sender_id, recipient_id, mensaje, leido, leido_at, created_at')
                .or(`sender_id.eq.${effectiveUid},recipient_id.eq.${effectiveUid}`).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(80)
            : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> }),
        ]);

        const dmTeams = (Array.isArray(dmTeamsRes.data) ? dmTeamsRes.data : []) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        const dmTeamIdToCanonical = new Map<string, string>();
        dmTeams.forEach((row) => {
          const rawCode = String(row.codigo_invitacion || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          if (!rawCode.startsWith('DM-')) return;
          let meta: Record<string, string> = {};
          try { if (String(row.nombre || '').startsWith('{')) meta = JSON.parse(String(row.nombre)); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
          const reqId = String(meta.reqId || row.creador_id || '').trim();
          const reqName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: reqId, name: meta.reqName || String(row.creador_nombre || ''), fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
          const tgtId = String(meta.tgtId || '').trim();
          const tgtName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: tgtId, name: meta.tgtName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
          if (!isStrictDmParticipant(effectiveUid, myUserName, reqId, reqName, tgtId, tgtName)) return;
          const merged = mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, {
            threadId: rawCode, dmCode: rawCode, dbTeamId: String(row.id), legacyCodes: [rawCode],
            requesterId: reqId, requesterName: reqName, requesterAvatar: meta.reqAv || null,
            targetId: tgtId, targetName: tgtName, targetAvatar: meta.tgtAv || null,
            status: meta.st === 'accepted' ? 'accepted' : 'pending', updatedAt: String(row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()), messages: [],
          });
          dmTeamIdToCanonical.set(String(row.id), merged.dmCode);
        });

        const dmTeamIds = Array.from(dmTeamIdToCanonical.keys());
        if (dmTeamIds.length > 0) {
          const { data: dmMsgs } = await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').select('id, equipo_id, usuario_id, usuario_nombre, mensaje, created_at')
            .in('equipo_id', dmTeamIds).not('mensaje', 'ilike', STORY_BASE64_PREFIX_FILTER).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50);
          if (Array.isArray(dmMsgs)) foldDmTeamMsgsIntoMap(dmMsgs as Array<Record<string, unknown>>, dmTeamIdToCanonical, byCode);
        }

        if (Array.isArray(directMsgsRes.data) && directMsgsRes.data.length > 0) {
          const myDisplay = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: effectiveUid, name: myUserName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
          foldDirectMsgsIntoMap(directMsgsRes.data as Array<Record<string, unknown>>, byCode, effectiveUid, myDisplay);
        }
        await hydrateMissingDmPeerProfiles(byCode, effectiveUid);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        void err;
      }

      const strictResult = filterAntiZombieDmThreads(Array.from(byCode.values()), deletedMap, effectiveUid, myUserName, getBlockedUserIdsSet());
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(strictResult)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      setDmThreadsCache(identityKey, strictResult);
      return strictResult;
    } finally {
      _dmSyncInflight = null;
    }
  })();
  return _dmSyncInflight;
}

async function upsertCloudDmTeamRow(params: {
  dmCode: string;
  thread: IDirectMessageThread;
  effectiveUid: string;
}): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const { dmCode, thread, effectiveUid } = params;
  const safeReqAv = isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(thread.requesterAvatar) ? thread.requesterAvatar : null;
  const safeTgtAv = isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(thread.targetAvatar) ? thread.targetAvatar : null;
  const metaJson = JSON.stringify({
    reqId: thread.requesterId, reqName: thread.requesterName, reqAv: safeReqAv,
    tgtId: thread.targetId, tgtName: thread.targetName, tgtAv: safeTgtAv, st: thread.status,
  });
  let dbTeamId = thread.dbTeamId;
  if (!dbTeamId) {
    const codes = Array.from(new Set([dmCode, ...(thread.legacyCodes || [])]));
    const { data: rows } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id').in('codigo_invitacion', codes).limit(1);
    dbTeamId = Array.isArray(rows) && rows[0]?.id ? String(rows[0].id) : undefined;
  }
  if (dbTeamId) {
    await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').update({ nombre: metaJson, codigo_invitacion: dmCode }).eq('id', dbTeamId);
    return dbTeamId;
  }
  const insertPayload: Record<string, unknown> = { nombre: metaJson, disciplina: 'DM_1A1', codigo_invitacion: dmCode, cupo_maximo: 2, creador_nombre: thread.requesterName };
  if (isUuid(effectiveUid)) insertPayload.creador_id = effectiveUid;
  const { data: created } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').insert([insertPayload]).select('id').single();
  return created?.id ? String(created.id) : undefined;
}

export async function sendCloudDirectMessage(params: {
  senderId: string; senderName: string; senderAvatar?: string | null;
  targetId: string; targetName: string; targetAvatar?: string | null; text: string;
  existingThread?: IDirectMessageThread | null;
}): Promise<{ thread: IDirectMessageThread; isNewRequest: boolean }> {
  const effectiveUid = (await resolveStrictDmUserId(params.senderId)) || String(params.senderId || '').trim();
  const cleanTargetId = String(params.targetId || '').trim();
  if (!canInitiateOrHydrateDm(effectiveUid, cleanTargetId, effectiveUid, params.senderName, params.targetName)) {
    throw new Error('SELF_DM_FORBIDDEN: No puedes iniciar un chat 1 a 1 contigo mismo.');
  }
  if (isUserBlockedUgc(cleanTargetId)) throw new Error('BLOCKED_DM_FORBIDDEN: Usuario bloqueado.');

  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  const resolvedSenderName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: effectiveUid, name: params.senderName, fallback: fb });
  const resolvedTargetName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: cleanTargetId, name: params.targetName, fallback: fb });
  const diskThreads = await loadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName);
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  [...diskThreads, ...(getDmCacheSnapshotState().val || []), ...(params.existingThread ? [params.existingThread] : [])]
    .forEach((t) => { if (t) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb); });

  const dmCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, cleanTargetId, resolvedTargetName);
  const targetLow = cleanTargetId.toLowerCase(), meLow = effectiveUid.toLowerCase();
  let existing = byCode.get(dmCode.toUpperCase()) || Array.from(byCode.values()).find((t) =>
    t.dmCode.toUpperCase() === dmCode.toUpperCase() || t.threadId.toUpperCase() === dmCode.toUpperCase() ||
    Boolean(t.legacyCodes?.some((c) => c.toUpperCase() === dmCode.toUpperCase())) ||
    (isUuid(meLow) && isUuid(targetLow) && ((t.requesterId?.toLowerCase() === meLow && t.targetId?.toLowerCase() === targetLow) || (t.requesterId?.toLowerCase() === targetLow && t.targetId?.toLowerCase() === meLow)))
  );

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const clientMsgId = `dm_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
  const msgObj: IDirectMessageItem = {
    id: clientMsgId, clientMsgId, senderId: effectiveUid, senderName: resolvedSenderName, senderAvatar: params.senderAvatar || null,
    text: String(params.text || td('¡Hola! Entrenemos en equipo en Kinetic ⚡', "Hey! Let's train together on Kinetic ⚡")).trim(), createdAt: nowIso,
  };

  let isNewRequest = false;
  if (!existing) {
    isNewRequest = true;
    existing = {
      threadId: dmCode, dmCode, requesterId: msgObj.senderId, requesterName: resolvedSenderName, requesterAvatar: params.senderAvatar || null,
      targetId: cleanTargetId || resolvedTargetName, targetName: resolvedTargetName, targetAvatar: params.targetAvatar || null, status: 'pending', updatedAt: nowIso, messages: [msgObj],
    };
  } else {
    const prevKey = existing.dmCode;
    existing.dmCode = dmCode; existing.threadId = dmCode; existing.updatedAt = nowIso;
    if (!isGenericPlaceholderName(resolvedTargetName)) {
      if (matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, existing.requesterId, existing.requesterName)) existing.targetName = resolvedTargetName;
      else existing.requesterName = resolvedTargetName;
    }
    const hasTwoWayReplies = existing.messages.some((m) => String(m.senderId || '').toLowerCase() !== meLow);
    if (existing.status === 'accepted' || hasTwoWayReplies || matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, existing.targetId, existing.targetName)) {
      existing.status = 'accepted';
    }
    existing.messages = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages([...existing.messages, msgObj]);
    if (prevKey && prevKey !== dmCode) byCode.delete(prevKey);
  }
  byCode.set(dmCode, existing);
  const consolidated = Array.from(byCode.values()).sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(consolidated)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  setDmThreadsCache(`${effectiveUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(resolvedSenderName)}`, consolidated);
  await markDmSeenCountInStorage(effectiveUid, existing);

  const peerUid = matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, resolvedSenderName, existing.requesterId, existing.requesterName) ? existing.targetId : existing.requesterId;
  const roomKey = resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey(peerUid, dmCode);
  void broadcastInstantChatMessage({
    kind: 'dm', roomKey, dmCode, senderId: effectiveUid, senderName: resolvedSenderName,
    senderAvatar: params.senderAvatar || null, recipientId: peerUid, recipientName: resolvedTargetName, clientMsgId, text: msgObj.text, createdAt: nowIso,
  });

  if (isUuid(effectiveUid) && isUuid(peerUid) && effectiveUid.toLowerCase() !== peerUid.toLowerCase()) {
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('mensajes_directos').insert([{ sender_id: effectiveUid, recipient_id: peerUid, mensaje: msgObj.text }]),
        markChatRoomReadEverywhere({ uid: effectiveUid, roomKey, roomKind: 'dm', peerId: peerUid, dmCode }),
      ]);
    } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  }
  try {
    const dbTeamId = await upsertCloudDmTeamRow({ dmCode, thread: existing, effectiveUid });
    if (dbTeamId) {
      existing.dbTeamId = dbTeamId;
      const msgRow: Record<string, unknown> = { equipo_id: dbTeamId, usuario_nombre: msgObj.senderName, mensaje: msgObj.text };
      if (isUuid(effectiveUid)) msgRow.usuario_id = effectiveUid;
      await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([msgRow]);
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return { thread: existing, isNewRequest };
}

export async function acceptCloudDirectMessage(
  dmCodeOrThreadId: string, myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null, threadSnapshot?: IDirectMessageThread | null
): Promise<IDirectMessageThread | null> {
  const effectiveUid = (await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId)) || String(myUserId || '').trim();
  const [diskThreads, memThreads] = [await loadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, myUserName), getDmCacheSnapshotState().val || []];
  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  [...diskThreads, ...memThreads, ...(threadSnapshot ? [threadSnapshot] : [])].forEach((t) => { if (t) mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb); });

  const targetCodeUp = String(dmCodeOrThreadId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const targetPeer = extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(targetCodeUp, effectiveUid).toLowerCase();
  const found = byCode.get(targetCodeUp) || Array.from(byCode.values()).find((t) =>
    t.dmCode.toUpperCase() === targetCodeUp || t.threadId.toUpperCase() === targetCodeUp ||
    Boolean(t.legacyCodes?.some((c) => c.toUpperCase() === targetCodeUp)) ||
    (targetPeer && resolvePeerUuidForThread(t, effectiveUid, myUserName) === targetPeer)
  ) || null;

  const code = found?.dmCode || targetCodeUp;
  if (found) {
    found.status = 'accepted';
    found.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    byCode.set(found.dmCode, found);
    if (effectiveUid) {
      const nextList = Array.from(byCode.values()).sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(nextList)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      setDmThreadsCache(`${effectiveUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName)}`, nextList);
      await markDmSeenCountInStorage(effectiveUid, found);
    }
  }
  if (!isUuid(effectiveUid)) { emitSquadsDataChanged(); return found; }
  try {
    const peerUid = found ? resolvePeerUuidForThread(found, effectiveUid, myUserName) : targetPeer;
    if (isUuid(peerUid)) {
      await markChatRoomReadEverywhere({ uid: effectiveUid, roomKey: resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey(peerUid, code), roomKind: 'dm', peerId: peerUid, dmCode: code });
    }
    if (found) await upsertCloudDmTeamRow({ dmCode: code, thread: found, effectiveUid });
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return found;
}
