import { sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName } from '../utils/kineticDisplayNamePureLeaf';
import {
  KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS,
  KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID,
} from './kineticAthleteDeduplication';
import { deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages, parseChatTimestampMs } from './kineticChatReadTruthLeaf';

export { KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS, KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID };

export interface IDirectMessageItem {
  id: string;
  clientMsgId?: string | null;
  senderId: string;
  senderName: string;
  senderAvatar?: string | null;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
  leidoAt?: string | null;
}

export interface IDirectMessageThread {
  threadId: string;
  dmCode: string;
  dbTeamId?: string;
  legacyCodes?: string[];
  requesterId: string;
  requesterName: string;
  requesterAvatar?: string | null;
  targetId: string;
  targetName: string;
  targetAvatar?: string | null;
  status: 'pending' | 'accepted';
  updatedAt: string;
  peerLastReadAt?: string | null;
  messages: IDirectMessageItem[];
}

export const isUuid = (v?: string | null): boolean =>
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String(v || '').trim());

export const normalizeChatIdentity = (raw?: string | null): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
    .trim();

export const isGenericPlaceholderName = (raw?: string | null): boolean => {
  const k = normalizeChatIdentity(raw);
  return (
    !k ||
    k === 'atletakinetic' ||
    k === 'kineticathlete' ||
    k === 'administrador' ||
    k === 'admin' ||
    k === 'me' ||
    k === 'anon' ||
    k === 'usuario' ||
    k === 'user'
  );
};

export function isMasterAdminChatIdentity(params: {
  id?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  rol?: string | null;
}): boolean {
  const idLow = String(params.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailLow = String(params.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nameSlug = normalizeChatIdentity(params.name);
  const rolLow = String(params.rol || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    idLow === KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_UUID ||
    KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS.has(emailLow) ||
    nameSlug === 'terminalglobalkinetic' ||
    nameSlug === 'kineticoficial' ||
    nameSlug === 'kineticofficial' ||
    rolLow === 'admin' ||
    rolLow === 'fundador'
  );
}

export function resolveOfficialChatDisplayName(params: {
  id?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  rol?: string | null;
  fallback?: string;
}): string {
  if (isMasterAdminChatIdentity(params)) return 'Kinetic Oficial';
  const cleanName = sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName(params.name, { fallback: '' });
  if (cleanName && !isGenericPlaceholderName(cleanName)) return cleanName;
  const emailPrefix = sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName(String(params.email || '').trim().split('@')[0], { fallback: '' });
  if (emailPrefix && !isGenericPlaceholderName(emailPrefix)) return emailPrefix;
  return params.fallback || 'Atleta Kinetic';
}

/**
 * Clave determinista canónica inmutable 1-a-1:
 * Cuando ambos participantes tienen UUID válido -> `DM-${sortedUuidA}-${sortedUuidB}` (simétrica e inmutable).
 */
export const buildDeterministicDmCode = (
  uidA?: string | null,
  nameA?: string | null,
  uidB?: string | null,
  nameB?: string | null
): string => {
  const cleanA = String(uidA || '').trim();
  const cleanB = String(uidB || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(cleanA) && isUuid(cleanB)) {
    const sorted = [cleanA.toUpperCase(), cleanB.toUpperCase()].sort();
    return `DM-${sorted[0]}-${sorted[1]}`;
  }
  const keyA = !isGenericPlaceholderName(nameA) ? normalizeChatIdentity(nameA) : normalizeChatIdentity(cleanA) || 'atleta1';
  const keyB = !isGenericPlaceholderName(nameB) ? normalizeChatIdentity(nameB) : normalizeChatIdentity(cleanB) || 'atleta2';
  const pair = [keyA.slice(0, 14), keyB.slice(0, 14)].sort();
  return `DM-${pair[0]}-${pair[1]}`.toUpperCase();
};

export const matchesUserIdentity = (
  myId?: string | null,
  myName?: string | null,
  candidateId?: string | null,
  candidateName?: string | null
): boolean => {
  const cleanMyId = String(myId || '').trim();
  const cleanCandId = String(candidateId || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(cleanMyId) && isUuid(cleanCandId)) {
    return cleanMyId.toLowerCase() === cleanCandId.toLowerCase();
  }
  const normMyName = normalizeChatIdentity(myName);
  const normCandName = normalizeChatIdentity(candidateName);
  if (normMyName && normCandName && !isGenericPlaceholderName(myName) && !isGenericPlaceholderName(candidateName)) {
    return normMyName === normCandName;
  }
  return false;
};

export function canInitiateOrHydrateDm(
  requesterId?: string | null,
  targetId?: string | null,
  effectiveUid?: string | null,
  requesterName?: string | null,
  targetName?: string | null
): boolean {
  const req = String(requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const tgt = String(targetId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const eff = String(effectiveUid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!req && !tgt) return false;
  if (req && tgt && req === tgt) return false;
  if (eff && req === eff && tgt === eff) return false;
  if (
    !isUuid(req) &&
    !isUuid(tgt) &&
    requesterName &&
    targetName &&
    !isGenericPlaceholderName(requesterName) &&
    normalizeChatIdentity(requesterName) === normalizeChatIdentity(targetName)
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (eff && matchesUserIdentity(eff, requesterName, req, requesterName) && matchesUserIdentity(eff, requesterName, tgt, targetName)) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export const isStrictDmParticipant = (
  myId?: string | null,
  myName?: string | null,
  reqId?: string | null,
  reqName?: string | null,
  tgtId?: string | null,
  tgtName?: string | null
): boolean => {
  const cleanMyId = String(myId || '').trim();
  if (!isUuid(cleanMyId) && isGenericPlaceholderName(myName)) return false;
  if (!canInitiateOrHydrateDm(reqId, tgtId, cleanMyId, reqName, tgtName)) return false;
  return (
    matchesUserIdentity(cleanMyId, myName, reqId, reqName) ||
    matchesUserIdentity(cleanMyId, myName, tgtId, tgtName)
  );
};

const CANONICAL_DM_UUID_PAIR_RE =
  /^DM-([0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12})-([0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12})$/i;

export function extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(dmCode?: string | null, myUserId?: string | null): string {
  const match = String(dmCode || '').trim().match(CANONICAL_DM_UUID_PAIR_RE);
  if (!match) return '';
  const u1 = match[1].toLowerCase();
  const u2 = match[2].toLowerCase();
  const me = String(myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (me && u1 === me) return u2;
  if (me && u2 === me) return u1;
  return '';
}

export function resolvePeerUuidForThread(
  thread: Pick<IDirectMessageThread, 'dmCode' | 'requesterId' | 'requesterName' | 'targetId' | 'targetName'>,
  effectiveUid?: string | null,
  myUserName?: string | null
): string {
  const amReq = matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, thread.requesterId, thread.requesterName);
  const candidate = String(amReq ? thread.targetId : thread.requesterId || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(candidate)) return candidate.toLowerCase();
  return extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(thread.dmCode, effectiveUid);
}

export function resolveEffectiveDeletedAtMs(
  thread: Pick<IDirectMessageThread, 'dmCode' | 'threadId' | 'legacyCodes' | 'requesterId' | 'requesterName' | 'targetId' | 'targetName'>,
  deletedMap: Record<string, string>,
  effectiveUid?: string | null,
  myUserName?: string | null
): number | null {
  if (!deletedMap || typeof deletedMap !== 'object') return null;
  const candidateKeys = new Set<string>();
  const code = String(thread.dmCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const tid = String(thread.threadId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (code) candidateKeys.add(code);
  if (tid) candidateKeys.add(tid);
  if (Array.isArray(thread.legacyCodes)) {
    thread.legacyCodes.forEach((lc) => {
      if (lc) candidateKeys.add(String(lc).trim().toUpperCase());
    });
  }
  const canonical = buildDeterministicDmCode(thread.requesterId, thread.requesterName, thread.targetId, thread.targetName).toUpperCase();
  if (canonical) candidateKeys.add(canonical);

  const peerUuid = resolvePeerUuidForThread(thread, effectiveUid, myUserName);
  if (peerUuid) candidateKeys.add(`PEER:${peerUuid.toUpperCase()}`);

  const upperDeleted = new Map<string, string>();
  Object.entries(deletedMap).forEach(([dk, dv]) => {
    if (dk && dv) upperDeleted.set(String(dk).trim().toUpperCase(), String(dv));
  });

  let maxDeletedMs: number | null = null;
  candidateKeys.forEach((k) => {
    const rawIso = upperDeleted.get(k.toUpperCase());
    if (!rawIso) return;
    const parsed = Date.parse(rawIso);
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && (maxDeletedMs === null || parsed > maxDeletedMs)) {
      maxDeletedMs = parsed;
    }
  });
  return maxDeletedMs;
}

/**
 * Filtro puro Anti-Zombis + Anti-AutoChat + Bloqueos UGC:
 * Descarta mensajes con `Date.parse(m.createdAt) <= Date.parse(deletedAt)`.
 * Si tras el filtrado estricto no queda ningún mensaje nuevo (`> deletedAt`), el hilo NO existe ni resucita.
 */
export function filterAntiZombieDmThreads(
  threads: IDirectMessageThread[],
  deletedMap: Record<string, string>,
  effectiveUid: string,
  myUserName?: string | null,
  blockedIdsSet?: ReadonlySet<string>
): IDirectMessageThread[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(threads) || !effectiveUid) return [];
  const out: IDirectMessageThread[] = [];

  for (const t of threads) {
    if (!t || !isStrictDmParticipant(effectiveUid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName)) {
      continue;
    }
    const peerUuid = resolvePeerUuidForThread(t, effectiveUid, myUserName);
    if (peerUuid && blockedIdsSet?.has(peerUuid.toLowerCase())) continue;

    const deletedAtMs = resolveEffectiveDeletedAtMs(t, deletedMap, effectiveUid, myUserName);
    const rawMsgs = Array.isArray(t.messages) ? t.messages : [];
    if (rawMsgs.length === 0) continue;

    let survivingMsgs = rawMsgs;
    if (deletedAtMs !== null) {
      survivingMsgs = rawMsgs.filter((m) => {
        const mMs = Date.parse(String(m?.createdAt || ''));
        return Number.isFinite(mMs) && mMs > deletedAtMs;
      });
      if (survivingMsgs.length === 0) continue;
    }

    const sortedMsgs = [...survivingMsgs].sort((a, b) =>
      String(a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(String(b.createdAt || ''))
    );
    const latestTs = sortedMsgs.length > 0 ? sortedMsgs[sortedMsgs.length - 1].createdAt : t.updatedAt;
    const canonicalCode = buildDeterministicDmCode(t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName);

    out.push({
      ...t,
      dmCode: canonicalCode,
      threadId: canonicalCode,
      requesterName: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.requesterId, name: t.requesterName }),
      targetName: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.targetId, name: t.targetName }),
      updatedAt: latestTs || new Date().toISOString(),
      messages: sortedMsgs,
    });
  }

  return out.sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
}

export function areDmTimestampsClose(isoA?: string | null, isoB?: string | null, windowMs = 15_000): boolean {
  const sA = String(isoA || ''), sB = String(isoB || '');
  const tA = Date.parse(sA), tB = Date.parse(sB);
  if (Number.isFinite(tA) && Number.isFinite(tB)) return Math.abs(tA - tB) < windowMs;
  return Boolean(sA && sA.slice(0, 16) === sB.slice(0, 16));
}

export function mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(
  byCode: Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>,
  incoming: IDirectMessageThread,
  fallbackLabel = 'Atleta Kinetic'
): IDirectMessageThread {
  const canonical = buildDeterministicDmCode(
    incoming.requesterId, incoming.requesterName, incoming.targetId, incoming.targetName
  ).toUpperCase();
  const rawCode = String(incoming.dmCode || incoming.threadId || canonical).trim().toUpperCase();

  let existing = byCode.get(canonical);
  if (!existing && isUuid(incoming.requesterId) && isUuid(incoming.targetId)) {
    const reqLow = incoming.requesterId.toLowerCase();
    const tgtLow = incoming.targetId.toLowerCase();
    existing = Array.from(byCode.values()).find((cand) => {
      const cReq = String(cand.requesterId || '').toLowerCase();
      const cTgt = String(cand.targetId || '').toLowerCase();
      return (cReq === reqLow && cTgt === tgtLow) || (cReq === tgtLow && cTgt === reqLow);
    });
    if (existing && existing.dmCode !== canonical) byCode.delete(existing.dmCode);
  }

  const pickName = (a?: string | null, b?: string | null, uid?: string | null): string => {
    const rA = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: uid, name: a, fallback: '' });
    if (rA === 'Kinetic Oficial') return rA;
    const rB = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: uid, name: b, fallback: '' });
    if (rB === 'Kinetic Oficial') return rB;
    if (rA && !isGenericPlaceholderName(rA)) return rA;
    if (rB && !isGenericPlaceholderName(rB)) return rB;
    return rA || rB || fallbackLabel;
  };

  if (!existing) {
    const legacy = rawCode && rawCode !== canonical ? [rawCode] : [];
    const created: IDirectMessageThread = {
      ...incoming,
      threadId: canonical,
      dmCode: canonical,
      legacyCodes: Array.from(new Set([...(incoming.legacyCodes || []), ...legacy])),
      requesterName: pickName(incoming.requesterName, '', incoming.requesterId),
      targetName: pickName(incoming.targetName, '', incoming.targetId),
      peerLastReadAt: incoming.peerLastReadAt || null,
      messages: deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages(incoming.messages || []),
    };
    byCode.set(canonical, created);
    return created;
  }

  const sameDir = String(existing.requesterId || '').toLowerCase() === String(incoming.requesterId || '').toLowerCase();
  existing.requesterName = pickName(existing.requesterName, sameDir ? incoming.requesterName : incoming.targetName, existing.requesterId);
  existing.targetName = pickName(existing.targetName, sameDir ? incoming.targetName : incoming.requesterName, existing.targetId);
  existing.requesterAvatar = existing.requesterAvatar || (sameDir ? incoming.requesterAvatar : incoming.targetAvatar) || null;
  existing.targetAvatar = existing.targetAvatar || (sameDir ? incoming.targetAvatar : incoming.requesterAvatar) || null;
  if (incoming.dbTeamId && !existing.dbTeamId) existing.dbTeamId = incoming.dbTeamId;
  if (incoming.status === 'accepted') existing.status = 'accepted';
  if (String(incoming.updatedAt || '') > String(existing.updatedAt || '')) existing.updatedAt = incoming.updatedAt;
  if (parseChatTimestampMs(incoming.peerLastReadAt) > parseChatTimestampMs(existing.peerLastReadAt)) {
    existing.peerLastReadAt = incoming.peerLastReadAt;
  }

  const extraLegacy = new Set<string>(existing.legacyCodes || []);
  if (rawCode && rawCode !== canonical) extraLegacy.add(rawCode);
  (incoming.legacyCodes || []).forEach((lc) => { if (lc && lc !== canonical) extraLegacy.add(lc); });
  existing.legacyCodes = Array.from(extraLegacy);
  existing.messages = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages([...(existing.messages || []), ...(incoming.messages || [])]);

  byCode.set(canonical, existing);
  return existing;
}

    // === src/services/kineticDmMemoryStore.ts === //
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  buildDeterministicDmCode,
  IDirectMessageThread,
  filterAntiZombieDmThreads,
  extractPeerUuidFromDmCode,
  isGenericPlaceholderName,
  isMasterAdminChatIdentity,
  isStrictDmParticipant,
  isUuid,
  mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap,
  normalizeChatIdentity,
  resolveOfficialChatDisplayName,
} from './kineticDmDeterministicHelpers';
import {
  deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages,
  parseChatTimestampMs,
  resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey,
  resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey,
} from './kineticChatReadTruthLeaf';
import { td } from './kineticlubHelpers';
import { emitSquadsDataChanged } from './kineticlubSquadsDeterministicEngine';
import { getBlockedUserIdsSet } from './kineticlubUgcModerationService';
import type { IInstantChatMessagePayload } from './kineticlubWallRealtimeHelper';
import { registerSessionCleanupHook } from './kineticSessionLeafCore';

export const DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_direct_messages_v25';
export const DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_deleted_dms_v25';
export const SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_shared_squad_msgs_v3';
export const DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX = '@kinetic_msg_seen_counts_v265_';
export const CHAT_READS_STORAGE_PREFIX = '@kinetic_chat_reads_v286_';
export const CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS = 2000;

let _dmSyncCacheKey = '';
let _dmSyncCacheTs = 0;
let _dmSyncCacheVal: IDirectMessageThread[] | null = null;
let _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot: Record<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>> = {};
let _chatReadsOwnerUid = '';
let _chatLastReadMap: Record<string, string> = {};
let _peerLastReadMap: Record<string, string> = {};

function ensureReadsOwner(uid?: string | null): string {
  const clean = String(uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean) return '';
  if (_chatReadsOwnerUid !== clean) {
    _chatReadsOwnerUid = clean;
    _chatLastReadMap = readWebLocalStorageJson<Record<string, string>>(`${CHAT_READS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${clean}`, {});
    _peerLastReadMap = {};
  }
  return clean;
}

export const getScopedSquadMsgsStorageKey = (uid?: string | null): string => {
  const clean = String(uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return isUuid(clean) ? `${SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_STORAGE_KEY}_${clean}` : SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_STORAGE_KEY;
};

registerSessionCleanupHook(() => {
  const prevOwner = _chatReadsOwnerUid;
  _dmSyncCacheKey = ''; _dmSyncCacheTs = 0; _dmSyncCacheVal = null;
  _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot = {}; _chatReadsOwnerUid = ''; _chatLastReadMap = {}; _peerLastReadMap = {};
  const keys = [SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_STORAGE_KEY, DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY, ...(prevOwner ? [getScopedSquadMsgsStorageKey(prevOwner), getScopedDmStorageKey(prevOwner), `${CHAT_READS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${prevOwner}`] : [])];
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    keys.forEach((k) => { try { window.localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } });
  }
  AsyncStorage.multiRemove(keys).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
});

export async function markDmSeenCountInStorage(
  uid?: string | null,
  dmThread?: Pick<IDirectMessageThread, 'dmCode' | 'requesterId' | 'requesterName' | 'targetId' | 'targetName' | 'messages'> | null
): Promise<void> {
  const cleanUid = String(uid || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUid || !dmThread?.dmCode) return;
  const total = Array.isArray(dmThread.messages) ? dmThread.messages.length : 0;
  const myLow = cleanUid.toLowerCase();
  const reqLow = String(dmThread.requesterId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const peerRaw = reqLow === myLow ? dmThread.targetId : dmThread.requesterId;
  const peerLow = String(peerRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const rowKey = isUuid(peerLow) ? `dm:peer:${peerLow}` : `dm:${String(dmThread.dmCode).toLowerCase()}`;
  const key = `${DM_SEEN_COUNTS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanUid}`;
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    const parsed: unknown = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    const safePrev = parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    markChatRoomLastReadLocal(cleanUid, rowKey, nowIso);
    markChatRoomLastReadLocal(cleanUid, `dm:${String(dmThread.dmCode).toLowerCase()}`, nowIso);
    if (safePrev[rowKey] === total && safePrev[dmThread.dmCode] === total) return;
    const next = { ...safePrev, [rowKey]: total, [dmThread.dmCode]: total };
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(next));
    emitSquadsDataChanged();
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
}

export function getDmCacheSnapshotState(): { key: string; ts: number; val: IDirectMessageThread[] | null } {
  return { key: _dmSyncCacheKey, ts: _dmSyncCacheTs, val: _dmSyncCacheVal };
}

export function setDmCacheIdentityKey(key: string): void {
  _dmSyncCacheKey = key;
}

export function setDmThreadsCache(identityKey: string, threads: IDirectMessageThread[]): void {
  _dmSyncCacheKey = identityKey;
  _dmSyncCacheVal = Array.isArray(threads) ? threads : [];
  _dmSyncCacheTs = Date.now();
}

export function invalidateDirectMessagesCache(): void {
  _dmSyncCacheTs = 0;
  _dmSyncCacheVal = null;
}

export const getScopedDmStorageKey = (uid?: string | null): string => {
  const clean = String(uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return isUuid(clean) ? `${DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY}_${clean}` : DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY;
};

function readWebLocalStorageJson<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  return fallback;
}

function writeWebLocalStorageJson(key: string, val: unknown): void {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val));
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
}

export function getChatLastReadMapSync(uid?: string | null): Record<string, string> {
  if (!ensureReadsOwner(uid)) return {};
  return { ..._chatLastReadMap };
}

export function mergeChatLastReadMap(uid: string | undefined | null, incoming: Record<string, string>): void {
  const owner = ensureReadsOwner(uid);
  if (!owner || !incoming) return;
  let changed = false;
  for (const [rawKey, rawIso] of Object.entries(incoming)) {
    const k = String(rawKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const iso = String(rawIso || '').trim();
    if (!k || !iso) continue;
    if (parseChatTimestampMs(iso) > parseChatTimestampMs(_chatLastReadMap[k])) {
      _chatLastReadMap[k] = iso;
      changed = true;
    }
  }
  if (changed) {
    const storageKey = `${CHAT_READS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${owner}`;
    writeWebLocalStorageJson(storageKey, _chatLastReadMap);
    AsyncStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(_chatLastReadMap)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  }
}

export function markChatRoomLastReadLocal(uid: string | undefined | null, roomKey: string, readAtIso: string): void {
  const k = String(roomKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!k || !readAtIso) return;
  mergeChatLastReadMap(uid, { [k]: readAtIso });
}

export async function loadPersistedChatReadsMap(uid?: string | null): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const owner = ensureReadsOwner(uid);
  if (!owner) return {};
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(`${CHAT_READS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${owner}`);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, string>;
      if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') mergeChatLastReadMap(owner, parsed);
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  return { ..._chatLastReadMap };
}

export function getPeerLastReadMapSync(uid?: string | null): Record<string, string> {
  if (!ensureReadsOwner(uid)) return {};
  return { ..._peerLastReadMap };
}

export function markPeerLastReadLocal(uid: string | undefined | null, roomKey: string, readAtIso: string): void {
  if (!ensureReadsOwner(uid)) return;
  const k = String(roomKey || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!k || !readAtIso) return;
  if (parseChatTimestampMs(readAtIso) > parseChatTimestampMs(_peerLastReadMap[k])) {
    _peerLastReadMap[k] = readAtIso;
  }
}

export function getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null): IDirectMessageThread[] {
  const cleanUid = String(myUserId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUid) {
    _dmSyncCacheVal = null;
    _dmSyncCacheKey = '';
    return [];
  }
  if (_dmSyncCacheVal && _dmSyncCacheVal.length > 0) {
    const blocked = getBlockedUserIdsSet();
    const prefix = `${cleanUid}|`;
    if (_dmSyncCacheKey.startsWith(prefix)) return _dmSyncCacheVal;
    return _dmSyncCacheVal.filter(
      (t) =>
        isStrictDmParticipant(cleanUid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName) &&
        !blocked.has(String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase()) &&
        !blocked.has(String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase())
    );
  }
  const rawList = readWebLocalStorageJson<IDirectMessageThread[]>(
    getScopedDmStorageKey(cleanUid),
    isUuid(cleanUid) ? [] : readWebLocalStorageJson<IDirectMessageThread[]>(DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY, [])
  );
  if (!Array.isArray(rawList) || rawList.length === 0) return [];
  const delKey = isUuid(cleanUid) ? `${DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY}_${cleanUid.toLowerCase()}` : DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY;
  const deletedMap = readWebLocalStorageJson<Record<string, string>>(delKey, {});
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
  rawList.forEach((t) => {
    if (t && isStrictDmParticipant(cleanUid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName)) {
      mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb);
    }
  });
  const filtered = filterAntiZombieDmThreads(Array.from(byCode.values()), deletedMap, cleanUid, myUserName, getBlockedUserIdsSet());
  if (filtered.length > 0) {
    _dmSyncCacheKey = `${cleanUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myUserName)}`;
    _dmSyncCacheVal = filtered;
  }
  return filtered;
}

export function getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(uid?: string | null): Record<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  if (Object.keys(_squadRoomsMemorySnapshot).length > 0) return _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot;
  const scopedKey = getScopedSquadMsgsStorageKey(uid);
  const localMap = readWebLocalStorageJson<Record<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>>>(scopedKey, {});
  if (localMap && typeof localMap === 'object' && Object.keys(localMap).length > 0) {
    _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot = localMap;
  }
  return _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot;
}

export function setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(map: Record<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>>, uid?: string | null): void {

  _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot = { ...map };
  if (isUuid(uid)) writeWebLocalStorageJson(getScopedSquadMsgsStorageKey(uid), _squadRoomsMemorySnapshot);

export function injectInstantDmBroadcastMessage(
  myUid: string,
  myName: string | null | undefined,
  p: IInstantChatMessagePayload
): void {
  const cleanUid = String(myUid || '').trim();
  const sId = String(p.senderId || '').trim();
  const rId = String(p.recipientId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUid || !sId || !String(p.text || '').trim()) return;
  if (cleanUid.toLowerCase() !== sId.toLowerCase() && cleanUid.toLowerCase() !== rId.toLowerCase()) return;
  if (getBlockedUserIdsSet().has(sId.toLowerCase())) return;
  const code = String(p.dmCode || buildDeterministicDmCode(sId, p.senderName, rId, p.recipientName)).toUpperCase();
  const current = getDmThreadsSyncSnapshot(cleanUid, myName);
  const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
  current.forEach((t) => mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t));
  const prev = byCode.get(code);
  const keepAccepted = prev?.status === 'accepted' || sId.toLowerCase() === cleanUid.toLowerCase();
  mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, {
    threadId: code, dmCode: code, requesterId: prev?.requesterId || sId, requesterName: prev?.requesterName || p.senderName, requesterAvatar: prev?.requesterAvatar || p.senderAvatar || null,
    targetId: prev?.targetId || rId || cleanUid, targetName: prev?.targetName || p.recipientName || String(myName || 'Atleta Kinetic'),
    status: keepAccepted ? 'accepted' : 'pending', updatedAt: p.createdAt,
    messages: [{ id: p.clientMsgId, clientMsgId: p.clientMsgId, senderId: sId, senderName: p.senderName, senderAvatar: p.senderAvatar || null, text: p.text, createdAt: p.createdAt }],
  });
  const merged = Array.from(byCode.values()).sort((a, b) => String(b.updatedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt || '')));
  setDmThreadsCache(`${cleanUid}|${normalizeChatIdentity(myName)}`, merged);
  AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(cleanUid), JSON.stringify(merged)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
}

export function injectInstantSquadBroadcastMessage(
  p: IInstantChatMessagePayload,
  allowedTeamIds?: ReadonlySet<string> | null,
  uid?: string | null
): void {
  const eqId = String(p.equipoId || '').trim();
  const sId = String(p.senderId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!eqId || !String(p.text || '').trim()) return;
  if (allowedTeamIds && !allowedTeamIds.has(eqId)) return;
  if (sId && getBlockedUserIdsSet().has(sId)) return;
  const snap = { ...getSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(uid) };
  const nextList = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages([
    ...(Array.isArray(snap[eqId]) ? snap[eqId] : []),
    { id: p.clientMsgId, client_msg_id: p.clientMsgId, equipo_id: eqId, usuario_id: p.senderId, usuario_nombre: p.senderName, usuario_avatar: p.senderAvatar || undefined, mensaje: p.text, created_at: p.createdAt },
  ]);
  snap[eqId] = nextList;
  setSquadRoomsSyncSnapshot(snap, uid);
  AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedSquadMsgsStorageKey(uid), JSON.stringify(snap)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
}

export async function resolveStrictDmUserId(explicitUserId?: string | null): Promise<string> {
  const clean = String(explicitUserId || '').trim();
  if (isUuid(clean)) return clean;
  try {
    const sUid = String((await supabase.auth.getSession()).data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
    if (isUuid(sUid)) return sUid;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  return '';
}

export async function markDmDeletedLocally(
  dmCode: string, myUserId?: string | null, deletedAtIso?: string, peerUuid?: string | null, extraCodes?: string[]
): Promise<void> {
  const code = String(dmCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const uid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
  const ts = deletedAtIso || new Date().toISOString();
  const resolvedPeer = isUuid(peerUuid) ? String(peerUuid).trim().toLowerCase() : extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(code, uid);
  if (!code && !resolvedPeer) return;
  const key = uid ? `${DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY}_${uid.toLowerCase()}` : DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY;
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    const map: Record<string, string> = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    if (code) map[code] = ts;
    if (resolvedPeer) map[`PEER:${resolvedPeer}`] = ts;
    (extraCodes || []).forEach((c) => { const up = String(c || '').trim().toUpperCase(); if (up) map[up] = ts; });
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(map));
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  invalidateDirectMessagesCache();
}

export async function loadDeletedDmMap(uid?: string | null): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const clean = String(uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(isUuid(clean) ? `${DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY}_${clean}` : DELETED_DMS_STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return {};
  }
}

export async function loadLocalDmThreads(myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null): Promise<IDirectMessageThread[]> {
  try {
    const uid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
    if (!uid) return [];
    const [scopedRaw, legacyRaw, deletedMap] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(uid)),
      isUuid(uid) ? Promise.resolve(null) : AsyncStorage.getItem(DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY),
      loadDeletedDmMap(uid),
    ]);
    const list: IDirectMessageThread[] = scopedRaw ? JSON.parse(scopedRaw) : legacyRaw ? JSON.parse(legacyRaw) : [];
    const byCode = new Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>();
    const fb = td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete');
    (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).forEach((t) => {
      if (t && isStrictDmParticipant(uid, myUserName, t.requesterId, t.requesterName, t.targetId, t.targetName)) {
        mergeThreadIntoCanonicalMap(byCode, t, fb);
      }
    });
    return filterAntiZombieDmThreads(Array.from(byCode.values()), deletedMap, uid, myUserName, getBlockedUserIdsSet());
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return [];
  }
}

export function resolveRoomKeyFromPayload(p: IInstantChatMessagePayload): string {
  return p.kind === 'dm'
    ? resolveCanonicalDmRoomKey(p.senderId, p.dmCode)
    : resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey(p.equipoId);
}

export async function hydrateMissingDmPeerProfiles(
  byCode: Map<string, IDirectMessageThread>,
  effectiveUid: string
): Promise<void> {
  const missingUuids = new Set<string>();
  const uidLow = effectiveUid.toLowerCase();
  byCode.forEach((t) => {
    [{ id: t.requesterId, name: t.requesterName, av: t.requesterAvatar }, { id: t.targetId, name: t.targetName, av: t.targetAvatar }].forEach((s) => {
      const cId = String(s.id || '').trim();
      if (isUuid(cId) && cId.toLowerCase() !== uidLow && !isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: cId, name: s.name }) && (isGenericPlaceholderName(s.name) || !s.av)) {
        missingUuids.add(cId);
      }
    });
  });
  if (missingUuids.size === 0) return;
  const idsArr = Array.from(missingUuids);
  const profileById = new Map<string, { nombre?: string; avatar_url?: string | null; rol?: string; email?: string }>();
  try {
    const pubRes = await supabase.from('perfiles_publicos').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel').in('id', idsArr);
    (pubRes.data || []).forEach((r: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      if (r?.id) profileById.set(String(r.id).toLowerCase(), r as { nombre?: string; avatar_url?: string | null });
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  const stillMissing = idsArr.filter((id) => {
    const f = profileById.get(id.toLowerCase());
    return !f || isGenericPlaceholderName(f.nombre);
  });
  if (stillMissing.length > 0) {
    try {
      const privRes = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, rol').in('id', stillMissing);
      (privRes.data || []).forEach((r: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        if (r?.id) {
          const k = String(r.id).toLowerCase();
          profileById.set(k, { ...profileById.get(k), ...(r as { nombre?: string; avatar_url?: string | null; rol?: string }) });
        }
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    }
  }
  byCode.forEach((t) => {
    const reqP = profileById.get(String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase());
    if (reqP || isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: t.requesterId, name: t.requesterName })) {
      t.requesterName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.requesterId, name: reqP?.nombre || t.requesterName, email: reqP?.email, rol: reqP?.rol, fallback: t.requesterName });
      if (!t.requesterAvatar && reqP?.avatar_url) t.requesterAvatar = reqP.avatar_url;
    }
    const tgtP = profileById.get(String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase());
    if (tgtP || isMasterAdminChatIdentity({ id: t.targetId, name: t.targetName })) {
      t.targetName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: t.targetId, name: tgtP?.nombre || t.targetName, email: tgtP?.email, rol: tgtP?.rol, fallback: t.targetName });
      if (!t.targetAvatar && tgtP?.avatar_url) t.targetAvatar = tgtP.avatar_url;
    }
    t.messages.forEach((m) => {
      if (m.senderId === t.requesterId && !isGenericPlaceholderName(t.requesterName)) m.senderName = t.requesterName;
      else if (m.senderId === t.targetId && !isGenericPlaceholderName(t.targetName)) m.senderName = t.targetName;
    });
  });
}

import { getLevelNumericWeight, getMembershipByLevel } from '../constants/memberships';
import { classifyKineticAccountRole } from '../utils/kineticRoleLeafGuards';
import { isKineticDevRuntime } from './kineticVaultCrypto';

export const KINETIC_REAL_JWT_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+\.[A-Za-z0-9-_]+$/;

export type ProductionAuthRejectReason =
  | 'ok'
  | 'missing_jwt'
  | 'synthetic_token'
  | 'aal2_required'
  | 'mfa_check_failed'
  | 'unconfirmed_email';

export interface ProductionAuthEvaluationInput {
  token?: unknown;
  aal?: unknown;
  hasVerifiedTotp?: boolean;
  emailConfirmed?: boolean | null;
  mfaCheckFailed?: boolean;
  isDevRuntime?: boolean;
}

export interface ProductionAuthEvaluationResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  reason: ProductionAuthRejectReason;
}

export interface IPendingMfaChallengeState {
  required: boolean;
  email?: string;
  factorId?: string;
  reason?: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export const isSyntheticOrDemoToken = (token: unknown): boolean => {
  if (typeof token !== 'string') return true;
  const trimmed = token.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return true;
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (
    lower.startsWith('kinetic-') ||
    lower.startsWith('demo-') ||
    lower.startsWith('mock-')
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  return !KINETIC_REAL_JWT_RE.test(trimmed);
};

export const isValidRealSupabaseJwt = (token: unknown): boolean => !isSyntheticOrDemoToken(token);

const B2B_UPPER = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
const B2B_LOWER = 'abcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
const B2B_DIGITS = '23456789';
const B2B_SYMBOLS = '!@#$%&*+-=?';
const B2B_ALL = `${B2B_UPPER}${B2B_LOWER}${B2B_DIGITS}${B2B_SYMBOLS}`;

const secureRandIndex = (max: number, getRandomValues: (arr: Uint32Array) => Uint32Array): number => {
  const limit = 0x1_0000_0000 - (0x1_0000_0000 % max);
  const buf = new Uint32Array(1);
  let val = 0;
  do {
    getRandomValues(buf);
    val = buf[0] >>> 0;
  } while (val >= limit);
  return val % max;
};

export const generateSecureB2BTempPassword = (length = 16): string => {
  const c = (globalThis as { crypto?: { getRandomValues?: (arr: Uint32Array) => Uint32Array } })?.crypto;
  if (!c?.getRandomValues) {
    throw new Error('SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE');
  }
  const grv = (arr: Uint32Array) => c.getRandomValues!(arr);
  const targetLen = Math.min(16, Math.max(14, Math.floor(Number(length) || 16)));
  const chars: string[] = [
    B2B_UPPER[secureRandIndex(B2B_UPPER.length, grv)],
    B2B_LOWER[secureRandIndex(B2B_LOWER.length, grv)],
    B2B_DIGITS[secureRandIndex(B2B_DIGITS.length, grv)],
    B2B_SYMBOLS[secureRandIndex(B2B_SYMBOLS.length, grv)],
  ];
  while (chars.length < targetLen) {
    chars.push(B2B_ALL[secureRandIndex(B2B_ALL.length, grv)]);
  }
  for (let i = chars.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
    const j = secureRandIndex(i + 1, grv);
    const tmp = chars[i];
    chars[i] = chars[j];
    chars[j] = tmp;
  }
  return chars.join('');
};

export const extractJwtClaimsSafe = (
  token: unknown,
): { sub?: string; aal?: string; exp?: number; amr?: unknown[]; email?: string } | null => {
  if (isSyntheticOrDemoToken(token)) return null;
  try {
    const parts = String(token).trim().split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3 || !parts[1]) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padLen = (4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4;
    const padded = b64 + '='.repeat(padLen);
    let jsonStr = '';
    if (typeof atob === 'function') {
      const bin = atob(padded);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i += 1) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      jsonStr = typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined' ? new TextDecoder().decode(bytes) : bin;
    } else {
      const globalWithBuf = globalThis as { Buffer?: { from?: (v: string, enc: string) => { toString: (enc: string) => string } } };
      const Buf = globalWithBuf.Buffer;
      if (!Buf?.from) return null;
      jsonStr = Buf.from(padded, 'base64').toString('utf8');
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const evaluateProductionAuthAccess = (
  input: ProductionAuthEvaluationInput,
): ProductionAuthEvaluationResult => {
  const devRuntime = typeof input.isDevRuntime === 'boolean' ? input.isDevRuntime : isKineticDevRuntime();
  const rawToken = typeof input.token === 'string' ? input.token.trim() : '';

  if (!rawToken) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'missing_jwt' };
  }

  const lower = rawToken.toLowerCase();
  const isExplicitSynthetic =
    lower.startsWith('kinetic-') || lower.startsWith('demo-') || lower.startsWith('mock-');
  if (isExplicitSynthetic) {
    if (!devRuntime) return { allowed: false, reason: 'synthetic_token' };
  } else if (!KINETIC_REAL_JWT_RE.test(rawToken)) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'missing_jwt' };
  }

  const claims = extractJwtClaimsSafe(rawToken);
  if (!devRuntime) {
    const subOk = typeof claims?.sub === 'string' && claims.sub.trim().length > 0;
    const expOk = typeof claims?.exp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(claims.exp) && claims.exp * 1000 > Date.now();
    if (!claims || !subOk || !expOk) {
      return { allowed: false, reason: 'missing_jwt' };
    }
  }
  if (input.mfaCheckFailed === true) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'mfa_check_failed' };
  }
  const claimAal = typeof claims?.aal === 'string' && claims.aal.trim() ? claims.aal.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
  const inputAal = typeof input.aal === 'string' && input.aal.trim() ? input.aal.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
  const resolvedAal = !devRuntime
    ? (claimAal === 'aal2' && inputAal !== 'aal1' ? 'aal2' : 'aal1')
    : (inputAal || claimAal || 'aal1');
  if (input.hasVerifiedTotp === true && resolvedAal !== 'aal2') {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'aal2_required' };
  }

  if (input.emailConfirmed === false && !devRuntime) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'unconfirmed_email' };
  }

  return { allowed: true, reason: 'ok' };
};

export const maskClabeAccount = (rawClabe: unknown): string => {
  const digits = String(rawClabe ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (!digits) return '•••• •••• •••• ••••';
  if (digits.length < 6) return '•'.repeat(Math.max(4, digits.length));
  const tail = digits.slice(-4);
  if (digits.length >= 16) return `•••• •••• •••• ••${tail}`;
  return `•••• •••• ${tail}`;
};

export const isValidKcMultipleOfTen = (amountKc: unknown): boolean => {
  if (typeof amountKc !== 'number') return false;
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountKc) || !Number.isInteger(amountKc)) return false;
  return amountKc >= 10 && amountKc <= 1_000_000 && amountKc % 10 === 0;
};

export const assertValidKcMultipleOfTen = (amountKc: unknown, contextLabel = 'KC'): number => {
  const num = Number(amountKc);
  if (!isValidKcMultipleOfTen(num)) {
    throw new Error(`[${contextLabel}] Monto invalido: solo multiplos exactos de 10 KC permitidos.`);
  }
  return num;
};

let _pendingMfaChallenge: IPendingMfaChallengeState = { required: false, updatedAt: 0 };
const _mfaListeners = new Set<(state: IPendingMfaChallengeState) => void>();

const emitMfaChallenge = (): void => {
  _mfaListeners.forEach((listener) => {
    try {
      listener(_pendingMfaChallenge);
    } catch {}
  });
};

export const getGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (): IPendingMfaChallengeState => _pendingMfaChallenge;

export const setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (
  patch: Omit<IPendingMfaChallengeState, 'updatedAt'>,
): void => {
  _pendingMfaChallenge = { ...patch, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  emitMfaChallenge();
};

export const clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (): void => {
  if (!_pendingMfaChallenge.required) return;
  _pendingMfaChallenge = { required: false, updatedAt: Date.now() };
  emitMfaChallenge();
};

export const subscribeGlobalPendingMfaChallenge = (
  listener: (state: IPendingMfaChallengeState) => void,
): (() => void) => {
  _mfaListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    _mfaListeners.delete(listener);
  };
};

export const CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID: Record<string, number> = {
  topup_100: 100,
  topup_250: 250,
  topup_500: 500,
  topup_1000: 1000,
};

export const resolveCanonicalCheckoutPlan = (input: {
  tipo: 'membresia' | 'topup';
  planId?: string | null;
  targetLevel?: string | null;
  currentLevel?: string | null;
}): {
  canonicalPlanId: string;
  canonicalLevel: string | null;
  kcOtorgados: number;
  precioMxn: number;
  isDowngrade: boolean;
} => {
  if (input.tipo === 'topup') {
    const rawId = String(input.planId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pkgKc = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID, rawId)
      ? CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID[rawId]
      : Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID, `topup_${rawId}`)
      ? CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID[`topup_${rawId}`]
      : 0;
    if (!pkgKc || typeof pkgKc !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(pkgKc)) {
      throw new Error('Paquete Top-Up no reconocido en catálogo oficial (mínimo 100 KC).');
    }
    const isVip = getLevelNumericWeight(input.currentLevel) >= 1;
    return {
      canonicalPlanId: `topup_${pkgKc}`,
      canonicalLevel: null,
      kcOtorgados: pkgKc,
      precioMxn: isVip ? pkgKc : Math.round(pkgKc * 1.2),
      isDowngrade: false,
    };
  }
  const targetPlan = getMembershipByLevel(input.targetLevel || input.planId);
  const nextW = getLevelNumericWeight(targetPlan.nivel);
  if (nextW < 1) {
    return { canonicalPlanId: 'free', canonicalLevel: 'Acceso Base', kcOtorgados: 0, precioMxn: 0, isDowngrade: true };
  }
  const curW = getLevelNumericWeight(input.currentLevel);
  if (nextW < curW) {
    return { canonicalPlanId: targetPlan.id, canonicalLevel: targetPlan.nivel, kcOtorgados: 0, precioMxn: 0, isDowngrade: true };
  }
  if (curW >= 1 && nextW > curW) {
    const curPlan = getMembershipByLevel(input.currentLevel);
    return {
      canonicalPlanId: targetPlan.id,
      canonicalLevel: targetPlan.nivel,
      kcOtorgados: Math.max(0, targetPlan.kc_otorgados - curPlan.kc_otorgados),
      precioMxn: Math.max(0, targetPlan.precio_mensual_mxn - curPlan.precio_mensual_mxn),
      isDowngrade: false,
    };
  }
  return {
    canonicalPlanId: targetPlan.id,
    canonicalLevel: targetPlan.nivel,
    kcOtorgados: targetPlan.kc_otorgados,
    precioMxn: targetPlan.precio_mensual_mxn,
    isDowngrade: false,
  };
};

export interface ISandboxPurchaseSimInput {
  planId: string;
  tipo: 'membresia' | 'topup';
  currentLevel?: string | null;
  kcMembresia?: number;
  kcTopup?: number;
  isStrictB2B?: boolean;
  rol?: string | null;
  tipoCuenta?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
}

export interface ISandboxPurchaseSimResult {
  ok: boolean;
  errorCode?: string;
  kcInyectados: number;
  montoMxn: number;
  kcMembresia: number;
  kcTopup: number;
  saldoKc: number;
  nivel: string;
}

const SANDBOX_MEMBERSHIP_PLANS: Record<string, { kc: number; mxn: number; tier: string; weight: number }> = {
  free: { kc: 0, mxn: 0, tier: 'Acceso Base', weight: 0 },
  acceso_base: { kc: 0, mxn: 0, tier: 'Acceso Base', weight: 0 },
  base: { kc: 0, mxn: 0, tier: 'Acceso Base', weight: 0 },
  bronze: { kc: 600, mxn: 699, tier: 'Bronze', weight: 1 },
  silver: { kc: 1500, mxn: 1549, tier: 'Silver', weight: 2 },
  gold: { kc: 2500, mxn: 2529, tier: 'Gold', weight: 3 },
  platinum: { kc: 3600, mxn: 3600, tier: 'Platinum', weight: 4 },
};

export const simulateBovedaSandboxPurchase = (input: ISandboxPurchaseSimInput): ISandboxPurchaseSimResult => {
  const mem = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.kcMembresia) || 0));
  const top = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.kcTopup) || 0));
  const currW = getLevelNumericWeight(input.currentLevel);
  const currTierName = getMembershipByLevel(input.currentLevel).nivel || 'Acceso Base';
  const currTierKey = currTierName.toLowerCase();
  const currBase = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SANDBOX_MEMBERSHIP_PLANS, currTierKey)
    ? SANDBOX_MEMBERSHIP_PLANS[currTierKey]
    : { kc: 0, mxn: 0, tier: 'Acceso Base', weight: 0 };

  if (
    input.isStrictB2B ||
    classifyKineticAccountRole({
      email: input.email,
      rol: input.rol,
      tipo_cuenta: input.tipoCuenta,
    }) === 'b2b'
  ) {
    return { ok: false, errorCode: 'B2B_ACCOUNT_WALLET_PURCHASE_FORBIDDEN', kcInyectados: 0, montoMxn: 0, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: mem + top, nivel: currTierName };
  }

  const rawPlan = String(input.planId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const memPlan = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SANDBOX_MEMBERSHIP_PLANS, rawPlan)
    ? SANDBOX_MEMBERSHIP_PLANS[rawPlan]
    : undefined;
  if (memPlan || input.tipo === 'membresia') {
    if (!memPlan || memPlan.weight <= currW) {
      return { ok: false, errorCode: 'MEMBERSHIP_DOWNGRADE_OR_SAME_TIER_FORBIDDEN', kcInyectados: 0, montoMxn: 0, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: mem + top, nivel: currTierName };
    }
    const kcDelta = currW >= 1 ? Math.max(0, memPlan.kc - currBase.kc) : memPlan.kc;
    const mxnDelta = currW >= 1 ? Math.max(0, memPlan.mxn - currBase.mxn) : memPlan.mxn;
    const nextMem = mem + kcDelta;
    return { ok: true, kcInyectados: kcDelta, montoMxn: mxnDelta, kcMembresia: nextMem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: nextMem + top, nivel: memPlan.tier };
  }

  const normalizedTopupId = rawPlan.startsWith('pkg_') ? `topup_${rawPlan.slice(4)}` : rawPlan;
  const topKc = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID, normalizedTopupId)
    ? CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID[normalizedTopupId]
    : Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID, `topup_${normalizedTopupId}`)
    ? CANONICAL_TOPUP_KC_BY_ID[`topup_${normalizedTopupId}`]
    : 0;
  if (!topKc) {
    return { ok: false, errorCode: 'UNKNOWN_SANDBOX_PLAN', kcInyectados: 0, montoMxn: 0, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: mem + top, nivel: currTierName };
  }
  const mxn = currW === 0 ? Number((topKc * 1.2).toFixed(2)) : topKc;
  const nextTop = top + topKc;
  return { ok: true, kcInyectados: topKc, montoMxn: mxn, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: nextTop, saldoKc: mem + nextTop, nivel: currTierName };
};

export interface IMonthlyStreakShieldInput {
  currentMonthKey: string;
  escudoMesIso?: string | null;
  escudosUsadosMes?: number;
  kcMembresia?: number;
  kcTopup?: number;
}
export interface IMonthlyStreakShieldResult {
  ok: boolean;
  errorCode?: 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ESCUDO';
  gratis: boolean;
  costoKc: number;
  escudoMesIso: string;
  escudosUsadosMes: number;
  kcMembresia: number;
  kcTopup: number;
  saldoKc: number;
}
export const STREAK_SHIELD_EXTRA_KC_COST = 25;

export const simulateMonthlyStreakShieldActivation = (input: IMonthlyStreakShieldInput): IMonthlyStreakShieldResult => {
  const monthKey = String(input.currentMonthKey || '').trim();
  const prevMonth = String(input.escudoMesIso || '').trim();
  const usedInWindow = prevMonth === monthKey ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input.escudosUsadosMes) || 0)) : 0;
  let mem = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.kcMembresia) || 0));
  let top = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.kcTopup) || 0));
  if (usedInWindow === 0) {
    return { ok: true, gratis: true, costoKc: 0, escudoMesIso: monthKey, escudosUsadosMes: 1, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: mem + top };
  }
  if (mem + top < STREAK_SHIELD_EXTRA_KC_COST) {
    return { ok: false, errorCode: 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ESCUDO', gratis: false, costoKc: STREAK_SHIELD_EXTRA_KC_COST, escudoMesIso: monthKey, escudosUsadosMes: usedInWindow, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: mem + top };
  }
  const useMem = Math.min(mem, STREAK_SHIELD_EXTRA_KC_COST);
  mem -= useMem;
  top -= STREAK_SHIELD_EXTRA_KC_COST - useMem;
  return { ok: true, gratis: false, costoKc: STREAK_SHIELD_EXTRA_KC_COST, escudoMesIso: monthKey, escudosUsadosMes: usedInWindow + 1, kcMembresia: mem, kcTopup: top, saldoKc: mem + top };
};

export interface IWebhookLedgerReceipt {
  eventId: string;
  paymentIntentId: string;
  userId: string;
  billetera: 'membresia' | 'topup';
  kcInyectados: number;
  montoMxn: number;
}

export const simulateStripeWebhookReceiptLedger = (
  events: IWebhookLedgerReceipt[]
): { processedEventIds: string[]; receipts: IWebhookLedgerReceipt[]; totalCreditedKc: number } => {
  const seenEvents = new Set<string>();
  const seenPaymentIntents = new Set<string>();
  const processedEventIds: string[] = [];
  const receipts: IWebhookLedgerReceipt[] = [];
  let totalCreditedKc = 0;
  for (const ev of events) {
    const eid = String(ev.eventId || '').trim();
    const pi = String(ev.paymentIntentId || '').trim() || eid;
    if (!eid || seenEvents.has(eid)) continue;
    seenEvents.add(eid);
    processedEventIds.push(eid);
    if (!seenPaymentIntents.has(pi)) {
      seenPaymentIntents.add(pi);
      receipts.push({ ...ev, eventId: eid, paymentIntentId: pi });
      totalCreditedKc += Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(ev.kcInyectados) || 0));
    }
  }
  return { processedEventIds, receipts, totalCreditedKc };
};

import { getMembershipByLevel } from '../constants/memberships';
import { getMazatlanNowParts, mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs } from './kineticVenueCanonicalGeoAndHours';

const FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MINUTES = 180;
const FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MS = FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

export interface IFlashPricingEventInput {
  nextTimestamp?: number | null;
  fecha_clase?: string | null;
  fecha_seleccionada?: string | null;
  fecha_proyectada?: string | null;
  fecha?: string | null;
  hora_inicio?: string | null;
  hora?: string | null;
  precio_base_kc?: number | string | null;
  precio_kc?: number | string | null;
  precio?: number | string | null;
  costo_total?: number | string | null;
  precioBaseKc?: number | string | null;
  es_venta_flash?: boolean | null;
  isFlashSale?: boolean | null;
  isFlashUrgent3h?: boolean | null;
  descuento_flash_pct?: number | string | null;
  atributos?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

export interface IResolveFlashVipDiscountParams {
  event: IFlashPricingEventInput | null | undefined;
  vipLevel?: string | null;
  kcMembresia?: number | null;
  isAdmin?: boolean;
  nowMs?: number;
  isEn?: boolean;
}

export interface IFlashVipDiscountPricing {
  basePriceKc: number;
  discountedTotalKc: number;
  escrow40: number;
  puerta60: number;
  discountPct: number;
  savingsKc: number;
  hasFlashDiscount: boolean;
  isFlashWindow: boolean;
  showFlashPromoBadge: boolean;
  resolvedVipLevel: string;
  flashBadgeText: string | null;
  minutesToStart: number | null;
}

const normalizeVipTierName = (rawLevel?: string | null, kcMembresia?: number | null): string => {
  const clean = String(rawLevel || '').trim();
  const lower = clean.toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || lower === 'acceso base' || lower === 'base access' || lower === 'free' || lower === 'ninguno') {
    const memKc = Number(kcMembresia) || 0;
    if (memKc >= 3600) return 'Platinum';
    if (memKc >= 2500) return 'Gold';
    if (memKc >= 1500) return 'Silver';
    if (memKc >= 600) return 'Bronze';
    return 'Acceso Base';
  }
  if (lower.startsWith('top-up') || lower.startsWith('topup')) {
    const memKc = Number(kcMembresia) || 0;
    if (memKc >= 3600) return 'Platinum';
    if (memKc >= 2500) return 'Gold';
    if (memKc >= 1500) return 'Silver';
    if (memKc >= 600) return 'Bronze';
    return 'Acceso Base';
  }
  if (lower.includes('platinum') || lower.includes('platino') || lower.includes('leyenda') || lower.includes('black')) {
    return 'Platinum';
  }
  if (lower.includes('gold') || lower.includes('oro')) return 'Gold';
  if (lower.includes('silver') || lower.includes('plata')) return 'Silver';
  if (lower.includes('bronze') || lower.includes('bronce')) return 'Bronze';
  return 'Acceso Base';
};

export const parseEventStartTimestampMazatlanMs = (ev: IFlashPricingEventInput | null | undefined): number | null => {
  if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object') return null;
  const rawSource = String(
    ev.fecha_clase || ev.fecha_seleccionada || ev.fecha_proyectada || ev.fecha || ''
  ).trim();
  const rawHora = String(ev.hora_inicio || ev.hora || '').trim();
  let rawDate = rawSource.split('T')[0].trim();

  if (/[T\s](?!00:00(?::00(?:\.0+)?)?(?:[zZ]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?$).+([zZ]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(rawSource)) {
    const parsed = new Date(rawSource);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      if (!rawHora) return parsed.getTime();
      rawDate = getMazatlanNowParts(parsed).isoDate;
    }
  }
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(rawDate)) {
    const [y, m, d] = rawDate.split('-').map(Number);
    const match = rawHora.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?/i);
    if (y && m && d && match) {
      let hh = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      const mm = Math.max(0, Math.min(59, parseInt(match[2], 10) || 0));
      const ss = Math.max(0, Math.min(59, parseInt(match[3] || '0', 10) || 0));
      const ampm = (match[4] || '').toLowerCase();
      if (ampm.startsWith('p') && hh < 12) hh += 12;
      if (ampm.startsWith('a') && hh === 12) hh = 0;
      hh = Math.max(0, Math.min(23, hh));
      const mzTs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(y, m, d, hh, mm, ss, 0);
      if (Number.isFinite(mzTs)) return mzTs;
    }
  }
  if (typeof ev.nextTimestamp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(ev.nextTimestamp) && ev.nextTimestamp > 0) {
    return ev.nextTimestamp;
  }
  return null;
};

export const resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing = ({
  event,
  vipLevel,
  kcMembresia,
  isAdmin = false,
  nowMs,
  isEn = false,
}: IResolveFlashVipDiscountParams): IFlashVipDiscountPricing => {
  const safeNowMs = typeof nowMs === 'number' && Number.isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
  const rawBase =
    event?.precio_base_kc ??
    event?.precio_kc ??
    event?.precio ??
    event?.costo_total ??
    event?.precioBaseKc ??
    0;
  const basePriceKc = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(rawBase) || 0));

  const startMs = parseEventStartTimestampMazatlanMs(event);
  const diffMs = startMs !== null ? startMs - safeNowMs : null;
  const within3hWindow = diffMs !== null && diffMs > 0 && diffMs <= FLASH_WINDOW_MAX_MS;
  const minutesToStart = diffMs !== null ? Math.round(diffMs / 60_000) : null;

  const explicitFlash = Boolean(
    event?.es_venta_flash ||
      event?.isFlashSale ||
      event?.isFlashUrgent3h ||
      event?.atributos?.es_venta_flash
  );
  const isFlashWindow = explicitFlash || within3hWindow;

  const resolvedVipLevel = normalizeVipTierName(vipLevel, kcMembresia);
  const membership = getMembershipByLevel(resolvedVipLevel);
  const tierPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(20, Number(membership?.descuento_flash) || 0));

  const rawAttrPct = Number(
    event?.atributos?.descuento_flash_pct ?? event?.descuento_flash_pct ?? 0
  );
  const attrPct = Number.isFinite(rawAttrPct) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(40, Math.round(rawAttrPct))) : 0;

  const eligibleVipPct = tierPct > 0 ? Math.min(40, Math.max(tierPct, attrPct)) : 0;
  const discountPct = !isAdmin && isFlashWindow && basePriceKc > 0 ? eligibleVipPct : 0;

  const discountedTotalKc =
    isAdmin || basePriceKc <= 0
      ? 0
      : Math.max(10, Math.round((basePriceKc * (100 - discountPct)) / 1000) * 10);
  const escrow40 =
    isAdmin || discountedTotalKc <= 0
      ? 0
      : discountedTotalKc >= 20
        ? Math.max(10, Math.min(discountedTotalKc - 10, Math.round((discountedTotalKc * 4) / 100) * 10))
        : 10;
  const puerta60 = isAdmin || discountedTotalKc <= 0 ? 0 : discountedTotalKc - escrow40;

  const savingsKc = isAdmin ? 0 : Math.max(0, basePriceKc - discountedTotalKc);
  const hasFlashDiscount = Boolean(!isAdmin && isFlashWindow && discountPct > 0 && savingsKc > 0);
  const showFlashPromoBadge = Boolean(isFlashWindow && basePriceKc > 0);

  const flashBadgeText = !showFlashPromoBadge
    ? null
    : isAdmin || discountPct <= 0
      ? isEn
        ? 'FLASH UP TO -20% VIP'
        : 'FLASH HASTA -20% VIP'
      : `FLASH -${discountPct}% ${resolvedVipLevel.toUpperCase()}`;

  return {
    basePriceKc,
    discountedTotalKc,
    escrow40,
    puerta60,
    discountPct,
    savingsKc,
    hasFlashDiscount,
    isFlashWindow,
    showFlashPromoBadge,
    resolvedVipLevel,
    flashBadgeText,
    minutesToStart,
  };
};

    // === src/services/kineticFounderWebPassLeaf.ts === //
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  CIPHER_PREFIX,
  decryptKineticString,
  encryptKineticString,
  getOrCreateWebSaltSync,
} from './kineticVaultCrypto';
import {
  PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY,
  readValidPrivateWebGrantSync,
  revokePrivateWebGrantSync,
} from './kineticWebPrivatePassLeaf';
import {
  WEB_COOKIE_FOUNDER,
  WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC,
  hasActiveWebOAuthReturnParams,
  readResilientWebMirror,
  removeResilientWebMirror,
  writeResilientWebMirror,
} from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

export const PUBLIC_WEB_APP_OPEN = false;
export const FOUNDER_WEB_DEVICE_PASS_KEY = '@kinetic_founder_web_device_v1';
export const FOUNDER_PASS_CHANGED_EVENT = 'kinetic:founder-pass-changed';
export const FOUNDER_PASS_TTL_MS = 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const POISON_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);
const EXEMPT_WEB_SEGMENTS = new Set(['', 'index', 'index.html', 'oauth', 'privacidad', 'terminos']);
const founderListeners = new Set<() => void>();

export interface IFounderWebDevicePass {
  v: 1;
  uid: string;
  email: string;
  issuedAtMs: number;
  expiresAtMs: number;
  issuer: 'is_kinetic_master_admin';
}

function hasPoisonKey(obj: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  for (const k of Object.keys(obj)) {
    if (POISON_KEYS.has(k)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function validateFounderPassObject(
  raw: unknown,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IFounderWebDevicePass | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return null;
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (hasPoisonKey(obj)) return null;
  if (obj.v !== 1 || obj.issuer !== 'is_kinetic_master_admin') return null;

  const uid = String(obj.uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const email = String(obj.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const issuedAtMs = Number(obj.issuedAtMs);
  const expiresAtMs = Number(obj.expiresAtMs);

  if (!UUID_RE.test(uid)) return null;
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email) || email.length > 120) return null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(issuedAtMs) || !Number.isFinite(expiresAtMs)) return null;
  if (issuedAtMs <= 0 || issuedAtMs > nowMs + 60_000) return null;
  if (expiresAtMs <= nowMs) return null;
  if (expiresAtMs - issuedAtMs > FOUNDER_PASS_TTL_MS + 60_000) return null;

  return {
    v: 1,
    uid,
    email,
    issuedAtMs,
    expiresAtMs,
    issuer: 'is_kinetic_master_admin',
  };
}

export function encodeFounderWebDevicePass(
  input: { uid: string; email: string; nowMs?: number },
  salt: string
): string {
  const now = Number.isFinite(input.nowMs) ? Number(input.nowMs) : Date.now();
  const cleanUid = String(input.uid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanEmail = String(input.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const candidate = validateFounderPassObject(
    {
      v: 1,
      uid: cleanUid,
      email: cleanEmail,
      issuedAtMs: now,
      expiresAtMs: now + FOUNDER_PASS_TTL_MS,
      issuer: 'is_kinetic_master_admin',
    },
    now
  );
  if (!candidate || !salt) {
    throw new Error('INVALID_FOUNDER_PASS_PAYLOAD');
  }
  return encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify(candidate), salt);
}

export function decodeFounderWebDevicePass(
  rawCipher: string | null | undefined,
  salt: string,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IFounderWebDevicePass | null {
  if (!rawCipher || typeof rawCipher !== 'string' || !rawCipher.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX) || !salt) {
    return null;
  }
  const plainJson = decryptKineticString(rawCipher, salt);
  if (!plainJson) return null;
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(plainJson);
    return validateFounderPassObject(parsed, nowMs);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
}

export function readValidFounderWebDevicePassSync(nowMs: number = Date.now()): IFounderWebDevicePass | null {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return null;
  }
  try {
    const raw = readResilientWebMirror(FOUNDER_WEB_DEVICE_PASS_KEY, WEB_COOKIE_FOUNDER);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const pass = decodeFounderWebDevicePass(raw, getOrCreateWebSaltSync(), nowMs);
    if (!pass) {
      removeResilientWebMirror(FOUNDER_WEB_DEVICE_PASS_KEY, WEB_COOKIE_FOUNDER);
      return null;
    }
    return pass;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
}

function notifyFounderListeners(): void {
  founderListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try { fn(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  });
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(FOUNDER_PASS_CHANGED_EVENT)); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  }
}

export function writeFounderWebDevicePassSync(
  uid: string,
  email: string,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): boolean {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const salt = getOrCreateWebSaltSync();
    const cipher = encodeFounderWebDevicePass({ uid, email, nowMs }, salt);
    writeResilientWebMirror(FOUNDER_WEB_DEVICE_PASS_KEY, cipher, WEB_COOKIE_FOUNDER, WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC);
    notifyFounderListeners();
    return true;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return false;
  }
}

export function revokeFounderWebDevicePassSync(): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  removeResilientWebMirror(FOUNDER_WEB_DEVICE_PASS_KEY, WEB_COOKIE_FOUNDER);
  revokePrivateWebGrantSync();
  notifyFounderListeners();
}

export function subscribeFounderWebDevicePass(listener: () => void): () => void {
  founderListeners.add(listener);
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const onStorage = (ev: StorageEvent) => {
      if (!ev.key || ev.key === FOUNDER_WEB_DEVICE_PASS_KEY || ev.key === PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY) listener();
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    window.addEventListener(FOUNDER_PASS_CHANGED_EVENT, listener);
    return () => {
      founderListeners.delete(listener);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage);
      window.removeEventListener(FOUNDER_PASS_CHANGED_EVENT, listener);
    };
  }
  return () => {
    founderListeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

export function isWebAppPubliclyAccessibleSync(opts?: {
  publicOpen?: boolean;
  hasFounderPass?: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return true;
  const isOpen = opts?.publicOpen ?? PUBLIC_WEB_APP_OPEN;
  if (isOpen) return true;
  if (typeof opts?.hasFounderPass === 'boolean') return opts.hasFounderPass;
  return Boolean(readValidFounderWebDevicePassSync() || readValidPrivateWebGrantSync());
}

function normalizePathRootSegment(rawPath: string | undefined): string {
  const cleanPath = String(rawPath || '').split('?')[0].split('#')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  const stripped = cleanPath.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  if (!stripped) return '';
  return stripped.split('/')[0] || '';
}

export function shouldBlockWebRoutePreLaunch(params: {
  platformOs: string;
  rootSegment?: string;
  pathname?: string;
  search?: string;
  hash?: string;
  publicOpen?: boolean;
  hasFounderPass?: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (params.platformOs !== 'web') return false;
  const isOpen = params.publicOpen ?? PUBLIC_WEB_APP_OPEN;
  if (isOpen) return false;
  const seg = String(params.rootSegment || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const pathSeg = normalizePathRootSegment(params.pathname);
  if (seg === 'oauth' || pathSeg === 'oauth' || hasActiveWebOAuthReturnParams(params.search, params.hash)) {
    return false;
  }
  const hasPass =
    typeof params.hasFounderPass === 'boolean'
      ? params.hasFounderPass
      : Boolean(readValidFounderWebDevicePassSync() || readValidPrivateWebGrantSync());
  if (hasPass) return false;

  if (seg && !EXEMPT_WEB_SEGMENTS.has(seg)) return true;
  if (pathSeg && !EXEMPT_WEB_SEGMENTS.has(pathSeg)) return true;
  return false;
}

export function tapFounderCopyrightCounter(
  prevCount: number,
  prevTapMs: number,
  nowMs: number,
  windowMs = 2800
): { count: number; triggered: boolean } {
  const safeNow = Number.isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
  const withinWindow = prevTapMs > 0 && safeNow - prevTapMs <= windowMs && safeNow >= prevTapMs;
  const next = withinWindow ? prevCount + 1 : 1;
  if (next >= 5) return { count: 0, triggered: true };
  return { count: next, triggered: false };
}
