export interface IMazatlanIsoWeekInfo {
  weekKey: string;
  mondayIso: string;
  sundayIso: string;
  todayIso: string;
  monthIso: string;
  isoDow: number;
}

const pad2 = (n: number): string => String(Math.floor(n)).padStart(2, '0');

export function getMazatlanIsoWeekInfo(nowMs: number = Date.now()): IMazatlanIsoWeekInfo {
  const m = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs));
  const todayUtc = new Date(Date.UTC(m.year, m.month - 1, m.day));
  const isoDow = todayUtc.getUTCDay() || 7;
  const monday = new Date(todayUtc.getTime() - (isoDow - 1) * 86_400_000);
  const sunday = new Date(monday.getTime() + 6 * 86_400_000);
  const thursday = new Date(monday.getTime() + 3 * 86_400_000);
  const isoYear = thursday.getUTCFullYear();
  const jan4 = new Date(Date.UTC(isoYear, 0, 4));
  const jan4Dow = jan4.getUTCDay() || 7;
  const isoWeek1Mon = new Date(jan4.getTime() - (jan4Dow - 1) * 86_400_000);
  const weekNo = Math.floor((monday.getTime() - isoWeek1Mon.getTime()) / (7 * 86_400_000)) + 1;
  return {
    weekKey: `steel_contract_${isoYear}-w${pad2(weekNo)}`,
    mondayIso: `${monday.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(monday.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(monday.getUTCDate())}`,
    sundayIso: `${sunday.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(sunday.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(sunday.getUTCDate())}`,
    todayIso: m.isoDate,
    monthIso: `${m.year}-${pad2(m.month)}`,
    isoDow,
  };
}

export function isVerifiedEligibleTrainingReservation(row: IGamificationReservaRow | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return false;
  if (row.es_pase_maestro === true) return false;
  const estado = String(row.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (estado === 'cancelada' || estado === 'no_show') return false;
  if (estado === 'completada' || estado === 'usada') return true;
  return Boolean(row.qr_usado_at && estado !== 'pendiente');
}

export function resolveReservaMazatlanDateIso(row: IGamificationReservaRow | null | undefined): string {
  if (!row) return '';
  const fc = String(row.fecha_clase || row.fecha || '').trim().slice(0, 10);
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(fc)) return fc;
  const rawTs = row.qr_usado_at || row.created_at;
  if (!rawTs) return '';
  const ms = parseMazatlanTimestampMs(String(rawTs));
  if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return String(rawTs).slice(0, 10);
  return getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(ms)).isoDate;
}

export interface ISteelContractEvaluation {
  weekKey: string;
  completedWeekSessions: number;
  target: 4;
  progressPct: number;
  claimedThisWeek: boolean;
  eligibleToClaim: boolean;
  rewardXp: 150;
}

export function evaluateSteelContract4x4Truth(
  reservas: ReadonlyArray<IGamificationReservaRow>,
  claimedKeys: ReadonlyArray<string>,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): ISteelContractEvaluation {
  const wk = getMazatlanIsoWeekInfo(nowMs);
  let completedWeekSessions = 0;
  for (const r of Array.isArray(reservas) ? reservas : []) {
    if (!isVerifiedEligibleTrainingReservation(r)) continue;
    const dIso = resolveReservaMazatlanDateIso(r);
    if (dIso >= wk.mondayIso && dIso <= wk.sundayIso) completedWeekSessions += 1;
  }
  const claimedSet = new Set((Array.isArray(claimedKeys) ? claimedKeys : []).map((k) => String(k || '').trim().toLowerCase()));
  const claimedThisWeek = claimedSet.has(wk.weekKey);
  const clamped = Math.min(4, completedWeekSessions);
  return {
    weekKey: wk.weekKey,
    completedWeekSessions,
    target: 4,
    progressPct: Math.min(100, Math.round((clamped / 4) * 100)),
    claimedThisWeek,
    eligibleToClaim: completedWeekSessions >= 4 && !claimedThisWeek,
    rewardXp: 150,
  };
}

export interface IMonthlyPassTruth {
  hasActiveMembership: boolean;
  monthIso: string;
  daysLeftInMonth: number;
  daysUntilCut: number;
  nextCutDateIso: string;
  monthSessionsVerified: number;
  monthXp: number;
}

export function evaluateMonthlyPassTruth(
  profile: IGamificationProfileRow | null | undefined,
  reservas: ReadonlyArray<IGamificationReservaRow>,
  monthlyClaimedBonusXp: number = 0,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IMonthlyPassTruth {
  const m = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs));
  const monthIso = `${m.year}-${pad2(m.month)}`;
  const lastDom = new Date(Date.UTC(m.year, m.month, 0)).getUTCDate();
  const daysLeftInMonth = Math.max(1, lastDom - m.day + 1);
  const nivelLow = String(profile?.nivel || 'Acceso Base').trim().toLowerCase();
  const kcMem = Math.max(0, Number(profile?.kc_membresia) || 0);
  const hasActiveMembership = (nivelLow !== 'acceso base' && nivelLow !== 'base') || kcMem > 0;

  let daysUntilCut = daysLeftInMonth;
  let nextCutDateIso = `${monthIso}-${pad2(lastDom)}`;
  if (hasActiveMembership && profile?.fecha_activacion_membresia) {
    const actMs = parseMazatlanTimestampMs(String(profile.fecha_activacion_membresia));
    if (Number.isFinite(actMs)) {
      const actP = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(actMs));
      const todayUtc = Date.UTC(m.year, m.month - 1, m.day);
      const actUtc = Date.UTC(actP.year, actP.month - 1, actP.day);
      const elapsed = Math.max(0, Math.floor((todayUtc - actUtc) / 86_400_000));
      const nextCutUtc = actUtc + (Math.floor(elapsed / 30) + 1) * 30 * 86_400_000;
      daysUntilCut = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, Math.round((nextCutUtc - todayUtc) / 86_400_000)));
      nextCutDateIso = new Date(nextCutUtc).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
  }

  let monthSessionsVerified = 0;
  for (const r of Array.isArray(reservas) ? reservas : []) {
    if (!isVerifiedEligibleTrainingReservation(r)) continue;
    if (resolveReservaMazatlanDateIso(r).startsWith(monthIso)) monthSessionsVerified += 1;
  }

  const monthXp = Math.max(0, monthSessionsVerified * 50 + Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(monthlyClaimedBonusXp) || 0)));
  return {
    hasActiveMembership,
    monthIso,
    daysLeftInMonth,
    daysUntilCut,
    nextCutDateIso,
    monthSessionsVerified,
    monthXp,
  };
}

export interface IStreakDayNodeD1ToD7 {
  dayIndex: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7;
  dateMzt: string;
  isFuture: boolean;
  isToday: boolean;
  hasVerifiedActivity: boolean;
  isShielded: boolean;
  lit: boolean;
}

export function evaluateWeeklyStreakD1ToD7Mazatlan(
  profile: IGamificationProfileRow | null | undefined,
  reservas: ReadonlyArray<IGamificationReservaRow>,
  claimedKeys: ReadonlyArray<string>,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IStreakDayNodeD1ToD7[] {
  const wk = getMazatlanIsoWeekInfo(nowMs);
  const [my, mm, md] = wk.mondayIso.split('-').map(Number);
  const mondayUtc = Date.UTC(my, mm - 1, md);
  const activeDates = new Set<string>();
  for (const r of Array.isArray(reservas) ? reservas : []) {
    if (!isVerifiedEligibleTrainingReservation(r)) continue;
    const dIso = resolveReservaMazatlanDateIso(r);
    if (dIso >= wk.mondayIso && dIso <= wk.todayIso) activeDates.add(dIso);
  }
  const claimedSet = new Set((Array.isArray(claimedKeys) ? claimedKeys : []).map((k) => String(k || '').trim().toLowerCase()));
  const shieldUntilMs = profile?.escudo_activo_hasta || profile?.escudo_racha_activo_hasta
    ? parseMazatlanTimestampMs(String(profile.escudo_activo_hasta || profile.escudo_racha_activo_hasta))
    : NaN;
  const shieldActiveNow = (Number.isFinite(shieldUntilMs) && shieldUntilMs > nowMs) || claimedSet.has(`escudo_activado_${wk.todayIso}`);
  const rachaDias = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(profile?.racha_dias ?? profile?.racha ?? 0) || 0));
  const lastStreakIso = String(profile?.ultima_fecha_racha || '').slice(0, 10);
  const hasAnchoredStreak = rachaDias > 0 && (!lastStreakIso || (lastStreakIso >= wk.mondayIso && lastStreakIso <= wk.todayIso));

  return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((idx) => {
    const dayIdx = idx as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7;
    const d = new Date(mondayUtc + (idx - 1) * 86_400_000);
    const dateMzt = `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getUTCDate())}`;
    const isFuture = idx > wk.isoDow;
    const isToday = dateMzt === wk.todayIso;
    if (isFuture) {
      return { dayIndex: dayIdx, dateMzt, isFuture: true, isToday: false, hasVerifiedActivity: false, isShielded: false, lit: false };
    }
    const withinAnchoredStreak = hasAnchoredStreak && wk.isoDow - idx < Math.min(rachaDias, wk.isoDow);
    const hasVerifiedActivity = activeDates.has(dateMzt) || withinAnchoredStreak;
    const isShielded = claimedSet.has(`escudo_activado_${dateMzt}`) || (isToday && shieldActiveNow);
    return { dayIndex: dayIdx, dateMzt, isFuture: false, isToday, hasVerifiedActivity, isShielded, lit: hasVerifiedActivity || isShielded };
  });
}

export interface IShield24hMonthlyTruth {
  activeNow: boolean;
  monthIso: string;
  usedThisMonth: number;
  nextCostKc: 0 | 25;
  claimKeyToday: string;
}

export function evaluateShield24hMonthlyTruth(
  profile: IGamificationProfileRow | null | undefined,
  claimedKeys: ReadonlyArray<string>,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IShield24hMonthlyTruth {
  const m = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs));
  const monthIso = `${m.year}-${pad2(m.month)}`;
  const claimKeyToday = `escudo_activado_${m.isoDate}`;
  const claimedSet = new Set((Array.isArray(claimedKeys) ? claimedKeys : []).map((k) => String(k || '').trim().toLowerCase()));
  const usedThisMonth = String(profile?.escudo_mes_iso || '') === monthIso ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(profile?.escudos_usados_mes) || 0)) : 0;
  const shieldUntilMs = profile?.escudo_activo_hasta || profile?.escudo_racha_activo_hasta
    ? parseMazatlanTimestampMs(String(profile.escudo_activo_hasta || profile.escudo_racha_activo_hasta))
    : NaN;
  const activeNow = claimedSet.has(claimKeyToday) || (Number.isFinite(shieldUntilMs) && shieldUntilMs > nowMs);
  return { activeNow, monthIso, usedThisMonth, nextCostKc: usedThisMonth === 0 ? 0 : 25, claimKeyToday };
}

export function simulateShield24hAtomicCharge(
  state: { kcMembresia: number; kcTopup: number; escudoMesIso?: string | null; escudosUsadosMes?: number | null; claimedKeys?: string[] },
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): { ok: boolean; duplicate?: boolean; errorCode?: 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ESCUDO'; costKc: number; nextMembresia: number; nextTopup: number; nextUsedMes: number; monthIso: string; nextClaimed: string[] } {
  const m = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs));
  const monthIso = `${m.year}-${pad2(m.month)}`;
  const dayKey = `escudo_activado_${m.isoDate}`;
  const claimed = Array.isArray(state.claimedKeys) ? [...state.claimedKeys] : [];
  const kcMem = Math.max(0, Number(state.kcMembresia) || 0);
  const kcTop = Math.max(0, Number(state.kcTopup) || 0);
  const usedPrev = String(state.escudoMesIso || '') === monthIso ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.escudosUsadosMes) || 0)) : 0;

  if (claimed.map((k) => k.toLowerCase()).includes(dayKey)) {
    return { ok: true, duplicate: true, costKc: 0, nextMembresia: kcMem, nextTopup: kcTop, nextUsedMes: usedPrev, monthIso, nextClaimed: claimed };
  }
  const costKc = usedPrev === 0 ? 0 : 25;
  if (kcMem + kcTop < costKc) {
    return { ok: false, errorCode: 'SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ESCUDO', costKc, nextMembresia: kcMem, nextTopup: kcTop, nextUsedMes: usedPrev, monthIso, nextClaimed: claimed };
  }
  const useMem = Math.min(kcMem, costKc);
  const useTop = costKc - useMem;
  return {
    ok: true,
    duplicate: false,
    costKc,
    nextMembresia: kcMem - useMem,
    nextTopup: kcTop - useTop,
    nextUsedMes: usedPrev + 1,
    monthIso,
    nextClaimed: Array.from(new Set([...claimed, `escudo_racha_${m.isoDate}`, dayKey])),
  };
}

export function evaluateDailyShareBonusTruth(
  claimedKeys: ReadonlyArray<string>,
  currentXpTotal: number,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): { claimKeyToday: string; claimedToday: boolean; rewardXp: 15; projectedXpIfClaimedNow: number } {
  const m = getMazatlanNowParts(new Date(nowMs));
  const claimKeyToday = `share_progress_${m.isoDate}`;
  const claimedSet = new Set((Array.isArray(claimedKeys) ? claimedKeys : []).map((k) => String(k || '').trim().toLowerCase()));
  const claimedToday = claimedSet.has(claimKeyToday);
  const baseXp = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(currentXpTotal) || 0));
  return { claimKeyToday, claimedToday, rewardXp: 15, projectedXpIfClaimedNow: claimedToday ? baseXp : baseXp + 15 };
}

export const normalizeRadarText = (val?: unknown): string =>
  String(val ?? '')
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

export const canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey = (rawName?: unknown): string => {
  const norm = normalizeRadarText(rawName).replace(/&/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  if (norm === 'palestra club' || norm.includes('palesttra')) return 'palesttra club';
  if (/baja\s+fitness.*medano/.test(norm)) return 'baja fitness medano';
  if (norm.includes('incorfit')) return 'incorfit barre & reformer studio';
  if (norm.includes('cabo yoga')) return 'cabo yoga & fitness center';
  if (norm.includes('el tule fitness')) return 'el tule fitness & crossfit';
  if (norm.includes('elemental strength')) return 'elemental strength studio';
  if (norm.includes('truefit cabo')) return 'truefit cabo studio';
  if (norm.includes('f45 training san jose')) return 'f45 training san jose del cabo';
  if (norm.includes('fitbox')) return 'fitbox cabo boxing studio';
  if (norm.includes('fortress fitness')) return 'fortress fitness gym';
  if (norm.includes('seal cross')) return 'seal crosstraining';
  if (norm.includes('seis24')) return 'seis24 strength & conditioning';
  if (norm.includes('tropical fitness')) return 'tropical fitness center';
  if (norm.includes('cagers')) return 'cagers gym mma & muay thai';
  return norm;
};

export async function loadGoogleIdentityServicesSdk(): Promise<IGoogleGisIdApi> {

      (document.getElementById(GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_ID) as HTMLScriptElement | null) || document.createElement('script');
    const cleanupListeners = () => {
      targetScript.removeEventListener('load', onDone);
      targetScript.removeEventListener('error', onFail);
    };
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      cleanupListeners();
      targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'error';
      targetScript.remove();
      reject(new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_TIMEOUT'));
    }, 10_000);
    const onDone = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      cleanupListeners();
      targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'ready';
      resolve();
    };
    const onFail = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      cleanupListeners();
      targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'error';
      targetScript.remove();
      reject(new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_LOAD_FAILED'));
    };
    if (targetScript.parentNode) {
      targetScript.addEventListener('load', onDone, { once: true });
      targetScript.addEventListener('error', onFail, { once: true });
      return;
    }
    targetScript.id = GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_ID;
    targetScript.src = GOOGLE_GIS_SCRIPT_SRC;
    targetScript.async = true;
    targetScript.defer = true;
    targetScript.dataset.kineticGisState = 'loading';
    targetScript.addEventListener('load', onDone, { once: true });
    targetScript.addEventListener('error', onFail, { once: true });
    document.head.appendChild(targetScript);

  if (!loaded) throw new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_UNAVAILABLE');

}

export async function mountKineticGoogleGisWidget(params: {
  container: HTMLElement;
  nonceHash: string;
  onCredential: (idToken: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onError: (err: Error) => void;
  locale?: string;
  isAborted?: () => boolean;
}): Promise<() => void> {
  const gisId = await loadGoogleIdentityServicesSdk();
  if (params.isAborted?.()) return () => {};
  const clientId = resolveGoogleWebClientId();
  let consumed = false;
  gisId.initialize({
    client_id: clientId,
    nonce: params.nonceHash,
    ux_mode: 'popup',
    auto_select: false,
    context: 'signin',
    use_fedcm_for_prompt: true,
    itp_support: true,
    callback: async (resp: { credential?: string }) => {
      if (consumed || params.isAborted?.()) return;
      consumed = true;
      const idToken = String(resp?.credential || '').trim();
      const claims = validateGoogleIdTokenClaims(idToken, {
        expectedNonceHash: params.nonceHash,
        expectedClientId: clientId,
      });
      if (!claims.ok) {
        params.onError(new Error('OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID'));
        return;
      }
      await params.onCredential(idToken);
    },
  });
  if (params.isAborted?.()) return () => {};
  gisId.renderButton(params.container, {
    theme: 'filled_black',
    size: 'large',
    shape: 'pill',
    text: 'continue_with',
    width: 280,
    locale: params.locale || 'es',
  });
  try {
    if (!params.isAborted?.()) gisId.prompt();
  } catch {}
  return () => {
    consumed = true;
    try { gisId.cancel?.(); } catch {}
  };
}

export async function runWebGoogleGisSignIn(
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b',
  options?: {
    onBeforeTokenExchange?: () => void;
    registerCleanup?: (cleanupFn: (() => void) | null) => void;
  }
): Promise<{ status: 'success'; user: User; session: Session } | { status: 'cancelled' } | { status: 'redirecting' }> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    throw new Error('GOOGLE_GIS_WEB_ONLY');
  }
  if (String(window.location.hostname || '').toLowerCase() === 'www.kineticapp.com.mx') {
    assignTopWindowLocation(`${KINETIC_CANONICAL_ORIGIN}/login`);
    return { status: 'cancelled' };
  }
  const isEn = getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en';
  const challenge = generateOidcNonceAndState('web', mode);
  if (isAppleWebKitOrMobileBrowser()) {
    writeResilientWebMirror('@kinetic_pending_oauth_mode_v1', mode, WEB_COOKIE_OAUTH_MODE, WEB_OAUTH_COOKIE_TTL_SEC);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem('@kinetic_pending_oauth_mode_v1', mode).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
    await persistPendingOidcChallenge({ ...challenge, mode, createdAtMs: Date.now() });
    setOidcReturnTransitionActive(true);
    const authUrl = buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl({
      redirectUri: KINETIC_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI,
      nonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
      state: challenge.state,
    });
    assignTopWindowLocation(authUrl);
    return { status: 'redirecting' };
  }

  return new Promise<{ status: 'success'; user: User; session: Session } | { status: 'cancelled' }>((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    let aborted = false;
    let cancelGis: () => void = () => {};
    document.getElementById('kinetic-google-gis-overlay')?.remove();

    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'kinetic-google-gis-overlay';
    overlay.style.cssText =
      'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999999;background:rgba(5,5,5,0.82);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;';

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText =
      'width:100%;max-width:360px;background:#090C12;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.45);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);color:#FFFFFF;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;text-align:center;';

    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.textContent = isEn ? 'Continue with Google' : 'Continuar con Google';
    title.style.cssText = 'font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0.3px;margin-bottom:6px;';

    const subtitle = document.createElement('div');
    subtitle.textContent = 'Kinetic • kineticapp.com.mx';
    subtitle.style.cssText = 'font-size:12px;color:#94A3B8;margin-bottom:18px;';

    const btnHost = document.createElement('div');
    btnHost.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;margin-bottom:16px;';

    const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
    cancelBtn.type = 'button';
    cancelBtn.textContent = isEn ? 'Cancel' : 'Cancelar';
    cancelBtn.style.cssText =
      'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);color:#CBD5E1;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;';

    const cleanup = () => {
      aborted = true;
      options?.registerCleanup?.(null);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      clearTimeout(maxTimer);
      cancelGis();
      overlay.remove();
    };
    const onCancel = () => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      cleanup();
      resolve({ status: 'cancelled' });
    };
    options?.registerCleanup?.(onCancel);
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onCancel(); };
    const maxTimer = setTimeout(onCancel, 180_000);
    cancelBtn.onclick = onCancel;
    overlay.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) onCancel(); };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);

    card.append(title, subtitle, btnHost, cancelBtn);
    overlay.appendChild(card);
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    mountKineticGoogleGisWidget({
      container: btnHost,
      nonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
      locale: isEn ? 'en' : 'es',
      isAborted: () => aborted || settled,
      onError: (err) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        reject(err);
      },
      onCredential: async (idToken) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        try {
          options?.onBeforeTokenExchange?.();
          const { data, error } = await exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(idToken, challenge.rawNonce);
          if (error) { reject(error); return; }
          if (!data?.user || !data?.session) { reject(new Error('OIDC_SESSION_EMPTY')); return; }
          resolve({ status: 'success', user: data.user, session: data.session });
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      },
    })
      .then((dispose) => {
        if (aborted || settled) { dispose(); return; }
        cancelGis = dispose;
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        reject(err);
      });
  });
}

export interface PendingOidcChallenge { rawNonce: string; nonceHash: string; state: string; mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b'; createdAtMs: number; }

export function resolveGoogleWebClientId(): string {
  try {
    const rawEnv = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process?.env?.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID : undefined;
    const fromEnv = typeof rawEnv === 'string' ? rawEnv.trim() : '';
    let fromExtra = '';
    try {
      const extraRaw = (Constants?.expoConfig?.extra as { googleWebClientId?: unknown } | undefined)?.googleWebClientId;
      fromExtra = typeof extraRaw === 'string' ? extraRaw.trim() : '';
    } catch (err) { void err; fromExtra = ''; }
    const candidate = fromEnv || fromExtra || DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID;
    if (
      !/^[0-9]{6,}-[a-z0-9_-]+\.apps\.googleusercontent\.com$/i.test(candidate) ||
      /secret|gocsp|supabase\.co|\s/i.test(candidate)
    ) {
      return DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID;
    }
    return candidate;
  } catch (err) { void err; return DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID; }
}

export const KINETIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID = DEFAULT_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID;

const encodeUtf8BytesPure = (str: string): Uint8Array => {
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') return new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const encoded = unescape(encodeURIComponent(str));
  return Uint8Array.from(encoded, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);
};

export function sha256HexOidc(input: string): string {
  const digest = sha256BytesSync(encodeUtf8BytesPure(String(input ?? '')));
  return Array.from(digest, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').toLowerCase();
}

const randomHexBytes = (byteCount: number): string => {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteCount);
  const gCrypto = (globalThis as { crypto?: { getRandomValues?: (arr: Uint8Array) => Uint8Array } })?.crypto;
  if (!gCrypto || typeof gCrypto.getRandomValues !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('SECURE_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE');
  }
  gCrypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  return Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
};

export function generateOidcNonceAndState(platform: 'web' | 'native', mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): { rawNonce: string; nonceHash: string; state: string } {
  const safePlatform: 'web' | 'native' = platform === 'native' ? 'native' : 'web';
  const safeMode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = mode === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c';
  const rawNonce = randomHexBytes(24);
  const nonceHash = sha256HexOidc(rawNonce);
  return { rawNonce, nonceHash, state: `knt1.${safePlatform}.${safeMode}.${randomHexBytes(16)}` };

export function parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(rawState: unknown, expectedState?: string | null): ParsedKineticOidcState | null {
  if (typeof rawState !== 'string') return null;

  if (!clean || clean.length > 96 || POISONED_KEYS.has(clean.toLowerCase())) return null;
  const match = OIDC_STATE_RE.exec(clean);
  if (!match || (expectedState != null && clean !== String(expectedState).trim())) return null;
  return { valid: true, platform: match[1] as 'web' | 'native', mode: match[2] as 'b2c' | 'b2b', csrf: match[3] };
}

export function buildGoogleOidcAuthorizeUrl(params: { clientId?: string; redirectUri?: string; nonceHash: string; state: string }): string {
  const clientId = String(params?.clientId || resolveGoogleWebClientId()).trim();

  url.searchParams.set('prompt', 'select_account');
  url.searchParams.set('nonce', nonceHash);

  return url.toString();
}

const B64_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';

const decodeBase64BytesPure = (b64: string): Uint8Array | null => {
  const clean = b64.replace(/=+$/, '');
  if (clean.length % 4 === 1) return null;
  const out = new Uint8Array(Math.floor((clean.length * 3) / 4));
  let ptr = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += 4) {
    const c0 = B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i]);
    const c1 = B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i + 1]);
    const c2 = i + 2 < clean.length ? B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i + 2]) : 0;
    const c3 = i + 3 < clean.length ? B64_ALPHABET.indexOf(clean[i + 3]) : 0;
    if (c0 < 0 || c1 < 0 || c2 < 0 || c3 < 0) return null;
    const n = (c0 << 18) | (c1 << 12) | (c2 << 6) | c3;
    out[ptr++] = (n >>> 16) & 0xff;
    if (i + 2 < clean.length) out[ptr++] = (n >>> 8) & 0xff;
    if (i + 3 < clean.length) out[ptr++] = n & 0xff;
  }
  return out;
};

const decodeBase64UrlJsonSafe = (segment: string): Record<string, unknown> | null => {
  if (!segment || typeof segment !== 'string' || segment.length > 4096) return null;
  try {
    const normalized = segment.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const padLen = (4 - (normalized.length % 4)) % 4;
    const bytes = decodeBase64BytesPure(normalized + '='.repeat(padLen));
    if (!bytes) return null;
    const decoded =
      typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined'
        ? new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)
        : decodeURIComponent(escape(Array.from(bytes, (b) => String.fromCharCode(b)).join('')));

    for (const key of Object.keys(parsed)) {
      if (POISONED_KEYS.has(key)) return null;
    }
    return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch (err) { void err; return null; }
};

  if (!header || !payload) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const iss = String(payload.iss || '').trim();
  if (!GOOGLE_ISSUERS.has(iss)) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const exp = Number(payload.exp);
  const nowSec = Number.isFinite(options?.nowSec) ? Number(options?.nowSec) : Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (!Number.isFinite(exp) || exp <= nowSec - 30) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const expectedAud = String(options?.expectedClientId || resolveGoogleWebClientId()).trim();
  if (!expectedAud) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const audMatches = Array.isArray(payload.aud)
    ? payload.aud.includes(expectedAud)
    : String(payload.aud || '').trim() === expectedAud;
  if (!audMatches) return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  const tokenNonce = typeof payload.nonce === 'string' ? payload.nonce.trim() : null;
  const expectedNonce = String(options?.expectedNonceHash || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!expectedNonce || !tokenNonce || tokenNonce !== expectedNonce) {
    return { ok: false, nonce: null };
  }
  return { ok: true, nonce: tokenNonce };
}

const isAllowedOidcCallbackTarget = (candidateUrl: string): boolean => {
  const clean = candidateUrl.trim();
  if (!clean || clean.length > 8192 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s]/.test(clean) || clean.startsWith('//') || clean.includes('..')) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/^kinetic:\/\//i.test(clean)) {
    const authority = clean.slice('kinetic://'.length).split(/[/?#]/)[0] || '';
    return !authority.includes('@') && /^kinetic:\/\/(?:login|oauth|auth\/callback)(?:[/?#].*)?$/i.test(clean);
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    return (
      parsed.protocol === 'https:' &&
      parsed.hostname.toLowerCase() === 'kineticapp.com.mx' &&
      !parsed.username &&
      !parsed.password
    );
  } catch (err) { void err; return false; }
};

export function extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(
  callbackUrl: unknown,
  options?: { expectedState?: string | null; expectedNonceHash?: string | null; expectedClientId?: string | null; nowSec?: number }
): ExtractedGoogleIdToken | null {
  if (typeof callbackUrl !== 'string') return null;
  const cleanUrl = callbackUrl.trim();
  if (!isAllowedOidcCallbackTarget(cleanUrl)) return null;
  const qPart = cleanUrl.includes('?') ? cleanUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] || '' : '';
  const hPart = cleanUrl.includes('#') ? cleanUrl.split('#')[1] || '' : '';
  let idToken = '';
  let rawState: string | null = null;
  for (const part of [hPart, qPart]) {
    if (!part) continue;
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams(part);
      if (p.get('error') || p.get('error_description')) return null;
      if (!idToken && p.get('id_token')) idToken = String(p.get('id_token') || '').trim();
      if (!rawState && p.get('state')) rawState = String(p.get('state') || '').trim();
    } catch (err) { void err; return null; }
  }
  if (!idToken || !rawState) return null;
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(rawState, options?.expectedState);
  if (!parsedState) return null;
  const claims = validateGoogleIdTokenClaims(idToken, {
    expectedNonceHash: options?.expectedNonceHash,
    expectedClientId: options?.expectedClientId,
    nowSec: options?.nowSec,
  });
  if (!claims.ok) return null;
  return { idToken, state: rawState, mode: parsedState.mode, nonce: claims.nonce };
}

export function buildNativeKineticIdTokenDeepLink(idToken: string, state: string): string {
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(state);
  if (!parsedState || parsedState.platform !== 'native') {
    throw new Error('OIDC_NATIVE_STATE_INVALID');

  if (typeof idToken !== 'string' || !JWT_3_PARTS_RE.test(idToken.trim()) || idToken.length > 8192) {

  }
  return `${KINETIC_NATIVE_OIDC_DEEP_LINK}#id_token=${encodeURIComponent(idToken.trim())}&state=${encodeURIComponent(state.trim())}`;
}

export async function verifyAndExchangeNativeGoogleOidcUrl(callbackUrl: string) {
  const cleanUrl = typeof callbackUrl === 'string' ? callbackUrl.trim() : '';
  if (!cleanUrl || !isAllowedOidcCallbackTarget(cleanUrl)) throw new Error('OIDC_CALLBACK_INVALID');
  if (_inflightNativeExchange?.url === cleanUrl) return _inflightNativeExchange.promise;
  const runPromise = (async () => {
    const peeked = await peekPendingOidcChallenge();
    if (!peeked) throw new Error('OIDC_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED');
    const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(cleanUrl, { expectedState: peeked.state, expectedNonceHash: peeked.nonceHash, expectedClientId: resolveGoogleWebClientId() });
    if (!extracted) throw new Error('OIDC_CALLBACK_INVALID');
    const consumed = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
    if (!consumed || consumed.state !== peeked.state) throw new Error('OIDC_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED');

    if (authRes.error) throw authRes.error;
    return authRes;
  })();
  _inflightNativeExchange = { url: cleanUrl, promise: runPromise };
  try { return await runPromise; }
  finally { if (_inflightNativeExchange?.promise === runPromise) _inflightNativeExchange = null; }
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync } from './kineticBiometricVaultService';
import { KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY, decodeStoredJson } from './kineticSessionLeafCore';
import {
  BIOMETRIC_LOGIN_ENABLED_KEY,
  CIPHER_PREFIX,
  DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY,
  SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY,
  decryptKineticString,
  encryptKineticString,
  ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync,
  getOrCreateWebSaltSync,
  purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys,
} from './kineticVaultCrypto';

const LEGACY_KEY_B2C = '@kinetic_biometric_creds_b2c_v1';
const LEGACY_KEY_B2B = '@kinetic_biometric_creds_b2b_v1';
const LEGACY_MAP_KEY = '@kinetic_saved_accounts_map_v2';
const LEGACY_V2_KEY = '@kinetic_saved_accounts_v2';

const LEGACY_PURGED_DEMO_EMAILS = new Set([
  'kinetic@kinetic.com',
  'atleta@kinetic.com',
  'demo.atleta@kineticapp.com.mx',
  'club@kinetic.com',
  'especialista@kinetic.com',
  'apple.tester@kineticapp.com.mx',
]);

const MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET = new Set([
  'administrador@kinetic.com.mx',
  'administrador@kinetic.com',
  'kinetic@kinetic.com',
]);

const POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export interface SafeSavedAccountMeta {
  email: string;
  nombre?: string;
  rol: 'b2c' | 'b2b';
}

export const sanitizeSavedAccount = (raw: unknown, fallbackRole: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'): SafeSavedAccountMeta | null => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const cleanEmail = String(obj.email || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@') || POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS.has(cleanEmail)) return null;
  const isAdmin = MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(cleanEmail);
  const rol: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = isAdmin || obj.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : fallbackRole;
  const nombre = isAdmin
    ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
    : typeof obj.nombre === 'string' && obj.nombre.trim()
      ? obj.nombre.trim().slice(0, 60)
      : cleanEmail.split('@')[0];
  return { email: cleanEmail, nombre, rol };
};

export const deduplicateSavedAccountsMap = (
  rawMap: Record<string, unknown>,
  fallbackRole: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'
): Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> => {
  const deduped: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> = {};
  if (!rawMap || typeof rawMap !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rawMap)) return deduped;

  for (const [keyHint, val] of Object.entries(rawMap)) {
    const cleanKeyHint = String(keyHint || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS.has(cleanKeyHint)) continue;
    const candidate =
      typeof val === 'object' && val !== null && !Array.isArray(val)
        ? (val as Record<string, unknown>)
        : { email: keyHint };
    const cleanEmail = String(candidate.email || keyHint || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
    if (!cleanEmail.includes('@') || POISONED_ACCOUNT_KEYS.has(cleanEmail) || LEGACY_PURGED_DEMO_EMAILS.has(cleanEmail)) {
      continue;
    }
    const cleanMeta = sanitizeSavedAccount({ ...candidate, email: cleanEmail }, fallbackRole);
    if (!cleanMeta) continue;
    const prev = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(deduped, cleanEmail) ? deduped[cleanEmail] : undefined;
    if (!prev) {
      deduped[cleanEmail] = cleanMeta;
      continue;
    }
    const emailLocal = cleanEmail.split('@')[0];
    const nextNombre =
      cleanMeta.nombre && cleanMeta.nombre !== emailLocal
        ? cleanMeta.nombre
        : prev.nombre || cleanMeta.nombre || emailLocal;
    deduped[cleanEmail] = {
      email: cleanEmail,
      nombre: nextNombre,
      rol: prev.rol === 'b2b' || cleanMeta.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c',
    };
  }
  return deduped;
};

async function readDeviceVerifiedEmailsSet(salt: string): Promise<Set<string>> {
  const allowed = new Set<string>();
  try {
    const rawWeb =
      Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? window.localStorage?.getItem(KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY) ?? null
        : null;
    const rawAsync = await AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY);
    for (const rawEntry of [rawWeb, rawAsync]) {
      const dec = decodeStoredJson(rawEntry, salt);
      if (!dec.json) continue;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(dec.json) as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) continue;
      for (const k of Object.keys(parsed)) {
        const clean = String(k || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (clean.includes('@')) allowed.add(clean);
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return allowed;
}

async function writeEncryptedDeviceLoginsMap(
  map: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>,
  salt: string
): Promise<void> {
  const clean = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(map);
  const cipher = encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify(clean), salt);
  await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.setItem(DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY, cipher),
    AsyncStorage.removeItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY),
    purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys(),
  ]).catch(() => {});
}

export async function loadSanitizedLoginAccounts() {
  const salt = Platform.OS === 'web' ? getOrCreateWebSaltSync() : await ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync();
  const [rawPref, rawPrefLegacy, rawV4, rawRealV3] = await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.getItem(BIOMETRIC_LOGIN_ENABLED_KEY),
    AsyncStorage.getItem('@kinetic_biometric_enabled_v1'),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY),
  ]);
  const effectiveBioRaw = rawPref ?? rawPrefLegacy;
  const bioEnabled = effectiveBioRaw === null ? true : effectiveBioRaw === 'true';
  let sanitizedMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta> = {};

  if (rawV4 && rawV4.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) {
    const decV4 = decryptKineticString(rawV4, salt);
    if (decV4) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(decV4) as Record<string, unknown>;
        sanitizedMap = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(parsed, 'b2c');
      } catch {}
    }
  } else if (rawRealV3) {
    try {
      const parsedV3 = JSON.parse(rawRealV3) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const verifiedOnDevice = await readDeviceVerifiedEmailsSet(salt);
      const filteredV3: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      if (parsedV3 && typeof parsedV3 === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsedV3)) {
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsedV3)) {
          const email = String(k || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          if (verifiedOnDevice.has(email)) filteredV3[email] = v;
        }
      }
      sanitizedMap = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(filteredV3, 'b2c');
      await writeEncryptedDeviceLoginsMap(sanitizedMap, salt);
    } catch {}
  }

  await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([LEGACY_KEY_B2C, LEGACY_KEY_B2B, LEGACY_MAP_KEY, LEGACY_V2_KEY]).catch(() => {});
  void purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys();

  const accountsList = Object.values(sanitizedMap);
  const safeB2C = accountsList.find((a) => a.rol === 'b2c') || null;
  const safeB2B = accountsList.find((a) => a.rol === 'b2b') || null;
  return { bioEnabled, safeB2C, safeB2B, sanitizedMap, accountsList };
}

export async function saveSanitizedLoginAccount(
  cleanEmail: string,
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b',
  currentMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>,
  displayName?: string
) {
  const salt = Platform.OS === 'web' ? getOrCreateWebSaltSync() : await ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync();
  const normEmail = String(cleanEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
  let baseMap = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(currentMap, mode);
  if (Object.keys(baseMap).length === 0) {
    const loaded = await loadSanitizedLoginAccounts().catch(() => null);
    if (loaded?.sanitizedMap) baseMap = loaded.sanitizedMap;
  }
  const isAdmin = MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(normEmail);
  const isB2B = isAdmin || mode === 'b2b';
  const resolvedNombre = isAdmin
    ? 'Kinetic Oficial'
    : String(displayName || baseMap[normEmail]?.nombre || normEmail.split('@')[0]).trim().slice(0, 80);
  const safeMeta: SafeSavedAccountMeta = {
    email: normEmail,
    nombre: resolvedNombre,
    rol: isB2B ? 'b2b' : 'b2c',
  };
  const nextMap = normEmail ? deduplicateSavedAccountsMap({ ...baseMap, [normEmail]: safeMeta }, mode) : baseMap;
  await writeEncryptedDeviceLoginsMap(nextMap, salt);
  return { isB2B, safeMeta, nextMap };
}

export async function removeSanitizedLoginAccount(
  emailToRemove: string,
  currentMap: Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>
): Promise<Record<string, SafeSavedAccountMeta>> {
  const salt = Platform.OS === 'web' ? getOrCreateWebSaltSync() : await ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync();
  const norm = String(emailToRemove || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const nextMap = deduplicateSavedAccountsMap(currentMap);
  delete nextMap[norm];
  await Promise.allSettled([
    writeEncryptedDeviceLoginsMap(nextMap, salt),
    norm ? purgeBiometricRefreshVaultAsync(norm) : Promise.resolve(),
  ]);
  return nextMap;
}

export function clearLoginCredentialsState(): {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  errorCleared: boolean;
} {
  return { email: '', password: '', errorCleared: true };
}

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array } from '../utils/kineticBinaryMediaHelper';

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const PROTO_POISON = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);
let _pendingMfaGateActive = false;

export interface IMfaFactorSummary {
  id?: string;
  status?: string | null;
  factor_type?: string | null;
  friendly_name?: string | null;
}

export interface IMfaSessionLike {
  access_token?: string | null;
  refresh_token?: string | null;
  user?: {
    id?: string;
    email?: string | null;
    factors?: IMfaFactorSummary[] | null;
    user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  } | null;
}

export const setPendingMfaGateActive = (active: boolean): void => {
  _pendingMfaGateActive = Boolean(active);
};

export const isPendingMfaGateActive = (): boolean => _pendingMfaGateActive;

export function sanitizeTotpSixDigitCode(raw: unknown): string {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
  return raw.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6);
}

export function isValidTotpSixDigitCode(raw: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof raw === 'string' && /^\d{6}$/.test(raw);
}

export function decodeJwtPayloadSafe(accessToken?: string | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    if (typeof accessToken !== 'string') return null;
    const trimmed = accessToken.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('kinetic-')) return null;
    const parts = trimmed.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3 || !parts[1]) return null;
    let b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const mod = b64.length % 4;
    if (mod === 1) return null;
    if (mod > 0) b64 += '='.repeat(4 - mod);
    const bytes = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(b64);
    if (!bytes || bytes.byteLength === 0) return null;
    const jsonStr =
      typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined'
        ? new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false }).decode(bytes)
        : String.fromCharCode(...Array.from(bytes));
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)
      : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function extractJwtSessionId(accessToken?: string | null): string | null {
  const parsed = decodeJwtPayloadSafe(accessToken);
  if (!parsed || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'session_id')) return null;
  const sid = String(parsed.session_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return UUID_RE.test(sid) && !PROTO_POISON.has(sid) ? sid : null;
}

export function extractJwtAal(accessToken?: string | null): 'aal1' | 'aal2' | null {
  const parsed = decodeJwtPayloadSafe(accessToken);
  if (!parsed) return null;
  const raw = String(parsed.aal || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (raw === 'aal2') return 'aal2';
  if (raw === 'aal1') return 'aal1';
  return null;
}

export function doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(session?: IMfaSessionLike | null): boolean {
  if (!session?.access_token) return false;
  const factors = Array.isArray(session.user?.factors) ? session.user.factors : [];
  const hasVerifiedTotp = factors.some(
    (f) => f?.status === 'verified' && (!f?.factor_type || f.factor_type === 'totp')
  );
  if (!hasVerifiedTotp) return false;
  return extractJwtAal(session.access_token) !== 'aal2';
}

export function parseUserAgentDeviceSummary(
  uaRaw?: string | null,
  isEn = false
): { label: string; icon: 'smartphone' | 'tablet' | 'monitor' } {
  const ua = typeof uaRaw === 'string' ? uaRaw.slice(0, 512) : '';
  const low = ua.toLowerCase();
  const fallback = isEn ? 'Kinetic Device' : 'Dispositivo Kinetic';
  if (!low.trim()) {
    return { label: fallback, icon: Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'monitor' : 'smartphone' };
  }
  let os = '';
  let icon: 'smartphone' | 'tablet' | 'monitor' = 'monitor';
  if (low.includes('ipad')) {
    os = 'iPad';
    icon = 'tablet';
  } else if (low.includes('iphone') || low.includes('ipod')) {
    os = 'iPhone';
    icon = 'smartphone';
  } else if (low.includes('android')) {
    icon = low.includes('tablet') ? 'tablet' : 'smartphone';
    os = icon === 'tablet' ? 'Android Tablet' : 'Android';
  } else if (low.includes('macintosh') || low.includes('mac os')) {
    os = 'macOS';
    icon = 'monitor';
  } else if (low.includes('windows')) {
    os = 'Windows';
    icon = 'monitor';
  } else if (low.includes('linux')) {
    os = 'Linux';
    icon = 'monitor';
  }

  let client = '';
  if (low.includes('kinetic') || low.includes('expo') || low.includes('okhttp') || low.includes('cfnetwork')) {
    client = 'Kinetic App';
  } else if (low.includes('edg/')) client = 'Edge';
  else if (low.includes('opr/') || low.includes('opera')) client = 'Opera';
  else if (low.includes('firefox') || low.includes('fxios')) client = 'Firefox';
  else if (low.includes('chrome') || low.includes('crios')) client = 'Chrome';
  else if (low.includes('safari')) client = 'Safari';

  const combined = os && client ? `${os} • ${client}` : os || client || fallback;
  return { label: combined.slice(0, 46), icon };
}

const rgbToCss = (rgb: [number, number, number]): string => {
  const r = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(rgb?.[0]) || 0)) * 255);
  const g = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(rgb?.[1]) || 0)) * 255);
  const b = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(rgb?.[2]) || 0)) * 255);
  return `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
};

    // === src/services/kineticNoShowEngine.ts === //
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { isMasterPass0Kc } from './adminB2BCutEngine';

const ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES = new Set(['activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada']);
const DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES = 45;
export const NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES = 180;
export type NoShowRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

let _lastSilentReconcileAtMs = 0;

export const isPassExpiredWithoutCheckIn = (
  reserva: NoShowRecord | null | undefined,
  matchedSrv?: NoShowRecord | null,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES
): boolean => {
  if (!reserva || typeof reserva !== 'object') return false;
  if (reserva.qr_usado_at || reserva.checked_in_at) return false;
  const st = String(reserva.estado || 'activa').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES.has(st)) return false;
  const safeGrace = Math.min(1440, Math.max(30, Math.round(Number(graceMinutes) || NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES)));
  const rawHora = String(
    reserva.hora_inicio || reserva.hora || matchedSrv?.hora_inicio || '08:00'
  ).trim();
  const candidates = [
    reserva.fecha_clase,
    reserva.fecha_programada,
    matchedSrv?.fecha,
    reserva.fecha_hora,
    reserva.fecha,
    reserva.created_at,
  ];
  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const raw = String(cand || '').trim();
    if (!raw) continue;
    const synthetic = {
      fecha_hora: raw,
      fecha_clase: raw,
      hora_inicio: rawHora,
    };
    const deadlineMs = parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs(synthetic, safeGrace);
    if (deadlineMs !== null && Number.isFinite(deadlineMs)) {
      return nowMs >= deadlineMs;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

export const NOSHOW_RECONCILE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;

export const reconcileExpiredNoShowPassesSilent = async (force = false): Promise<void> => {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!force && now - _lastSilentReconcileAtMs < 45_000) return;
  _lastSilentReconcileAtMs = now;
  const runReconcile = async () => {
    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('reconciliar_reservas_expiradas_noshow');
    if (error) {
      await supabase.rpc('ejecutar_barrido_noshow_escrow_40', {
        p_reserva_id: null,
        p_minutos_gracia: NOSHOW_EXPIRATION_MINUTES,
      });
    }
  };
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  try {
    await Promise.race([
      runReconcile(),
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        timer = setTimeout(resolve, NOSHOW_RECONCILE_TIMEOUT_MS);
      }),
    ]);
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } finally {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  }
};

export interface INoShowSummary {
  eligibleIds: string[];
  eligibleCount: number;
  totalEscrow40Kc: number;
  venueNet80Mxn: number;
  kineticFee20Mxn: number;
}

export const parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs = (
  reserva: NoShowRecord | null | undefined,
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): number | null => {
  if (!reserva || typeof reserva !== 'object') return null;
  const safeGraceMin = Math.min(1440, Math.max(5, Math.round(Number(graceMinutes) || DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES)));
  const graceMs = safeGraceMin * 60_000;

  const rawHora = String(reserva.hora_inicio || reserva.hora || '').trim();
  const horaMatch = rawHora.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  const hh = horaMatch ? Math.min(23, Math.max(0, Number(horaMatch[1]))) : 23;
  const mm = horaMatch ? Math.min(59, Math.max(0, Number(horaMatch[2]))) : 59;

  const candidates = [reserva.fecha_hora, reserva.fecha_clase, reserva.fecha];
  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const raw = String(cand || '').trim();
    if (!raw) continue;
    const dayMatch = raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:$|[T\s](.+))?/);
    if (dayMatch) {
      const timePart = (dayMatch[4] || '').trim();
      const isDateOrMidnight =
        !timePart || /^00:00(?::00(?:\.\d+)?)?(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})?$/i.test(timePart);
      if (isDateOrMidnight) {
        const y = Number(dayMatch[1]);
        const m = Number(dayMatch[2]) - 1;
        const d = Number(dayMatch[3]);
        const endShiftMin = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(reserva.duracion_minutos) || 0));
        // America/Mazatlan stays strictly on UTC-7 year-round (no DST)
        const mzStartUtcMs = Date.UTC(y, m, d, hh + 7, mm, 0, 0);
        if (!Number.isNaN(mzStartUtcMs)) {
          return mzStartUtcMs + endShiftMin * 60_000 + graceMs;
        }
        continue;
      }
    }
    const parsed = Date.parse(raw);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
      return parsed + graceMs;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

export const isReservationEligibleForNoShow40 = (
  reserva: NoShowRecord | null | undefined,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): boolean => {
  if (!reserva || typeof reserva !== 'object') return false;
  if (!reserva.id) return false;
  const st = String(reserva.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES.has(st)) return false;
  if (isMasterPass0Kc(reserva)) return false;
  const escrowKc = Number(reserva.monto_escrow) || 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(escrowKc) || escrowKc <= 0) return false;
  const deadlineMs = parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs(reserva, graceMinutes);
  if (deadlineMs === null || !Number.isFinite(deadlineMs)) return false;
  return nowMs >= deadlineMs;
};

export const summarizePendingNoShowContracts = (
  reservas: NoShowRecord[] = [],
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): INoShowSummary => {
  const eligibleIds: string[] = [];
  let totalCents = 0;

  for (const r of reservas || []) {
    if (!isReservationEligibleForNoShow40(r, nowMs, graceMinutes)) continue;
    const idStr = String(r.id || '').trim();
    if (!idStr) continue;
    eligibleIds.push(idStr);
    const escrow = Math.max(0, Number(r.monto_escrow) || 0);
    totalCents += Math.round(escrow * 100);
  }

  const feeCents = Math.round(totalCents * 0.2);
  const netCents = totalCents - feeCents;

  return {
    eligibleIds,
    eligibleCount: eligibleIds.length,
    totalEscrow40Kc: totalCents / 100,
    venueNet80Mxn: netCents / 100,
    kineticFee20Mxn: feeCents / 100,
  };
};

export const formatNoShowSweepResultMessage = (
  res: { procesadas: number; escrow_retenido_kc: number },
  isEn: boolean
): string =>
  res.procesadas > 0
    ? isEn
      ? `Settled ${res.procesadas} expired bookings keeping ${res.escrow_retenido_kc} KC (80% venue / 20% Kinetic) without charging the 60% door balance.`
      : `Se liquidaron ${res.procesadas} reservas vencidas reteniendo ${res.escrow_retenido_kc} KC (80% sede / 20% Kinetic) sin cobrar el 60% de puerta.`
    : isEn
      ? 'No eligible expired bookings (>45 min grace) were ready to settle in this sweep.'
      : 'No hubo reservas elegibles vencidas (>45 min de gracia) para liquidar en este corte.';

export const computeOptimisticNoShowState = <T extends NoShowRecord, K extends NoShowRecord>(
  reservasActivas: T[] = [],
  prevKpis: K = {} as K,
  targetReservaId?: string | null,
  sweepResult?: { procesadas?: number; escrow_retenido_kc?: number } | null,
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): { nextReservasActivas: T[]; nextKpis: K } => {
  const cleanId = String(targetReservaId || '').trim();
  const procesadas = Number(sweepResult?.procesadas) || 0;
  if (procesadas <= 0) {
    return { nextReservasActivas: reservasActivas, nextKpis: prevKpis };
  }
  const removedIds = new Set<string>();
  let removedEscrow = 0;
  const nextReservasActivas = (reservasActivas || []).filter((r) => {
    const rid = String(r?.id || '').trim();
    const shouldDrop = cleanId ? rid === cleanId : isReservationEligibleForNoShow40(r, nowMs, graceMinutes);
    if (shouldDrop) {
      if (rid) removedIds.add(rid);
      removedEscrow += Math.max(0, Number(r?.monto_escrow) || 0);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  const capturedKc = Math.max(removedEscrow, Number(sweepResult?.escrow_retenido_kc) || 0);
  const nextEscrowTotal = Math.max(0, (Number(prevKpis?.escrowTotal) || 0) - capturedKc);
  const nextLiquidity = (Number(prevKpis?.liquidezTotalCapturada) || 0) + capturedKc;
  return {
    nextReservasActivas,
    nextKpis: {
      ...prevKpis,
      escrowTotal: nextEscrowTotal,
      liquidezTotalCapturada: nextLiquidity,
      comisionKinetic20: Math.round(nextLiquidity * 0.2),
      reservasActivasCount: nextReservasActivas.length,
    },
  };
};

export const executeNoShow40Sweep = async (
  reservaId?: string | null,
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; procesadas: number; escrow_retenido_kc: number }> => {
  const safeGrace = Math.min(1440, Math.max(5, Math.round(Number(graceMinutes) || DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES)));
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('ejecutar_barrido_noshow_escrow_40', {
    p_reserva_id: reservaId || null,
    p_minutos_gracia: safeGrace,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  const dRec = data && typeof data === 'object' ? (data as NoShowRecord) : null;
  return {
    ok: Boolean(dRec?.ok ?? true),
    procesadas: Math.max(0, Number(dRec?.procesadas) || 0),
    escrow_retenido_kc: Math.max(0, Number(dRec?.escrow_retenido_kc) || 0),
  };
};

export interface IHourlyNoShowSweepEvaluation {
  sweptIds: string[];
  exemptMasterPassIds: string[];
  futureSkippedIds: string[];
  retainedKcTotal: number;
}

export function evaluateHourlyMazatlanNoShowSweep(
  reservas: NoShowRecord[] = [],
  nowMs = Date.now(),
  graceMinutes = DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES
): IHourlyNoShowSweepEvaluation {
  const sweptIds: string[] = [];
  const exemptMasterPassIds: string[] = [];
  const futureSkippedIds: string[] = [];
  let retainedCents = 0;

  for (const r of reservas || []) {
    if (!r || typeof r !== 'object' || !r.id) continue;
    const rid = String(r.id).trim();
    if (!rid || r.qr_usado_at || r.checked_in_at) continue;
    const st = String(r.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!ELIGIBLE_ESCROW_STATUSES.has(st)) continue;
    const deadlineMs = parseReservationScheduledEndOrGraceMs(r, graceMinutes);
    if (deadlineMs === null || !Number.isFinite(deadlineMs)) continue;
    if (nowMs < deadlineMs) {
      futureSkippedIds.push(rid);
      continue;
    }
    sweptIds.push(rid);
    if (isMasterPass0Kc(r)) {
      exemptMasterPassIds.push(rid);
      continue;
    }
    const esc = Math.max(0, Number(r.monto_escrow) || 0);
    retainedCents += Math.round(esc * 100);
  }

  return {
    sweptIds,
    exemptMasterPassIds,
    futureSkippedIds,
    retainedKcTotal: retainedCents / 100,
  };
}

import { filterValidRadarServices, isBannedAffiliateRecord } from './exploreRadarFilters';
import { exploreService } from './exploreService';
import { hydrateServicesGpsWithClubCoords } from './exploreZoneHelpers';
import { reconcileActiveLiveServicesSnapshot } from './kineticGhostEventsPurgeHelper';
import { isPassExpiredWithoutCheckIn } from './kineticNoShowEngine';
import { type IBovedaPassRow, setBovedaSWRReservas } from './kineticOptimisticStore';
import { isExplicitKineticSignOut, isRealSupabaseJwt, registerSessionCleanupHook } from './kineticSessionPersistence';
import {
  type IPostLoginPrefetchPayload,
  type SwrRecord,
  registerPostLoginPrefetchHook,
  setAdminHubSwrSync,
  setB2BDashboardSwrSync,
  setEventosSwrSync,
  setExploreSwrSync,
} from './kineticSwrMemoryHub';
import { persistServerClockOffsetMs, persistTerminalSwrCache } from './terminalOfflineService';
import { terminalService } from './terminalService';

export const PREFETCH_BRANCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 4200;
const PREFETCH_COOLDOWN_MS = 45_000;
const DELETED_SVC = new Set(['eliminado', 'eliminada', 'borrado', 'borrada', 'deleted', 'cancelado', 'cancelada', 'inactivo', 'inactiva', 'archivado', 'archivada']);

let _prefetchEpoch = 0;
const _inFlightByUser = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
const _lastPrefetchedAt = new Map<string, number>();

export const resetOmniPrefetchCoordinator = (): void => {
  _prefetchEpoch += 1;
  _inFlightByUser.clear();
  _lastPrefetchedAt.clear();
};

registerSessionCleanupHook(resetOmniPrefetchCoordinator);

export const withPrefetchBranchTimeout = <T>(
  promise: PromiseLike<T>,
  maxMs = PREFETCH_BRANCH_TIMEOUT_MS
): Promise<T> => {
  const safeMs = Math.min(4500, Math.max(250, Number(maxMs) || PREFETCH_BRANCH_TIMEOUT_MS));
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('PREFETCH_BRANCH_TIMEOUT')), safeMs);
    Promise.resolve(promise).then(
      (val) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(val); },
      (err) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(err); }
    );
  });
};

export interface IOmniPrefetchParams {
  user: { id?: string; email?: string | null; app_metadata?: Record<string, unknown>; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
  profile: { rol?: unknown; tipo_cuenta?: unknown; nombre?: unknown; avatar_url?: unknown; es_afiliado?: boolean | null; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
  session?: { access_token?: string | null; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
  force?: boolean;
}

const buildPrefetchedTerminalSnapshot = (
  uid: string,
  biz: SwrRecord | null,
  opRes: { reservas?: SwrRecord[]; servicios?: SwrRecord[] },
  isAdmin: boolean
) => {
  const validServicios = (opRes.servicios || []).filter(
    (s) => s && !DELETED_SVC.has(String(s.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim())
  );
  const activos: SwrRecord[] = [];
  const historial: SwrRecord[] = [];
  let ingresosHoy = 0;
  for (const r of opRes.reservas || []) {
    const st = String(r?.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (st === 'activa' || st === 'pendiente' || st === 'confirmada') {
      if (isPassExpiredWithoutCheckIn(r)) historial.push({ ...r, estado: 'no_show', penalizacion_aplicada: true });
      else activos.push(r);
    } else if (['completada', 'cancelada', 'no_show', 'expirada', 'penalizada'].includes(st)) {
      historial.push(r);
      if (st === 'completada') {
        const tot = Math.max(0, Number(r.costo_total ?? r.precio_kc) || 0);
        const pta = r.monto_puerta != null ? Math.max(0, Number(r.monto_puerta) || 0) : Math.round(tot * 0.6);
        ingresosHoy += pta;
      }
    }
  }
  const cleanBiz = isAdmin && !biz ? { id: 'admin-global-terminal', nombre: 'Kinetic Oficial', categoria: 'Club', estado: 'activo', isOfficialKinetic: true } : biz;
  return {
    userId: uid,
    fetchedAt: Date.now(),
    businessData: cleanBiz,
    servicios: validServicios,
    reservas: activos,
    metricas: { ingresosHoy, historialCompleto: historial, hasBusiness: Boolean(cleanBiz) },
  };
};

export const triggerKineticOmniPrefetch = (params: IOmniPrefetchParams): Promise<void> => {
  const uid = String(params.user?.id || '').trim();
  if (!uid || !params.profile || isExplicitKineticSignOut()) return Promise.resolve();
  const existingFlight = _inFlightByUser.get(uid);
  if (existingFlight && !params.force) return existingFlight;
  const lastTs = _lastPrefetchedAt.get(uid) || 0;
  if (!params.force && lastTs > 0 && Date.now() - lastTs < PREFETCH_COOLDOWN_MS) return Promise.resolve();

  const epochStart = _prefetchEpoch;
  const isStale = () => epochStart !== _prefetchEpoch || isExplicitKineticSignOut();
  const accessToken = params.session?.access_token ?? null;
  const hasValidJwt = isRealSupabaseJwt(accessToken);
  const email = normalizeRoleToken(params.user?.email);
  const appMeta = params.user?.app_metadata || {};
  const isAdmin =
    hasValidJwt &&
    hasAnyKineticMasterAdminRole(email, params.profile.rol, params.profile.tipo_cuenta, appMeta.rol, appMeta.tipo_cuenta);
  const isB2B =
    hasValidJwt &&
    (isAdmin ||
      params.profile.es_afiliado === true ||
      hasAnyKineticB2BRole(params.profile.rol, params.profile.tipo_cuenta, appMeta.rol, appMeta.tipo_cuenta));

  const task = (async () => {
    const branches: Promise<unknown>[] = [
      withPrefetchBranchTimeout(exploreService.fetchRadarData(isAdmin, false)).then((res) => {
        if (isStale()) return;
        const afiliados = ((res?.afiliados || []) as SwrRecord[]).filter((a) => Boolean(a) && !isBannedAffiliateRecord(a));
        const servicios = hydrateServicesGpsWithClubCoords(
          filterValidRadarServices(reconcileActiveLiveServicesSnapshot((res?.servicios || []).filter(Boolean))),
          afiliados
        ) as SwrRecord[];
        setExploreSwrSync({ afiliados, servicios, fetchedAt: Date.now(), scopeKey: `${uid}:${isAdmin ? 'admin' : 'pub'}` });
      }),
      withPrefetchBranchTimeout(eventsService.fetchGlobalEvents()).then((res) => {
        if (isStale()) return;
        setEventosSwrSync({
          servData: (res?.servData || []) as SwrRecord[],
          afData: (res?.afData || []) as SwrRecord[],
          resData: (res?.resData || []) as SwrRecord[],
          fetchedAt: Date.now(),
        });
      }),
      withPrefetchBranchTimeout(
        Promise.all([bovedaService.fetchReservasAtleta(uid), bovedaService.obtenerTiempoServidorMs()])
      ).then(([rows, serverMs]) => {
        if (isStale()) return;
        const cleanRows = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).filter(
          (r) => r?.id && !r?.isOptimistic && !String(r.id).startsWith('opt_')
        ) as IBovedaPassRow[];
        setBovedaSWRReservas(uid, cleanRows, true, true);
        void persistOfflineReservasAtleta(uid, cleanRows).catch(() => {});
        if (typeof serverMs === 'number' && Number.isFinite(serverMs)) {
          void persistServerClockOffsetMs(serverMs - Date.now()).catch(() => {});
        }
      }),
    ];

    if (isAdmin || isB2B) {
      const profName = String(params.profile?.nombre || 'Sede Kinetic');
      const roleHint = normalizeRoleToken(params.profile?.rol || params.profile?.tipo_cuenta);
      const defCat = email.startsWith('especialista@') ? 'Especialista' : 'Club';
      branches.push(
        withPrefetchBranchTimeout(
          (async () => {
            const negocios = await terminalService.fetchBusinessStatus(uid, email, profName, defCat, roleHint);
            if (isStale()) return;
            const biz = (Array.isArray(negocios) && negocios[0] ? negocios[0] : null) as SwrRecord | null;
            const targetName = isAdmin ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : String(biz?.nombre || '').trim();
            const hasActive = Boolean(biz?.id && String(biz?.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'activo');
            if (!isAdmin && !targetName) return;
            const opRes = await terminalService.fetchOperacionEstadio(targetName || 'Kinetic Oficial', isAdmin, hasActive);
            if (isStale()) return;
            persistTerminalSwrCache(buildPrefetchedTerminalSnapshot(uid, biz, opRes as { reservas?: SwrRecord[]; servicios?: SwrRecord[] }, isAdmin));
          })()
        ),
        withPrefetchBranchTimeout(bovedaService.fetchB2BData(uid, isAdmin, isAdmin ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : profName, email)).then((b2bRes) => {
          if (isStale() || !b2bRes) return;
          setB2BDashboardSwrSync(uid, buildB2BDashboardSwrSnapshot(b2bRes as unknown as Parameters<typeof buildB2BDashboardSwrSnapshot>[0], isAdmin) as unknown as SwrRecord);
        })
      );
    }

    if (isAdmin) {
      branches.push(
        withPrefetchBranchTimeout(adminService.fetchDashboardData(false)).then((adminSnap) => {
          if (isStale() || !adminSnap) return;
          setAdminHubSwrSync(uid, adminSnap as unknown as SwrRecord);
        })
      );
    }

    await Promise.allSettled(branches);
    if (!isStale()) _lastPrefetchedAt.set(uid, Date.now());
  })().finally(() => {
    if (_inFlightByUser.get(uid) === task) _inFlightByUser.delete(uid);
  });

  _inFlightByUser.set(uid, task);
  return task;
};

export const installKineticOmniPrefetchCoordinator = (): void => {
  registerPostLoginPrefetchHook((payload: IPostLoginPrefetchPayload) => {
    void triggerKineticOmniPrefetch(payload as unknown as IOmniPrefetchParams);
  });
};

installKineticOmniPrefetchCoordinator();

    // === src/services/kineticOptimisticStore.ts === //
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Alert } from 'react-native';
import { triggerArcadeHaptic, triggerHaptic } from '../components/SharedUI';
import { registerOptimisticActivePass } from './bovedaRealtimeSync';
import { type ExploreBookingServiceInput } from './exploreBookingExecutor';
import { exploreService } from './exploreService';
import { resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing } from './kineticFlashSaleHelper';
import { registerSessionCleanupHook } from './kineticSessionPersistence';
import { parseTerminalQrPacket } from './terminalSpeiAndStudioService';
import {
  buildSwrPassSignature,
  type IBovedaPassRow,
  reconcileBovedaSwrWithServerRows,
} from './kineticSwrMemoryHub';
import { computeSplitEscrow1NMath, persistSelectedSpotSession, rehydratePersistedSpotForEvent } from './kineticSplitPreBookingStore';
import { createSplitEscrowInvites, type ISplitInviteAthlete } from './splitEscrowInvitesService';
import { CIPHER_PREFIX, decryptKineticString, encryptKineticString, ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync } from './kineticVaultCrypto';
import { clearSpotLockAndIntent, normalizeLocalIsoDate, resolveClientPickedSpot, SPOT_COLLISION_ERROR_CODE } from './spotCollisionService';

const BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX = '@kinetic_boveda_res_v2_';
export const BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY = '@kinetic_boveda_passes_cache_v1';
const RADAR_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_radar_snapshot_v2';
export const BOVEDA_OPTIMISTIC_TTL_MS = 15_000;
export { buildSwrPassSignature, type IBovedaPassRow, reconcileBovedaSwrWithServerRows };

export type BovedaSwrChangeMeta = { fromServerSync?: boolean };
const bovedaMemoryStore: Record<string, IBovedaPassRow[]> = {};
const bovedaLastFetchedStore: Record<string, number> = {};
const bovedaSubscribers = new Map<string, Set<(rows: IBovedaPassRow[], meta?: BovedaSwrChangeMeta) => void>>();
const _inFlightOptimisticBookings = new Set<string>();
let _storageWriteEpoch = 0;

const sanitizePassRowsForDisk = (rows: IBovedaPassRow[]): IBovedaPassRow[] => (rows || []).map((r) => ({ ...r, qr_token: undefined }));

const persistBovedaDiskEncrypted = (uid: string, v1Passes: IBovedaPassRow[], atletaRows?: IBovedaPassRow[]): void => {
  const epoch = _storageWriteEpoch;
  void ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync()
    .then((salt) => {
      if (epoch !== _storageWriteEpoch || bovedaMemoryStore[uid] === undefined) return;
      AsyncStorage.setItem(BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY, encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify({ userId: uid, passes: sanitizePassRowsForDisk(v1Passes), updatedAt: Date.now() }), salt)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      if (atletaRows) {
        AsyncStorage.setItem(`${BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX}${uid}`, encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify(sanitizePassRowsForDisk(atletaRows)), salt)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      }
    })
    .catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
};

const notifyBovedaSubscribers = (uid: string, rows: IBovedaPassRow[], meta?: BovedaSwrChangeMeta) => {
  const subs = bovedaSubscribers.get(uid);
  if (!subs) return;
  subs.forEach((cb) => {
    try { cb(rows, meta); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  });
};

export const clearAllBovedaSWRMemory = (): void => {
  _storageWriteEpoch += 1;
  const uids = Object.keys(bovedaMemoryStore);
  for (const k of uids) delete bovedaMemoryStore[k];
  for (const k of Object.keys(bovedaLastFetchedStore)) delete bovedaLastFetchedStore[k];
  _inFlightOptimisticBookings.clear();
  AsyncStorage.removeItem(BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  uids.forEach((uid) => { AsyncStorage.removeItem(`${BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX}${uid}`).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; }); });
  if (typeof AsyncStorage?.getAllKeys === 'function') {
    AsyncStorage.getAllKeys()
      .then((keys) => Promise.all((keys || []).filter((k) => k.startsWith(BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX)).map((k) => AsyncStorage.removeItem(k).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; }))))
      .catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  }
};

registerSessionCleanupHook(clearAllBovedaSWRMemory);

export const getBovedaSWRReservas = (uid?: string): IBovedaPassRow[] | undefined =>
  uid ? bovedaMemoryStore[uid] : undefined;

export const getBovedaSWRLastFetchedAt = (uid?: string): number =>
  (uid && bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid]) || 0;

export const resetBovedaSWRLastFetchedAt = (uid?: string): void => {
  if (uid) bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid] = 0;
};

export const setBovedaSWRReservas = (
  uid: string,
  rows: IBovedaPassRow[],
  markFresh = true,
  fromServerSync = false
): IBovedaPassRow[] => {
  if (!uid) return rows || [];
  const merged = reconcileBovedaSwrWithServerRows(bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [], rows, Date.now(), BOVEDA_OPTIMISTIC_TTL_MS);
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = merged;
  if (markFresh) bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid] = Date.now();
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, merged, { fromServerSync });
  persistBovedaDiskEncrypted(uid, merged, rows);
  return merged;
};

export const subscribeBovedaSWR = (
  uid: string,
  cb: (rows: IBovedaPassRow[], meta?: BovedaSwrChangeMeta) => void
): (() => void) => {
  if (!uid) return () => {};
  let set = bovedaSubscribers.get(uid);
  if (!set) {
    set = new Set();
    bovedaSubscribers.set(uid, set);
  }
  set.add(cb);
  return () => {
    set?.delete(cb);
  };
};

export const hydrateBovedaSWRFromStorage = async (uid: string): Promise<IBovedaPassRow[] | null> => {
  if (!uid) return null;
  if (bovedaMemoryStore[uid] !== undefined) return bovedaMemoryStore[uid];
  const epoch = _storageWriteEpoch;
  try {
    const [rawV1, rawAt] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(`${BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX}${uid}`),
    ]);
    if (rawV1 && !rawV1.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) AsyncStorage.removeItem(BOVEDA_PASSES_CACHE_V1_KEY).catch(() => {});
    if (rawAt && !rawAt.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) AsyncStorage.removeItem(`${BOVEDA_ATLETA_CACHE_PREFIX}${uid}`).catch(() => {});
    if (!rawV1?.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX) && !rawAt?.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) return null;
    const salt = await ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync();
    if (epoch !== _storageWriteEpoch || bovedaMemoryStore[uid] !== undefined) return null;
    if (rawV1?.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) {
      const decV1 = decryptKineticString(rawV1, salt);
      const parsedV1 = decV1 ? (JSON.parse(decV1) as { userId?: string; passes?: IBovedaPassRow[] } | IBovedaPassRow[]) : null;
      const v1Passes =
        !Array.isArray(parsedV1) && parsedV1?.userId === uid && Array.isArray(parsedV1.passes)
          ? parsedV1.passes.filter((r) => String(r?.usuario_id || '') === uid)
          : Array.isArray(parsedV1)
          ? parsedV1.filter((r) => String(r?.usuario_id || '') === uid)
          : null;
      if (v1Passes && bovedaMemoryStore[uid] === undefined) {
        bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = v1Passes;
        notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, v1Passes, { fromServerSync: false });
        return v1Passes;
      }
    }
    if (rawAt?.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) {
      const decAt = decryptKineticString(rawAt, salt);
      const parsedAt = decAt ? (JSON.parse(decAt) as unknown) : null;
      if (Array.isArray(parsedAt) && bovedaMemoryStore[uid] === undefined) {
        const owned = (parsedAt as IBovedaPassRow[]).filter((r) => String(r?.usuario_id || '') === uid);
        bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = owned;
        notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, owned, { fromServerSync: false });
        return owned;
      }
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  return null;
};

export const hydrateExploreSWRFromStorage = async (): Promise<{
  afiliados: Record<string, unknown>[];
  servicios: Record<string, unknown>[];
} | null> => {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(RADAR_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { afiliados?: Record<string, unknown>[]; servicios?: Record<string, unknown>[] };
    if (Array.isArray(parsed?.afiliados) && parsed.afiliados.length > 0) {
      return {
        afiliados: parsed.afiliados,
        servicios: Array.isArray(parsed.servicios) ? parsed.servicios : [],
      };
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  return null;
};

export const injectConfirmedBovedaPass = (
  uid: string,
  p: {
    id?: string | null;
    servicioId?: string | number | null;
    title: string;

    fechaIso?: string | null;

): void => {

  const h5 = String(p.horaInicio || '08:00').trim().slice(0, 5) || '08:00';
  const d = String(p.fechaIso || '').trim().slice(0, 10);
  const tot = p.isAdmin ? 0 : Math.max(0, Number(p.totalKc) || 0);
  const esc = p.isAdmin ? 0 : Math.max(0, Number(p.escrowKc) || 0);
  const pta = p.isAdmin ? 0 : p.puertaKc !== undefined ? Math.max(0, Number(p.puertaKc) || 0) : Math.max(0, tot - esc);
  prependBovedaOptimisticPass(uid, {
    id: String(p.id || '').trim() || `opt_${Date.now()}`,

    titulo_clase: p.title,

    categoria: p.categoria || 'Fuerza',
    estado: 'confirmada',
    isOptimistic: !p.id,
    optimisticCreatedAtMs: Date.now(),
    es_pase_maestro: Boolean(p.isAdmin),
    costo_total: tot,
    precio_kc: tot,
    monto_escrow: esc,
    monto_puerta: pta,
    fecha: d || undefined,
    fecha_clase: d || undefined,
    fecha_hora: d ? `${d}T${h5}:00` : undefined,
    fecha_programada: d ? `${d}T${h5}:00` : undefined,
    hora: h5,
    hora_inicio: h5,
    spot_number: p.spotNumber ?? null,
