    instructor_nombre: p.instructorNombre || 'Coach Oficial Kinetic',
    ubicacion: p.ubicacion || undefined,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
};

export const prependBovedaOptimisticPass = (uid: string, pass: IBovedaPassRow): void => {
  if (!uid || !pass) return;
  const current = bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [];
  const stamped: IBovedaPassRow = {
    ...pass,
    usuario_id: String(pass.usuario_id || uid),
    id: pass.id || `opt_${Date.now()}`,
    optimisticCreatedAtMs: Number(pass.optimisticCreatedAtMs) > 0 ? Number(pass.optimisticCreatedAtMs) : Date.now(),
  };
  const next = [stamped, ...current.filter((r) => String(r?.id || '') !== String(stamped.id))];
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = next;
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, next, { fromServerSync: false });
  persistBovedaDiskEncrypted(uid, next);
};

export const commitBovedaOptimisticPass = (uid: string, tempId: string, realRow: IBovedaPassRow): void => {
  if (!uid) return;
  const current = bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [];
  const next = current.map((r) => {
    if (r?.id !== tempId) return r;
    const resolvedDate = realRow?.fecha_clase ? normalizeLocalIsoDate(String(realRow.fecha_clase)) : r.fecha_clase || r.fecha;
    const resolvedHora = String(realRow?.hora_inicio || realRow?.hora || r.hora_inicio || r.hora || '08:00').substring(0, 5);
    return {
      ...r, ...(realRow || {}), id: realRow?.id || r.id, qr_token: realRow?.qr_token || r.qr_token,
      fecha_clase: resolvedDate, fecha: resolvedDate, hora: resolvedHora, hora_inicio: resolvedHora,
      fecha_programada: `${String(resolvedDate || '')}T${resolvedHora}:00`, spot_number: realRow?.spot_number ?? r.spot_number ?? null, isOptimistic: false,
    };
  });
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = next;
  bovedaLastFetchedStore[uid] = Date.now();
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, next, { fromServerSync: true });
};

export const removeBovedaOptimisticPass = (uid: string, tempId: string): void => {
  if (!uid) return;
  const current = bovedaMemoryStore[uid] || [];
  const next = current.filter((r) => String(r?.id || '') !== String(tempId));
  bovedaMemoryStore[uid] = next;
  notifyBovedaSubscribers(uid, next, { fromServerSync: false });
  persistBovedaDiskEncrypted(uid, next);
};

export interface IOptimisticEscrowBookingOptions {
  user: { id?: string; email?: string | null } | null;
  profile: { nivel?: string; kc_membresia?: number; kc_topup?: number; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
  ev: ExploreBookingServiceInput & {
    split_count?: number;
    splitCount?: number;
    splitGuests?: string[];
    fecha_clase?: string;
    selectedDate?: string;
    fecha_proyectada?: string;
    fecha?: string;
    club?: string;
    hora?: string;
    categoria?: string;
    disciplina?: string;
    duracion_minutos?: number;
    duracion_min?: number;
    instructor_nombre?: string;
    coach?: string;
    ubicacion?: string;
  };
  isAdmin: boolean;
  fechaClase?: string | null;
  selectedDate?: string | null;
  selectedSpot?: number | null;
  spot?: number | null;
  activateResilientSession: (user: NonNullable<IOptimisticEscrowBookingOptions['user']>, profile: NonNullable<IOptimisticEscrowBookingOptions['profile']>) => void;
  refreshProfile?: () => Promise<void>;
  onOptimisticSeatDelta?: (evId: string, delta: number) => void;
  onInstantBooked?: (esc: number) => void;
  onSilentRevalidate?: () => Promise<unknown>;
  onRollbackError?: (errMessage: string) => void;
  fallbackTitle?: string;
}

export const executeOptimisticEscrowBooking = async ({
  user, profile, ev, isAdmin, fechaClase, selectedDate, selectedSpot, spot,
  activateResilientSession, refreshProfile, onOptimisticSeatDelta, onInstantBooked,
  onSilentRevalidate, onRollbackError, fallbackTitle = 'RESERVA REVERTIDA',
}: IOptimisticEscrowBookingOptions): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (!user?.id || !ev) return false;
  const uid = String(user.id);
  const servicioNombre = String(ev.nombre_servicio || ev.titulo || ev.servicio || 'Experiencia Kinetic');
  const fechaBase = normalizeLocalIsoDate(
    String(fechaClase || selectedDate || ev.fecha_clase || ev.selectedDate || ev.fecha_proyectada || ev.fecha || '')
  );
  const inFlightKey = `${uid}::${String(ev.id || servicioNombre)}::${fechaBase}`;
  if (_inFlightOptimisticBookings.has(inFlightKey)) return false;
  _inFlightOptimisticBookings.add(inFlightKey);

  try {
    const fp = resolveFlashVipDiscountPricing({
      event: { ...ev, fecha_clase: fechaBase },
      vipLevel: profile?.nivel,
      kcMembresia: profile?.kc_membresia,
      isAdmin,
    });
    const total = isAdmin ? 0 : fp.discountedTotalKc;
    const splitCount = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Number(ev?.split_count || ev?.splitCount) || 1));
    const rawSplit = Array.isArray(ev?.splitGuests) ? ev.splitGuests : [];
    const splitGuests: ISplitInviteAthlete[] = rawSplit.reduce<ISplitInviteAthlete[]>((acc, g) => {
      if (typeof g === 'string' && g.trim()) acc.push({ id: g.trim(), nombre: g.trim() });
      else if (g && typeof g === 'object' && 'id' in g) {
        const o = g as Partial<ISplitInviteAthlete>;
        const gid = String(o.id || '').trim();
        if (gid) acc.push({ ...o, id: gid, nombre: String(o.nombre || gid) });
      }
      return acc;
    }, []);

export const parseAndValidateTerminalQr = (raw: string, nowSynced: number, tr: (es: string, en: string) => string): string => {
  const trimmedRaw = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!trimmedRaw) throw new Error(tr('Ingresa o escanea una llave QR o folio válido.', 'Enter or scan a valid QR key or folio.'));
  const pkt = parseTerminalQrPacket(trimmedRaw, nowSynced);
  if (pkt.isExpired) {
    throw new Error(tr('Llave QR expirada (más de 60s). Pídele al atleta que muestre su Bóveda activa.', 'Expired QR key (over 60s). Ask the athlete to display their active Vault pass.'));
  }
  if (!pkt.ok || !pkt.qrIdentifier) throw new Error(tr('Formato de llave QR inválido o ajeno a Kinetic.', 'Invalid or non-Kinetic QR key format.'));
  return pkt.qrIdentifier;
};

const SHA256_K = [
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,

  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,

  0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,

];

function utf8ToBytes(str: string): Uint8Array {
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') return new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const encoded = unescape(encodeURIComponent(str));
  return Uint8Array.from(encoded, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);
}

export function sha256BytesSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const bitLen = data.length * 8;
  const paddedLen = (((data.length + 8) >> 6) + 1) * 64;
  const words = new Int32Array(paddedLen >> 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 1) {
    words[i >> 2] |= (data[i] & 0xff) << (24 - (i % 4) * 8);
  }
  words[data.length >> 2] |= 0x80 << (24 - (data.length % 4) * 8);
  words[words.length - 2] = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  words[words.length - 1] = bitLen >>> 0;

  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const rotr = (n: number, x: number) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const w = new Int32Array(64);
  for (let j = 0; j < words.length; j += 16) {
    let [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h] = H;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i += 1) {
      w[i] =
        i < 16
          ? words[j + i]
          : ((rotr(17, w[i - 2]) ^ rotr(19, w[i - 2]) ^ (w[i - 2] >>> 10)) +
              w[i - 7] +
              (rotr(7, w[i - 15]) ^ rotr(18, w[i - 15]) ^ (w[i - 15] >>> 3)) +
              w[i - 16]) |
            0;
      const t1 = (h + (rotr(6, e) ^ rotr(11, e) ^ rotr(25, e)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + SHA256_K[i] + w[i]) | 0;
      const t2 = ((rotr(2, a) ^ rotr(13, a) ^ rotr(22, a)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c))) | 0;
      [h, g, f, e, d, c, b, a] = [g, f, e, (d + t1) | 0, c, b, a, (t1 + t2) | 0];
    }
    const vals = [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h];
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k += 1) H[k] = (H[k] + vals[k]) | 0;
  }
  const out = new Uint8Array(32);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {
    out[i * 4] = (H[i] >>> 24) & 0xff;
    out[i * 4 + 1] = (H[i] >>> 16) & 0xff;
    out[i * 4 + 2] = (H[i] >>> 8) & 0xff;
    out[i * 4 + 3] = H[i] & 0xff;
  }
  return out;
}

export function hmacSha256HexSync(secret: string, message: string): string {
  let keyBytes = utf8ToBytes(secret);
  if (keyBytes.length > 64) keyBytes = sha256BytesSync(keyBytes);
  const block = new Uint8Array(64);
  block.set(keyBytes);

  const msgBytes = utf8ToBytes(message);
  const inner = new Uint8Array(64 + msgBytes.length);
  const outer = new Uint8Array(64 + 32);
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i += 1) {
    inner[i] = block[i] ^ 0x36;
    outer[i] = block[i] ^ 0x5c;
  }
  inner.set(msgBytes, 64);
  outer.set(sha256BytesSync(inner), 64);
  return Array.from(sha256BytesSync(outer), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

function timingSafeHexEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length || a.length === 0) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 1) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

export function verifyStripeWebhookSignatureSync(input: {
  rawBody: string;
  signatureHeader: string;
  webhookSecret: string;
  nowEpochSec: number;
  toleranceSec?: number;
}): { ok: boolean; reason?: string; timestampSec?: number } {
  const { rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret, nowEpochSec } = input;
  const tol = typeof input.toleranceSec === 'number' && input.toleranceSec > 0 ? input.toleranceSec : 300;
  if (!webhookSecret || !signatureHeader || typeof rawBody !== 'string') return { ok: false, reason: 'missing_inputs' };

  const parts = signatureHeader.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  let timestampSec = -1;
  const v1List: string[] = [];
  for (const part of parts) {
    const eqIdx = part.indexOf('=');
    if (eqIdx <= 0) continue;
    const k = part.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
    const v = part.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (k === 't' && /^\d+$/.test(v)) timestampSec = Number(v);
    if (k === 'v1' && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(v)) v1List.push(v);
  }
  if (timestampSec <= 0 || v1List.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'malformed_signature_header' };
  if (Math.abs(nowEpochSec - timestampSec) > tol) return { ok: false, reason: 'timestamp_outside_tolerance', timestampSec };

  const expected = hmacSha256HexSync(webhookSecret, `${timestampSec}.${rawBody}`);
  const match = v1List.some((sig) => timingSafeHexEqual(sig, expected));
  return match ? { ok: true, timestampSec } : { ok: false, reason: 'signature_mismatch', timestampSec };
}

export function createIdempotentStripeEventProcessor() {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  let totalKcCredited = 0;
  let processedCount = 0;
  return {
    process(eventId: string, kcAmount: number): { status: 'processed' | 'duplicate_ignored' | 'rejected'; totalKcCredited: number; processedCount: number } {
      const cleanId = String(eventId || '').trim();
      if (cleanId.length < 4 || !Number.isSafeInteger(kcAmount) || kcAmount <= 0 || kcAmount % 10 !== 0) {
        return { status: 'rejected', totalKcCredited, processedCount };
      }
      if (seen.has(cleanId)) return { status: 'duplicate_ignored', totalKcCredited, processedCount };
      seen.add(cleanId);
      totalKcCredited += kcAmount;
      processedCount += 1;
      return { status: 'processed', totalKcCredited, processedCount };
    },
  };
}

export function createDeterministicWindowRateLimiter(maxHits: number, windowSeconds: number) {
  const safeMax = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxHits));
  const safeWin = Math.max(1, Math.floor(windowSeconds));
  const windows = new Map<string, { windowStartSec: number; hitCount: number }>();
  return {
    consume(scope: string, actorKey: string, nowSec: number): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterSeconds: number } {
      const key = `${String(scope)}\u0000${String(actorKey)}`;
      const existing = windows.get(key);
      if (!existing || nowSec >= existing.windowStartSec + safeWin) {
        windows.set(key, { windowStartSec: nowSec, hitCount: 1 });
        return { allowed: true, remaining: Math.max(0, safeMax - 1), retryAfterSeconds: 0 };
      }
      if (existing.hitCount < safeMax) {
        existing.hitCount += 1;
        return { allowed: true, remaining: Math.max(0, safeMax - existing.hitCount), retryAfterSeconds: 0 };
      }
      const retry = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(existing.windowStartSec + safeWin - nowSec));
      return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterSeconds: retry };
    },
  };
}

export function createSingleUseQrNonceGuard() {
  const consumedReservas = new Set<string>();
  const consumedStepNonces = new Set<string>();
  return {
    consume(reservaId: string, totpStep: number, qrNonce?: string | null): boolean {
      const cleanRes = String(reservaId || '').trim();
      if (!cleanRes || consumedReservas.has(cleanRes)) return false;
      const cleanNonce = String(qrNonce || '').trim();
      const stepNonceKey = cleanNonce && cleanNonce !== String(totpStep) ? `${totpStep}\u0000${cleanNonce}` : '';
      if (stepNonceKey && consumedStepNonces.has(stepNonceKey)) return false;
      consumedReservas.add(cleanRes);
      if (stepNonceKey) consumedStepNonces.add(stepNonceKey);
      return true;
    },
  };
}

export type ConcurrentSimOp =
  | { kind: 'reserve'; precioKc: number }
  | { kind: 'claim_reward'; retoId: string; kcReward: number }
  | { kind: 'cancel_one' };

export function simulateConcurrentEscrowAndChestBurst(
  initialCap: number,
  initialMemKc: number,
  initialTopKc: number,
  ops: ConcurrentSimOp[]
) {
  const cap = Math.max(0, Math.floor(initialCap));
  let memKc = Math.max(0, Math.floor(initialMemKc / 10) * 10);
  let topKc = Math.max(0, Math.floor(initialTopKc / 10) * 10);
  let inscritos = 0;
  let acceptedBookings = 0;
  let rejectedCupo = 0;
  let duplicateClaims = 0;
  const claimedRetos = new Set<string>();

  for (const op of ops) {
    if (op.kind === 'reserve') {
      if (inscritos >= cap) { rejectedCupo += 1; continue; }
      const rawPrice = Math.max(0, Math.floor(op.precioKc));
      if (rawPrice % 10 !== 0) continue;
      const escrow = Math.round(rawPrice * 0.4);
      if (memKc + topKc < escrow) continue;
      const useMem = Math.min(memKc, escrow);
      const useTop = escrow - useMem;
      memKc -= useMem;
      topKc -= useTop;
      inscritos += 1;
      acceptedBookings += 1;
    } else if (op.kind === 'claim_reward') {
      const key = String(op.retoId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!key) continue;
      if (claimedRetos.has(key)) { duplicateClaims += 1; continue; }
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(op.kcReward) || op.kcReward < 0 || op.kcReward % 10 !== 0 || op.kcReward > 50) continue;
      claimedRetos.add(key);
      topKc += op.kcReward;
    } else if (op.kind === 'cancel_one' && inscritos > 0) {
      inscritos -= 1;
    }
  }
  return {
    cap,
    inscritos,
    memKc,
    topKc,
    totalKc: memKc + topKc,
    acceptedBookings,
    rejectedCupo,
    duplicateClaims,
    claimedCount: claimedRetos.size,
  };
}

const toPdfSafeText = (input: unknown): string =>
  String(input ?? '')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/•/g, '-')
    .replace(/✓/g, 'OK')
    .replace(/⚡/g, '')
    .replace(/★/g, '*')
    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7EÁÉÍÓÚáéíóúÑñÜü$%.,:;()/#@+\-_]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

const escapePdfLiteral = (str: string): string =>
  toPdfSafeText(str)
    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
    .replace(/\(/g, '\\(')
    .replace(/\)/g, '\\)');

    ) => {

        config.tableSectionTitle ||
        (isEn
          ? 'ACCOUNTING & BANKING SPEI PAYOUT BREAKDOWN BY AFFILIATE (PARITY 1 KC = $1.00 MXN)'
          : 'DESGLOSE CONTABLE Y BANCARIO DE DISPERSIONES SPEI POR AFILIADO (PARIDAD 1 KC = $1.00 MXN)');
      drawText(sectionHeader, 24, cursorY + 4, 8.2, true, [0.08, 0.1, 0.16]);
      cursorY += 10;

      const tableX = 24;
      const tableW = pageWidth - 48;
      drawRect(tableX, cursorY, tableW, 18, [0.06, 0.08, 0.14]);
      const defaultHeaders = isEn
        ? ['#', 'AFFILIATE / DISCIPLINE', 'TAX STATUS / CLABE', 'ACTIVITY', 'GROSS 100%', 'KINETIC 20%', 'SAT TAX', 'NET SPEI']
        : ['#', 'AFILIADO / DISCIPLINA', 'ESTATUS FISCAL / CLABE', 'OPERACIÓN', 'BRUTO 100%', 'KINETIC 20%', 'RET. SAT', 'NETO SPEI'];
      const hdrs = config.tableHeaders && config.tableHeaders.length === 8 ? config.tableHeaders : defaultHeaders;
      const colXs = [28, 44, 178, 296, 358, 412, 468, 520];
      colXs.forEach((x, idx) => drawText(hdrs[idx] || '', x, cursorY + 12, 6.4, true, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]));
      cursorY += 18;

      const rowH = 20.5;
      for (let i = 0; i < pageRows.length; i++) {
        const r = pageRows[i];
        const bgRgb: [number, number, number] = r.hasPositivePayout
          ? [0.92, 0.99, 0.95]
          : i % 2 === 0
          ? [1, 1, 1]
          : [0.96, 0.97, 0.99];
        drawRect(tableX, cursorY, tableW, rowH, bgRgb, [0.88, 0.9, 0.94], 0.4);
        drawText(r.idx, 28, cursorY + 13, 7, true, [0.35, 0.4, 0.48]);
        drawText(r.afiliado, 44, cursorY + 9.5, 7, true, [0.08, 0.1, 0.15]);
        drawText(r.disciplina, 44, cursorY + 17.5, 6, false, [0.42, 0.47, 0.56]);
        drawText(r.rfcStatus, 178, cursorY + 9.5, 6.2, true, [0.15, 0.2, 0.28]);
        drawText(`CLABE: ${r.clabe}`, 178, cursorY + 17.5, 6, false, [0.42, 0.47, 0.56]);
        drawText(r.operacion, 296, cursorY + 13, 6.4, false, [0.2, 0.24, 0.32]);
        drawText(r.bruto, 358, cursorY + 13, 6.8, true, [0.12, 0.15, 0.22]);
        drawText(r.kinetic20, 412, cursorY + 13, 6.8, false, [0.48, 0.2, 0.72]);
        drawText(r.retSat, 468, cursorY + 13, 6.8, false, [0.8, 0.18, 0.18]);
        drawText(
          r.netoSpei,
          520,
          cursorY + 13,
          7.5,
          true,
          r.hasPositivePayout ? [0.0, 0.58, 0.26] : [0.45, 0.5, 0.58]
        );
        cursorY += rowH;
      }
      cursorY += 8;
    }

    if (isLastPage) {
      if (config.detailBlocks && config.detailBlocks.length > 0) {
        config.detailBlocks.forEach((block) => {
          const blockH = 22 + block.lines.length * 18;
          drawRect(24, cursorY, pageWidth - 48, blockH, [1, 1, 1], [0.84, 0.87, 0.92], 0.8);
          drawRect(24, cursorY, pageWidth - 48, 18, [0.06, 0.08, 0.14]);
          drawText(block.sectionTitle, 32, cursorY + 12, 7.5, true, [0.0, 0.94, 1.0]);
          let lineY = cursorY + 31;
          block.lines.forEach((ln) => {
            drawText(ln.label, 34, lineY, 8, false, [0.3, 0.35, 0.44]);
            drawText(ln.value, 320, lineY, 8.5, true, ln.highlight ? [0.0, 0.58, 0.26] : [0.08, 0.1, 0.16]);
            lineY += 18;
          });
          cursorY += blockH + 10;
        });
      }

      const footerY = Math.max(cursorY + 4, pageHeight - 54);
      drawRect(24, footerY, pageWidth - 48, 36, [0.05, 0.07, 0.12]);
      (config.footerLegal || []).slice(0, 3).forEach((line, idx) => {
        drawText(
          line,
          32,
          footerY + 11 + idx * 9,
          6.3,
          idx === 0,
          idx === 0 ? [0.0, 0.94, 1.0] : [0.75, 0.8, 0.88]
        );
      });
    }

    pageStreams.push(ops.join('\n'));
  }

  const kidsStr = pageStreams.map((_, idx) => `${5 + idx * 2} 0 R`).join(' ');
  const objects: string[] = [
    '1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj\n',
    `2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [${kidsStr}] /Count ${pageStreams.length} >>\nendobj\n`,
    '3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>\nendobj\n',
    '4 0 obj\n<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>\nendobj\n',
  ];

  pageStreams.forEach((stream, idx) => {
    const pageObjId = 5 + idx * 2;
    const streamObjId = 6 + idx * 2;
    objects.push(
      `${pageObjId} 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${pageWidth} ${pageHeight}] /Contents ${streamObjId} 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R >> >> >>\nendobj\n`
    );
    objects.push(
      `${streamObjId} 0 obj\n<< /Length ${stream.length} >>\nstream\n${stream}\nendstream\nendobj\n`
    );
  });

  let pdfStr = '%PDF-1.4\n';
  const offsets: number[] = [0];
  for (const obj of objects) {
    offsets.push(pdfStr.length);
    pdfStr += obj;
  }
  const xrefOffset = pdfStr.length;
  pdfStr += `xref\n0 ${objects.length + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= objects.length; i++) {
    pdfStr += `${String(offsets[i]).padStart(10, '0')} 00000 n \n`;
  }
  pdfStr += `trailer\n<< /Size ${objects.length + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xrefOffset}\n%%EOF`;

  const bytes = new Uint8Array(pdfStr.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < pdfStr.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = pdfStr.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff;
  }
  return bytes;
};

export const uploadAndOpenInvoicePdf = async (
  fileNamePrefix: string,
  config: IPdfInvoiceConfig
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const cleanName =
    config.fileName ||
    buildCleanKineticPdfFileName(config.pdfKind || fileNamePrefix, config.periodDateIso);

  if (
    Platform.OS === 'web' &&
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof document.createElement === 'function'
  ) {
    const pdfBytes = buildKineticInvoicePdfBytes(config);
    const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array(pdfBytes)], { type: 'application/pdf' });
    const navObj = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? (navigator as Navigator & { canShare?: (d: { files?: File[] }) => boolean; share?: (d: { files?: File[]; title?: string }) => Promise<void> }) : null;
    const ua = String(navObj?.userAgent || '');
    const isIosWebKit = /(iphone|ipad|ipod)/i.test(ua);
    if (isIosWebKit && typeof File === 'function' && typeof navObj?.canShare === 'function' && typeof navObj?.share === 'function') {
      try {
        const file = new File([blob], cleanName, { type: 'application/pdf' });
        if (navObj.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
          await navObj.share({ files: [file], title: cleanName }).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
          return true;
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }
    const blobUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    if (isIosWebKit && typeof window.open === 'function') {
      window.open(blobUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
      setTimeout(() => { try { window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } }, 45_000);
      return true;
    }
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = blobUrl;
    link.download = cleanName;
    link.rel = 'noopener';
    link.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    setTimeout(() => {
      try { link.remove(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }, 400);
    setTimeout(() => {
      try { window.URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }, 45_000);
    return true;
  }

  const html = buildNativeKineticPdfHtml(config);
  const { uri } = await Print.printToFileAsync({ html, width: 595, height: 842 });
  if (!uri) {
    throw new Error('NATIVE_PDF_PRINT_FAILED');
  }

  let shareUri = uri;
  if (cacheDirectory) {
    const baseDir = cacheDirectory.endsWith('/') ? cacheDirectory : `${cacheDirectory}/`;
    const targetUri = `${baseDir}${cleanName}`;
    if (targetUri !== uri) {
      try {
        await deleteAsync(targetUri, { idempotent: true }).catch(() => {});
        await copyAsync({ from: uri, to: targetUri });
        shareUri = targetUri;
        void deleteAsync(uri, { idempotent: true }).catch(() => {});
      } catch {
        shareUri = uri;
      }
    }
  }

  const canShare = await Sharing.isAvailableAsync().catch(() => false);
  if (canShare) {
    await Sharing.shareAsync(shareUri, {
      mimeType: 'application/pdf',
      UTI: 'com.adobe.pdf',
      dialogTitle: config.docTitle,
    });
    return true;
  }

  await Share.share({
    title: config.docTitle,
    url: shareUri,
    message: `${config.docTitle} (${config.folio})`,
  });
  return true;
};

export const safeOpenOrShareInvoicePdf = async (
  rawPrefix: string,
  config: IPdfInvoiceConfig
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const safePrefix =
    String(rawPrefix || 'Kinetic_Reporte')
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '_')
      .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'Kinetic_Reporte';
  try {
    return await uploadAndOpenInvoicePdf(safePrefix, config);
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      const summaryLines = [
        config.docTitle,
        `Folio: ${config.folio}`,
        config.periodoLabel,
        '',
        ...(config.kpis || []).map((k) => `• ${k.label}: ${k.value} (${k.sub})`),
      ].join('\n');
      await Share.share({ title: config.docTitle, message: summaryLines });
      return true;
    } catch {
      throw err;
    }
  }
};

export const escapeHtmlSafe = (val: unknown): string =>
  String(val ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')

export function buildCleanKineticPdfFileName(
  kind: 'ceo' | 'b2b' | 'boveda' | string,
  rawDateIso?: string
): string {
  const cleanIsoMatch = String(rawDateIso || '').trim().match(/(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);
  const datePart = cleanIsoMatch ? cleanIsoMatch[1] : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const normKind = String(kind || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (normKind === 'ceo' || normKind.includes('maestro') || normKind.includes('ceo')) {
    return `Kinetic_Reporte_CEO_${datePart}.pdf`;
  }
  if (normKind === 'b2b' || normKind.includes('estado') || normKind.includes('account') || normKind.includes('afiliado')) {
    return `Kinetic_Estado_Cuenta_B2B_${datePart}.pdf`;
  }
  return `Kinetic_Recibo_Boveda_${datePart}.pdf`;
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { PermissionsAndroid, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export type PushPlatform = 'android' | 'ios' | 'web';

export const PUSH_FCM_SYNCED_SNAPSHOT_KEY = '@kinetic_push_fcm_synced_v1';
const UUID_STRICT_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const FORBIDDEN_TOKEN_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', 'null', 'undefined']);

export function resolveCurrentPushPlatform(): PushPlatform {
  if (Platform.OS === 'ios') return 'ios';
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return 'web';
  return 'android';
}

export function sanitizePushDeviceToken(rawToken: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof rawToken !== 'string') return null;
  const clean = rawToken.trim();
  if (clean.length < 16 || clean.length > 4096) return null;
  if (/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s<>"'`]/.test(clean)) return null;
  if (clean.includes('..') || /^(?:https?|javascript|data):/i.test(clean)) return null;
  if (FORBIDDEN_TOKEN_KEYS.has(clean.toLowerCase())) return null;
  return clean;
}

export function shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce(input: {
  userId?: string | null;
  nextToken?: string | null;
  cachedUserId?: string | null;
  cachedToken?: string | null;
}): boolean {
  const uid = String(input.userId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_STRICT_RE.test(uid)) return false;
  const cleanToken = sanitizePushDeviceToken(input.nextToken);
  if (!cleanToken) return false;
  if (String(input.cachedUserId || '').trim() === uid && String(input.cachedToken || '').trim() === cleanToken) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

async function hasSilentPushPermission(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'android') return true;
  const apiLevel = Number(Platform.Version);
  if (!Number.isFinite(apiLevel) || apiLevel < 33) return true;
  try {
    return await PermissionsAndroid.check('android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost(params: {
  userId?: string | null;
  rawToken?: string | null;
  platform?: PushPlatform;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; synced: boolean; reason?: string }> {
  const uid = String(params.userId || '').trim();
  const cleanToken = sanitizePushDeviceToken(params.rawToken);
  if (!UUID_STRICT_RE.test(uid) || !cleanToken) {
    return { ok: true, synced: false, reason: 'permission_or_token_pending' };
  }
  if (!(await hasSilentPushPermission())) {
    return { ok: true, synced: false, reason: 'permission_or_token_pending' };
  }

  let cachedUserId = '';
  let cachedToken = '';
  try {
    const rawSnapshot = await AsyncStorage.getItem(PUSH_FCM_SYNCED_SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    if (rawSnapshot) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawSnapshot) as { userId?: unknown; token?: unknown };
      cachedUserId = typeof parsed?.userId === 'string' ? parsed.userId : '';
      cachedToken = typeof parsed?.token === 'string' ? parsed.token : '';
    }
  } catch {}

  if (!shouldSyncPushTokenWriteOnce({ userId: uid, nextToken: cleanToken, cachedUserId, cachedToken })) {
    return { ok: true, synced: false, reason: 'unchanged_write_once' };
  }

  try {
    const platform = params.platform || resolveCurrentPushPlatform();
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('user_push_devices')
      .upsert(
        { user_id: uid, platform, push_token: cleanToken, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() },
        { onConflict: 'user_id,push_token' }
      );
    if (error) return { ok: false, synced: false, reason: 'sync_deferred_offline_or_schema' };
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(PUSH_FCM_SYNCED_SNAPSHOT_KEY, JSON.stringify({ userId: uid, token: cleanToken })).catch(() => {});
    return { ok: true, synced: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, synced: false, reason: 'sync_deferred_offline' };
  }
}

async function purgeDeletedDmFromStorage(
  code: string, extraCodes: string[], peerId: string, effectiveUid: string, currentThreads: IDirectMessageThread[]
): Promise<void> {
  const allCodesUpper = new Set([code, ...extraCodes.map((c) => c.toUpperCase())]);
  const filtered = currentThreads.filter((t) => {
    if (allCodesUpper.has(t.dmCode.toUpperCase()) || allCodesUpper.has(t.threadId.toUpperCase())) return false;
    if (peerId && (String(t.requesterId || '').toLowerCase() === peerId || String(t.targetId || '').toLowerCase() === peerId)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  if (effectiveUid) await AsyncStorage.setItem(getScopedDmStorageKey(effectiveUid), JSON.stringify(filtered));
  const legacyRaw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY);
  if (!legacyRaw) return;
  const legacyList = JSON.parse(legacyRaw) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  const nextLegacy = (Array.isArray(legacyList) ? legacyList : []).filter(
    (t) => !allCodesUpper.has(String(t?.dmCode || '').toUpperCase()) && !allCodesUpper.has(String(t?.threadId || '').toUpperCase())
  );
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(DIRECT_MESSAGES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextLegacy));
}

async function collectVerifiedDmTeamIds(
  code: string,
  extraCodes: string[],
  targetDbTeamId: string,
  effectiveUid: string,
  myUserName: string | null | undefined
): Promise<string[]> {
  const codesToDelete = Array.from(new Set([code, ...extraCodes])).filter(Boolean);
  const { data: teams } = codesToDelete.length > 0
    ? await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id, nombre, creador_id, codigo_invitacion').in('codigo_invitacion', codesToDelete)
    : { data: [] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> };
  const candidateTeams = Array.isArray(teams) ? [...(teams as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)] : [];
  if (isUuid(targetDbTeamId) && !candidateTeams.some((r) => String(r?.id || '').toLowerCase() === targetDbTeamId.toLowerCase())) {
    const { data: teamById } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id, nombre, creador_id, codigo_invitacion').eq('id', targetDbTeamId).maybeSingle();
    if (teamById) candidateTeams.push(teamById as Record<string, unknown>);
  }
  const verifiedTeamIds = new Set<string>();
  candidateTeams.forEach((r) => {
    const tid = String(r?.id || '');
    if (!tid) return;
    let meta: Record<string, string> = {};
    try { if (String(r?.nombre || '').startsWith('{')) meta = JSON.parse(String(r.nombre)); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    const isPart = String(r?.creador_id || '').toLowerCase() === effectiveUid.toLowerCase()
      || matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, meta.reqId, meta.reqName)
      || matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, meta.tgtId, meta.tgtName)
      || Boolean(extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(String(r?.codigo_invitacion || ''), effectiveUid));
    if (isPart) verifiedTeamIds.add(tid);
  });
  return Array.from(verifiedTeamIds);
}

export async function deleteDirectMessageThread(dmCodeOrThreadId: string, myUserId?: string | null, myUserName?: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
  const code = String(dmCodeOrThreadId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!code) return false;
  const effectiveUid = await resolveStrictDmUserId(myUserId);
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  let peerId = extractPeerUuidFromDmCode(code, effectiveUid), extraCodes: string[] = [], targetDbTeamId = '';

  try {
    const currentThreads = await baseLoadLocalDmThreads(effectiveUid, myUserName);
    const targetThread = currentThreads.find((t) => t.dmCode.toUpperCase() === code || t.threadId.toUpperCase() === code);
    if (targetThread) {
      const amReq = matchesUserIdentity(effectiveUid, myUserName, targetThread.requesterId, targetThread.requesterName);
      const candidatePeer = String(amReq ? targetThread.targetId : targetThread.requesterId || '').trim();
      if (isUuid(candidatePeer)) peerId = candidatePeer.toLowerCase();
      if (targetThread.dbTeamId) targetDbTeamId = String(targetThread.dbTeamId);
      if (Array.isArray(targetThread.legacyCodes)) extraCodes = targetThread.legacyCodes;
    }
    await markDmDeletedLocally(code, effectiveUid, nowIso, peerId, extraCodes);
    await purgeDeletedDmFromStorage(code, extraCodes, peerId, effectiveUid, currentThreads);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }

  if (isUuid(effectiveUid)) {
    try {
      const verifiedIds = await collectVerifiedDmTeamIds(code, extraCodes, targetDbTeamId, effectiveUid, myUserName);
      for (const tid of verifiedIds) {
        await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').delete().eq('equipo_id', tid);
        await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').delete().eq('id', tid);
      }
      if (isUuid(peerId) && effectiveUid.toLowerCase() !== peerId.toLowerCase()) {
        await supabase.from('mensajes_directos').delete().or(`and(sender_id.eq.${effectiveUid},recipient_id.eq.${peerId}),and(sender_id.eq.${peerId},recipient_id.eq.${effectiveUid})`);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    }
  }
  invalidateRealtimeChatBridgeCache();
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return true;
}

export async function deleteSquadCloud(equipoId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const eqId = String(equipoId || '').trim(), uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!eqId) return false;
  try {
    if (isUuid(eqId) && isUuid(uid)) {
      const { data: ownRow } = await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').select('id').eq('id', eqId).eq('creador_id', uid).maybeSingle();
      if (ownRow?.id) {
        await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').delete().eq('equipo_id', eqId);
        await supabase.from('equipo_miembros').delete().eq('equipo_id', eqId);
        await supabase.from('equipos_kinetic').delete().eq('id', eqId).eq('creador_id', uid);
      }
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }

  try {
    const [rawSq, rawMsg, rawInv] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(SHARED_SQUADS_KEY), AsyncStorage.getItem(SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_KEY), AsyncStorage.getItem(SHARED_SQUAD_INVITES_KEY),
    ]);
    if (rawSq) {
      const mapSq = (JSON.parse(rawSq) || {}) as Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
      delete mapSq[eqId];
      if (uid) delete mapSq[`sq_${uid}`];
      Object.keys(mapSq).forEach((k) => { if (String(mapSq[k]?.id) === eqId) delete mapSq[k]; });
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(SHARED_SQUADS_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapSq));
    }
    if (rawMsg) {
      const mapMsg = (JSON.parse(rawMsg) || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      delete mapMsg[eqId];
      if (uid) delete mapMsg[`sq_${uid}`];
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapMsg));
    }
    if (rawInv) {
      const listInv = (JSON.parse(rawInv) || []) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(SHARED_SQUAD_INVITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(listInv.filter((i) => String(i?.equipo_id) !== eqId)));
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }

  clearStableSquadRegistry(eqId);
  if (uid) clearStableSquadRegistry(uid);
  invalidateRealtimeChatBridgeCache();
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return true;
}

export async function leaveSquadCloud(equipoId: string, userId: string, userName?: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
  const eqId = String(equipoId || '').trim(), uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  const cleanName = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: uid, name: userName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
  if (!eqId) return false;
  try {
    if (isUuid(eqId) && isUuid(uid)) {
      await supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([{ equipo_id: eqId, usuario_id: uid, usuario_nombre: cleanName, mensaje: `⚡ ${cleanName} salió del equipo.` }]);
      await supabase.from('equipo_miembros').delete().eq('equipo_id', eqId).eq('usuario_id', uid);
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }

  try {
    const [rawSq, rawMsg, rawInv] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(SHARED_SQUADS_KEY), AsyncStorage.getItem(SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_KEY), AsyncStorage.getItem(SHARED_SQUAD_INVITES_KEY),
    ]);
    if (rawSq) { const mapSq = (JSON.parse(rawSq) || {}) as Record<string, unknown>; delete mapSq[eqId]; await AsyncStorage.setItem(SHARED_SQUADS_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapSq)); }
    if (rawMsg) { const mapMsg = (JSON.parse(rawMsg) || {}) as Record<string, unknown>; delete mapMsg[eqId]; await AsyncStorage.setItem(SHARED_SQUAD_MSGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapMsg)); }
    if (rawInv) {
      const listInv = (JSON.parse(rawInv) || []) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
      const nextInv = listInv.filter((i) => !(String(i?.equipo_id) === eqId && ((uid && String(i?.usuario_id) === uid) || (cleanName && normalizeChatIdentity(String(i?.usuario_nombre || '')) === normalizeChatIdentity(cleanName)))));
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(SHARED_SQUAD_INVITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextInv));
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }

  invalidateRealtimeChatBridgeCache();
  emitSquadsDataChanged();
  return true;
}

let _squadMsgsInflight: Promise<Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]>> | null = null;
let _squadMsgsCacheKey = '';
let _squadMsgsCacheTs = 0;

export const resolveSquadCloudRoomKey = (squadOrId?: Partial<IEquipoKinetic> | string | null): string => {
  if (!squadOrId) return 'sq_kinetic_oficial';
  if (typeof squadOrId === 'object') {
    const code = String(squadOrId.codigo_invitacion || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code.length >= 4) return `code_${code}`;
    const nameKey = normalizeChatIdentity(squadOrId.nombre || squadOrId.creador_nombre);
    if (nameKey) return `name_${nameKey}`;
    return String(squadOrId.id || 'sq_kinetic_oficial');
  }
  return String(squadOrId);
};

export async function publishSquadMessageCloud(params: {
  id: string; equipoId: string; squadCode?: string; roomKey?: string;
  senderId: string; senderName: string; senderAvatar?: string | null; text: string; createdAt: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const cleanSender = resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({ id: params.senderId, name: params.senderName, fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete') });
  const roomKey = resolveCanonicalTeamRoomKey(params.equipoId);
  void broadcastInstantChatMessage({
    kind: 'team', roomKey, equipoId: params.equipoId, senderId: params.senderId, senderName: cleanSender,
    senderAvatar: params.senderAvatar || null, clientMsgId: params.id, text: params.text, createdAt: params.createdAt,
  });
  if (isUuid(params.equipoId)) {
    const row: Record<string, unknown> = { equipo_id: params.equipoId, usuario_nombre: cleanSender, mensaje: params.text };
    if (isUuid(params.senderId)) row.usuario_id = params.senderId;
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('equipo_mensajes').insert([row]),
        isUuid(params.senderId) ? markChatRoomReadEverywhere({ uid: params.senderId, roomKey, roomKind: 'team', equipoId: params.equipoId }) : Promise.resolve(''),
      ]);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    }
  }
  invalidateRealtimeChatBridgeCache();
}

async function hydrateCloudSquadMsgsIntoMap(
  dbUuids: string[],
  bySquadId: Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]>
): Promise<void> {
  if (dbUuids.length === 0) return;
  try {
    const { data: dbData } = await supabase
      .from('equipo_mensajes')
      .select('id, equipo_id, usuario_id, usuario_nombre, mensaje, created_at')
      .in('equipo_id', dbUuids)
      .not('mensaje', 'ilike', STORY_BASE64_PREFIX_FILTER)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(60);
    if (!Array.isArray(dbData)) return;
    [...dbData].reverse().forEach((m: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      const eqId = String(m.equipo_id || '');
      if (!bySquadId[eqId]) return;
      bySquadId[eqId].push({
        id: String(m.id),
        equipo_id: eqId,
        usuario_id: String(m.usuario_id || ''),
        usuario_nombre: resolveOfficialChatDisplayName({
          id: String(m.usuario_id || ''),
          name: String(m.usuario_nombre || ''),
          fallback: td('Atleta Kinetic', 'Kinetic Athlete'),
        }),
        mensaje: String(m.mensaje || ''),
        created_at: String(m.created_at || new Date().toISOString()),
      });
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
}

export async function fetchAllCloudSquadMessages(squads: IEquipoKinetic[]): Promise<Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]>> {
  const squadKey = squads.map((s) => String(s.id)).sort().join('|');
  if (_squadMsgsCacheVal && _squadMsgsCacheKey === squadKey && Date.now() - _squadMsgsCacheTs < CHAT_BRIDGE_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return _squadMsgsCacheVal;
  }
  if (_squadMsgsInflight && _squadMsgsCacheKey === squadKey) return _squadMsgsInflight;
  _squadMsgsCacheKey = squadKey;
  _squadMsgsInflight = (async () => {
    try {
      const bySquadId: Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]> = {};
      squads.forEach((s) => { bySquadId[String(s.id)] = []; });
      const dbUuids = squads.map((s) => String(s.id)).filter((id) => isUuid(id));
      await hydrateCloudSquadMsgsIntoMap(dbUuids, bySquadId);
      const output: Record<string, IMensajeEquipo[]> = {};
      Object.keys(bySquadId).forEach((sqId) => { output[sqId] = deduplicateRealtimeChatMessages(bySquadId[sqId]); });
      _squadMsgsCacheVal = output;
      _squadMsgsCacheTs = Date.now();
      return output;
    } finally {
      _squadMsgsInflight = null;
    }
  })();
  return _squadMsgsInflight;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

const PRESENCE_CHANNEL_NAME = 'kinetic_live_presence_v272';
const FORBIDDEN_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export interface IKineticLivePresenceState {
  onlineUserIds: Set<string>;
  onlineCount: number;
  isConnected: boolean;
}

export const extractOnlineUserIdsFromPresenceState = (
  stateObj: Record<string, any> | null | undefined
): Set<string> => {
  const result = new Set<string>();
  if (!stateObj || typeof stateObj !== 'object') return result;

  for (const [presenceKey, entries] of Object.entries(stateObj)) {
    const cleanKey = String(presenceKey || '').trim();
    if (!cleanKey || FORBIDDEN_KEYS.has(cleanKey.toLowerCase()) || cleanKey.startsWith('anon_')) {
      continue;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) continue;
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') continue;
      if (entry.stealth === true || entry.radar_publico !== true) continue;
      const uid = String(entry.user_id || entry.id || cleanKey).trim();
      if (uid && !FORBIDDEN_KEYS.has(uid.toLowerCase()) && !uid.startsWith('anon_')) {
        result.add(uid);
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
};

let _sharedChannel: any = null;
let _sharedChannelKey = '';
let _sharedConnected = false;
let _sharedOnlineIds: Set<string> = new Set();
const _listeners = new Set<(ids: Set<string>, connected: boolean) => void>();

const emitSharedPresence = () => {
  _listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(_sharedOnlineIds, _sharedConnected);
    } catch {}
  });
};

const releaseSharedPresenceChannel = () => {
  const ch = _sharedChannel;
  _sharedChannel = null;
  _sharedChannelKey = '';
  _sharedConnected = false;
  _sharedOnlineIds = new Set();
  if (ch) {
    try {
      ch.untrack?.();
    } catch {}
    supabase.removeChannel(ch).catch(() => {});
  }
};

export function useKineticLivePresence(
  user?: { id?: string | null } | null,
  profile?: { id?: string | null; nombre?: string | null; radar_publico?: boolean | null } | null
): IKineticLivePresenceState {
  const userId = String(user?.id || profile?.id || '').trim();
  const radarPublico = Boolean(profile && profile.radar_publico === true);
  const displayName = String(profile?.nombre || '').trim().slice(0, 40);

  const [state, setState] = useState<{ ids: Set<string>; connected: boolean }>(() => ({
    ids: _sharedOnlineIds,
    connected: _sharedConnected,
  }));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId) {
      setState({ ids: new Set(), connected: false });
      return;
    }

    const listener = (ids: Set<string>, connected: boolean) => {
      setState({ ids: new Set(ids), connected });
    };
    _listeners.add(listener);

    const desiredModeKey = radarPublico ? `pub:${userId}` : `anon:${userId}`;
    if (_sharedChannel && _sharedChannelKey !== desiredModeKey) {
      releaseSharedPresenceChannel();
    }

    if (!_sharedChannel) {
      const channelKey = radarPublico
        ? userId
        : `anon_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
      const channel = supabase.channel(PRESENCE_CHANNEL_NAME, {
        config: { presence: { key: channelKey } },
      });
      _sharedChannel = channel;
      _sharedChannelKey = desiredModeKey;

      const syncState = () => {
        if (_sharedChannel !== channel) return;
        try {
          _sharedOnlineIds = extractOnlineUserIdsFromPresenceState(channel.presenceState());
          emitSharedPresence();
        } catch {}
      };

      channel
        .on('presence', { event: 'sync' }, syncState)
        .on('presence', { event: 'join' }, syncState)
        .on('presence', { event: 'leave' }, syncState)
        .subscribe(async (status: string) => {
          if (_sharedChannel !== channel) return;
          _sharedConnected = status === 'SUBSCRIBED';
          emitSharedPresence();
          if (_sharedConnected && radarPublico) {
            try {
              await channel.track({
                user_id: userId,
                nombre: displayName || 'Atleta Kinetic',
                radar_publico: true,
                online_at: new Date().toISOString(),
              });
            } catch {}
          }
        });
    } else {
      setState({ ids: new Set(_sharedOnlineIds), connected: _sharedConnected });
    }

    return () => {
      _listeners.delete(listener);
      if (_listeners.size === 0) {
        releaseSharedPresenceChannel();
      }
    };
  }, [userId, radarPublico, displayName]);

  return {
    onlineUserIds: state.ids,
    onlineCount: state.ids.size,
    isConnected: state.connected,
  };
}

import { WAIVER_CURRENT_VERSION } from '../components/LegalTermsModal';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { validateStrictWhatsappPhone } from '../utils/kineticPhoneValidatorLeaf';
import { persistRoleCache } from '../utils/kineticRoleCache';
import { getActiveKineticLanguage } from '../utils/kineticSmartTranslator';
import { eventsService } from './eventsService';
import { doesSessionRequireMfaAal2, getMfaSecuritySnapshot, setPendingMfaGateActive } from './kineticSecurityMfaService';
import { rememberRegisteredKineticAccount } from './kineticSessionPersistence';

export const DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS = new Set([
  'test.com', 'example.com', 'fake.com', 'asdf.com', 'mailinator.com',
  'yopmail.com', 'tempmail.com', '10minutemail.com', 'guerrillamail.com', 'trashmail.com',
]);

export const TRIVIAL_PASSWORDS = new Set([
  '123456', '000000', '111111', '654321', 'abcdef', 'password', '12345678', 'qwerty',
]);

export const validateRealIdentityInputs = (
  rawName: string, rawEmail: string, rawPhone: string, termsAccepted: boolean, isEnLang: boolean,
  showAlert?: (title: string, msg: string, type?: string) => void,
  triggerHaptic?: (type: string) => void, isAffiliate?: boolean
): { ok: boolean; cleanNombre: string; cleanEmail: string; cleanPhone: string } => {
  const cleanNombre = String(rawName || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  const cleanEmail = String(rawEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const phoneCheck = validateStrictWhatsappPhone(rawPhone);
  const cleanPhone = phoneCheck.normalized10 || phoneCheck.digits;

  if (isAffiliate) {
    const validBizChars = /^[a-zA-Z0-9áéíóúÁÉÍÓÚñÑüÜ\s'&.,-]+$/.test(cleanNombre);
    const hasAlnum = /[a-zA-Z0-9áéíóúÁÉÍÓÚñÑüÜ]/.test(cleanNombre);
    if (cleanNombre.length < 2 || !hasAlnum || !validBizChars || /^atleta\s*\d*$/i.test(cleanNombre)) {
      triggerHaptic?.('Warning');
      showAlert?.(
        isEnLang ? 'BUSINESS NAME REQUIRED' : 'NOMBRE COMERCIAL REQUERIDO',
        isEnLang ? 'Enter your club, studio, or specialist commercial name (at least 2 characters).' : 'Ingresa el nombre comercial de tu club, estudio o marca personal (mínimo 2 caracteres).',
        'warning'
      );
      return { ok: false, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone };
    }
  } else {
    const nameParts = cleanNombre.split(' ').filter((w) => w.length >= 2);
    const hasValidChars = /^[a-zA-ZáéíóúÁÉÍÓÚñÑüÜ\s'-]+$/.test(cleanNombre);
    if (nameParts.length < 2 || !hasValidChars || /^atleta\s*\d*$/i.test(cleanNombre)) {
      triggerHaptic?.('Warning');
      showAlert?.(
        isEnLang ? 'FULL NAME REQUIRED' : 'NOMBRE Y APELLIDO REQUERIDOS',
        isEnLang ? 'Please enter your real first and last name for bookings and Escrow security.' : 'Ingresa tu Nombre y Apellido reales para respaldar tus reservaciones y custodia Escrow.',
        'warning'
      );
      return { ok: false, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone };
    }
  }

  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@([^\s@]+\.[a-z]{2,})$/;
  const emailMatch = cleanEmail.match(emailRegex);
  const domain = emailMatch ? emailMatch[1] : '';
  if (!emailMatch || DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS.has(domain)) {
    triggerHaptic?.('Warning');
    showAlert?.(
      isEnLang ? 'VALID EMAIL REQUIRED' : 'CORREO VÁLIDO REQUERIDO',
      isEnLang ? 'Please enter a valid personal or corporate email address.' : 'Ingresa un correo electrónico real y válido (no se permiten correos temporales o de prueba).',
      'warning'
    );
    return { ok: false, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone };
  }

  if (!phoneCheck.valid || phoneCheck.normalized10.length !== 10) {
    triggerHaptic?.('Warning');
    showAlert?.(
      isEnLang ? 'VALID 10-DIGIT PHONE REQUIRED' : 'TELÉFONO REAL REQUERIDO',
      isEnLang ? 'Enter a real phone number (no repeated or sequential digits) to link your Kinetic Vault.' : 'Ingresa un teléfono/WhatsApp real (sin secuencias ni dígitos repetidos) para vincular tu Bóveda.',
      'warning'
    );
    return { ok: false, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone };
  }

  if (!termsAccepted) {
    triggerHaptic?.('Warning');
    showAlert?.(
      isEnLang ? 'LEGAL WAIVER REQUIRED' : 'ACEPTACIÓN REQUERIDA',
      isEnLang
        ? 'You must accept the Terms, Conditions & Athletic Waiver of Kinetic.'
        : 'Debes aceptar los Términos, Condiciones y el Waiver Legal de Kinetic.',
      'warning'
    );
    return { ok: false, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone };
  }

  return { ok: true, cleanNombre, cleanEmail, cleanPhone };
};

  avatarBase64: string | null;
  refreshProfile?: () => Promise<any>;
  activateResilientSession?: (user: any, profile: any, session?: any) => void;
}

async function upsertProfileSelfHealing(
  fullPayload: Record<string, unknown>,
  minimalPayload: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const uid = String(fullPayload?.id || minimalPayload?.id || '').trim();
  if (uid) {
    const { data: existing } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', uid).maybeSingle();
    if (existing) return existing;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('perfiles')
    .upsert(fullPayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
    .select('*')
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!error) return data || fullPayload;

  const { data: minData } = await supabase
    .from('perfiles')
    .upsert(minimalPayload, { onConflict: 'id', ignoreDuplicates: true })
    .select('*')
    .maybeSingle();
  return minData || minimalPayload;
}

async function signUpOrRecoverSession(
  cleanEmail: string,
  cleanPass: string,
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const isEn = getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en';
  if (TRIVIAL_PASSWORDS.has(cleanPass.toLowerCase()) || cleanPass.length < 6) {
    throw new Error(
      isEn
        ? 'Password must be at least 6 characters and cannot be an obvious sequence like 123456.'
        : 'La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres y no puede ser una secuencia obvia como 123456.'
    );
  }

  const { data: signUpData, error: signUpErr } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
    email: cleanEmail,
    password: cleanPass,
    options: { data: metadata },
  });

  if (signUpErr) {
    const errLower = String(signUpErr.message || '').toLowerCase();
    const isRateLimit =
      Number((signUpErr as { status?: number })?.status) === 429 ||
      errLower.includes('over_email_send_rate_limit') ||
      errLower.includes('rate limit') ||
      errLower.includes('too many requests') ||
      errLower.includes('for security purposes');

    if (isRateLimit) {
      const { data: recoverData, error: recoverErr } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email: cleanEmail,
        password: cleanPass,
      });
      if (!recoverErr && recoverData?.user) {
        const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot().catch(() => null);
        if (doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(recoverData.session) || mfaSnap?.requiresMfaChallenge || !mfaSnap || mfaSnap.checkFailed) {
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch((err) => { void err; });
          throw new Error('User already registered');
        }
        return { user: recoverData.user, session: recoverData.session ?? null };
      }
      throw new Error(
        isEn
          ? 'Email verification rate limit reached. Wait 60 seconds and try signing in or registering again.'
          : 'Límite temporal de correos de verificación alcanzado. Espera 60 segundos e intenta iniciar sesión o registrarte de nuevo.'
      );
    }
    throw signUpErr;
  }

  let activeUser = signUpData?.user ?? null;
  let activeSession = signUpData?.session ?? null;

  if (!activeSession) {
    const { data: signInData } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: cleanEmail,
      password: cleanPass,
    });
    if (signInData?.session) activeSession = signInData.session;
    if (signInData?.user) activeUser = signInData.user;
  }

  return { user: activeUser, session: activeSession };
}

export async function executeKineticRegistration(
  payload: IKineticRegisterPayload
): Promise<'/(tabs)/admin' | '/(tabs)/terminal' | '/(tabs)'> {
  const {
    isAffiliate,
    tipoSocio,
    cleanNombre,
    cleanEmail,
    cleanPass,
    cleanRfc,
    cleanPhone = '',
    disciplinaSeleccionada,
    avatarUri,
    avatarBase64,
    refreshProfile,
    activateResilientSession,
  } = payload;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const normalizedPhone = cleanPhone.trim() || null;
  const isMasterAdmin =
    cleanEmail === 'administrador@kinetic.com.mx' || cleanEmail === 'administrador@kinetic.com';

  if (isAffiliate) {
    const roleKey = isMasterAdmin ? 'admin' : tipoSocio === 'Especialista' ? 'especialista' : 'socio';
    setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
    try {
      const { user: activeUser, session: activeSession } = await signUpOrRecoverSession(
        cleanEmail,
        cleanPass,
        {
          nombre: cleanNombre,
          telefono: normalizedPhone,
          rol: roleKey,
          tipo_cuenta: roleKey,
          rfc: cleanRfc || null,
          waiver_firmado: true,
          waiver_version: WAIVER_CURRENT_VERSION,
        }
      );

      const userId = activeUser?.id;
      if (!userId) throw new Error(getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? 'Could not generate operator identifier.' : 'No se pudo generar el identificador de operador.');
      const hasRealB2BSess = Boolean(activeSession?.access_token) && !String(activeSession?.access_token || '').startsWith('kinetic-');
      const devB2BMode = typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__ === true && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';
      if (!devB2BMode && !hasRealB2BSess) {
        throw new Error('EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED');
      }

      let finalAvatarUrl = avatarBase64;
      if (avatarUri) {
        const uploaded = await eventsService
          .uploadImage(avatarUri, `avatars/socio_${userId}_${Date.now()}.jpg`)
          .catch(() => null);
        if (uploaded) finalAvatarUrl = uploaded;
      }

      let b2bProfile: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
      const { error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc('registrar_operador_b2b_propio', {
        p_nombre: cleanNombre,
        p_tipo_socio: tipoSocio,
        p_rfc: cleanRfc || null,
        p_telefono: normalizedPhone,
        p_disciplina: disciplinaSeleccionada || 'Fuerza',
        p_avatar_url: finalAvatarUrl || null,
      });

      const rpcErrMsg = String(rpcErr?.message || '').toLowerCase();
      const isRpcMissing =
        rpcErr?.code === '42883' ||
        rpcErr?.code === 'PGRST202' ||
        rpcErrMsg.includes('could not find the function') ||
        rpcErrMsg.includes('does not exist');

      if (rpcErr && !isRpcMissing) {
        throw new Error(rpcErr.message || (getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? 'Could not register B2B operator.' : 'No se pudo registrar el operador B2B.'));
      }

      if (!rpcErr) {
        const { data: fetchedB2B } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('*').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle();
        b2bProfile = {
          ...(fetchedB2B || {}),
          id: userId,
          nombre: (fetchedB2B as any)?.nombre || cleanNombre,
          email: (fetchedB2B as any)?.email || cleanEmail,
          telefono: (fetchedB2B as any)?.telefono ?? normalizedPhone,
          rol: roleKey,
          tipo_cuenta: roleKey,
          nivel: (fetchedB2B as any)?.nivel || (isMasterAdmin ? 'Black' : 'Partner B2B'),
          kc_membresia: Number((fetchedB2B as any)?.kc_membresia || 0),
          kc_topup: Number((fetchedB2B as any)?.kc_topup || 0),
          rfc_fiscal: (fetchedB2B as any)?.rfc_fiscal || cleanRfc || null,
          waiver_firmado: true,
          waiver_version: WAIVER_CURRENT_VERSION,
          waiver_fecha: (fetchedB2B as any)?.waiver_fecha || nowIso,
          avatar_url: (fetchedB2B as any)?.avatar_url || finalAvatarUrl || null,
        };
      } else {
        const selfHealed = await upsertProfileSelfHealing(
          {
            id: userId,
            nombre: cleanNombre,
            email: cleanEmail,
            telefono: normalizedPhone,
            rol: roleKey,
            tipo_cuenta: roleKey,
            nivel: isMasterAdmin ? 'Black' : 'Partner B2B',
            kc_membresia: 0,
            kc_topup: 0,
            rfc_fiscal: cleanRfc || null,
            waiver_firmado: true,
            waiver_version: WAIVER_CURRENT_VERSION,
            waiver_fecha: nowIso,
            avatar_url: finalAvatarUrl || null,
          },
          {
            id: userId,
            nombre: cleanNombre,
            email: cleanEmail,
            telefono: normalizedPhone,
            rol: roleKey,
            tipo_cuenta: roleKey,
            nivel: isMasterAdmin ? 'Black' : 'Partner B2B',
            waiver_firmado: true,
          }
        );
        b2bProfile = { ...(selfHealed || {}), id: userId, rol: roleKey, tipo_cuenta: roleKey };

        const { data: matchByOwner } = await supabase
          .from('afiliados')
          .select('id')
          .eq('propietario_id', userId)
          .limit(1)
          .maybeSingle();

        const existingAffiliateId = matchByOwner?.id || null;

        if (existingAffiliateId) {
          await supabase
            .from('afiliados')
            .update({
              nombre: cleanNombre,
              email_contacto: cleanEmail,
              whatsapp: normalizedPhone,
              rfc: cleanRfc || null,
              estado: 'activo',
            })
            .eq('id', existingAffiliateId)
            .eq('propietario_id', userId);
        } else {
          await supabase.from('afiliados').insert([
            {
              propietario_id: userId,
              nombre: cleanNombre,
              categoria: tipoSocio === 'Especialista' ? 'Especialista' : 'Club',
              es_especialista: tipoSocio === 'Especialista',
              disciplina: disciplinaSeleccionada || 'Fuerza',
              ubicacion: 'Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S.',
              whatsapp: normalizedPhone,
              email_contacto: cleanEmail,
              rfc: cleanRfc || null,
              estado: 'activo',
            },
          ]);
        }
      }

      await persistRoleCache(userId, roleKey);
      await rememberRegisteredKineticAccount(
        cleanEmail,
        cleanNombre,
        'b2b',
        activeUser,
        b2bProfile as Record<string, unknown>,
        activeSession as Record<string, unknown> | null
      );
      setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
      activateResilientSession?.(activeUser, b2bProfile, activeSession);
      Promise.resolve(refreshProfile?.()).catch(() => {});
      return isMasterAdmin ? '/(tabs)/admin' : '/(tabs)/terminal';
    } finally {
      setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
    }
  }

  const athleteRole = isMasterAdmin ? 'admin' : 'atleta';
  const athleteNivel = isMasterAdmin ? 'Black' : 'Acceso Base';

  const { user: activeUser, session: activeSession } = await signUpOrRecoverSession(
    cleanEmail,
    cleanPass,
    {
      nombre: cleanNombre,
      telefono: normalizedPhone,
      rol: athleteRole,
      waiver_firmado: true,
      waiver_version: WAIVER_CURRENT_VERSION,
    }
  );

  if (!activeUser?.id) {
    throw new Error(getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en' ? 'Could not create athlete account.' : 'No se pudo crear la cuenta de atleta.');
  }
  const hasRealAthleteSess = Boolean(activeSession?.access_token) && !String(activeSession?.access_token || '').startsWith('kinetic-');
  const devAthleteMode = typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__ === true && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';
  if (!devAthleteMode && !hasRealAthleteSess) {
    throw new Error('EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED');
  }

  let finalUrl = avatarBase64;
  if (avatarUri) {
    const uploaded = await eventsService
      .uploadImage(avatarUri, `avatars/atleta_${activeUser.id}_${Date.now()}.jpg`)
      .catch(() => null);
    if (uploaded) finalUrl = uploaded;
  }

  const b2cProfile = await upsertProfileSelfHealing(
    {
      id: activeUser.id, nombre: cleanNombre, email: cleanEmail, telefono: normalizedPhone,
      rol: athleteRole, nivel: athleteNivel, kc_membresia: 0, kc_topup: 0,
      fecha_activacion_membresia: nowIso, perdones_mensuales_usados: 0, mes_perdones_control: nowIso.slice(0, 7),
      waiver_firmado: true, waiver_version: WAIVER_CURRENT_VERSION, waiver_fecha: nowIso, avatar_url: finalUrl || null,
    },
    { id: activeUser.id, nombre: cleanNombre, email: cleanEmail, telefono: normalizedPhone, rol: athleteRole, nivel: athleteNivel, waiver_firmado: true, avatar_url: finalUrl || null }
  );

  await rememberRegisteredKineticAccount(
    cleanEmail,
    cleanNombre,
    isMasterAdmin ? 'b2b' : 'b2c',
    activeUser,
    b2cProfile as Record<string, unknown>,
    activeSession as Record<string, unknown> | null
  );
  activateResilientSession?.(activeUser, b2cProfile, activeSession);
  await refreshProfile?.();
  return resolveRoleDestination(activeUser, b2cProfile);
}

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY,
  OPERATIONAL_ACCOUNT_BLUEPRINTS,
  decodeStoredJson,
  enforceJwtRoleGuard,
  getPersistenceState,
  isKineticMasterAdminEmail,
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut,
  safeWebGetItem,
  safeWebSetItem,
  synthesizeProfileFromUser,
  type IKineticPersistedSessionPayload,
  type IKineticPersistedUser,
} from './kineticSessionLeafCore';
import {
  CIPHER_PREFIX,
  DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY,
  SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY,
  decryptKineticString,
  encryptKineticString,
  ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync,
  getOrCreateWebSaltSync,
  isKineticDevRuntime,
  purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys,
} from './kineticVaultCrypto';

export const readEncryptedPersistedAccountSession = async (
  emailRaw: string
): Promise<IKineticPersistedSessionPayload | null> => {
  const cleanEmail = String(emailRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@')) return null;
  try {
    const [salt, rawAsyncCache] = await Promise.all([
      ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync(),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY),
    ]);
    const { json: decAsync, wasPlain } = decodeStoredJson(rawAsyncCache, salt);
    if (!decAsync) return null;
    if (wasPlain) {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(
        KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY,
        encryptKineticString(decAsync, salt)
      ).catch(() => {});
    }
    const asyncMap = JSON.parse(decAsync) as Record<string, IKineticPersistedSessionPayload>;
    return asyncMap?.[cleanEmail]?.user?.id ? enforceJwtRoleGuard(asyncMap[cleanEmail]) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const buildResilientFallbackSessionForEmail = async (
  emailRaw: string,
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b' = 'b2c'
): Promise<IKineticPersistedSessionPayload | null> => {
  if (!isKineticDevRuntime()) return null;
  const cleanEmail = String(emailRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@')) return null;

  const syncActive = getPersistenceState().readSyncSnapshotHook?.() ?? null;
  if (syncActive && String(syncActive.user.email || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanEmail) return syncActive;

  const webSalt = getOrCreateWebSaltSync();
  const { json: decWeb, wasPlain: plainWeb } = decodeStoredJson(
    safeWebGetItem(KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY),
    webSalt
  );
  if (decWeb) {
    try {
      if (plainWeb) safeWebSetItem(KINETIC_PERSISTED_ACCOUNTS_CACHE_KEY, encryptKineticString(decWeb, webSalt));
      const map = JSON.parse(decWeb) as Record<string, IKineticPersistedSessionPayload>;
      if (map?.[cleanEmail]?.user?.id) return enforceJwtRoleGuard(map[cleanEmail]);
    } catch {}
  }

  try {
    const [cachedEncrypted, rawSavedAccounts] = await Promise.all([
      readEncryptedPersistedAccountSession(cleanEmail),
      AsyncStorage.getItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY),
    ]);
    if (cachedEncrypted) return enforceJwtRoleGuard(cachedEncrypted);
    if (rawSavedAccounts) {
      const savedMap = JSON.parse(rawSavedAccounts) as Record<string, { email?: string; nombre?: string; rol?: string }>;
      if (savedMap?.[cleanEmail]) {
        const metaSaved = savedMap[cleanEmail];
        const isB2BSaved = metaSaved.rol === 'b2b' || mode === 'b2b';
        const synthUser: IKineticPersistedUser = {
          id: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${cleanEmail.length.toString().padStart(12, '0')}`,
          email: cleanEmail,
          user_metadata: { nombre: metaSaved.nombre || cleanEmail.split('@')[0], rol: isB2BSaved ? 'socio' : 'atleta' },
        };
        return enforceJwtRoleGuard({
          session: { access_token: `kinetic-cached-${synthUser.id}`, token_type: 'bearer', user: synthUser },
          user: synthUser,
          profile: synthesizeProfileFromUser(synthUser, null, isB2BSaved ? 'b2b' : 'b2c'),
          updatedAt: Date.now(),
        });
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  const blueprint = OPERATIONAL_ACCOUNT_BLUEPRINTS[cleanEmail];
  if (!blueprint || blueprint.rol === 'admin' || blueprint.rol === 'fundador') return null;
  const opUser: IKineticPersistedUser = {
    id: blueprint.id,
    email: cleanEmail,
    user_metadata: { nombre: blueprint.nombre, rol: blueprint.rol, tipo_cuenta: blueprint.tipo_cuenta, nivel: blueprint.nivel },
  };
  return enforceJwtRoleGuard({
    session: { access_token: `kinetic-op-${blueprint.id}`, token_type: 'bearer', user: opUser },
    user: opUser,
    profile: synthesizeProfileFromUser(opUser, null, mode),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  });
};

export const rememberRegisteredKineticAccount = async (
  emailRaw: string,
  nombreRaw: string,
  mode: 'b2c' | 'b2b',
  user?: IKineticPersistedUser | null,
  profile?: Record<string, unknown> | null,
  session?: Record<string, unknown> | null
): Promise<void> => {
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
  const cleanEmail = String(emailRaw || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanEmail.includes('@')) return;
  const isAdmin = isKineticMasterAdminEmail(cleanEmail);
  const safeMeta = {
    email: cleanEmail,
    nombre: isAdmin ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : String(nombreRaw || cleanEmail.split('@')[0]).trim().slice(0, 80),
    rol: (isAdmin || mode === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c') as 'b2c' | 'b2b',
  };
  if (user?.id) getPersistenceState().persistSnapshotHook?.(user, profile || null, session || null);
  try {
    const salt = Platform.OS === 'web' ? getOrCreateWebSaltSync() : await ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync();
    const [rawV4, rawBioEnabled] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY),
      AsyncStorage.getItem('@kinetic_biometric_login_enabled_v1'),
    ]);
    const decV4 = rawV4 && rawV4.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX) ? decryptKineticString(rawV4, salt) : null;
    const prevMap = decV4 ? (JSON.parse(decV4) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
    const normalizedPrev: Record<string, { email: string; nombre: string; rol: 'b2c' | 'b2b' }> = {};
    if (prevMap && typeof prevMap === 'object' && !Array.isArray(prevMap)) {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(prevMap)) {
        const entry = typeof v === 'object' && v !== null ? (v as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
        const mailLower = String(entry.email || k || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
        if (!mailLower || !mailLower.includes('@') || mailLower === '__proto__' || mailLower === 'constructor' || mailLower === 'prototype') continue;
        normalizedPrev[mailLower] = {
          email: mailLower,
          nombre: String(entry.nombre || mailLower.split('@')[0]).trim().slice(0, 80),
          rol: entry.rol === 'b2b' ? 'b2b' : 'b2c',
        };
      }
    }
    const nextMap = { ...normalizedPrev, [cleanEmail]: safeMeta };
    await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.setItem(DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY, encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify(nextMap), salt)),
      AsyncStorage.removeItem(SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY),
      rawBioEnabled === null ? AsyncStorage.setItem('@kinetic_biometric_login_enabled_v1', 'true') : Promise.resolve(),
      purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys(),
    ]);
  } catch {}
};
