import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow } from '../utils/kineticIcsCalendarLeaf';
import { getSafeWebPushBrowserCapabilities } from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';
import { syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost } from './kineticPushFcmZeroCostHelper';

const REMINDER_STORE_KEY = '@kinetic_triple_reminders_v286';
const EAS_PROJECT_ID = '0e8e1c68-63d9-4db4-88dc-4a989dd2651a';
let storeQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
function withStoreLock<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const run = storeQueue.then(task, task);
  storeQueue = run.then(() => undefined, () => undefined);
  return run;
}
export const TRIPLE_REMINDER_WINDOWS = [
  { key: 'rem_10h' as const, offsetMins: 600 },
  { key: 'rem_3h' as const, offsetMins: 180 },
  { key: 'rem_30m' as const, offsetMins: 30 },
];

export interface ITripleReminderSpec {
  dedupKey: string;
  windowKey: 'rem_10h' | 'rem_3h' | 'rem_30m';
  triggerAtMs: number;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  data: { route: '/boveda'; reservaId: string; window: string };
}

interface ExpoNotificationsLike {
  scheduleNotificationAsync?: (req: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<string>;
  cancelScheduledNotificationAsync?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  getExpoPushTokenAsync?: (opts?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<{ data?: string }>;
  getDevicePushTokenAsync?: () => Promise<{ data?: unknown }>;
  getPermissionsAsync?: () => Promise<{ granted?: boolean; status?: string }>;
}

function getOptionalExpoNotifications(): ExpoNotificationsLike | null {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  try {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
    return require('expo-notifications') as ExpoNotificationsLike;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
}

export function computeTripleReminderScheduleMazatlan(input: {
  reservaId: string;
  venueName: string;
  serviceName: string;
  fechaIso: string;
  horaInicio: string;
  spotNumber?: number | null;
  esPaseMaestro?: boolean;
  montoPuertaKc?: number;
  nowMs?: number;
  language?: 'es' | 'en';
}): ITripleReminderSpec[] {
  const cleanId = String(input.reservaId || '').trim();
  const rawDate = String(input.fechaIso || '').trim();
  if (!cleanId || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(rawDate)) return [];
  const win = resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow(rawDate, input.horaInicio, 60);
  const nowMs = typeof input.nowMs === 'number' ? input.nowMs : Date.now();
  const isEn = input.language === 'en';
  const club = String(input.venueName || 'Kinetic').trim().slice(0, 42);
  const cls = String(input.serviceName || (isEn ? 'Session' : 'Sesión')).trim().slice(0, 42);
  const spotTxt = input.spotNumber ? ` • Spot #${input.spotNumber}` : '';
  const doorTxt = input.esPaseMaestro
    ? '0 KC (Pase Maestro)'
    : `${Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.montoPuertaKc) || 0))} KC (60%)`;

  const out: ITripleReminderSpec[] = [];
  for (const w of TRIPLE_REMINDER_WINDOWS) {
    const triggerAtMs = win.startMs - w.offsetMins * 60_000;
    if (triggerAtMs <= nowMs + 15_000) continue;
    const copy =
      w.key === 'rem_10h'
        ? {
            title: isEn ? `Session at ${club} in 10h` : `Tu sesión en ${club} es en 10h`,
            body: isEn ? `${cls} at ${input.horaInicio}${spotTxt}. Prep your gear.` : `${cls} a las ${input.horaInicio}${spotTxt}. Prepara tu equipo.`,
          }
        : w.key === 'rem_3h'
          ? {
              title: isEn ? `3h left: ${cls} • ${club}` : `Faltan 3h: ${cls} • ${club}`,
              body: isEn ? `Heading to ${club}${spotTxt}. 4h lock active.` : `Salida sugerida rumbo a ${club}${spotTxt}.`,
            }
          : {
              title: isEn ? '30 min! Open KINETIC DIGITAL PASS' : '¡30 min! Abre tu PASE DIGITAL KINETIC',
              body: isEn
                ? `Show your 60s QR at ${club}, settle ${doorTxt} and protect your 40%.`
                : `Presenta tu QR 60s en ${club}, liquida ${doorTxt} y protege tu 40%.`,
            };
    out.push({
      dedupKey: `${cleanId}:${w.key}`,
      windowKey: w.key,
      triggerAtMs,
      title: copy.title,
      body: copy.body,
      data: { route: '/boveda', reservaId: cleanId, window: w.key },
    });
  }
  return out;
}

export async function registerPushDeviceBestEffort(userId?: string | null): Promise<void> {
  if (!userId) return;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    const caps = getSafeWebPushBrowserCapabilities();
    if (!caps.hasNotification || !caps.hasServiceWorker || !caps.hasPushManager) return;
  }
  try {
    const notif = getOptionalExpoNotifications();
    if (notif?.getPermissionsAsync) {
      const perm = await notif.getPermissionsAsync();
      if (!perm?.granted && perm?.status !== 'granted') return;
      const expoRes = notif.getExpoPushTokenAsync ? await notif.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId: EAS_PROJECT_ID }).catch(() => null) : null;
      const devRes = !expoRes?.data && notif.getDevicePushTokenAsync ? await notif.getDevicePushTokenAsync().catch(() => null) : null;
      const tok = String(expoRes?.data || devRes?.data || '').trim();
      if (tok) await syncPushDeviceTokenZeroCost({ userId, rawToken: tok });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    void err;
  }
}

export function scheduleLocalTripleRemindersForReserva(params: {
  reservaId: string;
  venueName: string;
  serviceName: string;
  fechaIso: string;
  horaInicio: string;
  spotNumber?: number | null;
  esPaseMaestro?: boolean;
  montoPuertaKc?: number;
  language?: 'es' | 'en';
}): Promise<number> {
  return withStoreLock(async () => {
    const notif = getOptionalExpoNotifications();
    const specs = computeTripleReminderScheduleMazatlan(params);
    if (!notif?.scheduleNotificationAsync || specs.length === 0) return 0;
    let map: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {};
    let existing: Record<string, string> = {};
    let scheduled = 0;
    try {
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REMINDER_STORE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as unknown) : null;
      if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        map = parsed as Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
      }
      const prevRow = map[params.reservaId];
      if (prevRow && typeof prevRow === 'object' && !Array.isArray(prevRow)) existing = prevRow;
      for (const s of specs) {
        if (existing[s.windowKey]) continue;
        const nid = await notif.scheduleNotificationAsync({
          content: { title: s.title, body: s.body, data: s.data, sound: true },
          trigger: { date: new Date(s.triggerAtMs) },
        });
        if (nid) {
          existing[s.windowKey] = nid;
          scheduled += 1;
        }
      }
      return scheduled;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      return scheduled;
    } finally {
      if (scheduled > 0) {
        map[params.reservaId] = existing;
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(REMINDER_STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(map)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
      }
    }
  });
}

export function cancelLocalTripleRemindersForReserva(reservaId: string): Promise<void> {
  return withStoreLock(async () => {
    const notif = getOptionalExpoNotifications();
    try {
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REMINDER_STORE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const map = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
      const ids = Object.values(map[reservaId] || {});
      if (notif?.cancelScheduledNotificationAsync) {
        await Promise.all(
          ids.map((id) => notif.cancelScheduledNotificationAsync!(id).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; }))
        );
      }
      delete map[reservaId];
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(REMINDER_STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(map));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    }
  });
}

export async function reconcileReservasTripleReminders(
  reservas: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  language: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'
): Promise<void> {
  for (const r of reservas.slice(0, 15)) {
    const st = String(r?.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const id = String(r?.id || '').trim();
    if (!id) continue;
    if (['cancelada', 'no_show', 'completada', 'usada', 'expirada'].includes(st) || r?.qr_usado_at) {
      await cancelLocalTripleRemindersForReserva(id);
      continue;
    }
    if (st === 'activa' || st === 'confirmada') {
      await scheduleLocalTripleRemindersForReserva({
        reservaId: id,
        venueName: String(r?.negocio_nombre || 'Kinetic'),
        serviceName: String(r?.nombre_servicio || r?.servicio || 'Sesión'),
        fechaIso: String(r?.fecha_clase || r?.fecha || ''),
        horaInicio: String(r?.hora_inicio || r?.hora || '08:00'),
        spotNumber: typeof r?.spot_number === 'number' ? r.spot_number : null,
        esPaseMaestro: Boolean(r?.es_pase_maestro),
        montoPuertaKc: Number(r?.monto_puerta || 0),
        language,
      });
    }
  }
}

export function triggerPendingPushDispatchBestEffort(): void {
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine === false) return;
  void supabase.functions.invoke('kinetic-push-dispatcher', { body: { scope: 'self' } }).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
}

export function subscribeUserPushOutboxRealtime(
  userId: string,
  onOutboxRow: (row: { kind: string; title: string; body: string }) => void,
  lang: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'
): () => void {
  if (!userId) return () => {};
  const ch = supabase
    .channel(`kc_push_outbox_${userId}`)
    .on(
      'postgres_changes',
      { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'kinetic_push_outbox', filter: `recipient_id=eq.${userId}` },
      (payload: { new?: Record<string, unknown> }) => {
        const row = payload?.new;
        if (!row) return;
        const title = String(lang === 'en' ? row.title_en || row.title_es : row.title_es || row.title_en || '');
        const body = String(lang === 'en' ? row.body_en || row.body_es : row.body_es || row.body_en || '');
        if (title) onOutboxRow({ kind: String(row.kind || ''), title, body });
      }
    )
    .subscribe();
  return () => { void supabase.removeChannel(ch); };
}

export const TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S = 3200;
export const TROPHY_FRICTION_60HZ = 0.986;
export const TROPHY_SETTLE_OMEGA_DEG_S = 24;
export const TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG = 3.5;

export interface ITrophySpinPhysicsState {
  angleDeg: number;
  omegaDegPerSec: number;
  isSpinning: boolean;
}

export interface ITrophySpinStepResult extends ITrophySpinPhysicsState {
  tiltZDeg: number;
  didCrossRevolution: boolean;
  crossedHalfTurns: number;
}

export interface ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom {
  side: 'left' | 'right';
  zDepth: number;
  isFront: boolean;
  pathD: string;
  innerHighlightD: string;
  thicknessRatio: number;
}

export interface ITrophyRevolutionGeometry {
  thetaDeg: number;
  cosTheta: number;
  sinTheta: number;
  absCos: number;
  absSin: number;
  activeFace: 'front' | 'back';
  bowlScaleX: number;
  bowlShiftX: number;
  specularX: number;
  specularWidth: number;
  shadowX: number;
  shadowWidth: number;
  rimRx: number;
  rimRy: number;
  rimDepthOffset: number;
  baseRx: number;
  baseRy: number;
  frontScaleX: number;
  backScaleX: number;
  isFrontVisible: boolean;
  isBackVisible: boolean;
  handlesOrdered: ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom[];
}

const normalizeDeg = (angleDeg: number): number => {
  const safe = Number.isFinite(Number(angleDeg)) ? Number(angleDeg) : 0;
  const mod = ((safe % 360) + 360) % 360;
  return mod === 0 ? 0 : mod;
};

export const clampTrophyOmega = (omegaDegPerSec: number): number => {
  const num = Number(omegaDegPerSec);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return 0;
  if (num > TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S) return TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S;
  if (num < -TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S) return -TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S;
  return num;
};

export const computeDragReleaseOmega = (vxPxPerMs: number, sensitivity = 920): number => {
  const safeVx = Number.isFinite(Number(vxPxPerMs)) ? Number(vxPxPerMs) : 0;
  const safeSens = Number.isFinite(Number(sensitivity)) && Number(sensitivity) > 0 ? Number(sensitivity) : 920;
  return clampTrophyOmega(safeVx * safeSens);
};

export interface ITrophyDragSample {
  dx: number;
  t: number;
}

export const computeSlidingWindowVx = (
  samples: ReadonlyArray<ITrophyDragSample>,
  nowMs: number,
  windowMs = 60,
): number => {
  if (!Array.isArray(samples) || samples.length < 2 || !Number.isFinite(Number(nowMs))) return 0;
  const safeNow = Number(nowMs);
  const safeWindow = Math.max(16, Number.isFinite(Number(windowMs)) ? Number(windowMs) : 60);
  const finite = samples.filter(
    (s) => s && Number.isFinite(Number(s.dx)) && Number.isFinite(Number(s.t)) && Number(s.t) <= safeNow + 4
  );
  if (finite.length < 2) return 0;
  const inWindow = finite.filter((s) => Number(s.t) >= safeNow - safeWindow);
  const pair = inWindow.length >= 2 ? inWindow : finite.slice(-2);
  const oldest = pair[0];
  const latest = pair[pair.length - 1];
  if (inWindow.length < 2 && safeNow - Number(latest.t) > safeWindow * 1.5) return 0;
  const dt = Number(latest.t) - Number(oldest.t);
  if (dt <= 0) return 0;
  const rawVx = (Number(latest.dx) - Number(oldest.dx)) / Math.max(8, dt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(rawVx)) return 0;
  return Math.max(-12, Math.min(12, rawVx));
};

export const stepTrophySpinPhysics = (
  state: ITrophySpinPhysicsState,
  dtMs: number,
): ITrophySpinStepResult => {
  const prevUnwrapped = Number.isFinite(Number(state?.angleDeg)) ? Number(state.angleDeg) : 0;
  const safeDtMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number.isFinite(Number(dtMs)) ? Number(dtMs) : 16.6667));
  const dtFrames = safeDtMs / (1000 / 60);
  const dtSec = safeDtMs / 1000;
  const omega = clampTrophyOmega(state?.omegaDegPerSec ?? 0);

  const nextUnwrapped = prevUnwrapped + omega * dtSec;
  const nextAngleDeg = normalizeDeg(nextUnwrapped);

  const prevRevIdx = Math.floor(prevUnwrapped / 360);
  const nextRevIdx = Math.floor(nextUnwrapped / 360);
  const didCrossRevolution = prevRevIdx !== nextRevIdx && Math.abs(omega) > 0;

  const prevHalfIdx = Math.floor(prevUnwrapped / 180);
  const nextHalfIdx = Math.floor(nextUnwrapped / 180);
  const crossedHalfTurns = Math.abs(nextHalfIdx - prevHalfIdx);

  const decayedOmega = omega * Math.pow(TROPHY_FRICTION_60HZ, dtFrames);
  const settled = Math.abs(decayedOmega) < TROPHY_SETTLE_OMEGA_DEG_S;
  const nextOmega = settled ? 0 : clampTrophyOmega(decayedOmega);

  const rad = (nextAngleDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const wobbleFactor = 0.45 + 0.55 * Math.sin(rad);
  const rawTilt = settled
    ? 0
    : (nextOmega / TROPHY_MAX_OMEGA_DEG_S) * TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG * wobbleFactor;
  const tiltZDeg = Math.max(-TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG, Math.min(TROPHY_MAX_TILT_Z_DEG, Number(rawTilt.toFixed(3))));

  return {
    angleDeg: nextAngleDeg,
    omegaDegPerSec: nextOmega,
    isSpinning: !settled,
    tiltZDeg: tiltZDeg === 0 ? 0 : tiltZDeg,
    didCrossRevolution,
    crossedHalfTurns,
  };
};

export const computeTrophyRevolutionGeometry = (
  angleDeg: number,
  size = 144,
): ITrophyRevolutionGeometry => {
  const safeSize = Math.max(24, Number.isFinite(Number(size)) && Number(size) > 0 ? Number(size) : 144);
  const thetaDeg = normalizeDeg(angleDeg);
  const rad = (thetaDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const rawCos = Math.cos(rad);
  const rawSin = Math.sin(rad);
  const cosTheta = Math.abs(rawCos) < 1e-9 ? 0 : rawCos;
  const sinTheta = Math.abs(rawSin) < 1e-9 ? 0 : rawSin;
  const absCos = Math.abs(cosTheta);
  const absSin = Math.abs(sinTheta);
  const activeFace: 'front' | 'back' = cosTheta >= 0 ? 'front' : 'back';

  // Revolución cilíndrica continua: la copa gira su eje óptico manteniendo grosor sólido > 0
  const bowlScaleX = Math.max(0.76, 0.78 + absCos * 0.22);
  const bowlShiftX = sinTheta * 3.8;
  const specularX = 48 + sinTheta * 15;
  const specularWidth = Math.max(3.6, 5.8 - absSin * 1.4);
  const shadowX = 68 - sinTheta * 13;
  const shadowWidth = Math.max(4, 7.5 + absSin * 2);

  const rimRx = Math.max(15.5, 22 * bowlScaleX);
  const rimRy = 6.2 + absSin * 0.9;
  const rimDepthOffset = (safeSize / 144) * sinTheta * 1.2;
  const baseRx = Math.max(20, 28 * (0.84 + absCos * 0.16));
  const baseRy = 6.2 + absSin * 0.6;

  // Asas orbitales 3D con ordenamiento Z-buffer (sinTheta controla qué asa cruza delante vs detrás)
  const leftXAnchor = 60 - 21 * cosTheta - sinTheta * 3.2;
  const leftTipX = 60 - 44 * cosTheta - sinTheta * 5.2;
  const rightXAnchor = 60 + 21 * cosTheta + sinTheta * 3.2;
  const rightTipX = 60 + 44 * cosTheta + sinTheta * 5.2;

  const leftZ = -sinTheta;
  const rightZ = sinTheta;

  const leftHandle: ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom = {
    side: 'left',
    zDepth: leftZ,
    isFront: leftZ >= 0,
    thicknessRatio: Math.max(0.45, 0.5 + Math.abs(cosTheta) * 0.5),
    pathD: `M${leftXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 45 C${((leftXAnchor + leftTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 43, ${leftTipX.toFixed(1)} 56, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 12).toFixed(1)} 71 C${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 74, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 5).toFixed(1)} 70, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 66 C${(leftTipX + cosTheta * 6).toFixed(1)} 58, ${((leftXAnchor + leftTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 51, ${leftXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 51 Z`,
    innerHighlightD: `M${leftXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 46.5 C${leftTipX.toFixed(1)} 50, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 10).toFixed(1)} 63, ${(leftXAnchor - cosTheta * 7).toFixed(1)} 68`,
  };

  const rightHandle: ITrophyOrbitalHandleGeom = {
    side: 'right',
    zDepth: rightZ,
    isFront: rightZ >= 0,
    thicknessRatio: Math.max(0.45, 0.5 + Math.abs(cosTheta) * 0.5),
    pathD: `M${rightXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 45 C${((rightXAnchor + rightTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 43, ${rightTipX.toFixed(1)} 56, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 12).toFixed(1)} 71 C${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 74, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 5).toFixed(1)} 70, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 8).toFixed(1)} 66 C${(rightTipX - cosTheta * 6).toFixed(1)} 58, ${((rightXAnchor + rightTipX) * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 51, ${rightXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 51 Z`,
    innerHighlightD: `M${rightXAnchor.toFixed(1)} 46.5 C${rightTipX.toFixed(1)} 50, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 10).toFixed(1)} 63, ${(rightXAnchor + cosTheta * 7).toFixed(1)} 68`,
  };

  const handlesOrdered = [leftHandle, rightHandle].sort((a, b) => a.zDepth - b.zDepth);

  return {
    thetaDeg,
    cosTheta,
    sinTheta,
    absCos,
    absSin,
    activeFace,
    bowlScaleX,
    bowlShiftX,
    specularX,
    specularWidth,
    shadowX,
    shadowWidth,
    rimRx,
    rimRy,
    rimDepthOffset,
    baseRx,
    baseRy,
    frontScaleX: Math.max(0.85, 0.85 + 0.15 * absCos),
    backScaleX: Math.max(0.85, 0.85 + 0.15 * absCos),
    isFrontVisible: cosTheta >= 0.06,
    isBackVisible: cosTheta < -0.06,
    handlesOrdered,
  };
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { requireOptionalNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import {
  WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC,
  readResilientWebMirror,
  writeResilientWebMirror,
} from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

export const DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY = '@kinetic_device_cipher_salt_v1';
export const BIOMETRIC_VAULT_V2_KEY = 'KINETIC_BIOMETRIC_REFRESH_VAULT_V2';
export const SAVED_ACCOUNTS_REAL_V3_KEY = '@kinetic_saved_accounts_real_v3';
export const DEVICE_VERIFIED_LOGINS_V4_KEY = '@kinetic_device_verified_logins_v4';
export const BIOMETRIC_LOGIN_ENABLED_KEY = '@kinetic_biometric_login_enabled_v1';
export const CIPHER_PREFIX = 'kenc_v1:';
export const LEGACY_PLAINTEXT_AUTH_KEYS = [
  '@kinetic_saved_accounts_map_v2', '@kinetic_saved_accounts_v2',
  '@kinetic_biometric_creds_b2c_v1', '@kinetic_biometric_creds_b2b_v1',
  '@kinetic_biometric_vault_v2',
] as const;

interface NativeSecureStoreLike {
  getItemAsync?: (key: string) => Promise<string | null>;
  getValueWithKeyAsync?: (key: string, opts: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<string | null>;
  setItemAsync?: (key: string, value: string) => Promise<void>;
  setValueWithKeyAsync?: (value: string, key: string, opts: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>;
  deleteItemAsync?: (key: string) => Promise<void>;
  deleteValueWithKeyAsync?: (key: string, opts: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>;
}

export const evaluateIsKineticDevRuntime = (devFlag?: unknown, nodeEnv?: unknown): boolean =>
  devFlag === true && String(nodeEnv ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'production';

export const isKineticDevRuntime = (): boolean =>
  evaluateIsKineticDevRuntime(typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' ? __DEV__ : false, process.env.NODE_ENV);

let _cachedDeviceSalt: string | null = null;
const HEX_LUT = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, i) => i.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));

const getSecureStore = (): NativeSecureStoreLike | null => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return null;
  try { return requireOptionalNativeModule<NativeSecureStoreLike>('ExpoSecureStore') || null; } catch { return null; }
};
const toSSKey = (key: string): string => key.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_');

const bytesToHex = (bytes: Uint8Array): string => {
  const parts = new Array<string>(bytes.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) parts[i] = HEX_LUT[bytes[i]];
  return parts.join('');
};

const hexCharVal = (code: number): number => {
  if (code >= 48 && code <= 57) return code - 48;
  if (code >= 97 && code <= 102) return code - 87;
  if (code >= 65 && code <= 70) return code - 55;
  return -1;
};

const randomHex = (byteLen: number): string => {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
  const c = (globalThis as { crypto?: { getRandomValues?: (arr: Uint8Array) => void } })?.crypto;
  if (c?.getRandomValues) c.getRandomValues(bytes);
  else {
    let s = (Date.now() ^ ((Math.random() * 0xffffffff) >>> 0)) >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < byteLen; i += 1) {
      s = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 0x2c1b3c6d) >>> 0;
      bytes[i] = ((Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 12), 0x297a2d39) >>> 15) ^ Math.floor(Math.random() * 256)) & 0xff;
    }
  }
  return bytesToHex(bytes);
};

const fnvMix32 = (input: string, seed = 0x811c9dc5): number => {
  let h = seed >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i += 1) h = Math.imul(h ^ input.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0;
  return (Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35) ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0;
};

const fnvStepBlock32 = (state: number, blockIndex: number, keySeed: number): number => {
  let h = (state ^ keySeed ^ Math.imul((blockIndex + 1) >>> 0, 0x9e3779b9)) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35) >>> 0;
  return (h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0;
};

const getEnvFp = (): string => {
  const nav = Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent || '' : '';
  const platVer = Platform.OS === 'web' ? '' : String(Platform.Version || '');
  return fnvMix32(`knt25|${Platform.OS}|${platVer}|${nav.slice(0, 48)}`, 0x9e3779b9).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
};

const utf8ToBytes = (s: string): Uint8Array => {
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') return new TextEncoder().encode(s);
  return Uint8Array.from(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)), (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);
};
const bytesToUtf8 = (b: Uint8Array): string => {
  if (typeof TextDecoder !== 'undefined') return new TextDecoder().decode(b);
  let bin = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 1) bin += String.fromCharCode(b[i]);
  return decodeURIComponent(escape(bin));
};
const computeMac = (nonce: string, cipher: string, salt: string): string => {
  const m = `${salt}|${getEnvFp()}|${nonce}|${cipher}`;
  return `${fnvMix32(m, 0x811c9dc5).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}${fnvMix32(`m:${m}`, 0x27d4eb2f).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
};

export const getOrCreateWebSaltSync = (): string => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const ex = readResilientWebMirror(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY, '');
      if (ex && ex.length >= 32) { _cachedDeviceSalt = ex; return ex; }
      const fresh = randomHex(32);
      writeResilientWebMirror(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY, fresh, '', WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC);
      _cachedDeviceSalt = fresh;
      return fresh;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    }
  }
  return _cachedDeviceSalt || getEnvFp().repeat(8);
};

export const ensureDeviceCipherSaltAsync = async (): Promise<string> => {
  if (_cachedDeviceSalt && _cachedDeviceSalt.length >= 64) return _cachedDeviceSalt;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return getOrCreateWebSaltSync();
  const ss = getSecureStore();
  const sk = toSSKey(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY);
  try {
    const sVal = ss?.getItemAsync
      ? await ss.getItemAsync(sk)
      : ss?.getValueWithKeyAsync
      ? await ss.getValueWithKeyAsync(sk, {})
      : null;
    if (sVal && sVal.length >= 32) {
      _cachedDeviceSalt = sVal;
      await AsyncStorage.removeItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY).catch(() => {});
      return sVal;
    }
  } catch {}
  const aVal = await AsyncStorage.getItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY).catch(() => null);
  const resolved = aVal && aVal.length >= 32 ? aVal : randomHex(32);
  _cachedDeviceSalt = resolved;
  let storedInHardware = false;
  try {
    if (ss?.setItemAsync) { await ss.setItemAsync(sk, resolved); storedInHardware = true; }
    else if (ss?.setValueWithKeyAsync) { await ss.setValueWithKeyAsync(resolved, sk, {}); storedInHardware = true; }
  } catch {}
  if (storedInHardware) {
    await AsyncStorage.removeItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY).catch(() => {});
  } else {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(DEVICE_CIPHER_SALT_KEY, resolved).catch(() => {});
  }
  return resolved;
};

export const encryptKineticString = (plainText: string, salt: string): string => {
  const nonce = randomHex(16);
  const src = utf8ToBytes(plainText);
  const out = new Uint8Array(src.length);
  const key = `${salt}|${getEnvFp()}|${nonce}`;
  const keySeed = fnvMix32(key, 0x27d4eb2f);
  let st = fnvMix32(key, 0x811c9dc5);
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i += 1) {
    if ((i & 3) === 0) st = fnvStepBlock32(st, i >>> 2, keySeed);
    out[i] = src[i] ^ ((st >>> ((i & 3) * 8)) & 0xff);
  }
  const cHex = bytesToHex(out);
  return `${CIPHER_PREFIX}${nonce}:${computeMac(nonce, cHex, salt)}:${cHex}`;
};

export const decryptKineticString = (encoded: string, salt: string): string | null => {
  if (!encoded || !encoded.startsWith(CIPHER_PREFIX)) return null;
  const [nonce, mac, cHex] = encoded.slice(CIPHER_PREFIX.length).split(':');
  if (!nonce || !mac || typeof cHex !== 'string' || (cHex.length & 1) !== 0) return null;
  const expected = computeMac(nonce, cHex, salt);
  if (mac.length !== expected.length) return null;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < mac.length; i += 1) diff |= mac.charCodeAt(i) ^ expected.charCodeAt(i);
  if (diff !== 0) return null;
  const byteLen = cHex.length >>> 1;
  const out = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
  const key = `${salt}|${getEnvFp()}|${nonce}`;
  const keySeed = fnvMix32(key, 0x27d4eb2f);
  let st = fnvMix32(key, 0x811c9dc5);
  for (let i = 0; i < byteLen; i += 1) {
    if ((i & 3) === 0) st = fnvStepBlock32(st, i >>> 2, keySeed);
    const hi = hexCharVal(cHex.charCodeAt(i * 2));
    const lo = hexCharVal(cHex.charCodeAt(i * 2 + 1));
    if (hi < 0 || lo < 0) return null;
    out[i] = ((hi << 4) | lo) ^ ((st >>> ((i & 3) * 8)) & 0xff);
  }
  try { return bytesToUtf8(out); } catch { return null; }
};

export const secureVaultReadAsync = async (key: string): Promise<string | null> => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    try { return typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.localStorage?.getItem(key) ?? null : null; } catch { return null; }
  }
  const ss = getSecureStore();
  const safeKey = toSSKey(key);
  try {
    if (typeof ss?.getItemAsync === 'function') {
      const val = await ss.getItemAsync(safeKey);
      if (val) return val;
    } else if (typeof ss?.getValueWithKeyAsync === 'function') {
      const val = await ss.getValueWithKeyAsync(safeKey, {});
      if (val) return val;
    }
  } catch {}
  return AsyncStorage.getItem(key).catch(() => null);
};

export const secureVaultWriteAsync = async (key: string, encryptedVal: string): Promise<void> => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    try { if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.localStorage?.setItem(key, encryptedVal); } catch {}
    return;
  }
  const ss = getSecureStore();
  const safeKey = toSSKey(key);
  let wroteSecureStore = false;
  try {
    if (typeof ss?.setItemAsync === 'function') { await ss.setItemAsync(safeKey, encryptedVal); wroteSecureStore = true; }
    else if (typeof ss?.setValueWithKeyAsync === 'function') { await ss.setValueWithKeyAsync(encryptedVal, safeKey, {}); wroteSecureStore = true; }
  } catch {}
  if (!wroteSecureStore) {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, encryptedVal).catch(() => {});
  }
};

export const secureVaultDeleteAsync = async (key: string): Promise<void> => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try { window.localStorage?.removeItem(key); } catch {}
  }
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
    const ss = getSecureStore();
    const safeKey = toSSKey(key);
    try {
      if (typeof ss?.deleteItemAsync === 'function') await ss.deleteItemAsync(safeKey);
      else if (typeof ss?.deleteValueWithKeyAsync === 'function') await ss.deleteValueWithKeyAsync(safeKey, {});
    } catch {}
  }
  await AsyncStorage.removeItem(key).catch(() => {});
};

export const purgeLegacyPlaintextStorageKeys = async (): Promise<void> => {
  const keysToPurge = [...LEGACY_PLAINTEXT_AUTH_KEYS];
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    keysToPurge.forEach((k) => { try { window.localStorage?.removeItem(k); } catch {} });
  }
  await AsyncStorage.multiRemove(keysToPurge).catch(() => {});
};

    // === src/services/kineticVenueCanonicalGeoAndHours.ts === //
import { CABO_BASE_COORDS, KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES } from '../constants/exploreData';
import { canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey, isCoordsInsideLosCabos } from './kineticGeoLeafGuards';

export const KINETIC_CANONICAL_TIMEZONE = 'America/Mazatlan';
const MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS = -7;

export interface IMazatlanNowParts {
  isoDate: string;
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  hour: number;
  minute: number;
  hhmm: string;
  minutesOfDay: number;
  jsDayOfWeek: number;
  monDayIdx: number;
}

const pad2 = (n: number) => String(Math.max(0, Math.floor(n))).padStart(2, '0');

export const mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs = (
  year: number,
  month: number,
  day: number,
  hour = 0,
  minute = 0,
  second = 0,
  ms = 0
): number =>
  Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour - MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS, minute, second, ms);

export const getMazatlanNowParts = (nowRef?: Date): IMazatlanNowParts => {
  const ref = nowRef instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(nowRef.getTime()) ? nowRef : new Date();
  try {
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: KINETIC_CANONICAL_TIMEZONE,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
    const map: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const p of fmt.formatToParts(ref)) {
      if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
    }
    const year = parseInt(map.year || '', 10);
    const month = parseInt(map.month || '', 10);
    const day = parseInt(map.day || '', 10);
    const rawHour = parseInt(map.hour || '', 10);
    const minute = parseInt(map.minute || '', 10);
    if (
      Number.isFinite(year) &&
      Number.isFinite(month) &&
      Number.isFinite(day) &&
      Number.isFinite(rawHour) &&
      Number.isFinite(minute)
    ) {
      const hour = rawHour % 24;
      const jsDayOfWeek = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, 12, 0, 0)).getUTCDay();
      return {
        isoDate: `${year}-${pad2(month)}-${pad2(day)}`,
        year,
        month,
        day,
        hour,
        minute,
        hhmm: `${pad2(hour)}:${pad2(minute)}`,
        minutesOfDay: hour * 60 + minute,
        jsDayOfWeek,
        monDayIdx: (jsDayOfWeek + 6) % 7,
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback determinista UTC-7
  }
  const shifted = new Date(ref.getTime() + MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS * 3600_000);
  const year = shifted.getUTCFullYear();
  const month = shifted.getUTCMonth() + 1;
  const day = shifted.getUTCDate();
  const hour = shifted.getUTCHours();
  const minute = shifted.getUTCMinutes();
  const jsDayOfWeek = shifted.getUTCDay();
  return {
    isoDate: `${year}-${pad2(month)}-${pad2(day)}`,
    year,
    month,
    day,
    hour,
    minute,
    hhmm: `${pad2(hour)}:${pad2(minute)}`,
    minutesOfDay: hour * 60 + minute,
    jsDayOfWeek,
    monDayIdx: (jsDayOfWeek + 6) % 7,
  };
};

export const getMazatlanWeekAndDayBounds = (nowRef?: Date) => {
  const parts = getMazatlanNowParts(nowRef);
  const startOfTodayMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const endOfTodayMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, 23, 59, 59, 999);
  const mondayUtc = new Date(Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day - parts.monDayIdx, 12));
  const sundayUtc = new Date(Date.UTC(mondayUtc.getUTCFullYear(), mondayUtc.getUTCMonth(), mondayUtc.getUTCDate() + 6, 12));
  const mY = mondayUtc.getUTCFullYear(), mM = mondayUtc.getUTCMonth() + 1, mD = mondayUtc.getUTCDate();
  const sY = sundayUtc.getUTCFullYear(), sM = sundayUtc.getUTCMonth() + 1, sD = sundayUtc.getUTCDate();
  const startMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(mY, mM, mD, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const endMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(sY, sM, sD, 23, 59, 59, 999);
  const lastDayOfMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month, 0)).getUTCDate();
  const monthStartMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const monthEndMs = mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(parts.year, parts.month, lastDayOfMonth, 23, 59, 59, 999);
  return {
    parts,
    startOfTodayMs,
    endOfTodayMs,
    startMs,
    endMs,
    monthStartMs,
    monthEndMs,
    periodoInicio: `${mY}-${pad2(mM)}-${pad2(mD)}`,
    periodoFin: `${sY}-${pad2(sM)}-${pad2(sD)}`,
  };
};

export const parseMazatlanTimestampMs = (rawDate: unknown): number => {
  if (!rawDate) return NaN;
  const s = String(rawDate).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) {
    const [yy, mm, dd] = s.split('-').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
    return mazatlanWallClockToEpochMs(yy, mm || 1, dd || 1, 12, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  return new Date(s).getTime();
};

let _canonicalUserOrigin: { latitude: number; longitude: number; isReal: boolean } = {
  latitude: CABO_BASE_COORDS.latitude,
  longitude: CABO_BASE_COORDS.longitude,
  isReal: false,
};

const isValidNonZeroCoordPair = (lat: number, lon: number): boolean =>
  Number.isFinite(lat) &&
  Number.isFinite(lon) &&
  Math.abs(lat) <= 90 &&
  Math.abs(lon) <= 180 &&
  Math.abs(lat) > 1 &&
  Math.abs(lon) > 1;

export const setCanonicalUserGpsOrigin = (coords?: { latitude?: number; longitude?: number } | null, isReal = true): void => {
  const lat = Number(coords?.latitude);
  const lon = Number(coords?.longitude);
  if (isValidNonZeroCoordPair(lat, lon)) {
    _canonicalUserOrigin = { latitude: lat, longitude: lon, isReal };
  }
};

export const getCanonicalUserGpsOrigin = () => ({ ..._canonicalUserOrigin });

export const computeCanonicalVenueDistanceKm = (
  lat2?: number | null,
  lon2?: number | null,
  userOrigin?: { latitude: number; longitude: number } | null
): number => {
  const originLat = Number(userOrigin?.latitude);
  const originLon = Number(userOrigin?.longitude);
  const origin = userOrigin && isValidNonZeroCoordPair(originLat, originLon)
    ? { latitude: originLat, longitude: originLon }
    : _canonicalUserOrigin;
  const nLat = Number(lat2);
  const nLon = Number(lon2);
  if (!isValidNonZeroCoordPair(nLat, nLon)) {
    return 1.8;
  }
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((nLat - origin.latitude) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((nLon - origin.longitude) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos((origin.latitude * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.cos((nLat * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
  const km = R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, a))), Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - a)));
  return Number(Math.max(0.1, km).toFixed(1));
};

export const parseExplicitMapsLatLon = (rawText?: unknown): { latitud: number; longitud: number } | null => {
  let txt = String(rawText || '').trim();
  if (!txt) return null;
  try { txt = `${txt} ${decodeURIComponent(txt)}`; } catch {}
  const m =
    txt.match(/!3d(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)!4d(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/i) ||
    txt.match(/@(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/) ||
    txt.match(/[?&](?:q|ll|query|center|destination|daddr)=(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  const lat = Number(m[1]), lon = Number(m[2]);
  return isValidNonZeroCoordPair(lat, lon)
    ? { latitud: Number(lat.toFixed(6)), longitud: Number(lon.toFixed(6)) }
    : null;
};

const toValidPair = (latRaw: unknown, lonRaw: unknown): { latitud: number; longitud: number } | null => {
  const lat = Number(latRaw), lon = Number(lonRaw);
  if (isValidNonZeroCoordPair(lat, lon)) {
    return { latitud: lat, longitud: lon };
  }
  return null;
};

export interface IVenueGeoInput {
  id?: string | number | null;
  propietario_id?: string | number | null;
  nombre?: string | null;
  negocio_nombre?: string | null;
  ubicacion?: string | null;
  direccion?: string | null;
  latitud?: number | string | null;
  longitud?: number | string | null;
  latitude?: number | string | null;
  longitude?: number | string | null;
}

export const resolveCanonicalVenueCoordinates = (
  venue?: IVenueGeoInput | null,
  catalogRef?: IVenueGeoInput | null,
  fallbackIndex = 0
): { latitud: number; longitud: number } => {
  const key = canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(
    venue?.nombre || venue?.negocio_nombre || catalogRef?.nombre || catalogRef?.negocio_nombre
  );
  const staticCatItem = key
    ? (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).find((a) => canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(a?.nombre) === key) || null
    : null;
  const catItem = catalogRef && catalogRef !== venue ? catalogRef : staticCatItem;
  const forceCat = Boolean(key && (key.includes('baja crossfit') || key.includes('kinetic especialista')));
  const staticPair = staticCatItem
    ? toValidPair(staticCatItem.latitude ?? staticCatItem.latitud, staticCatItem.longitude ?? staticCatItem.longitud)
    : null;
  const catPair =
    (catItem ? toValidPair(catItem.latitude ?? catItem.latitud, catItem.longitude ?? catItem.longitud) : null) ||
    staticPair;
  if (forceCat && (staticPair || catPair)) return (staticPair || catPair)!;

  const explicitUrlPair = parseExplicitMapsLatLon(venue?.ubicacion || venue?.direccion);
  const directPair = toValidPair(venue?.latitud ?? venue?.latitude, venue?.longitud ?? venue?.longitude);
  if (directPair && isCoordsInsideLosCabos(directPair.latitud, directPair.longitud)) return directPair;
  if (explicitUrlPair && isCoordsInsideLosCabos(explicitUrlPair.latitud, explicitUrlPair.longitud)) return explicitUrlPair;
  if (directPair) return directPair;
  if (explicitUrlPair) return explicitUrlPair;
  if (catPair) return catPair;

  return {
    latitud: Number((CABO_BASE_COORDS.latitude + ((fallbackIndex % 7) - 3) * 0.0045).toFixed(6)),
    longitud: Number((CABO_BASE_COORDS.longitude + ((fallbackIndex % 5) - 2) * 0.0045).toFixed(6)),
  };
};

const DAY_ALIASES: [RegExp, number][] = [
  [/\blun(?:es)?\b|\bmon(?:day)?\b/i, 0],
  [/\bmar(?:tes)?\b|\btue(?:s(?:day)?)?\b/i, 1],
  [/\bmie(?:rcoles)?\b|\bwed(?:nesday)?\b/i, 2],
  [/\bjue(?:ves)?\b|\bthu(?:r(?:s(?:day)?)?)?\b/i, 3],
  [/\bvie(?:rnes)?\b|\bfri(?:day)?\b/i, 4],
  [/\bsab(?:ado)?\b|\bsat(?:urday)?\b/i, 5],
  [/\bdom(?:ingo)?\b|\bsun(?:day)?\b/i, 6],
];

const DAY_RANGE_TOKEN =
  '(?:lun(?:es)?|mar(?:tes)?|mie(?:rcoles)?|jue(?:ves)?|vie(?:rnes)?|sab(?:ado)?|dom(?:ingo)?|mon(?:day)?|tue(?:s(?:day)?)?|wed(?:nesday)?|thu(?:r(?:s(?:day)?)?)?|fri(?:day)?|sat(?:urday)?|sun(?:day)?)';
const HAS_TIME_RANGE_RX = /\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*(?:a|al|to|-|–|hasta)\s*\d{1,2}/i;
const STARTS_DAY_RX = new RegExp(`^\\s*(?:${DAY_RANGE_TOKEN}|fin(?:es)?\\s+de\\s+semana|weekends?|daily|diario|todos)\\b`, 'i');
const DAY_RANGE_RX = new RegExp(`\\b(${DAY_RANGE_TOKEN})\\b\\s*(?:a|al|to|-|–)\\s*\\b(${DAY_RANGE_TOKEN})\\b`, 'i');

const parseTimeTokenMinutes = (rawTime: string, mer?: string): number | null => {
  const parts = rawTime.split(':').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
  if (parts.length < 1 || Number.isNaN(parts[0])) return null;
  let hh = parts[0];
  const mm = parts.length >= 2 && !Number.isNaN(parts[1]) ? parts[1] : 0;
  const mLow = String(mer || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\./g, '');
  if (mLow === 'pm' && hh < 12) hh += 12;
  if (mLow === 'am' && hh === 12) hh = 0;
  if (hh === 24 && mm === 0) return 1440;
  return hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59 ? hh * 60 + mm : null;
};

const matchesScheduleDaysSegment = (segNorm: string, monDayIdx: number): boolean => {
  if (!segNorm || /\b(todos\s+los\s+dias|every\s+day|daily|diario|24\s*h|lun(?:es)?\s*(?:a|to|-)\s*dom(?:ingo)?|mon(?:day)?\s*(?:to|-)\s*sun(?:day)?)\b/i.test(segNorm)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (/\bfin(?:es)?\s+de\s+semana|weekends?|sab(?:ado)?\s+y\s+dom(?:ingo)?|sat\s*&\s*sun\b/i.test(segNorm)) {
    return monDayIdx === 5 || monDayIdx === 6;
  }
  const rangeMatch = segNorm.match(DAY_RANGE_RX);
  if (rangeMatch) {
    const startIdx = DAY_ALIASES.find(([rx]) => rx.test(rangeMatch[1]))?.[1];
    const endIdx = DAY_ALIASES.find(([rx]) => rx.test(rangeMatch[2]))?.[1];
    if (startIdx !== undefined && endIdx !== undefined) {
      return startIdx <= endIdx
        ? monDayIdx >= startIdx && monDayIdx <= endIdx
        : monDayIdx >= startIdx || monDayIdx <= endIdx;
    }
  }
  const mentionedDays = DAY_ALIASES.filter(([rx]) => rx.test(segNorm)).map(([, idx]) => idx);
  return mentionedDays.length > 0 ? mentionedDays.includes(monDayIdx) : true;
};

const splitScheduleSegments = (norm: string): string[] => {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const chunk of norm.split(/[\/;|]+/)) {
    let acc = '';
    for (const part of chunk.split(',')) {
      const p = part.trim();
      if (!p) continue;
      if (acc && HAS_TIME_RANGE_RX.test(acc) && STARTS_DAY_RX.test(p)) {
        out.push(acc);
        acc = p;
      } else {
        acc = acc ? `${acc}, ${p}` : p;
      }
    }
    if (acc) out.push(acc);
  }
  return out;
};

export const evaluateVenueOpenStatusMazatlan = (
  horariosRaw?: string | null,
  nowRef?: Date,
  lang: 'es' | 'en' = 'es'
) => {
  const { monDayIdx, minutesOfDay } = getMazatlanNowParts(nowRef);
  const raw = String(horariosRaw || '')
    .replace(/\s*\|\|\s*ig:@?[^\s|]+/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s*__ig:@?[^\s|]+/gi, '')
    .replace(/\b2[5-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '21:$1')
    .trim();
  const effectiveRaw = raw || 'Lunes a Sábado • 06:00 a 21:00';
  const norm = effectiveRaw.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();

  let isOpen = false;
  if (/\b(abierto\s*24|open\s*24|24\s*horas|24\s*hrs|24\/7)\b/i.test(norm)) {
    isOpen = true;
  } else {
    const segments = splitScheduleSegments(norm);
    for (const seg of segments) {
      const daysMatch = matchesScheduleDaysSegment(seg, monDayIdx);
      if (!daysMatch) continue;
      const timePairs = Array.from(
        seg.matchAll(/(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?)\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?\s*(?:a|al|to|-|–|hasta)\s*(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?)\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?/gi)
      );
      if (timePairs.length === 0) continue;
      for (const m of timePairs) {
        const startMin = parseTimeTokenMinutes(m[1].includes(':') ? m[1] : `${m[1]}:00`, m[2]);
        const endMin = parseTimeTokenMinutes(m[3].includes(':') ? m[3] : `${m[3]}:00`, m[4]);
        if (startMin === null || endMin === null) continue;
        if (endMin > startMin ? (minutesOfDay >= startMin && minutesOfDay < endMin) : (minutesOfDay >= startMin || minutesOfDay < endMin)) {
          isOpen = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (isOpen) break;
    }
  }

  return {
    isOpen,
    badgeEs: isOpen ? ('● ABIERTO' as const) : ('🕒 PRONTO' as const),
    badgeEn: isOpen ? ('● OPEN' as const) : ('🕒 SOON' as const),
    badgeText: lang === 'en' ? (isOpen ? '● OPEN' : '🕒 SOON') : (isOpen ? '● ABIERTO' : '🕒 PRONTO'),
    minutesNow: minutesOfDay,
  };
};

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export type WalletPlatformTarget = 'apple_wallet' | 'google_wallet';

export interface IWalletCompanionInput {
  reservaId: string;
  venueName: string;
  discipline: string;
  sessionTitle?: string | null;
  fechaIso?: string | null;
  horaInicio?: string | null;
  spotNumber?: number | null;
  escrowKc?: number | null;
  puertaKc?: number | null;
  vipLevel?: string | null;
  language?: 'es' | 'en';
  [extraKey: string]: unknown;
}

export interface IWalletCompanionReminderPayload {
  kind: 'kinetic_companion_reminder_v1';
  reservaId: string;
  venueName: string;
  discipline: string;
  sessionTitle: string;
  timeZone: 'America/Mazatlan';
  localDate: string;
  localTime: string;
  spotLabel: string;
  escrow40Kc: number;
  frontDesk60Kc: number;
  vipLevel: string;
  deepLinkUrl: 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda';
  legend: string;
  containsStaticQr: false;
}

export interface IWalletCompanionRequestResult {
  ok: boolean;
  status: number;
  code: 'WALLET_PASSES_DISABLED' | 'WALLET_ISSUER_NOT_CONFIGURED' | 'WALLET_READY' | 'UNAUTHORIZED';
  message: string;
  payload?: IWalletCompanionReminderPayload;
}

const FORBIDDEN_QR_KEYS = new Set([
  'qr_token',
  'qr_secret',
  'totp_secret',
  'totp_seed',
  'qr_payload',
  'barcode',
  'barcodes',
]);

let _cachedWalletFlag: { value: boolean; fetchedAt: number } | null = null;
const FLAG_CACHE_TTL_MS = 60_000;

export const shouldRenderNativeWalletPassButton = (enabled: unknown): boolean => enabled === true;

export function buildWalletCompanionReminderPayload(
  rawInput: IWalletCompanionInput
): IWalletCompanionReminderPayload {
  const sanitized = Object.create(null) as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (rawInput && typeof rawInput === 'object') {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rawInput)) {
      if (!FORBIDDEN_QR_KEYS.has(k.toLowerCase())) sanitized[k] = v;
    }
  }
  const isEn = sanitized.language === 'en';
  const fechaRaw = String(sanitized.fechaIso || '').trim().split('T')[0] || 'Por confirmar';
  const horaRaw = String(sanitized.horaInicio || '08:00').trim().slice(0, 5);
  const spotNum = Number(sanitized.spotNumber);
  const spotLabel =
    Number.isFinite(spotNum) && spotNum > 0
      ? isEn ? `Station #${Math.floor(spotNum)}` : `Estación #${Math.floor(spotNum)}`
      : isEn ? 'General Access' : 'Acceso General';

  return {
    kind: 'kinetic_companion_reminder_v1',
    reservaId: String(sanitized.reservaId || '').trim(),
    venueName: String(sanitized.venueName || 'Kinetic Oficial').trim(),
    discipline: String(sanitized.discipline || 'Fitness').trim(),
    sessionTitle: String(sanitized.sessionTitle || sanitized.discipline || 'Sesión Kinetic').trim(),
    timeZone: 'America/Mazatlan',
    localDate: fechaRaw,
    localTime: horaRaw,
    spotLabel,
    escrow40Kc: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(sanitized.escrowKc) || 0)),
    frontDesk60Kc: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(sanitized.puertaKc) || 0)),
    vipLevel: String(sanitized.vipLevel || 'Acceso Base').trim(),
    deepLinkUrl: 'https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda',
    legend: isEn
      ? 'Open your Kinetic Vault at reception to display your 60s Dynamic QR Key.'
      : 'Abre tu Bóveda Kinetic en recepción para mostrar tu Llave QR Dinámica de 60s.',
    containsStaticQr: false,
  };
}

export async function fetchNativeWalletPassesEnabled(forceRefresh = false): Promise<boolean> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!forceRefresh && _cachedWalletFlag && now - _cachedWalletFlag.fetchedAt < FLAG_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return _cachedWalletFlag.value;
  }
  try {
    const { data: cfgRow, error: cfgErr } = await supabase
      .from('app_config')
      .select('bool_value')
      .eq('config_key', 'enable_native_wallet_passes')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!cfgErr && cfgRow && typeof (cfgRow as { bool_value?: unknown }).bool_value === 'boolean') {
      const val = Boolean((cfgRow as { bool_value?: boolean }).bool_value);
      _cachedWalletFlag = { value: val, fetchedAt: now };
      return val;
    }
    const { data: flagRow } = await supabase
      .from('kinetic_system_flags')
      .select('enabled')
      .eq('flag_key', 'enable_native_wallet_passes')
      .maybeSingle();
    const fallbackVal = Boolean((flagRow as { enabled?: boolean } | null)?.enabled);
    _cachedWalletFlag = { value: fallbackVal, fetchedAt: now };
    return fallbackVal;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function resetWalletFlagCacheForTests(): void {
  _cachedWalletFlag = null;
}

export async function requestWalletCompanionPass(params: {
  input: IWalletCompanionInput;
  targetWallet: WalletPlatformTarget;
  flagOverride?: boolean;
}): Promise<IWalletCompanionRequestResult> {
  const enabled =
    typeof params.flagOverride === 'boolean'
      ? params.flagOverride
      : await fetchNativeWalletPassesEnabled();
  const isEn = params.input?.language === 'en';
  if (!enabled) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      status: 503,
      code: 'WALLET_PASSES_DISABLED',
      message: isEn
        ? 'Native Wallet companion passes are disabled until Fase 14C.'
        : 'Los pases compañero para Wallet nativo permanecen desactivados hasta la Fase 14C.',
    };
  }
  const cleanId = String(params.input?.reservaId || '').trim();
  if (!cleanId) {
    return { ok: false, status: 400, code: 'WALLET_PASSES_DISABLED', message: 'Missing reservaId.' };
  }
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('wallet-companion-pass', {
      body: { reservaId: cleanId, walletTarget: params.targetWallet },
    });
    const rec = (data || null) as { ok?: boolean; code?: string; message?: string } | null;
    if (error || !rec?.ok) {
      const code =
        rec?.code === 'WALLET_ISSUER_NOT_CONFIGURED'
          ? 'WALLET_ISSUER_NOT_CONFIGURED'
          : 'WALLET_PASSES_DISABLED';
      return {
        ok: false,
        status: 503,
        code,
        message: rec?.message || 'Wallet companion emitter unavailable.',
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      status: 200,
      code: 'WALLET_READY',
      message: 'OK',
      payload: buildWalletCompanionReminderPayload(params.input),
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: false,
      status: 503,
      code: 'WALLET_PASSES_DISABLED',
      message: 'Wallet companion service temporarily unavailable.',
    };
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  consumePendingOidcChallenge,
  exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase,
  extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl,
  parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState,
  resolveGoogleWebClientId,
} from './kineticGoogleOidcService';
import { scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation } from './kineticWebOAuthPopupHelper';
import { readSupabaseAuthTokenSyncWeb } from './kineticSessionPersistence';
import { type CapturedWebOAuthSnapshot } from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

export type WebOAuthExchangeOut =
  | { ok: true; user: unknown; session: unknown; modeHint: 'b2c' | 'b2b' | null }
  | { ok: false; reason: 'empty' | 'error'; errorText?: string };

let _inflightWebOAuthExchange: { key: string; promise: Promise<WebOAuthExchangeOut> } | null = null;
const _preBootAccessToken: string | null =
  typeof window !== 'undefined'
    ? ((readSupabaseAuthTokenSyncWeb()?.session as { access_token?: string } | null)?.access_token ?? null)
    : null;

async function readActiveSupabaseSessionSafe(): Promise<{ user: unknown; session: unknown } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    const s = res?.data?.session;
    return s?.user ? { user: s.user, session: s } : null;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
}

async function exchangePkceCodeSafe(cbCode: string): Promise<WebOAuthExchangeOut> {
  let pkceErrMsg = '';
  try {
    const ex = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(cbCode);
    if (ex?.data?.user && ex?.data?.session) {
      return { ok: true, user: ex.data.user, session: ex.data.session, modeHint: null };
    }
    pkceErrMsg = String(ex?.error?.message || '');
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    pkceErrMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
  }
  if (/(?:code.?verifier|already|consumed)/i.test(pkceErrMsg)) {
    const hydrated = await readActiveSupabaseSessionSafe();
    const hTok = (hydrated?.session as { access_token?: string } | null)?.access_token;
    if (hydrated && hTok && hTok !== _preBootAccessToken) {
      return { ok: true, ...hydrated, modeHint: null };
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: 'PKCE_EXCHANGE_FAILED' };
}

async function exchangeImplicitTokenSafe(
  cbAccessToken: string,
  cbRefreshToken: string,
  cbStateRaw: string
): Promise<WebOAuthExchangeOut> {
  const parsedState = parseAndVerifyKineticOidcState(cbStateRaw);
  if (!parsedState) return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: 'OAUTH_CSRF_REJECTED' };
  const ch = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
  if (!ch || ch.state !== cbStateRaw) return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: 'OAUTH_STATE_MISMATCH' };
  if (cbRefreshToken) {
    try {
      const sr = await supabase.auth.setSession({ access_token: cbAccessToken, refresh_token: cbRefreshToken });
      if (sr?.data?.user && sr?.data?.session) {
        return { ok: true, user: sr.data.user, session: sr.data.session, modeHint: parsedState.mode };
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
    }
  }
  const hydrated = await readActiveSupabaseSessionSafe();
  const hTok = (hydrated?.session as { access_token?: string } | null)?.access_token;
  return hydrated && hTok === cbAccessToken
    ? { ok: true, ...hydrated, modeHint: parsedState.mode }
    : { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: 'IMPLICIT_SESSION_EMPTY' };
}

async function executeWebOAuthExchange(snap: CapturedWebOAuthSnapshot): Promise<WebOAuthExchangeOut> {
  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(snap.search || '');
  const rawHash = snap.hash.startsWith('#?') ? snap.hash.slice(2) : snap.hash.startsWith('#') ? snap.hash.slice(1) : snap.hash;
  const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(rawHash);
  const cbError = String(hashParams.get('error_description') || searchParams.get('error_description') || hashParams.get('error') || searchParams.get('error') || '').trim();
  const idToken = String(hashParams.get('id_token') || searchParams.get('id_token') || '').trim();
  const cbCode = String(searchParams.get('code') || '').trim();
  const cbAccessToken = String(hashParams.get('access_token') || '').trim();
  const cbRefreshToken = String(hashParams.get('refresh_token') || '').trim();

  if (cbError) {
    scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
    return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: cbError };
  }
  if (idToken) {
    scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
    const challenge = await consumePendingOidcChallenge();
    if (!challenge) return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: 'OIDC_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED' };
    const extracted = extractGoogleIdTokenFromCallbackUrl(snap.href, {
      expectedState: challenge.state,
      expectedNonceHash: challenge.nonceHash,
      expectedClientId: resolveGoogleWebClientId(),
    });
    if (!extracted) return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: 'OIDC_CALLBACK_INVALID' };
    const { data, error } = await exchangeGoogleIdTokenWithSupabase(extracted.idToken, challenge.rawNonce);
    if (error || !data?.user || !data?.session) {
      return { ok: false, reason: 'error', errorText: error?.message || 'OIDC_SESSION_EMPTY' };
    }
    return { ok: true, user: data.user, session: data.session, modeHint: extracted.mode || challenge.mode };
  }
  if (cbCode) {
    scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
    return exchangePkceCodeSafe(cbCode);
  }
  if (cbAccessToken) {
    scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
    const cbStateRaw = String(hashParams.get('state') || searchParams.get('state') || '').trim();
    return exchangeImplicitTokenSafe(cbAccessToken, cbRefreshToken, cbStateRaw);
  }
  const existing = await readActiveSupabaseSessionSafe();
  return existing ? { ok: true, ...existing, modeHint: null } : { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };
}

export function runWebOAuthExchangeDeduplicated(snap: CapturedWebOAuthSnapshot): Promise<WebOAuthExchangeOut> {
  if (_inflightWebOAuthExchange?.key === snap.href) return _inflightWebOAuthExchange.promise;
  const promise = executeWebOAuthExchange(snap).finally(() => {
    if (_inflightWebOAuthExchange?.promise === promise) _inflightWebOAuthExchange = null;
  });
  _inflightWebOAuthExchange = { key: snap.href, promise };
  return promise;
}

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

const OAUTH_STATIC_HTTPS_ORIGINS = new Set([
  'https://kineticapp.com.mx',
  'https://www.kineticapp.com.mx',
]);
const OAUTH_LOCAL_DEV_ORIGIN_RE = /^http:\/\/(?:localhost|127\.0\.0\.1):(?:8081|19006|3000)$/i;
const OAUTH_NATIVE_DEEP_LINK_RE = /^kinetic:\/\/(?:login|oauth|auth\/callback)(?:[/?#].*)?$/i;
const OAUTH_SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS = [
  'code', 'state', 'id_token', 'access_token', 'refresh_token', 'provider_token',
  'provider_refresh_token', 'expires_in', 'token_type', 'error', 'error_description', 'error_code',
];

export function isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(candidateUrl: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof candidateUrl !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = candidateUrl.trim();
  if (!clean || clean.length > 4096 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\s]/.test(clean) || clean.startsWith('//') || clean.includes('..')) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/^kinetic:\/\//i.test(clean)) {
    const authority = clean.slice('kinetic://'.length).split(/[/?#]/)[0] || '';
    return !authority.includes('@') && OAUTH_NATIVE_DEEP_LINK_RE.test(clean);
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    if (parsed.username || parsed.password) return false;
    const origin = parsed.origin.toLowerCase();
    return OAUTH_STATIC_HTTPS_ORIGINS.has(origin) || OAUTH_LOCAL_DEV_ORIGIN_RE.test(origin);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function resolveSafeKineticOAuthRedirectTo(platformOs: string, webOrigin?: string | null): string {
  if (platformOs !== 'web') return 'kinetic://login';
  const clean = String(webOrigin || '').trim();
  if (!isAllowedKineticOAuthRedirectUrl(clean) || /^kinetic:\/\//i.test(clean)) {
    throw new Error('OAUTH_REDIRECT_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN');
  }
  return new URL(clean).origin;
}

export function validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(oauthUrl: unknown): string {
  const clean = typeof oauthUrl === 'string' ? oauthUrl.trim() : '';
  if (!clean || clean.length > 4096 || /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(clean) || clean.toLowerCase().includes('service_role')) {
    throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(clean);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:' || parsed.username || parsed.password) {
      throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
    }
    const host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (host !== 'accounts.google.com' || parsed.pathname !== '/o/oauth2/v2/auth') {
      throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
    }
    return clean;
  } catch {
    throw new Error('OAUTH_AUTHORIZE_URL_FORBIDDEN');
  }
}

export function scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation(): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location || !window.history?.replaceState) return;
  try {
    let changed = false;
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || '');
    for (const k of OAUTH_SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS) {
      if (searchParams.has(k)) { searchParams.delete(k); changed = true; }
    }
    let nextHash = window.location.hash || '';
    if (nextHash.length > 1 && nextHash.includes('=')) {
      const rawHash = nextHash.startsWith('#?') ? nextHash.slice(2) : nextHash.slice(1);
      const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(rawHash);
      let hashChanged = false;
      for (const k of OAUTH_SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS) {
        if (hashParams.has(k)) { hashParams.delete(k); hashChanged = true; }
      }
      if (hashChanged) {
        changed = true;
        const rem = hashParams.toString();
        nextHash = rem ? `#${rem}` : '';
      }
    }
    if (changed) {
      const s = searchParams.toString();
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', `${window.location.pathname || '/'}${s ? `?${s}` : ''}${nextHash}`);
    }
  } catch {}
}

export function openInAppGoogleOAuthPopup(oauthUrl: string): Window | null {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || window.innerWidth < 768) return null;
  const safeUrl = validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(oauthUrl);
  try {
    const w = 500;
    const h = 650;
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.round((window.screenX || 0) + (window.outerWidth - w) / 2));
    const top = Math.max(0, Math.round((window.screenY || 0) + (window.outerHeight - h) / 2));
    return window.open(
      safeUrl,
      'kinetic_google_oauth',
      `popup=yes,width=${w},height=${h},left=${left},top=${top},resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`
    );
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function probeAndRunWebGoogleOAuthPopup({
  oauthUrl,
  cleanupRef,
  isMountedRef,
}: {
  oauthUrl: string;
  cleanupRef: { current: (() => void) | null };
  isMountedRef: { current: boolean };
}): Promise<{ kind: 'popup_settled' | 'fallback_redirect' }> {
  const safeUrl = validateSupabaseAuthorizeUrl(oauthUrl);
  cleanupRef.current?.();

  let probeTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  try {
    const ctrl = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : null;
    probeTimer = ctrl ? setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 3500) : null;
    const probe = await fetch(safeUrl, {
      method: 'GET',
      redirect: 'manual',
      ...(ctrl ? { signal: ctrl.signal } : {}),
    });
    if (probe.type !== 'opaqueredirect' && !probe.ok && probe.status >= 400) {
      const rawBody = await probe.text().catch(() => '');
      if (rawBody) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(rawBody) as Record<string, unknown>;
          throw new Error(String(parsed.msg || parsed.error_description || parsed.message || 'Unsupported provider'));
        } catch (parseErr) {
          if (parseErr instanceof Error && parseErr.message && !rawBody.trim().startsWith('{')) throw parseErr;
          throw new Error(rawBody);
        }
      }
      throw new Error('Unsupported provider');
    }
  } catch (probeErr: unknown) {
    const pm = (probeErr instanceof Error ? probeErr.message : String(probeErr || '')).toLowerCase();
    if (pm.includes('unsupported provider') || pm.includes('provider is not enabled') || pm.includes('validation_failed')) {
      throw probeErr;
    }
  } finally {
    if (probeTimer) clearTimeout(probeTimer);
  }

  const popup = openInAppGoogleOAuthPopup(safeUrl);
  if (!popup) return { kind: 'fallback_redirect' };

  await new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    const cleanup = () => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(maxTimeout);
      clearInterval(poll);
      sub.subscription.unsubscribe();
      cleanupRef.current = null;
      scrubOAuthSecretsFromWebLocation();
      resolve(true);
    };
    const { data: sub } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_ev, sess) => {
      if (!settled && sess?.user) {
        try { popup.close(); } catch {}
        cleanup();
      }
    });
    const poll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!settled && popup.closed) cleanup();
    }, 400);
    const maxTimeout = setTimeout(() => cleanup(), 180_000);
    cleanupRef.current = () => {
      try { popup.close(); } catch {}
      cleanup();
    };
  });

  void isMountedRef.current;
  return { kind: 'popup_settled' };
}

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  decryptKineticString,
  encryptKineticString,
  getOrCreateWebSaltSync,
} from './kineticVaultCrypto';
import {
  WEB_COOKIE_PRIVATE_GRANT,
  WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC,
  readResilientWebMirror,
  removeResilientWebMirror,
  shouldRevokePrivateWebGrantOnHttpError,
  writeResilientWebMirror,
} from '../utils/kineticWebKitIosOAuthShieldLeaf';

export const PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_web_invite_grant_v286';
export const WEB_PASS_CHANGED_EVENT = 'kinetic:founder-pass-changed';
const KPASS_REGEX = /^KNT-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$/;
const POISON_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export type PrivateWebTargetPath = '/login' | '/socios';

export interface IPrivateWebGrantPass {
  v: 1;
  issuer: 'kinetic_web_invite_v286';
  grantToken: string;
  targetPath: PrivateWebTargetPath;
  allowSandboxBeta: boolean;
  issuedAtMs: number;
  expiresAtMs: number;
}

export interface AdminWebInviteRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  code_hint: string;
  target_path: PrivateWebTargetPath;
  max_uses: number;
  used_count: number;
  allow_sandbox_beta: boolean;
  expires_at: string;
  revoked_at: string | null;
  last_used_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export function normalizeKpassCode(raw: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return null;
  const alnum = raw.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
  const formatted =
    alnum.length === 11 && alnum.startsWith('KNT')
      ? `KNT-${alnum.slice(3, 7)}-${alnum.slice(7, 11)}`
      : raw.trim().toUpperCase();
  return KPASS_REGEX.test(formatted) ? formatted : null;
}

export function scrubKpassFromWebLocation(rawHref: string): {
  code: string | null;
  cleanedRelativeUrl: string | null;
} {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(rawHref, 'https://kineticapp.com.mx');
    const rawCode = parsed.searchParams.get('kpass');
    if (rawCode === null) return { code: null, cleanedRelativeUrl: null };
    const code = normalizeKpassCode(rawCode);
    parsed.searchParams.delete('kpass');
    const qs = parsed.searchParams.toString();
    const cleanedRelativeUrl = `${parsed.pathname || '/'}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}${parsed.hash || ''}`;
    return { code, cleanedRelativeUrl };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return { code: null, cleanedRelativeUrl: null };
  }
}

export function validatePrivateWebGrantObject(
  raw: unknown,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IPrivateWebGrantPass | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return null;
  for (const key of Object.keys(raw)) {
    if (POISON_KEYS.has(key)) return null;
  }
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const grantToken = typeof obj.grantToken === 'string' ? obj.grantToken.trim() : '';
  const targetPath = obj.targetPath === '/socios' ? '/socios' : obj.targetPath === '/login' ? '/login' : null;
  const issuedAtMs = typeof obj.issuedAtMs === 'number' ? obj.issuedAtMs : 0;
  const expiresAtMs = typeof obj.expiresAtMs === 'number' ? obj.expiresAtMs : 0;
  if (
    obj.v !== 1 ||
    obj.issuer !== 'kinetic_web_invite_v286' ||
    grantToken.length < 16 ||
    !targetPath ||
    !Number.isFinite(issuedAtMs) ||
    !Number.isFinite(expiresAtMs) ||
    issuedAtMs <= 0 ||
    issuedAtMs > nowMs + 60_000 ||
    expiresAtMs <= nowMs
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    v: 1,
    issuer: 'kinetic_web_invite_v286',
    grantToken,
    targetPath,
    allowSandboxBeta: Boolean(obj.allowSandboxBeta),
    issuedAtMs,
    expiresAtMs,
  };
}

export function encodePrivateWebGrantPass(
  input: {
    grantToken: string;
    targetPath: PrivateWebTargetPath;
    expiresAtMs: number;
    allowSandboxBeta?: boolean;
    nowMs?: number;
  },
  salt: string
): string {
  const nowMs = typeof input.nowMs === 'number' ? input.nowMs : Date.now();
  const clean = validatePrivateWebGrantObject(
    {
      v: 1,
      issuer: 'kinetic_web_invite_v286',
      grantToken: input.grantToken,
      targetPath: input.targetPath,
      allowSandboxBeta: Boolean(input.allowSandboxBeta),
      issuedAtMs: nowMs,
      expiresAtMs: input.expiresAtMs,
    },
    nowMs
  );
  if (!clean) throw new Error('INVALID_PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT');
  return encryptKineticString(JSON.stringify(clean), salt);
}

export function decodePrivateWebGrantPass(
  rawCipher: string | null | undefined,
  salt: string,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): IPrivateWebGrantPass | null {
  if (!rawCipher || !salt) return null;
  const plain = decryptKineticString(String(rawCipher), salt);
  if (!plain) return null;
  try {
    return validatePrivateWebGrantObject(JSON.parse(plain), nowMs);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
}

function notifyPassSubscribers(): void {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(WEB_PASS_CHANGED_EVENT)); } catch (err) { void err; }
  }
}

export function readValidPrivateWebGrantSync(nowMs: number = Date.now()): IPrivateWebGrantPass | null {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const raw = readResilientWebMirror(PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY, WEB_COOKIE_PRIVATE_GRANT);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const salt = getOrCreateWebSaltSync();
    const parsed = decodePrivateWebGrantPass(raw, salt, nowMs);
    if (!parsed) {
      removeResilientWebMirror(PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY, WEB_COOKIE_PRIVATE_GRANT);
      return null;
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
}

export function writePrivateWebGrantSync(input: {
  grantToken: string;
  targetPath: PrivateWebTargetPath;
  expiresAtMs: number;
  allowSandboxBeta?: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const salt = getOrCreateWebSaltSync();
    const cipher = encodePrivateWebGrantPass(input, salt);
    writeResilientWebMirror(PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY, cipher, WEB_COOKIE_PRIVATE_GRANT, WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC);
    notifyPassSubscribers();
    return true;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return false;
  }
}

export function revokePrivateWebGrantSync(): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  removeResilientWebMirror(PRIVATE_WEB_GRANT_STORAGE_KEY, WEB_COOKIE_PRIVATE_GRANT);
  notifyPassSubscribers();
}

export function extractAndScrubKpassFromBrowserUrl(): string | null {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location) return null;
  const { code, cleanedRelativeUrl } = scrubKpassFromWebLocation(window.location.href);
  if (cleanedRelativeUrl && window.history?.replaceState) {
    try { window.history.replaceState(null, '', cleanedRelativeUrl); } catch (err) { void err; }
  }
  return code;
}

function resolveBrowserBucket(): string {
  try {
    const ua = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent.slice(0, 24) : 'web';
    const salt = Platform.OS === 'web' ? getOrCreateWebSaltSync().slice(0, 16) : 'nat';
    return `wb_${salt}_${ua.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`.slice(0, 48);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return 'web_default';
  }
}

export async function redeemPrivateWebInviteCloud(
  rawCode: string
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; targetPath?: PrivateWebTargetPath; reason?: string }> {
  const code = normalizeKpassCode(rawCode);
  if (!code) return { ok: false, reason: 'INVALID_FORMAT' };
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('canjear_acceso_web_privado_v286', {
      p_raw_code: code,
      p_client_bucket: resolveBrowserBucket(),
    });
    const res = (data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (error || res.ok !== true || typeof res.grant_token !== 'string') {
      return { ok: false, reason: String(res.reason || error?.message || 'DENIED') };
    }
    const targetPath: PrivateWebTargetPath = res.target_path === '/socios' ? '/socios' : '/login';
    const expMs = Date.parse(String(res.expires_at || ''));
    const saved = writePrivateWebGrantSync({
      grantToken: res.grant_token,
      targetPath,
      expiresAtMs: Number.isFinite(expMs) ? expMs : Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000,
      allowSandboxBeta: Boolean(res.allow_sandbox_beta),
    });
    return saved ? { ok: true, targetPath } : { ok: false, reason: 'STORAGE_BLOCKED' };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return { ok: false, reason: 'NETWORK_ERROR' };
  }
}

export async function revalidatePrivateWebGrantCloud(): Promise<{ checked: boolean; active: boolean }> {
  const current = readValidPrivateWebGrantSync();
  if (!current) return { checked: false, active: false };
  const matchesCurrent = () => readValidPrivateWebGrantSync()?.grantToken === current.grantToken;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('validar_pase_web_activo_v286', {
      p_grant_token: current.grantToken,
    });
    if (!matchesCurrent()) return { checked: false, active: true };
    if (shouldRevokePrivateWebGrantOnHttpError(error, data)) {
      revokePrivateWebGrantSync();
      return { checked: true, active: false };
    }
    if (error || !data || typeof data !== 'object') {
      return { checked: false, active: true };
    }
    return { checked: true, active: true };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    if (!matchesCurrent()) return { checked: false, active: true };
    if (shouldRevokePrivateWebGrantOnHttpError(err)) {
      revokePrivateWebGrantSync();
      return { checked: true, active: false };
    }
    return { checked: false, active: true };
  }
}

export async function adminCreateWebInviteCloud(params: {
  label: string;
  ttlHours: number;
  maxUses: number;
  targetPath: PrivateWebTargetPath;
  allowSandboxBeta: boolean;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; code?: string; url?: string; error?: string }> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('admin_crear_acceso_web_privado_v286', {
    p_label: params.label.trim() || 'Invitado Kinetic',
    p_ttl_hours: params.ttlHours,
    p_max_uses: params.maxUses,
    p_target_path: params.targetPath,
    p_allow_sandbox: params.allowSandboxBeta,
  });
  const res = (data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (error || res.ok !== true) return { ok: false, error: error?.message || 'CREATE_FAILED' };
  return { ok: true, code: String(res.code || ''), url: String(res.url || '') };
}

export async function adminListWebInvitesCloud(): Promise<AdminWebInviteRow[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('admin_listar_accesos_web_privados_v286');
  if (error || !Array.isArray(data)) return [];
  return data as AdminWebInviteRow[];
}

export async function adminRevokeWebInviteCloud(inviteId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('admin_revocar_acceso_web_privado_v286', { p_invite_id: inviteId });
  return !error && Boolean((data as { ok?: unknown } | null)?.ok);
}

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { BackHandler, Platform } from 'react-native';

export interface KineticOverlayEntry {
  id: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

let _overlayStack: KineticOverlayEntry[] = [];
let _disciplinePickerOpenCount = 0;
let _fullScreenModalOverlayCount = 0;
let _platformHooksInstalled = false;
const _listeners = new Set<() => void>();

const emitOverlayChange = (): void => {
  for (const fn of Array.from(_listeners)) {
    try {
      fn();
    } catch (err) {
      void err;
    }
  }
};

export const popTopOverlay = (): boolean => {
  if (_overlayStack.length === 0) return false;
  const top = _overlayStack[_overlayStack.length - 1];
  _overlayStack = _overlayStack.slice(0, -1);
  emitOverlayChange();
  try {
    top.onClose();
  } catch (err) {
    void err;
  }
  return true;
};

const ensurePlatformBackListeners = (): void => {
  if (_platformHooksInstalled) return;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
    _platformHooksInstalled = true;
    window.addEventListener(
      'keydown',
      (ev: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (ev.key !== 'Escape' || _overlayStack.length === 0) return;
        ev.preventDefault();
        ev.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
        ev.stopPropagation();
        popTopOverlay();
      },
      true
    );
    return;
  }
  if (Platform.OS === 'android' && typeof BackHandler?.addEventListener === 'function') {
    _platformHooksInstalled = true;
    BackHandler.addEventListener('hardwareBackPress', () => {
      if (_overlayStack.length === 0) return false;
      return popTopOverlay();
    });
  }
};

export const registerOverlay = (id: string, onClose: () => void): (() => void) => {
  const cleanId = String(id || '').trim() || `overlay-${Date.now()}`;
  ensurePlatformBackListeners();
  _overlayStack = [..._overlayStack.filter((item) => item.id !== cleanId), { id: cleanId, onClose }];
  emitOverlayChange();

  let released = false;
  return () => {
    if (released) return;
    released = true;
    const prevLen = _overlayStack.length;
    _overlayStack = _overlayStack.filter((item) => item.id !== cleanId);
    if (_overlayStack.length !== prevLen) {
      emitOverlayChange();
    }
  };
};

export const getOverlayDepth = (): number => _overlayStack.length;

export const peekTopOverlayId = (): string | null =>
  _overlayStack.length > 0 ? _overlayStack[_overlayStack.length - 1].id : null;

export const subscribeOverlayStack = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
  _listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    _listeners.delete(listener);
  };
};

export const resetOverlayStackForTests = (): void => {
  _overlayStack = [];
  _disciplinePickerOpenCount = 0;
  _fullScreenModalOverlayCount = 0;
  emitOverlayChange();
};

export const setDisciplinePickerOpen = (open: boolean): void => {
  const next = Math.max(0, _disciplinePickerOpenCount + (open ? 1 : -1));
  if (next === _disciplinePickerOpenCount) return;
  _disciplinePickerOpenCount = next;
  emitOverlayChange();
};

export const setFullScreenModalOverlayOpen = (open: boolean): void => {
  const next = Math.max(0, _fullScreenModalOverlayCount + (open ? 1 : -1));
  if (next === _fullScreenModalOverlayCount) return;
  _fullScreenModalOverlayCount = next;
  emitOverlayChange();
};

const getDisciplinePickerSnapshot = (): boolean => _disciplinePickerOpenCount > 0;
const getFullScreenOverlaySnapshot = (): boolean => _fullScreenModalOverlayCount > 0;

export const useIsDisciplinePickerOpen = (): boolean =>
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribeOverlayStack, getDisciplinePickerSnapshot, getDisciplinePickerSnapshot);

export const useIsFullScreenModalOverlayOpen = (): boolean =>
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribeOverlayStack, getFullScreenOverlaySnapshot, getFullScreenOverlaySnapshot);

export const useOverlayStackDepth = (): number =>
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribeOverlayStack, getOverlayDepth, getOverlayDepth);

export const useRegisterOverlayLayer = (
  id: string,
  active: boolean,
  onClose?: (() => void) | null
): void => {
  const instanceId = useId();
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
  onCloseRef.current = onClose;

  const hasClose = Boolean(onClose);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active || !onCloseRef.current) return undefined;
    const scopedId = `${id}:${instanceId}`;
    return registerOverlay(scopedId, () => {
      onCloseRef.current?.();
    });
  }, [active, hasClose, id, instanceId]);
};
