import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { ensureFirstTimeProfile, mapSupabaseAuthError } from '../kineticAuthHelpers';
import {
  toKineticAuthSession,
  toKineticAuthUser,
  withAuthTimeout,
  type KineticAuthProfile,
  type KineticAuthSession,
  type KineticAuthUser,
} from '../kineticAuthContextHelpers';
import {
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
  setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge,
} from '../kineticFintechSecurityGuards';
import { runWebGoogleGisSignIn } from '../kineticGoogleGisWebRunner';
import {
  doesSessionRequireMfaAal2,
  getMfaSecuritySnapshot,
  setPendingMfaGateActive,
  verifyAndActivateTotpFactor,
  type IMfaSessionLike,
} from '../kineticSecurityMfaService';
import {
  purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly,
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut,
  synthesizeProfileFromUser,
} from '../kineticSessionPersistence';

export interface IPartnerWebPendingMfa {
  factorId: string;
  friendlyName: string;
  email: string;
  user: KineticAuthUser;
}

export type PartnerWebSignInOutcome =
  | { status: 'authenticated'; user: KineticAuthUser; profile: KineticAuthProfile }
  | { status: 'mfa_required'; challenge: IPartnerWebPendingMfa }
  | { status: 'cancelled' };

type ActivateSessionFn = (
  nextUser: KineticAuthUser,
  nextProfile: KineticAuthProfile | null,
  nextSession?: KineticAuthSession | null
) => void;

const AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS = 9500;
const PROFILE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500;

async function safeBestEffortCleanup(op: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await op();
    return true;
  } catch (cleanupErr: unknown) {
    return cleanupErr instanceof Error ? false : false;
  }
}

async function finalizeWebSignInOrRequireMfa(
  signedUser: KineticAuthUser,
  activeSess: KineticAuthSession | null,
  activateResilientSession: ActivateSessionFn
): Promise<PartnerWebSignInOutcome> {
  const mfaSnap = await getMfaSecuritySnapshot().catch((mfaErr: unknown) => (mfaErr ? null : null));
  const needsMfa = Boolean(
    !mfaSnap ||
      mfaSnap.checkFailed ||
      mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge ||
      doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(activeSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike | null)
  );

  if (needsMfa) {
    const factor = mfaSnap?.verifiedFactors?.[0];
    if (!factor?.id) {
      setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
      await safeBestEffortCleanup(() => supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }));
      await safeBestEffortCleanup(() => purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly());
      throw new Error('Tu cuenta requiere verificación 2FA activa.');
    }
    setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
    setGlobalPendingMfaChallenge({
      required: true,
      email: String(signedUser.email || ''),
      factorId: String(factor.id),
      reason: 'aal2_required',
    });
    await safeBestEffortCleanup(() => purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly());
    return {
      status: 'mfa_required',
      challenge: {
        factorId: String(factor.id),
        friendlyName: String(factor.friendly_name || 'Kinetic Authenticator'),
        email: String(signedUser.email || ''),
        user: signedUser,
      },
    };
  }

  setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut();

  const profileData = await withAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(signedUser), PROFILE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(
    (profErr: unknown) =>
      synthesizeProfileFromUser(
        signedUser,
        null,
        profErr instanceof Error ? 'b2b' : 'b2b'
      ) as unknown as KineticAuthProfile
  );
  activateResilientSession(signedUser, profileData as KineticAuthProfile, activeSess);
  return { status: 'authenticated', user: signedUser, profile: profileData as KineticAuthProfile };
}

export async function signInPartnerWebEmail(
  rawEmail: string,
  rawPassword: string,
  activateResilientSession: ActivateSessionFn
): Promise<PartnerWebSignInOutcome> {
  const cleanEmail = String(rawEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 120);
  const cleanPassword = String(rawPassword || '').trim().slice(0, 128);
  if (!cleanEmail || !cleanPassword) {
    throw new Error('Ingresa tu correo corporativo y contraseña.');
  }

  setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
  try {
    const { data, error } = await withAuthTimeout(
      supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: cleanEmail, password: cleanPassword }),
      AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS
    );
    if (error) throw new Error(mapSupabaseAuthError(error.message));
    const signedUser = toKineticAuthUser(data?.user);
    const activeSess = toKineticAuthSession(data?.session);
    if (!signedUser || !activeSess?.access_token) {
      throw new Error('No se recibió sesión válida del servidor.');
    }
    return await finalizeWebSignInOrRequireMfa(signedUser, activeSess, activateResilientSession);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
    throw new Error(mapSupabaseAuthError(msg) || msg);
  }
}

export async function signInPartnerWebGoogle(
  activateResilientSession: ActivateSessionFn,
  registerCleanup?: (cleanupFn: (() => void) | null) => void
): Promise<PartnerWebSignInOutcome> {
  setPendingMfaGateActive(true);
  try {
    const webRes = await runWebGoogleGisSignIn('b2b', { registerCleanup });
    if (webRes.status === 'redirecting') {
      setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
      return { status: 'cancelled' };
    }
    if (webRes.status !== 'success') {
      setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
      return { status: 'cancelled' };
    }
    const kUser = toKineticAuthUser(webRes.user);
    const kSess = toKineticAuthSession(webRes.session);
    if (!kUser || !kSess?.access_token) {
      throw new Error('Google no devolvió credenciales válidas.');
    }
    return await finalizeWebSignInOrRequireMfa(kUser, kSess, activateResilientSession);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err || '');
    throw new Error(mapSupabaseAuthError(msg) || msg);
  }
}

export async function verifyPartnerWebMfaTotp(
  challenge: IPartnerWebPendingMfa,
  code: string,
  activateResilientSession: ActivateSessionFn
): Promise<boolean> {
  const upgradedRaw = await verifyAndActivateTotpFactor(challenge.factorId, code);
  const upgradedSess = toKineticAuthSession(upgradedRaw);
  if (!upgradedSess || doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(upgradedSess as unknown as IMfaSessionLike)) {
    throw new Error('Código 2FA inválido o expirado.');
  }
  const activeUser = upgradedSess.user || challenge.user;
  setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
  resetExplicitKineticSignOut();
  const profileData = await withAuthTimeout(ensureFirstTimeProfile(activeUser), PROFILE_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(
    (profErr: unknown) =>
      synthesizeProfileFromUser(
        activeUser,
        null,
        profErr instanceof Error ? 'b2b' : 'b2b'
      ) as unknown as KineticAuthProfile
  );
  activateResilientSession(activeUser, profileData as KineticAuthProfile, upgradedSess);
  return true;
}

export async function cancelPartnerWebMfaChallenge(): Promise<void> {
  setPendingMfaGateActive(false);
  clearGlobalPendingMfaChallenge();
  await safeBestEffortCleanup(() => supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }));
  await safeBestEffortCleanup(() => purgeKineticPersistedSnapshotOnly());
}

export async function loadPartnerPortalWorkspace(params: {
  userId: string;
  userEmail?: string | null;
  profileName?: string | null;
  userRole?: string | null;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  isEn: boolean;
  supervisedAffiliate?: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
}): Promise<IPartnerPortalWorkspaceData> {
  const { userId, userEmail, profileName, userRole, isAdmin, isEn, supervisedAffiliate } = params;
  let business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null = supervisedAffiliate || null;

  if (isAdmin && supervisedAffiliate?.id && UUID_RE.test(supervisedAffiliate.id)) {
    const { data: fullAffiliateRow } = await supabase
      .from('afiliados')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', supervisedAffiliate.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (fullAffiliateRow) {
      business = { ...supervisedAffiliate, ...(fullAffiliateRow as IPartnerWebAffiliateRow) };
    }
  }

  if (!business) {
    const bizRows = await terminalService.fetchBusinessStatus(
      userId,
      userEmail || undefined,
      profileName || undefined,
      'Club',
      userRole || undefined
    );
    business = (Array.isArray(bizRows) && bizRows.length > 0 ? bizRows[0] : null) as IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  }

  const periodOptions = buildPartnerPeriodOptions(Date.now(), isEn);
  if (!business?.nombre && !isAdmin) {
    return {
      business: null,
      services: [],
      activeReservations: [],
      completedReservations: [],
      historyReservations: [],
      kpis: {
        ingresosHoyMxn: 0,
        proyeccionSpei80Mxn: 0,
        checkInsCompletados: 0,
        reservasActivasEscrow: 0,
        escrowCustodiaKc: 0,
        ocupacionPct: 0,
        pasesMaestrosHoy: 0,
        pasesMaestrosSemana: 0,
        pasesMaestrosMes: 0,
      },
      masterPassSummary: { ...EMPTY_MASTER_PASS_SUMMARY },
      periodOptions,
    };
  }

  const scopeName = business?.nombre ? String(business.nombre) : null;
  const isGlobalScope = isAdmin && !supervisedAffiliate && !scopeName;
  void reconcileExpiredNoShowPassesSilent();
  const hasActiveBiz =
    Boolean(business?.isOfficialKinetic) ||
    String(scopeName || '').toLowerCase() === 'kinetic oficial' ||
    String(business?.estado || '').toLowerCase() === 'activo';

  const opRes = await terminalService.fetchOperacionEstadio(scopeName, isGlobalScope, hasActiveBiz);
  const perfById = new Map<string, { id?: string; nombre?: string | null; avatar_url?: string | null; nivel?: string | null }>();
  for (const p of opRes.perfiles || []) {
    if (p?.id) perfById.set(String(p.id), p as { id?: string; nombre?: string | null; avatar_url?: string | null; nivel?: string | null });
  }

  const allReservas: IPartnerWebReservationRow[] = (opRes.reservas || []).map((r) => {
    const uid = String(r.usuario_id || '');
    return {
      ...(r as unknown as IPartnerWebReservationRow),
      perfiles: (r.perfiles as IPartnerWebReservationRow['perfiles']) || (uid ? perfById.get(uid) || null : null),
    };
  });

  const activeReservations = allReservas.filter((r) =>
    ACTIVE_STATES.has(String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim())
  );
  const completedReservations = allReservas.filter((r) =>
    COMPLETED_STATES.has(String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim())
  );
  const historyReservations = allReservas.filter(
    (r) => !ACTIVE_STATES.has(String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim())
  );
  const services = (opRes.servicios || []) as unknown as IPartnerWebServiceRow[];

  const masterPassSummary = await fetchMasterPassesAuditSummary(
    isGlobalScope ? null : scopeName,
    isGlobalScope,
    allReservas as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[],
    hasActiveBiz
  ).catch((mpErr: unknown) => (mpErr instanceof Error ? { ...EMPTY_MASTER_PASS_SUMMARY } : { ...EMPTY_MASTER_PASS_SUMMARY }));

  const mz = getMazatlanWeekAndDayBounds();
  let ingresosHoyMxn = 0;
  for (const r of historyReservations) {
    const st = String(r.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (st !== 'completada' && st !== 'no_show' && st !== 'penalizada') continue;
    const ts = parseMazatlanTimestampMs(r.updated_at || r.fecha_clase || r.fecha_hora || r.created_at);
    if (!Number.isNaN(ts) && ts >= mz.startOfTodayMs && ts <= mz.endOfTodayMs) {
      ingresosHoyMxn += resolveReservaB2BMonto(r as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, true);
    }
  }

  const weekCut = computePartnerSpeiStatement(
    business || { nombre: 'Kinetic Oficial', isOfficialKinetic: true },
    historyReservations,
    activeReservations,
    periodOptions[0]?.override
  );
  const escrowCustodiaKc = activeReservations.reduce(
    (acc, r) => acc + Math.max(0, Number(r.monto_escrow ?? Math.round((Number(r.precio_kc ?? r.costo_total ?? 0) || 0) * 0.4)) || 0),
    0
  );
  const totalCap = services.reduce((acc, s) => acc + Math.max(0, Number(s.cupo_maximo) || 0), 0);
  const totalOccupied = services.reduce((acc, s) => acc + Math.max(0, Number(s.cupo_actual) || 0), 0);
  const fallbackOcc = totalCap > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round(((totalOccupied || activeReservations.length) / totalCap) * 100)) : 0;

  return {
    business,
    services,
    activeReservations,
    completedReservations,
    historyReservations,
    kpis: {
      ingresosHoyMxn: Math.round(ingresosHoyMxn),
      proyeccionSpei80Mxn: Number(weekCut.corteSocio?.subtotal_socio_80_mxn ?? 0),
      checkInsCompletados: completedReservations.length,
      reservasActivasEscrow: activeReservations.length,
      escrowCustodiaKc: Math.round(escrowCustodiaKc),
      ocupacionPct: fallbackOcc,
      pasesMaestrosHoy: masterPassSummary.hoy,
      pasesMaestrosSemana: masterPassSummary.semana,
      pasesMaestrosMes: masterPassSummary.mes,
    },
    masterPassSummary,
    periodOptions,
  };
}

export async function validateAndSettlePartnerQrCheckin(params: {
  rawInput: string;
  scopeBusinessName?: string | null;
  isMasterAdmin: boolean;
  isEn: boolean;
}): Promise<{
  reserva: IPartnerWebReservationRow;
  athleteName: string;
  settled: boolean;
}> {
  const cleanScope = String(params.scopeBusinessName || '').trim();
  if (!params.isMasterAdmin && !cleanScope) {
    throw new Error(
      params.isEn
        ? 'Active venue required before validating QR passes.'
        : 'Debes tener una sede activa cargada antes de validar pases QR.'
    );
  }
  const packet = parseTerminalQrPacket(params.rawInput, Date.now());
  if (!packet.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      packet.isExpired
        ? params.isEn
          ? 'Dynamic QR key expired (60s window). Ask the athlete to show the refreshed QR.'
          : 'Llave dinámica QR expirada (ventana 60s). Solicita el código actualizado al atleta.'
        : params.isEn
        ? 'Invalid QR pass or folio format.'
        : 'Formato de llave QR o folio inválido.'
    );
  }
  const found = (await terminalService.findReservaByQR(
    packet.qrIdentifier,
    UUID_RE.test(packet.qrIdentifier),
    cleanScope || null
  )) as IPartnerWebReservationRow | null;
  if (!found?.id) {
    throw new Error(
      params.isEn
        ? 'No active pass found matching that QR or folio for this venue.'
        : 'No se encontró un pase activo con ese QR o folio para esta sede.'
    );
  }
  await terminalService.liquidarPase(
    found.id,
    found.usuario_id || null,
    Number(found.monto_puerta ?? 0),
    packet.qrIdentifier,
    packet.totpStep,
    packet.qrNonce,
    { isMasterAdmin: params.isMasterAdmin }
  );
  return {
    reserva: found,
    athleteName: String(found.perfiles?.nombre || (params.isEn ? 'Kinetic Athlete' : 'Atleta Kinetic')),
    settled: true,
  };
}

function isRealIsoCalendarDate(raw: string): boolean {
  const m = raw.match(ISO_DATE_RE);
  if (!m) return false;
  const y = Number(m[1]), mo = Number(m[2]), d = Number(m[3]);
  const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d));
  return dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === mo - 1 && dt.getUTCDate() === d;
}

export function isValidPartnerGpsPair(lat: unknown, lng: unknown): boolean {
  const nLat = typeof lat === 'number' ? lat : typeof lat === 'string' && lat.trim() ? Number(lat.trim()) : Number.NaN;
  const nLng = typeof lng === 'number' ? lng : typeof lng === 'string' && lng.trim() ? Number(lng.trim()) : Number.NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(nLat) || !Number.isFinite(nLng)) return false;
  if (nLat < -90 || nLat > 90 || nLng < -180 || nLng > 180) return false;
  if (Math.abs(nLat) < 0.0001 && Math.abs(nLng) < 0.0001) return false;
  return true;
}

function parseOptionalCoord(raw: unknown): number | null {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && !raw.trim()) return null;
  const n = typeof raw === 'number' ? raw : Number(String(raw).trim());
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : Number.NaN;
}

function sanitizeHttpsGalleryArray(raw: unknown, maxLen = 4): { ok: boolean; urls: string[] } {
  const arr = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [];
  if (arr.length > maxLen) return { ok: false, urls: [] };
  const urls: string[] = [];
  for (const item of arr) {
    if (!isValidPartnerHttpsUrl(item)) return { ok: false, urls: [] };
    urls.push(String(item).trim());
  }
  return { ok: true, urls };
}

export interface IPartnerAccessEvalInput {
  platformOs: string;
  session?: { access_token?: string | null; user?: { factors?: IMfaFactorSummary[] | null } | null } | null;
  user?: {
    id?: string | null;
    email?: string | null;
    email_confirmed_at?: string | null;
    confirmed_at?: string | null;
    factors?: IMfaFactorSummary[] | null;
    app_metadata?: { rol?: unknown; tipo_cuenta?: unknown; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
  } | null;
  profile?: { rol?: unknown; tipo_cuenta?: unknown; es_afiliado?: unknown; [k: string]: unknown } | null;
}

export function evaluatePartnerWebPortalAccess(input: IPartnerAccessEvalInput): IPartnerWebAccessDecision {
  if (input.platformOs !== 'web') return { status: 'redirect_native_root', allowed: false, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, reasonCode: 'native_platform' };
  if (!input.user?.id || !input.session) return { status: 'unauthenticated', allowed: false, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, reasonCode: 'missing_session' };
  const token = input.session.access_token;
  if (!isValidRealSupabaseJwt(token) || isPendingMfaGateActive()) return { status: 'invalid_jwt', allowed: false, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, reasonCode: 'non_jwt_token' };
  const claims = extractJwtClaimsSafe(token);
  const sub = typeof claims?.sub === 'string' ? claims.sub.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  const expOk = typeof claims?.exp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(claims.exp) && claims.exp * 1000 > Date.now();
  if (!claims || !sub || sub !== String(input.user.id).trim().toLowerCase() || !expOk) {
    return { status: 'invalid_jwt', allowed: false, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, reasonCode: 'non_jwt_token' };
  }
  const mfaCheck = doesSessionRequireMfaAal2({ access_token: token, user: { id: input.user.id, email: input.user.email, factors: input.user.factors || input.session.user?.factors || null } });
  if (mfaCheck) return { status: 'invalid_jwt', allowed: false, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, reasonCode: 'non_jwt_token' };

  const appMeta = input.user.app_metadata || {};
  const isConfirmedAdminEmail = Boolean(input.user.email_confirmed_at || input.user.confirmed_at);
  const isAdmin = hasAnyKineticMasterAdminRole(isConfirmedAdminEmail ? input.user.email : undefined, input.profile?.rol, input.profile?.tipo_cuenta, appMeta.rol, appMeta.tipo_cuenta);
  const isB2BOnly = !isAdmin && (hasAnyKineticB2BRole(input.profile?.rol, input.profile?.tipo_cuenta, appMeta.rol, appMeta.tipo_cuenta) || input.profile?.es_afiliado === true);
  if (!isAdmin && !isB2BOnly) return { status: 'blocked_athlete', allowed: false, isAdmin: false, isB2B: false, reasonCode: 'athlete_forbidden' };
  return { status: 'authorized', allowed: true, isAdmin, isB2B: true, reasonCode: 'ok' };
}

export function canActorManageAffiliateVenue(params: {
  actorUserId?: string | null;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  isB2B: boolean;
  targetOwnerId?: string | null;
}): boolean {
  if (params.isAdmin) return true;
  if (!params.isB2B) return false;
  const actor = String(params.actorUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const owner = String(params.targetOwnerId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return UUID_RE.test(actor) && UUID_RE.test(owner) && actor === owner;
}

export function isValidPartnerClabe18(raw: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || CSV_PREFIX_START_RE.test(raw)) return false;
  return CLABE_18_RE.test(raw);
}

export function normalizePartnerClabe18(raw: unknown): { ok: boolean; clabe: string } {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return { ok: true, clabe: '' };
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return { ok: false, clabe: '' };
  if (!raw.replace(/[\s\u00A0\uFEFF]/g, '')) return { ok: true, clabe: '' };
  if (CSV_PREFIX_START_RE.test(raw) || !CLABE_18_RE.test(raw)) return { ok: false, clabe: '' };
  return { ok: true, clabe: raw };
}

export function isValidPartnerEventPriceKc(raw: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw) && Number.isSafeInteger(raw) && raw >= 0 && raw % 10 === 0;
}

export function isValidPartnerHttpsUrl(raw: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = raw.replace(/^[\s\u00A0\uFEFF]+|[\s\u00A0\uFEFF]+$/g, '');
  return HTTPS_URL_RE.test(clean) && !/(<script|javascript:|vbscript:)/i.test(clean);
}

export function sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(
  raw: unknown,
  maxLen = 500,
  stripCsvPrefix = true
): string {
  let clean = String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\u00A0\uFEFF]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?(?:<\/script>|$)/gi, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>?/g, '')
    .replace(/(javascript|vbscript)\s*:/gi, '')
    .trim();
  if (stripCsvPrefix) {
    while (clean && CSV_PREFIX_CHAR_RE.test(clean)) {
      clean = clean.slice(1).trim();
    }
  }
  if (POISON_KEYS.has(clean.toLowerCase())) return '';
  return [...clean].slice(0, Math.max(1, maxLen)).join('').trim();
}

export function normalizePartnerWhatsapp10(raw: unknown): { ok: boolean; value: string } {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return { ok: true, value: '' };
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return { ok: false, value: '' };
  if (!raw.replace(/[\s\u00A0\uFEFF]/g, '')) return { ok: true, value: '' };
  if (CSV_PREFIX_START_RE.test(raw)) return { ok: false, value: '' };
  const check = validateStrictWhatsappPhone(raw);
  if (!check.valid || check.normalized10.length !== 10 || (check.digits.length !== 10 && !(check.digits.length === 12 && check.digits.startsWith('52')))) {
    return { ok: false, value: '' };
  }
  return { ok: true, value: check.normalized10 };
}

export function normalizePartnerSatRfc(raw: unknown): { ok: boolean; value: string } {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return { ok: true, value: '' };
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return { ok: false, value: '' };
  if (!raw.replace(/[\s\u00A0\uFEFF]/g, '')) return { ok: true, value: '' };
  if (CSV_PREFIX_START_RE.test(raw)) return { ok: false, value: '' };
  const up = raw.toUpperCase();
  if (!RFC_SAT_RE.test(up) || GENERIC_RFCS.has(up)) return { ok: false, value: '' };
  return { ok: true, value: up };
}

export function resolvePartnerRegimenFiscal(cleanRfc: string, csfValidada = false, isAdmin = false): RegimenFiscalB2B {
  if (!cleanRfc || GENERIC_RFCS.has(cleanRfc) || (!csfValidada && !isAdmin)) return 'sin_rfc';
  if (/^[A-ZÑ&]{3}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$/.test(cleanRfc)) return 'persona_moral';
  if (/^[A-ZÑ&]{4}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$/.test(cleanRfc)) return 'persona_fisica_con_rfc';
  return 'sin_rfc';
}

export function sanitizePartnerProfilePatch(
  rawPatch: unknown,
  isAdmin: boolean,
  options?: { currentCsfValidada?: boolean; currentRfc?: string | null }
): { ok: boolean; patch: IPartnerWebProfilePatch; error?: string } {
  const patch: IPartnerWebProfilePatch = {};
  if (!rawPatch || typeof rawPatch !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rawPatch)) {
    return { ok: false, patch, error: 'Payload de perfil inválido.' };
  }
  const obj = rawPatch as Record<string, unknown>;
  const hasKey = (k: string) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, k) && !POISON_KEYS.has(k);

  if (hasKey('nombre')) {
    const nombre = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.nombre, 120, true);
    if (nombre.length < 2) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'Nombre comercial inválido (mín. 2 caracteres).' };
    patch.nombre = nombre;
  }
  if (hasKey('disciplina')) patch.disciplina = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.disciplina, 60, true);
  if (hasKey('ubicacion')) patch.ubicacion = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.ubicacion, 240, true);
  if (hasKey('latitud') || hasKey('longitud')) {
    const lat = hasKey('latitud') ? parseOptionalCoord(obj.latitud) : Number.NaN;
    const lng = hasKey('longitud') ? parseOptionalCoord(obj.longitud) : Number.NaN;
    if (lat === null && lng === null) {
      patch.latitud = null;
      patch.longitud = null;
    } else if (!isValidPartnerGpsPair(lat, lng) || lat === null || lng === null) {
      return { ok: false, patch, error: 'Coordenadas GPS inválidas: bloqueado (0,0), NaN o fuera de rango.' };
    } else {
      patch.latitud = Number(lat.toFixed(6));
      patch.longitud = Number(lng.toFixed(6));
    }
  }
  if (hasKey('horarios')) patch.horarios = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.horarios, 240, true);
  if (hasKey('descripcion')) patch.descripcion = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.descripcion, 1200, true);
  if (hasKey('instagram')) {
    const igRaw = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.instagram, 64, false).replace(/^[=+\-|\s\u00A0\uFEFF]+/, '');
    if (!igRaw) {
      patch.instagram = '';
    } else if (/@@/.test(igRaw) || !/^@?[A-Za-z0-9._]{2,60}$/.test(igRaw)) {
      return { ok: false, patch, error: 'Instagram inválido: usa @usuario (2-60 caracteres).' };
    } else {
      patch.instagram = igRaw.startsWith('@') ? igRaw.toLowerCase() : `@${igRaw.toLowerCase()}`;
    }
  }
  if (hasKey('clabe_bancaria')) {
    const clabeRes = normalizePartnerClabe18(obj.clabe_bancaria);
    if (!clabeRes.ok) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'CLABE bancaria inválida: requiere exactamente 18 dígitos.' };
    patch.clabe_bancaria = clabeRes.clabe;
  }
  if (hasKey('whatsapp')) {
    const waRes = normalizePartnerWhatsapp10(obj.whatsapp);
    if (!waRes.ok) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'WhatsApp inválido: requiere 10 dígitos válidos.' };
    patch.whatsapp = waRes.value;
  }
  let cleanRfc = '';
  if (hasKey('rfc')) {
    const rfcRes = normalizePartnerSatRfc(obj.rfc);
    if (!rfcRes.ok) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'RFC inválido: debe cumplir el patrón SAT de 12 o 13 caracteres.' };
    cleanRfc = rfcRes.value;
    patch.rfc = cleanRfc;
  }
  if (hasKey('regimen_fiscal') || hasKey('rfc')) {
    const prevRfc = options?.currentRfc !== undefined ? String(options.currentRfc || '').trim().toUpperCase() : undefined;
    const effectiveCsf = !isAdmin && prevRfc !== undefined && cleanRfc !== prevRfc ? false : Boolean(options?.currentCsfValidada);
    patch.regimen_fiscal = resolvePartnerRegimenFiscal(cleanRfc, effectiveCsf, isAdmin);
  }
  if (hasKey('avatar_url')) {
    const av = String(obj.avatar_url ?? '').trim();
    if (av && !isValidPartnerHttpsUrl(av)) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'avatar_url debe usar protocolo https:// válido.' };
    patch.avatar_url = av || null;
  }
  if (hasKey('portada_url')) {
    const cov = String(obj.portada_url ?? '').trim();
    if (cov && !isValidPartnerHttpsUrl(cov)) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'portada_url debe usar protocolo https:// válido.' };
    patch.portada_url = cov || null;
  }
  if (hasKey('galeria')) {
    const galRes = sanitizeHttpsGalleryArray(obj.galeria, 4);
    if (!galRes.ok) return { ok: false, patch, error: 'La galería admite máximo 4 URLs HTTPS válidas.' };
    patch.galeria = galRes.urls;
  }
  if (hasKey('amenidades') && Array.isArray(obj.amenidades)) {
    patch.amenidades = obj.amenidades.map((item) => sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(item, 64, true)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 24);
  }
  if (isAdmin) {
    if (hasKey('estado')) patch.estado = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.estado, 24, true).toLowerCase();
    if (hasKey('verificado') && typeof obj.verificado === 'boolean') patch.verificado = obj.verificado;
    if (hasKey('csf_validada') && typeof obj.csf_validada === 'boolean') patch.csf_validada = obj.csf_validada;
    if (hasKey('estrellas_exclusividad')) patch.estrellas_exclusividad = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(obj.estrellas_exclusividad) || 4)));
    if (hasKey('strikes_operativos')) patch.strikes_operativos = Math.min(3, Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(obj.strikes_operativos) || 0)));
  }
  return { ok: true, patch };
}

export function filterAdminAffiliatesDirectory(
  affiliates: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow[],
  searchQuery: string,
  filterKey: AdminDirectoryFilterKey
): IPartnerWebAffiliateRow[] {
  const q = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(searchQuery, 80, false).toLowerCase();
  return (affiliates || []).filter((af) => {
    const st = String(af.estado || 'pendiente').toLowerCase().trim();
    const isSpec = Boolean(af.es_especialista) || String(af.categoria || '').toLowerCase().includes('especialista');
    const isActive = st === 'activo';
    if (filterKey === 'active' && !isActive) return false;
    if (filterKey === 'pending' && isActive) return false;
    if (filterKey === 'clubs' && isSpec) return false;
    if (filterKey === 'specialists' && !isSpec) return false;
    if (!q) return true;
    return [af.nombre, af.disciplina, af.ubicacion, af.categoria, af.email_contacto].map((v) => String(v || '').toLowerCase()).join(' ').includes(q);
  });
}

export function canPartnerMutateCatalog(params: {
  actorUserId?: string | null;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  isB2B: boolean;
  business?: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
}): { ok: boolean; reasonCode: 'ok' | 'missing_venue' | 'bola_forbidden' | 'venue_not_verified' } {
  const biz = params.business;
  if (!biz || !String(biz.nombre || '').trim()) return { ok: false, reasonCode: 'missing_venue' };
  if (params.isAdmin) return { ok: true, reasonCode: 'ok' };
  if (!canActorManageAffiliateVenue({ actorUserId: params.actorUserId, isAdmin: false, isB2B: params.isB2B, targetOwnerId: biz.propietario_id })) {
    return { ok: false, reasonCode: 'bola_forbidden' };
  }
  const st = String(biz.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!biz.verificado || st !== 'activo') return { ok: false, reasonCode: 'venue_not_verified' };
  return { ok: true, reasonCode: 'ok' };
}

export function sanitizePartnerServiceDraft(
  rawDraft: unknown,
  opts: { minRequiredSpots: number; minIsoDate?: string; isEditing?: boolean }
): { ok: boolean; draft?: IPartnerWebServiceDraft; error?: string } {
  if (!rawDraft || typeof rawDraft !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rawDraft)) return { ok: false, error: 'Payload de evento inválido.' };
  const obj = rawDraft as Record<string, unknown>;
  const nombre = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.nombre_servicio, 120, true);
  if (nombre.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: 'Título requerido (mín. 2 caracteres).' };
  const categoria = sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.categoria, 60, true);
  if (categoria.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: 'Disciplina / categoría requerida.' };
  const fecha = String(obj.fecha ?? '').trim();
  if (!isRealIsoCalendarDate(fecha)) return { ok: false, error: 'Fecha inválida (formato YYYY-MM-DD).' };
  if (!opts.isEditing && opts.minIsoDate && fecha < opts.minIsoDate) return { ok: false, error: 'No puedes publicar eventos en fechas pasadas.' };
  const hora = String(obj.hora_inicio ?? '').trim();
  if (!HHMM_24_RE.test(hora)) return { ok: false, error: 'Hora inválida (formato 24h HH:MM).' };
  const dur = typeof obj.duracion_minutos === 'number' ? obj.duracion_minutos : Number(String(obj.duracion_minutos ?? '').trim());
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(dur) || dur < 15 || dur > 480) return { ok: false, error: 'Duración inválida (15 a 480 min).' };
  const price = typeof obj.precio_kc === 'number' ? obj.precio_kc : typeof obj.precio_kc === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(obj.precio_kc.trim()) ? Number(obj.precio_kc.trim()) : NaN;
  if (!isValidPartnerEventPriceKc(price) || price > 50000) return { ok: false, error: 'Precio inválido: múltiplo exacto de 10 KC (0 a 50,000).' };

  const floorSpots = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(opts.minRequiredSpots) || 1));
  if (floorSpots > MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) return { ok: false, error: 'Piso de reservas excede el máximo de 50 estaciones.' };
  const rawCupo = obj.cupo_maximo !== undefined ? Number(obj.cupo_maximo) : floorSpots;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(rawCupo) || rawCupo < floorSpots || rawCupo > MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) {
    return { ok: false, error: `Aforo inválido: mínimo ${floorSpots} (reservas activas) y máximo ${MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS}.` };
  }

  const slRaw = obj.studio_layout && typeof obj.studio_layout === 'object' ? (obj.studio_layout as Partial<IStudioLayoutConfig>) : null;
  const eqType: StudioEquipmentType = slRaw?.equipmentType && VALID_EQ_TYPES.has(slRaw.equipmentType) ? slRaw.equipmentType : 'spot';
  const studio_layout =
    slRaw && Number(slRaw.rows) >= 1 && Number(slRaw.cols) >= 1
      ? clampStudioGridToMaxSpots(Number(slRaw.rows), Number(slRaw.cols), Array.isArray(slRaw.disabledCells) ? slRaw.disabledCells.map(String) : [], eqType)
      : buildGridForTotalSpots(rawCupo, eqType);
  if (studio_layout.totalSpots < floorSpots || studio_layout.totalSpots > MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) {
    return { ok: false, error: `La Sala 3D debe mantener al menos ${floorSpots} estaciones activas.` };
  }

  const freqRaw = (obj.frecuencia === undefined ? 'Única Vez' : String(obj.frecuencia).trim()) as PartnerEventFrequency;
  if (!VALID_FREQS.has(freqRaw)) return { ok: false, error: 'Frecuencia programada inválida.' };
  const estadoRaw = obj.estado === undefined ? 'aprobado' : String(obj.estado).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (estadoRaw !== 'aprobado' && estadoRaw !== 'pausado') return { ok: false, error: 'Estado de publicación inválido.' };
  const flashOn = Boolean(obj.es_venta_flash);
  const flashPct = flashOn ? Number(obj.descuento_flash_pct ?? 15) : 0;
  if (flashOn && (!Number.isSafeInteger(flashPct) || flashPct < 5 || flashPct > 50)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Descuento Flash inválido (5% a 50%).' };
  }
  const portada = String(obj.portada_url ?? '').trim();
  if (portada && !isValidPartnerHttpsUrl(portada)) return { ok: false, error: 'Portada debe usar URL https:// válida.' };
  const galRes = sanitizeHttpsGalleryArray(obj.galeria, 4);
  if (!galRes.ok) return { ok: false, error: 'Galería inválida (máx. 4 URLs https://).' };
  const galeria = galRes.urls;
  const splitMax: 2 | 3 | 4 = obj.split_max_personas === 2 ? 2 : obj.split_max_personas === 3 ? 3 : 4;
  return {
    ok: true,
    draft: {
      nombre_servicio: nombre,
      categoria,
      fecha,
      hora_inicio: hora,
      duracion_minutos: dur,
      instructor_nombre: sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.instructor_nombre, 80, true) || 'Coach Oficial Kinetic',
      ubicacion: sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.ubicacion, 240, true),
      precio_kc: price,
      cupo_maximo: studio_layout.totalSpots,
      frecuencia: freqRaw,
      descripcion: sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(obj.descripcion, 1200, true),
      estado: estadoRaw,
      es_venta_flash: flashOn,
      descuento_flash_pct: flashPct,
      split_escrow_enabled: Boolean(obj.split_escrow_enabled),
      split_max_personas: splitMax,
      portada_url: portada,
      galeria,
      studio_layout,
    },
  };
}

import { Platform } from 'react-native';

export const PARTNER_EVENT_FREQS: PartnerEventFrequency[] = ['Única Vez', 'Diario', 'Semanal', 'Mensual'];

export const PARTNER_EVENT_SPLIT_OPTS: (2 | 3 | 4)[] = [2, 3, 4];

export interface IPartnerEventFormState {

export function buildPartnerEventFormState(srv: IPartnerWebServiceRow | null, business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null): IPartnerEventFormState {
  const attrs = srv?.atributos && typeof srv.atributos === 'object' ? (srv.atributos as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  const cat = String(srv?.categoria || business?.disciplina || 'Fuerza');
  const title = String(srv?.nombre_servicio || srv?.titulo || '');
  const cupo = Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, Math.max(1, Number(srv?.cupo_maximo) || 12));
  const rawFreq = String(srv?.frecuencia || attrs.frecuencia || 'Única Vez') as PartnerEventFrequency;
  const freq: PartnerEventFrequency = PARTNER_EVENT_FREQS.includes(rawFreq) ? rawFreq : 'Única Vez';
  const rawDesc = String(attrs.descripcion || (srv as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.descripcion || '').replace(/\[Frecuencia Programada:.*?\]/gi, '').trim();
  const splitMaxRaw = Number(attrs.split_max_personas ?? attrs.max_division_personas ?? 4);
  return {
    nombre_servicio: title, categoria: cat, fecha: String(srv?.fecha || getMazatlanNowParts().isoDate).slice(0, 10),
    hora_inicio: String(srv?.hora_inicio || '08:00').slice(0, 5),
    duracion_minutos: String(srv?.duracion_minutos ?? attrs.duracion_minutos ?? 60),
    instructor_nombre: String(srv?.instructor_nombre || 'Coach Oficial Kinetic'),
    ubicacion: String(srv?.ubicacion || business?.ubicacion || ''), precio_kc: String(srv?.precio_kc ?? attrs.precio_kc ?? 200),
    cupo_maximo: String(cupo), frecuencia: freq, descripcion: rawDesc,
    estado: String(srv?.estado || '').toLowerCase() === 'pausado' ? 'pausado' : 'aprobado',
    es_venta_flash: Boolean(srv?.es_venta_flash),
    descuento_flash_pct: Math.min(50, Math.max(5, Number(srv?.descuento_flash_pct) || 15)),
    split_escrow_enabled: Boolean(attrs.split_escrow_enabled || attrs.permite_dividir_cuenta),
    split_max_personas: splitMaxRaw === 2 ? 2 : splitMaxRaw === 3 ? 3 : 4,
    portada_url: String(srv?.imagen_url || srv?.portada_url || attrs.imagen_url || attrs.portada_url || '').trim(),
    studio_layout: resolveDefaultStudioLayout(cat, cupo, srv?.studio_layout_json || attrs.studio_layout, title),
  };
}

export function validatePartnerWebBinaryImage(params: { bytes: Uint8Array; fileName: string; mimeType?: string }): { ok: boolean; contentType?: 'image/jpeg' | 'image/png' | 'image/webp'; ext?: 'jpg' | 'png' | 'webp'; reason?: string } {
  const check = validateSafeStorageImagePayload({ bytes: params.bytes, uriOrName: params.fileName, declaredMime: params.mimeType, maxBytes: AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES });
  if (!check.ok || !check.ext) return { ok: false, reason: check.reason || 'invalid_image' };
  if ((check.contentType !== 'image/jpeg' && check.contentType !== 'image/png' && check.contentType !== 'image/webp') || check.ext === 'heic') {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'disallowed_web_mime' };
  }
  return { ok: true, contentType: check.contentType, ext: check.ext };
}

export async function pickWebImageFileAsBytes(): Promise<IPickedWebImagePayload | null> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  return new Promise<IPickedWebImagePayload | null>((resolve, reject) => {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = 'image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp';
    input.style.display = 'none';
    let settled = false;
    let focusTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    const cleanup = () => {
      if (focusTimer) { clearTimeout(focusTimer); focusTimer = null; }
      input.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', onWindowFocus);
      if (input.parentNode) input.parentNode.removeChild(input);
    };
    const finishOk = (val: IPickedWebImagePayload | null) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true; cleanup(); resolve(val);
    };
    const finishErr = (err: Error) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true; cleanup(); reject(err);
    };
    const onWindowFocus = () => {
      if (focusTimer) clearTimeout(focusTimer);
      focusTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!settled && (!input.files || input.files.length === 0)) finishOk(null);
      }, 380);
    };
    const onChange = async () => {
      if (focusTimer) { clearTimeout(focusTimer); focusTimer = null; }
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) { finishOk(null); return; }
      if (file.size <= 0 || file.size > AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES) {
        finishErr(new Error('La imagen debe pesar más de 0 B y máximo 8 MB.'));
        return;
      }
      try {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
        if (bytes.byteLength <= 0 || bytes.byteLength > AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES) {
          finishErr(new Error('Archivo de imagen inválido o superior a 8 MB.'));
          return;
        }
        finishOk({ bytes, fileName: String(file.name || 'partner_media.jpg'), mimeType: String(file.type || '') });
      } catch (readErr: unknown) {
        finishErr(readErr instanceof Error ? readErr : new Error('No fue posible leer la imagen seleccionada.'));
      }
    };
    input.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    window.addEventListener('focus', onWindowFocus);
    document.body.appendChild(input);
    input.click();
  });
}

export async function framePartnerWebPickedImage(picked: IPickedWebImagePayload, slot: PartnerMediaSlotKind): Promise<IPickedWebImagePayload | null> {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof URL === 'undefined' || typeof Blob === 'undefined') return picked;
  const rawBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([picked.bytes as unknown as BlobPart], { type: picked.mimeType || 'image/jpeg' }));
  try {
    const framedUri = await openKineticImageFrame({
      uri: rawBlobUrl, aspect: slot === 'avatar' ? '1:1' : '16:9', lockAspect: slot !== 'gallery' && slot !== 'event',
      titleEs: slot === 'avatar' ? 'Logo Comercial (1:1)' : slot === 'cover' ? 'Portada de Sede (16:9)' : 'Encuadrar Imagen',
      titleEn: slot === 'avatar' ? 'Commercial Logo (1:1)' : slot === 'cover' ? 'Venue Cover (16:9)' : 'Frame Image',
    });
    if (!framedUri) return null;
    if (framedUri.startsWith('data:image/')) {
      const framedBytes = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(framedUri);
      if (framedBytes && framedBytes.byteLength > 0) return { bytes: framedBytes, fileName: 'kinetic_framed.jpg', mimeType: 'image/jpeg' };
    }
    return picked;
  } finally {
    try { URL.revokeObjectURL(rawBlobUrl); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
  }
}

export async function uploadPartnerImageToAvatarsBucket(params: { bytes: Uint8Array; fileName: string; mimeType: string; slot: PartnerMediaSlotKind; isAdmin: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const { bytes, fileName, mimeType, slot, isAdmin } = params;
  const check = validatePartnerWebBinaryImage({ bytes, fileName, mimeType });
  if (!check.ok || !check.contentType || !check.ext) {
    throw new Error(check.reason === 'file_too_large' ? 'La imagen excede el máximo de 8 MB permitido.' : 'Formato no permitido. Usa JPG, PNG o WEBP válido (<= 8 MB).');
  }
  const sessRes = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  let authUid = String(sessRes.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
  if (!authUid) {
    const refreshed = await supabase.auth.refreshSession().catch((refErr: unknown) => (refErr ? null : null));
    authUid = String(refreshed?.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
  }
  if (!UUID_RE.test(authUid)) throw new Error('Sesión autenticada requerida para subir imágenes.');

  const nonce = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  const buildPath = (uid: string) => `${uid}/b2b_${slot}_${Date.now()}_${nonce}.${check.ext}`;
  let storagePath = buildPath(authUid);
  const policyCheck = validateAvatarsBucketUpload({ objectName: storagePath, authUid, isMasterAdmin: isAdmin, mimeType: check.contentType, byteLength: bytes.byteLength });
  if (!policyCheck.ok) throw new Error('La ruta o tipo de archivo infringe las políticas del bucket avatars.');

  const uploadOpts = { contentType: check.contentType, cacheControl: '604800', upsert: false };
  let { error: upErr } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(storagePath, bytes, uploadOpts);
  if (upErr && /jwt|token|expired|unauthorized|row-level/i.test(String(upErr.message || ''))) {
    const refreshed = await supabase.auth.refreshSession().catch((refErr: unknown) => (refErr ? null : null));
    const refreshedUid = String(refreshed?.data?.session?.user?.id || '').trim();
    if (UUID_RE.test(refreshedUid)) {
      storagePath = buildPath(refreshedUid);
      upErr = (await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(storagePath, bytes, uploadOpts)).error;
    }
  }
  if (upErr) throw new Error(upErr.message || 'Error subiendo archivo a Supabase Storage.');

  const { data: pubData } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(storagePath);
  const publicUrl = String(pubData?.publicUrl || '').trim();
  if (!isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(publicUrl) || !isValidPartnerHttpsUrl(publicUrl)) {
    throw new Error('La URL pública generada no cumple protocolo HTTPS seguro.');
  }
  return publicUrl;
}

function extractAuthorizedAvatarPath(publicUrl: string | null | undefined, authUid: string | null | undefined, isAdmin: boolean): string | null {
  const cleanUrl = String(publicUrl || '').trim();
  const markerIdx = cleanUrl.indexOf(AVATARS_PUBLIC_MARKER);
  if (markerIdx < 0) return null;
  const rawObjectPath = decodeURIComponent(cleanUrl.slice(markerIdx + AVATARS_PUBLIC_MARKER.length).split(/[?#]/)[0] || '').trim();
  if (!rawObjectPath || rawObjectPath.includes('..') || rawObjectPath.startsWith('/')) return null;
  const uid = String(authUid || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const ownerFolder = rawObjectPath.split('/')[0]?.toLowerCase() || '';
  if (!isAdmin && (!UUID_RE.test(uid) || ownerFolder !== uid)) return null;
  return rawObjectPath;
}

export async function removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectsBatchSafe(publicUrls: Iterable<string | null | undefined>, authUid: string | null | undefined, isAdmin = false): Promise<number> {
  const validPaths = [...new Set(Array.from(publicUrls, (u) => extractAuthorizedAvatarPath(u, authUid, isAdmin)).filter((p): p is string => Boolean(p)))];
  if (validPaths.length === 0) return 0;
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').remove(validPaths);
    return error ? 0 : validPaths.length;
  } catch (removeErr: unknown) {
    return removeErr instanceof Error ? 0 : 0;
  }
}

export async function removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectSafe(publicUrl: string | null | undefined, authUid: string | null | undefined, isAdmin = false): Promise<void> {
  await removePartnerOwnedAvatarObjectsBatchSafe([publicUrl], authUid, isAdmin);
}

export function computeServiceMinRequiredSpots(
  service: Pick<IPartnerWebServiceRow, 'id' | 'nombre_servicio' | 'titulo' | 'cupo_actual' | 'fecha'> | null | undefined,
  activeReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[],
  completedReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[] = [],
  extraSpots: number[] = []
): { activeBookedCount: number; highestBookedSpot: number; minRequiredSpots: number; occupiedSpots: number[] } {
  const sid = String(service?.id || '').trim();
  const sName = String(service?.nombre_servicio || service?.titulo || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const targetDate = String(service?.fecha || '').slice(0, 10);
  const matchesSrv = (r: IPartnerWebReservationRow) => {
    const rSid = String(r?.servicio_id || '').trim();
    if (sid && rSid) return rSid === sid;
    const rNames = [r?.servicio, r?.nombre_servicio, r?.titulo_clase].map((n) => String(n || '').trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
    return Boolean(sName && rNames.includes(sName));
  };
  const matchedActive = (activeReservations || []).filter((r) => ACTIVE_RES_STATES.has(String(r?.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase()) && matchesSrv(r));
  const matchedCompleted = (completedReservations || []).filter((r) => {
    if (String(r?.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'completada' || !matchesSrv(r)) return false;
    const rDate = String(r?.fecha_clase || r?.fecha_hora || '').slice(0, 10);
    return !targetDate || !rDate || rDate === targetDate;
  });
  const occSet = new Set<number>();
  for (const r of [...matchedActive, ...matchedCompleted]) {
    const sp = Math.round(Number(r?.spot_number) || 0);
    if (sp > 0) occSet.add(sp);
  }
  for (const sp of extraSpots) {
    const n = Math.round(Number(sp) || 0);
    if (n > 0) occSet.add(n);
  }
  const highestBookedSpot = occSet.size > 0 ? Math.max(...occSet) : 0;
  const activeBookedCount = Math.max(matchedActive.length, Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(service?.cupo_actual) || 0)));
  return {
    activeBookedCount, highestBookedSpot,
    minRequiredSpots: Math.max(1, activeBookedCount, highestBookedSpot),
    occupiedSpots: Array.from(occSet).sort((a, b) => a - b),
  };
}

export function preservesBookedSpotPositions(prev: IStudioLayoutConfig, next: IStudioLayoutConfig, minSpots: number, occupiedSpots?: Set<number>): boolean {
  const effectiveMin = Math.max(minSpots, ...(occupiedSpots && occupiedSpots.size > 0 ? Array.from(occupiedSpots) : [1]));
  if (next.totalSpots < effectiveMin || next.totalSpots > MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) return false;
  if (!occupiedSpots || occupiedSpots.size === 0) return true;
  const mapOf = (cfg: IStudioLayoutConfig) => {
    const dis = new Set(cfg.disabledCells || []), m = new Map<number, string>();
    for (let r = 0, n = 0; r < cfg.rows; r++) for (let c = 0; c < cfg.cols; c++) if (!dis.has(`${r}-${c}`)) m.set(++n, `${r}-${c}`);
    return m;
  };
  const prevM = mapOf(prev), nextM = mapOf(next);
  for (const sp of occupiedSpots) if (prevM.has(sp) && nextM.get(sp) !== prevM.get(sp)) return false;
  return true;
}

export function assertServiceBelongsToBusiness(
  service: Pick<IPartnerWebServiceRow, 'id' | 'afiliado_id' | 'negocio_nombre'> | null | undefined,
  business: Pick<IPartnerWebAffiliateRow, 'id' | 'nombre'> | null | undefined
): void {
  if (!service?.id) throw new Error('Experiencia no encontrada.');
  const srvAfId = String(service.afiliado_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const bizId = String(business?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (srvAfId) {
    if (!UUID_RE.test(srvAfId) || !UUID_RE.test(bizId) || srvAfId !== bizId) {
      throw new Error('BOLA_FORBIDDEN: Esta experiencia no pertenece a la sede activa.');
    }
    return;
  }
  const srvNeg = String(service.negocio_nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const bizNeg = String(business?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!srvNeg || !bizNeg || srvNeg !== bizNeg) {
    throw new Error('BOLA_FORBIDDEN: Esta experiencia no pertenece a la sede activa.');
  }
}

function assertCatalogWriteAccess(params: { actorUserId: string; isAdmin: boolean; isB2B: boolean; business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null }) {
  const decision = canPartnerMutateCatalog(params);
  if (decision.ok) return;
  if (decision.reasonCode === 'missing_venue') throw new Error('Selecciona o activa una sede antes de modificar el catálogo.');
  if (decision.reasonCode === 'venue_not_verified') throw new Error('Tu sede debe estar activa y verificada por Kinetic para publicar o editar eventos.');
  throw new Error('Sin permisos B2B para modificar eventos de esta sede.');
}

export async function savePartnerWebEventService(params: {
  actorUserId: string; isAdmin: boolean; isB2B: boolean; business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null;
  editingService?: IPartnerWebServiceRow | null; activeReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[];
  completedReservations?: IPartnerWebReservationRow[]; rawDraft: unknown;
}): Promise<IPartnerWebServiceRow | null> {
  const { actorUserId, isAdmin, isB2B, business, editingService, activeReservations, completedReservations = [], rawDraft } = params;
  assertCatalogWriteAccess({ actorUserId, isAdmin, isB2B, business });
  if (editingService) assertServiceBelongsToBusiness(editingService, business);
  const floor = editingService ? computeServiceMinRequiredSpots(editingService, activeReservations, completedReservations).minRequiredSpots : 1;
  const minIsoDate = editingService?.id ? undefined : getMazatlanNowParts().isoDate;
  const parsed = sanitizePartnerServiceDraft(rawDraft, { minRequiredSpots: floor, minIsoDate, isEditing: Boolean(editingService?.id) });
  if (!parsed.ok || !parsed.draft) throw new Error(parsed.error || 'Formulario de experiencia inválido.');

  const d = parsed.draft;
  const prevAttrs = editingService?.atributos && typeof editingService.atributos === 'object' ? editingService.atributos : {};
  const resolvedLoc = d.ubicacion || sanitizePartnerTextAntiXss(business?.ubicacion || '', 240, true);
  const resolvedCover = d.portada_url || d.galeria[0] || '';
  const mergedGallery = d.portada_url ? [d.portada_url, ...d.galeria.filter((u) => u !== d.portada_url)].slice(0, 4) : d.galeria;
  const atributos: Record<string, unknown> = {
    ...prevAttrs, studio_layout: d.studio_layout, frecuencia: d.frecuencia, duracion_minutos: d.duracion_minutos,
    precio_kc: d.precio_kc, ubicacion: resolvedLoc, galeria: mergedGallery,
    split_escrow_enabled: d.split_escrow_enabled, split_max_personas: d.split_max_personas,
    permite_dividir_cuenta: d.split_escrow_enabled, max_division_personas: d.split_max_personas,
  };
  if (resolvedCover) { atributos.portada_url = resolvedCover; atributos.imagen_url = resolvedCover; }
  else { delete atributos.portada_url; delete atributos.imagen_url; }

  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    ...(business?.id && UUID_RE.test(business.id) ? { afiliado_id: business.id } : {}),
    negocio_nombre: String(business?.nombre || '').trim(),
    nombre_servicio: d.nombre_servicio, titulo: d.nombre_servicio, categoria: d.categoria, fecha: d.fecha,
    hora_inicio: d.hora_inicio, duracion_minutos: d.duracion_minutos, instructor_nombre: d.instructor_nombre,
    ubicacion: resolvedLoc, cupo_maximo: d.studio_layout.totalSpots, precio_kc: d.precio_kc, frecuencia: d.frecuencia,
    descripcion: `${d.descripcion} [Frecuencia Programada: ${d.frecuencia}]`.trim(), estado: d.estado,
    es_venta_flash: d.es_venta_flash, descuento_flash_pct: d.es_venta_flash ? d.descuento_flash_pct : 0,
    galeria: mergedGallery, portada_url: resolvedCover || null, imagen_url: resolvedCover || null,
    studio_layout_json: d.studio_layout, atributos,
    ...(isValidPartnerGpsPair(business?.latitud, business?.longitud)
      ? { latitud: Number(business?.latitud), longitud: Number(business?.longitud) }
      : {}),
  };

  const saved = editingService?.id ? await terminalService.updateService(editingService.id, payload) : await terminalService.createService(payload);
  const savedRow = saved && typeof saved === 'object' ? (saved as unknown as IPartnerWebServiceRow) : null;
  const savedId = String(savedRow?.id || editingService?.id || '').trim();
  if (savedId) { await saveStudioLayoutLocal(savedId, d.studio_layout); await syncStudioLayoutToCloud(savedId, d.studio_layout); }
  return savedRow || editingService || null;
}

export async function savePartnerWebStudioLayoutOnly(params: { actorUserId: string; isAdmin: boolean; isB2B: boolean; business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null; service: IPartnerWebServiceRow; activeReservations: IPartnerWebReservationRow[]; completedReservations?: IPartnerWebReservationRow[]; layout: IStudioLayoutConfig }): Promise<void> {
  const { actorUserId, isAdmin, isB2B, business, service, activeReservations, completedReservations = [], layout } = params;
  assertCatalogWriteAccess({ actorUserId, isAdmin, isB2B, business });
  assertServiceBelongsToBusiness(service, business);
  const { minRequiredSpots } = computeServiceMinRequiredSpots(service, activeReservations, completedReservations);
  if (layout.totalSpots < minRequiredSpots || layout.totalSpots > MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) throw new Error(`El mapa 3D requiere mínimo ${minRequiredSpots} estaciones (reservas activas) y máximo 50.`);
  const prevAttrs = service.atributos && typeof service.atributos === 'object' ? service.atributos : {};
  await terminalService.updateService(service.id, { cupo_maximo: layout.totalSpots, studio_layout_json: layout, atributos: { ...prevAttrs, studio_layout: layout } });
  await saveStudioLayoutLocal(service.id, layout);
  await syncStudioLayoutToCloud(service.id, layout);
}

export async function togglePartnerWebEventState(params: {
  actorUserId: string; isAdmin: boolean; isB2B: boolean; business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null; service: IPartnerWebServiceRow;
}): Promise<'aprobado' | 'pausado'> {
  assertCatalogWriteAccess(params);
  assertServiceBelongsToBusiness(params.service, params.business);
  const nextState: 'aprobado' | 'pausado' = String(params.service.estado || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'pausado' ? 'aprobado' : 'pausado';
  await terminalService.updateService(params.service.id, { estado: nextState });
  return nextState;
}

export async function deletePartnerWebEventService(params: {
  actorUserId: string; isAdmin: boolean; isB2B: boolean; business: IPartnerWebAffiliateRow | null; service: IPartnerWebServiceRow;
}): Promise<void> {
  assertCatalogWriteAccess(params);
  assertServiceBelongsToBusiness(params.service, params.business);
  if (!UUID_RE.test(String(params.service.id || '').trim())) throw new Error('Identificador de experiencia inválido.');
  await terminalService.deleteService(params.service.id);
}

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile,
  isMasterAdminProfileRecord,
} from './kineticAthleteDeduplication';

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const POISON_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);
const NON_ATHLETE_ROLE_RE = /\b(socio|afiliado|club|especialista|admin|administrador|fundador|ceo|b2b|operador|staff|negocio|estadio)\b/i;
const NON_ATHLETE_PHRASE_RE = /(partner[\s_-]*b2b|kinetic[\s_-]*oficial|kinetic[\s_-]*official|sede[\s_-]*kinetic)/i;
const GENERIC_SELF_NAMES = new Set([
  '', 'atleta', 'athlete', 'atleta kinetic', 'kinetic athlete', 'aliado kinetic', 'usuario', 'user',
]);

type DynamicRow = Record<string, unknown>;

const normSplitText = (val?: unknown): string =>
  String(val ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

export interface IFilterEligibleSplitAthletesContext {
  myUserId?: string | null;
  myEmail?: string | null;
  myName?: string | null;
  b2bOwnerIds?: Iterable<string>;
  b2bNames?: Iterable<string>;
  allyIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

export interface ISplitInviteAthlete {
  id: string;
  nombre: string;
  avatar_url?: string | null;
  nivel?: string | null;
  isAlly?: boolean;
}

const hasDisallowedRoleOrLabel = (raw?: unknown): boolean => {
  const txt = normSplitText(raw);
  if (!txt) return false;
  return NON_ATHLETE_ROLE_RE.test(txt) || NON_ATHLETE_PHRASE_RE.test(txt);
};

export const filterEligibleSplitInviteAthletes = (
  rows: unknown,
  ctx: IFilterEligibleSplitAthletesContext = {}
): ISplitInviteAthlete[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [];
  const myIdLow = String(ctx.myUserId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myEmailLow = String(ctx.myEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const myNameNorm = normSplitText(ctx.myName);
  const canMatchSelfName = myNameNorm.length >= 3 && !GENERIC_SELF_NAMES.has(myNameNorm);

  const b2bOwnerSet = new Set<string>();
  if (ctx.b2bOwnerIds) {
    for (const rawId of ctx.b2bOwnerIds) {
      const clean = String(rawId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (clean && !POISON_KEYS.has(clean)) b2bOwnerSet.add(clean);
    }
  }

  const b2bNameSet = new Set<string>(['kinetic oficial', 'kinetic official', 'sede kinetic', 'partner b2b']);
  if (ctx.b2bNames) {
    for (const rawNm of ctx.b2bNames) {
      const cleanNm = normSplitText(rawNm);
      if (cleanNm && !POISON_KEYS.has(cleanNm)) b2bNameSet.add(cleanNm);
    }
  }

  const out: ISplitInviteAthlete[] = [];
  const seenIds = new Set<string>();

  for (const item of rows) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
    const row = item as DynamicRow;
    const id = String(row.id ?? '').trim();
    const idLow = id.toLowerCase();
    if (!id || POISON_KEYS.has(idLow) || seenIds.has(idLow)) continue;
    if (isDeactivatedOrAnonymousProfile(row) || isMasterAdminProfileRecord(row)) continue;

    if (myIdLow && idLow === myIdLow) continue;
    const rowEmailLow = String(row.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (myEmailLow && rowEmailLow && rowEmailLow === myEmailLow) continue;

    const rawName = String(row.nombre ?? '').trim();
    const nameNorm = normSplitText(rawName);
    if (POISON_KEYS.has(nameNorm)) continue;
    if (canMatchSelfName && nameNorm === myNameNorm) continue;

    if (row.es_afiliado === true || row.es_b2b === true) continue;
    const ownerLow = String(row.propietario_id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (b2bOwnerSet.has(idLow) || (ownerLow && b2bOwnerSet.has(ownerLow))) continue;
    if (nameNorm && (b2bNameSet.has(nameNorm) || NON_ATHLETE_PHRASE_RE.test(nameNorm))) continue;

    if (
      hasDisallowedRoleOrLabel(row.rol) ||
      hasDisallowedRoleOrLabel(row.tipo_cuenta) ||
      hasDisallowedRoleOrLabel(row.nivel) ||
      hasDisallowedRoleOrLabel(row.categoria)
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    seenIds.add(idLow);
    out.push({
      id,
      nombre: rawName || 'Atleta Kinetic',
      avatar_url: typeof row.avatar_url === 'string' ? row.avatar_url : null,
      nivel: typeof row.nivel === 'string' && row.nivel ? row.nivel : 'Acceso Base',
      isAlly: Boolean(ctx.allyIds?.has(id) || row.isAlly),
    });
  }
  return out;
};

const fetchB2BFilterSets = async (): Promise<{ b2bOwnerIds: Set<string>; b2bNames: Set<string> }> => {
  const b2bOwnerIds = new Set<string>();
  const b2bNames = new Set<string>();
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('afiliados').select('propietario_id, nombre').limit(200);
    ((data as DynamicRow[] | null) || []).forEach((af) => {
      const pid = String(af?.propietario_id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const nm = normSplitText(af?.nombre);
      if (UUID_RE.test(pid)) b2bOwnerIds.add(pid);
      if (nm) b2bNames.add(nm);
    });
  } catch {}
  return { b2bOwnerIds, b2bNames };
};

const enrichCandidatesWithProfileRoles = async (rows: DynamicRow[]): Promise<DynamicRow[]> => {
  const ids = Array.from(
    new Set(rows.map((r) => String(r?.id || '').trim()).filter((id) => UUID_RE.test(id)))
  ).slice(0, 80);
  if (ids.length === 0) return rows;
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('perfiles').select('id, rol, tipo_cuenta').in('id', ids);
    if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) return rows;
    const roleMap = new Map<string, DynamicRow>(
      (data as DynamicRow[]).map((p) => [String(p.id || '').trim(), p])
    );
    return rows.map((r) => {
      const extra = roleMap.get(String(r?.id || '').trim());
      return extra ? { ...r, rol: r?.rol ?? extra.rol, tipo_cuenta: r?.tipo_cuenta ?? extra.tipo_cuenta } : r;
    });
  } catch {
    return rows;
  }
};

const fetchAllyIdSetForUser = async (userId: string): Promise<Set<string>> => {
  const allyIds = new Set<string>();
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_RE.test(uid)) return allyIds;
  try {
    const [myTeamsRes, dmRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('equipo_miembros').select('equipo_id').eq('usuario_id', uid).in('estado', ['activo', 'aceptado']).limit(20),
      supabase.from('mensajes_directos').select('sender_id, recipient_id').or(`sender_id.eq.${uid},recipient_id.eq.${uid}`).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(30),
    ]);
    const teamIds = ((myTeamsRes.data as DynamicRow[] | null) || [])
      .map((r) => String(r?.equipo_id || '').trim())
      .filter((id) => UUID_RE.test(id));
    if (teamIds.length > 0) {
      const { data: teamMembers } = await supabase
        .from('equipo_miembros')
        .select('usuario_id')
        .in('equipo_id', teamIds)
        .in('estado', ['activo', 'aceptado'])
        .limit(80);
      ((teamMembers as DynamicRow[] | null) || []).forEach((m) => {
        const mid = String(m?.usuario_id || '').trim();
        if (UUID_RE.test(mid) && mid !== uid) allyIds.add(mid);
      });
    }
    ((dmRes.data as DynamicRow[] | null) || []).forEach((d) => {
      const s = String(d?.sender_id || '').trim();
      const r = String(d?.recipient_id || '').trim();
      if (UUID_RE.test(s) && s !== uid) allyIds.add(s);
      if (UUID_RE.test(r) && r !== uid) allyIds.add(r);
    });
  } catch {}
  return allyIds;
};

const queryPublicProfilesSafe = async (opts: { pattern?: string; ids?: string[]; limitCount?: number }): Promise<DynamicRow[]> => {
  const lim = opts.limitCount ?? 60;
  let pubQ = supabase.from('perfiles_publicos').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel, radar_publico');
  if (opts.pattern) pubQ = pubQ.ilike('nombre', opts.pattern);
  if (opts.ids?.length) pubQ = pubQ.in('id', opts.ids);
  const pubRes = await pubQ.limit(lim);
  if (!pubRes.error && Array.isArray(pubRes.data)) return pubRes.data as DynamicRow[];
  let fbQ = supabase.from('perfiles').select('id, nombre, avatar_url, nivel, rol, tipo_cuenta, radar_publico').eq('radar_publico', true);
  if (opts.pattern) fbQ = fbQ.ilike('nombre', opts.pattern);
  if (opts.ids?.length) fbQ = fbQ.in('id', opts.ids);
  const fbRes = await fbQ.limit(lim);
  return (fbRes.data as DynamicRow[] | null) || [];
};

export const loadSplitEscrowDirectory = async (
  userId?: string | null,
  userMeta?: { myEmail?: string | null; myName?: string | null }
): Promise<ISplitInviteAthlete[]> => {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  const [allyIds, b2bSets, profiles] = await Promise.all([
    uid ? fetchAllyIdSetForUser(uid) : Promise.resolve(new Set<string>()),
    fetchB2BFilterSets(),
    queryPublicProfilesSafe({ limitCount: 60 }),
  ]);
  const filterCtx: IFilterEligibleSplitAthletesContext = {
    myUserId: uid, myEmail: userMeta?.myEmail, myName: userMeta?.myName,
    b2bOwnerIds: b2bSets.b2bOwnerIds, b2bNames: b2bSets.b2bNames, allyIds,
  };
  const enrichedMain = await enrichCandidatesWithProfileRoles(profiles);
  const byId = new Map<string, ISplitInviteAthlete>(
    filterEligibleSplitInviteAthletes(enrichedMain, filterCtx).map((item) => [item.id, item])
  );
  const missingAllyIds = Array.from(allyIds).filter((id) => !byId.has(id)).slice(0, 25);
  if (missingAllyIds.length > 0) {
    try {
      const missingData = await queryPublicProfilesSafe({ ids: missingAllyIds, limitCount: 25 });
      const enrichedMissing = await enrichCandidatesWithProfileRoles(missingData);
      filterEligibleSplitInviteAthletes(enrichedMissing, filterCtx).forEach((item) => {
        byId.set(item.id, { ...item, isAlly: true });
      });
    } catch {}
  }
  return Array.from(byId.values()).sort((a, b) => {
    if (Boolean(a.isAlly) !== Boolean(b.isAlly)) return a.isAlly ? -1 : 1;
    return a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre);
  });
};

export const searchPublicAthletesForSplit = async (
  query: string,
  userId?: string | null,
  knownAllyIds?: Set<string>,
  userMeta?: { myEmail?: string | null; myName?: string | null }
): Promise<ISplitInviteAthlete[]> => {
  const clean = String(query || '').trim();
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return loadSplitEscrowDirectory(uid, userMeta);
  const pattern = `%${clean.replace(/[%_]/g, '')}%`;
  const [b2bSets, rows] = await Promise.all([
    fetchB2BFilterSets(),
    queryPublicProfilesSafe({ pattern, limitCount: 35 }),
  ]);
  const enriched = await enrichCandidatesWithProfileRoles(rows);
  return filterEligibleSplitInviteAthletes(enriched, {
    myUserId: uid, myEmail: userMeta?.myEmail, myName: userMeta?.myName,
    b2bOwnerIds: b2bSets.b2bOwnerIds, b2bNames: b2bSets.b2bNames, allyIds: knownAllyIds,
  });
};

    // === src/services/splitEscrowInvitesService.ts === //
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession } from './kineticSessionReconciler';
import {
  filterEligibleSplitInviteAthletes,
  IFilterEligibleSplitAthletesContext,
  ISplitInviteAthlete,
  loadSplitEscrowDirectory,
  searchPublicAthletesForSplit,
} from './splitEscrowCandidatesHelper';

export {
  filterEligibleSplitInviteAthletes,
  IFilterEligibleSplitAthletesContext,
  ISplitInviteAthlete,
  loadSplitEscrowDirectory,
  searchPublicAthletesForSplit,
};

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
type DynamicRow = Record<string, unknown>;

export interface IPendingSplitEscrowInvite {
  id: string;
  reserva_id: string;
  anfitrion_id: string;
  anfitrion_nombre: string;
  anfitrion_avatar?: string | null;
  invitado_id: string;
  invitado_nombre?: string | null;
  monto_kc_parte: number;
  monto_liquidado_kc?: number;
  reembolsada?: boolean;
  estado: 'pendiente' | 'aceptada' | 'rechazada' | 'cancelada' | string;
  created_at: string;
  servicio_nombre: string;
  negocio_nombre: string;
  fecha_clase?: string | null;
  hora_inicio?: string | null;
  spot_number?: number | null;
}

export const quantizeSplitEscrowShare10Kc = (montoEscrowKc: number, splitCount: number): number => {
  const cleanEscrow = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(montoEscrowKc) || 0));
  const safeSplit = Math.min(4, Math.max(2, Math.floor(Number(splitCount) || 2)));
  if (cleanEscrow < 10) return 0;
  return Math.floor(cleanEscrow / safeSplit / 10) * 10;
};

export interface ISplitSimulationInput {
  hostInitialBalance: number;
  guestInitialBalances: number[];
  guestIsB2BFlags?: boolean[];
  escrowTotalKc: number;
  splitCount: number;
  acceptFlags: boolean[];
  cancelWithRefund: boolean;
}

export interface ISplitSimulationResult {
  shareKc: number;
  hostFinalBalance: number;
  guestFinalBalances: number[];
  hostNetRefundedKc: number;
  guestsRefundedKc: number;
  escrowRetainedKc: number;
  totalSystemDelta: number;
}

export const simulateSplitEscrow1NSettlement = (input: ISplitSimulationInput): ISplitSimulationResult => {
  const safeSplit = Math.min(4, Math.max(2, Math.floor(Number(input.splitCount) || 2)));
  const escrow = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input.escrowTotalKc) / 10) * 10);
  const shareKc = quantizeSplitEscrowShare10Kc(escrow, safeSplit);
  const hostStart = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.hostInitialBalance) || 0));
  if (hostStart < escrow) throw new Error('SALDO_INSUFICIENTE_ANFITRION');

  let hostBal = hostStart - escrow;
  const guestBalances = input.guestInitialBalances.slice(0, safeSplit - 1).map((b) => Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(b) || 0)));
  const acceptedPaid: number[] = guestBalances.map(() => 0);

  guestBalances.forEach((bal, idx) => {
    const wantsAccept = Boolean(input.acceptFlags[idx]);
    const isB2B = Boolean(input.guestIsB2BFlags?.[idx]);
    if (!wantsAccept || isB2B || shareKc <= 0 || bal < shareKc) return;
    guestBalances[idx] -= shareKc;
    hostBal += shareKc;
    acceptedPaid[idx] = shareKc;
  });

  const sumAccepted = acceptedPaid.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n, 0);
  let hostNetRefundedKc = 0;
  let guestsRefundedKc = 0;
  let escrowRetainedKc = escrow;

  if (input.cancelWithRefund) {
    acceptedPaid.forEach((paid, idx) => {
      if (paid > 0) {
        guestBalances[idx] += paid;
        guestsRefundedKc += paid;
      }
    });
    hostNetRefundedKc = Math.max(0, escrow - guestsRefundedKc);
    hostBal += hostNetRefundedKc;
    escrowRetainedKc = 0;
  }

  const startSum = hostStart + input.guestInitialBalances.slice(0, safeSplit - 1).reduce((a, b) => a + Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(b) || 0)), 0);
  const endSum = hostBal + guestBalances.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) + escrowRetainedKc;
  return {
    shareKc,
    hostFinalBalance: hostBal,
    guestFinalBalances: guestBalances,
    hostNetRefundedKc,
    guestsRefundedKc,
    escrowRetainedKc,
    totalSystemDelta: endSum - startSum,
  };
};

export const resolveActiveReservaIdForEvent = async (
  userId?: string | null,
  eventId?: string | number | null,
  title?: string | null
): Promise<string | null> => {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_RE.test(uid)) return null;
  const sid = String(eventId || '').trim();
  try {
    let q = supabase
      .from('reservas')
      .select('id')
      .eq('usuario_id', uid)
      .in('estado', ['confirmada', 'activa', 'pendiente'])
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1);
    if (UUID_RE.test(sid)) q = q.eq('servicio_id', sid);
    else if (title) q = q.eq('servicio', String(title).trim());
    const { data } = await q;
    const found = String((data as DynamicRow[] | null)?.[0]?.id || '').trim();
    return UUID_RE.test(found) ? found : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const createSplitEscrowInvites = async (params: {
  reservaId?: string | null;
  eventId?: string | number | null;
  title?: string | null;
  anfitrionId: string;
  invitados: ISplitInviteAthlete[];
  montoKcParte: number;
}): Promise<{ insertedCount: number; resolvedReservaId: string | null; requiresReserva: boolean }> => {
  const uid = String(params.anfitrionId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_RE.test(uid)) throw new Error('Sesión requerida para enviar invitaciones Kinetic.');
  const jwtCheck = await reconcileRealSupabaseJwtSession(supabase, 3500);
  const authUid = String(jwtCheck.user?.id || '').trim();
  if (jwtCheck.status !== 'valid' || !authUid || authUid !== uid) {
    throw new Error('No autorizado para enviar invitaciones a nombre de otro atleta.');
  }
  const cleanGuestIds = Array.from(
    new Set(
      (Array.isArray(params.invitados) ? params.invitados : [])
        .map((g) => String(g?.id || '').trim())
        .filter((gid) => UUID_RE.test(gid) && gid.toLowerCase() !== authUid.toLowerCase())
    )
  ).slice(0, 3);
  if (cleanGuestIds.length === 0) throw new Error('Selecciona al menos un aliado o atleta válido para invitar.');

  let reservaId = UUID_RE.test(String(params.reservaId || '').trim()) ? String(params.reservaId).trim() : null;
  if (!reservaId) reservaId = await resolveActiveReservaIdForEvent(authUid, params.eventId, params.title);
  if (!reservaId) return { insertedCount: 0, resolvedReservaId: null, requiresReserva: true };

  const { data: reservaRow } = await supabase
    .from('reservas')
    .select('id, usuario_id, precio_kc, monto_escrow, split_count')
    .eq('id', reservaId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!reservaRow || String(reservaRow.usuario_id || '').trim() !== authUid) {
    throw new Error('Solo el titular de la reserva puede emitir invitaciones Split-Escrow.');
  }
  const rawSplit = Number(reservaRow.split_count) || 1;
  const safeDbSplit = Math.min(
    4,
    Math.max(2, rawSplit >= 2 ? Math.max(rawSplit, cleanGuestIds.length + 1) : cleanGuestIds.length + 1)
  );
  const dbEscrow = Math.max(
    0,
    Number(reservaRow.monto_escrow) || Math.round((Number(reservaRow.precio_kc) || 0) * 0.4)
  );
  const maxShare = quantizeSplitEscrowShare10Kc(dbEscrow, safeDbSplit);
  const reqShare = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Number(params.montoKcParte) || 0) / 10) * 10);
  const montoParte =
    dbEscrow > 0 ? (reqShare > 0 ? Math.min(maxShare, reqShare) : maxShare) : reqShare;

  const payload = cleanGuestIds.map((guestUid) => ({
    reserva_id: reservaId,
    anfitrion_id: authUid,
    invitado_id: guestUid,
    invitado_email: null,
    monto_kc_parte: montoParte,
    estado: 'pendiente',
  }));
  const { error } = await supabase.from('split_escrow_invitaciones').insert(payload);
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message || 'No se pudieron enviar las invitaciones Kinetic.');
  return { insertedCount: payload.length, resolvedReservaId: reservaId, requiresReserva: false };
};

export const fetchMySplitEscrowInvites = async (userId?: string | null): Promise<IPendingSplitEscrowInvite[]> => {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_RE.test(uid)) return [];
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('listar_mis_invitaciones_split_escrow');
  if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
    return (data as DynamicRow[]).map((inv) => ({
      id: String(inv.id || ''),
      reserva_id: String(inv.reserva_id || ''),
      anfitrion_id: String(inv.anfitrion_id || ''),
      anfitrion_nombre: String(inv.anfitrion_nombre || 'Atleta Kinetic'),
      anfitrion_avatar: typeof inv.anfitrion_avatar === 'string' ? inv.anfitrion_avatar : null,
      invitado_id: String(inv.invitado_id || ''),
      invitado_nombre: typeof inv.invitado_nombre === 'string' ? inv.invitado_nombre : null,
      monto_kc_parte: Number(inv.monto_kc_parte) || 0,
      monto_liquidado_kc: Number(inv.monto_liquidado_kc) || 0,
      reembolsada: Boolean(inv.reembolsada),
      estado: String(inv.estado || 'pendiente'),
      created_at: String(inv.created_at || ''),
      servicio_nombre: String(inv.servicio_nombre || 'Sesión Split-Escrow'),
      negocio_nombre: String(inv.negocio_nombre || 'Club Kinetic'),
      fecha_clase: typeof inv.fecha_clase === 'string' ? inv.fecha_clase : null,
      hora_inicio: typeof inv.hora_inicio === 'string' ? inv.hora_inicio : null,
      spot_number: typeof inv.spot_number === 'number' ? inv.spot_number : null,
    }));
  }
  return [];
};

export const fetchPendingSplitInvites = async (userId?: string | null): Promise<IPendingSplitEscrowInvite[]> => {
  const uid = String(userId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_RE.test(uid)) return [];
  const allRows = await fetchMySplitEscrowInvites(uid);
  return allRows.filter(
    (inv) => inv.invitado_id.toLowerCase() === uid.toLowerCase() && String(inv.estado).toLowerCase() === 'pendiente'
  );
};

export const respondSplitEscrowInvite = async (
  inviteId: string,
  estado: 'aceptada' | 'rechazada'
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const cleanId = String(inviteId || '').trim();
  if (!UUID_RE.test(cleanId)) return false;
  const { error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('responder_split_escrow_invitacion', {
    p_invitacion_id: cleanId,
    p_aceptar: estado === 'aceptada',
  });
  if (!rpcError) return true;
  throw new Error(rpcError.message || 'No se pudo procesar de forma atómica tu parte del Split-Escrow.');
};
