export const SPOT_COLLISION_ERROR_CODE = 'KINETIC_SPOT_COLLISION';
export const DEFAULT_SPOT_LOCK_MS = 95_000; // Bloqueo táctico 90–120 s
const PICKED_INTENT_MAX_AGE_MS = 15 * 60_000;
const CLIENT_HOLDER_SESSION_ID = `kcli_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;

const isUuid = (val?: unknown): boolean =>
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String(val || '').trim());

export const getSpotCollisionAlertMessage = (lang?: string): string => {
  const code = String(lang || getActiveKineticLanguage() || 'es').toLowerCase().trim();
  return code.startsWith('en')
    ? 'Sorry! Another athlete took your spot while you were deciding. Hurry, spots are running out! Choose another spot.'
    : '¡Lo sentimos! Otro atleta tomó tu lugar mientras pensabas qué lugar tomar. ¡Vamos, se agotan los lugares! Elige tu lugar.';
};

export const createSpotCollisionError = (lang?: string): Error & { code: string; spotCollision: boolean } => {
  const err = new Error(getSpotCollisionAlertMessage(lang)) as Error & { code: string; spotCollision: boolean };
  err.code = SPOT_COLLISION_ERROR_CODE;
  err.spotCollision = true;
  return err;
};

// === FECHA LOCAL PURA (CERO new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') EN UTC / CERO toISOString().slice(0,10) UTC) === //
export const getTodayLocalIsoDate = (): string => getMazatlanNowParts().isoDate;

export const normalizeLocalIsoDate = (rawDate?: string | Date | null): string => {
  if (rawDate instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(rawDate.getTime())) return getTodayLocalIsoDate();
    return getMazatlanNowParts(rawDate).isoDate;
  }
  const s = String(rawDate ?? '').trim();
  if (!s) return getTodayLocalIsoDate();
  const match = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})(?:$|[T\s](.+))?$/);
  if (match) {
    const timePart = (match[4] || '').trim();
    const hasExplicitTz = /[zZ]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2}$/.test(timePart);
    const isMidnightPlaceholder = /^00:00(?::00(?:\.0+)?[zZ]?)?$/i.test(timePart);
    if (!timePart || !hasExplicitTz || isMidnightPlaceholder) {
      const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]) - 1, Number(match[3]), 12, 0, 0, 0));
      if (!Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())) {
        return `${dt.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(dt.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      }
    }
  }
  const parsed = new Date(s);
  if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return getMazatlanNowParts(parsed).isoDate;
  }
  return getTodayLocalIsoDate();
};

export const parseIsoLocal = (rawDate?: string | Date | null, hour: number = 12, minute: number = 0): Date | null => {
  const s = rawDate instanceof Date ? rawDate : String(rawDate ?? '').trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  const [y, m, d] = normalizeLocalIsoDate(s).split('-').map(Number);
  if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
  const dt = new Date(y, m - 1, d, hour, minute, 0, 0);
  return Number.isNaN(dt.getTime()) ? null : dt;
};

export const parseReservaLocalDateTimeMs = (reserva: any, servFallback?: any): number => {
  const rawDate =
    reserva?.fecha_clase || reserva?.fecha_programada || reserva?.fecha ||
    servFallback?.fecha || reserva?.fecha_hora || reserva?.created_at;
  if (!rawDate) return NaN;
  const ymd = normalizeLocalIsoDate(rawDate);
  const extractTime = (val?: unknown): string | null => {
    const m = String(val || '').match(/T(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
    return m && `${m[1]}:${m[2]}` !== '00:00' ? `${m[1]}:${m[2]}` : null;
  };
  const hhmm = String(
    reserva?.hora_inicio || reserva?.hora || servFallback?.hora_inicio ||
      extractTime(reserva?.fecha_programada) || extractTime(reserva?.fecha_hora) || '08:00'
  ).substring(0, 5);
  const [hh, mm] = hhmm.split(':').map((n) => Number(n) || 0);
  return parseIsoLocal(ymd, hh, mm)?.getTime() ?? NaN;
};

// === BLOQUEOS TEMPORALES 90–120s Y DETECCIÓN ANTI-COLISIÓN EN VIVO === //
export const GLOBAL_SPOTS_LOCKS = new Map<string, { spot: number; expiresAt: number }>();
const _clientPickedSpotIntent = new Map<string, { spot: number; pickedAt: number }>();
const _collisionListeners = new Set<(eventKey: string, spotNum: number, occupiedSpots: number[]) => void>();

export const subscribeSpotCollisions = (cb: (eventKey: string, spotNum: number, occupiedSpots: number[]) => void): (() => void) => {
  _collisionListeners.add(cb);
  return () => { _collisionListeners.delete(cb); };
};

const notifySpotCollision = (eventKey: string, spotNum: number, occupiedSpots: number[]) => {
  _collisionListeners.forEach((cb) => { try { cb(eventKey, spotNum, occupiedSpots); } catch {} });
};

export const getSpotLockRemainingSec = (eventKey?: string, spotNum?: number | null): number => {
  if (!eventKey || !spotNum) return 0;
  const lock = GLOBAL_SPOTS_LOCKS.get(eventKey);
  return lock && lock.spot === spotNum ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil((lock.expiresAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) : 0;
};

export const setSpotLock90s = (eventKey?: string, spotNum?: number | null, ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_SPOT_LOCK_MS): void => {
  const cleanKey = String(eventKey || '').trim();
  if (!cleanKey) return;
  if (!spotNum || spotNum <= 0) {
    GLOBAL_SPOTS_LOCKS.delete(cleanKey);
    _clientPickedSpotIntent.delete(cleanKey);
    return;
  }
  const safeSpot = Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(spotNum))));
  GLOBAL_SPOTS_LOCKS.set(cleanKey, { spot: safeSpot, expiresAt: Date.now() + ttlMs });
  _clientPickedSpotIntent.set(cleanKey, { spot: safeSpot, pickedAt: Date.now() });
};

export const clearSpotLockAndIntent = (...keys: (string | undefined | null)[]): void => {
  for (const k of keys) {
    const clean = String(k || '').trim();
    if (clean) { GLOBAL_SPOTS_LOCKS.delete(clean); _clientPickedSpotIntent.delete(clean); }
  }
};

export const resolveClientPickedSpot = (...keys: (string | undefined | null)[]): number | null => {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const k of keys) {
    const clean = String(k || '').trim();
    if (!clean) continue;
    const lock = GLOBAL_SPOTS_LOCKS.get(clean);
    if (lock && lock.spot > 0 && lock.expiresAt > now) return lock.spot;
    const intent = _clientPickedSpotIntent.get(clean);
    if (intent && intent.spot > 0 && now - intent.pickedAt <= PICKED_INTENT_MAX_AGE_MS) return intent.spot;
  }
  return null;
};

export const buildSpotAwareQrToken = (spotNumber?: number | null): string => {
  const rand = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase();
  const safeSpot = Number(spotNumber) || 0;
  return safeSpot >= 1 && safeSpot <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS ? `KNT-S${safeSpot}-${Date.now()}-${rand}` : `KNT-${Date.now()}-${rand}`;
};

export const extractSpotNumberFromReserva = (row: any): number | null => {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return null;
  for (const direct of [row.spot_number, row.estacion, row.spot]) {
    if (direct !== undefined && direct !== null && String(direct).trim() !== '') {
      const m = String(direct).match(/(\d{1,2})/);
      const num = m ? Number(m[1]) : NaN;
      if (Number.isInteger(num) && num >= 1 && num <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) return num;
    }
  }
  for (const tokenField of [row.qr_token, row.codigo_reserva]) {
    const m = String(tokenField || '').match(/KNT-S(\d{1,2})-/i) || String(tokenField || '').match(/SPOT[-_:#\s]*(\d{1,2})\b/i);
    const num = m ? Number(m[1]) : NaN;
    if (Number.isInteger(num) && num >= 1 && num <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) return num;
  }
  for (const noteField of [row.notas, row.comentario_atleta]) {
    const m = String(noteField || '').match(/(?:spot|estaci[oó]n|lugar|reformer|bike|bici|barre|bag|court)\s*#?\s*(\d{1,2})\b/i);
    const num = m ? Number(m[1]) : NaN;
    if (Number.isInteger(num) && num >= 1 && num <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) return num;
  }
  return null;
};

const resolveHolderId = (userId?: string | null): string => String(userId || '').trim() || CLIENT_HOLDER_SESSION_ID;

export const registerTemporarySpotLock = async (params: ISpotLookupParams & { ttlMs?: number }): Promise<void> => {
  const ttl = params.ttlMs ?? DEFAULT_SPOT_LOCK_MS;
  const sid = isUuid(params.serviceId) ? String(params.serviceId).trim() : isUuid(params.eventKey) ? String(params.eventKey).trim() : '';
  const key = String(params.eventKey || sid || '').trim();
  if (key) setSpotLock90s(key, params.spotNumber, ttl);
  if (sid && sid !== key) setSpotLock90s(sid, params.spotNumber, ttl);
  if (!sid) return;

  const holder = resolveHolderId(params.userId);
  const dateTag = params.fechaClase ? normalizeLocalIsoDate(params.fechaClase) : 'any';
  const sp = Number(params.spotNumber) || 0;
  try {
    const { error: lockRpcErr } = await supabase.rpc('registrar_lock_spot_temporal', {
      p_servicio_id: sid,
      p_spot_number: sp >= 1 && sp <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS ? sp : null,
      p_fecha_clase: dateTag,
      p_ttl_ms: ttl,
    });
    if (!lockRpcErr) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    const { data: srv } = await supabase.from('servicios').select('id, spots_locks').eq('id', sid).maybeSingle();
    const rawLocks = srv?.spots_locks && typeof srv.spots_locks === 'object' ? { ...srv.spots_locks } : {};
    const cleaned: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [lk, lv] of Object.entries(rawLocks)) {
      const exp = Number((lv as any)?.expiresAt) || 0;
      if (exp > now && !(String((lv as any)?.holder || '') === holder && String((lv as any)?.dateTag || 'any') === dateTag)) cleaned[lk] = lv;
    }
    if (sp >= 1 && sp <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS && !cleaned[`${dateTag}:${sp}`]) {
      cleaned[`${dateTag}:${sp}`] = { spot: sp, holder, dateTag, expiresAt: now + ttl };
    }
    await supabase.from('servicios').update({ spots_locks: cleaned }).eq('id', sid);
  } catch {}
};

export const fetchLiveOccupiedSpots = async (params: ISpotLookupParams): Promise<ILiveSpotsSnapshot> => {
  const sid = isUuid(params.serviceId) ? String(params.serviceId).trim() : isUuid(params.eventKey) ? String(params.eventKey).trim() : '';
  const titleLookup = String(params.eventTitle || (!sid ? params.eventKey : '') || '').trim();
  const targetDate = params.fechaClase ? normalizeLocalIsoDate(params.fechaClase) : null;
  const holder = resolveHolderId(params.userId);
  const cap = Math.min(MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS, Math.max(1, Number(params.maxSpots) || MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS));
  const dbBooked = new Set<number>();
  const lockedByOthers = new Set<number>();
  let unassignedCount = 0;
  let activeCount = 0;
  let liveQueryOk = false;

  if (sid || titleLookup) {
    try {
      const { data: occData, error: occErr } = await supabase.rpc('obtener_ocupacion_spots_servicio', {
        p_servicio_id: sid || null,
        p_servicio_nombre: !sid ? titleLookup : null,
        p_fecha_clase: targetDate || null,
      });
      if (!occErr && occData && typeof occData === 'object') {
        const bList = Array.isArray((occData as any).booked_spots) ? (occData as any).booked_spots : [];
        const lList = Array.isArray((occData as any).locked_other_spots) ? (occData as any).locked_other_spots : [];
        bList.forEach((n: any) => { const v = Number(n); if (v >= 1 && v <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) dbBooked.add(v); });
        lList.forEach((n: any) => { const v = Number(n); if (v >= 1 && v <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) lockedByOthers.add(v); });
        unassignedCount = Math.max(0, Number((occData as any).unassigned_count) || 0);
        activeCount = Math.max(0, Number((occData as any).active_count) || 0);
        liveQueryOk = true;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  if (!liveQueryOk) {
    let rows: any[] = [];
    if (sid || titleLookup) {
      try {
        const runQ = (cols: string) => {
          const q = supabase.from('reservas').select(cols).in('estado', ['pendiente', 'activa', 'confirmada']).limit(60);
          return sid ? q.eq('servicio_id', sid) : q.eq('servicio', titleLookup);
        };
        const primary = await runQ('id, usuario_id, servicio_id, servicio, estado, fecha_clase, spot_number, created_at');
        if (!primary.error) { rows = primary.data || []; liveQueryOk = true; }
        else {
          const fallback = await runQ('id, usuario_id, servicio_id, servicio, estado, fecha_clase, created_at');
          if (!fallback.error) { rows = fallback.data || []; liveQueryOk = true; }
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    if (sid) {
      try {
        const { data: srv } = await supabase.from('servicios').select('id, spots_locks').eq('id', sid).maybeSingle();
        const rawLocks = srv?.spots_locks && typeof srv.spots_locks === 'object' ? srv.spots_locks : {};
        const now = Date.now();
        for (const lv of Object.values(rawLocks)) {
          const exp = Number((lv as any)?.expiresAt) || 0;
          const sp = Number((lv as any)?.spot) || 0;
          const itemHolder = String((lv as any)?.holder || '');
          const itemDate = String((lv as any)?.dateTag || 'any');
          if (exp > now && sp >= 1 && sp <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS && itemHolder && itemHolder !== holder && (!targetDate || itemDate === 'any' || itemDate === targetDate)) lockedByOthers.add(sp);
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    const matchingRows = rows.filter((r) => !targetDate || !r?.fecha_clase || normalizeLocalIsoDate(r.fecha_clase) === targetDate);
    activeCount = matchingRows.length;
    for (const r of matchingRows) {
      const sp = extractSpotNumberFromReserva(r);
      if (sp !== null) dbBooked.add(sp); else unassignedCount++;
    }
  }

  const occupied = new Set<number>([...dbBooked, ...lockedByOthers]);
  let remainingUnassigned = Math.max(0, liveQueryOk ? unassignedCount : Math.round(Number(params.fallbackOccupiedCount) || 0) - occupied.size);
  for (let s = 1; s <= cap && remainingUnassigned > 0; s++) {
    if (!occupied.has(s)) { occupied.add(s); remainingUnassigned--; }
  }

  return {
    occupiedSpots: Array.from(occupied).sort((a, b) => a - b),
    dbBookedSpots: Array.from(dbBooked).sort((a, b) => a - b),
    lockedByOthersSpots: Array.from(lockedByOthers).sort((a, b) => a - b),
    activeDbRowsCount: activeCount,
    liveQueryOk,
  };
};

export const verifyLiveSpotAvailability = async (
  params: ISpotLookupParams
): Promise<{ available: boolean; occupiedSpots: number[]; message: string }> => {
  const spot = Number(params.spotNumber) || 0;
  if (spot < 1 || spot > MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS) return { available: true, occupiedSpots: [], message: '' };
  const snapshot = await fetchLiveOccupiedSpots({ ...params, fallbackOccupiedCount: 0 });
  const cap = Number(params.maxSpots) || 0;
  const isTaken = snapshot.dbBookedSpots.includes(spot) || snapshot.lockedByOthersSpots.includes(spot) || (cap > 0 && snapshot.activeDbRowsCount >= cap);
  if (isTaken) {
    const updatedOccupied = Array.from(new Set([...snapshot.occupiedSpots, spot])).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const notifyKey = String(params.eventKey || params.serviceId || params.eventTitle || '').trim();
    if (notifyKey) notifySpotCollision(notifyKey, spot, updatedOccupied);
    return { available: false, occupiedSpots: updatedOccupied, message: getSpotCollisionAlertMessage(params.lang) };
  }
  return { available: true, occupiedSpots: snapshot.occupiedSpots, message: '' };
};

export const assertLiveSpotAvailableOrThrow = async (params: ISpotLookupParams): Promise<void> => {
  const check = await verifyLiveSpotAvailability(params);
  if (!check.available) { clearSpotLockAndIntent(params.eventKey, params.serviceId, params.eventTitle); throw createSpotCollisionError(params.lang); }
};

// === PERSISTENCIA DIRECTA 0 KC Y SINCRONIZACIÓN POST-RPC DE fecha_clase + spot_number === //
export const insertDirectReservaRowSafe = async (params: {
  userId: string; serviceId?: string | null; negocioNombre: string; servicioNombre: string;
  exactLocalDate: string; costoTotal: number; montoEscrow: number; montoPuerta: number;
  estado: 'confirmada' | 'activa'; spotNumber?: number | null; qrToken?: string;
}): Promise<any> => {
  const sid = isUuid(params.serviceId) ? String(params.serviceId).trim() : null;
  const qr = params.qrToken || buildSpotAwareQrToken(params.spotNumber);
  const safeSpot = params.spotNumber && params.spotNumber >= 1 && params.spotNumber <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS ? Math.round(params.spotNumber) : null;
  const saldoPend = params.costoTotal <= 0 ? 0 : params.montoPuerta;
  const corePayload: Record<string, any> = {
    usuario_id: params.userId, servicio_id: sid, negocio_nombre: params.negocioNombre, servicio: params.servicioNombre,
    fecha_clase: params.exactLocalDate, costo_total: params.costoTotal, precio_kc: params.costoTotal,
    monto_escrow: params.montoEscrow, monto_puerta: params.montoPuerta, estado: params.estado, qr_token: qr,
  };
  const fullPayload: Record<string, any> = {
    ...corePayload, nombre_servicio: params.servicioNombre, saldo_pendiente_mxn: saldoPend, ...(safeSpot ? { spot_number: safeSpot } : {}),
  };
  const safeInsertCols =
    'id, usuario_id, servicio_id, servicio, negocio_nombre, estado, monto_escrow, monto_puerta, precio_kc, fecha_clase, spot_number, created_at';
  const safeCoreCols =
    'id, usuario_id, servicio_id, servicio, negocio_nombre, estado, monto_escrow, monto_puerta, precio_kc, fecha_clase, created_at';
  const firstTry = await supabase.from('reservas').insert([fullPayload]).select(safeInsertCols).single();
  if (!firstTry.error && firstTry.data) {
    return { ...firstTry.data, qr_token: qr, reserva_id: firstTry.data.id, monto_congelado: params.montoEscrow, saldo_pendiente_mxn: saldoPend, fecha_clase: params.exactLocalDate, fecha: params.exactLocalDate, spot_number: safeSpot ?? firstTry.data.spot_number ?? null };
  }
  const secondTry = await supabase.from('reservas').insert([corePayload]).select(safeCoreCols).single();
  if (secondTry.error) throw new Error(secondTry.error.message);
  return { ...secondTry.data, qr_token: qr, reserva_id: secondTry.data?.id, monto_congelado: params.montoEscrow, saldo_pendiente_mxn: saldoPend, fecha_clase: params.exactLocalDate, fecha: params.exactLocalDate, spot_number: safeSpot };
};

export const executeZeroKcMasterPassBooking = async (params: {
  userId: string; serviceId?: string | null; negocioNombre: string; servicioNombre: string;
  exactLocalDate: string; spotNumber?: number | null; cupoMaximo?: number; lang?: string;
}): Promise<any> => {
  await assertLiveSpotAvailableOrThrow({ serviceId: params.serviceId, eventTitle: params.servicioNombre, fechaClase: params.exactLocalDate, spotNumber: params.spotNumber, userId: params.userId, maxSpots: params.cupoMaximo, lang: params.lang });
  const sid = isUuid(params.serviceId) ? String(params.serviceId).trim() : null;
  const maxCupo = Math.max(1, Number(params.cupoMaximo) || 50);
  if (sid) {
    const { data: activeRows } = await supabase.from('reservas').select('id, usuario_id, fecha_clase').eq('servicio_id', sid).in('estado', ['pendiente', 'activa', 'confirmada']);
    const sameDayRows = (activeRows || []).filter((r: any) => !r?.fecha_clase || normalizeLocalIsoDate(r.fecha_clase) === params.exactLocalDate);
    if (sameDayRows.length >= maxCupo) throw new Error('Cupo agotado para esta sesión.');
  }
  const inserted = await insertDirectReservaRowSafe({ userId: params.userId, serviceId: sid, negocioNombre: params.negocioNombre, servicioNombre: params.servicioNombre, exactLocalDate: params.exactLocalDate, costoTotal: 0, montoEscrow: 0, montoPuerta: 0, estado: 'confirmada', spotNumber: params.spotNumber });
  void registerTemporarySpotLock({ serviceId: sid, eventKey: sid || params.servicioNombre, fechaClase: params.exactLocalDate, spotNumber: null, userId: params.userId });
  return inserted;
};

export const syncPostRpcBookingRow = async (params: {
  rpcData: any; userId: string; serviceId?: string | null; servicioNombre: string;
  exactLocalDate: string; spotNumber?: number | null; precioTotal: number;
}): Promise<any> => {
  const baseResult = Array.isArray(params.rpcData) ? params.rpcData[0] : params.rpcData;
  const sid = isUuid(params.serviceId) ? String(params.serviceId).trim() : null;
  const safeSpot = params.spotNumber && params.spotNumber >= 1 && params.spotNumber <= MAX_STUDIO_SPOTS ? Math.round(params.spotNumber) : null;
  const targetId = String(baseResult?.reserva_id || baseResult?.id || '').trim() || null;
  clearSpotLockAndIntent(sid, params.servicioNombre);
  void registerTemporarySpotLock({ serviceId: sid, eventKey: sid || params.servicioNombre, fechaClase: params.exactLocalDate, spotNumber: null, userId: params.userId });
  return {
    ...(baseResult && typeof baseResult === 'object' ? baseResult : {}),
    id: targetId || baseResult?.id,
    reserva_id: targetId || baseResult?.reserva_id || baseResult?.id,
    fecha_clase: baseResult?.fecha_clase || params.exactLocalDate,
    fecha: baseResult?.fecha_clase || params.exactLocalDate,
    spot_number: baseResult?.spot_number ?? safeSpot ?? null,
    monto_congelado: baseResult?.monto_escrow ?? baseResult?.monto_congelado ?? baseResult?.monto_retenido ?? Math.round(params.precioTotal * 0.4),
  };
};

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

export const DISMISSED_ALERTS_STORAGE_KEY = '@kinetic_dismissed_alerts_v1';

export interface TacticalUpcomingReminder {
  id: string;
  reservaId: string;
  servicio: string;
  club: string;
  disciplina: string;
  minutosRestantes: number;
  qrToken: string;
  horaInicio: string;
  fecha: string;
  mensaje: string;
  rawReserva: any;
}

export interface FlashSaleExperience {
  id: string;
  nombre_servicio: string;
  negocio_nombre: string;
  precio_kc: number;
  cupo_maximo: number;
  cupo_actual: number;
  cupos_disponibles: number;
  minutosParaInicio: number;
  distanciaKmNum?: number;
  distanciaKm?: string;
  isNearby?: boolean;
  flashBadge: string;
  urgencyTag: string;
  rawServicio: any;
}

let _memoryDismissedAlerts = new Set<string>();
let _hasHydratedDismissed = false;

export const hydrateDismissedAlerts = async (): Promise<Set<string>> => {
  if (_hasHydratedDismissed) return _memoryDismissedAlerts;
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(DISMISSED_ALERTS_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        _memoryDismissedAlerts = new Set(parsed);
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  _hasHydratedDismissed = true;
  return _memoryDismissedAlerts;
};

export const isAlertDismissed = (alertId: string): boolean => {
  return _memoryDismissedAlerts.has(alertId);
};

export const dismissUpcomingAlert = async (alertId: string): Promise<void> => {
  _memoryDismissedAlerts.add(alertId);
  try {
    const arr = Array.from(_memoryDismissedAlerts).slice(-50);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(DISMISSED_ALERTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr));
  } catch {}
};

const parseLocalTimeParts = (rawHora?: unknown): { hh: number; mm: number } => {
  const s = String(rawHora ?? '').trim();
  const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\s*(a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?)?/i);
  if (!m) return { hh: 8, mm: 0 };
  let hh = parseInt(m[1], 10);
  const mm = Math.max(0, Math.min(59, parseInt(m[2], 10) || 0));
  const ampm = (m[3] || '').toLowerCase();
  if (ampm.startsWith('p') && hh < 12) hh += 12;
  if (ampm.startsWith('a') && hh === 12) hh = 0;
  return { hh: Math.max(0, Math.min(23, Number.isNaN(hh) ? 8 : hh)), mm };
};

export const resolveEventStartTimestamp = (item: any): number | null => {
  if (!item) return null;
  const rawDate =
    item.fecha_proyectada ||
    item.fecha_programada ||
    item.fecha_clase ||
    item.fecha_hora ||
    item.fecha;
  const rawHora = item.hora_inicio || item.hora || '';
  if (typeof rawDate !== 'string' || !rawDate.trim()) return null;
  const trimmed = rawDate.trim();

  if (trimmed.includes('T')) {
    if (/(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(trimmed)) {
      const t = new Date(trimmed).getTime();
      return Number.isNaN(t) ? null : t;
    }
    const [dPart, tPart = ''] = trimmed.split('T');
    const [y, mo, d] = dPart.split('-').map(Number);
    if (y && mo && d) {
      const { hh, mm } = parseLocalTimeParts(tPart || rawHora);
      const localTs = new Date(y, mo - 1, d, hh, mm, 0).getTime();
      if (!Number.isNaN(localTs)) return localTs;
    }
  }

  const dateOnly = trimmed.split('T')[0];
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateOnly)) {
    const [y, mo, d] = dateOnly.split('-').map(Number);
    const { hh, mm } = rawHora ? parseLocalTimeParts(rawHora) : { hh: 23, mm: 59 };
    const localTs = new Date(y, mo - 1, d, hh, mm, 0).getTime();
    return Number.isNaN(localTs) ? null : localTs;
  }
  return null;
};

export const checkUpcomingClassReminders = (
  reservasActivas: any[],
  nowTs: number = Date.now()
): TacticalUpcomingReminder[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(reservasActivas) || reservasActivas.length === 0) return [];
  const validStatus = new Set(['activa', 'pendiente', 'confirmada']);
  const reminders: TacticalUpcomingReminder[] = [];

  for (const r of reservasActivas) {
    const st = String(r?.estado || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!validStatus.has(st)) continue;

    const startMs = resolveEventStartTimestamp(r);
    if (!startMs) continue;

    const diffMinutes = Math.floor((startMs - nowTs) / 60000);
    if (diffMinutes >= 10 && diffMinutes <= 120) {
      const servicio = String(r?.servicio || r?.nombre_servicio || r?.titulo_clase || 'Experiencia Kinetic').trim();
      const club = String(r?.negocio_nombre || r?.club || 'Sede Oficial Kinetic').trim();
      const qrToken = String(r?.qr_token || r?.id || '').trim();
      const horaInicio = String(
        r?.hora_inicio || (r?.fecha_hora ? r.fecha_hora.split('T')[1]?.slice(0, 5) : '') || '10:00'
      );
      const fecha = String(r?.fecha_programada || r?.fecha_clase || r?.fecha || '').split('T')[0];
      const id = `rem_${r.id || qrToken}_${diffMinutes}`;

      const mensaje = `Tu sesión de ${servicio} en ${club} inicia en ${diffMinutes} min. Tu llave QR dinámica está lista en Bóveda para liquidar en recepción.`;

      reminders.push({
        id,
        reservaId: String(r.id || qrToken),
        servicio,
        club,
        disciplina: String(r?.categoria || 'Fuerza').trim(),
        minutosRestantes: diffMinutes,
        qrToken,
        horaInicio,
        fecha,
        mensaje,
        rawReserva: r,
      });
    }
  }

  return reminders.sort((a, b) => a.minutosRestantes - b.minutosRestantes);
};

const computeHaversineKm = (lat1: number, lon1: number, lat2: number, lon2: number): number => {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c * 10) / 10;
};

export const filterFlashSalesUpcoming = (
  servicios: any[],
  userLocation?: { lat: number; lon: number } | null,
  nowTs: number = Date.now()
): FlashSaleExperience[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(servicios) || servicios.length === 0) return [];
  const results: FlashSaleExperience[] = [];

  for (const srv of servicios) {
    if (!srv || typeof srv !== 'object') continue;
    const isOfficialKinetic =
      String(srv?.negocio_nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'kinetic oficial';
    if (
      srv?.isInactive === true ||
      srv?.isExpired === true ||
      srv?.eliminado === true ||
      (!isOfficialKinetic && (srv?.esClubActivo === false || srv?.isGhost === true))
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    const rawEst = String(srv?.estado || 'aprobado').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (rawEst && rawEst !== 'aprobado' && rawEst !== 'activo') continue;

    const cupoMax = Math.max(1, Number(srv?.cupo_maximo) || 12);
    const cupoAct = Number(srv?.cupo_actual ?? srv?.cupos_ocupados ?? srv?.reservadosCount) || 0;
    const cuposDisp = Math.max(0, cupoMax - cupoAct);
    if (cuposDisp <= 0) continue;

    const startMs = resolveEventStartTimestamp(srv);
    if (!startMs) continue;

    const diffMinutes = Math.floor((startMs - nowTs) / 60000);
    if (diffMinutes > 0 && diffMinutes <= 180) {
      let distKmNum: number | undefined;
      let isNearby = false;

      const srvLat = Number(srv?.latitud ?? srv?.lat);
      const srvLon = Number(srv?.longitud ?? srv?.lng ?? srv?.lon);

      if (userLocation && !Number.isNaN(srvLat) && !Number.isNaN(srvLon) && srvLat !== 0) {
        distKmNum = computeHaversineKm(userLocation.lat, userLocation.lon, srvLat, srvLon);
        isNearby = distKmNum <= 10;
      }

      results.push({
        id: String(srv?.id || ''),
        nombre_servicio: String(srv?.nombre_servicio || 'Sesión Kinetic'),
        negocio_nombre: String(srv?.negocio_nombre || 'Club Afiliado'),
        precio_kc: Number(srv?.precio_kc) || 0,
        cupo_maximo: cupoMax,
        cupo_actual: cupoAct,
        cupos_disponibles: cuposDisp,
        minutosParaInicio: diffMinutes,
        distanciaKmNum: distKmNum,
        distanciaKm: distKmNum !== undefined ? `${distKmNum} km` : srv?.distanciaKm,
        isNearby,
        flashBadge: 'VENTA FLASH • INICIA PRONTO',
        urgencyTag: '⏰ INICIA EN < 3 HORAS',
        rawServicio: {
          ...srv,
          es_venta_flash: true,
          isFlashSale: true,
          isFlashUrgent3h: true,
          minutosParaInicio: diffMinutes,
          flashUrgencyTag: '⏰ INICIA EN < 3 HORAS',
        },
      });
    }
  }

  return results.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.isNearby && !b.isNearby) return -1;
    if (!a.isNearby && b.isNearby) return 1;
    return a.minutosParaInicio - b.minutosParaInicio;
  });
};

export const tacticalAlertsService = {
  checkUpcomingClassReminders,
  filterFlashSalesUpcoming,
  dismissUpcomingAlert,
  isAlertDismissed,
  hydrateDismissedAlerts,
  resolveEventStartTimestamp,
};

import React from 'react';
import {
  Dimensions,
  PixelRatio,
  Platform,
  StyleSheet,
} from 'react-native';
// ==========================================
// 0. MOTOR DE NORMALIZACIÓN UNIVERSAL (Base: Pixel 412dp)
// ==========================================
const { width: WINDOW_WIDTH, height: WINDOW_HEIGHT } = Dimensions.get('window');
export const SCREEN_WIDTH = WINDOW_WIDTH;
export const SCREEN_HEIGHT = WINDOW_HEIGHT;

const BASE_WIDTH = 412; // Ancho lógico de referencia (Pixel Pro XL)
export const IS_COMPACT_SCREEN = WINDOW_WIDTH < 385; // Samsung Serie A / Gama media-baja (360dp)
export const KINETIC_DOCK_CLEARANCE = 112;

export const scaleSize = (size: number) => {
  const ratio = Math.min(Math.max(WINDOW_WIDTH / BASE_WIDTH, 0.85), 1.08);
  return Math.round(PixelRatio.roundToNearestPixel(size * ratio));
};

export const moderateScale = (size: number, factor = 0.45) => {
  return Math.round(size + (scaleSize(size) - size) * factor);
};

// ==========================================
// 1. TOKENS DE DISEÑO (Variables Maestras)
// ==========================================

export interface IRpgStats {
  fuerza: number;
  zen: number;
  resistencia?: number;
  cardio?: number;
  agilidad: number;
  ovr?: number;
  fuerzaSessions?: number;
  cardioSessions?: number;
  agilidadSessions?: number;
  zenSessions?: number;
}

export interface IUserPreferences {
  radar_publico: boolean;
  notificaciones_push: boolean;
  recordatorios_entrenamiento: boolean;
  alertas_ventas_flash: boolean;
  biometria_activa: boolean;
}

export type TrophyRarity = "comun" | "raro" | "epico" | "legendario";
export type TrophyMetricType = "diario" | "sesiones" | "racha" | "disciplinas" | "nivel" | "clubes_visitados" | "maestria_disciplina" | "experto_disciplina" | "disciplina_especifica" | "habito_app" | "equipo";
export type TrophyFamilyCategory = "sesiones" | "clubes" | "experto";

export interface ITrofeo {
  id: string;
  orden?: number;
  codigo?: string;
  division?: "facil" | "intermedio" | "avanzado" | "pro" | "leyenda" | string;
  divisionLabel?: string;
  titulo: string;
  desc: string;
  tituloEn?: string;
  descEn?: string;
  requisitoCortoEn?: string;
  kc?: number;
  xp?: number;
  recompensaXp?: number;
  recompensaKc?: number;
  meta: number;
  tipo?: TrophyMetricType | string;
  familia?: TrophyFamilyCategory | string;
  disciplinaClave?: string;
  disciplina_objetivo?: string;
  disciplinaObjetivo?: string;
  rareza?: TrophyRarity;
  icon: string;
  color_neon?: string;
  insignia_tag?: string;
  requisito_corto?: string;
  requisitoCorto?: string;
}

export type RegimenFiscalSAT = "persona_fisica_con_rfc" | "persona_moral" | "sin_rfc_omiso" | "sin_rfc" | string;

export interface IPerfil {
  id: string;
  nombre: string;
  email?: string;
  telefono?: string;
  ciudad_base?: string;
  kc_membresia?: number;
  kc_topup?: number;
  saldo_kc?: number;
  nivel?: string;
  racha?: number;
  racha_dias?: number;
  is_streak_frozen?: boolean;
  radar_publico?: boolean;
  waiver_firmado?: boolean;
  waiver_firmado_at?: string | null;
  waiver_version?: string | null;
  ultimo_token_usado?: string;
  avatar_url?: string;
  calling_card?: string;
  aura_color?: string;
  fuerza?: number;
  zen?: number;
  resistencia?: number;
  agilidad?: number;
  xp_total?: number;
  recompensas_reclamadas?: string[];
  perdones_mensuales_usados?: number;
  codigo_referido?: string;
  referido_por?: string | null;
  referidos_count?: number;
  kc_ganados_referidos?: number;
  contacto_emergencia_nombre?: string;
  contacto_emergencia_tel?: string;
  rfc_fiscal?: string;
  razon_social_fiscal?: string;
  regimen_fiscal_receptor?: string;
  cp_fiscal?: string;

    // === src/utils/clubLocalOverridesHelper.ts === //
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import {
  AFFILIATES_RUNTIME_STATE_KEY,
  KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES,
  reconcileCatalogWithSupabaseDb,
} from '../constants/exploreData';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import {
  canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey,
  isBannedAffiliateName,
  isBannedAffiliateRecord,
  normalizeRadarText,
} from '../services/exploreRadarFilters';
import {
  formatKineticDate,
  getActiveKineticLanguage,
} from './kineticSmartTranslator';

export const CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX = '@kinetic_club_ext_v1_';
export const GLOBAL_RATINGS_MAP_KEY = '@kinetic_clubs_ratings_map_v1';

const supabaseKnownTruthMap = new Map<string, any>();

const sanitizeOverrideAgainstDbRow = (
  overrideObj: Record<string, any> | null | undefined,
  dbRow: any
): { cleaned: Record<string, any>; mutated: boolean } => {
  if (!overrideObj || typeof overrideObj !== 'object') {
    return { cleaned: {}, mutated: false };
  }
  const cleaned: Record<string, any> = { ...overrideObj };
  let mutated = false;
  const statusKeys = ['estado', 'activo', 'esActivo', 'esClubActivo', 'verificado'];
  for (const sk of statusKeys) {
    if (sk in cleaned) {
      delete cleaned[sk];
      mutated = true;
    }
  }
  if (dbRow && typeof dbRow === 'object') {
    const dbPersistedFields = [
      'nombre',
      'disciplina',
      'categoria',
      'ubicacion',
      'horarios',
      'whatsapp',
      'instagram',
      'portada_url',
      'avatar_url',
      'descripcion',
      'amenidades',
    ];
    for (const f of dbPersistedFields) {
      const dbVal = dbRow[f];
      const hasDbVal = Array.isArray(dbVal)
        ? dbVal.length > 0
        : dbVal !== null && dbVal !== undefined && String(dbVal).trim() !== '';
      if (hasDbVal && f in cleaned && cleaned[f] !== dbVal) {
        delete cleaned[f];
        mutated = true;
      }
    }
  }
  const ovIg = String(cleaned.instagram || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (ovIg.includes('julibbb3') || ovIg.includes('incorfitcabo')) {
    cleaned.instagram = '@incorfitbarremx';
    mutated = true;
  }
  const ovName = String(cleaned.nombre || dbRow?.nombre || '').toLowerCase();
  if (ovName.includes('kinetic especialista') && cleaned.disciplina && cleaned.disciplina !== 'Fisioterapia') {
    cleaned.disciplina = 'Fisioterapia';
    mutated = true;
  }
  return { cleaned, mutated };
};

export const hydrateStaticAffiliatesRatings = async () => {
  try {
    const rawMap = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_RATINGS_MAP_KEY);
    if (!rawMap) return;
    const parsedMap = JSON.parse(rawMap);
    if (!parsedMap || typeof parsedMap !== 'object') return;
    (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).forEach((item: any) => {
      const keyById = String(item?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const keyByName = String(item?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const entry = parsedMap[keyById] || parsedMap[keyByName];
      if (entry && typeof entry.rating === 'number') {
        item.rating = entry.rating;
        item.calificacion = entry.rating;
        if (Array.isArray(entry.audit_scores)) {
          item.audit_scores = entry.audit_scores;
        }
      }
    });
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }
};

hydrateStaticAffiliatesRatings();

export const DIAS_SEMANA = [
  'Lunes',
  'Martes',
  'Miércoles',
  'Jueves',
  'Viernes',
  'Sábado',
  'Domingo',
];

export const AVAILABLE_DATES = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + i);
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const val = `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
  const label = formatKineticDate(d, getActiveKineticLanguage(), {
    weekday: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
  }).toUpperCase();
  return { val, value: val, label };
});

export const formatHorarioCompacto = (rawHorario?: string | null): string => {
  if (!rawHorario || !String(rawHorario).trim()) {
    return getActiveKineticLanguage() === 'en'
      ? 'Mon–Fri • 06:00 to 22:00'
      : 'Lunes a Viernes • 06:00 a 22:00';
  }
  return String(rawHorario)
    .replace(/\n+/g, ' • ')
    .replace(/([a-zA-ZáéíóúÁÉÍÓÚñÑ])(\d{1,2}:\d{2})/g, '$1 • $2')
    .trim();
};

export const readClubExtendedCache = async (clubId: string, nameKey: string) => {
  const [rawById, rawByName, rawGlobalRatings] = await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.getItem(`${CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX}${clubId}`),
    nameKey
      ? AsyncStorage.getItem(`${CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX}${nameKey}`)
      : Promise.resolve(null),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_RATINGS_MAP_KEY),
  ]);
  const raw = rawById || rawByName;
  const rawParsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  const dbTruth =
    supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(normalizeRadarText(clubId)) ||
    supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(nameKey));
  const parsed = dbTruth
    ? sanitizeOverrideAgainstDbRow(rawParsed, dbTruth).cleaned
    : rawParsed;
  const globalMap = rawGlobalRatings ? JSON.parse(rawGlobalRatings) : {};
  const savedRatingEntry = globalMap[clubId.toLowerCase()] || globalMap[nameKey];
  return { parsed, savedRatingEntry };
};

export const saveClubExtCache = async (
  clubId: string,
  fields: Record<string, any>,
  clubName?: string
) => {
  if (isBannedAffiliateName(clubName || clubId)) return;
  try {
    const key = `${CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX}${clubId}`;
    const existingRaw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    const existing = existingRaw ? JSON.parse(existingRaw) : {};
    const merged = { ...existing, ...fields };
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(merged));
    if (clubName) {
      const nameKey = `${CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX}${String(clubName)
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()}`;
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(nameKey, JSON.stringify(merged));
    }
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }
};

export const persistClubAuditRatingToStorage = async (
  affiliate: any,
  clubId: string,
  clubName: string,
  cleanRating: number,
  cleanScores: number[] | null
) => {
  const lowerId = clubId.toLowerCase();
  const lowerName = clubName.toLowerCase();

  (KINETIC_ALL_AFFILIATES || []).forEach((st: any) => {
    const stId = String(st?.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const stName = String(st?.nombre || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if ((lowerId && stId === lowerId) || (lowerName && stName === lowerName)) {
      st.rating = cleanRating;
      st.calificacion = cleanRating;
      if (cleanScores) st.audit_scores = cleanScores;
    }
  });

  await saveClubExtCache(
    clubId,
    { rating: cleanRating, calificacion: cleanRating, audit_scores: cleanScores },
    clubName
  );

  try {
    const rawGlobal = await AsyncStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_RATINGS_MAP_KEY);
    const globalMap = rawGlobal ? JSON.parse(rawGlobal) : {};
    const entry = {
      rating: cleanRating,
      audit_scores: cleanScores,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    if (lowerId) globalMap[lowerId] = entry;
    if (lowerName) globalMap[lowerName] = entry;
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_RATINGS_MAP_KEY, JSON.stringify(globalMap));
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }

  try {
    const starsInt = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(cleanRating)));
    if (affiliate.id && String(affiliate.id).length > 20) {
      await supabase
        .from('afiliados')
        .update({ estrellas_exclusividad: starsInt })
        .eq('id', affiliate.id);
    } else if (clubName) {
      await supabase
        .from('afiliados')
        .update({ estrellas_exclusividad: starsInt })
        .eq('nombre', clubName);
    }
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }
};

export const reconcileClubOverridesWithSupabase = async (dbAffiliates: any[]): Promise<void> => {
  if (!Array.isArray(dbAffiliates) || dbAffiliates.length === 0) return;

  supabaseKnownTruthMap.clear();
  dbAffiliates.forEach((row) => {
    if (!row || isBannedAffiliateRecord(row)) return;
    const idKey = normalizeRadarText(row.id);
    const nameKey = canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(row.nombre);
    if (idKey) supabaseKnownTruthMap.set(idKey, row);
    if (nameKey) supabaseKnownTruthMap.set(nameKey, row);
  });

  reconcileCatalogWithSupabaseDb(dbAffiliates);

  // 1) Sincronización inmediata en Web localStorage (evita overrides obsoletos en lecturas síncronas)
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try {
      const lsKeys: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < window.localStorage.length; i++) {
        const k = window.localStorage.key(i);
        if (k && k.startsWith(CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX)) lsKeys.push(k);
      }
      for (const fullKey of lsKeys) {
        const suffix = fullKey.slice(CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX.length);
        if (isBannedAffiliateName(suffix)) {
          window.localStorage.removeItem(fullKey);
          continue;
        }
        const dbRow =
          supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(normalizeRadarText(suffix)) ||
          supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(suffix));
        if (!dbRow) {
          window.localStorage.removeItem(fullKey);
          continue;
        }
        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(fullKey);
        if (raw) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          const { cleaned, mutated } = sanitizeOverrideAgainstDbRow(parsed, dbRow);
          if (Object.keys(cleaned).length === 0) {
            window.localStorage.removeItem(fullKey);
          } else if (mutated) {
            window.localStorage.setItem(fullKey, JSON.stringify(cleaned));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Silencioso
    }
  }

  // 2) Purga de AFFILIATES_RUNTIME_STATE_KEY: la verdad de public.afiliados manda sobre cualquier estado/campo viejo
  try {
    const rawRuntime = await AsyncStorage.getItem(AFFILIATES_RUNTIME_STATE_KEY);
    if (rawRuntime) {
      const runtimeMap: Record<string, any> = JSON.parse(rawRuntime) || {};
      let mutated = false;
      for (const k of Object.keys(runtimeMap)) {
        const entry = runtimeMap[k];
        if (!entry || isBannedAffiliateRecord(entry) || isBannedAffiliateName(k)) {
          delete runtimeMap[k];
          mutated = true;
          continue;
        }
        const dbRow =
          supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(normalizeRadarText(entry.id)) ||
          supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(entry.nombre || k));
        if (!dbRow) {
          delete runtimeMap[k];
          mutated = true;
          continue;
        }
        const { cleaned, mutated: itemMut } = sanitizeOverrideAgainstDbRow(entry, dbRow);
        if (Object.keys(cleaned).length === 0) {
          delete runtimeMap[k];
          mutated = true;
        } else if (itemMut) {
          runtimeMap[k] = cleaned;
          mutated = true;
        }
      }
      if (mutated) {
        if (Object.keys(runtimeMap).length === 0) {
          await AsyncStorage.removeItem(AFFILIATES_RUNTIME_STATE_KEY);
        } else {
          await AsyncStorage.setItem(AFFILIATES_RUNTIME_STATE_KEY, JSON.stringify(runtimeMap));
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }

  // 3) Purga de CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX en AsyncStorage nativo/web
  try {
    if (typeof AsyncStorage.getAllKeys === 'function') {
      const allKeys = await AsyncStorage.getAllKeys();
      const clubKeys = (allKeys || []).filter((k) => k.startsWith(CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX));
      for (const fullKey of clubKeys) {
        const suffix = fullKey.slice(CLUB_EXT_CACHE_PREFIX.length);
        if (isBannedAffiliateName(suffix)) {
          await AsyncStorage.removeItem(fullKey);
          continue;
        }
        const dbRow =
          supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(normalizeRadarText(suffix)) ||
          supabaseKnownTruthMap.get(canonicalizeAffiliateLookupKey(suffix));
        if (!dbRow) {
          await AsyncStorage.removeItem(fullKey);
          continue;
        }
        const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(fullKey);
        if (raw) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          const { cleaned, mutated } = sanitizeOverrideAgainstDbRow(parsed, dbRow);
          if (Object.keys(cleaned).length === 0) {
            await AsyncStorage.removeItem(fullKey);
          } else if (mutated) {
            await AsyncStorage.setItem(fullKey, JSON.stringify(cleaned));
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Silencioso
  }
};

const DIRECT_GOOGLE_MAPS_BUSINESS_QUERY_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  'ar wellness & barre studio': 'AR WELLNESS STUDIO, Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur',
  'studio de barre incorfit cabo san lucas': 'InCorFit Barre & Reformer Studio, Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S.',
  'incorfit barre & reformer studio': 'InCorFit Barre & Reformer Studio, Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S.',
  'baja fitness by medano': 'Baja Fitness By Medano, Plaza Pioneros, Cabo San Lucas, B.C.S.',
  'palesttra club': 'PALESTTRA CLUB, San Jose del Cabo, B.C.S.',
  'palestra club': 'PALESTTRA CLUB, San Jose del Cabo, B.C.S.',
};

const GENERIC_LOC_PLACEHOLDERS_RE =
  /^(ubicaci[oó]n\s+verificada|verified\s+location|ubicaci[oó]n\s+por\s+confirmar|por\s+confirmar|location\s+tbd)$/i;

const GENERIC_VENUE_PLACEHOLDERS_RE =
  /^(sede\s+kinetic|sede\s+oficial\s+kinetic|official\s+kinetic\s+venue|club|sede)$/i;

const OFFICIAL_GMAPS_HOSTS = new Set([
  'google.com',
  'www.google.com',
  'maps.google.com',
  'maps.app.goo.gl',
  'goo.gl',
]);

const sanitizeVerifiedGoogleMapsHttpsUrl = (rawUrl?: unknown): string => {
  const str = String(rawUrl || '').trim();
  if (!str) return '';
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(str);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return '';
    const host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
    return OFFICIAL_GMAPS_HOSTS.has(host) ? parsed.toString() : '';
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

export function buildGoogleMapsSearchUrl(
  query?: string | null,
  lat?: number | null,
  lng?: number | null,
): string {
  const cleanQuery = String(query || '').trim();
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(cleanQuery)) {
    const verifiedUrl = sanitizeVerifiedGoogleMapsHttpsUrl(cleanQuery);
    if (verifiedUrl) return verifiedUrl;
    if (typeof lat === 'number' && typeof lng === 'number' && Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng)) {
      return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${lat},${lng}`;
    }
    return 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Cabos,+B.C.S.';
  }
  if (cleanQuery.length > 0) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(cleanQuery)}`;
  }
  if (typeof lat === 'number' && typeof lng === 'number' && Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng)) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${lat},${lng}`;
  }
  return 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Cabos,+B.C.S.';
}

/**
 * [V5-04] Construye la URL directa al establecimiento exacto en Google Maps
 * priorizando enlace directo verificado o búsqueda comercial "${nombre}, ${ubicacion || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.'}".
 * Solo recurre a coordenadas GPS si la sede carece de nombre comercial, evitando pines vacíos en la calle.
 */
const extractEmbeddedHttpUrl = (val?: unknown): string => {
  const m = String(val || '').trim().match(/https?:\/\/\S+/i);
  if (!m) return '';
  return sanitizeVerifiedGoogleMapsHttpsUrl(m[0].replace(/[),.;]+$/, ''));
};

interface IAffiliateMapsSubject {
  google_maps_url?: string | null;
  direccion?: string | null;
  ubicacion?: string | null;
  nombre?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  zona?: string | null;
  zoneKey?: string | null;
  latitude?: number | null;
  latitud?: number | null;
  longitude?: number | null;
  longitud?: number | null;
}

export function buildAffiliateGoogleMapsUrl(affiliate?: IAffiliateMapsSubject | null): string {
  if (!affiliate) return 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Los+Cabos,+B.C.S.';

  const embeddedUrl =
    extractEmbeddedHttpUrl(affiliate.google_maps_url) ||
    extractEmbeddedHttpUrl(affiliate.direccion) ||
    extractEmbeddedHttpUrl(affiliate.ubicacion);
  if (embeddedUrl && !/query=-?\d+\.\d+,-?\d+\.\d+$/i.test(embeddedUrl)) {
    return embeddedUrl;
  }

  const rawDir = String(affiliate.direccion || affiliate.ubicacion || '').trim();

  const rawNombre = String(affiliate.nombre || affiliate.name || '').trim();
  const nombre = GENERIC_VENUE_PLACEHOLDERS_RE.test(rawNombre) ? '' : rawNombre;
  const nombreLower = nombre.toLowerCase();

  if (nombreLower && DIRECT_GOOGLE_MAPS_BUSINESS_QUERY_MAP[nombreLower]) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(
      DIRECT_GOOGLE_MAPS_BUSINESS_QUERY_MAP[nombreLower]
    )}`;
  }

  const cleanDir = GENERIC_LOC_PLACEHOLDERS_RE.test(rawDir) ? '' : rawDir;
  const rawZona = String(affiliate.zona || affiliate.zoneKey || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const zoneCityFallback = rawZona.includes('SAN JOS')
    ? 'San José del Cabo, Los Cabos, B.C.S.'
    : rawZona.includes('CABO SAN LUCAS')
      ? 'Cabo San Lucas, Los Cabos, B.C.S.'
      : 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.';

  if (nombre) {
    const hasBcsContext = /(cabo|b\.?c\.?s|baja\s+california)/i.test(cleanDir);
    const locationPart = cleanDir
      ? hasBcsContext
        ? cleanDir
        : `${cleanDir}, ${zoneCityFallback}`
      : zoneCityFallback;
    const exactBusinessQuery = `${nombre}, ${locationPart}`;
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(exactBusinessQuery)}`;
  }

  const lat = Number(affiliate.latitude ?? affiliate.latitud);
  const lng = Number(affiliate.longitude ?? affiliate.longitud);
  if (Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng) && Math.abs(lat) > 1 && Math.abs(lng) > 1) {
    return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${lat},${lng}`;
  }

  return buildGoogleMapsSearchUrl(cleanDir || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.');
}

export function openGoogleMapsVenue(
  affiliateOrVenue?: string | IAffiliateMapsSubject | null,
  ubicacionFallback?: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const payload =
    typeof affiliateOrVenue === 'string'
      ? { nombre: affiliateOrVenue, ubicacion: ubicacionFallback || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.' }
      : affiliateOrVenue;
  return openExternalLinkSafe(buildAffiliateGoogleMapsUrl(payload));
}

/**
 * Normaliza nombres y alias históricos de sedes para emparejar siempre
 * sus eventos activos aunque tengan variaciones de escritura en la BD.
 */
export function normalizeClubAlias(rawName?: string | null): string {
  const clean = String(rawName || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!clean) return '';

  if (clean.includes('incorfit')) return 'incorfit barre reformer studio';
  if (clean.includes('seal') && clean.includes('cross')) return 'seal crosstraining';
  if (clean.includes('truefit')) return 'truefit cabo studio';
  if (clean.includes('fitbox')) return 'fitbox cabo boxing studio';
  if (clean.includes('cabo') && clean.includes('pilates')) return 'cabo pilates';
  if (clean.includes('cabo') && clean.includes('yoga')) return 'cabo yoga and fitness';
  if (clean.includes('baja') && clean.includes('crossfit')) return 'baja crossfit gym';
  if (clean.includes('kinetic') && clean.includes('especialista')) return 'kinetic especialista';
  if (clean.includes('kinetic') && clean.includes('sports')) return 'kinetic sports club';
  if (clean.includes('kinetic') && clean.includes('oficial')) return 'kinetic oficial';
  if (clean.includes('palestra')) return 'palestra club';
  if (clean.includes('40') && clean.includes('padel')) return '40 0 padel club';

  return clean;
}

/**
 * Compara si dos nombres de sedes pertenecen al mismo Club o Especialista.
 */
export function isSameClubIdentity(nameA?: string | null, nameB?: string | null): boolean {
  const normA = normalizeClubAlias(nameA);
  const normB = normalizeClubAlias(nameB);
  if (!normA || !normB) return false;
  if (normA === normB) return true;
  if (normA.length >= 6 && normB.length >= 6) {
    return normA.includes(normB) || normB.includes(normA);
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Handles de Instagram confirmados manualmente como existentes. Cualquier otro handle
 * del catálogo semilla se trata como no verificado y se resuelve con fallback seguro.
 */
const VERIFIED_INSTAGRAM_HANDLES = new Set<string>(['kineticapp.mx']);

/** Handles reportados en auditoría como inexistentes ("User not found"). */
const REPORTED_BROKEN_INSTAGRAM_HANDLES = new Set<string>(['tropicalfitnesssjc']);

const RESERVED_OR_INVALID_IG_SLUGS = new Set<string>([
  'explore', 'search', 'p', 'reel', 'reels', 'stories', 'tv', 'accounts', 'direct',
  'about', 'legal', 'developer', 'directory', '__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype',
  'tostring', 'valueof', 'null', 'undefined', 'none', 'na', 'n_a', 'sin_instagram', 'instagram',
]);

/**
 * Valida estrictamente que la entrada sea un @handle oficial o URL de perfil de Instagram.
 * Rechaza URLs de búsqueda (/explore/search), espacios, inyecciones o handles inválidos.
 */
export function extractVerifiedInstagramHandle(raw?: unknown): string {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed || /\s/.test(trimmed) || /[<>"'\\]/.test(trimmed)) return '';
  if (/^(javascript|data|vbscript|file|about|blob|mailto|tel|whatsapp):/i.test(trimmed)) return '';
  if (/\/(explore|search|p|reel|reels|stories|tv|accounts|direct)(\/|\?|$)/i.test(trimmed) || /\?q=/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return '';
  }
  let candidate = '';
  if (/instagram\.com|instagr\.am|^https?:/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const match = trimmed.match(/^(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?(?:instagram\.com|instagr\.am)\/([a-zA-Z0-9._]{1,30})\/?$/i);
    if (!match) return '';
    candidate = match[1];
  } else {
    if (/[/:?#]/.test(trimmed)) return '';
    candidate = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
  }
  const h = candidate.toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[a-z0-9._]{1,30}$/.test(h) || !/[a-z0-9]/.test(h)) return '';
  if (h.startsWith('.') || h.endsWith('.') || h.includes('..')) return '';
  if (RESERVED_OR_INVALID_IG_SLUGS.has(h) || REPORTED_BROKEN_INSTAGRAM_HANDLES.has(h)) return '';
  return h;
}

/**
 * Limpia un handle o URL de Instagram usando validación estricta de perfil oficial.
 * Devuelve cadena vacía si el handle no es válido.
 */
export function sanitizeInstagramHandle(raw?: string | null): string {
  return extractVerifiedInstagramHandle(raw);
}

/** Normaliza un WhatsApp a formato internacional E.164 sin "+" (MX por defecto). */
export function sanitizeWhatsAppNumber(raw?: string | null): string {
  const digits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const ten = digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('52') ? digits.slice(2) : digits;
  if (ten === '6241234567' || ten === '1234567890') return '';
  if (digits.length === 10) return `52${digits}`;
  if (digits.length >= 11 && digits.length <= 15) return digits;
  return '';
}

export interface IAffiliateInstagramTarget {
  handle?: string | null;
  isVerified?: boolean;
  whatsapp?: string | null;
  clubName?: string | null;
  city?: string | null;
  language?: 'es' | 'en' | string;
  onMissingHandle?: (message: string) => void;
}

/**
 * Resuelve el destino seguro del botón de Instagram de un afiliado:
 * abre el perfil directo SOLO si tiene @handle válido verificado; de lo contrario retorna ''.
 */
export function resolveAffiliateInstagramUrl(target: IAffiliateInstagramTarget): string {
  const handle = extractVerifiedInstagramHandle(target?.handle);
  if (handle && (target?.isVerified !== false || VERIFIED_INSTAGRAM_HANDLES.has(handle))) {
    return `https://www.instagram.com/${handle}/`;
  }
  return '';
}

export function openAffiliateInstagramSafe(target: IAffiliateInstagramTarget): Promise<boolean> {
  const url = resolveAffiliateInstagramUrl(target);
  if (!url) {
    target?.onMissingHandle?.(
      target?.language === 'en'
        ? 'This venue has not linked an official Instagram handle yet.'
        : 'Esta sede aún no ha vinculado su usuario oficial de Instagram.'
    );
    return Promise.resolve(false);
  }
  return openExternalLinkSafe(url);
}

export function openAffiliateWhatsAppSafe(
  whatsappRaw?: string | null,
  clubName?: string | null,
  language?: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const wa = sanitizeWhatsAppNumber(whatsappRaw);
  if (!wa) return Promise.resolve(false);
  const name = String(clubName || 'Kinetic').trim();
  const msg =
    language === 'en'
      ? `Hi, I saw your club ${name} on Kinetic App and I'd like more information.`
      : `Hola, vi su club ${name} en Kinetic App y me gustaría recibir más información.`;
  return openExternalLinkSafe(`https://wa.me/${wa}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`);
}

export function sanitizeExternalLinkUrl(rawUrl?: string | null): string | null {
  if (typeof rawUrl === 'string' && /(?:instagram\.com|instagr\.am)/i.test(rawUrl)) {
    if (!extractVerifiedInstagramHandle(rawUrl)) return null;
  }
  const url = String(rawUrl || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').trim();
  if (!url || url.startsWith('//')) return null;

  if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/.test(url) && !/^(https:|mailto:|tel:|whatsapp:)/i.test(url)) {
    return null;
  }

  const finalUrl = /^(https:|mailto:|tel:|whatsapp:)/i.test(url) ? url : `https://${url}`;
  if (/^https:/i.test(finalUrl)) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(finalUrl);
      if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:' || !parsed.hostname) return null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  } else if (!/^(mailto:|tel:|whatsapp:)/i.test(finalUrl)) {
    return null;
  }
  return finalUrl;
}

/**
 * Abre enlaces externos (Google Maps, Instagram, WhatsApp) de forma segura en iOS, Android y Web
 * evitando pestañas en blanco (about:blank) o parpadeos al regresar al navegador.
 */
export async function openExternalLinkSafe(rawUrl?: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
  const finalUrl = sanitizeExternalLinkUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!finalUrl) return false;

  try {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const anchor = document.createElement('a');
      anchor.href = finalUrl;
      if (!/^(mailto:|tel:)/i.test(finalUrl)) {
        anchor.target = '_blank';
        anchor.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
      }
      anchor.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.appendChild(anchor);
      anchor.click();
      setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          if (anchor.parentNode) anchor.parentNode.removeChild(anchor);
        } catch {}
      }, 150);
      return true;
    }

    const supported = await Linking.canOpenURL(finalUrl);
    if (supported) {
      await Linking.openURL(finalUrl);
      return true;
    }
    await Linking.openURL(finalUrl);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export { compressWebImageUri } from './webImageCompressLeaf';

export function sanitizeCleanText(raw: unknown): string {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return '';
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/\\r\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();
}
export function buildWhatsAppDirectUrl(phoneRaw?: string, customMsg?: string): string {
  const digits = String(phoneRaw || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  if (!digits) return '';
  const finalPhone = digits.length === 10 ? '52' + digits : digits;
  const text = encodeURIComponent(customMsg || '¡Hola! Vi su sede en KINETIC App y quiero pedir informes.');
  return 'https://wa.me/' + finalPhone + '?text=' + text;
}

import { Platform } from "react-native";
import * as ExpoCrypto from "expo-crypto";
import * as SplashScreen from "expo-splash-screen";

let hermesEntropyCounter = 1;

// KINETIC_WARN_FILTER_INSTALLED: Filtra avisos de deprecación de librerías externas en React 19 Web
export function installKineticWarnFilter(): void {
  const g: any =
    typeof globalThis !== "undefined"
      ? globalThis
      : typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? window
        : {};

  if (g.KINETIC_WARN_FILTER_INSTALLED) return;
  if (typeof console === "undefined") return;
  g.KINETIC_WARN_FILTER_INSTALLED = true;

  const shouldIgnoreLog = (args: any[]): boolean => {
    const msg = args
      .map((a) => {
        if (typeof a === "string") return a;
        if (a && typeof a.message === "string") return a.message;
        return "";
      })
      .join(" ");

    return (
      msg.includes('"shadow*" style props are deprecated') ||
      msg.includes("props.pointerEvents is deprecated") ||
      msg.includes("useNativeDriver") ||
      msg.includes("RCTAnimation") ||
      msg.includes("TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated") ||
      msg.includes("Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19")
    );
  };

  if (typeof console.warn === "function") {
    const origWarn = console.warn.bind(console);
    console.warn = (...args: any[]) => {
      if (shouldIgnoreLog(args)) return;
      origWarn(...args);
    };
  }

  if (typeof console.error === "function") {
    const origErr = console.error.bind(console);
    console.error = (...args: any[]) => {
      if (shouldIgnoreLog(args)) return;
      origErr(...args);
    };
  }
}

installKineticWarnFilter();

type ListenerFn = (event: any) => void;

const hermesListenersMap: Record<string, Set<ListenerFn>> = Object.create(null);
const hermesMemoryStorage: Record<string, string> = Object.create(null);

export function canUseHermesDevPrngFallback(devFlag?: unknown, nodeEnv?: unknown): boolean {
  return devFlag === true && String(nodeEnv ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() !== "production";
}

export function installHermesNativePolyfills(): void {
  if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    const webRoot = (typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : {}) as {
      requestIdleCallback?: unknown; cancelIdleCallback?: unknown;
    };
    if (typeof webRoot.requestIdleCallback !== "function") {
      webRoot.requestIdleCallback = (cb: (d: { didTimeout: boolean; timeRemaining: () => number }) => void) => {
        const start = Date.now();
        return setTimeout(() => cb({ didTimeout: false, timeRemaining: () => Math.max(0, 50 - (Date.now() - start)) }), 1);
      };
    }
    if (typeof webRoot.cancelIdleCallback !== "function") {
      webRoot.cancelIdleCallback = (id: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>) => clearTimeout(id);
    }
    return;
  }

  const g: any =
    typeof globalThis !== "undefined"
      ? globalThis
      : typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? window
        : {};

  if (typeof g.window === "undefined") {
    g.window = g;
  }

  if (typeof g.window.location === "undefined") {
    g.window.location = {
      href: "",
      pathname: "",
      hostname: "",
      search: "",
      hash: "",
      origin: "",
      assign: () => {},
      replace: () => {},

    g.window.addEventListener = (type: string, callback: ListenerFn) => {
      if (!type || typeof callback !== "function") return;

      hermesListenersMap[type].add(callback);

    g.window.removeEventListener = (type: string, callback: ListenerFn) => {

      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(hermesMemoryStorage, key)
        ? hermesMemoryStorage[key]
        : null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string): void => {
      hermesMemoryStorage[String(key)] = String(value ?? "");
    },
    removeItem: (key: string): void => {

    clear: (): void => {

      if (typeof console !== "undefined" && typeof console.error === "function") {
        console.error("[KINETIC_BOOT_SHIELD]", safeMsg);
      }
      const hideSplashSafe = () => {
        try {
          Promise.resolve(SplashScreen?.hideAsync?.()).catch(() => {});

        setTimeout(hideSplashSafe, 250);
      }
      if (typeof __DEV__ !== "undefined" && __DEV__ === true && typeof prevHandler === "function") {
        prevHandler(error, isFatal);
      }

  }
  if (typeof g.sessionStorage === "undefined") {
    g.sessionStorage = safeStorage;
  }
}

export const STEALTH_RIVAL_HASHES = new Set([1507459749, 1800830082, 79832761, 2447318640, 2016519120]);
export const MAX_CONCIERGE_PROMPT_CHARS = 600;
export const MAX_CONCIERGE_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 320;
export const CONCIERGE_HARD_TIMEOUT_MS = 6200;

export function hasStealthRivalHashToken(raw: string): boolean {
  const norm = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  return norm.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).some((tok) => {
    if (!tok) return false;
    let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < tok.length; i += 1) h = Math.imul(h ^ tok.charCodeAt(i), 16777619) >>> 0;
    return STEALTH_RIVAL_HASHES.has(h);
  });
}

export function redactSensitiveDlpBeforeAi(rawInput: string, maxChars = MAX_CONCIERGE_PROMPT_CHARS): { sanitized: string; redactedCount: number } {
  let text = String(rawInput || '').slice(0, maxChars);
  let count = 0;
  const swap = (re: RegExp, token: string): void => {
    text = text.replace(re, () => {
      count += 1;
      return token;
    });
  };
  swap(/\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}\b/g, '[REDACTED_JWT]');
  swap(/\b(?:sk|rk|pk)_(?:live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9_]{8,}\b/gi, '[REDACTED_KEY]');
  swap(/\b(?:whsec|sbp|sb_secret|ghp)_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b/gi, '[REDACTED_KEY]');
  swap(/\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{16,}\b/g, '[REDACTED_KEY]');
  swap(/\b\d{18}\b/g, '[REDACTED_CLABE]');
  text = text.replace(/\b(?:\d[ -]?){13,19}\b/g, (m: string) => {
    const d = m.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (d.length >= 13 && d.length <= 19) {
      count += 1;
      return '[REDACTED_CARD]';
    }
    return m;
  });
  swap(/\b[A-Z&Ñ]{3,4}\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}\b/gi, '[REDACTED_RFC]');
  text = text.replace(/\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b/gi, (m: string) => {
    if (m.toLowerCase() === 'soporte@kineticapp.com.mx') return m;
    count += 1;
    return '[REDACTED_EMAIL]';
  });
  text = text.replace(/(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?(?:\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.-]?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4})\b/g, (m: string) => {
    const d = m.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (d.length >= 10 && d.length <= 15) {
      count += 1;
      return '[REDACTED_PHONE]';
    }
    return m;
  });
  return { sanitized: text.trim(), redactedCount: count };
}

const POISON_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export function pickAllowedScalarPayload(
  raw: unknown,
  allowedKeys: readonly string[]
): { ok: boolean; value: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>; rejectedKeys: string[] } {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
    return { ok: false, value: {}, rejectedKeys: ['_root'] };
  }
  const allowed = new Set(allowedKeys);
  const out: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> = {};
  const rejected: string[] = [];
  for (const key of Object.keys(raw)) {
    if (POISON_KEYS.has(key) || !allowed.has(key)) {
      rejected.push(key);
      continue;
    }
    const val = (raw as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    const isScalar =
      val === null ||
      typeof val === 'string' ||
      (typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val)) ||
      typeof val === 'boolean';
    if (!isScalar) {
      rejected.push(key);
      continue;
    }
    out[key] = typeof val === 'string' ? val.slice(0, 800) : val;
  }
  return { ok: rejected.length === 0, value: out, rejectedKeys: rejected };
}

export function sanitizePostgrestFilterToken(raw: unknown): string {
  return String(raw || '')
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[(),*;"'`\\/%$.:<>[\]{}|!@#&=?+]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 64);
}

export function computeTokenBucketState(input: {
  currentTokens: number;
  lastUpdatedMs: number;
  nowMs: number;
  cost?: number;
  capacity?: number;
  refillPerSec?: number;
}): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterSeconds: number } {
  const cap = Math.max(1, input.capacity ?? 12);
  const rate = Math.max(0.001, input.refillPerSec ?? 0.05);
  const cost = Math.max(0.5, input.cost ?? 1);
  const elapsedSec = Math.max(0, (input.nowMs - input.lastUpdatedMs) / 1000);
  const refilled = Math.min(cap, Math.max(0, input.currentTokens) + elapsedSec * rate);
  if (refilled < cost) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      remaining: Number(refilled.toFixed(3)),
      retryAfterSeconds: Math.ceil((cost - refilled) / rate),
    };
  }
  return {
    allowed: true,
    remaining: Number(Math.max(0, refilled - cost).toFixed(3)),
    retryAfterSeconds: 0,
  };
}

export function createConciergeCircuitBreaker(opts?: {
  timeoutMs?: number;
  failureThreshold?: number;
  cooldownMs?: number;
}) {
  const timeoutMs = Math.min(6500, Math.max(1500, opts?.timeoutMs ?? CONCIERGE_HARD_TIMEOUT_MS));
  const threshold = Math.max(1, opts?.failureThreshold ?? 3);
  const cooldownMs = Math.max(5000, opts?.cooldownMs ?? 30000);
  let failures = 0;
  let openUntil = 0;

  return {
    timeoutMs,
    getState: () => ({ failures, isOpen: Date.now() < openUntil, openUntil }),
    reset: () => { failures = 0; openUntil = 0; },
    run: async <T>(fn: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>): Promise<{ ok: boolean; value?: T; reason?: string }> => {
      if (Date.now() < openUntil) return { ok: false, reason: 'CIRCUIT_OPEN' };
      const ctrl = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeoutMs);
      try {
        const value = await fn(ctrl.signal);
        failures = 0;
        openUntil = 0;
        return { ok: true, value };
      } catch (err) {
        failures += 1;
        if (failures >= threshold) openUntil = Date.now() + cooldownMs;
        return { ok: false, reason: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'UPSTREAM_ERROR' };
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    },
  };
}

export const CONCIERGE_NO_SE_FALLBACK = {
  es: 'No tengo ese dato exacto confirmado en la base oficial de Kinetic en este momento. Te invito a verificar disponibilidad vigente en el Radar Deportivo o escribir a soporte@kineticapp.com.mx.',
  en: 'I do not have that exact confirmed detail in Kinetic’s official knowledge base right now. Please check live availability in the Sports Radar or contact soporte@kineticapp.com.mx.',
};

export function sanitizeConciergeOutputPureBrand(
  rawText: string,
  lang: 'es' | 'en'
): { text: string; blockedLeak: boolean } {
  const dlp = redactSensitiveDlpBeforeAi(rawText || '', 1400);
  let cleaned = dlp.sanitized;
  let blocked = dlp.redactedCount > 0;
  if (hasStealthRivalHashToken(cleaned)) {
    blocked = true;
    cleaned = CONCIERGE_NO_SE_FALLBACK[lang];
  }
  cleaned = cleaned
    .replace(/\bKinetic\s+OS\b/gi, 'Kinetic')
    .replace(/\bEscuadr[oó]n(?:es)?\b/gi, 'Equipo')
    .replace(/\bKinetiSquads?\b/gi, 'Equipos Kinetic')
    .replace(/\bSquads?\b/gi, (lang === 'en' ? 'Team' : 'Equipo'))
    .replace(/\bRPG\b/gi, lang === 'en' ? 'athletic progression' : 'progreso atlético')
    .replace(/\b(Supabase|pgvector|PostgREST|Edge Function|SERVICE_ROLE)\b/gi, 'Kinetic');
  if (!cleaned.trim()) cleaned = CONCIERGE_NO_SE_FALLBACK[lang];
  return { text: cleaned.slice(0, 1400), blockedLeak: blocked };
}

function normLexTokens(raw: string): string[] {
  return String(raw || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9@._-]+/g, ' ').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
}

export function deriveAnonRateLimitActorKey(input: {
  cfIp?: string | null;
  realIp?: string | null;
  forwardedFor?: string | null;
  clientBucket?: string | null;
}): string {
  const xff = String(input.forwardedFor || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const ip = (String(input.cfIp || '').trim() || String(input.realIp || '').trim() || xff[xff.length - 1] || 'anon').slice(0, 64);
  let h1 = 2166136261 >>> 0;
  let h2 = 33554467 >>> 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ip.length; i += 1) {
    const ch = ip.charCodeAt(i);
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch, 16777619) >>> 0;
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (ch + 13), 2654435761) >>> 0;
  }
  return `ipb_${h1.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}${h2.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
}

export function evaluateGeminiQuotaShortCircuit(
  state: { cooldownUntilMs: number },
  event: { nowMs: number; httpStatus?: number | null; timedOut?: boolean; errorMsg?: string | null; cooldownWindowMs?: number }
): { shortCircuited: boolean; useDeterministicFallback: boolean; nextCooldownUntilMs: number; isQuotaError: boolean } {
  const win = Math.max(60_000, event.cooldownWindowMs ?? 600_000);
  if (event.nowMs < state.cooldownUntilMs) {
    return { shortCircuited: true, useDeterministicFallback: true, nextCooldownUntilMs: state.cooldownUntilMs, isQuotaError: true };
  }
  const st = Number(event.httpStatus || 0);
  const msg = String(event.errorMsg || '');
  const isQuota = st === 402 || st === 429 || /prepayment credits|resource_exhausted|quota|billing/i.test(msg);
  const useFallback = isQuota || Boolean(event.timedOut) || st >= 400;
  return {
    shortCircuited: false,
    useDeterministicFallback: useFallback,
    nextCooldownUntilMs: isQuota ? event.nowMs + win : 0,
    isQuotaError: isQuota,
  };
}

export function extractKbLexicalQuery(rawQuery: string): string {
  const toks = normLexTokens(rawQuery).filter((t) => t.length >= 2 && !KB_STOPWORDS.has(t));
  return toks.slice(0, 6).join(' ') || normLexTokens(rawQuery).slice(0, 4).join(' ') || String(rawQuery || '').trim().slice(0, 64);
}

export function buildDeterministicConciergeFallback(input: {
  query: string;
  lang: 'es' | 'en';
  isLanding: boolean;
  kbRows?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  servicios?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
}): { status: 200; ok: true; mode: 'kb_verified_fallback'; matched: boolean; reply: string } {
  const lang = input.lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
  const rawKb = Array.isArray(input.kbRows) ? input.kbRows : [];
  const kbList = input.isLanding ? rawKb.filter((r) => !['boveda', 'reservas', 'socios'].includes(String(r.category || ''))) : rawKb;
  const clubs = Array.isArray(input.clubs) ? input.clubs : [];
  const srvs = Array.isArray(input.servicios) ? input.servicios : [];

  const qToks = normLexTokens(input.query).filter((t) => t.length >= 2 && !KB_STOPWORDS.has(t));
  const catalogVocab = new Set<string>();
  const addVocab = (raw: string): void => { for (const w of normLexTokens(raw)) catalogVocab.add(w); };
  for (const k of kbList) addVocab(`${k.title || ''} ${k.content || ''} ${Array.isArray(k.keywords) ? k.keywords.join(' ') : ''}`);
  for (const c of clubs) addVocab(`${c.nombre || ''} ${c.disciplina || ''} ${c.ubicacion || ''}`);
  for (const s of srvs) addVocab(`${s.negocio_nombre || ''} ${s.nombre_servicio || ''} ${s.categoria || ''}`);
  const alien = qToks.filter((t) => t.length >= 3 && !KNOWN_KINETIC_VOCAB.has(t) && !catalogVocab.has(t));
  if (alien.length > 0 && srvs.length === 0 && clubs.length === 0) {
    return { status: 200, ok: true, mode: 'kb_verified_fallback', matched: false, reply: CONCIERGE_NO_SE_FALLBACK[lang] };
  }

  const scored = kbList.map((row) => {
    const kw = Array.isArray(row.keywords) ? row.keywords.join(' ') : '';
    const hay = new Set(normLexTokens(`${row.title || ''} ${row.content || ''} ${kw}`));
    const hits = qToks.reduce((acc, tok) => acc + (hay.has(tok) ? 1 : 0), 0);
    return { row, hits };
  }).sort((a, b) => b.hits - a.hits);

  const parts: string[] = scored.filter((x) => x.hits > 0).slice(0, 2).map((x) => String(x.row.content || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
  for (const s of srvs.slice(0, 2)) {
    const line = input.isLanding
      ? `${String(s.nombre_servicio || '')} (${String(s.negocio_nombre || '')})`
      : `${String(s.nombre_servicio || '')} en ${String(s.negocio_nombre || '')} (${String(s.precio_kc || 0)} KC${s.hora_inicio ? `, ${String(s.hora_inicio)}` : ''})`;
    if (line.trim()) parts.push(line);
  }
  for (const c of clubs.slice(0, 2)) {
    parts.push(`${String(c.nombre || '')} (${String(c.disciplina || 'Kinetic')}, ${String(c.ubicacion || 'Los Cabos')})`);
  }

  if (parts.length === 0) {
    const isGeneralKinetic = alien.length === 0 && qToks.some((t) => ['kinetic', 'atletas', 'athletes', 'funciona', 'zonas'].includes(t));
    if (isGeneralKinetic && kbList.length > 0) parts.push(String(kbList[0].content || '').trim());
  }
  if (parts.length === 0 && alien.length === 0 && qToks.some((t) => ['hola', 'hello', 'ayuda', 'help'].includes(t))) {
    const hi = lang === 'en'
      ? 'Hi! Ask me about Kinetic 3D Digital Pass, Streak Shield 24h, Los Cabos venues, or reservations.'
      : 'Hola! Pregúntame sobre tu Pase Digital Kinetic 3D, Escudo 24h, sedes en Los Cabos o reservas.';
    return { status: 200, ok: true, mode: 'kb_verified_fallback', matched: true, reply: hi };
  }
  if (parts.length === 0) {
    return { status: 200, ok: true, mode: 'kb_verified_fallback', matched: false, reply: CONCIERGE_NO_SE_FALLBACK[lang] };
  }
  const safe = sanitizeConciergeOutputPureBrand(parts.join(' '), lang);
  return { status: 200, ok: true, mode: 'kb_verified_fallback', matched: !safe.blockedLeak, reply: safe.text };
}
