import { File } from 'expo-file-system';
import { readAsStringAsync } from 'expo-file-system/legacy';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

const B64_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
const B64_LOOKUP = (() => {
  const table = new Int16Array(256);
  table.fill(-1);
  for (let i = 0; i < B64_ALPHABET.length; i++) {
    table[B64_ALPHABET.charCodeAt(i)] = i;
  }
  return table;
})();

/**
 * Decodificador binario puro Base64 / DataURI -> Uint8Array.
 * Rechaza cadenas vacías, corruptas o malformadas devolviendo `null` sin lanzar excepciones.
 */
export function decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(rawInput: unknown): Uint8Array | null {
  try {
    if (typeof rawInput !== 'string') return null;
    const trimmed = rawInput.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return null;

    let b64Payload = trimmed;
    if (/^data:/i.test(trimmed)) {
      const match = trimmed.match(/^data:[^;,]+(?:;charset=[^;,]+)?;base64,([\s\S]+)$/i);
      if (!match || !match[1]) return null;
      b64Payload = match[1];
    }

    const clean = b64Payload.replace(/[\r\n\t ]+/g, '');
    if (clean.length < 4 || clean.length % 4 !== 0) return null;
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(clean)) return null;

    const padCount = clean.endsWith('==') ? 2 : clean.endsWith('=') ? 1 : 0;
    const byteLen = (clean.length * 3) / 4 - padCount;
    if (byteLen <= 0) return null;

    const out = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
    let p = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += 4) {
      const c0 = clean.charCodeAt(i);
      const c1 = clean.charCodeAt(i + 1);
      const c2 = clean.charCodeAt(i + 2);
      const c3 = clean.charCodeAt(i + 3);
      const a = c0 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c0] : -1;
      const b = c1 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c1] : -1;
      const c = c2 === 61 ? 0 : c2 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c2] : -1;
      const d = c3 === 61 ? 0 : c3 < 256 ? B64_LOOKUP[c3] : -1;
      if (a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 || d < 0) return null;

      out[p++] = (a << 2) | (b >> 4);
      if (p < byteLen) out[p++] = ((b & 15) << 4) | (c >> 2);
      if (p < byteLen) out[p++] = ((c & 3) << 6) | d;
    }

    return out.byteLength > 0 ? out : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function encodeUint8ArrayToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  if (!(bytes instanceof Uint8Array) || bytes.byteLength === 0) return '';
  let out = '';
  const len = bytes.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i];
    const b1 = i + 1 < len ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const b2 = i + 2 < len ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
    out += B64_ALPHABET[b0 >> 2];
    out += B64_ALPHABET[((b0 & 3) << 4) | (b1 >> 4)];
    out += i + 1 < len ? B64_ALPHABET[((b1 & 15) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)] : '=';
    out += i + 2 < len ? B64_ALPHABET[b2 & 63] : '=';
  }
  return out;
}

export const ALLOWED_STORAGE_IMAGE_MIMES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/heic'] as const;
export type StorageImageMime = (typeof ALLOWED_STORAGE_IMAGE_MIMES)[number];
export const MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
export const AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES = 8_388_608;

  'image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/heic', 'image/heif', 'video/mp4', 'video/quicktime',

const SAFE_AVATARS_EXT_RE = /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|heic|heif|mp4|mov)$/i;

export interface ISafeStorageImageValidationResult {

  ext?: 'jpg' | 'png' | 'webp' | 'heic';
  byteLength: number;
  reason?: 'empty_payload' | 'file_too_large' | 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' | 'active_content_detected' | 'invalid_magic_bytes';
}

const MIME_ALIASES: Record<string, { contentType: StorageImageMime; ext: 'jpg' | 'png' | 'webp' | 'heic' }> = {
  'image/jpeg': { contentType: 'image/jpeg', ext: 'jpg' },
  'image/jpg': { contentType: 'image/jpeg', ext: 'jpg' },
  'image/png': { contentType: 'image/png', ext: 'png' },
  'image/webp': { contentType: 'image/webp', ext: 'webp' },

  'image/heif': { contentType: 'image/heic', ext: 'heic' },
};

const DANGEROUS_URI_EXT_RE = /\.(?:svgz?|html?|xhtml|xml|js|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx|php|jsp|asp|aspx|exe|dll|sh|bat|cmd|msi|apk|pdf)(?:\.|$)/i;

export function validateAvatarsBucketUpload(input: {
  objectName?: string | null;
  authUid?: string | null;
  isMasterAdmin?: boolean;
  mimeType?: string | null;
  byteLength?: number | null;
}): { ok: boolean; reason?: 'empty_or_oversize' | 'unauthorized_folder' | 'unsafe_extension' | 'unsafe_mime' } {
  const cleanName = String(input?.objectName || '').trim().split(/[?#]/)[0];
  const size = Number(input?.byteLength ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(size) || size <= 0 || size > AVATARS_BUCKET_MAX_BYTES) {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'empty_or_oversize' };
  }
  const folder = cleanName.split('/')[0] || '';
  const uid = String(input?.authUid || '').trim();
  if (!input?.isMasterAdmin && (!uid || folder !== uid)) {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'unauthorized_folder' };
  }
  const lowName = cleanName.toLowerCase();
  if (!SAFE_AVATARS_EXT_RE.test(lowName) || DANGEROUS_URI_EXT_RE.test(lowName)) {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'unsafe_extension' };
  }
  const cleanMime = String(input?.mimeType || '').trim().toLowerCase().split(';')[0].trim();
  if (!cleanMime || !AVATARS_ALLOWED_MIME_SET.has(cleanMime)) {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'unsafe_mime' };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}
const HEIC_FTYP_BRANDS = new Set(['heic', 'heix', 'hevc', 'hevx', 'mif1', 'msf1']);

const asciiAt = (bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, len: number): string => {
  let out = '';
  for (let i = start; i < start + len && i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
    out += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  }
  return out;
};

export function validateSafeStorageImagePayload(input: {
  bytes?: Uint8Array | null;
  uriOrName?: string | null;
  declaredMime?: string | null;
  maxBytes?: number;
}): ISafeStorageImageValidationResult {
  const bytes = input?.bytes;
  if (!(bytes instanceof Uint8Array) || bytes.byteLength <= 0) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: 0, reason: 'empty_payload' };
  }
  const maxBytes = typeof input.maxBytes === 'number' && input.maxBytes > 0 ? input.maxBytes : MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES;
  if (bytes.byteLength > maxBytes) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'file_too_large' };
  }

  const rawMime = String(input.declaredMime || '').trim().toLowerCase().split(';')[0].trim();
  if (rawMime && !MIME_ALIASES[rawMime]) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' };
  }

  const rawUri = String(input.uriOrName || '').trim();
  if (rawUri) {
    if (/^data:/i.test(rawUri)) {
      const dataMimeMatch = rawUri.match(/^data:([^;,]+)/i);
      const dataMime = String(dataMimeMatch?.[1] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!dataMime || !MIME_ALIASES[dataMime]) {
        return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' };
      }
    } else {
      const cleanPath = rawUri.split(/[?#]/)[0].trim();
      if (DANGEROUS_URI_EXT_RE.test(cleanPath)) {
        return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'unsafe_mime_or_ext' };
      }
    }
  }

  let offset = 0;
  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xef && bytes[1] === 0xbb && bytes[2] === 0xbf) offset = 3;
  while (offset < bytes.length && offset < 64 && (bytes[offset] === 0x20 || bytes[offset] === 0x09 || bytes[offset] === 0x0a || bytes[offset] === 0x0d)) {
    offset += 1;
  }
  const headText = asciiAt(bytes, offset, 24).toLowerCase();
  if (
    /^(?:<svg\b|<!doctype\b|<html\b|<script\b|<\?xml\b)/.test(headText) ||
    (bytes.length >= 2 && bytes[0] === 0x4d && bytes[1] === 0x5a) ||
    (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x7f && bytes[1] === 0x45 && bytes[2] === 0x4c && bytes[3] === 0x46) ||
    (bytes.length >= 2 && bytes[0] === 0x23 && bytes[1] === 0x21)
  ) {
    return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'active_content_detected' };
  }

  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xd8 && bytes[2] === 0xff) {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/jpeg', ext: 'jpg', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  if (
    bytes.length >= 8 &&
    bytes[0] === 0x89 && bytes[1] === 0x50 && bytes[2] === 0x4e && bytes[3] === 0x47 &&
    bytes[4] === 0x0d && bytes[5] === 0x0a && bytes[6] === 0x1a && bytes[7] === 0x0a
  ) {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/png', ext: 'png', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && asciiAt(bytes, 0, 4) === 'RIFF' && asciiAt(bytes, 8, 4) === 'WEBP') {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/webp', ext: 'webp', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  if (bytes.length >= 12 && asciiAt(bytes, 4, 4) === 'ftyp' && HEIC_FTYP_BRANDS.has(asciiAt(bytes, 8, 4).toLowerCase())) {
    return { ok: true, contentType: 'image/heic', ext: 'heic', byteLength: bytes.byteLength };
  }

  return { ok: false, byteLength: bytes.byteLength, reason: 'invalid_magic_bytes' };
}

export function isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(uri?: string | null): boolean {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  return /^https:\/\/(?!localhost\b|127\.|10\.|192\.168\.)/i.test(clean) && !/^blob:/i.test(clean);
}

export function isLocalOrEphemeralMediaUri(uri?: string | null): boolean {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return false;
  return !isVerifiedHttpsMediaUrl(clean);
}

/**
 * Convierte cualquier URI multimedia (`data:image/...`, `file://...`, `content://...`, `blob:...`)
 * en `Uint8Array` puro verificando `byteLength > 0`. Prohibido usar `fetch(uri).blob()`.
 */
export async function readMediaUriAsUint8Array(rawUri: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  const uri = String(rawUri || '').trim();
  if (!uri) return null;

  if (/^data:/i.test(uri)) {
    return decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(uri);
  }

  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' && /^(file|content|ph|assets-library):\/\//i.test(uri)) {
    if (/^file:\/\//i.test(uri)) {
      try {
        const fsFile = new File(uri);
        const bytes = await fsFile.bytes();
        if (bytes && bytes.byteLength > 0) {
          return bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const b64 = await readAsStringAsync(uri, { encoding: 'base64' });
      const decoded = decodeBase64OrDataUriToUint8Array(b64);
      if (decoded && decoded.byteLength > 0) return decoded;
    } catch {}
  }

  if (!/^(blob:|https?:\/\/|file:\/\/|content:\/\/)/i.test(uri)) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(uri);
    if (!resp || (typeof resp.ok === 'boolean' && !resp.ok && resp.status !== 0)) return null;
    const ct = String(resp.headers?.get?.('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (/text\/html|application\/json|svg|xml|javascript/.test(ct)) return null;
    const cLen = Number(resp.headers?.get?.('content-length') || 0);
    if (Number.isFinite(cLen) && cLen > MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES) return null;
    const ab = await resp.arrayBuffer();
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(ab);
    return bytes.byteLength > 0 && bytes.byteLength <= MAX_STORAGE_IMAGE_BYTES ? bytes : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export const BIOMETRIC_BACKGROUND_LOCK_THRESHOLD_MS = 15_000;

export type TransientNativeOverlayKind =
  | 'biometric_prompt'
  | 'qr_camera'
  | 'image_picker'
  | 'calendar_perm'
  | 'oidc';

const _activeNativeOverlays = new Set<TransientNativeOverlayKind>();
let _lastTransientOverlayClearedAtMs = 0;

export function markTransientNativeOverlayActive(
  kind: TransientNativeOverlayKind,
  active: boolean
): void {
  if (active) {
    _activeNativeOverlays.add(kind);
    return;
  }
  _activeNativeOverlays.delete(kind);
  _lastTransientOverlayClearedAtMs = Date.now();
}

export function isTransientNativeOverlayActive(nowMs = Date.now()): boolean {
  if (_activeNativeOverlays.size > 0) return true;
  return _lastTransientOverlayClearedAtMs > 0 && nowMs - _lastTransientOverlayClearedAtMs < 2_500;
}

export function clearTransientNativeOverlaysForTest(): void {
  _activeNativeOverlays.clear();
  _lastTransientOverlayClearedAtMs = 0;
}

export interface IBiometricGateEvalInput {
  platformOs: string;
  hasActiveSession: boolean;
  isBiometricLockEnabled: boolean;
  isColdBootPending: boolean;
  backgroundEnteredAtMs: number | null;
  nowMs: number;
  isTransientOverlayActive: boolean;
  isOidcTransitionActive: boolean;
  wasInteractiveLoginVerified: boolean;
}

export type BiometricGateTriggerReason =
  | 'cold_boot'
  | 'background_timeout'
  | 'none';

export interface IBiometricGateEvalOutput {
  shouldLock: boolean;
  reason: BiometricGateTriggerReason;
  clearColdBootPending: boolean;
}

export function evaluateBiometricAppGateState(
  input: IBiometricGateEvalInput
): IBiometricGateEvalOutput {
  if (input.platformOs === 'web') {
    return { shouldLock: false, reason: 'none', clearColdBootPending: true };
  }
  if (!input.hasActiveSession || !input.isBiometricLockEnabled) {
    return { shouldLock: false, reason: 'none', clearColdBootPending: true };
  }
  if (input.wasInteractiveLoginVerified && input.isColdBootPending) {
    return { shouldLock: false, reason: 'none', clearColdBootPending: true };
  }
  if (input.isTransientOverlayActive || input.isOidcTransitionActive) {
    return { shouldLock: false, reason: 'none', clearColdBootPending: false };
  }
  if (input.isColdBootPending) {
    return { shouldLock: true, reason: 'cold_boot', clearColdBootPending: true };
  }
  if (
    typeof input.backgroundEnteredAtMs === 'number' &&
    input.backgroundEnteredAtMs > 0 &&
    input.nowMs - input.backgroundEnteredAtMs >= BIOMETRIC_BACKGROUND_LOCK_THRESHOLD_MS
  ) {
    return { shouldLock: true, reason: 'background_timeout', clearColdBootPending: true };
  }
  return { shouldLock: false, reason: 'none', clearColdBootPending: false };
}

export const LIVE_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(
  RAW_BIO_PAIRS.map(([es, en]) => [normalizeClubBioKey(es), en])
);

export const lookupLiveClubBioEn = (raw?: string | null): string | null => {
  const key = normalizeClubBioKey(raw);
  if (!key) return null;
  return LIVE_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[key] || null;
};

export const translateSpanishVenueBioFallback = (text: string): string => {
  if (!text) return text;
  const direct = lookupLiveClubBioEn(text);
  if (direct) return direct;
  let out = text;
  for (const [pattern, replacement] of SPANISH_BIO_CLAUSE_RULES) {
    out = out.replace(pattern, replacement);
  }
  return out;
};

export const resolveOnAccentLock = (solidBgHex: string) => {
  const norm = String(solidBgHex || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (norm === '#00F0FF' || norm === '#00E5FF' || norm === '#00D8EB') return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' };
  if (norm === '#00FF66' || norm === '#059669') return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#047857' };
  if (norm === '#FFCC00' || norm === '#FFD700') return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#B45309' };
  if (norm === '#9D4EDD' || norm === '#B026FF' || norm === '#7C3AED') return { textColor: '#FFFFFF', iconColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#5B21B6' };
  if (norm === '#FF3B30' || norm === '#EF4444') return { textColor: '#FFFFFF', iconColor: '#FFFFFF', borderBottomColor: '#991B1B' };
  return { textColor: '#050505', iconColor: '#050505', borderBottomColor: '#0369A1' };
};

export const DARK_ELEVATED_HEXES = new Set([
  '#080C12', '#090C12', '#0A0C12', '#0A0D14', '#0A0F18', '#0B0E14', '#0C1017',
  '#0D1117', '#0E131F', '#0F1014', '#0F1218', '#0F172A', '#111318', '#12151C',
  '#141821', '#161B26', '#181C24', '#1A1D24', '#1E2430',
]);

export const resolveParentChildTextColor = (rawColor: string | undefined, parentIsLightSurface: boolean): string => {
  const c = String(rawColor || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!parentIsLightSurface) {
    if (c === '#050505' || c === '#0F172A' || c === '#000000' || c === '#111827') return '#FFFFFF';
    if (c === '#9D4EDD' || c === '#7C3AED') return '#C77DFF';
    return rawColor || '#FFFFFF';
  }
  if (!c || c === '#FFFFFF' || c === '#FFF' || c === '#F8FAFC') return '#0F172A';
  if (c === '#CBD5E1' || c === '#E2E8F0' || c === '#D1D5DB') return '#334155';
  if (['#B5B5B5', '#A0A0A0', '#8E8E93', '#888', '#888888', '#94A3B8', '#64748B'].includes(c) || c.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255') || c.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255')) {
    return '#475569';
  }
  if (c === '#00F0FF' || c === '#00E5FF' || c === '#B8FFFF' || c === '#0284C7') return '#006B82';
  if (c === '#00FF66') return '#047857';
  if (c === '#FFCC00' || c === '#FFD700') return '#B45309';
  if (c === '#CD7F32') return '#92400E';
  if (c === '#FF3B30' || c === '#EF4444' || c === '#FF453A' || c === '#FF6B6B') return '#B91C1C';
  if (['#F3E8FF', '#E0AAFF', '#D8B4FE', '#C77DFF', '#B026FF', '#9D4EDD'].includes(c)) return '#6D28D9';
  return rawColor || '#0F172A';
};

export const build3DCardStyle = (isLight: boolean, accent: 'neutral' | 'cyan' | 'purple' = 'neutral'): ViewStyle => {
  if (isLight) {
    const lip = accent === 'cyan' ? '#0369A1' : accent === 'purple' ? '#5B21B6' : '#94A3B8';
    const side = accent === 'cyan' ? '#38BDF8' : accent === 'purple' ? '#A78BFA' : '#CBD5E1';
    return {
      backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderTopWidth: 1.5, borderLeftWidth: 1, borderRightWidth: 1, borderBottomWidth: 3.8,
      borderTopColor: '#FFFFFF', borderLeftColor: side, borderRightColor: side, borderBottomColor: lip,
      shadowColor: '#0F172A', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.08, shadowRadius: 10, elevation: 6,
    };
  }
  const lipDark = accent === 'cyan' ? '#008B99' : accent === 'purple' ? '#4A1478' : '#020408';
  return {
    backgroundColor: '#090C12', borderTopWidth: 1.5, borderLeftWidth: 1, borderRightWidth: 1, borderBottomWidth: 3.5,

    borderLeftColor: accent === 'cyan' ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10)',
    borderRightColor: accent === 'cyan' ? 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10)',

};

      }

      };

const isWhiteRgbaBorder = (val: unknown): boolean => {
  const up = String(val || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return up.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255') || up.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255');
};

type StyleRuleObj = Record<string, unknown>;

const capShadowAndAndroidElevation = (styleObj: StyleRuleObj, isLight: boolean): StyleRuleObj => {
  let out = styleObj;
  if (Number(out.shadowRadius) > 10) out = out === styleObj ? { ...out, shadowRadius: 10 } : (out.shadowRadius = 10, out);
  if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
    const hasBgProp = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(out, 'backgroundColor');
    const bgl = String(out.backgroundColor || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const isNonSolidBg = bgl === 'transparent' || bgl.startsWith('rgba(') || bgl.startsWith('hsla(');
    if ((hasBgProp && isNonSolidBg) || (Number(out.elevation) > 0 && (!hasBgProp || isNonSolidBg))) {
      out = { ...out, elevation: 0, shadowOpacity: 0, shadowRadius: 0 };
    } else if (Number(out.elevation) > (isLight ? 2 : 3)) {
      out = {
        ...out,
        elevation: isLight ? 2 : 3,
        shadowColor: isLight ? '#64748B' : '#000000',
        ...(isLight ? { shadowOpacity: 0.08 } : {}),
      };
    }
  }
  return out;
};

export const adaptStyleSheetForTheme = <T extends Record<string, object>>(
  baseStyles: T,
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme,
  mediaLockKeys: string[] = []
): T => {
  if (!baseStyles) return baseStyles;
  const mediaSet = new Set(mediaLockKeys);

  if (resolvedTheme !== 'light') {
    const darkAdapted: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const key of Object.keys(baseStyles)) {
      let raw = baseStyles[key] as StyleRuleObj | undefined;
      if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !mediaSet.has(key)) {
        const upColor = typeof raw.color === 'string' ? raw.color.trim().toUpperCase() : '';
        if (upColor === '#9D4EDD' || upColor === '#7C3AED') raw = { ...raw, color: '#C77DFF' };
        raw = capShadowAndAndroidElevation(raw, false);
      }
      darkAdapted[key] = raw;
    }
    return darkAdapted as T;
  }

  const adapted: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(baseStyles)) {
    const raw = baseStyles[key] as StyleRuleObj | undefined;
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || mediaSet.has(key)) {
      adapted[key] = raw;
      continue;
    }
    const next: StyleRuleObj = { ...raw };
    const bg = String(next.backgroundColor || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const isSolidAccent = ['#00F0FF', '#00E5FF', '#00FF66', '#FFCC00', '#FFD700', '#CD7F32', '#A8B2C1', '#E0AAFF', '#9D4EDD', '#B026FF', '#FF3B30', '#EF4444'].includes(bg);
    const isMediaBackdrop = bg.startsWith('RGBA(5,') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(5 ');
    if (isSolidAccent || isMediaBackdrop) {
      if (isSolidAccent) {
        if (bg === '#00F0FF' || bg === '#00E5FF' || bg === '#00D8EB') next.borderBottomColor = '#0369A1';
        else if (bg === '#00FF66' || bg === '#059669') next.borderBottomColor = '#047857';
        else if (bg === '#FFCC00' || bg === '#FFD700') next.borderBottomColor = '#B45309';
        else if (bg === '#9D4EDD' || bg === '#B026FF' || bg === '#7C3AED') next.borderBottomColor = '#5B21B6';
        else if (bg === '#FF3B30' || bg === '#EF4444') next.borderBottomColor = '#991B1B';
      }
      adapted[key] = capShadowAndAndroidElevation(next, true);
      continue;
    }
    if (bg === '#050505') next.backgroundColor = '#ECF1F8';
    else if (key.toLowerCase().includes('dragpill') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255,0.2') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255,0.3') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.2') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.3')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#94A3B8';
    } else if (DARK_ELEVATED_HEXES.has(bg) || /^#0[89ABCDEF]/.test(bg) || /^#1[0-9A-E]/.test(bg) || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,255,255,0.0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.0')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF';
    } else if (/^#0[4567]/.test(bg)) next.backgroundColor = '#F1F5F9';
    else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(157, 78, 221') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(157,78,221') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(168, 85, 247') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(176, 38, 255')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#F5F3FF'; next.borderColor = '#7C3AED';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#5B21B6'; next.shadowColor = '#7C3AED'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.22; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 59, 48') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,59,48') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(239, 68, 68')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#FEF2F2'; next.borderColor = '#DC2626';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#991B1B'; next.shadowColor = '#DC2626'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.2; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(0, 240, 255') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(0,240,255')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#ECFEFF'; next.borderColor = '#0284C7';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#0369A1'; next.shadowColor = '#0284C7'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.22; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(0, 255, 102') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(0,255,102')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#ECFDF5'; next.borderColor = '#10B981';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#047857'; next.shadowColor = '#047857'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.2; }
    } else if (bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 204, 0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255,204,0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(255, 215, 0') || bg.startsWith('RGBA(245, 158, 11')) {
      next.backgroundColor = '#FEF3C7'; next.borderColor = '#F59E0B';
      if (next.borderTopColor) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
      if (next.borderBottomColor || Number(next.borderBottomWidth) >= 3) { next.borderBottomColor = '#B45309'; next.shadowColor = '#B45309'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.2; }
    }
    const bbc = String(next.borderBottomColor || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (/^#00[456789AB]/.test(bbc)) next.borderBottomColor = '#0369A1';
    else if (bbc === '#4A1478' || bbc === '#4C1D95' || bbc === '#3B0764') next.borderBottomColor = '#5B21B6';
    else if (bbc === '#7F0000' || bbc === '#991B1B') next.borderBottomColor = '#991B1B';
    else if (/^#0[234]/.test(bbc)) next.borderBottomColor = '#94A3B8';
    else if (bbc === '#1F222A' || isWhiteRgbaBorder(bbc) || bbc === '#CBD5E1') next.borderBottomColor = '#94A3B8';
    if (isWhiteRgbaBorder(next.borderColor)) next.borderColor = '#E2E8F0';
    if (isWhiteRgbaBorder(next.borderLeftColor)) next.borderLeftColor = '#E2E8F0';
    if (isWhiteRgbaBorder(next.borderRightColor)) next.borderRightColor = '#E2E8F0';
    if (next.borderTopColor && !String(next.borderTopColor).startsWith('#94')) next.borderTopColor = '#FFFFFF';
    if (String(next.shadowColor || '').toUpperCase() === '#000000') { next.shadowColor = '#0F172A'; next.shadowOpacity = 0.08; }
    if (typeof next.color === 'string') next.color = resolveParentChildTextColor(next.color, true);
    adapted[key] = capShadowAndAndroidElevation(next, true);
  }
  return adapted as T;
};

let _lastRnRuleCount = -1;
let _lastEngineCss = '';

export const syncOmniSurfaceEngine = (
  resolvedTheme: KineticResolvedTheme = 'dark',
  language: KineticLanguage = 'es'
): void => {
  const themeChanged = _lastSyncedTheme !== resolvedTheme;
  _lastSyncedTheme = resolvedTheme;
  const bgHex = resolvedTheme === 'light' ? LIGHT_M3_TOKENS.rootCanvas : DARK_M3_TOKENS.rootCanvas;
  try {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const htmlEl = document.documentElement;
      if (htmlEl.getAttribute('data-kinetic-theme') !== resolvedTheme) htmlEl.setAttribute('data-kinetic-theme', resolvedTheme);
      if (htmlEl.getAttribute('data-theme') !== resolvedTheme) htmlEl.setAttribute('data-theme', resolvedTheme);
      if (htmlEl.lang !== language) htmlEl.lang = language;
      if (htmlEl.getAttribute('translate') !== 'no') { htmlEl.setAttribute('translate', 'no'); htmlEl.classList.add('notranslate'); }
      if (htmlEl.style.backgroundColor !== bgHex) htmlEl.style.backgroundColor = bgHex;
      if (document.body) {
        if (document.body.style.backgroundColor !== bgHex) document.body.style.backgroundColor = bgHex;
        if (document.body.getAttribute('translate') !== 'no') { document.body.setAttribute('translate', 'no'); document.body.classList.add('notranslate'); }
      }
      if (document.head) {
        if (!document.head.querySelector('meta[name="google"]')) {
          const meta = document.createElement('meta');
          meta.setAttribute('name', 'google');
          meta.setAttribute('content', 'notranslate');
          document.head.appendChild(meta);
        }
        installKineticWebBaseCss();
        document.getElementById('kinetic-theme-engine')?.remove();
        let styleEl = document.getElementById('kinetic-3d-contrast-engine') as HTMLStyleElement | null;
        const isFirstInject = !styleEl;
        if (!styleEl) { styleEl = document.createElement('style'); styleEl.id = 'kinetic-3d-contrast-engine'; document.head.appendChild(styleEl); }
        const rnStyle = document.getElementById('react-native-stylesheet') as HTMLStyleElement | null;
        let rnCount = 0;
        try { rnCount = rnStyle?.sheet?.cssRules?.length ?? (rnStyle?.textContent?.length || 0); } catch {}
        if (isFirstInject || themeChanged || (_lastRnRuleCount <= 0 && rnCount > 0)) {
          const darkBase = 'html[data-kinetic-theme="dark"], html[data-kinetic-theme="dark"] body, html[data-kinetic-theme="dark"] #root { background-color: #050505 !important; color-scheme: dark; }';
          const nextCss = `${darkBase}\n${buildOmniWebM3Css()}`;
          if (nextCss !== _lastEngineCss) { styleEl.textContent = nextCss; _lastEngineCss = nextCss; }
          _lastRnRuleCount = rnCount;
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    RNStatusBar.setBarStyle(resolvedTheme === 'light' ? 'dark-content' : 'light-content', true);
    if (Platform.OS === 'android') RNStatusBar.setBackgroundColor(bgHex, true);
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
    const SystemUI = require('expo-system-ui');
    if (SystemUI?.setBackgroundColorAsync) SystemUI.setBackgroundColorAsync(bgHex).catch(() => {});
  } catch {}
};

const extractCleanDateIso = (raw: unknown): string => {
  const txt = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!txt) return '';
  const match = txt.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
};

const extractCleanHora = (raw: unknown): string => {
  const txt = String(raw || '').trim();
  const match = txt.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!match) return '08:00';
  const hh = String(Math.min(23, Math.max(0, Number(match[1]) || 0))).padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = String(Math.min(59, Math.max(0, Number(match[2]) || 0))).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${hh}:${mm}`;
};

const resolvePositiveSpotNumber = (raw: DigitalPassRecordInput): number | null => {
  const candidates = [raw.spot_number, raw.spot, raw.estacion, raw.selectedSpot];
  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const num = Math.round(Number(cand));
    if (Number.isFinite(num) && num > 0) return num;
  }
  return null;
};

export function buildKineticDigitalPassViewModel(
  rawInput: DigitalPassRecordInput | null | undefined,
  opts?: { isEn?: boolean; equipmentTypeOverride?: string | null; isAdminOverride?: boolean }
): IKineticDigitalPassViewModel {
  const raw = rawInput || {};
  const srv = (raw.servicios && typeof raw.servicios === 'object' ? raw.servicios : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null;
  const isEn = Boolean(opts?.isEn);
  const pickNonEmptyStr = (...vals: unknown[]): string =>
    vals.map((v) => String(v ?? '').trim()).find(Boolean) || '';
  const toFiniteNum = (v: unknown): number => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return NaN;
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() === '') return NaN;
    return Number(v);
  };
  const venueName = pickNonEmptyStr(raw.negocio_nombre, raw.sede, raw.club) || 'Kinetic Oficial';
  const disciplineRaw = pickNonEmptyStr(raw.categoria, raw.disciplina, srv?.categoria) || 'Fuerza';
  const sessionTitle =
    pickNonEmptyStr(raw.servicio, raw.nombre_servicio, raw.titulo_clase, raw.titulo, srv?.nombre_servicio) ||
    (isEn ? 'Kinetic Session' : 'Sesión Kinetic');
  const fechaClaseIso =
    extractCleanDateIso(raw.fecha_clase) ||
    extractCleanDateIso(raw.fecha_programada) ||
    extractCleanDateIso(raw.fecha_proyectada) ||
    extractCleanDateIso(raw.fecha) ||
    extractCleanDateIso(srv?.fecha_clase) ||
    extractCleanDateIso(srv?.fecha) ||
    extractCleanDateIso(raw.fecha_hora) ||
    '';
  const horaStr = extractCleanHora(
    raw.hora_inicio || raw.hora || srv?.hora_inicio || srv?.hora || (typeof raw.fecha_hora === 'string' && raw.fecha_hora.includes('T') ? raw.fecha_hora.split('T')[1] : '')
  );
  const durMin = Math.max(15, Math.min(480, Math.round(Number(raw.duracion_minutos ?? raw.duracion_min ?? srv?.duracion_minutos ?? 60) || 60)));
  const fechaDisplayLabel = fechaClaseIso
    ? formatKineticDate(fechaClaseIso, isEn ? 'en' : 'es', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }) || fechaClaseIso
    : (isEn ? 'Scheduled' : 'Programado');
  const scheduleLabel = `${horaStr} hrs (${durMin} min)`;
  const rawZone = String(raw.ubicacion || raw.zona || raw.ciudad || srv?.ubicacion || '').trim();
  const zoneLabel = rawZone || (venueName.toLowerCase() === 'kinetic oficial' ? 'Los Cabos, B.C.S.' : venueName);
  const rawCoach = String(raw.instructor_nombre || raw.coach || srv?.instructor_nombre || '').trim();
  const coachLabel = !rawCoach || rawCoach === 'Coach Oficial Kinetic'
    ? (isEn ? 'Official Kinetic Coach' : 'Coach Oficial Kinetic')
    : rawCoach;
  const zoneAndCoachLabel = `${zoneLabel} • ${coachLabel}`;

  const rawPrice = toFiniteNum(raw.precio_kc ?? raw.costo_total);
  const rawEscrow = toFiniteNum(raw.monto_escrow);
  const splitSum = (Number(raw.escrow_membresia) || 0) + (Number(raw.escrow_topup) || 0);
  const totalKc = Number.isFinite(rawPrice) ? Math.max(0, Math.round(rawPrice)) : 0;
  const isMasterPass = Boolean(
    opts?.isAdminOverride ||
    raw.es_pase_maestro === true ||
    raw.isMasterPass === true ||
    raw.isAdmin === true ||
    String(raw.tipo_pase || '').toLowerCase().includes('maestro') ||
    (Number.isFinite(rawPrice) && totalKc === 0 && (!Number.isFinite(rawEscrow) || rawEscrow <= 0) && splitSum <= 0)
  );
  const escrowKc = isMasterPass
    ? 0
    : Number.isFinite(rawEscrow) && rawEscrow > 0
      ? Math.round(rawEscrow)
      : splitSum > 0
        ? Math.round(splitSum)
        : Math.round(totalKc * 0.4);
  const rawPuerta = toFiniteNum(raw.monto_puerta);
  const puertaKc = isMasterPass
    ? 0
    : Number.isFinite(rawPuerta) && rawPuerta >= 0
      ? Math.round(rawPuerta)
      : Math.max(0, totalKc - escrowKc);

  const spotNumber = resolvePositiveSpotNumber(raw);
  const eqType = opts?.equipmentTypeOverride || raw.equipmentType || inferEquipmentByDiscipline(disciplineRaw, sessionTitle);
  const stationBadge = spotNumber !== null ? formatStudioStationBadge(eqType, spotNumber, isEn) : null;

  return {
    headerTitle: isEn ? 'KINETIC DIGITAL PASS' : 'PASE DIGITAL KINETIC',
    masterPassBadge: isMasterPass ? (isEn ? 'MASTER PASS • 0 KC' : 'PASE MAESTRO • 0 KC') : null,
    venueName,
    disciplineLabel: disciplineRaw,
    sessionTitle,
    fechaClaseIso,
    fechaDisplayLabel,
    scheduleLabel,
    zoneLabel,
    coachLabel,
    zoneAndCoachLabel,
    spotNumber,
    stationBadge,
    isMasterPass,
    totalKc: isMasterPass ? 0 : Math.max(totalKc, escrowKc + puertaKc),
    escrowKc,
    puertaKc,
    depositLabel: isEn ? 'Protected Deposit (40%)' : 'Anticipo Protegido (40%)',
    depositValueLabel: `${escrowKc} KC`,
    settlementLabel: isEn ? 'Front Desk Settlement (60%)' : 'Liquidación en Recepción (60%)',
    settlementValueLabel: `${puertaKc} KC`,
    formatQrValidityText: (secondsLeft: number) => {
      const cleanSecs = Math.max(0, Math.min(60, Math.round(Number(secondsLeft) || 0)));
      return isEn ? `60s QR validity: ${cleanSecs}s` : `Vigencia QR 60s: ${cleanSecs}s`;
    },
  };
}

export function buildCancelDualConfirmCopy(
  policy: ICancellationWindowPolicy,
  montoEscrow: number,
  isEn: boolean
): ICancelDualConfirmCopy {
  const safeEscrow = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(montoEscrow) || 0));
  const cancelLabel = isEn ? 'Cancel' : 'Cancelar';
  const confirmLabel = isEn ? 'Cancel Reservation' : 'Cancelar Reserva';
  const title = isEn ? 'Cancel Reservation' : 'Cancelar Reserva';

  if (policy.windowType === 'zero_kc_or_admin') {
    return {
      title,
      cancelLabel,
      confirmLabel,
      tone: 'amber',
      message: isEn
        ? 'Free release: this Official Master Pass (0 KC) will be cancelled and the spot returned to the venue at no charge.'
        : 'Liberación sin costo: este Pase Maestro Oficial (0 KC) se cancelará y devolverá el cupo a la sede sin cargos.',
    };
  }
  if (policy.windowType === 'grace_5m_or_72h') {
    return {
      title,
      cancelLabel,
      confirmLabel,
      tone: 'amber',
      message: isEn
        ? `Free cancellation (>=72h or 5-min grace): 100% of your Protected Deposit (${safeEscrow} KC) will be refunded to your Vault.`
        : `Cancelación libre (>=72h o tolerancia 5 min): se reembolsará el 100% de tu Anticipo Protegido (${safeEscrow} KC) a tu Bóveda.`,
    };
  }
  if (policy.windowType === 'vip_forgiveness_72h_4h') {
    const availBefore = policy.remainingForgiveness + 1;
    return {
      title,
      cancelLabel,
      confirmLabel,
      tone: 'amber',
      message: isEn
        ? `Within <72h window: cancelling now will use 1 monthly VIP Forgiveness (${availBefore}/${policy.maxForgiveness} left) to refund 100% of your ${safeEscrow} KC.`
        : `Ventana <72h: cancelar ahora consumirá 1 Perdón VIP mensual (${availBefore}/${policy.maxForgiveness} disponibles) para reembolsarte el 100% de tus ${safeEscrow} KC.`,
    };
  }
  if (policy.windowType === 'late_no_forgiveness_72h_4h') {
    return {
      title,
      cancelLabel,
      confirmLabel,
      tone: 'danger',
      message: isEn
        ? `Within <72h with 0 monthly VIP Forgiveness left: cancelling now will retain your 40% Protected Deposit (${safeEscrow} KC) for the venue (60% front-desk fee is waived).`
        : `Ventana <72h sin Perdones VIP mensuales disponibles: cancelar ahora retendrá tu Anticipo Protegido del 40% (${safeEscrow} KC) para la sede (el 60% de recepción no se cobra).`,
    };
  }
  return {
    title,
    cancelLabel,
    confirmLabel,
    tone: 'danger',
    message: isEn
      ? `Less than 4h before class (<4h): cancelling now will retain your 40% Protected Deposit (${safeEscrow} KC) for the venue (60% front-desk fee is waived).`
      : `A menos de 4h de iniciar (<4h): cancelar ahora retendrá tu Anticipo Protegido del 40% (${safeEscrow} KC) para la sede (el 60% de recepción no se cobra).`,
  };
}

const CHECKMARK_GLYPHS_RE = /[\u2705\u2713\u2714\u2611\uFE0F]/g;
const CORRUPTED_KINETIC_RE = /\bkine(?:[\u2705\u2713\u2714\u2611\uFE0F\s]*)tic(?:\s+(oficial|official))?\b/gi;
const OFFICIAL_SLUGS = new Set<string>([
  'kinetic',
  'kineticoficial',
  'kineticofficial',
  'terminalglobalkinetic',
]);

export interface ISanitizeDisplayNameOptions {
  isOfficial?: boolean;
  isEn?: boolean;
  fallback?: string;
}

export function normalizeDisplayNameSlug(raw?: unknown): string {
  return String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(CHECKMARK_GLYPHS_RE, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

export function isOfficialKineticBrandName(raw?: unknown): boolean {
  const slug = normalizeDisplayNameSlug(raw);
  return OFFICIAL_SLUGS.has(slug);
}

/**
 * Elimina cualquier checkmark incrustado (ej. `Kine✅tic`) para garantizar
 * que el texto limpio y la insignia verificada separada con `gap: 4` jamás se mezclen.
 */
export function sanitizeVerifiedDisplayName(
  rawName?: unknown,
  opts?: ISanitizeDisplayNameOptions
): string {
  const isEn = opts?.isEn === true;
  const fallback = String(opts?.fallback || (isEn ? 'Kinetic Athlete' : 'Atleta Kinetic')).trim();
  const stripped = String(rawName ?? '')
    .replace(CORRUPTED_KINETIC_RE, (_m, suffix) => (suffix ? 'Kinetic Oficial' : 'Kinetic'))
    .replace(CHECKMARK_GLYPHS_RE, '')
    .replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (opts?.isOfficial) {
    if (!stripped || isOfficialKineticBrandName(stripped)) {
      return isEn ? 'Kinetic Official' : 'Kinetic Oficial';
    }
    return stripped;
  }

  if (!stripped) return fallback;
  if (normalizeDisplayNameSlug(stripped) === 'kinetic') return 'Kinetic';
  if (isOfficialKineticBrandName(stripped)) {
    return isEn ? 'Kinetic Official' : 'Kinetic Oficial';
  }
  return stripped;
}

// 1. Sanitizador contra caracteres escapados crudos (\r\n)
export function sanitizeCleanText(raw: unknown): string {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return '';
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/\\r\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();
}

// 2. Comparador semantico de Amenidades (Regaderas, Lockers, Parking, Recovery)
export type TKineticAmenityFilterKey = 'all' | 'regaderas' | 'lockers' | 'parking' | 'recovery';

const AMENITY_SYNONYMS: Record<Exclude<TKineticAmenityFilterKey, 'all'>, string[]> = {
  regaderas: ['regadera', 'ducha', 'shower', 'vestidor', 'bano', 'vapor'],
  lockers: ['locker', 'casillero', 'guarda', 'seguridad'],
  parking: ['estacionamiento', 'parking', 'valet', 'cochera'],
  recovery: ['cold plunge', 'hielo', 'sauna', 'crioterapia', 'recovery', 'spa', 'fisioterapia', 'masaje', 'hiperbarica'],
};

export function matchesAmenityFilter(
  amenidades: string[] | undefined | null,
  filterKey: TKineticAmenityFilterKey,
  disciplinaFallback?: string
): boolean {
  if (!filterKey || filterKey === 'all') return true;
  const keywords = AMENITY_SYNONYMS[filterKey] || [];
  const pool = [...(Array.isArray(amenidades) ? amenidades : []), String(disciplinaFallback || '')]
    .join(' ')
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  return keywords.some((kw) => pool.includes(kw));
}

// 3. Insignias dinamicas de Estado de Cupo y Alta Demanda
export function getEventCapacityBadge(cupoMaximo?: number, inscritosCount?: number): {
  label: string;
  tone: 'danger' | 'warning' | 'diamond' | 'ok';
  remaining: number;
} {
  const max = Math.max(1, Number(cupoMaximo) || 15);
  const used = Math.max(0, Number(inscritosCount) || 0);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, max - used);
  if (remaining === 0) {
    return { label: '⛔ AGOTADA', tone: 'danger', remaining: 0 };
  }
  if (used > 0 && remaining > 0 && remaining <= 3) {
    return { label: '🔥 ULTIMOS ' + remaining + ' LUGARES', tone: 'warning', remaining };
  }
  if (remaining <= Math.ceil(max * 0.35)) {
    return { label: '💎 ALTA DEMANDA • SUELE AGOTARSE', tone: 'diamond', remaining };
  }
  return { label: '✓ ' + remaining + ' CUPOS DISPONIBLES', tone: 'ok', remaining };
}

// 4. Cronometro y detector de Venta Flash (< 3h antes de iniciar)
export function getFlashSaleCountdownInfo(fechaIso?: string, horaInicio?: string): {
  isFlashWindow: boolean;
  countdownLabel: string;
} {
  try {
    if (!fechaIso || !horaInicio) return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
    const cleanTime = String(horaInicio).trim().slice(0, 5);
    const parts = cleanTime.split(':').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
    const hh = parts[0];
    const mm = parts[1];
    if (Number.isNaN(hh) || Number.isNaN(mm)) return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
    const dateParts = String(fechaIso).slice(0, 10).split('-').map((n) => parseInt(n, 10));
    const target = new Date(dateParts[0], (dateParts[1] || 1) - 1, dateParts[2] || 1, hh, mm, 0).getTime();
    const diffMs = target - Date.now();
    const threeHoursMs = 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    if (diffMs <= 0 || diffMs > threeHoursMs) {
      return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
    }
    const totalSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const hours = String(Math.floor(totalSec / 3600)).padStart(2, '0');
    const mins = String(Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const secs = String(totalSec % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    return { isFlashWindow: true, countdownLabel: '⏱️ FLASH ' + hours + ':' + mins + ':' + secs };
  } catch {
    return { isFlashWindow: false, countdownLabel: '' };
  }
}

// 5. Detector de Horario Nocturno para sugerir Cartelera de Manana (Anti-pantalla vacia)
export function shouldSuggestTomorrowSchedule(activeDayEventsCount: number): boolean {
  const currentHour = new Date().getHours();
  return activeDayEventsCount === 0 || currentHour >= 21;
}

// 6. Historial persistente de Sedes Vistas Recientemente (Estilo Airbnb)
export async function recordRecentlyViewedClub(clubIdentifier: string): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const cleanId = String(clubIdentifier || '').trim();
    if (!cleanId) return [];
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(RECENTLY_VIEWED_CLUBS_KEY);
    const prev: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    const next = [cleanId, ...prev.filter((id) => id !== cleanId)].slice(0, 12);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(RECENTLY_VIEWED_CLUBS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    return next;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function saveAthleteEmergencyContact(

): Promise<{ ok: boolean; nombre: string; telefono: string }> {
  const cleanName = sanitizeCleanText(nombreContacto);
  const cleanPhone = String(telefonoContacto || '').replace(/[^0-9+\s-]/g, '').trim();
  const payload = { nombre: cleanName, telefono: cleanPhone, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(EMERGENCY_CONTACT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
    if (userId && userId.length > 10) {
      await supabase
        .from('perfiles')
        .update({
          contacto_emergencia_nombre: cleanName,
          contacto_emergencia_tel: cleanPhone,
        })
        .eq('id', userId);
    }
    return { ok: true, nombre: cleanName, telefono: cleanPhone };
  } catch {
    return { ok: true, nombre: cleanName, telefono: cleanPhone };
  }
}

// 9. Detector tactil universal Swipe-to-Close desde Portada / Cabecera (>42px hacia abajo)
interface SwipeTouchEvt {
  nativeEvent?: {
    touches?: Array<{ pageY?: number; clientY?: number; pageX?: number; clientX?: number }>;
    changedTouches?: Array<{ pageY?: number; clientY?: number; pageX?: number; clientX?: number }>;
    pageY?: number; clientY?: number; pageX?: number; clientX?: number;
  };
}
let _kineticSwipeStartY = 0;
let _kineticSwipeStartX = 0;
let _kineticSwipeFired = false;
export function createSwipeDownToCloseHandlers(onClose?: (() => void) | null, threshold = 42) {
  return {
    onTouchStart: (e: SwipeTouchEvt) => {
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      _kineticSwipeStartY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0);
      _kineticSwipeStartX = Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0);
      _kineticSwipeFired = false;
    },
    onTouchMove: (e: SwipeTouchEvt) => {
      if (!_kineticSwipeStartY || _kineticSwipeFired || typeof onClose !== 'function') return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.touches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const deltaY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0) - _kineticSwipeStartY;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0) - _kineticSwipeStartX);
      if (deltaY > threshold && deltaY > deltaX * 1.15) {
        _kineticSwipeFired = true; _kineticSwipeStartY = 0; onClose();
      }
    },
    onTouchEnd: (e: SwipeTouchEvt) => {
      if (!_kineticSwipeStartY || _kineticSwipeFired || typeof onClose !== 'function') return;
      const t = e?.nativeEvent?.changedTouches?.[0] || e?.nativeEvent;
      const deltaY = Number(t?.pageY ?? t?.clientY ?? 0) - _kineticSwipeStartY;
      const deltaX = Math.abs(Number(t?.pageX ?? t?.clientX ?? 0) - _kineticSwipeStartX);
      _kineticSwipeStartY = 0;
      if (deltaY > threshold && deltaY > deltaX * 1.15) { _kineticSwipeFired = true; onClose(); }
    },
  };
}

// 10. Bus global multi-plataforma para sincronizacion instantanea Radar + Root Refresh + Modales
const _radarListeners = new Set<() => void>();
const _rootRefreshListeners = new Set<() => void>();
let _inlineOverlayOpenCount = 0;
let _dispatchingRadarInternal = false;
let _dispatchingRootInternal = false;

export const createDebouncedEventRunner = (fn: () => void, delayMs = 150) => {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  const trigger = () => {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => { timer = null; try { fn(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } }, delayMs);
  };
  const cancel = () => { if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; } };
  return { trigger, cancel };
};

export const emitKineticRadarUpdated = (): void => {
  _dispatchingRadarInternal = true;
  try {
    _radarListeners.forEach((cb) => { try { cb(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } });
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:radar-updated'));
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:boveda-updated'));
      } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }
  } finally { _dispatchingRadarInternal = false; }
};

export const emitFavoriteOnlyRadarPulse = (): void => {
  runWithFavoriteOnlyRadarPulse(() => emitKineticRadarUpdated());
};

export const subscribeKineticRadarUpdated = (cb: () => void): (() => void) => {
  _radarListeners.add(cb);
  const winHandler = () => { if (!_dispatchingRadarInternal) { try { cb(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } } };
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') window.addEventListener('kinetic:radar-updated', winHandler);
  return () => {
    _radarListeners.delete(cb);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.removeEventListener === 'function') window.removeEventListener('kinetic:radar-updated', winHandler);
  };
};

export const emitKineticRootRefresh = (): void => {
  _dispatchingRootInternal = true;
  try {
    _rootRefreshListeners.forEach((cb) => { try { cb(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } });
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function') {
      try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kinetic:root-refresh')); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; }
    }
  } finally { _dispatchingRootInternal = false; }
};

export const subscribeKineticRootRefresh = (cb: () => void): (() => void) => {
  _rootRefreshListeners.add(cb);
  const winHandler = () => { if (!_dispatchingRootInternal) { try { cb(); } catch (err: unknown) { void err; } } };
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') window.addEventListener('kinetic:root-refresh', winHandler);
  return () => {
    _rootRefreshListeners.delete(cb);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.removeEventListener === 'function') window.removeEventListener('kinetic:root-refresh', winHandler);
  };
};

export const setKineticInlineOverlayOpen = (open: boolean): void => {
  _inlineOverlayOpenCount = Math.max(0, _inlineOverlayOpenCount + (open ? 1 : -1));
};

export const hasOpenKineticModal = (): boolean => {
  if (_inlineOverlayOpenCount > 0) return true;
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof document.querySelector === 'function') {
    const dlg = document.querySelector('[aria-modal="true"], [role="dialog"], [data-kinetic-sheet-open="true"]');
    if (dlg) return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const extractGoogleMapsUrlAndCoords = (
  rawInput?: string | null
): { cleanValue: string; url: string | null; lat: number | null; lng: number | null; detectedZone: string | null } => {
  const str = String(rawInput || '').trim();
  const urlMatch = str.match(/https?:\/\/\S+/i);
  const url = urlMatch ? urlMatch[0].replace(/[),.]+$/, '') : null;
  let lat: number | null = null;
  let lng: number | null = null;
  const atMatch = str.match(/@(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+),(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/);
  const qMatch = str.match(/[?&](?:q|query|ll)=(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)(?:%2C|,)(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/i);
  const d3Match = str.match(/!3d(-?\d{1,2}\.\d+)!4d(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)/);
  const coordHit = atMatch || qMatch || d3Match;
  if (coordHit) {
    const pLat = parseFloat(coordHit[1]);
    const pLng = parseFloat(coordHit[2]);
    if (Number.isFinite(pLat) && Number.isFinite(pLng)) {
      lat = pLat;
      lng = pLng;
    }
  }
  let detectedZone: string | null = null;
  if (url) {
    const placeMatch = decodeURIComponent(url).match(/\/place\/([^/@?]+)/i);
    if (placeMatch?.[1]) {
      detectedZone = placeMatch[1].replace(/\+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
  }
  return {
    cleanValue: url || str,
    url,
    lat,
    lng,
    detectedZone,
  };
};

  const key = getCanonicalFixedEventKey(ev);
  if (key && memoryEventRatingsMap[key]) return memoryEventRatingsMap[key];
  const raw = Number(ev?.rating_evento || ev?.rating || 5.0);
  return Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0 ? raw : 5.0;
};

export const saveCustomEventRating = async (ev: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined, stars: number): Promise<number> => {
  const key = getCanonicalFixedEventKey(ev);
  const clean = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Number(stars) || 5));
  if (key) memoryEventRatingsMap[key] = clean;
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(EVENT_RATINGS_MAP_KEY, JSON.stringify(memoryEventRatingsMap)).catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });
  return clean;
};

import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

export type KineticHapticType =
  | 'Light'
  | 'Medium'
  | 'Heavy'
  | 'Selection'
  | 'Success'
  | 'Warning'
  | 'Error'
  | string;

export const triggerHaptic = (type: KineticHapticType = 'Light'): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  try {
    if (type === 'Light') Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);
    else if (type === 'Medium') Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium);
    else if (type === 'Heavy') Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy);
    else if (type === 'Selection') Haptics.selectionAsync();
    else if (type === 'Success') Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success);
    else if (type === 'Warning') Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Warning);
    else if (type === 'Error') Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Error);
  } catch {}
};

export const triggerArcadeHaptic = (
  preset: 'checkIn' | 'levelUp' | 'reward' | 'unlock' | 'shield' = 'checkIn'
): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
  try {
    if (preset === 'levelUp' || preset === 'unlock') {
      Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success);
      setTimeout(() => Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy), 130);
    } else if (preset === 'reward' || preset === 'shield') {
      Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium);
      setTimeout(() => Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success), 110);
    } else {
      Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackType.Success);
    }
  } catch {}
};

import { formatStudioStationBadge } from '../services/studioLayoutGridHelper';

export const MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS = -7;

export interface IKineticCalendarEventInput {
  reservaId: string;
  title: string;
  venueName: string;
  location?: string | null;
  fechaIso?: string | null;
  horaInicio?: string | null;
  durationMinutes?: number | null;
  spotNumber?: number | null;
  equipmentType?: string | null;
  escrowKc?: number | null;
  puertaKc?: number | null;
  status?: 'CONFIRMED' | 'CANCELLED';
  language?: 'es' | 'en';
  updatedAtIso?: string | null;
}

export interface IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry {
  eventId: string;
  calendarId: string;
  syncedAt: string;
}

export interface IMazatlanUtcWindow {
  startMs: number;
  endMs: number;
  dtStartUtc: string;
  dtEndUtc: string;
}

const POISON_MAP_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype']);

export const pad2 = (n: number): string => String(Math.floor(Math.abs(n))).padStart(2, '0');

export const formatIcsUtcStamp = (utcMs: number): string => {
  const d = new Date(Number.isFinite(utcMs) ? utcMs : Date.now());
  return (
    `${d.getUTCFullYear()}${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}${pad2(d.getUTCDate())}` +
    `T${pad2(d.getUTCHours())}${pad2(d.getUTCMinutes())}${pad2(d.getUTCSeconds())}Z`
  );
};

export function resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow(
  rawFecha?: string | null,
  rawHora?: string | null,
  rawDurationMinutes?: number | null
): IMazatlanUtcWindow {
  const cleanDate = String(rawFecha || '').trim();
  const cleanTime = String(rawHora || '08:00').trim();
  const durMin = Math.max(15, Math.min(480, Math.round(Number(rawDurationMinutes) || 60)));

  const timeMatch = cleanTime.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  const hour = timeMatch ? Math.min(23, Math.max(0, Number(timeMatch[1]))) : 8;
  const minute = timeMatch ? Math.min(59, Math.max(0, Number(timeMatch[2]))) : 0;

  const datePart = cleanDate.split('T')[0].split(' ')[0];
  const dateMatch = datePart.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
  let startMs: number;

  if (dateMatch) {
    const year = Number(dateMatch[1]);
    const month = Number(dateMatch[2]);
    const day = Number(dateMatch[3]);
    // America/Mazatlan stays on UTC-7 year-round (no DST since 2022)
    startMs = Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour - MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS, minute, 0);
  } else {
    const parsedIso = cleanDate ? Date.parse(cleanDate) : Number.NaN;
    if (Number.isFinite(parsedIso)) {
      startMs = parsedIso;
    } else {
      const now = new Date();
      startMs = Date.UTC(
        now.getUTCFullYear(),
        now.getUTCMonth(),
        now.getUTCDate() + 1,
        hour - MAZATLAN_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS,
        minute,
        0
      );
    }
  }

  const endMs = startMs + durMin * 60_000;
  return {
    startMs,
    endMs,
    dtStartUtc: formatIcsUtcStamp(startMs),
    dtEndUtc: formatIcsUtcStamp(endMs),
  };
}

export const escapeIcsText = (raw: unknown): string =>
  String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
    .replace(/\r\n|\r|\n/g, '\\n')
    .replace(/;/g, '\\;')
    .replace(/,/g, '\\,');

export function foldIcsLine(line: string): string {
  const encoder = typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined' ? new TextEncoder() : null;
  const byteLen = (s: string): number => (encoder ? encoder.encode(s).length : s.length);
  if (byteLen(line) <= 75) return line;

  const chunks: string[] = [];
  let current = '';
  let maxBytes = 75;
  for (const ch of line) {
    if (byteLen(current + ch) > maxBytes && current.length > 0) {
      chunks.push(current);
      current = ` ${ch}`;
      maxBytes = 75;
    } else {
      current += ch;
    }
  }
  if (current) chunks.push(current);
  return chunks.join('\r\n');
}

export const buildCanonicalReservaUid = (reservaId: string): string => {
  const safe = String(reservaId || 'session').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '-').slice(0, 80) || 'session';
  return `kinetic-reserva-${safe}@kineticapp.com.mx`;
};

export function buildKineticReservaDescription(input: IKineticCalendarEventInput): string {
  const isEn = input.language === 'en';
  const escrowKc = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.escrowKc) || 0));
  const puertaKc = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.puertaKc) || 0));
  const parsedSpot = input.spotNumber != null && String(input.spotNumber).trim() !== '' ? Math.round(Number(input.spotNumber)) : NaN;
  const spotLabel = Number.isFinite(parsedSpot) && parsedSpot > 0
    ? formatStudioStationBadge(input.equipmentType, parsedSpot, isEn)
    : '';

  if (isEn) {
    return [
      `Venue: ${input.venueName || 'Kinetic Official Venue'}${spotLabel ? ` • ${spotLabel}` : ''}`,
      `Protected Deposit (40%): ${escrowKc} KC • Front Desk Settlement (60%): ${puertaKc} KC.`,
      'Policy: Free cancellation >=72h before start (or <=5 min grace); <4h retains 40% Protected Deposit.',
      'Open My Vault at reception to show your Kinetic Digital Pass: https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda',
    ].join('\n');
  }
  return [
    `Sede: ${input.venueName || 'Sede Oficial Kinetic'}${spotLabel ? ` • ${spotLabel}` : ''}`,
    `Anticipo Protegido (40%): ${escrowKc} KC • Liquidación en Recepción (60%): ${puertaKc} KC.`,
    'Política: Cancelación libre >=72h antes (o <=5 min gracia); <4h retiene 40% del Anticipo.',
    'Abre Mi Bóveda en recepción para mostrar tu Pase Digital Kinetic: https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda',
  ].join('\n');
}

export function buildKineticReservaIcsPayload(input: IKineticCalendarEventInput): string {
  const isCancel = input.status === 'CANCELLED';
  const win = resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow(input.fechaIso, input.horaInicio, input.durationMinutes);
  const stampMs = input.updatedAtIso ? Date.parse(input.updatedAtIso) : Date.now();
  const dtStamp = formatIcsUtcStamp(Number.isFinite(stampMs) ? stampMs : Date.now());
  const uid = buildCanonicalReservaUid(input.reservaId);
  const venue = String(input.venueName || 'Kinetic').trim();
  const rawTitle = String(input.title || 'Kinetic').trim();
  const summary = isCancel
    ? `${input.language === 'en' ? '[CANCELLED]' : '[CANCELADA]'} Kinetic: ${rawTitle}`
    : `Kinetic: ${rawTitle}${venue ? ` (${venue})` : ''}`;
  const location = String(input.location || venue || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S., México').trim();
  const description = buildKineticReservaDescription(input);

  const lines: string[] = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//KineticApp S.A.S.//KINETIC v2.8.6//ES',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    `METHOD:${isCancel ? 'CANCEL' : 'PUBLISH'}`,
    'BEGIN:VEVENT',
    `UID:${uid}`,
    `DTSTAMP:${dtStamp}`,
    `DTSTART:${win.dtStartUtc}`,
    `DTEND:${win.dtEndUtc}`,
    `SUMMARY:${escapeIcsText(summary)}`,
    `LOCATION:${escapeIcsText(location)}`,
    `DESCRIPTION:${escapeIcsText(description)}`,
    'URL:https://kineticapp.com.mx/boveda',
    `STATUS:${isCancel ? 'CANCELLED' : 'CONFIRMED'}`,
    `SEQUENCE:${isCancel ? 2 : 1}`,
  ];

  if (!isCancel) {
    lines.push(
      'BEGIN:VALARM',
      'ACTION:DISPLAY',
      'TRIGGER:-PT4H',
      `DESCRIPTION:${escapeIcsText('Kinetic — Tu sesión comienza en 4 horas / Starts in 4h')}`,
      'END:VALARM',
      'BEGIN:VALARM',
      'ACTION:DISPLAY',
      'TRIGGER:-PT1H',
      `DESCRIPTION:${escapeIcsText('Kinetic — Tu sesión comienza en 1 hora / Prepara tu Llave QR')}`,
      'END:VALARM'
    );
  }

  lines.push('END:VEVENT', 'END:VCALENDAR');
  return `${lines.map(foldIcsLine).join('\r\n')}\r\n`;
}

export function buildGoogleCalendarWebFallbackUrl(input: IKineticCalendarEventInput): string {
  const win = resolveMazatlanSessionUtcWindow(input.fechaIso, input.horaInicio, input.durationMinutes);
  const venue = String(input.venueName || 'Kinetic').trim();
  const title = `Kinetic: ${String(input.title || 'Sesión').trim()}${venue ? ` (${venue})` : ''}`;
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    action: 'TEMPLATE',
    text: title,
    dates: `${win.dtStartUtc}/${win.dtEndUtc}`,
    details: buildKineticReservaDescription(input),
    location: String(input.location || venue || 'Los Cabos, B.C.S., México').trim(),
    ctz: 'America/Mazatlan',
  });
  return `https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?${params.toString()}`;
}

export function upsertCalendarMapImmutable(
  currentMap: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> | null | undefined,
  reservaId: string,
  entry: IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry
): Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> {
  const cleanId = String(reservaId || '').trim();
  const safeOut: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> = Object.create(null) as Record<
    string,
    IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry
  >;
  if (currentMap && typeof currentMap === 'object') {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(currentMap)) {
      if (!POISON_MAP_KEYS.has(k) && v && typeof v.eventId === 'string') {
        safeOut[k] = { eventId: v.eventId, calendarId: String(v.calendarId || ''), syncedAt: String(v.syncedAt || '') };
      }
    }
  }
  if (cleanId && !POISON_MAP_KEYS.has(cleanId) && entry?.eventId) {
    safeOut[cleanId] = {
      eventId: String(entry.eventId).trim(),
      calendarId: String(entry.calendarId || '').trim(),
      syncedAt: String(entry.syncedAt || new Date().toISOString()),
    };
  }
  return safeOut;
}

export function removeCalendarMapImmutable(
  currentMap: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> | null | undefined,
  reservaId: string
): Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> {
  const cleanId = String(reservaId || '').trim();
  const safeOut: Record<string, IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry> = Object.create(null) as Record<
    string,
    IKineticSyncedCalendarEntry
  >;
  if (currentMap && typeof currentMap === 'object') {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(currentMap)) {
      if (!POISON_MAP_KEYS.has(k) && k !== cleanId && v && typeof v.eventId === 'string') {
        safeOut[k] = { eventId: v.eventId, calendarId: String(v.calendarId || ''), syncedAt: String(v.syncedAt || '') };
      }
    }
  }
  return safeOut;
}

export type KineticFrameAspect = '1:1' | '9:16' | '16:9';

export const MIN_FRAME_ZOOM = 1;
export const MAX_FRAME_ZOOM = 3;
export const MAX_FRAMED_JPEG_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

export interface KineticImageFrameRequest {
  uri: string;
  aspect?: KineticFrameAspect;
  lockAspect?: boolean;
  titleEs?: string;
  titleEn?: string;
}

export interface FrameTransformInput {
  naturalWidth: number;
  naturalHeight: number;
  stageWidth: number;
  stageHeight: number;
  zoom: number;
  offsetX: number;
  offsetY: number;
}

export interface ClampedFrameTransform {
  zoom: number;
  offsetX: number;
  offsetY: number;
  maxOffsetX: number;
  maxOffsetY: number;
}

export interface NormalizedSourceCropRect {
  originX: number;
  originY: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  normX: number;
  normY: number;
  normW: number;
  normH: number;
}

type FrameHostListener = (req: KineticImageFrameRequest | null) => void;
let _hostListener: FrameHostListener | null = null;
let _pendingResolve: ((res: string | null) => void) | null = null;

export function registerKineticImageFrameHost(listener: FrameHostListener): () => void {
  _hostListener = listener;
  return () => { if (_hostListener === listener) _hostListener = null; };
}

export function resolveKineticImageFrameRequest(result: string | null): void {
  const resFn = _pendingResolve;
  _pendingResolve = null;
  _hostListener?.(null);
  resFn?.(result);
}

const SAFE_DATA_RASTER_RE = /^data:image\/(?:jpeg|jpg|png|webp|heic|heif);base64,/i;

export function isSafeKineticMediaUri(raw?: string | null, allowHttpDev = false): string {
  const clean = String(raw || '').replace(/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/g, '').trim();
  if (clean.length < 5) return '';
  if (/^(javascript:|vbscript:|data:text|data:image\/svg\+xml)/i.test(clean)) return '';
  if (/^(blob:|file:|content:)/i.test(clean) || SAFE_DATA_RASTER_RE.test(clean)) return clean;
  if (/^https:\/\//i.test(clean)) return clean;
  if (allowHttpDev && /^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?\//i.test(clean)) return clean;
  return '';
}

export function openKineticImageFrame(req: KineticImageFrameRequest): Promise<string | null> {
  const cleanUri = isSafeKineticMediaUri(req?.uri, true);
  if (!cleanUri) return Promise.resolve(null);
  const safeReq: KineticImageFrameRequest = { ...req, uri: cleanUri };
  if (!_hostListener) return Promise.resolve(cleanUri);
  if (_pendingResolve) {
    _pendingResolve(null);
    _pendingResolve = null;
  }
  return new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
    _pendingResolve = resolve;
    _hostListener?.(safeReq);
  });
}

const finiteOr = (val: number, fallback: number): number =>
  typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val) ? val : fallback;

const clampNum = (val: number, min: number, max: number): number =>
  Math.min(max, Math.max(min, val));

export function resolveAspectRatioValue(aspect: KineticFrameAspect): number {
  if (aspect === '9:16') return 9 / 16;
  if (aspect === '16:9') return 16 / 9;
  return 1;
}

export function resolveOutputDimensionsForAspect(aspect: KineticFrameAspect): { width: number; height: number } {
  if (aspect === '9:16') return { width: 720, height: 1280 };
  if (aspect === '16:9') return { width: 1280, height: 720 };
  return { width: 960, height: 960 };
}

export function computeFrameStageDimensions(
  aspect: KineticFrameAspect,
  viewportWidth: number,
  viewportHeight: number
): { width: number; height: number } {
  const vw = Math.max(260, finiteOr(viewportWidth, 390));
  const vh = Math.max(400, finiteOr(viewportHeight, 760));
  const maxW = Math.min(vw - 36, 420);
  const maxH = Math.min(vh - 250, 480);
  const ratio = resolveAspectRatioValue(aspect);
  let width = maxW;
  let height = width / ratio;
  if (height > maxH) {
    height = maxH;
    width = height * ratio;
  }
  return { width: Math.max(120, Math.round(width)), height: Math.max(120, Math.round(height)) };
}

export function computeCoverScaledImageSize(
  naturalWidth: number, naturalHeight: number, stageWidth: number, stageHeight: number, zoom: number
) {
  const nw = Math.max(1, finiteOr(naturalWidth, 1000));
  const nh = Math.max(1, finiteOr(naturalHeight, 1000));
  const sw = Math.max(1, finiteOr(stageWidth, 300));
  const sh = Math.max(1, finiteOr(stageHeight, 300));
  const safeZoom = clampNum(finiteOr(zoom, MIN_FRAME_ZOOM), MIN_FRAME_ZOOM, MAX_FRAME_ZOOM);
  const imgRatio = nw / nh;
  const stageRatio = sw / sh;
  const baseWidth = imgRatio >= stageRatio ? sh * imgRatio : sw;
  const baseHeight = imgRatio >= stageRatio ? sh : sw / imgRatio;
  const scaledWidth = baseWidth * safeZoom;
  const scaledHeight = baseHeight * safeZoom;
  return {
    baseWidth, baseHeight, scaledWidth, scaledHeight,
    maxOffsetX: Math.max(0, (scaledWidth - sw) / 2),
    maxOffsetY: Math.max(0, (scaledHeight - sh) / 2),
    safeZoom,
  };
}

export function clampFrameTransform(input: FrameTransformInput): ClampedFrameTransform {
  const metrics = computeCoverScaledImageSize(
    input.naturalWidth, input.naturalHeight, input.stageWidth, input.stageHeight, input.zoom
  );
  return {
    zoom: metrics.safeZoom,
    offsetX: clampNum(finiteOr(input.offsetX, 0), -metrics.maxOffsetX, metrics.maxOffsetX),
    offsetY: clampNum(finiteOr(input.offsetY, 0), -metrics.maxOffsetY, metrics.maxOffsetY),
    maxOffsetX: metrics.maxOffsetX,
    maxOffsetY: metrics.maxOffsetY,
  };
}

export function computeNormalizedSourceCropRect(input: FrameTransformInput): NormalizedSourceCropRect {
  const nw = Math.max(1, Math.round(finiteOr(input.naturalWidth, 1000)));
  const nh = Math.max(1, Math.round(finiteOr(input.naturalHeight, 1000)));
  const sw = Math.max(1, finiteOr(input.stageWidth, 300));
  const sh = Math.max(1, finiteOr(input.stageHeight, 300));
  const metrics = computeCoverScaledImageSize(nw, nh, sw, sh, input.zoom);
  const clamped = clampFrameTransform(input);
  const leftScaled = Math.max(0, (metrics.scaledWidth - sw) / 2 - clamped.offsetX);
  const topScaled = Math.max(0, (metrics.scaledHeight - sh) / 2 - clamped.offsetY);
  const pxPerScaledX = nw / Math.max(1, metrics.scaledWidth);
  const pxPerScaledY = nh / Math.max(1, metrics.scaledHeight);
  const originX = clampNum(Math.round(leftScaled * pxPerScaledX), 0, nw - 1);
  const originY = clampNum(Math.round(topScaled * pxPerScaledY), 0, nh - 1);
  const width = clampNum(Math.round(sw * pxPerScaledX), 1, nw - originX);
  const height = clampNum(Math.round(sh * pxPerScaledY), 1, nh - originY);
  return { originX, originY, width, height, normX: originX / nw, normY: originY / nh, normW: width / nw, normH: height / nh };
}

export async function preloadImageInMemory(uri: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const clean = String(uri || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return false;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.Image === 'undefined') return true;
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    try {
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      const tid = setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 2500);
      img.onload = () => {
        clearTimeout(tid);
        const maybeDecode = (img as unknown as { decode?: () => Promise<void> }).decode;
        if (typeof maybeDecode === 'function') {
          maybeDecode.call(img).then(() => resolve(true), () => resolve(true));
        } else {
          resolve(true);
        }
      };
      img.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(tid); resolve(false); };
      img.src = clean;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      resolve(false);
    }
  });
}

export interface ISpiderfyInputMarker {
  id: string;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  markerType?: string | null;
  [k: string]: unknown;
}

export type SpiderfiedMarker<T extends ISpiderfyInputMarker> = T & {
  renderLatitude: number;
  renderLongitude: number;
  anchorLatitude: number;
  anchorLongitude: number;
  isSpiderfied: boolean;
  clusterSize: number;
};

export interface ISpiderfyAnchorLeg {
  id: string;
  fromLat: number;
  fromLng: number;
  toLat: number;
  toLng: number;
}

export function haversineDistanceMeters(lat1: number, lng1: number, lat2: number, lng2: number): number {
  const rad = Math.PI / 180;
  const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * rad;
  const dLng = (lng2 - lng1) * rad;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(lat1 * rad) * Math.cos(lat2 * rad) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);
  return 6_371_000 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - a)));
}

export function resolveSpiderfyOrbitRadiusDeg(zoom: number, clusterSize: number, extraSpreadRatio = 1): number {
  const clampedZoom = Math.min(20, Math.max(10, Number(zoom) || 14));
  const basePxMeters = 156_543.03 * Math.cos((22.89 * Math.PI) / 180) / Math.pow(2, clampedZoom);
  const pixelSeparation = (clusterSize > 4 ? 46 : 38) * extraSpreadRatio;
  const minMeters = Math.max(22, Math.min(480, basePxMeters * pixelSeparation));
  return minMeters / 111_320;
}

export function computeElasticSpiderfyMarkers<T extends ISpiderfyInputMarker>(
  markers: T[],
  options?: {
    zoom?: number;
    userCoords?: { latitude: number; longitude: number } | null;
    clusterThresholdMeters?: number;
    extraSpreadRatio?: number;
  }
): {
  markers: Array<SpiderfiedMarker<T>>;
  spiderLegs: ISpiderfyAnchorLeg[];
} {
  if (!Array.isArray(markers) || markers.length === 0) {
    return { markers: [], spiderLegs: [] };
  }
  const threshold = Math.max(5, Number(options?.clusterThresholdMeters) || SPIDERFY_CLUSTER_DISTANCE_METERS);
  const zoom = Number(options?.zoom) || 14;
  const userCoords = options?.userCoords;
  const validCoords = (m: { latitude?: number; longitude?: number } | null | undefined): m is { latitude: number; longitude: number } =>
    Boolean(m && Number.isFinite(m.latitude) && Number.isFinite(m.longitude));

  const n = markers.length;
  const visited = new Array<boolean>(n).fill(false);
  const resolved: Array<SpiderfiedMarker<T>> = new Array(n);
  const spiderLegs: ISpiderfyAnchorLeg[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
    if (visited[i]) continue;
    const queue = [i];
    visited[i] = true;
    const clusterIndices: number[] = [];
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const curIdx = queue.shift()!;
      clusterIndices.push(curIdx);
      const cur = markers[curIdx];
      if (!validCoords(cur)) continue;
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j += 1) {
        if (visited[j]) continue;
        const cand = markers[j];
        if (!validCoords(cand)) continue;
        if (haversineDistanceMeters(cur.latitude, cur.longitude, cand.latitude, cand.longitude) <= threshold) {
          visited[j] = true;
          queue.push(j);
        }
      }
    }

    clusterIndices.sort((a, b) => String(markers[a]?.id || '').localeCompare(String(markers[b]?.id || '')));
    const first = markers[clusterIndices[0]];
    const anchorLat = Number(first?.latitude) || 0;
    const anchorLng = Number(first?.longitude) || 0;
    const nearUser =
      validCoords(userCoords) &&
      haversineDistanceMeters(anchorLat, anchorLng, userCoords.latitude, userCoords.longitude) <= threshold;

    if (clusterIndices.length === 1 && !nearUser) {
      resolved[clusterIndices[0]] = {
        ...first,
        renderLatitude: anchorLat,
        renderLongitude: anchorLng,
        anchorLatitude: anchorLat,
        anchorLongitude: anchorLng,
        isSpiderfied: false,
        clusterSize: 1,
      };
      continue;
    }

    const effectiveSize = clusterIndices.length + (nearUser ? 1 : 0);
    const orbitDeg = resolveSpiderfyOrbitRadiusDeg(zoom, effectiveSize, options?.extraSpreadRatio || 1);
    const cosLat = Math.max(0.25, Math.cos((anchorLat * Math.PI) / 180));

    clusterIndices.forEach((idx, slot) => {
      const m = markers[idx];
      const angle = ((slot + (nearUser ? 0.5 : 0)) / effectiveSize) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      const renderLatitude = m.latitude + Math.sin(angle) * orbitDeg;
      const renderLongitude = m.longitude + (Math.cos(angle) * orbitDeg) / cosLat;
      resolved[idx] = {
        ...m,
        renderLatitude,
        renderLongitude,
        anchorLatitude: m.latitude,
        anchorLongitude: m.longitude,
        isSpiderfied: true,
        clusterSize: effectiveSize,
      };
      spiderLegs.push({
        id: `leg_${String(m.id || idx)}`,
        fromLat: m.latitude,
        fromLng: m.longitude,
        toLat: renderLatitude,
        toLng: renderLongitude,
      });
    });
  }

  return { markers: resolved, spiderLegs };
}

const CSV_FORMULA_PREFIX_RE = /^[=@|\t\r\n]/;
const ONLY_DIGITS_PLUS_SEP_RE = /^\+?[\d\s().-]+$/;
const ALL_EQUAL_DIGITS_RE = /^(\d)\1+$/;
const REPEATING_PAIR_RE = /^(\d{2})\1{4,}$/;
const REPEATING_TRIPLE_PREFIX_RE = /^(\d{3})\1{2}/;
const ASCENDING_SEQ = '01234567890123456789';
const DESCENDING_SEQ = '98765432109876543210';

export type PhoneRejectionReason =
  | 'empty'
  | 'invalid_type'
  | 'csv_injection'
  | 'invalid_chars'
  | 'length'
  | 'repeated'
  | 'sequential'
  | 'repeating_pair';

export interface StrictWhatsappValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  digits: string;
  normalized10: string;
  reason?: PhoneRejectionReason;
}

const deriveNormalized10 = (digits: string): string => {
  if (digits.length === 13 && digits.startsWith('521')) return digits.slice(3);
  if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith('52')) return digits.slice(2);
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith('1')) return digits.slice(1);
  return digits.length > 10 ? digits.slice(-10) : digits;
};

export function validateStrictWhatsappPhone(raw: unknown): StrictWhatsappValidationResult {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) {
    return { valid: false, digits: '', normalized10: '', reason: 'empty' };
  }
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') {
    return { valid: false, digits: '', normalized10: '', reason: 'invalid_type' };
  }
  const trimmed = raw.replace(/[\u00A0\uFEFF]/g, '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return { valid: false, digits: '', normalized10: '', reason: 'empty' };
  }
  if (CSV_FORMULA_PREFIX_RE.test(trimmed) || (trimmed.startsWith('+') && !/^\+\d/.test(trimmed)) || trimmed.startsWith('-')) {
    return { valid: false, digits: '', normalized10: '', reason: 'csv_injection' };
  }
  if (!ONLY_DIGITS_PLUS_SEP_RE.test(trimmed)) {
    return { valid: false, digits: '', normalized10: '', reason: 'invalid_chars' };
  }
  const digits = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length < 10 || digits.length > 15) {
    return { valid: false, digits, normalized10: '', reason: 'length' };
  }
  const normalized10 = deriveNormalized10(digits);
  if (normalized10.length < 10) {
    return { valid: false, digits, normalized10, reason: 'length' };
  }
  if (ALL_EQUAL_DIGITS_RE.test(digits) || ALL_EQUAL_DIGITS_RE.test(normalized10)) {
    return { valid: false, digits, normalized10, reason: 'repeated' };
  }
  if (ASCENDING_SEQ.includes(normalized10) || DESCENDING_SEQ.includes(normalized10)) {
    return { valid: false, digits, normalized10, reason: 'sequential' };
  }
  if (REPEATING_PAIR_RE.test(normalized10) || REPEATING_TRIPLE_PREFIX_RE.test(normalized10)) {
    return { valid: false, digits, normalized10, reason: 'repeating_pair' };
  }
  return { valid: true, digits, normalized10 };
}

export function isStrictValidWhatsappInput(raw: unknown, allowEmpty = false): boolean {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined || (typeof raw === 'string' && !raw.trim())) {
    return allowEmpty;
  }
  return validateStrictWhatsappPhone(raw).valid;
}
