import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Animated,
  Insets,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  StyleProp,
  StyleSheet,
  ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';

export type KineticPhysicsPresetName = 'tactileChip' | 'cardFloat' | 'dockTab' | 'primaryAction';

export interface IKineticSpringConfig {
  tension: number;
  friction: number;
  pressScale: number;
  pressTranslateY: number;
}

export const KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS: Record<KineticPhysicsPresetName, IKineticSpringConfig> = {
  tactileChip: { tension: 320, friction: 20, pressScale: 0.945, pressTranslateY: 1.5 },
  cardFloat: { tension: 260, friction: 22, pressScale: 0.975, pressTranslateY: 2.0 },
  dockTab: { tension: 340, friction: 19, pressScale: 0.925, pressTranslateY: 1.5 },
  primaryAction: { tension: 290, friction: 18, pressScale: 0.955, pressTranslateY: 2.5 },
};

export interface ITactilePressFrame {
  scale: number;
  translateY: number;
  opacity: number;
}

export const computeTactilePressFrame = (
  preset: KineticPhysicsPresetName,
  pressed: boolean,
  disabled = false,
): ITactilePressFrame => {
  const cfg = KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS[preset] || KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS.tactileChip;
  if (disabled) {
    return { scale: 1, translateY: 0, opacity: 0.56 };
  }
  if (!pressed) {
    return { scale: 1, translateY: 0, opacity: 1 };
  }
  return {
    scale: cfg.pressScale,
    translateY: cfg.pressTranslateY,
    opacity: 0.96,
  };
};

interface KineticPhysicsPressableProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  preset?: KineticPhysicsPresetName;
  onPress?: (e?: any) => void;
  onLongPress?: (e?: any) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  contentContainerStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  hitSlop?: number | Insets;
  accessibilityRole?: any;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
  accessibilityState?: any;
  testID?: string;
  activeOpacity?: number;
  dataSet?: Record<string, string>;
}

export const KineticPhysicsPressable: React.FC<KineticPhysicsPressableProps> = ({
  children,
  preset = 'tactileChip',
  onPress,
  onLongPress,
  disabled = false,
  style,
  contentContainerStyle,
  hitSlop,
  accessibilityRole = 'button',
  accessibilityLabel,
  accessibilityState,
  testID,
  dataSet,
}) => {
  const cfg = KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS[preset] || KINETIC_PHYSICS_PRESETS.tactileChip;
  const pressAnim = useRef(typeof Animated?.Value === 'function' ? new Animated.Value(0) : null).current;
  const activeAnimRef = useRef<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      try {
        activeAnimRef.current?.stop?.();
      } catch {}
    };
  }, []);

  const animateTo = useCallback(
    (toValue: number) => {
      if (!pressAnim || typeof Animated?.spring !== 'function') return;
      try {
        activeAnimRef.current?.stop?.();
        const anim = Animated.spring(pressAnim, {
          toValue,
          tension: cfg.tension,
          friction: cfg.friction,
          useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web',
        });
        activeAnimRef.current = anim;
        anim.start();
      } catch {}
    },
    [pressAnim, cfg.tension, cfg.friction],
  );

  const flatStyle = (StyleSheet.flatten(style as any) || {}) as ViewStyle;
  const outerStyle: ViewStyle = {};
  if (flatStyle.flex !== undefined) outerStyle.flex = flatStyle.flex;
  if (flatStyle.width !== undefined) outerStyle.width = flatStyle.width;
  if (flatStyle.minWidth !== undefined) outerStyle.minWidth = flatStyle.minWidth;
  if (flatStyle.maxWidth !== undefined) outerStyle.maxWidth = flatStyle.maxWidth;
  if (flatStyle.height !== undefined) outerStyle.height = flatStyle.height;
  if (flatStyle.minHeight !== undefined) outerStyle.minHeight = flatStyle.minHeight;
  if (flatStyle.maxHeight !== undefined) outerStyle.maxHeight = flatStyle.maxHeight;
  if (flatStyle.alignSelf !== undefined) outerStyle.alignSelf = flatStyle.alignSelf;
  if (flatStyle.position !== undefined) outerStyle.position = flatStyle.position;
  if (flatStyle.top !== undefined) outerStyle.top = flatStyle.top;
  if (flatStyle.bottom !== undefined) outerStyle.bottom = flatStyle.bottom;
  if (flatStyle.left !== undefined) outerStyle.left = flatStyle.left;
  if (flatStyle.right !== undefined) outerStyle.right = flatStyle.right;
  if (flatStyle.zIndex !== undefined) outerStyle.zIndex = flatStyle.zIndex;
  if (flatStyle.marginBottom !== undefined) outerStyle.marginBottom = flatStyle.marginBottom;
  if (flatStyle.marginTop !== undefined) outerStyle.marginTop = flatStyle.marginTop;
  if (flatStyle.borderRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderRadius = flatStyle.borderRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderTopLeftRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderTopLeftRadius = flatStyle.borderTopLeftRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderTopRightRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderTopRightRadius = flatStyle.borderTopRightRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius = flatStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius;
  if (flatStyle.borderBottomRightRadius !== undefined) outerStyle.borderBottomRightRadius = flatStyle.borderBottomRightRadius;
  if (
    flatStyle.overflow !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderTopLeftRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderTopRightRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderBottomLeftRadius !== undefined ||
    flatStyle.borderBottomRightRadius !== undefined
  ) {
    outerStyle.overflow = flatStyle.overflow ?? 'hidden';
  }

  const animTransform = pressAnim
    ? [
        {
          scale: pressAnim.interpolate({
            inputRange: [0, 1],
            outputRange: [1, cfg.pressScale],
          }),
        },
        {
          translateY: pressAnim.interpolate({
            inputRange: [0, 1],
            outputRange: [0, cfg.pressTranslateY],
          }),
        },
      ]
    : undefined;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={disabled ? undefined : onPress}
      onLongPress={disabled ? undefined : onLongPress}
      onPressIn={() => {
        if (!disabled) animateTo(1);
      }}
      onPressOut={() => animateTo(0)}
      disabled={disabled}
      hitSlop={hitSlop}
      accessibilityRole={accessibilityRole}
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
      accessibilityState={accessibilityState}
      testID={testID}
      {...(dataSet ? ({ dataSet } as any) : {})}
      style={outerStyle}
    >
      <Animated.View
        style={[
          style,
          outerStyle.width ? { width: '100%' } : undefined,
          outerStyle.height === '100%' ? { flex: 1, height: undefined } : undefined,
          outerStyle.flex !== undefined
            ? { flex: undefined, flexGrow: 1, flexShrink: 1, flexBasis: 'auto' }
            : undefined,
          outerStyle.position === 'absolute' ? { position: 'relative', top: undefined, bottom: undefined, left: undefined, right: undefined } : undefined,
          outerStyle.marginBottom !== undefined ? { marginBottom: 0 } : undefined,
          outerStyle.marginTop !== undefined ? { marginTop: 0 } : undefined,
          outerStyle.overflow !== undefined ? { overflow: outerStyle.overflow } : undefined,
          contentContainerStyle,
          animTransform ? { transform: animTransform } : undefined,
          disabled ? { opacity: 0.56 } : undefined,
        ]}
      >
        {children}
      </Animated.View>
    </Pressable>
  );
};

export const KineticPhysicsTabBarButton: React.FC<any> = ({
  children,

  const pressAnim = useRef(typeof Animated?.Value === 'function' ? new Animated.Value(0) : null).current;

  useEffect(() => {

      try {

        const anim = Animated.spring(pressAnim, {

export const DEFAULT_RANGE_PAGE_SIZE = 500;
export const DEFAULT_MAX_RANGE_PAGES = 20;

export interface IRangePaginationResult<T> {
  rows: T[];
  totalFetched: number;
  pagesFetched: number;
  hasMore: boolean;
  isTruncated: boolean;
  error: unknown;
}

export async function fetchAllDeterministicRangePages<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  fetchPage: (from: number, to: number) => PromiseLike<{ data: T[] | null; error: unknown }>,
  opts?: { pageSize?: number; maxPages?: number; idKey?: string }
): Promise<IRangePaginationResult<T>> {
  const rawPageSize = Number(opts?.pageSize);
  const rawMaxPages = Number(opts?.maxPages);
  const pageSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(1000, Number.isFinite(rawPageSize) ? Math.floor(rawPageSize) : DEFAULT_RANGE_PAGE_SIZE));
  const maxPages = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number.isFinite(rawMaxPages) ? Math.floor(rawMaxPages) : DEFAULT_MAX_RANGE_PAGES));
  const idKey = opts?.idKey || 'id';

  const seenIds = new Set<string>();
  const rows: T[] = [];
  let pagesFetched = 0;
  let lastBatchLength = 0;

  for (let page = 0; page < maxPages; page += 1) {
    const from = page * pageSize;
    const to = from + pageSize - 1;
    const res = await fetchPage(from, to);
    pagesFetched += 1;
    if (res?.error) {
      return {
        rows,
        totalFetched: rows.length,
        pagesFetched,
        hasMore: false,
        isTruncated: false,
        error: res.error,
      };
    }

    const batch = Array.isArray(res?.data) ? res.data : [];
    lastBatchLength = batch.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < batch.length; i += 1) {
      const item = batch[i];
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
      const rawId = item[idKey];
      const dedupeKey =
        rawId !== undefined && rawId !== null && String(rawId).trim() !== ''
          ? `id:${String(rawId).trim()}`
          : `pos:${page}:${i}`;
      if (!seenIds.has(dedupeKey)) {
        seenIds.add(dedupeKey);
        rows.push(item);
      }
    }

    if (batch.length < pageSize) {
      return {
        rows,
        totalFetched: rows.length,
        pagesFetched,
        hasMore: false,
        isTruncated: false,
        error: null,
      };
    }
  }

  let hasMore = false;
  if (lastBatchLength === pageSize) {
    const probeIdx = maxPages * pageSize;
    const probe = await fetchPage(probeIdx, probeIdx);
    if (!probe?.error && Array.isArray(probe.data) && probe.data.length > 0) {
      hasMore = true;
    }
  }

  return {
    rows,
    totalFetched: rows.length,
    pagesFetched,
    hasMore,
    isTruncated: hasMore,
    error: null,
  };
}

export interface ICollectionAccountingTotals {
  validCount: number;
  totalBrutoKc: number;
  comisionKineticKc: number;
  netoSocioKc: number;
}

const resolveFinitePositive = (val: unknown): number => {
  const n = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0;
};

export function reconcileCollectionAccountingTotals(
  rows: ReadonlyArray<Record<string, unknown>>,
  commissionRate = 0.2
): ICollectionAccountingTotals {
  const safeRate =
    Number.isFinite(commissionRate) && commissionRate >= 0 && commissionRate <= 1
      ? commissionRate
      : 0.2;

  let validCount = 0;
  let totalBrutoCents = 0;
  let comisionCents = 0;

  for (const r of rows || []) {
    if (!r || r.es_cuenta_sandbox === true || r.is_sandbox === true) continue;
    const montoEscrow = resolveFinitePositive(r.monto_escrow);
    const montoPuerta = resolveFinitePositive(r.monto_puerta);
    const bruto = Math.max(
      resolveFinitePositive(r.costo_total),
      resolveFinitePositive(r.precio_kc),
      resolveFinitePositive(r.precio_total_kc),
      montoEscrow + montoPuerta
    );
    if (bruto <= 0) continue;

    const rowCents = Math.round(bruto * 100);
    const rowFeeCents = Math.round(rowCents * safeRate);
    validCount += 1;
    totalBrutoCents += rowCents;
    comisionCents += rowFeeCents;
  }

  const netoCents = totalBrutoCents - comisionCents;
  return {
    validCount,
    totalBrutoKc: Number((totalBrutoCents / 100).toFixed(2)),
    comisionKineticKc: Number((comisionCents / 100).toFixed(2)),
    netoSocioKc: Number((netoCents / 100).toFixed(2)),
  };
}

// Caché síncrona del último rol confirmado (memoria de módulo + localStorage web) para pintar pestañas en 0 ms
// sin cortina de carga durante la navegación habitual.
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

const ROLE_CACHE_KEY = '@kinetic_last_role_v1';
let memoryRoleCache: { userId: string; role: string } | null = null;

export const readCachedRoleSync = (userId?: string | null): string | null => {
  if (!userId) return null;
  if (memoryRoleCache?.userId === userId) return memoryRoleCache.role;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(window.localStorage?.getItem(ROLE_CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
      if (parsed?.userId === userId && parsed?.role) {
        memoryRoleCache = parsed;
        return parsed.role;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
};

export const persistRoleCache = (userId?: string | null, role?: string | null): void => {
  if (!userId || !role || (memoryRoleCache?.userId === userId && memoryRoleCache.role === role)) return;
  memoryRoleCache = { userId, role };
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      window.localStorage?.setItem(ROLE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(memoryRoleCache));
    } catch {}
  }
};

export const KINETIC_CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES = [
  'socio',
  'afiliado',
  'club',
  'especialista',
  'operador_b2b',
  'negocio',
  'estadio',
] as const;

export type KineticCanonicalB2BRole = (typeof KINETIC_CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES)[number];

export const KINETIC_B2B_ACCOUNT_TYPE_ALIASES = [
  'b2b',
  'partner_b2b',
  'partner b2b',
  'partner',
  'operador',
  'coach_club',
] as const;

export const KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_ROLES = ['admin', 'fundador', 'ceo'] as const;

export const KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_LIST = [
  'administrador@kinetic.com.mx',
  'administrador@kinetic.com',
  'kinetic@kinetic.com',
  'admin@kinetic.com',
] as const;

const MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET = new Set<string>(KINETIC_MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_LIST);
const CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES_SET = new Set<string>(KINETIC_CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES);
const B2B_ALL_ROLES_SET = new Set<string>([
  ...KINETIC_CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES,
  ...KINETIC_B2B_ACCOUNT_TYPE_ALIASES,
]);

export const normalizeRoleToken = (raw: unknown): string =>
  String(raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();

export const isMasterAdminEmailOnly = (rawEmail: unknown): boolean =>
  MASTER_ADMIN_EMAILS_SET.has(normalizeRoleToken(rawEmail));

export const isKineticMasterAdminRole = (rawRole: unknown, rawEmail?: unknown): boolean => {
  if (isMasterAdminEmailOnly(rawEmail)) return true;
  const r = normalizeRoleToken(rawRole);
  return r === 'admin' || r === 'fundador' || (r === 'ceo' && isMasterAdminEmailOnly(rawEmail));
};

export const isCanonicalB2BRoleToken = (rawRole: unknown): boolean =>
  CANONICAL_B2B_ROLES_SET.has(normalizeRoleToken(rawRole));

export const isKineticB2BRoleText = (rawRole: unknown): boolean =>
  B2B_ALL_ROLES_SET.has(normalizeRoleToken(rawRole));

export const hasAnyKineticMasterAdminRole = (
  rawEmail: unknown,
  ...roles: unknown[]
): boolean => isMasterAdminEmailOnly(rawEmail) || roles.some((r) => isKineticMasterAdminRole(r, rawEmail));

export const hasAnyKineticB2BRole = (...roles: unknown[]): boolean =>
  roles.some((r) => isKineticB2BRoleText(r));

export interface IKineticRoleClassificationSubject {
  email?: unknown;
  rol?: unknown;
  tipo_cuenta?: unknown;
  app_rol?: unknown;
  ownsActiveAffiliate?: boolean;
}

export const classifyKineticAccountRole = (
  subject: IKineticRoleClassificationSubject
): 'master_admin' | 'b2b' | 'athlete' => {
  if (hasAnyKineticMasterAdminRole(subject.email, subject.rol, subject.tipo_cuenta, subject.app_rol)) {
    return 'master_admin';
  }
  if (
    hasAnyKineticB2BRole(subject.rol, subject.tipo_cuenta, subject.app_rol) ||
    Boolean(subject.ownsActiveAffiliate)
  ) {
    return 'b2b';
  }
  return 'athlete';
};

export interface IPaginatedAuthLookupResult<T> {
  user: T | null;
  pagesScanned: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  error: unknown;
}

export async function findAuthUserByEmailPaginated<
  T extends { id?: string; email?: string | null },
>(
  listPageFn: (page: number, perPage: number) => Promise<{ users: T[]; error?: unknown }>,
  rawEmail: string,
  opts?: { perPage?: number; maxPages?: number }
): Promise<IPaginatedAuthLookupResult<T>> {
  const target = normalizeRoleToken(rawEmail);
  if (!target) return { user: null, pagesScanned: 0, truncated: false, error: null };
  const rawPerPage = Number(opts?.perPage);
  const rawMaxPages = Number(opts?.maxPages);
  const perPage = Math.max(1, Math.min(1000, Number.isFinite(rawPerPage) ? Math.floor(rawPerPage) : 200));
  const maxPages = Math.max(1, Math.min(500, Number.isFinite(rawMaxPages) ? Math.floor(rawMaxPages) : 200));
  let pagesScanned = 0;
  let reachedNaturalEnd = false;

  for (let page = 1; page <= maxPages; page += 1) {
    const res = await listPageFn(page, perPage);
    pagesScanned += 1;
    if (res?.error) {
      return { user: null, pagesScanned, truncated: false, error: res.error };
    }
    const users = Array.isArray(res?.users) ? res.users : [];
    const match = users.find((u) => normalizeRoleToken(u?.email) === target) || null;
    if (match) {
      return { user: match, pagesScanned, truncated: false, error: null };
    }
    if (users.length < perPage) {
      reachedNaturalEnd = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  return { user: null, pagesScanned, truncated: !reachedNaturalEnd, error: null };
}

import { FlatList, Platform, ScrollView, Text, TextInput } from 'react-native';
import { readInitialWebPreferencesSync, syncNativeAndWebThemeSurface } from '../context/KineticPreferencesContext';

interface DefaultPropsHost {
  defaultProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export function enforceDarkNativeWindowAndWebLocks(
  resolved?: 'dark' | 'light',
  lang?: 'es' | 'en'
): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;
  const bootPrefs = readInitialWebPreferencesSync();
  syncNativeAndWebThemeSurface(resolved ?? bootPrefs.resolvedTheme, lang ?? bootPrefs.language);
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.getElementById('kinetic-web-button-cleaner')) {
    const cleaner = document.createElement('style');
    cleaner.id = 'kinetic-web-button-cleaner';
    cleaner.textContent =
      'button, [role="button"] { outline: none !important; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important; }';
    document.head.appendChild(cleaner);
  }
}

export function applyGlobalSystemLocks(): void {
  try {
    const textHost = Text as unknown as DefaultPropsHost;
    if (textHost) {
      textHost.defaultProps = { ...(textHost.defaultProps || {}), allowFontScaling: false, maxFontSizeMultiplier: 1 };
    }
    const textInputHost = TextInput as unknown as DefaultPropsHost;
    if (textInputHost) {
      textInputHost.defaultProps = { ...(textInputHost.defaultProps || {}), allowFontScaling: false, maxFontSizeMultiplier: 1 };
    }
    if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
      const flatListHost = FlatList as unknown as DefaultPropsHost;
      if (flatListHost) flatListHost.defaultProps = { ...(flatListHost.defaultProps || {}), removeClippedSubviews: false };
      const scrollViewHost = ScrollView as unknown as DefaultPropsHost;
      if (scrollViewHost) scrollViewHost.defaultProps = { ...(scrollViewHost.defaultProps || {}), removeClippedSubviews: false };
    }
  } catch {}
}

// Motor de Traducción Semántica Inteligente ES/EN con Preservación de Entidades (Entity-Lock)

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { AMENITY_ID_EN_MAP, translateAmenityLabelEn } from '../constants/kineticAmenitiesTranslations';
import {
  CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP,
  DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP,
  DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP,
  ENTITY_LOCK_BRAND_NAMES,
} from '../constants/kineticDisciplineMap';
import {
  lookupLiveClubBioEn,
  translateSpanishVenueBioFallback,
} from './kineticBioTranslatorEn';
import {
  type IChallengeLocalizable,
  localizeKineticChallengeEn,
} from '../constants/challenges250LocalizationLeaf';
import type { KineticLanguage } from '../constants/kineticTranslations';

let activeKineticLanguage: KineticLanguage = 'es';

AsyncStorage.getItem('@kinetic_language_v25')
  .then((saved) => {
    if (saved === 'en' || saved === 'es') activeKineticLanguage = saved;
  })
  .catch((err: unknown) => { void err; });

export const getActiveKineticLanguage = (): KineticLanguage => activeKineticLanguage;

export const setActiveKineticLanguage = (lang: KineticLanguage): void => {
  activeKineticLanguage = lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es';
};

const SORTED_BRAND_ENTITIES = [...ENTITY_LOCK_BRAND_NAMES].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);

const escapeRegex = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

export const protectEntities = (text: string): { masked: string; tokens: string[] } => {
  const tokens: string[] = [];
  let masked = text;

  const lockMatch = (val: string) => {
    const idx = tokens.length;
    tokens.push(val);
    return `__KNT_ENT_${idx}__`;
  };

  masked = masked.replace(/\bKNT-[A-Z0-9-]+\b/g, lockMatch);
  masked = masked.replace(/@[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, lockMatch);

  for (const entity of SORTED_BRAND_ENTITIES) {
    if (!entity || !masked.includes(entity)) continue;
    const re = new RegExp(escapeRegex(entity), 'g');
    masked = masked.replace(re, lockMatch);
  }

  return { masked, tokens };
};

export const restoreEntities = (masked: string, tokens: string[]): string =>
  masked.replace(/__KNT_ENT_(\d+)__/g, (_, i) => tokens[Number(i)] ?? '');

export const isEntityLockedBrand = (name?: string | null): boolean => {
  const clean = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean) return false;
  return SORTED_BRAND_ENTITIES.some((b) => b.toLowerCase() === clean);
};

const normalizeDisciplineLookupKey = (value: string): string =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

const NORMALIZED_DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP: Record<string, string> = (() => {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP)) {
    map[normalizeDisciplineLookupKey(k)] = v;
  }
  map['ninguno'] = 'None';
  map['ninguna'] = 'None';
  map['sin filtro'] = 'None';
  map['voleibol'] = 'Volleyball';
  map['padel'] = 'Padel';
  map['futbol'] = 'Soccer';
  map['natacion'] = 'Swimming';
  return map;
})();

export const translateDiscipline = (
  cat?: string | null,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const raw = String(cat ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw || lang !== 'en') return raw;

  if (DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[raw]) {
    return raw === raw.toUpperCase() ? DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[raw].toUpperCase() : DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[raw];
  }

  const normKey = normalizeDisciplineLookupKey(raw);
  const directHit = NORMALIZED_DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[normKey];
  if (directHit) {
    return raw === raw.toUpperCase() ? directHit.toUpperCase() : directHit;
  }

  for (const sep of ['•', '|', '/', ',']) {
    if (raw.includes(sep)) {
      const joiner = sep === ',' ? ', ' : ` ${sep} `;
      return raw.split(sep).map((part) => translateDiscipline(part.trim(), lang)).join(joiner);
    }
  }
  return raw;
};

const RARITY_RULES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [

  [/CARGA (\d+\/\d+)\s*•\s*ÉPICO PÚRPURA/gi, 'CHARGE $1 • EPIC PURPLE'],

];

export const translateRarity = (rarity?: string | null, lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage): string => {
  const raw = String(rarity ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw || lang !== 'en') return raw;
  return RARITY_RULES.reduce((acc, [re, rep]) => acc.replace(re, rep), raw);
};

const HOURS_ES_RULES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/Monday to Friday|Mon[–-]Fri/gi, 'Lunes a Viernes'], [/Monday to Saturday|Mon[–-]Sat/gi, 'Lunes a Sábado'],
  [/Monday to Sunday|Mon[–-]Sun/gi, 'Lunes a Domingo'], [/Tuesday to Sunday|Tue[–-]Sun/gi, 'Martes a Domingo'],

  [/(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s+to\s+(\d{1,2}:\d{2})/gi, '$1 a $2'],
];
const HOURS_EN_RULES: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/Lunes a Viernes|Lun\s*[-–a]\s*Vie/gi, 'Monday to Friday'],
  [/Lunes a Sábados?|Lunes a Sabados?|Lun\s*[-–a]\s*S[áa]b/gi, 'Monday to Saturday'],

  [/\bLunes\b/gi, 'Monday'], [/\bMartes\b/gi, 'Tuesday'], [/\bMi[ée]rcoles\b/gi, 'Wednesday'],

];

export const translateOperatingHours = (raw?: string | null, lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage): string => {
  const str = String(raw || '').trim().replace(/\b2[4-9]:(\d{2})\b/g, '20:$1');
  if (!str) return '';
  const rules = lang === 'es' ? HOURS_ES_RULES : HOURS_EN_RULES;
  return rules.reduce((acc, [re, rep]) => acc.replace(re, rep), str);
};

const normalizeTeamTerminology = (text: string, lang: KineticLanguage): string => {
  if (!text) return text;
  const re = /\b(KinetiSquads?|Escuadrones|Escuadr[óo]n|Tribus|Tribu|Squads|Squad)\b/gi;
  return text.replace(re, (m) => {
    const isPlural = /s$/i.test(m) || /^escuadrones$/i.test(m);
    const word = lang === 'en' ? (isPlural ? 'Teams' : 'Team') : (isPlural ? 'Equipos' : 'Equipo');
    if (m === m.toUpperCase()) return word.toUpperCase();
    if (m[0] === m[0].toUpperCase()) return word;
    return word.toLowerCase();
  });
};

export const translateDynamicContent = (
  text?: string | null,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const raw = String(text ?? '');
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return raw;
  if (lang === 'es') {
    if (/(Monday|Tuesday|Mon[–-]|Tue[–-]|Weekends|\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s+to\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2})/i.test(trimmed)) {
      return normalizeTeamTerminology(translateOperatingHours(trimmed, 'es'), 'es');
    }
    return normalizeTeamTerminology(raw, 'es');
  }
  if (isEntityLockedBrand(trimmed)) return raw;

  const liveBioDirect = lookupLiveClubBioEn(trimmed);
  if (liveBioDirect) return normalizeTeamTerminology(liveBioDirect, 'en');
  if (CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[trimmed]) return normalizeTeamTerminology(CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[trimmed], 'en');
  if (DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[trimmed]) return normalizeTeamTerminology(DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[trimmed], 'en');
  const amenityDirectHit = translateAmenityLabelEn(trimmed);
  if (amenityDirectHit) return amenityDirectHit;
  if (DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[trimmed]) return DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[trimmed];
  if (ALERT_AND_UI_EXACT_EN[trimmed]) return normalizeTeamTerminology(ALERT_AND_UI_EXACT_EN[trimmed], 'en');

  const athleteCapMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\s+Atletas?$/i);
  if (athleteCapMatch) {
    const n = Number(athleteCapMatch[1]);
    return `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'Athlete' : 'Athletes'}`;
  }
  const spotsCapMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\s+Lugares?$/i);
  if (spotsCapMatch) {
    const n = Number(spotsCapMatch[1]);
    return `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'Spot' : 'Spots'}`;
  }
  const minsMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\s+min(?:utos)?$/i);
  if (minsMatch) return `${minsMatch[1]} min`;

  // Extract optional [Frecuencia Programada: X] suffix
  let freqSuffix = '';
  let working = trimmed.replace(/\s*\[Frecuencia Programada:\s*([^\]]+)\]\s*$/i, (_, f) => {
    const fEn = DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[f.trim()] || f.trim();
    freqSuffix = ` [Scheduled Frequency: ${fEn}]`;
    return '';
  });

  const liveBioWorking = lookupLiveClubBioEn(working);
  if (liveBioWorking) return liveBioWorking + freqSuffix;
  if (CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[working]) return CATALOG_CLUB_BIO_EN_MAP[working] + freqSuffix;
  if (DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[working]) return DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[working] + freqSuffix;

  // Comma-separated requirements or amenities list
  if (working.includes(', ')) {
    const parts = working.split(', ').map((p) => p.trim());
    if (parts.every((p) => Boolean(DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[p] || DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[p] || translateAmenityLabelEn(p)))) {
      return (
        parts
          .map((p) => DYNAMIC_PHRASE_EN_MAP[p] || translateAmenityLabelEn(p) || DISCIPLINE_EN_MAP[p] || p)
          .join(', ') + freqSuffix
      );
    }
  }

  // Schedules ("Lunes a Viernes • 06:00 a 22:00 | Lun-Sáb • 06:00 a 21:00")
  if (
    /(Lunes|Martes|Mi[ée]rcoles|Jueves|Viernes|S[áa]bados?|Domingos?|Lun\s*[-–a]|Mar\s*[-–a]|Fines de Semana|D[íi]as Personalizados)/i.test(
      working
    ) ||
    /\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s+a\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}/i.test(working)
  ) {
    return translateOperatingHours(working, 'en') + freqSuffix;
  }

  // Autogenerated club bio template
  const autoClubMatch = working.match(
    /^Ubicado en (.+?),\s*(.+?)\s+es un espacio verificado dentro de la red Kinetic dedicado al entrenamiento deportivo y bienestar de alto nivel(?:\s+en Los Cabos)?\.?$/i
  );
  if (autoClubMatch) {
    return `Located in ${autoClubMatch[1]}, ${autoClubMatch[2]} is a verified training & wellness space in the Kinetic network dedicated to high-performance fitness and recovery.${freqSuffix}`;
  }

  // Autogenerated session template: "Sesión certificada de X en Y..."
  const autoSessionMatch = working.match(/^Sesión certificada de (.+?) en (.+?)\.?$/i);
  if (autoSessionMatch) {
    const discEn = translateDiscipline(autoSessionMatch[1].trim(), 'en');
    return `Certified session of ${discEn} at ${autoSessionMatch[2].trim()}.${freqSuffix}`;
  }

  // General semantic pass with Entity-Lock protection
  const { masked, tokens } = protectEntities(working);
  let translated = masked
    .replace(/^Ubicado en el corazón de /i, 'Located in the heart of ')
    .replace(/^Ubicado estratégicamente en /i, 'Strategically located in ')
    .replace(/^Ubicado en /i, 'Located in ')
    .replace(/es un espacio verificado dentro de la red Kinetic/gi, 'is a verified training & wellness space in the Kinetic network')
    .replace(/Sesión certificada de /gi, 'Certified session of ')
    .replace(/Experiencia oficial de /gi, 'Official experience of ')
    .replace(/Lugar asegurado en /gi, 'Spot secured at ')
    .replace(/40% en Garantía Escrow:/gi, '40% Escrow Deposit:')
    .replace(/60% en Recepción QR:/gi, '60% at Front Desk QR:')
    .replace(/Tu pase QR de acceso te espera en la Bóveda\./gi, 'Your dynamic QR access pass awaits in your Vault.')
    .replace(/Requiere (\d+) KC \(40% en Garantía Escrow\)\./gi, 'Requires $1 KC (40% Escrow Deposit).');

  translated = translateSpanishVenueBioFallback(translated);
  return normalizeTeamTerminology(restoreEntities(translated, tokens) + freqSuffix, 'en');
};

export const translateAmenityString = (
  raw?: string | null,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const clean = String(raw ?? '').trim();
  if (!clean || lang !== 'en') return clean;
  return translateAmenityLabelEn(clean) || translateDynamicContent(clean, 'en');
};

export const translateAmenity = <
  T extends { id?: string; title?: string; titleEn?: string; desc?: string; descEn?: string },
>(
  item: T,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): T => {
  if (!item || lang !== 'en') return item;
  if (typeof item === 'string') return translateAmenityString(item, 'en') as unknown as T;
  const idKey = String(item.id ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const byId = idKey ? AMENITY_ID_EN_MAP[idKey] : undefined;
  return {
    ...item,
    title:
      item.titleEn ||
      byId?.titleEn ||
      (item.title ? translateAmenityString(item.title, 'en') : item.title),
    desc:
      item.descEn ||
      byId?.descEn ||
      (item.desc ? translateAmenityString(item.desc, 'en') : item.desc),
  };
};

const parseSafeLocalDate = (isoOrDate: string | Date | number): Date | null => {
  if (isoOrDate instanceof Date) return Number.isNaN(isoOrDate.getTime()) ? null : isoOrDate;
  if (typeof isoOrDate === 'number') {
    const d = new Date(isoOrDate);
    return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  }
  const s = String(isoOrDate || '').trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  const ymd = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
  if (ymd) {
    return new Date(Number(ymd[1]), Number(ymd[2]) - 1, Number(ymd[3]), 12, 0, 0);
  }
  const d = new Date(s);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
};

export const formatKineticDate = (
  isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage,
  options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
): string => {
  const raw = String(isoOrDate ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';
  if (/^hoy$/i.test(raw)) return lang === 'en' ? 'TODAY' : 'HOY';
  if (/^ma[ñn]ana$/i.test(raw)) return lang === 'en' ? 'TOMORROW' : 'MAÑANA';

  const d = parseSafeLocalDate(isoOrDate ?? '');
  if (!d) return raw;
  const locale = lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'es-MX';
  const fmtOpts: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = options || {
    weekday: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
  };
  return d.toLocaleDateString(locale, fmtOpts);
};

export const formatKineticDateTime = (
  isoOrDate: string | Date | number | null | undefined,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage,
  options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
): string => {
  const d = parseSafeLocalDate(isoOrDate ?? '');
  if (!d) return String(isoOrDate ?? '');
  const locale = lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'es-MX';
  return d.toLocaleString(
    locale,
    options || { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }
  );
};

export const formatDistanceLabel = (
  km: number | string | null | undefined,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage,
  fromYou = false
): string => {
  const cleanStr = String(km ?? '').replace(/\s*km.*$/i, '').trim();
  const cleanKm = Number(cleanStr);
  const val = Number.isFinite(cleanKm) && cleanStr !== '' ? Number(cleanKm.toFixed(1)) : cleanStr || '1.2';
  const display = typeof km === 'number' && Number.isFinite(km) ? Number(km.toFixed(1)) : val;
  if (lang === 'en') {
    return fromYou ? `${display}\u00A0km from you` : `${display}\u00A0km away`;
  }
  return fromYou ? `A ${display}\u00A0km de ti` : `A ${display}\u00A0km`;
};

export const formatActiveEventsCount = (
  count: number,
  lang: KineticLanguage = activeKineticLanguage
): string => {
  const n = Math.max(0, Number(count) || 0);
  if (lang === 'en') return n === 1 ? '1 active event' : `${n} active events`;
  return n === 1 ? '1 evento activo' : `${n} eventos activos`;
};

const ZERO_WIDTH_RE = /[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g;

const COMPETITOR_TOKENS = [
  ['fit', 'pass'].join(''),
  ['class', 'pass'].join(''),
  ['gym', 'pass'].join(''),
  ['well', 'hub'].join(''),
  ['urban', 'sports'].join(''),
  ['min', 'dbody'].join(''),
];

const OFF_TOPIC_GAMING_SOCIAL_RE =
  /\b(?:xbox|playstation|ps5|ps4|nintendo\s*switch|gta\s*(?:vi|6|v|5)|grand\s+theft\s+auto|fortnite|valorant|tiktok|onlyfans|botarga|botargas|apuestas\s*deportivas|casino\s*online)\b/i;

const XSS_INJECTION_RE = new RegExp(
  [
    '<\\s*script',
    '</\\s*script',
    '<\\s*iframe',
    'javascript\\s*:',
    'on(?:error|load|click|mouseover)\\s*=',
    '\\beva[l]\\s*\\(',
    'document\\.cookie',
  ].join('|'),
  'i'
);

export type KineticUgcRejectionCode = 'XSS_OR_INJECTION' | 'OFF_TOPIC_SPAM' | 'COMPETITOR_SPAM' | 'EMPTY';

export interface KineticUgcValidationResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  reasonCode: KineticUgcRejectionCode | null;
  cleanedText: string;
}

export function sanitizeKineticUgcText(raw?: unknown): string {
  return String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(ZERO_WIDTH_RE, '')
    .replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

export function detectBlockedUgcCategory(raw?: unknown): KineticUgcRejectionCode | null {
  const cleaned = sanitizeKineticUgcText(raw);
  if (!cleaned) return 'EMPTY';
  if (XSS_INJECTION_RE.test(cleaned)) return 'XSS_OR_INJECTION';
  if (OFF_TOPIC_GAMING_SOCIAL_RE.test(cleaned)) return 'OFF_TOPIC_SPAM';
  const low = cleaned.toLowerCase();
  if (COMPETITOR_TOKENS.some((tok) => tok.length > 0 && low.includes(tok))) {
    return 'COMPETITOR_SPAM';
  }
  return null;
}

export function validateKineticUgcPayload(
  rawText?: unknown,
  options?: { allowEmptyText?: boolean; extraFields?: unknown[] }
): KineticUgcValidationResult {
  const cleanedText = sanitizeKineticUgcText(rawText);
  const parts = [cleanedText, ...(options?.extraFields || []).map(sanitizeKineticUgcText)].filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) {
    return options?.allowEmptyText
      ? { allowed: true, reasonCode: null, cleanedText: '' }
      : { allowed: false, reasonCode: 'EMPTY', cleanedText: '' };
  }
  for (const part of parts) {
    const issue = detectBlockedUgcCategory(part);
    if (issue && issue !== 'EMPTY') {
      return { allowed: false, reasonCode: issue, cleanedText };
    }
  }
  return { allowed: true, reasonCode: null, cleanedText };
}

export function isKineticUgcAllowed(rawText?: unknown, extraFields?: unknown[]): boolean {
  return validateKineticUgcPayload(rawText, { allowEmptyText: false, extraFields }).allowed;
}

export function getKineticUgcBlockedMessage(reasonCode: KineticUgcRejectionCode | null, isEn: boolean): string {
  if (reasonCode === 'XSS_OR_INJECTION') {
    return isEn
      ? 'Invalid characters or unsafe markup detected in your post.'
      : 'Se detectaron caracteres o código no permitido en tu publicación.';
  }
  if (reasonCode === 'COMPETITOR_SPAM' || reasonCode === 'OFF_TOPIC_SPAM') {
    return isEn
      ? 'KinetiClub allows sports, training, wellness, and recovery updates only.'
      : 'KinetiClub es exclusivo para comunidad deportiva, entrenamientos, bienestar y recuperación.';
  }
  return isEn ? 'Write a message or attach media before publishing.' : 'Escribe un mensaje o adjunta una foto para publicar.';
}

type FeedRowLike = {
  contenido?: unknown;
  titulo?: unknown;
  autor_nombre?: unknown;
  disciplina?: unknown;
  comentarios_json?: unknown;
  [k: string]: unknown;
};

export function filterCleanKineticUgcFeedRows<T extends FeedRowLike>(rows: T[]): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [];
  return rows.reduce<T[]>((acc, row) => {
    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return acc;
    const textParts = [row.contenido, row.titulo, row.autor_nombre, row.disciplina];
    const check = validateKineticUgcPayload(row.contenido ?? row.titulo ?? '', {
      allowEmptyText: true,
      extraFields: textParts,
    });
    if (!check.allowed) return acc;

    if (Array.isArray(row.comentarios_json)) {
      const cleanComments = row.comentarios_json.filter((c) => {
        if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return false;
        const rec = c as Record<string, unknown>;
        return isKineticUgcAllowed(rec.text ?? rec.texto ?? rec.contenido ?? '', [rec.author, rec.autor_nombre]);
      });
      acc.push(cleanComments.length === row.comentarios_json.length ? row : { ...row, comentarios_json: cleanComments });
    } else {
      acc.push(row);
    }
    return acc;
  }, []);
}

export interface IStationProjectionInput {
  row: number;
  col: number;
  rows: number;
  cols: number;
  stageWidth?: number;
}

export interface IStationProjectionResult {
  depthScale: number;
  extrusionPx: number;
  liftY: number;
  shadowWidthRatio: number;
  shadowOpacity: number;
  zIndex: number;
  frontLipPx: number;
}

const finiteNum = (v: unknown, fallback = 0): number => {
  const n = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
};

const clampRange = (val: number, min: number, max: number): number =>
  Math.max(min, Math.min(max, finiteNum(val, min)));

export function computeIsometricStationProjection(
  input: IStationProjectionInput
): IStationProjectionResult {
  const safeRows = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Math.round(finiteNum(input?.rows, 1))));
  const safeCols = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Math.round(finiteNum(input?.cols, 1))));
  const safeRow = clampRange(Math.round(finiteNum(input?.row, 0)), 0, safeRows - 1);
  const safeCol = clampRange(Math.round(finiteNum(input?.col, 0)), 0, safeCols - 1);
  const rowProgress = safeRows > 1 ? safeRow / (safeRows - 1) : 0.5;
  const centerOffset = safeCols > 1 ? Math.abs(safeCol / (safeCols - 1) - 0.5) * 2 : 0;
  const depthScale = Number((0.91 + rowProgress * 0.11 - centerOffset * 0.015).toFixed(4));
  const extrusionPx = Math.round(5 + rowProgress * 2);
  const liftY = Number((-(1 - rowProgress) * 2.5).toFixed(2));
  const shadowWidthRatio = Number((0.8 + rowProgress * 0.14).toFixed(3));
  const shadowOpacity = Number((0.2 + rowProgress * 0.16).toFixed(3));
  const zIndex = 10 + safeRow * 10 + Math.round((1 - centerOffset) * 4);
  const frontLipPx = Math.max(4, Math.min(7, extrusionPx));
  return {
    depthScale,
    extrusionPx,
    liftY,
    shadowWidthRatio,
    shadowOpacity,
    zIndex,
    frontLipPx,
  };
}

export function resolveVolumetricPerspectiveTransform(
  platformOs: string,
  rotateXDeg = 28
): {
  rotateXDeg: number;
  perspective: number;
  usePerspective3D: boolean;
  styleTransform: Array<{ perspective: number } | { rotateX: string }>;
} {
  const clampedDeg = clampRange(rotateXDeg, 0, 45);
  const safeDeg = platformOs === 'android' ? Math.min(20, clampedDeg) : clampedDeg;
  return {
    rotateXDeg: safeDeg,
    perspective: 980,
    usePerspective3D: safeDeg > 0,
    styleTransform: safeDeg > 0 ? [{ perspective: 980 }, { rotateX: `${safeDeg}deg` }] : [],
  };
}

export type StudioStepAction =
  | { type: 'PICK_STATION'; spot: number | null | undefined }
  | { type: 'OPEN_CONFIRM' }
  | { type: 'SEAL_START' }
  | { type: 'SEAL_SUCCESS' }
  | { type: 'BACK_TAP'; isBusy?: boolean; isSealed?: boolean }
  | { type: 'COLLISION_RESET' }
  | { type: 'INSUFFICIENT_KC' }
  | { type: 'MODAL_CLOSED' };

export function stepStudioBookingStepMachine(
  currentStep: 1 | 2,
  event: StudioStepAction
): 1 | 2 {
  const safeCur: 1 | 2 = currentStep === 2 ? 2 : 1;
  switch (event?.type) {
    case 'PICK_STATION': {
      const n = Number(event.spot);
      return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 ? 2 : safeCur;
    }
    case 'OPEN_CONFIRM':
    case 'SEAL_START':
    case 'SEAL_SUCCESS':
      return 2;
    case 'BACK_TAP':
      return event.isBusy || event.isSealed ? 2 : 1;
    case 'COLLISION_RESET':
    case 'INSUFFICIENT_KC':
    case 'MODAL_CLOSED':
      return 1;
    default:
      return safeCur;
  }
}

export interface IOrbitalChestFrameInput {
  angleDeg: number;
  omegaDegPerSec: number;
  dtMs: number;
  frictionPerSec?: number;
  isClaimBurst?: boolean;
  burstProgress01?: number;
}

export interface IOrbitalParticle {
  id: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  size: number;
  opacity: number;
  scale: number;
}

export function computeOrbitalChestFrame360(input: IOrbitalChestFrameInput): {
  angleDeg: number;
  omegaDegPerSec: number;
  showBackEngraving: boolean;
  particles: IOrbitalParticle[];
} {
  const dtSec = clampRange(finiteNum(input?.dtMs, 16), 1, 80) / 1000;
  const friction = clampRange(finiteNum(input?.frictionPerSec, 2.2), 0.2, 12);
  const rawOmega = clampRange(finiteNum(input?.omegaDegPerSec, 0), -2400, 2400);
  const nextOmega = Number((rawOmega * Math.exp(-friction * dtSec)).toFixed(3));
  const rawAngle = finiteNum(input?.angleDeg, 0) + nextOmega * dtSec;
  const normMod = ((rawAngle % 360) + 360) % 360;
  const roundedAngle = Number(normMod.toFixed(3));
  const angleDeg = roundedAngle >= 360 || roundedAngle < 0 ? 0 : roundedAngle;
  const showBackEngraving = angleDeg >= 105 && angleDeg <= 255;

  const spinIntensity = clampRange(Math.abs(nextOmega) / 260, 0, 1);
  const burstP = input?.isClaimBurst ? clampRange(finiteNum(input?.burstProgress01, 0), 0, 1) : 0;
  const particles: IOrbitalParticle[] = [];
  const count = 8;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const theta = ((angleDeg + i * (360 / count)) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const baseR = input?.isClaimBurst ? 34 + burstP * 68 : 48 + spinIntensity * 20 + (i % 2) * 8;
    const x = Number((Math.cos(theta) * baseR).toFixed(2));
    const y = Number((Math.sin(theta) * baseR * 0.52 - burstP * 26).toFixed(2));
    const op = input?.isClaimBurst
      ? Number(clampRange(1 - burstP * 0.9, 0.08, 1).toFixed(3))
      : Number(clampRange(0.16 + spinIntensity * 0.72, 0.14, 0.95).toFixed(3));
    const scale = Number((0.7 + spinIntensity * 0.5 + (input?.isClaimBurst ? 0.35 : 0)).toFixed(3));
    particles.push({ id: i, x, y, size: i % 2 === 0 ? 5 : 4, opacity: op, scale });
  }
  return { angleDeg, omegaDegPerSec: Math.abs(nextOmega) < 0.05 ? 0 : nextOmega, showBackEngraving, particles };
}

export function computeHoldDeleteProgress3s(
  elapsedMs: number,
  isPressed: boolean
): {
  progress01: number;
  percentInt: number;
  percentLabel: string;
  completed: boolean;
  secondTick: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3;
} {
  const safeElapsed = Math.max(0, finiteNum(elapsedMs, 0));
  if (!isPressed && safeElapsed < 3000) {
    return { progress01: 0, percentInt: 0, percentLabel: '0%', completed: false, secondTick: 0 };
  }
  const progress01 = clampRange(safeElapsed / 3000, 0, 1);
  const percentInt = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(progress01 * 100)));
  const completed = safeElapsed >= 3000;
  const rawSec = Math.min(3, Math.floor(safeElapsed / 1000));
  const secondTick: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 = rawSec === 3 ? 3 : rawSec === 2 ? 2 : rawSec === 1 ? 1 : 0;
  return { progress01, percentInt, percentLabel: `${percentInt}%`, completed, secondTick };
}

export function evaluateSubModalSwipeDismiss(
  dy: number,
  vy: number
): { shouldDismiss: boolean; clampedDragY: number } {
  const cleanDy = finiteNum(dy, 0);
  const cleanVy = finiteNum(vy, 0);
  const clampedDragY = Math.max(0, cleanDy);
  return {
    shouldDismiss: clampedDragY >= 70 || (clampedDragY > 20 && cleanVy > 0.65),
    clampedDragY,
  };
}

export const yieldNextUiFrame = (): Promise<void> =>
  new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve());
      return;
    }
    setTimeout(resolve, 0);
  });

const OAUTH_RETURN_PARAM_RE = /(?:^|[?&#])(?:code|access_token|id_token|error)=/i;

const APPLE_MOBILE_UA_RE = /\b(?:iPhone|iPad|iPod|CriOS|FxiOS|EdgiOS|OPiOS)\b/i;
const NON_APPLE_UA_RE = /\b(?:Android|Windows|Linux|CrOS)\b/i;
const SAFARI_MOBILE_RE = /\bMobile\/\w+/i;
const CHROMIUM_RE = /\b(?:Android|Chrome\/|Chromium\/)\b/i;

export function isAppleWebKitOrMobileBrowser(
  uaRaw?: string | null,
  maxTouchPoints?: number | null,
  standalone?: boolean | null
): boolean {
  const nav = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? (navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }) : null;
  const ua = String(uaRaw ?? nav?.userAgent ?? '').trim();
  const touchPts = Number(maxTouchPoints ?? nav?.maxTouchPoints ?? 0);
  const isStandalone = typeof standalone === 'boolean' ? standalone : Boolean(nav?.standalone);
  if (!ua) return false;
  if (APPLE_MOBILE_UA_RE.test(ua)) return true;
  if (/\bMacintosh\b/i.test(ua) && Number.isFinite(touchPts) && touchPts > 1) return true;
  if (isStandalone && /\bAppleWebKit\b/i.test(ua) && !NON_APPLE_UA_RE.test(ua)) return true;
  if (SAFARI_MOBILE_RE.test(ua) && /\bAppleWebKit\b/i.test(ua) && !CHROMIUM_RE.test(ua)) return true;
  return false;
}

export function resolveTopSameOriginWindow(win?: Window): Window | undefined {
  const cur = win ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : undefined);
  if (!cur) return undefined;
  try {
    if (cur.top && cur.top !== cur && cur.top.location?.origin === cur.location?.origin) return cur.top;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  return cur;
}

const safeStoreGet = (store: Storage | undefined, key: string): string | null => {
  try {
    return store?.getItem(key) ?? null;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return null;
  }
};

const safeStoreSet = (store: Storage | undefined, key: string, val: string): boolean => {
  try {
    store?.setItem(key, val);
    return true;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return false;
  }
};

const safeStoreDel = (store: Storage | undefined, key: string): void => {
  try {
    store?.removeItem(key);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
};

const readCookieByName = (doc: Document | undefined, name: string): string | null => {
  if (!doc || typeof doc.cookie !== 'string' || !doc.cookie) return null;
  const prefix = `${name}=`;
  for (const part of doc.cookie.split(';')) {
    const trimmed = part.trim();
    if (!trimmed.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(trimmed.slice(prefix.length));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      return trimmed.slice(prefix.length);
    }
  }
  return null;
};

const writeCookieByName = (doc: Document | undefined, name: string, value: string, maxAgeSec: number, isHttps: boolean): boolean => {
  if (!doc) return false;
  try {
    const secAttr = isHttps ? '; Secure' : '';
    doc.cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; Path=/; Max-Age=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(maxAgeSec))}; SameSite=Lax${secAttr}`;
    return true;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return false;
  }
};

export function writeResilientWebMirror(
  key: string,
  value: string,
  cookieName: string,
  maxAgeSec: number = WEB_PASS_COOKIE_TTL_SEC,
  win?: Window
): boolean {
  const cur = win ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : undefined);
  if (!cur) return false;
  const topW = resolveTopSameOriginWindow(cur) || cur;
  const isHttps = cur.location?.protocol === 'https:';
  const okTop = safeStoreSet(topW.localStorage, key, value);
  const okCur = topW === cur ? okTop : safeStoreSet(cur.localStorage, key, value);
  const okSess = safeStoreSet(topW.sessionStorage, key, value) || safeStoreSet(cur.sessionStorage, key, value);
  const okCookie = cookieName ? writeCookieByName(topW.document || cur.document, cookieName, value, maxAgeSec, isHttps) : false;
  return okTop || okCur || okSess || okCookie;
}

export function readResilientWebMirror(key: string, cookieName: string, win?: Window): string | null {
  const cur = win ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : undefined);
  if (!cur) return null;

  const fromCookie = cookieName ? readCookieByName(topW.document || cur.document, cookieName) : null;
  const recovered = fromSession || fromCookie;
  if (recovered) {
    safeStoreSet(topW.localStorage, key, recovered);
    if (topW !== cur) safeStoreSet(cur.localStorage, key, recovered);
  }
  return recovered;
}

export function removeResilientWebMirror(key: string, cookieName: string, win?: Window): void {

export function breakOutOfIframeToTop(win?: Window): boolean {
  const cur = win ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : undefined);
  if (!cur) return false;
  try {
    if (cur.top && cur.top !== cur.self) {
      cur.top.location.replace(cur.location.href);
      return true;
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
  }
  return false;
}

export function assignTopWindowLocation(targetUrl: string, win?: Window): void {
  const cur = win ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : undefined);
  if (!cur) return;
  try {
    const targetWin = cur.top || cur;
    if (targetWin.location?.assign) targetWin.location.assign(targetUrl);
    else if (targetWin.location) targetWin.location.href = targetUrl;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    try {
      cur.location?.assign?.(targetUrl);
    } catch (errInner: unknown) {
      void errInner;
    }
  }
}

export function hasActiveWebOAuthReturnParams(search?: string | null, hash?: string | null): boolean {
  return OAUTH_RETURN_PARAM_RE.test(String(search || '')) || OAUTH_RETURN_PARAM_RE.test(String(hash || ''));
}

export function captureInitialWebOAuthUrlOnce(liveHref: string): CapturedWebOAuthSnapshot {
  const parsed = (() => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(liveHref, 'https://kineticapp.com.mx');
      return { href: liveHref, search: u.search || '', hash: u.hash || '' };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      void err;
      return { href: liveHref, search: '', hash: '' };
    }
  })();
  const now = Date.now();
  const hasParams = OAUTH_CAPTURE_PARAM_RE.test(parsed.search) || OAUTH_CAPTURE_PARAM_RE.test(parsed.hash);
  if (hasParams) {
    _capturedOAuthSnap = { snap: parsed, capturedAtMs: now };
    return parsed;
  }
  if (_capturedOAuthSnap && now - _capturedOAuthSnap.capturedAtMs <= 15_000) {
    return _capturedOAuthSnap.snap;
  }
  return parsed;
}

export function clearCapturedWebOAuthUrlSnapshot(): void {
  _capturedOAuthSnap = null;
}

export function shouldRequireMfaOnGoogleOAuthReturn(params: {
  session?: IMfaSessionLike | null;
  userFactors?: IMfaFactorSummary[] | null;
  mfaSnap?: { requiresMfaChallenge?: boolean; checkFailed?: boolean; verifiedFactors?: IMfaFactorSummary[] } | null;
}): boolean {
  if (doesSessionRequireMfaAal2(params.session)) return true;
  const explicitFactors = Array.isArray(params.userFactors)
    ? params.userFactors
    : Array.isArray(params.session?.user?.factors)
      ? params.session.user.factors
      : null;
  const merged = [...(explicitFactors || []), ...(Array.isArray(params.mfaSnap?.verifiedFactors) ? params.mfaSnap.verifiedFactors : [])];
  const hasVerifiedTotp = merged.some((f) => f?.status === 'verified' && (!f?.factor_type || f.factor_type === 'totp'));
  if (hasVerifiedTotp && extractJwtAal(params.session?.access_token) !== 'aal2') return true;
  if (!params.mfaSnap || params.mfaSnap.checkFailed) {
    return explicitFactors === null;
  }
  return Boolean(params.mfaSnap.requiresMfaChallenge);
}

export function shouldRevokePrivateWebGrantOnHttpError(err: unknown, data?: unknown): boolean {
  if (data && typeof data === 'object' && (data as { active?: unknown }).active === false) return true;
  if (!err || typeof err !== 'object') return false;
  const rec = err as { status?: unknown; code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
  const status = Number(rec.status || 0);
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return true;
  const code = String(rec.code || '').toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'PGRST301' || code === '401' || code === '403') return true;
  return /\b(?:401|403|PGRST301|jwt expired)\b/i.test(String(rec.message || ''));
}

export function getSafeWebPushBrowserCapabilities(g?: unknown): {
  hasNotification: boolean;
  hasServiceWorker: boolean;
  hasPushManager: boolean;
  permission: string;
} {
  const root = (g ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : null)) as
    | { Notification?: { permission?: unknown }; navigator?: { serviceWorker?: unknown }; PushManager?: unknown }
    | null;
  if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') {
    return { hasNotification: false, hasServiceWorker: false, hasPushManager: false, permission: 'unsupported' };
  }
  const hasNotification = 'Notification' in root && typeof root.Notification !== 'undefined' && root.Notification !== null;
  const hasServiceWorker = Boolean(root.navigator && 'serviceWorker' in root.navigator && root.navigator.serviceWorker);
  const hasPushManager = 'PushManager' in root && typeof root.PushManager !== 'undefined';
  const permission = hasNotification && typeof root.Notification?.permission === 'string' ? root.Notification.permission : 'unsupported';
  return { hasNotification, hasServiceWorker, hasPushManager, permission };
}

export function installWebSafariIdleCallbackPolyfill(g?: unknown): void {
  const root = (g ?? (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : null)) as
    | { requestIdleCallback?: unknown; cancelIdleCallback?: unknown }
    | null;
  if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return;
  if (typeof root.requestIdleCallback !== 'function') {
    root.requestIdleCallback = (cb: (d: { didTimeout: boolean; timeRemaining: () => number }) => void): ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> => {
      const start = Date.now();
      return setTimeout(() => {
        cb({ didTimeout: false, timeRemaining: () => Math.max(0, 50 - (Date.now() - start)) });
      }, 1);
    };
  }
  if (typeof root.cancelIdleCallback !== 'function') {
    root.cancelIdleCallback = (id: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>) => {
      clearTimeout(id);
    };
  }
}

export function safePlayHtmlVideoBestEffort(
  el: { play?: () => unknown } | null | undefined,
  onBlocked?: () => void
): void {
  if (!el || typeof el.play !== 'function') return;
  try {
    const out = el.play();
    if (out && typeof (out as Promise<unknown>).catch === 'function') {
      (out as Promise<unknown>).catch((err: unknown) => {
        void err;
        onBlocked?.();
      });
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    onBlocked?.();
  }
}

const parseRgba = (val: string): [number, number, number, number] | null => {
  const m = val.match(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)(?:\s*,\s*([0-9.]+))?\s*\)/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  return [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3]), m[4] !== undefined ? Number(m[4]) : 1];
};

  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join('\n');
};

  buildOfficialPinSvgMarkup,

const KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET = require('../../assets/logo.png');

export const resolveKineticOfficialLogoWebUri = (): string => {
  try {
    const src = RNImage?.resolveAssetSource?.(KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET);
    if (src?.uri) return String(src.uri);
  } catch {}
  if (typeof KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET === 'string' && KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET.trim()) {
    return KINETIC_PIN_LOGO_ASSET.trim();
  }
  return '/logo.png';
};

export const OPENFREEMAP_STYLE_DARK = 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark';
export const OPENFREEMAP_STYLE_LIGHT = 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron';

const FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_VAR_RE =
  /(?:^|_)(GEMINI_API_KEY|GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY|STRIPE_SECRET_KEY|STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET|SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN|SUPABASE_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN)$/i;
const FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_SECRET_RE =
  /(?:^|[_-])(sk_(?:live|test)|rk_(?:live|test)|whsec_|sbp_|sb_secret_|service_role|gemini_api_key|google_maps_server_api_key)|^eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}\./i;

export function assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(val: unknown, varName = 'EXPO_PUBLIC_ENV'): string {
  if (FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_VAR_RE.test(String(varName || '').trim())) {
    throw new Error(`SECURITY_VIOLATION: Private credential variable ${varName} is forbidden in public client.`);
  }
  const clean = typeof val === 'string' ? val.trim() : '';
  if (!clean) return '';
  const lower = clean.toLowerCase();
  if (
    FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_SECRET_RE.test(clean) ||
    clean.startsWith('sk_') ||
    clean.startsWith('rk_') ||
    clean.startsWith('whsec_') ||
    lower.includes('service_role') ||
    lower.includes('gemini_api_key') ||
    lower.includes('google_maps_server_api_key')
  ) {
    throw new Error(`SECURITY_VIOLATION: Private credential detected in public variable ${varName}.`);
  }
  return clean;
}

export function resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey(
  platform: 'web' | 'android' | 'ios' = 'web',
  envSource?: Record<string, unknown>
): string {
  const runtimeEnv: Record<string, unknown> =
    envSource ??
    (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process?.env
      ? (process.env as Record<string, unknown>)
      : {});
  const specificVar =
    platform === 'android'
      ? 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_KEY'
      : platform === 'ios'
      ? 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_IOS_KEY'
      : 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY';
  const specificVal = assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(runtimeEnv[specificVar], specificVar);
  if (specificVal) return specificVal;
  if (platform === 'web') {
    const extraRaw = (Constants?.expoConfig?.extra as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.googleMapsWebKey;
    const extraVal = assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(extraRaw, 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY');
    if (extraVal) return extraVal;
    const webAlias = assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(runtimeEnv.GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY, 'GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY');
    if (webAlias) return webAlias;
  }
  return assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(runtimeEnv.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY');
}

export const KINETIC_WEB_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY = resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey('web');

export type WebGlobalMapNamespace = Record<string, unknown>;
let _googleMapsPromise: Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace> | null = null;

export const escHtml = (s: unknown): string =>
  String(s ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

export const safeImgUrl = (u: unknown): string => {
  const s = String(u ?? '').trim();
  return /^(https?:\/\/|data:image\/|blob:|\/)/i.test(s) ? escHtml(s) : '';
};

export const safeHex = (c: unknown, fallback = '#00F0FF'): string => {
  const s = String(c ?? '').trim();
  return /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/.test(s) ? s : fallback;
};

export const isWebGlSupported = (): boolean => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    return Boolean(
      canvas.getContext('webgl2') ||
        canvas.getContext('webgl') ||
        canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

export const buildPinMarkerHtml = (
  pin: {
    color: string;
    avatar: string;
    isOfficial: boolean;
    isHidden: boolean;
    svgKind: OfficialPinSvgKind;
  },
  pinScale: string,
  hiddenLabel: string
): string => {
  const officialLogoUri = safeImgUrl(resolveKineticOfficialLogoWebUri()) || '/logo.png';
  const cleanColor = safeHex(pin.color, '#00F0FF');
  const safeAvatar = safeImgUrl(pin.avatar);
  const imgSrc = pin.isOfficial ? officialLogoUri : safeAvatar;
  const numScale = Number(pinScale);
  const safeScale = Number.isFinite(numScale) ? String(Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.5, numScale))) : '1';
  const svgMarkup = buildOfficialPinSvgMarkup(pin.svgKind, cleanColor, 20);
  const inner = pin.isOfficial
    ? `<img src="${imgSrc}" onerror="if(!this.dataset.fb){this.dataset.fb='1';this.src='/logo.png';}" alt="" />`
    : imgSrc
      ? `<img src="${imgSrc}" onerror="this.style.display='none';if(this.nextElementSibling)this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';" alt="" /><div class="knt-pin-svg-box" style="display:none;">${svgMarkup}</div>`
      : `<div class="knt-pin-svg-box">${svgMarkup}</div>`;
  const hiddenTag = pin.isHidden ? `<div class="knt-hidden-tag">${escHtml(hiddenLabel)}</div>` : '';
  const wrapOpacity = pin.isHidden ? 'opacity:0.62;' : '';
  return (
    `<div class="knt-pin-zoom-wrap" style="transform:scale(${safeScale});${wrapOpacity}">` +
    `<div class="knt-pin-outer" style="background:${cleanColor}24;border:1px solid ${cleanColor}66;">` +
    `<div class="knt-pin-ring" style="border-color:${cleanColor};">${inner}</div></div>${hiddenTag}</div>`
  );
};

const injectCriticalMapCss = () => {
  const existingCrit = document.getElementById('kinetic-leaflet-critical-css');
  if (!existingCrit) {
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'kinetic-leaflet-critical-css';
    st.textContent = CRITICAL_MAP_CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  } else if (existingCrit.textContent !== CRITICAL_MAP_CSS) {
    existingCrit.textContent = CRITICAL_MAP_CSS;
  }
};

const loadStylesheetWithFallback = (id: string, urls: string[]) => {
  if (document.getElementById(id)) return;
  const lk = document.createElement('link');
  lk.id = id;
  lk.rel = 'stylesheet';
  lk.href = urls[0];
  if (urls[1]) {
    lk.onerror = () => {
      lk.onerror = null;
      lk.href = urls[1];
    };
  }
  document.head.appendChild(lk);
};

export const buildGoogleMapsJsUrl = (apiKey: string): string =>
  `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey)}&v=weekly&loading=async`;

export const ensureGoogleMapsVectorEngine = (overrideKey?: string): Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace> => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_DOM'));
  }
  const win = window as unknown as {
    google?: { maps?: WebGlobalMapNamespace & { Map?: unknown; OverlayView?: unknown; importLibrary?: (lib: string) => Promise<unknown> } };
  };
  const apiKey = assertNoSecretInPublicEnv(overrideKey || resolvePlatformGoogleMapsKey('web'), 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY');
  if (!apiKey) return Promise.reject(new Error('GOOGLE_MAPS_WEB_KEY_MISSING'));
  injectCriticalMapCss();

  if (win.google?.maps?.Map && win.google?.maps?.OverlayView) {
    return Promise.resolve(win.google.maps);
  }
  if (_googleMapsPromise) return _googleMapsPromise;

  _googleMapsPromise = new Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace>((resolve, reject) => {
    const existing = document.getElementById('kinetic-gmaps-js-sdk') as HTMLScriptElement | null;
    const waitForReady = (triesLeft: number) => {
      if (win.google?.maps?.Map && win.google?.maps?.OverlayView) {
        resolve(win.google.maps);
        return;
      }
      if (win.google?.maps?.importLibrary) {
        void win.google.maps.importLibrary('maps').then(() => {
          if (win.google?.maps?.Map) resolve(win.google.maps);
          else if (triesLeft > 0) setTimeout(() => waitForReady(triesLeft - 1), 35);
          else { _googleMapsPromise = null; reject(new Error('GOOGLE_MAPS_INIT_TIMEOUT')); }
        }).catch(() => { _googleMapsPromise = null; reject(new Error('GOOGLE_MAPS_LOAD_ERR')); });
        return;
      }
      if (triesLeft <= 0) { _googleMapsPromise = null; reject(new Error('GOOGLE_MAPS_INIT_TIMEOUT')); return; }
      setTimeout(() => waitForReady(triesLeft - 1), 35);
    };
    if (existing) { waitForReady(120); return; }
    const sc = document.createElement('script');
    sc.id = 'kinetic-gmaps-js-sdk';
    sc.src = buildGoogleMapsJsUrl(apiKey);
    sc.async = true;
    sc.defer = true;
    sc.onload = () => waitForReady(120);
    sc.onerror = () => { sc.remove(); _googleMapsPromise = null; reject(new Error('GOOGLE_MAPS_CDN_ERR')); };
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
  });
  return _googleMapsPromise;
};

export const preloadGoogleMapsWebScript = (): void => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  void ensureGoogleMapsVectorEngine().catch(() => {});
};

export const ensureMapLibreEngine = (): Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace> => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_DOM'));
  if (!isWebGlSupported()) return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_WEBGL'));
  injectCriticalMapCss();
  loadStylesheetWithFallback('kinetic-maplibre-cdn-css', MAPLIBRE_CSS_URLS);
  const win = window as unknown as { maplibregl?: WebGlobalMapNamespace & { Map?: unknown } };
  if (win.maplibregl && typeof win.maplibregl.Map === 'function') return Promise.resolve(win.maplibregl);
  if (_maplibrePromise) return _maplibrePromise;
  _maplibrePromise = new Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace>((resolve, reject) => {
    let idx = 0;
    const tryNext = () => {
      if (win.maplibregl && typeof win.maplibregl.Map === 'function') { resolve(win.maplibregl); return; }
      if (idx >= MAPLIBRE_JS_URLS.length) { _maplibrePromise = null; reject(new Error('MAPLIBRE_CDN_UNAVAILABLE')); return; }
      const sc = document.createElement('script');
      sc.src = MAPLIBRE_JS_URLS[idx++]; sc.async = true; sc.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      sc.onload = () => { if (win.maplibregl && typeof win.maplibregl.Map === 'function') resolve(win.maplibregl); else tryNext(); };
      sc.onerror = () => { sc.remove(); tryNext(); };
      document.head.appendChild(sc);
    };
    tryNext();
  });
  return _maplibrePromise;
};

export const ensureLeafletEngine = (): Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace> => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') return Promise.reject(new Error('NO_DOM'));
  injectCriticalMapCss();
  loadStylesheetWithFallback('kinetic-leaflet-cdn-css', LEAFLET_CSS_URLS);
  const win = window as unknown as { L?: WebGlobalMapNamespace & { map?: unknown } };
  if (win.L && typeof win.L.map === 'function') return Promise.resolve(win.L);
  if (_leafletPromise) return _leafletPromise;
  _leafletPromise = new Promise<WebGlobalMapNamespace>((resolve, reject) => {
    let idx = 0;
    const tryNext = () => {
      if (win.L && typeof win.L.map === 'function') { resolve(win.L); return; }
      if (idx >= LEAFLET_JS_URLS.length) { _leafletPromise = null; reject(new Error('LEAFLET_CDN_UNAVAILABLE')); return; }
      const sc = document.createElement('script');
      sc.src = LEAFLET_JS_URLS[idx++]; sc.async = true; sc.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      sc.onload = () => { if (win.L && typeof win.L.map === 'function') resolve(win.L); else tryNext(); };
      sc.onerror = () => { sc.remove(); tryNext(); };
      document.head.appendChild(sc);
    };
    tryNext();
  });
  return _leafletPromise;
};

import type React from 'react';

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
const ReactDOM = require('react-dom') as {
  createPortal?: (children: React.ReactNode, container: Element) => React.ReactPortal;
};

export const renderInWebPortal = (node: React.ReactNode): React.ReactElement | null => {
  if (!node) return null;
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.body && typeof ReactDOM?.createPortal === 'function') {
    return ReactDOM.createPortal(node, document.body) as unknown as React.ReactElement;
  }
  return node as React.ReactElement | null;
};

/**
 * Preserva la sesión en Web ante fallos transitorios de red o latencia MFA al volver a enfocar la pestaña.
 */
export function shouldPreserveSessionOnTransientMfaCheckFailure(params: {
  hasActiveValidUserSession: boolean;
  sessionRequiresAal2: boolean;
  mfaCheckFailed: boolean;
  mfaRequiresChallenge: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (!params.hasActiveValidUserSession) return false;
  if (params.sessionRequiresAal2 || params.mfaRequiresChallenge) return false;
  return params.mfaCheckFailed;
}

/**
 * Evita desmontar contenido o mostrar skeletons cuando ya existe un snapshot SWR hidratado en pantalla.
 */
export function shouldShowLoadingOnWebFocusRevalidate(params: {
  hasHydratedData: boolean;
  isExplicitManualRefresh?: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (params.isExplicitManualRefresh) return false;
  return !params.hasHydratedData;
}

/**
 * Calcula una firma determinista liviana para omitir re-renders de portal cuando la revalidación en segundo plano trae los mismos datos.
 */
export function computeStableDataSignature(payload: unknown): string {
  try {
    if (payload === null || payload === undefined) return '';
    return JSON.stringify(payload);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    void err;
    return String(payload);
  }
}

    // =====================================================================================
// KINETIC OS v2.5 — SUPABASE PRO IMAGE TRANSFORMATION ENGINE
// Misión: Reducción drástica de Egress (ancho de banda) mediante renderizado WebP en CDN.
// Docs: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage/serving/image-transformations
// =====================================================================================

export interface SupabaseImageTransformOptions {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  quality?: number; // Valor 1-100 (Default: 80)
  format?: 'webp' | 'origin' | 'avif'; // Default: 'webp'
  resize?: 'cover' | 'contain' | 'fill'; // Default: 'cover'
}

const SUPABASE_OBJECT_ENDPOINT = '/storage/v1/object/public/';
const SUPABASE_RENDER_ENDPOINT = '/storage/v1/render/image/public/';

/**
 * Transforma una URL de Supabase Storage al endpoint de Renderizado Supabase Pro
 * aplicando compresión WebP, redimensionamiento al vuelo y caché de borde.
 */
export function getOptimizedImageUrl(
  url?: string | null,
  options: SupabaseImageTransformOptions = {}
): string {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';

  // 1. Omitir URLs no optimizables en Edge CDN (Base64, Blob, rutas locales)
  if (
    trimmed.startsWith('data:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('blob:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('file:') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')
  ) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  // 2. Soporte nativo Supabase Pro Image Transformations
  const isSupabasePublicObject = trimmed.includes(SUPABASE_OBJECT_ENDPOINT);
  const isSupabaseRendered = trimmed.includes(SUPABASE_RENDER_ENDPOINT);

  if (isSupabasePublicObject || isSupabaseRendered) {
    const [baseUrlAndPath, rawQuery] = trimmed.split('?');
    const transformedBase = baseUrlAndPath.replace(
      SUPABASE_OBJECT_ENDPOINT,
      SUPABASE_RENDER_ENDPOINT
    );

    const params: string[] = [];

    // Priorizar parámetros solicitados con valores por defecto Pro
    const width = options.width ? Math.round(options.width) : undefined;
    const height = options.height ? Math.round(options.height) : undefined;
    const quality = options.quality ?? 80;
    const format = options.format ?? 'webp';
    const resize = options.resize ?? 'cover';

    if (width && width > 0) params.push(`width=${width}`);
    if (height && height > 0) params.push(`height=${height}`);
    params.push(`quality=${quality}`);
    params.push(`format=${format}`);
    params.push(`resize=${resize}`);

    // Preservar query params no conflictivos si venían en la URL original
    if (rawQuery) {
      const existingParams = rawQuery.split('&').filter((p) => {
        const key = p.split('=')[0];
        return !['width', 'height', 'quality', 'format', 'resize'].includes(key);
      });
      if (existingParams.length > 0) {
        params.push(...existingParams);
      }
    }

    return `${transformedBase}?${params.join('&')}`;
  }

  // 3. Optimización complementaria para imágenes de demostración Unsplash
  if (trimmed.includes('images.unsplash.com')) {
    const [base, rawQuery] = trimmed.split('?');
    const width = options.width ? Math.round(options.width) : 600;
    const quality = options.quality ?? 80;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(rawQuery || '');
    params.set('w', String(width));
    params.set('q', String(quality));
    params.set('auto', 'format');
    params.set('fit', options.resize === 'contain' ? 'max' : 'crop');
    return `${base}?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  return trimmed;
}

/**
 * Avatar circular de atleta o club (1:1 en WebP).
 * Ej. listas, modales de perfil, ranking KinetiClub.
 */
export function getAvatarUrl(url?: string | null, size = 160): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width: size,
    height: size,
    quality: 80,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'cover',
  });
}

/**
 * Portada principal de club, gimnasio o evento (16:9 en WebP).
 * Ej. Cartelera, cabecera de explorar y modales de detalle.
 */
export function getCoverUrl(
  url?: string | null,
  width = 720,
  height = 405
): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width,
    height,
    quality: 80,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'cover',
  });
}

/**
 * Miniaturas para tarjetas compactas, feeds o listas (WebP ultra-ligero).
 */
export function getThumbnailUrl(
  url?: string | null,
  width = 320,
  height = 200
): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width,
    height,
    quality: 75,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'cover',
  });
}

/**
 * Fotografías de alta definición para galería de instalaciones del club.
 */
export function getGalleryUrl(url?: string | null, width = 1080): string {
  return getOptimizedImageUrl(url, {
    width,
    quality: 85,
    format: 'webp',
    resize: 'contain',
  });
}

    // === src/utils/webImageCompressLeaf.ts === //
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

/**
 * Convierte cualquier URI temporal (blob: o file:) en un Data URI Base64 JPEG comprimido
 * en Web (Android Chrome / iOS Safari) para persistencia cross-dispositivo sin ciclo de imports.
 */
export async function compressWebImageUri(
  uri: string,
  maxDim = 1080,
  quality = 0.78
): Promise<string> {
  const cleanUri = String(uri || '').trim();
  if (!cleanUri) return '';

  if (Platform.OS !== 'web' || typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    return cleanUri;
  }

  if (cleanUri.startsWith('data:image/') && cleanUri.length < 900000) {
    return cleanUri;
  }

  return new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
    try {
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        resolve(cleanUri);
      }, 6500);

      img.onload = () => {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        try {
          let width = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1080;
          let height = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1080;

          if (width > maxDim || height > maxDim) {
            if (width >= height) {
              height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
              width = maxDim;
            } else {
              width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
              height = maxDim;
            }
          }

          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = Math.max(1, width);
          canvas.height = Math.max(1, height);
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!ctx) {
            resolve(cleanUri);
            return;
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = '#050505';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

          const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
          resolve(dataUrl && dataUrl.startsWith('data:image/') ? dataUrl : cleanUri);
        } catch {
          resolve(cleanUri);
        }
      };

      img.onerror = () => {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        resolve(cleanUri);
      };

      img.src = cleanUri;
    } catch {
      resolve(cleanUri);
    }
  });
}
